पदक: पदक, अम्, n. a step; a position; an office; (अस्), m. a Niṣka or weight of gold; an ornament of the neck; (अस्, आ, अम्), familiar with the Pada-pāṭha.
पदन: पदन, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what goes or moves.
पदनीय: पदनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be investigated.
पदात: पदात, अस्, m. (properly पद + आत), a foot-man, pedestrian.
पदाति: पदाति, इस्, इस्, इ (properly पद + आति), going or being on foot; (इस्), m. a pedestrian, footman, foot-soldier, peon; N. of a son of Janam-ejaya. —पदाति-जन, अस्, m. a footman, pedestrian. —पदातिजन-सङ्कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, mingled with footmen or pedestrians. —पदाति-मात्र, अस्, m. only a foot-soldier. —पदात्य्-अध्यक्ष, अस्, m. the commander-in-chief of the infantry.
पदातिक: पदातिक, अस्, m. a footman, foot-soldier, peon.
पदातिन्: पदातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having foot-soldiers; going on foot, being on foot; (ई), m. a foot-soldier.
पदातीय: पदातीय, अस्, m. a foot-soldier, footman, pedestrian.
पदार: पदार, अस्, m. the dust of the feet; a boat (= पादालिन्द).
पदास: पदास, अम्, n. (said to be fr. पद + 1. आस), with वसिष्ठस्य, N. of a Sāman.
पदि: पदि, इस्, m. (according to the Nirukta = गन्तु), Ved. an animal which uses its feet for locomotion; a bird; a particular kind of animal (?).
पदिक: पदिक, अस्, आ, अम्, going on foot, pedestrian; one Pada long; containing only one division; (अस्), m. a footman, foot-soldier; (अम्), n. the point of the foot.
पदेक: पदेक, अस्, m. a hawk, falcon.
पदेकृत्य: पदे-कृत्य (or पदे कृत्वा), ind. having placed in a position, (Pāṇ. I. 4, 76.)
पद्वन्: पद्वन्, आ, m. a road, path, way.
पन्न: पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen, gone down or down-wards, sunk, descended; gone; (अस्), m. downward motion, falling, descent, fall; creeping on the ground. —पन्न-ग, अस्, m. ‘creeping along the ground,’ a snake, serpent, serpent-demon or Nāga; a species of plant (= पद्म-काष्ठ); (आ), f. a female serpent, a female serpent-demon; (ई), f. a species of shrub (= सर्पिणी). —पन्नग-केशर, अस्, m. Mesua Roxburghii. —पन्नग-नाशन, अस्, m. ‘serpent-destroyer,’ an epithet of Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of Viṣṇu. —पन्नग-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, formed or consisting of serpents. —पन्नगारि (°ग-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of serpents,’ an epithet of Garuḍa; N. of a teacher; (also read पन्न-गानि।) —पन्नगाशन (°ग-अश्°), अस्, m. ‘serpent-devourer,’ an epithet of Garuḍa. —पन्नागार (°न-अग्° or आग्°), अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.
पद्धति: पद्धति पद्-धति। See 3. पद्, p. 529, col. 3.
पद्म: पद्म पद्म, अस्, अम्, m. n. (perhaps for an original पद्-मत्, rich in stalks, but said to be fr. rt. 2. पद्), a lotus, lotus-flower, especially the Nelumbium Speciosum (not the plant itself, but the flower which closes towards the evening; often con-founded with the water-lily or Nymphæa Alba); a lotus-like ornament; the form or figure of a lotus; a N. given by the Tāntrikas to the six divisions of the upper part of the body called Cakras, (see चक्र); a particular mark or mole on the human body; a spot; red or coloured marks on the face and trunk of an elephant; N. of a particular part of a column or pillar; an army arrayed in the form of a lotus; a particular posture of the body in religious meditation; one of the personified treasures of Kuvera as worshipped by the Tāntrikas; a particular high number, 1000 billions; N. of a constellation; (with Buddhists) N. of a particular hell (characterized by coldness); a species of fragrant plant (= पद्म-काष्ठ); the root of the Nelumbium Speciosum; a species of bdellium; a particular fragrant substance; lead; (अस्), m. a kind of temple; a kind of coitus; one of the eight treasures connected with the magical art called Padminī; a species of plant; an elephant; a species of serpent; a Nāga; N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; (with Jainas) N. of the ninth Cakra-vartin in Bhārata; an epithet of Rāma (the son of Daśa-ratha by his wife Kauśalyā); N. of a prince of Kaśmīra (founder of Padma-pura and of a temple, see पद्म-स्वामिन्); of a man; of a Brāhman; of a mythical elephant [cf. महा-पद्म]; of a monkey; of a mountain; (आ), f. ‘the lotus-hued one,’ an epithet of Śrī, the goddess of fortune and wife of Viṣṇu [cf. पद्म-श्री]; N. of two plants, Clero-dendrum Siphonanthus and Hibiscus Mutabilis; cloves; the flower of Carthamus Tinctoria; N. of the mother of Muni-suvrata, the twentieth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; N. of a female serpent-demon (= the goddess Manasā, wife of the sage Jarat-kāru; cf. पद्म-प्रिया); N. of a daughter of king Bṛhad-ratha and wife of Kalki; (अस्, आ, अम्), lotus-hued, being of the colour of a lotus. —पद्म-कर, अस्, m. a lotus-like hand, a hand like a lotus; (अस्, आ, अम्), having a lotus in the hand, holding a lotus; (आ), f. an epithet of Śrī; (अस्), m., N. of the sun. —पद्म-कर्णिक (per-haps incorrect for पद्म-कर्णिका), the capsule or pericarp of a lotus or the central part of an army arrayed in that form. —पद्म-कलिका, f. an un-blown lotus. —पद्म-काष्ठ, अम्, n. a fragrant wood used in medicine and described as cooling and tonic (= केदार-ज, पद्म-वृक्ष, &c.). —पद्-म-कीट, अस्, m. a species of venomous insect. —पद्म-कूट, अम्, n. ‘lotus-peak,’ N. of the palace of Su-bhīmā. —पद्म-केतन, अस्, m. ‘cha-racterized by a lotus,’ N. of a son of Garuḍa. —पद्म-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a Ketu. —पद्म-केशर, अस्, अम्, m. n. the filament of a lotus. —पद्म-कोश or पद्म-कोष, अस्, m. the calyx of a lotus; a particular position of the fingers resembling the calyx of a lotus. —पद्म-क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of one of four districts in Orissa held espe-cially sacred. —पद्म-खण्ड, अम्, n. a quantity of lotuses, a spot abounding with them. —पद्म-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, or पद्म-गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, lotus-scented, smelling like a lotus, fragrant as a lotus. —पद्म-गर्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘lotus-born,’ sprung from a lotus; (अस्), m. an epithet of Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; the sun; N. of a man; of a Bodhi-sattva; of a Brāhman who was changed into a swan. —पद्म-गृहा, f. ‘lotus-housed,’ ‘living in a lotus,’ an epithet of Lakṣmī. —पद्म-चारिणी, f. a small tree, Hibiscus Mutabilis. —पद्म-ज, अस्, m. ‘lotus-born,’ an epithet of Brahmā. —पद्म-तन्तु, उस्, m. the fibrous stalk of a lotus or the fibre of a lotus-stalk. —पद्म-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, looking like a lotus; (अस्), m. the resin of the Pinus Longifolia; N. of a man. —पद्म-नन्दिन्, ई, m., N. of an author. —पद्म-नाभ, having a lotus springing from his navel; (अस्), m. an epi-thet of Viṣṇu (so called because the lotus containing Brahmā, the future creator, sprang from his navel); N. of the eleventh month (reckoned from Mārga-śīrṣa); N. of a Nāga; of one of the 100 sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; of the first Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī; of various other men; of a magical formula pronounced over weapons. —पद्मनाभ-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a grammarian and lexicographer, father of Vijñāneśvara. —पद्मनाभ-बीज, अम्, n. the algebra of Padma-nābha. —पद्मनाभ-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the father of the commentator Vijñā-neśvara. —पद्म-नाभि, इस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu, (see पद्म-नाभ।) —पद्म-नाल, अम्, n. a lotus-stalk. —पद्म-निभेक्षण (°भ-ईक्ष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having lotus-like eyes, whose eyes are like a lotus. —पद्म-निमीलन, अम्, n. the closing of a lotus. —पद्म-नेत्र, अस्, m. ‘lotus-eyed,’ N. of a future Buddha. —पद्म-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a lotus-leaf, the petal of a lotus; Costus Speciosus. —पद्मपत्त्र-निभेक्षण (°भ-ईक्ष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having eyes like lotus-leaves. —पद्म-पद or पद्म-पाद, अस्, m., N. of an author, the pupil of Śaṅkara. —पद्म-पर्ण, अम्, n. Costus Spe-ciosus. —पद्म-पाणि, इस्, m. ‘lotus-handed,’ ‘holding a lotus in his hand,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Viṣṇu; the sun; N. of a particular Buddha; epithet of the Bodhi-sattva Avalokiteśvara. —पद्म-पादाचार्य (°द-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —पद्म-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a city founded by Padma. —पद्म-पुराण, अम्, n. ‘Lotus-purāṇa,’ N. of a Purāṇa describing the period during which the world was a lotus. —पद्म-पुष्प, अस्, m. the plant Pterospermum Acerifolium; a species of small bird (= पिकाङ्ग). —पद्म-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a future Buddha; of a divine being; (with Jainas) of the sixth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī. —पद्म-प्रिया, f. an epithet of the goddess Manasā, wife of Jarat-kāru. —पद्म-बन्ध, अस्, m. an artificial arrangement of the words of a verse in a figure representing a lotus-flower, (the several syllables being distributed on the eight petals of the flower and a syllable to be repeated before each group of syllables being written on the part representing the pericarp.) —पद्म-बन्धु, उस्, m. ‘friend of the lotus,’ an epithet of the Sun; a bee. —पद्म-बीज, अम्, n. a lotus-seed, the seed of a lotus. —पद्मबीजाभ (°ज-आभ्°), अम्, n. ‘resembling the lotus-seed,’ the seed of Euryala Ferox. —पद्म-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘lotus-born,’ ‘produced from a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā. —पद्म-भास, अस्, m. ‘brilliant with a lotus,’ or ‘bright as a lotus,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu; [cf. पद्म-हास।] —पद्म-भू, ऊस्, m. ‘lotus-born,’ an epithet of Brahmā. —पद्म-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of lotus-flowers. —पद्म-मालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ‘lotus-garlanded,’ wearing a gar-land of lotuses; (ई), m., N. of a Rakṣas; (इनी), f. an epithet of Śrī. —पद्म-मिहिर, अस्, m., N. of the writer of a history of Kaśmīra. —पद्म-मुखी, f. a species of prickly nightshade, Alhagi Maurorum. —पद्म-योनि, इस्, or पद्म-योनिन्, ई, m. ‘lotus-born,’ ‘sprung from a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā; N. of a man. —पद्म-रथ, अस्, m., N. of two princes. —पद्म-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, lotus-hued, of the colour of a lotus; (अस्), m. a ruby; (ई), f., N. of one of the tongues of Fire. —पद्मराग-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of rubies. —पद्म-राज, अस्, m., N. of two persons. —पद्म-रूप, आ, f. ‘lotus-hued,’ an epithet of Śrī. —पद्म-रेखा, f. a line in the palm of the hand indicating the acquisition of great wealth. —पद्म-लाञ्छन, अस्, m. ‘marked or symbol-ized by a lotus,’ a king; an epithet of Brahmā; an epithet of Kuvera; the sun; (आ), f. an epithet of the goddess Śrī; an epithet of Sarasvatī; an epi-thet of Tārā. —पद्म-लेखा, f., N. of a woman. —पद्म-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, lotus-eyed. —पद्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, full of lotuses, abounding in lotus-flowers; (अती), f., N. of a wife of A-śoka. —पद्म-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, lotus-hued, lotus-coloured; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Yadu. —पद्मवर्णक, अम्, n. Costus Speciosus. —पद्म-वासा, f. ‘dwelling in a lotus,’ an epithet of Śrī (as having dwelt at the creation within the petals of a lotus). —पद्म-वा-हिनी, f., N. of a work. —पद्म-विषय, अस्, m., N. of a country. —पद्म-वृक्ष, अम्, n. = पद्म-काष्ठ, q. v. —पद्म-वृषभ-विक्रा-मिन्, ई, m., N. of a future Buddha. —पद्म-व्यूह, अस्, m., N. of a Sam-ādhi. —पद्म-शस्, ind. by thousands of billions. —पद्म-श्री, ईस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva; (ईस्), f., N. of two princesses. —पद्मश्री-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —पद्म-षण्ड, अम्, n. a quantity or multitude of lotuses; [cf. पद्म-खण्ड।] —पद्म-सङ्काश, अस्, आ, अम्, lotus-like, resembling a lotus. —पद्म-समासन, अस्, m. ‘having a seat like a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā. —पद्म-सम्भव, अस्, m. ‘sprung from a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā; N. of a Buddhist scholar. —पद्म-सरस्, अस्, n. ‘lotus-lake,’ N. of various lakes. —पद्म-सूत्र, अम्, n. a garland of lotuses. —पद्म-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पद्म-सौगन्धिक, अस्, ई, अम्, fragrant as a lotus. —पद्म-स्नुषा, f. ‘daughter-in-law of a lotus,’ an epithet of Gaṅgā; of Śrī; of Durgā. —पद्म-स्वस्तिक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a mystical mark consisting of lotus-flowers; (according to the scholiast) a four-cornered sort of painting. —पद्म-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a sacred edifice built by Padma. —पद्-म-हास, अस्, m. ‘smiling like a lotus or with a lotus,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu; [cf. पद्म-भास।] —पद्माकर (°म-आक्°), अस्, m. a lotus-pool; a large deep tank or pond abounding in lotuses. —पद्माकर-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a scholar. —पद्माकार (°म-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, lotus-shaped, shaped like a lotus. —पद्माक्ष (°म-अक्ष), अस्, ई, अम्, lotus-eyed, having eyes like a lotus; (अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; N. of a man; (अम्), n. the seed of the lotus. —पद्माट (°म-आट), अस्, m. Cassia Tora. —पद्मान्तर (°म-अन्°), अस्, m. a lotus-leaf, the petal of a lotus. —पद्-मालय (°म-आल्°), अस्, m. ‘dwelling in a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā; (आ), f. an epithet of Śrī. —पद्मासन (°म-आस्°), अम्, n. a lotus-seat, a seat or throne in the shape of a lotus, especially one on which idols are placed; a particular posture in religious meditation, sitting with the thighs crossed with one hand resting on the left thigh, the other held up with the thumb upon the heart, and the eyes directed to the tip of the nose; a kind of coitus; (अस्, आ, अम्), ‘sitting in a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Śiva; of the goddess Manasā; sitting in the position called Padmāsana; (अस्), m. the sun. —पद्-माह्वा (°म-आह्°), f. = पद्म-चारिणी, q. v. —पद्-मे-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, reclining or sleeping on a lotus; (अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu. —पद्मोत्-तम (°म-उत्°), अस्, m., N. of a future Buddha. —पद्मोत्तर (°म-उत्°), अस्, m. the plant Car-thamus Tinctorius; N. of a man; of a Buddha. —पद्मोत्तरात्म-ज (°र-आत्°), अस्, m. ‘son of Padmottara,’ (with Jainas) epithet of the ninth Cakra-vartin in Bhārata. —पद्मोद्भव (°म-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘sprung from a lotus,’ an epithet of Brahmā, of the goddess Manasā; (अस्), m., N. of a man; origin of the lotus (?). —पद्मोद्भव-प्रादुर्भाव (°म-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘the manifestation of Brahmā on the lotus,’ N. of the ninth chapter of the first part of the Kūrma-purāṇa.
पद्मक: पद्मक, अस्, m. an army arrayed in the form of a lotus-flower; N. of several men; (अस्, अम्), m. n. red or coloured spots on the skin of an ele-phant; Costus Speciosus or Arabicus; (अम्), n. a par-ticular posture in sitting; a species of tree and its wood which is used for various purposes (= पद्म-काष्ठ = कुष्ठ, Costus Speciosus or Arabicus). —पद्मकामलक-प्लक्ष-कदम्बोडुम्बरा-वृत (°क-आम्°, °ब-उड्°, °र-आव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, filled with lotuses, Emblic Myrobalans, fig-trees, Nau-clea Kadambas and Uḍumbaras (a kind of fig-tree).
पद्मकिन्: पद्मकिन्, ई, m. the Indian birch tree (= भूर्ज), the bark of which is used for writing upon, &c.
पद्मावत: पद्मावत, अस्, m., N. of a kingdom founded by Padma-varṇa.
पद्मावती: पद्मावती, f. Hibiscus Mutabilis; a kind of Prākṛt metre; an epithet of Lakṣmī; N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; an epithet of the goddess Manasā; N. of a divine being executing the orders of the twenty-third Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; N. of a wife of king Śṛgāla; of a wife of Yudhi-ṣṭhira, king of Kaśmīra; of the wife of Jaya-deva; of a poetess; of a wife of king Vīra-bāhu; of king Naya-pāla; of a city; of a river; of the seventeenth Lambaka of the Kathā-sarit-sāgara. —पद्मावती-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘husband of Padmāvatī,’ an epithet of Jarat-kāru.
पद्मिन्: पद्मिन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing lotuses; spotted or having coloured marks (as an elephant); (ई), m. an elephant; (इनी), f. a lotus, Nelumbium Speciosum, (the whole plant, whereas पद्म is properly only the flower; the same difference exists between अब्ज and अब्जिनी, नलिन and नलिनी, &c.); a mul-titude of lotuses or lake abounding in them; a lotus-pool, a pool or pond (especially one deep enough for the growth of the lotus); the fibrous stalk of a lotus; a female elephant; a particular magical art; a woman of the first and most excellent of the four classes into which the sex is distinguished; N. of a woman. —पद्-मिनी-कण्टक, अस्, m., N. of a kind of leprosy. —पद्मिनी-कान्त, अस्, m. ‘beloved of the lotuses,’ an epithet of the Sun, (so called because the Nelum-bium Speciosum closes towards the evening.) —पद्-मिनी-खण्ड, अम्, n. a multitude of lotuses, a place abounding in lotuses or district in which they grow. —पद्मिनी-वल्लभ, अस्, m. ‘friend of the lotuses,’ an epithet of the Sun. —पद्मिनीश (°नी-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of the lotuses,’ the Sun.
पद्य: पद्य पद्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 3. पद् or पद), relating to or belonging to the foot; paining or hurting or coming in contact with the feet; bearing traces of the feet, marked with footprints, measuring a Pada in length, (at the end of a comp. with a preceding numeral, e. g. दश-पद्य, ten Padas long); consisting of Padas, formed of parts of verses; consisting of one Pada; belonging to a word; final; (अस्), m. a Śūdra (as sprung from the feet of Brahmā); a part of a word, a verbal element; (आ), f. a way, path, road; (आस्), f. pl., Ved. footsteps, paces; (अम्), n. a verse, metre, poetry. —पद्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of verses. —पद्य-वेणी, f., N. of a collection of poems by Veṇī-datta. —पद्य-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. a collection of verses, N. of a collection of twenty verses ascribed to Kavi-bhaṭṭa.
पद्र: पद्र पद्र, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. पद्), a village; the entrance into a village; the earth; a particular district.
पद्व: पद्व पद्व, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. पद्), the abode or world of human beings; a road; a car; (निसर्ग-पद्व, अस्, ई, अम्, naturally inclined to, feeling attracted towards.)
पन्: पन् पन्, cl. 1. P. A. पनायति, -ते, (Ved. पनयति, -ते), पेने, पनिता or पना-यिता, पनितुम् or पनायितुम् (mostly Ved.), to be worthy of admiration; to admire; to regard with surprise or wonder; to praise; to acknowledge, recognise; (A.) to rejoice at, be glad of, con-gratulate one's self upon (with gen.).
पनयाय्य: पनयाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. worthy of admira-tion, admirable; astonishing, surprising.
पनस्य: पनस्य, Nom. A. पनस्यते, &c., Ved. to show one's self worthy of admiration, be admirable.
पनस्यु: पनस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. showing one's self worthy of admiration, boasting; an epithet of the Maruts, of Indra, &c.
पनाय्य: पनाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. worthy of admiration, admirable, surprising.
पनित: पनित, अस्, आ, अम्, admired, praised.
पनितृ: पनितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, acknowledging with praise, praising.
पनिप्नत्: पनिप्नत्, अत्, अती, अत् (pres. part. of the Intens.), Ved. showing one's self worthy of admiration or praise.
पनिष्टम: पनिष्टम, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps for पनिष्ठ-तम, cf. नेदिष्ठ-तम), Ved. highly praised; (but Sāy. takes it for 1st pers. pl. = स्तुमः।)
पनिष्टि: पनिष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. (perhaps) admiration, praise.
पनिष्ठ: पनिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. very wonderful, exceedingly glorious or praiseworthy.
पनीयस्: पनीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. more wonderful or praiseworthy, very wonderful.
पनु: पनु, उस्, or पनू, ऊस्, Ved. admiration, praise.
पन्य: पन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praiseworthy; astonishing.
पन्यस्: पन्यस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. = पनीयस्, more won-derful, very wonderful.
पनस: पनस पनस, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पन्), the bread-fruit or Jaka tree, Artocarpus Inte-grifolia; a thorn; a species of serpent; N. of a monkey; (आ or ई), f. a malady, pustular and phleg-monoid inflammation of the skin or external organs; a female monkey; a female demon; (अम्), n. the bread-fruit, fruit of the Jaka tree. —पनस-तालिका or (according to some) पनस-नालिका, f. the bread-fruit tree.
पनसिका: पनसिका, f. a kind of disease, pustules on the ears and neck.
पनिष्पद: पनिष्पद पनिष्पद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens. of स्पन्द्), Ved. quivering, palpitating.
पन्थ्: पन्थ् पन्थ्, cl. 1. and 10. P. पन्थति, पन्थयति, &c., to go, move.
पन्थक: पन्थक पन्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in or on the way; (अस्), m., N. of a Brāhman.
पन्दर: पन्दर पन्दर, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
पपि: पपि पपि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. पा), drinking, who or what drinks; (इस्), m. the moon.
पपीति: पपीति, इस्, f. (fr. Intens. of rt. 1. पा), mutual or reciprocal drinking, drinking alike or together.
पपी: पपी पपी, ईस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. पा, to cherish), the sun; the moon.
पपु: पपु, उस्, m. a fosterer, protector; (उस्), f. a nurse, foster-mother.
पपुरि: पपुरि पपुरि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. पॄ), Ved. liberal, giving, granting; abundant.
पपृक्षेण्य: पपृक्षेण्य पपृक्षेण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रछ्), Ved. to be wished or longed for, desirable.
पप्रि: पप्रि 1. पप्रि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. पृ), lead-ing over, delivering, saving.
पप्रि 2. पप्रि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 2. पृ), Ved. giving, granting.
पफक: पफक पफक, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पफक-नरक, आस्, m. pl. the descendants of Paphaka and Naraka.
पब्बेक: पब्बेक पब्बेक, अस्, m., N. of the father of Kedāra who composed the Vṛtta-ratnākara.
पमरा: पमरा पमरा, f. a kind of fragrant sub-stance.
पम्पस्य: पम्पस्य पम्पस्य (probably fr. an unused पम्पस्, grief), Nom. P. पम्पस्यति, to feel pain.
पम्पा: पम्पा पम्पा, f. (said to be fr. rt. 3. पा), N. of a river in the south of India; (according to a Scholiast) N. of a lake.
पम्ब्: पम्ब् पम्ब्, cl. 1. P. पम्बति, &c., to go, move; [cf. rt. कम्प्, बम्ब्, मम्ब्, नम्ब्, खम्ब्, गम्ब्, घम्ब्, चम्ब्, तम्ब्।]
पय्: पय् पय्, cl. 1. A. पयते, &c., to go, move.
पयस्: पयस् पयस्, अस्, n. (fr. rt. 1. पी or rt. पिन्व्; but said to be fr. rt. 1. पा, to drink), juice, fluid, vital spirit, power, strength (Ved.); water, rain; milk; semen virile; N. of a Sāman; N. of a Virāj; night (Ved.). —पयः-कन्दा, f. Batatas Paniculata (= क्षीर-विदारी). —पयः-पयोष्णी, f. = प-योष्णी, q. v. —पयः-पान, अम्, n. drinking milk, a draught of milk. —पयः-पूर, अस्, m. a pool, lake. —पयः-फेनी, f. a species of small shrub (= दुग्ध-फेनी). —पयश्-चय, अस्, m. a reser-voir, piece of water, lake. —पयस्-प, अस्, m. ‘milk-drinker,’ a cat; night. —पयस्-पा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. milk-drinking, drinking milk. —पयस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. full of sap or juice, succulent, juicy, liquid; full of strength or of milk, milky, containing water or milk or semen; (वत्यस्), f. pl. rivers (Ved.). —पयस्-वल, अस्, आ, अम्, rich in milk, yielding milk abundantly; (अस्), m. a goat. —पयस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, abounding in sap or milk, juicy, succulent, milky; (इनी), f. a milch cow; a she-goat; a river; N. of a river; the night; N. of various plants containing milky juice (= काकोली, क्षीर-काकोली, दुग्ध-फेनी, क्षीर-विदारी); N. of a deity. —पयो-गड, अस्, m. ‘water-drop (?),’ hail; (अस् or अम्), m. n. an island. —पयो-ग्रह, अस्, m., Ved. an oblation of milk. —पयो-घन, अस्, m. ‘water-lump,’ hail. —पयो-जन्मन्, आ, m. ‘birthplace of water,’ a cloud. —पयो-द, अस्, आ, अम्, yielding milk; (अस्), m. ‘water-giver,’ a cloud; N. of a son of Yadu; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda. —पयोद-सुहृद्, त्, m. ‘friend of the clouds,’ the peacock. —पयो-दुह्, धुक्, क्, क्, Ved. milking; giving semen (?). —पयो-धर, अस्, m. ‘water-holder,’ a cloud; ‘containing milk,’ a woman's breast; an udder; the root of Scirpus Kysoor; a species of sugar-cane (= कोष-कार); the cocoa-nut; a species of Cyperus; (in prosody) an amphibrach. —पयो-धस्, आस्, m. a rain-cloud; a piece of water, pond, lake; the ocean. —पयो-धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. sucking milk (as a calf). —पयो-धारा, f. a stream of water; N. of a river. —पयोधारा-गृह, अम्, n. = धारा-गृह, a bath-room with flowing water, shower-bath. —प-यो-धि, इस्, m. ‘receptacle of waters,’ the ocean. —पयोधिक, अम्, n. ‘sea-foam,’ cuttle-fish bone. —पयो-निधन, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman. —पयो-निधि, इस्, m. ‘receptacle of waters,’ the ocean. —पयो-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, having milk on the surface, milk-faced. —पयो-मुच्, क्, क्, क्, yielding or giving milk; (क्), m. ‘water-discharging,’ a cloud. —पयो-ऽमृत-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —पयो-राशि, इस्, f. a piece of water, the ocean. —पयो-लता, f. the plant Batatas Paniculata. —प-यो-वाह, अस्, m. ‘water-bearer,’ a cloud. —पयो-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. full of sap, superabounding with water, overflowing. —पयो-व्रत, अम्, n. the act of subsisting on mere milk in consequence of a vow, (regarded as an expiation for receiving an unsuitable present, if continued for a month with prayer and residence in a cow-house); offering milk to Viṣṇu and subsisting upon it for twelve days; also for one or for three days as a religious act; (अस्, आ, अम्), one who subsists upon mere milk in consequence of a vow. —पयोष्णि-जाता, f. an epithet of the river Sarasvatī. —पयोष्णी, f. (fr. पयस् and उष्ण), ‘warm as milk,’ N. of a river that rises in the Vindhya mountain.
पयस: पयस, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. full of juice or sap; (अम्), n. water; milk.
पयस्य: 1. पयस्य, Nom. P. A. पयस्यति, -ते, &c., to flow, be fluid.

2. पयस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, made of milk (curds, butter, cheese, &c.), milky; watery; (अस्), m. a cat; N. of one of the sons of Aṅgiras; (आ), f. coagulated milk, curds (made by mixing sour with hot sweet milk); a shrub, Asclepias Rosea; N. of various plants (= दुग्धिका, काकोली, क्षीरि-काकोली, स्वर्ण-क्षीरी, अर्क-पुष्पिका, and कुतुम्बिनी-क्षुप); any plant yielding a milky sap, as the Euphorbia, the Asclepias, &c.
पयाय: पयाय, Nom. A. पयायते, &c., to be fluid.
पयोर: पयोर, अस्, m. = खदिर, Acacia Catechu.
पर: पर पर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पृ, or per-haps fr. अप + र; declined optionally as a prono-minal in abl. loc. sing. m. n. and nom. voc. pl. m., when it denotes relative position, e. g. abl. परस्-मात् and परात्, loc. परस्मिन् and परे, nom. pl. m. परे and परास्, Ved. परासस्, see Gram. 238. अ), distant, remote, removed; opposite, ulterior, beyond, further, on the other side of (with abl. or rarely with gen., e. g. सरय्वाः परे तीरे, on the opposite or further bank of the Sarayū); past, ante-cedent, earlier, previous, former (Ved.); long past, ancient; subsequent, succeeding, following, future, next, after (with abl.); added; (at the end of a comp.) having as a following letter or sound (e. g. त-पर, having त् as a following letter, followed by त्); exceeding, left, remaining; very high or excel-lent, distinguished, pre-eminent, highest, greatest, longest, most excellent, best, supreme, principal, chief, most complete, utmost (= Lat. summus, e. g. परम् ब्रह्मन्, the Supreme Spirit); highest, latest (e. g. परः कालः, the highest or latest times; परम् आयुः, the highest or last stage of human life; used at the end of comps. to denote hav-ing anything as the highest object, completely devoted to or occupied with or engaged or engrossed in or intent upon, e. g. चिन्ता-पर, occupied with reflec-tion; ध्यान-पर, engaged in meditation, whose highest object is meditation; सुख-पर, extremely glad or happy; शोक-पर, filled with grief, whose principal occupation is grief); strange, a stranger, other, another, different, varying, foreign, alien, inimical, hostile, estranged, adverse; exceeding, having a remainder or surplus (e. g. परं शतम्, more than a hundred); left over, left as a remainder; concerned or anxious for (with loc.); (अस्), m. an enemy, foe, adversary; (sc. ग्रह) a subsidiary Soma-graha (Ved.); N. of a king of Kośala with the patronymic Āṭṇāra (Ved.); N. of a prince; (sc. प्रासाद or वास) N. of the palace of Mitra-vindā; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the Supreme, Supreme Spirit, soul of the universe, the Absolute; (आ), f., N. of a plant (= बन्ध्या-कर्कोटकी); N. of a river; (अम्), n. the highest or culminating point, acme, highest degree; final beatitude; the secondary or more remote meaning of a word; (in logic) one species of common property, that which comprehends many objects, genus; existence (regarded as the common property of all things); (अम्), ind. beyond, over (with abl., e. g. परं विज्ञानात्, beyond human knowledge); after (with abl., e. g. अस्तमयात् प-रम्, after sunset; मत्तः परम्, after me; अतः परम्, after this, after that, farther from hence, farther from here, farther on, hereupon, hereafter, next; नास्मात् परम्, no more of this, enough; ततः परम्, after that, thereupon); thereupon, thereafter (without an abl.); but, however; other-wise; rather; in a high degree, excessively, ex-ceedingly, beyond measure, completely; most wil-lingly; at the most, at the utmost; only; यदि परम्, if at all, perhaps, at any rate; (एण), ind. farther, beyond (with acc., e. g. परेणास्मान् प-रैहि, pass by us); on the other side, thereupon; afterwards; after (with abl. or gen.); (परे), ind. afterwards, in future, farther; thereupon; [cf. पार, परा; Zend para, ‘before;’ Gr. πέρᾱ, πέρας, πέρᾱν, περαίνω, περαῖο-ς, περά-τη, Πειραιεύ-ς, πεῖ-ραρ, ἀ-περείσ-ιο-ς; Lat. peren-die, per-egre, per-per-a-m; Goth. fairra, ‘far;’ Angl. Sax. far; Slav. pol-ŭ, ‘the opposite border.’] —पर-कर्-मन्, अ, n. another's work, service for others. —परकर्म-निरत, अस्, m. engaged in service for another, a servant. —पर-कलत्र, अम्, n. another's wife. —परकलत्राभिगमन (°र-अभ्°), अम्, n. approaching the wife of another, intriguing with another man's wife, adultery. —प-र-कार्य, अम्, n. another's business, the affair of another. —पर-कृति, इस्, f. the action or history of another. —पर-क्रम, अस्, m. Krama of the subsequent or second letter of a conjunction of con-sonants, (see क्रम।) —पर-क्राथिन्, ई, m., N. of a hero in the Mahā-bhārata who fought on the side of the Kurus. —पर-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. the greatest declination, inclination of the ecliptic. —पर-क्षुद्रास्, f. pl. (probably) those verses of the Veda which are the shortest or excessively short. —पर-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. another's field; another man's wife; another's body. —पर-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, being with another, present with another, relating to another. —पर-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, belonging or relating to another, beneficial to another. —पर-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, advantageous or beneficial to another or to an enemy. —पर-गृह-वास, अस्, m. dwelling in the house of another. —पर-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘the extreme point of a limb,’ an articulation, a joint. —पर-ग्लानि, इस्, f. reduction or subjugation of an enemy. —पर-चक्र, अम्, n. the army of an enemy; a hostile prince. —पर-चित्त-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowing the thoughts of another. —पर-च्छन्द, अस्, m. the will of another; dependance; (अस्, आ, अम्), depending upon or subject to the will of another, dependant, subjected, subservient. —प-रच्छन्द-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, dependant on the will of another, subjected, subservient. —पर-च्छिद्र, अम्, n. a fault or flaw or defect in another. —पर-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘born of another,’ strange, a stranger, (see पर-जात।) —पर-जन, अस्, m. another per-son, a stranger, (opposed to स्व-जन।) —पर-जन्मन्, अ, n. a future birth. —परजन्मिक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a future birth or life. —पर-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born of another, nourished or maintained by a stranger, dependant on others for sustenance, adopted, fostered by strangers; dependant, servile, subjected; (अस्), m. a servant. —पर-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, conquered or subdued by another; nourished by a stranger, (for पर-जात, q. v.) —प-रञ्-ज, अस्, m. an oil-press; froth, foam; the blade of a sword or knife, (in these three senses also read पराञ्ज, q. v.); a sword or scymitar; (आ), f. the sound of instruments at a festival; (अम्), n. Indra's sword. —परञ्-जन, अस्, m. an epithet of Varuṇa, ‘regent of the waters.’ —परञ्-जय, अस्, आ, अम्, foe-conquering; (अस्), m. an epithet of Varuṇa. —पर-तः-पोष, अस्, आ, अम्, receiving food from another, nourished by another. —पर-तङ्गण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —पर-तन्त्र, अम्, n. a rule, ritual or formula for another rite; (अस्, आ, अम्), de-pendant upon another, dependant, subject to another, subservient, obedient. —पर-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, highest, greatest, most excellent; farthest, &c. —प-र-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, greater, higher, more; farther, &c. —पर-तस्, ind. through or from another, (often taking the place of the abl. of पर, e. g. परतो ऽपि परश्चासि, and thou art greater than the greatest or higher than the highest; स्वकात् परतो वा गृहात्, from his own house or that of another); farther, afterwards, behind, (often used in native grammars after locatives with the omission of the substantive verb, e. g. शसादौ परतः [सति], when the termination beginning with शस् follows); after, over, beyond (with abl.); otherwise, differ-ently. —पर-ता, f. comprehensiveness, absolute-ness; highest degree. —पर-तापन, अस्, m. ‘pain-ing enemies,’ N. of a Marut. —पर-तीर्थिक, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —पर-त्र, ind. else-where, in another place, in a future state, in another world, in the other or next world; (अम्), n. clamour, menace. —परोपकार (°र-उप्°), अस्, m. the assisting others, doing good to another, beneficence, benevolence, charity. —परोपकारिन् (°र-उप्°), ई, इणी, इ, assisting others, supporting others, beneficent, charitable, kind to others. —परोपकारैकरस (°र-एक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wholly devoted to the service of another; (आ), f. a wife wholly devoted to her husband. —परोप-कृत (°र-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, helped or befriended by another; brought by another. —परोपजाप (°र-उप्°), अस्, m. the dissension of enemies, causing dissension among enemies. —परोपदेश (°र-उप्°), अस्, m. giving advice to others, counselling others, admonishing or instructing another, the in-struction of others. —परोपरुद्ध (°र-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, besieged by an enemy, blockaded, in-vested.
पर; (at the end of comps.) sometimes to be translated by ‘another word, another equivalent ex-pression,’ e. g. जीव-शब्दो महत्-परः, the word जीव is an equivalent expression or another word for महत्।
परक: परक, अस्, आ, अम्, = पर, at the end of an adj. comp. (e. g. इति-शब्द-परक, followed by the word इति).
परकीय: परकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to another or to a stranger, another, strange, hostile; (आ), f. the mistress or wife of another, i. e. one of the three objects of love, according to the Śriṅgāra or ama-tory doctrine.
परम: परम, अस्, आ, अम् (superlative of पर), most distant, last; highest, first, most excellent or dis-tinguished, best, greatest, chief, primary, principal, superior; exceeding; extreme; worst; more excel-lent (with abl. शिवात् परमः, more excellent than Śiva); adequate, sufficient; (अम्), n. the utmost or highest; the chief part, the most prominent part; (at the end of an adj. comp.) amounting at the highest to, consisting chiefly or principally of, occu-pied only with; (अम्), ind. (a particle of assent, affirmation, or agreement) yes, very well, well; (in a comp. before an adj. or part.) excessively, ex-tremely, very, much, in the highest degree, to a great degree, excellently; [cf. Lith. pirma, ‘the first;’ probably Lat. prīmu-s, but cf. प्र; Goth. fruma, ‘first.’] —परम-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. = पर-क्रान्ति। —परमक्रान्ति-ज्या, f. the sine of the greatest declination. —परम-क्रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, extremely angry; (ई), m., N. of one of the Viśve-devas. —परम-गति, इस्, f. any chief object or refuge (as a god, a protector); final beatitude. —परम-गव, अस्, m. an excellent bull or cow. —परम-गहन, अस्, आ, अम्, very mysterious or profound. —परम-चेतस्, अस्, n. the entire heart, all the heart. —परम-जा, f., Ved. (according to the Scholiast) = प्र-कृति, (probably for परावतः?). —परम-ज्या, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. ‘holding supreme power,’ an epithet of Indra. —परम-तस्, ind. in the highest degree, excessively; still worse. —प-रम-ता, f. the highest position or rank; highest end or aim. —परम-दारुण, अस्, आ, अम्, very dreadful. —परम-दुःखित, अस्, आ, अम्, deeply afflicted. —परम-दुर्मेधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, exceed-ingly stupid. —परम-द्रु, उस्, m. Amyris Agal-locha. —परम-नन्द, अस्, m., N. of a teacher; (perhaps a wrong reading for परमानन्द।) —परम-पद, अम्, n. the highest rank, high station, excellence; final beatitude. —परम-प-रम, अस्, आ, अम्, highest or most excellent of all. —परम-पुरुष, अस्, m. the Supreme Spirit. —परमपुरुष-प्रार्थना-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a collection of prayers addressed to Viṣṇu and other deities. —परम-ब्रह्म-चारिणी, f. an epithet of Durgā. —परम-ब्रह्मन्, अ, n. the Supreme Spirit. —परम-भास्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively radiant. —परम-मन्यु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, deeply distressed. —परम-महत्, आन्, अती, अत्, infinitely great. —परम-रस, अस्, m. ‘most excellent beverage,’ buttermilk mixed with water. —परम-राज, अस्, m. a supreme monarch. —परमर्षि (°म-ऋ°), इस्, m. ‘greatest sage,’ a Ṛṣi or divine sage of a peculiar order or division. —परम-विस्मित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly surprized or amazed. —परम-शोभन, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly bril-liant or beautiful. —परम-संहृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly rejoiced. —परम-स्वधर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, most exact in the observance of the duties of one's own (caste or tribe). —परम-हंस, अस्, m. an ascetic of the highest order, a religious man who has subdued all his senses by abstract medi-tation. —परमहंस-प्रिया, f., N. of a work ascribed to Vopa-deva. —परमहंसोपनिषद्, त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad. —परमाख्य (°म-आख्°), अस्, आ, अम्, called supreme, considered as the highest. —परमाङ्गना (°म-अङ्°), f. an ex-cellent woman, a beautiful woman. —परमाणु (°म-अण्°), उस्, m. an infinitesimal particle, an atom, the invisible base of all aggregate bodies, (of which thirty are said to form a mote in a sun-beam); the sun's passage past an atom of matter, an infinitesimal division of time; (उ), n. the eighth part of a Mātrā. —परमाणु-ता, f. infinite minuteness, the state of an atom. —परमाण्व्-अङ्गक, अस्, m. ‘subtle-bodied,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu (as being smaller than the smallest as well as greater than the greatest). —परमात्मक (°म-आत्°), अस्, इका, अम्, of the highest nature, the highest, greatest (= सुम्मुस्). —परमात्मन् (°म-आत्°), आ, m. the Supreme Spirit, soul of the universe. —परमाद्वैत (°म-अद्°), अस्, m. ‘the highest without a duplicate,’ ‘peerless,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. pure unitarianism. —परमा-नन्द (°म-आन्°), अस्, m. supreme felicity, the Supreme Spirit, soul of the universe; N. of the reputed author of the Caitanya-candrodaya, (also called Kari-karṇa-pūra or Purī-dāsa.) —परमान्न (°म-अन्°), अम्, n. ‘best food,’ rice boiled in milk with sugar (offered to gods or to the Manes). —प-रमापक्रम (°म-अप्°), अस्, m. = पर-क्रान्ति। —परमापद् (°म-आप्°), त्, f. the greatest mis-fortune. —परमापम (°म-अप्°), अस्, m. ‘great-est declination,’ the inclination of a planet's orbit to the ecliptic; the sine of the sun's greatest declina-tion. —परमायुष (°म-आय्°), अस्, m. the plant Terminalia Tomentosa. —परमायुस् (°म-आय्°), उस्, उस्, उस्, reaching or attaining to a very advanced age (Ved.); the longest period of life either in men or animals. —परमार्थ (°म-अर्°), अस्, m. the highest or most sublime truth, the whole truth, real truth, reality, truth; spiritual knowledge; any excel-lent or important aim or object; the best sense; the best kind of wealth; (आत् or एन), ind. in reality. —परमार्थ-तस्, ind. in reality, in the true sense of the word. —परमार्थ-ता, f. the highest truth, reality. —परमार्थ-धर्म-विजय, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist work. —परमार्थ-निर्-वृति-सत्य-निर्देश, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist work. —परमार्थ-प्रपा, f., N. of a commen-tary by Sūrya-paṇḍita on the Bhagavad-gītā. —प-रमार्थ-मत्स्य, अस्, m. a real fish, really a fish. —परमार्थ-विद्, त्, f. one who knows the highest truth, a philosopher. —परमार्थ-विन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, acquiring knowledge of truth, obtaining the best kind of wealth, &c. —परमार्थ-सत्य, अम्, n. the real truth, the entire or whole truth. —परमार्थ-सार, अस्, m., N. of a book. —प-रमार्थ-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, really asleep. —पर-मार्हत (°म-आर्°), अस्, m. ‘the most excellent follower of Jina,’ an epithet of Kumāra-pāla. —प-रमावटिक (°म-आव्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a school. —परमावधि (°म-अव्°), इस्, m. utmost term or limit. —परमाह (°म-अह), अस्, m. an excel-lent day. —परमेक्षु (°म-इक्षु), उस्, m., N. of a son of Anu. —परमेश (°म-ईश), अस्, m. ‘su-preme lord,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —परमेश्वर (°म-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘supreme lord,’ (said of rich or illustrious men and of princes and of gods); an epithet of Viṣṇu; of Indra; of a Jina; (most fre-quently) of Śiva; the Supreme Being; (ई), f. an epi-thet of Durgā; (अम्), n., scil. लिङ्ग, N. of a Liṅga sacred to Śiva. —परमेश्वर-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work. —परमेषु (°म-इषु?), उस्, m., N. of a son of Anu. —परमे-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing at the top, supreme, superior; (अस्), m. an epithet of Brahmā; a deity. —परमे-ष्ठि, इस्, m. (con-nected with परमे-ष्ठिन्), ‘standing at the head,’ a superior, a chief god of the Jainas. —परमेष्ठि-ता, f. supremacy, superiority. —परमे-ष्ठिन्, ई, इनी, इ, standing at the head or top, highest, chief, principal; (ई), m. an epithet of Agni or of any supreme deity; a N. of Prajā-pati; of a son of Prajā-pati; of Brahmā; of Śiva; of Viṣṇu; of Garuḍa; of Manu Cakṣus; (with Jainas) an Arhat or superior deity; a Guru or spiritual teacher; N. of a son of Aja-mīḍha; of a son of Indra-dyumna (or of Deva-dyumna); a kind of Virāj; a kind of Śāla-grāma stone; (इनौ), m. du. an epithet of Viṣṇu and Śrī; (इनी), f. a species of culinary plant (= ब्राह्मी; cf. पारमेष्ठ्य।) —परमेष्ठिन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = परमे-ष्ठिन्. —परमैश्-वर्य (°म-ऐश्°), अम्, n. supremacy.
परमक: परमक, अस्, इका, अम्, the most excellent, highest, best, greatest, extreme.
परमिक: परमिक, अस्, आ, अम्, = परम, col. 1.
परस्: परस्, ind., Ved. beyond, further, (opposed to अर्वाक्), on the other or opposite side, further on, far away, away, at a distance; in future, hereafter, afterwards, after; (with acc.) on the other side, beyond, over against, more than; (with inst.) beyond, away from, higher or more than; (with inst.) without; (with abl.) beyond, on the other side of; without, exclusive of, with the exception of, except. —पर-उरु, उस्, वी, उ, Ved. broad on the outside, broad above or at the top. —पर-ऋक्-शत-गाथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. containing in addition 100 verses of the Veda as well as Gāthās. —परः-कृष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, more than black or dark, extremely dark. —परः-पुंसा, f., Ved. a woman who is not satisfied with her husband. —परः-पुरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, higher than a man. —परः-शत, अस्, आ, अम्, more than 100; containing more than 100 verses, &c. —परः-श्वस्, ind. the day after to-morrow. —परः-षष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. more than 60. —परः-सहस्र, अस्, आ, अम्, more than 1000. —परः-सामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. ‘having super-fluous or surplus Sāmans,’ N. of certain sacrificial days. —परश्-चत्वारिंश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. more than 40. —परस्-तरम् or परस्-तराम्, ind., Ved. further away, further. —परस्-तात्, ind. (with gen.) on the other side, beyond, further on, towards, (opposed to अवस्-तात्, अर्वाक्); higher than; from afar off, from above, from before or behind (Ved.); aside, apart; under (Ved.); hereafter, afterwards, later, (opposed to पूर्वम्।) —परस्-प, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. protecting; (अम्), n. protection. —प-रस्प-त्व, अम्, n. protection. —परस्-पा, आस्, m. a protector, protecting. —परोऽंहु (°अस्-अं°), उस्, वी, उ, Ved. narrow on the outside or at the top. —प-रोऽक्ष, see s.v.
परारि: परारि, ind. the year before last.
परारित्न: परारित्न, अस्, आ or ई (?), अम्, belonging to the year before last.
परण: परण परण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पृ), Ved. crossing [cf. अरित्र-परण]; (अम्), n. reading, (a wrong form for पारण); N. of a town.
परतर्कुक: परतर्कुक परतर्कुक or परतर्कक, अस्, m., Ved. a beggar; [cf. तर्कुक।]
परमार: परमार परमार, अस्, m., N. of a son of the Ṛṣi Śaunaka (ancestor of Bhoja-deva).
पररु: पररु पररु, उस्, m. a species of pot-herb, Eclipta Prostrata; (another reading has पवरु।)
परश: परश परश, अम्, n. a species of gem.
परशु: परशु पर-शु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. शो and पर, but said to be fr. rt. शॄ and पर, hurting another), a hatchet, the axe of a wood-cutter, a battle-axe; a thunderbolt; N. of a prince; [cf. पर्शु; Gr. πέλεκυ-ς, πέλεκ-ρα, πέλεκκο-ν, πέλεκκο-ς, πελεκ-ᾶς.] —परशु-धर, अस्, m. a soldier armed with an axe; N. of Gaṇeśa; of Paraśu-rāma. —परशु-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘axe in hand,’ armed with an axe. —परशु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having an axe. —परशु-राम, अस्, m. ‘Rāma with the axe,’ an epithet of Rāma, son of the saint Jamad-agni, (the first of the three Rāmas and the sixth Avatāra or descent of the deity Viṣṇu who appeared in the world for the purpose of repressing the tyranny and punishing the violence of the Kṣatriya or military caste; he seems to typify the tribe of Brāhmans and their contests with the Kṣatriyas); N. of a modern prince by whose orders the Paraśurāma-prakāśa was composed. —परशुराम-प्रताप, अस्, m., N. of a book mentioned in the Śūdra-dharma-tattva. —प-रशुराम-प्रादुर्भाव, अस्, m. ‘the manifestation of Paraśu-rāma,’ N. of the forty-fifth chapter of the Narasiṃha-Purāṇa. —परशुरामावतार (°म-अव्°), अस्, m. ‘the descent of Paraśu-rāma,’ i. e. the incarnation of Viṣṇu in the form of Paraśu-rāma, N. of a chapter of the Khaṇḍa-praśasti (a poem ascribed to Hanu-mat). —परशुरामावतार-क-थन, अम्, n. ‘story of the descent of Paraśu-rāma,’ N. of the fiftieth chapter of the Uttara-khaṇḍa or fifth part of the Padma-Purāṇa. —प-रशु-वन, अम्, n. ‘forest of axes,’ N. of a hell (containing a forest the leaves of which are axes).
परशव्य: परशव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit or proper for a hatchet or axe; [cf. पारशव्य।]
परश्वध: परश्वध, अस्, m. an axe, a hatchet; [cf. पारश्वध, पारश्वधिक।] —परश्वधायु-ध (°ध-आय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, armed with an axe.
परश्वध परश्वध or परस्वध। See above.
परश्वधिन्: परश्वधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, provided or furnished with an axe.
परस्वत्: परस्वत् परस्वत्, आन्, m., Ved. a species of animal, (perhaps) the wild ass; [cf. पारस्वत।]
परा: परा परा (connected with पर, परस्, and प्र, probably an old inst. sing. of पर, and used as an indeclinable and inseparable prefix to verbs and nouns in the sense of) away, off; back, backward; inverted order; aside; to, towards; over, on. According to native lexicographers the senses in which परा may be used are expressed by the following Sanskrit words: आभिमुख्य, प्रातिलोम्य, गति, वि-क्रम, धर्षण, हिंसा (वध), वि-मोक्ष, भृशम्, प्रत्या-वृत्ति, भङ्ग, अन्-आदर, and न्यग्-भाव; [cf. परेण, पर-तस्, परे: Zend para: Gr. παρά, παραί, πάρ, πάλιν: Lat. per, pereo = parā-i, perdo = parā-dā: Osc. perum, ‘without:’ Goth. fra-, fair: Angl. Sax. for: Old Germ. far-, fer: Mod. Germ. ver-: Lith. par-, ‘back, again;’ per, ‘through:’ Hib. frea, far-, ‘back, again.’]
पराक: पराक पराक। See under पराञ्च्, col. 3.

पराक, distance from, (generally in loc. पराके, at a distance, or abl. पराकात्, from a distance or at a distance); (अस्), m., N. of a Tri-rātra; N. of a sort of penance or religious vow of an expiatory kind, (said to consist in fasting for twelve days and nights and keeping the mind attentive and organs subdued); a sacrificial sword or scimitar; a kind of disease; a species of animal; (अस्, आ, अम्), small. —पराकात्-तात्, ind. from a distance.
पराकाश: पराकाश परा-काश, अस्, m., Ved. distant view, remote expectation.
पराकृ: पराकृ परा-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to set aside, reject, disregard.
पराकरण: परा-करण, अम्, n. the act of setting aside, rejection, disregarding, disdaining.
पराकुर्वत्: परा-कुर्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, setting aside, throwing off, rejecting, disdaining.
पराकृत: परा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, set aside, rejected, thrown off, disdained.
पराकृष्: पराकृष् परा-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, -कर्ष्टुम्, -क्रष्टुम्, to draw or drag away; to draw down; to censure, revile.
पराकॄ: पराकॄ परा-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम्, -करीतुम्, to throw away, lose.
पराकीर्य: परा-कीर्य, ind. having thrown away; having forfeited.
पराक्रम्: पराक्रम् परा-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रमति (ep. for -क्रामति), -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, -क्रान्तुम्, to march forward, advance; to march against, attack; to turn back; to display courage or spirit, display strength or heroism; show zeal, excel, distinguish one's self.
पराक्रम: परा-क्रम, अस्, m. marching or going forth, advancing against, attacking, attack; heroism, prowess, valour, courage, power, strength, forcible means; exertion; attempt, endeavour, effort, enterprise; a N. of Viṣṇu; N. of a warrior on the side of the Kurus; of a Vidyā-dhara prince, (associated with Ā-krama, Vi-krama, and Saṅ-krama.) —पराक्र-म-केशरिन्, ई, m., N. of a prince, son of Vikrama-keśarin. —पराक्रम-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the strength (of an enemy). —पराक्रम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, valorous, spirited, heroic, courageous, possessed of power or strength.
पराक्रमिन्: परा-क्रमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, spirited, showing or dis-playing courage or strength, exerting power.
पराक्रान्त: परा-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, turned back (e. g. प-लायने, in flight); advanced; valorous, strong, pow-erful, vigorous, bold, valiant, active, energetic.

पराञ्चिन्: पराञ्चिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. not returning, not recurring.

परि: परि परि (an indeclinable particle and prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns; often परी in composition; allied to पर, परा, प्र), round, around, about, round about; further, in addition to; against, opposite to, in the way; much, excessively. (As a separable preposition, especially in the Veda), around, about (with acc., e. g. मध्यन्-दिनम् परि, about midday); against, opposite to, towards, to (with acc., e. g. वृक्षम् परि, in the direction of a tree; त्वा परि, against thee); to the share of (with acc., e. g. यन् माम् परि स्यात्, what may fall to my lot); beyond, more than (with acc., e. g. दै-वीम् परि वाक्, a voice more than divine); after, successively, severally (with acc. distributively, e. g. वृक्षं वृक्षम् परि सिञ्चति, he waters tree after tree); from, away from, out of (with abl. after verbs of motion, e. g. समुद्राद् उत वा दिवः परि, out of sea or sky); outside of, except, with exception of (with abl., e. g. परि त्रिगर्तेभ्यः, round about or outside Tri-garta); after the lapse or expiration of (with abl., e. g. परि संवत्सरात्, after the lapse of a full year); in consequence of, on account of, for the sake of (with abl., e. g. रक्षसः परि, on account of the Rakṣas); according to, in accordance with (with abl., e. g. धर्मणः परि, according to the ordinance); above, over (Ved. according to the Scholiast = अधि, उपरि). (As an adverbial prefix to nouns not immediately connected with verbs), very, excessively (e. g. पर्य्-अश्रु, very tearful; परि-दुर्बल, excessively weak). At the beginning of an adverbial comp. परि implies outside, without, except, exclusive of (e. g. परि-त्रिगर्तम्, outside Trigarta, Pāṇ. II. 1. 12, VI. 2, 33; and according to Pāṇ. II. 1, 10, it may be used in this sense at the end of an adverbial comp., but only after अक्ष, शलाका, and a numeral). At the beginning of an adjective comp., according to Pāṇ. (II. 2, 18, Vārt. 7), परि may be used in the sense of परि-ग्लान, exhausted, (but पर्य्-अध्ययन is said to mean ‘one to whom study is repugnant.’) Native lexicographers explain the senses of परि by the following Sanskrit words: आ-लिङ्गन, दोषाख्यान (दोष-कीर्तन), निर्-असन (नि-वसन), पूजा, भूषण, व्याधि, व्य्-आप्ति, उप-रम, शोक, शेष, अति-शय, त्याग, नि-यम; [cf. Zend pairi; Gr. περί, πέριξ, περι-σσό-ς, -περ; Lat. per- in adj., e. g. per-idoneus: probably Old Germ. furi; Old Iceland. fyri; Mod. Germ. für; Hib. faoi, ‘about, round.’]

परिकोप: परि-कोप, अस्, m. great or violent anger.
परिकूट: परिकूट परि-कूट, अम्, n. a barrier, a trench before the gate of a town forming a sort of covered way; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga-rāja.
परिकृ: परिकृ परि-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to surround; [cf. परि-ष्-कृ।]
परिकर्तृ: परि-कर्तृ, ता, m. a priest who performs the marriage ceremony for a younger brother whose elder brother is not yet married.

परिकृत: परि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, (Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 5044.)
परिक्रिया: परि-क्रिया, f. surrounding, inclosing, inclosing with a fence or ditch, intrenching; attending to (a sacred fire &c.), attention; (in dramatic language) allusion to future action, = परि-कर।
परिक्रिया परि-क्रिया, f. See परि-कृ, p. 538.
परिकृत्: परिकृत् 1. परि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut round, clip, cut off; to exclude from.

परिकर्तिका: परि-कर्तिका, f. sharp shooting pain, especially in the rectum.
परिकृश: परिकृश परि-कृश, अस्, आ, अम्, very thin, emaciate, wasted.

परिक्रम्य: परि-क्रम्य, ind. having walked round or about.

परिक्रान्ति: परि-क्रान्ति, इस्, f. moving round, revolution, circumrotation.
परिक्रामत्: परि-क्रामत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going or moving round or about.

परिक्लेद: परि-क्लेद, अस्, m. humidity, wetness, dampness.

परिगै: परिगै परि-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to go about or walk round singing, to sing or cele-brate everywhere, proclaim to all the world.

परिग्राह्य: परि-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be treated kindly or hospitably, to be addressed with kind words.

परिपूज्: परिपूज् परि-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यि-तुम्, to honour greatly, adore, worship.

परिरथ्य: परिरथ्य परि-रथ्य, अम्, n., Ved. or परि-रथ्या, f. a particular part of a chariot.
परिरन्धित: परिरन्धित परि-रन्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, injured, destroyed.
परिरभ्: परिरभ् परि-रभ्, cl. 1. A. -रभते, -रब्-धुम्, to embrace, clasp: Desid. A. -रिप्सते, to wish or desire to embrace.
परिरब्ध: परि-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, embraced, clasped, encircled.
परिरभ्यमाण: परि-रभ्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being embraced.
परिरम्भ: परि-रम्भ, अस्, m. embracing, an embrace.
परिरम्भिन्: परि-रम्भिन्, ई, इणी, इ (at the end of a comp.), clasped, girded, girt.
परिरिप्समान: परि-रिप्समान, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing or trying to embrace.
परिरम्: परिरम् परि-रम्, cl. 1. P. -रमति, -रन्तुम्, to be delighted.
परिराज्: परिराज् परि-राज्, cl. 1. P. A. -राजति, -ते, राजितुम्, to shine on all sides, be very resplendent.
परिराप्: परिराप् परि-राप्, प्, प्, प् (fr. rt. रप् with परि), Ved. crying or talking all round, a reviler (Sāy. = परि-वदत्, निन्दक); (प्), m. epithet of a demon.
परिरापिन्: परि-रापिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. whispering to, talking over, persuading.
परिरोध: परिरोध परि-रोध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रुध् with परि), obstructing, keeping back, resistance.
परिल: परिल परिल, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf. पारिल।]
परिलघु: परिलघु परि-लघु, उस्, उस्, उ, very light, easy to digest.
परिलङ्घ्: परिलङ्घ् परि-लङ्घ्, cl. 10. P. -लङ्घयति, -यितुम्, to overleap, transgress, overstep.
परिलङ्घन: परि-लङ्घन, अम्, n. jumping or leaping to and fro, jumping over.
परिलिह्: परिलिह् परि-लिह्, cl. 2. P. A. -लेढि, -लीढे, -लेढुम्, to lick all round, lick over, lick: Intens. -लेलिह्यते, -लेलेढि, to lick all round, lick repeatedly.
परिलीढ: परि-लीढ, अस्, आ, अम्, licked all round, licked over.
परिलेहिन्: परि-लेहिन्, ई, m. a particular disease of the ear.
परिलुप्: परिलुप् परि-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्पति, ते, -लोप्तुम्, to interrupt, break through, disturb; to suspend, diminish; to dispel.
परिलुप्त: परि-लुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, interrupted, disturbed, diminished, injured, lost. —परिलुप्त-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose consciousness is suspended, un-conscious, senseless.
परिलुप्यमान: परि-लुप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being interrupted.
परिलोप: परि-लोप, अस्, m. injury; neglect, omission.
परिलुभ्: परिलुभ् परि-लुभ्, Caus. A. -लोभयते, -यितुम्, to entice, allure.
परिलेख: परिलेख परि-लेख, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लिख् with परि), outline, delineation, sketch, figure, picture. —परिलेखाधिकार (°ख-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘section on delineation,’ N. of the sixth chapter of the Sūrya-siddhānta.
परिलेखन: परि-लेखन, अम्, n., Ved. drawing lines round about.
परिवक्रा: परिवक्रा परि-वक्रा, f., Ved. a circular pit; (according to a Scholiast) N. of a town.
परिवञ्च्: परिवञ्च् परि-वञ्च्, Caus. P. -वञ्चयति, -यितुम्, to deceive.
परिवत्सक: परिवत्सक परि-वत्सक, आस्, m. pl. (fr. वत्स with परि), N. of the descendants of Vatsa.
परिवत्सर: परिवत्सर परि-वत्सर, अस्, m. a full year, a year; the second of a cycle of five years.
परिवत्सरीण: परि-वत्सरीण or परि-वत्सरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to a full year; lasting a whole year.
परिवद्: परिवद् परि-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -वदितुम्, to speak ill of, revile, calumniate, slander, accuse.
परिवदत्: परि-वदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking ill of, reviling, slandering.
परिवदन: परि-वदन, अम्, n. reviling, accusing; crying out, clamouring, screaming.
परिवाद: परि-वाद, अस्, m. abuse, reproach, reproof, cen-sure, detraction; charge, accusation; an instrument with which the Indian lute is played.
परिवादक: परि-वादक, अस्, m. a complainant, accuser, plain-tiff, calumniator; one who plays on the lute.
परिवादिन्: परि-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking ill of, reviling, abusing, slandering, blaming; an accuser; calling out, crying, screaming; censured, abused; (ई), m. an accuser, plaintiff, reprover; (इनी), f. a Vīṇā or lute of seven strings.
परिवर्त: परि-वर्त, अस्, m. revolving, revolution (of a planet &c.); a period or lapse or expiration of time, especially of a Yuga (e. g. लोकानाम् परिवर्ते, at the end of the world); a year; going or turning back, flight, retreat, desertion; transmigration, re-peated birth; change, exchange, barter (e. g. अन्न-परिवर्त, change of diet; समुद्र-परिवर्त, exchange of sealed goods); requital, return; a chapter, section, book, canto; an abode, spot, place; N. of one of the eight sons of Duḥ-saha (son of Mṛtyu); N. of a king of the tortoises or the tortoise incarnation.
परिवर्धित: परिवर्धित 1. परि-वर्धित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वर्ध्, to cut, with परि; for 2. see under परि-वृध्, p. 548, col. 3), cut excavated.
2. परि-वर्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, increased, augmented.
परिवर्मन्: परिवर्मन् परि-वर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, wearing a coat of mail, clad in mail, armed.
परिवर्ह: परिवर्ह परि-वर्ह, परि-वर्हण। See परि-बर्ह, परि-बर्हण, p. 545, col. 1.
परिवस्: परिवस् परि-वस् (see rt. 4. वस्), cl. 10. P. -वासयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to split, cut through.
परिवासन: परि-वासन, अम्, n., Ved. a shred, chip.
परिवसथ: परिवसथ परि-वसथ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 6. वस् with परि), a village.
परिवास: परि-वास, अस्, m. abode, residence, stay, sojourn; [cf. काल-प्°।]
परिवासित: परि-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, respectfully attentive to superiors (?).
परिवह्: परिवह् परि-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to carry round, carry about.
परिवह: परि-वह, अस्, m., N. of one of the seven winds; one of the seven tongues of fire.
परिवाह: परि-वाह, अस्, m. the overflowing of a tank, an inundation, overflow natural or artificial; a water-course or drain to carry off excess of water; [cf. परी-वाह।] —परिवाह-वत्, आन्, m. ‘having a channel,’ a tank, pool.
परिवाहिन्: परि-वाहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, overflowing, swimming with.
परिवाप: परिवाप परि-वाप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वप् with परि), fried grains of rice; coagulated or thick sour milk (= दधि, Ved.); furniture; a train, retinue; sowing; a reservoir, pool, pond, piece of water; shaving, shearing.
परिवापित: परि-वापित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaven, shorn.
परिवाप्य: परि-वाप्य or परी-वाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having or requiring or deserving fried grains of rice or thickened milk.
परिवार: परिवार परि-वार, परि-वारण। See under परि-वृ, col. 2.

परि-वार, अस्, m. (also spelt परी-वार), a cover, covering; surroundings, train, suite, retinue, attend-ants, dependants, subjects, followers; a sheath, scab-bard. —परिवार-ता, f. subjection, dependance. —प-रिवार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a great retinue. —परिवार-शोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, rendered illustrious by a retinue.
परिवासस्: परिवासस् परि-वासस्, अस्, n., Ved. (pro-bably) an upper garment; अङ्गिरसाम् अभिवासः-परिवाससी, N. of two Sāmans.
परिविंशत्: परिविंशत् परि-विंशत्, त्, f. quite twenty, full twenty, twenty at least.
परिविक्रयिन्: परिविक्रयिन् परि-विक्रयिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. 1. क्री with परि-वि), selling or trading in (with gen.).
परिविक्षत: परिविक्षत परि-विक्षत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. क्षन् with परि-वि), sorely wounded, much hurt.
परिविक्षोभ: परिविक्षोभ परि-विक्षोभ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. क्षुभ् with परि-वि), shaking violently, de-stroying.
परिविचर्: परिविचर् परि-वि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -चरितुम्, Ved. to stream forth in all directions.
परिविद्: परिविद् परि-विद्, cl. 2. P. -वेत्ति, -वेद, -वेदितुम्, Ved. to know thoroughly, understand fully; cl. 6. P. A. -विन्दति, -ते, -वेदितुम्, -वेत्तुम्, to marry before an elder brother.
परिविण्ण: परि-विण्ण or परि-वित्त or परि-वित्ति, इस्, m. an unmarried elder brother whose younger brother is married. —परिवित्ति-ता, f. the marrying of a younger brother before the elder.
परिविन्दक: परि-विन्दक, अस्, m. a younger brother married before the elder.
परिविन्दत्: परि-विन्दत्, अन्, m. an unmarried elder brother.
परिविविदान: परि-विविदान, अस्, m., Ved. a married man whose elder brother is still unmarried.
परिवेत्तृ: परि-वेत्तृ, ता, m. or परि-वेदक, अस्, m. a younger brother married before the elder.
परिवेद: परि-वेद, अस्, m. complete or accurate knowledge.
परिवेदन: 1. परि-वेदन, अम्, n. (for 2. see p. 549, col. 1), complete or accurate knowledge; discussion; anguish, pain, misery; the marrying of a younger brother before the elder; marriage; laying the fire on the sacrificial fire-place; gain, acquisition; (आ), f. shrewd-ness, wit; foresight, prudence.
परिवेदन 2. परि-वेदन, अम्, n. (probably a various reading for परि-देवन), complaining, lamentation. (For 1. see p. 548, col. 1.)
परिवेदनीया: परि-वेदनीया or परि-वेदिनी, f. the wife of a younger brother who has married before the elder.
परिवेदिन्: परि-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, knowing, shrewd.
परिविद्ध: परिविद्ध परि-विद्ध, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. परि-व्यध्), an epithet of Kuvera; [cf. पर-विद्ध।]
परिविश्: परिविश् परि-विश् (often confounded with परि-विष् below), Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्, to pro-vide; to offer, present, (probably for परि-विष्, q. v.)
परिवेशस्: परि-वेशस्, आस्, m., Ved. a neighbour.
परिविश्वस्: परिविश्वस् परि-वि-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति, -श्वसितुम्, to confide completely, feel secure, be fearless: Caus. -श्वासयति, -यितुम्, to comfort, console.
परिश्वस्त: परि-श्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, feeling secure, confident.
परिविष्: परिविष् परि-विष्, Caus. P. -वेषयति, -यितुम्, to surround; to present, offer, offer food; to wait on; (sometimes erroneously written परि-विश्, q. v.)
परिविष्ट: परि-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enclosed; offered, presented.
परिविष्टि: परि-विष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. service, attendance.
परिवेष: परि-वेष, अस्, m. (sometimes wrongly spelt परि-वेश), preparation (of food); attendance, wait-ing at meals, distributing food, serving up meals; a circle, circlet, wreath, crown; the circumference of a circle; the disk of the sun or moon; a halo round the sun or moon; anything surrounding or protecting (e. g. कृताङ्गरक्षा-प्°, surrounded by a body-guard); putting on, clothing, dressing. —परिवेष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a halo, surrounded by a halo.
परिवेषक: परि-वेषक, अस्, m. (sometimes wrongly परि-वेशक), an attendant, waiter, one who serves up meals.
परिवेषण: परि-वेषण, अम्, n. attendance, waiting, serving up meals, distributing food; surrounding, enclosing; circumference; a halo round the sun or moon.
परिवेषिन्: परि-वेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, surrounded by a halo.
परिवेष्टव्य: परि-वेष्टव्य or परि-वेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be served up; to be offered or presented.
परिवेष्टृ: परि-वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a waiter; one who serves up meals.
परिविहार: परिविहार परि-विहार, अस्, m. walking or roaming about, walking for pleasure.
परिविह्वल: परिविह्वल परि-विह्वल, अस्, आ, अम्, ex-tremely agitated, bewildered, beside one's self. —प-रिविह्वल-ता, f. bewilderment.
परिवी: परिवी परि-वी, परि-वीत। See under परि-व्ये, p. 549, col. 1.
परि-वी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. wound round.
परिवृ: परिवृ परि-वृ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -णुते, -वृणाति, -णीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -व-रीतुम्, to surround, conceal: Caus. -वारयति, -यि-तुम्, to surround, cover, clothe.
परिवारण: परि-वारण, अम्, n. a cover, covering, envelope; a train, retinue; keeping or warding off.
परिवारित: परि-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, encompassed, surrounded, encircled, enclosed, begirt.
परिवार्य: परि-वार्य, ind. having surrounded or encompassed.
परिवृत: परि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, encompassed, surrounded, encircled, attended, invested; concealed; overspread, pervaded; entirely gained or received; known; (अम्), n., Ved. a covered place or shed enclosed with walls used as a place of sacrifice.
परिवृति: परि-वृति, इस्, f. surrounding, standing round.
परिवृंह्: परिवृंह् परि-वृंह् or परि-वृह्, also written परि-बृंह् or परि-बृह्, q. v., p. 545, col. 1.
परिवृंहित: परि-वृंहित or परि-वृहित। See परि-बृं-हित, p. 545, col. 1.
परिवृढ: परि-वृढ, अस्, m. a master, owner, &c. See परि-बृढ, p. 545, col. 2.
परिव्रढिमन्: परिव्रढिमन् परि-व्रढिमन्। See under परि-वृंह्, p. 548, col. 2.
परिवृज्: परिवृज् 1. परि-वृज्, cl. 7. 1. P. -वृणक्ति, -वर्जति, -वर्जितुम्, to leave, forsake, abandon, shun, avoid, quit, cease, leave off: Caus. -वर्जयति, -यितुम्, to avoid, shun.
2. परि-वृज्, क्, f., Ved. avoiding, removing, (Sāy. = परितः स्व-स्थान-त्याग); purification, expi-ation.
परिवर्ग: परि-वर्ग, अस्, m., Ved. shunning, avoiding, removing, discomfiting; अ-परिवर्गम्, ind. without omission, without intermission, completely.
परिवर्ग्य: परि-वर्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be avoided.
परिवर्जक: परि-वर्जक, अस्, आ, अम्, shunning, avoiding; giving up, resigning, abstaining from.
परिवर्जन: परि-वर्जन, अम्, n. avoiding, shunning, giving up, resigning, quitting; abstaining from; killing, slaughter.
परिवर्जनीय: परि-वर्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, avoidable, to be avoided.
परिवर्जित: परि-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, shunned; deprived or devoid of.
परिवृक्त: परि-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. avoided, disliked, despised; (आ and ई), f. ‘the disliked or despised one,’ epithet of a wife lightly esteemed in comparison with the favourite wife (महिषी, वावाता).
परिवृत्: परिवृत् परि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut., Cond., and Aor.), to turn round, roll or wheel round, revolve; to be whirled; to hasten to and fro, roam or wander about; to change (e. g. क्ष-णेन तत् परिवर्तते ऽन्यथा, that changes or turns out to be different in a moment); to interchange; to become, to be: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to exchange.
परिवर्तक: परि-वर्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, turning round, turning back; causing to turn round or flow back; causing to revolve; bringing to a close; requiting, exchanging; leaving off a thing begun for some other object; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Duḥ-saha.
परिवर्तन: परि-वर्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to turn round; (ई), f. epithet of a particular magical art; (अम्), n. cutting, clipping (the hair, Ved.); (according to a Scholiast) = प्रेरण (Ved.); turning round, going round, turning back, returning; moving to and fro; whirling round, revolving; revolution, end of a period of time; inverting, taking or putting anything in a wrong direction; change, exchange, barter; requital, return.
परिवर्तनीय: परि-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be exchanged, capable of being exchanged.
परिवर्तिका: परि-वर्तिका, f. contraction of the prepuce, phi-mosis.
परिवर्तित: परि-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, revolved; returned, retreated; taken or put on in a wrong direction; exchanged.
परिवर्तिन्: परि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, moving round, going round, revolving; circling, going in a circle, being constantly renewed, ever recurring; changing, passing into; being or remaining or staying in a place or near a person (e. g. सुग्रीव-परिवर्तिन्, being about, i. e. in attendance on Su-grīva); flying, re-treating; exchanging, requiting, recompensing; (इनी), f., scil. विष्टुति, a hymn arranged according to the recurring form abc, abc, abc.
परिवर्त्मन्: परि-वर्त्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. going or extending round.
परिवृत्त: परि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, revolved, gone round; turned back, retreated, retired, returned; exchanged, bartered; finished, ended; (अम्), n. an embrace. —परिवृत्तार्ध-मुख (°त-अर्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having the face half turned round.
परिवृत्ति: परि-वृत्ति, इस्, f. revolution, return; exchange, barter; end, termination; surrounding, encompassing; staying in a place, dwelling; contraction of the pre-puce, phimosis; (त्या), ind. alternately; (sometimes परि-वृत्ति is a wrong reading for परि-वित्ति, q. v.)
परिवृत्य: परि-वृत्य, ind. having turned round, having revolved; having retreated or retired.
परिवृध्: परिवृध् परि-वृध् [cf. परि-वृंह्], cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut., Cond., and Aor.) -वर्धते, -वर्धितुम्, to grow, grow up, increase: Caus. -वर्धयति, -यितुम्, to increase, augment; to bring up, rear.
परिवर्धन: परि-वर्धन, अम्, n. increasing, augmenting, enlarging, multiplying; growing; rearing, breeding (as of cattle).
परिवृद्ध: परि-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased. —परिवृद्ध-ता, f. increase, extension.
परिवृस्ति: परिवृस्ति परि-वृस्ति, इस्, m. a wrong reading for परि-वित्ति, q. v.
परिवेदित: परि-वेदित, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for परि-देवित), lamented; (अम्), n. lamentation.
परिवेष्ट्: परिवेष्ट् परि-वेष्ट्, cl. 1. A. -वेष्टते, -वेष्टितुम्, to surround, encompass, encircle; to wrap up, cover, clothe: Caus. -वेष्टयति, -यितुम्, to surround; to wrap up, clothe; to embrace.
परिवेष्टन: परि-वेष्टन, अम्, n. surrounding, encompassing; circumference; a cover, covering; a ligature, bandage.
परिवेष्टित: परि-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encompassed, enclosed; beset, beleaguered; bound round, covered, veiled, swathed.
परिवेष्टितृ: परि-वेष्टितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who sur-rounds or encompasses.
परिव्यक्त: परिव्यक्त परि-व्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, very clear or distinct; (अम्), ind. very clearly or distinctly.
परिव्यध्: परिव्यध् परि-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to hit, strike, smite, wound.
परिव्याध: परि-व्याध, अस्, m. a species of reed, Calamus Fasciculatus; a species of tree, Pterospermum Aceri-folium; N. of an ancient sage.
परिव्यय: परिव्यय परि-व्यय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. इ with परि-वि), expense, cost; condiment, spices.
परिव्ये: परिव्ये परि-व्ये, cl. 1. P. A. -व्ययति, -ते, -व्यातुम्, to surround, invest, wrap round, veil, cover, put on, wrap one's self up.
परिवीत: परि-वीत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encompassed, invested; overspread, pervaded; (अम्), n. the bow of Brahmā.
परिव्ययण: परि-व्ययण, अम्, n., Ved. winding round, covering.
परिव्ययणीय: परि-व्ययणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to wrapping round or binding on (as a verse).
परिव्रज्: परिव्रज् परि-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. -व्रजति, -व्र-जितुम्, to go or wander about, wander about as a mendicant, lead the life of a religious mendicant.
परिव्रज्य: परि-व्रज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be roamed about or walked for pleasure; (आ), f. strolling, wandering about from place to place; religious wandering, leading the life of a religious mendicant; ascetic devotion, religious austerity, abandonment of the world.
परिव्राज्: परि-व्राज्, ट्, or परि-व्राज, अस्, m. a vagrant, wandering man, ascetic of the fourth and last religious order, a mendicant devotee.
परिव्राजक: परि-व्राजक, अस्, इका, m. f. a wandering religious mendicant.
परिव्राजि: परि-व्राजि, इस्, f. a species of plant, Sphæranthus Mollis; [cf. तपो-धना, भिक्षु।]
परिशङ्क्: परिशङ्क् परि-शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. -शङ्कते, -शङ्-कितुम्, to suspect of (with inst.); to distrust.
परिशङ्कनीय: परि-शङ्कनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be doubted or distrusted; to be feared or apprehended; परिशङ्क-नीयम्, (used impersonally) distrust must be felt.
परिशङ्किन्: परि-शङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, fearing, apprehending, having apprehensions.
परिशप्: परिशप् परि-शप्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. -शपति, -ते, -शप्यति, -ते, -शप्तुम्, to curse, execrate.
परिशाप: परि-शाप, अस्, m. cursing, reviling, anathema.
परिशम्: परिशम् परि-शम्, Caus. P. -शमयति, -यि-तुम्, to allay, quench; to destroy.
परिशमित: परि-शमित, अस्, आ, अम्, allayed, quenched; de-stroyed.
परिशाश्वत: परिशाश्वत परि-शाश्वत, अस्, ई, अम्, remain-ing or continuing for ever, perpetually the same.
परिशिष्: परिशिष् परि-शिष्, Caus. P. -शेषयति, -यि-तुम्, to leave over, leave (as a remainder); to leave (a place), quit; with न, to destroy (e. g. मेघ-नादस्य धनुर् न पर्य्-अशेषयत्, he did not suffer to remain, i. e. he destroyed the bow of Megha-nāda).
परिशिष्ट: परि-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, left, remaining; finished; (अम्), n. a supplement, appendix. —परिशिष्ट-प्र-काश, अस्, m., N. of a work by Śrī-nātha-śarman.
परिशेष: परि-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, left over, remaining (Ved.); (अस्, अम्), m. n. remnant, remains, re-mainder, residue, rest; sequel, supplement; conclu-sion, completion, termination; (एण), ind. with the residue or conclusion; to the very end, com-pletely, in full. —परिशेष-शास्त्र, अम्, n. a sup-plementary work, an appendix.
परिशीलन: परिशीलन परि-शीलन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. शील् with परि), frequent touch or contact, intercourse, correspondence, constant occupation, fond pursuit of or attachment to (a subject), study.
परिशुच्: परिशुच् परि-शुच्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -शोचति (-ते), -शोचितुम्, to be deeply grieved, mourn, lament, bewail.
परिशुध्: परिशुध् परि-शुध्, Caus. P. -शोधयति, -यितुम्, to clear, clean, purify completely; to solve, explain, clear up.
परिशुद्ध: परि-शुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, completely cleansed, cleaned, purified; acquitted, discharged; cleared off, paid. —परिशुद्ध-भाव, अस्, m. cleansed; dis-charged, paid.
परिशुद्धि: परि-शुद्धि, इस्, f. complete purification, becom-ing perfectly clean; justification, acquittal, proving innocent.
परिशोध: परि-शोध, अस्, m. cleansing, purifying, correct-ing; discharging a debt or obligation, quittance.
परिशोधन: परि-शोधन, अम्, n. purification; justification; paying, discharging a debt.
परिशुश्रूषा: परिशुश्रूषा परि-शुश्रूषा। See under प-रि-श्रु, col. 3.
परि-शुश्रूषा, f. complete or implicit obedience.
परिशुष्: परिशुष् परि-शुष्, cl. 4. P. (ep. also A.) -शुष्यति (-ते), -शोष्टुम्, to be thoroughly dried up, become quite dry; to shrivel, wither; to pine, waste away; to be afflicted: Caus. -शोषयति, -यितुम्, to emaciate.
परिशुष्क: परि-शुष्क, अस्, आ, अम्, perfectly dried up, thoroughly dried, completely dry or parched; withered, shriveled, shrunk (as a vein); hollow (as the cheeks); परिशुष्कम् मांसम्, meat fried in ghee, washed and spiced. —परिशुष्क-तालु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the palate dried up. —परिशुष्क-पलाश, अस्, आ, अम्, having withered foliage.
परिशुष्यत्: परि-शुष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, drying up, evaporating.
परिशोष: परि-शोष, अस्, m. becoming completely dried up, dryness, desiccation, evaporation.
परिशोषण: परि-शोषण, अस्, आ, अम्, drying up, parching; (अम्), n. drying, parching, emaciating.
परिशोषिन्: परि-शोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, drying up, shriveling up, becoming quite emaciated.
परिशून्य: परिशून्य परि-शून्य, अस्, आ, अम्, quite empty, quite free from, totally devoid of.
परिशृत: परिशृत 1. परि-शृत, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), ardent spirits; [cf. परि-स्रुत्, परि-स्रुता।]
परिशॄ: परिशॄ परि-शॄ, Pass. -शीर्यते, to be cleft or rent asunder, to be split.
परिश्रम: परिश्रम परि-श्रम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रम् with परि), fatigue, distress; fatiguing occupation, labour, exertion, trouble, pain. —परिश्रमापह (°म-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, relieving weariness.
परिश्रान्त: परि-श्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly fatigued, worn out, exhausted, wearied; one who has per-formed acts of religious austerity.
परिश्रान्ति: परि-श्रान्ति, इस्, f. fatigue, exhaustion; labour, trouble.
परिश्राम: परि-श्राम, अस्, m. fatigue, a fatiguing occu-pation, exertion, toiling after.
परिश्रय: परिश्रय परि-श्रय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रि with परि), an enclosure, fence (Ved.); a refuge, asylum; an assembly, meeting.
परिश्रयण: परि-श्रयण, अम्, n. encompassing, surrounding with a fence.
परिश्रित्: परि-श्रित्, त्, f., Ved. ‘enclosure,’ epithet of certain small stones laid round the hearth and other parts of the altar.
परिश्रित: 2. परि-श्रित, अम्, n., Ved. = परि-वृतम्, q. v.
परिश्रु: परिश्रु परि-श्रु, cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, -श्रोतुम्, to hear.
परिश्रुत: परि-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, heard; (अस्), m., N. of one of the attendants of Skanda.
परिश्लिष्ट: परिश्लिष्ट परि-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्लिष् with परि), embraced, clasped.
परिश्लेष: परि-श्लेष, अस्, m. embracing, an embrace.
परिषण्ड: परिषण्ड परि-षण्ड, a particular part of a house. —परिषण्ड-वारिक, a servant.
परिषद्: परिषद् 1. परि-षद् (परि-सद्), cl. 1. 6. P. -षीदति, -षत्तुम्, Ved. to sit round.

2. परि-षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. surrounding, besetting; (त्), f. an assembly, meeting, audience, congregation, council. —परिषत्-त्व, अम्, n. the state of con-stituting a legal assembly; a legal assemblage of councillors. —परिषद्-वल, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded by a council; convoking assemblies; (अस्), m. a mem-ber of an assembly, assessor, associate, spectator.
परिषद: परि-षद, अस्, m. (a various reading for पारि-षद), one of an assembly or congregation, a councillor, assessor, a spectator at a play.
परिषद्य: परि-षद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought after laboriously (Ved.); to be worshipped (Ved.); to be avoided (Ved.); (according to Mahī-dhara) belonging to an assembly; (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 4, 7, = पर्य्-आप्त), sufficient, adequate, com-petent; (अस्), m. a member of an assembly, assessor, hearer, spectator, guest.
परिषद्वन्: परि-षद्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. surrounding, en-compassing, besetting.
परिषह्: परिषह् परि-षह् (परि-सह्), cl. 1. A. -षहते, -षहितुम्, -षोढुम्, to sustain, bear up against.
परिषिच्: परिषिच् परि-षिच् (परि-सिच्), cl. 1. P. A. -षिञ्चति, -ते, -षेक्तुम्, to sprinkle round, scatter about, diffuse: Caus. -षेचयति (ep. -षिञ्चयति), -यितुम्, to sprinkle round.
परिषेक: परि-षेक, अस्, m. sprinkling over, moistening; a bath, bathing apparatus.
परिषेचक: परि-षेचक, अस्, आ, अम्, pouring over, sprinkling.
परिषेचन: परि-षेचन, अम्, n. pouring over, sprinkling; water for watering tress.
परिषीवण: परिषीवण परि-षीवण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सिव् with परि), Ved. sewing round, winding round.
परिषू: परिषू परि-षू (परि-सू, see rt. 2. सू), cl. 6. P. -षुवति, -षवितुम्, Ved. to besiege, be-leaguer.
परिषूत: परि-षूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. besieged, beleaguered.
परिषूति: परि-षूति, इस्, f., Ved. oppression; (Sāy.) violence (= परितः प्रेरक उपद्रवः).
परिषोडश: परिषोडश परि-षोडश, अस्, ई, अम्, full six-teen, quite sixteen.
परिष्कन्द्: परिष्कन्द् परि-ष्कन्द् or परि-स्कन्द्, cl. 1. P. -ष्कन्दति, -ष्कन्तुम्, to leap about, spring round or about.
परिष्कण्ण: परि-ष्कण्ण or परि-ष्कन्न, अस्, m. a foster or adopted child, one nourished by a stranger; the Koïl or Indian cuckoo (?).
परिष्कन्द: परि-ष्कन्द or परि-स्कन्द, अस्, m. a foster child, one nourished by a stranger; a servant; (औ), m. du. two servants running by the two sides of a carriage; (अम्), n. going round or about (?).
परिष्कन्दत्: परि-ष्कन्दत् or परि-स्कन्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, leaping about, jumping round, going round or about; surrounding, circumambulating; wandering.
परिष्कृ: परिष्कृ परि-ष्-कृ (परि-कृ with स् inserted, cf. परि-कृ, p. 538, col. 2), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to prepare, fit out, equip; to adorn, decorate; to polish, perfect; to cleanse.
परिष्कार: परि-ष्-कार, अस्, m. surrounding (?); adorning, ornament, decoration, embellishment; finishing, polishing; cooking, dressing; cleansing, purification by essential rites, initiation; domestic utensils, furni-ture. —परिष्कार-चीवर, a kind of garment.
परिष्कृत: परि-ष्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encom-passed (?); prepared, equipped; adorned, decorated, embellished; highly finished, polished; cooked, dressed; cleansed, purified by initiatory rites. —प-रिष्कृत-भूमि, इस्, f. an altar or ground prepared for a sacrifice or for the victim and sacrificial utensils.
परिष्कृति: परि-ष्-कृति, इस्, f. finishing, polishing; cleansing.
परिष्क्रिया: परि-ष्-क्रिया, f. adorning, decorating; (अग्नि-प्° is a various reading for अग्नि-परिक्रिया, q. v.)
परिष्टि: परिष्टि परि-ष्टि, इस्, f. (according to some fr. rt. 1. अस् with परि, but more probably fr. परि-ष्ठा below; cf. अभि-ष्टि, उप-स्ति), Ved. obstruc-tion, impediment; distress, dilemma; (Sāy.) searching all round, (as if fr. rt. 3. इष् with परि।)
परिष्टु: परिष्टु परि-ष्टु (परि-स्तु), cl. 2. P. -स्तौति, -स्तोतुम्, to praise, (Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 70.)
परिष्टवनीय: परि-ष्टवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. intended for the Pari-ṣṭavana.
परिष्टुति: परि-ष्टुति, इस्, f. (fr. परि-स्तु), Ved. praise.
परिष्टोम: परि-ष्टोम, अस्, m. an elephant's coloured hous-ings; a coverlet; a cushion; [cf. परि-स्तोम।]
परिष्टुभ्: परिष्टुभ् परि-ष्टुभ्, प्, प्, प् (fr. rt. स्तुभ् with परि), Ved. uttering joyful cries or exulting on every side; (Sāy.) = स्तुतिभिर् युक्त, endowed or glorified with praises; (प्), f. exultation, acclamation.
परिष्टोभ: परि-ष्टोभ, अस्, m., Ved. embellishing a Sāman with the so-called Stobhas.
परिष्ठल: परिष्ठल परि-ष्ठल, अम्, n. surrounding place or site.
परिष्ठा: परिष्ठा परि-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. ob-structing, hindering, an obstructor; (आस्), f. obstruc-tion, impediment.
परिष्यन्द: परिष्यन्द परि-ष्यन्द or परि-स्यन्द, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्यन्द् with परि), a stream, river; wet-ness, moisture; a sand-bank, island (Ved.).
परिष्यन्दिन्: परि-ष्यन्दिन् or परि-स्यन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, flow-ing, streaming.
परिष्वञ्ज्: परिष्वञ्ज् परि-ष्वञ्ज् (परि-स्वञ्ज्), cl. 1. A. -ष्वजते (rarely P. -ष्वजति), -ष्वङ्क्तुम्, to embrace.
परिष्वङ्ग: परि-ष्वङ्ग, अस्, m. embracing, an embrace; contact, touch.
परिष्वजन: परि-ष्वजन, अम्, n. embracing, an embrace.
परिष्वजान: परि-ष्वजान, अस्, आ, अम्, embracing, (Rāmā-yaṇa II. 83, 10.)
परिष्वज्य: 1. परि-ष्वज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be embraced.
परिष्वञ्जन: परि-ष्वञ्जन, अम्, n. embracing, an embrace.
परिष्वञ्जल्य: परि-ष्वञ्जल्य, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a particular domestic utensil.
परिष्वञ्जीयस्: परि-ष्वञ्जीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. clasping more firmly.
परिष्वष्कित: परिष्वष्कित परि-ष्वष्कित, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ष्वष्क् with परि, probably) the act of leaping about.
परिसंलिह्: परिसंलिह् परि-सं-लिह्, cl. 2. P. A. -लेढि, -लीढे, -लेढुम्, to lick all round, lick over, lick.
परिसंवत्सर: परिसंवत्सर परि-संवत्सर, अस्, m. a whole or full year; (आत्), ind. after the expiration of a whole year; (अस्, आ, अम्), a whole year old; one who has waited a whole year; (in medicine) chronic.
परिसंस्तु: परिसंस्तु परि-सं-स्तु, cl. 2. P. A. -स्तौति, -स्तवीति, -स्तुते, -स्तुवीते, -स्तोतुम्, to praise.
परिसंस्तूयमान: परि-संस्तूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being praised.

परिसख्य: परिसख्य परि-सख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being on friendly terms.
परिसङ्क्रीड्: परिसङ्क्रीड् परि-सङ्-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. -क्रीडति, -क्रीडितुम्, to play about, jest, amuse one's self.

परिसङ्घुष्ट: परि-सङ्घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, resonant on all sides.

परिसञ्चित: परि-सञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected, accumulated.

परिसमन्त: परिसमन्त परि-समन्त, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), circumference, circuit.
