परिसमाप्त: परि-समाप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fully completed, en-tirely done or finished.
परिसमाप्ति: परि-समाप्ति, इस्, f. entire completion, end, con-clusion.
परिसमुत्सुक: परिसमुत्सुक परि-समुत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, very anxious, greatly agitated or excited.
परिसमूह्: परिसमूह् परि-सम्-ऊह्, cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to heap or sweep together.

परिसम्भू: परिसम्भू परि-सम्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, Ved. to arise, spring, be produced.

परिसाध्: परिसाध् परि-साध्, Caus. P. -साधयति, -यितुम्, to finish, complete, settle (a cause).

परिसान्त्वन: परिसान्त्वन परि-सान्त्वन, अम्, n. the act of consoling; conciliation.
परिसामन्: परिसामन् परि-सामन्, अ, n., Ved. a Sāman which is occasionally inserted.
परिसिध्: परिसिध् परि-सिध्, cl. 1. P. -सेधति, -से-धितुम्, to go round, go about.
परिसिद्धिका: परि-सिद्धिका, f. a kind of rice-gruel.
परिसेधत्: परि-सेधत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going round, going about.
परिसीमन्: परिसीमन् परि-सीमन्, आ, m. a boundary, border, extreme term or limit.
परिसीर्य: परिसीर्य परि-सीर्य, अम्, n. (fr. परि + सीर), Ved. a leather thong on a plough.
परिसृ: परिसृ परि-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to go or flow round.

परिसार: परि-सार, अस्, m. going round or about, wan-dering about, perambulation.
परिसारक: परि-सारक, अम्, n., N. of a place near the Sarasvatī.
परिसारिन्: परि-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wandering or running about.
परिसृप्: परिसृप् परि-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्-तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to go round, go to and fro.
परिसर्पण: परि-सर्पण, अम्, n. creeping about, walking about, running to and fro, constantly changing one's place; a kind of disease (= वि-सर्प).
परिसर्पिन्: परि-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going or moving or roam-ing about.

परिस्तृ: परिस्तृ परि-स्तृ, cl. 5. P. A. -स्तृणोति, -णुते, or परि-स्तॄ, cl. 9. P. A. -स्तृणाति, -णीते, -स्तर्तुम्, -स्तरितुम्, -स्तरीतुम्, to spread, extend; to strew round; to arrange; to envelop, cover.
परिस्तर: परि-स्तर, अस्, m. strewing round or heaping together, strewing; a cover, covering (?).
परिस्तरण: परि-स्तरण, अम्, n. strewing round, strewing, scattering about; a cover, covering (?).
परिस्तीर्य: परि-स्तीर्य, ind. having strewed around (sacred grass).
परिस्तृत: परि-स्तृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread over, covered.
परिस्था: परिस्था परि-स्था, cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, Ved. to stand round, encompass; to obstruct (Sāy. = परि-वृत्य स्था).
परिस्थान: परि-स्थान, अम्, n. or परि-स्थिति, इस्, f. abode, dwelling, residence; fixedness, solidity; fortitude, firmness.
परिस्पन्द्: परिस्पन्द् परि-स्पन्द्, cl. 1. P. A. -स्पन्दति, -ते, -स्पन्दितुम्, to tremble, throb, quiver, vibrate, totter.
परिस्पन्द: परि-स्पन्द, अस्, m. beating, throbbing, vibra-tion; motion, movement; pressure, crush; main-tenance, provision; train, retinue (in this sense also spelt परि-स्यन्द); decoration of the hair.
परिस्पन्दत्: परि-स्पन्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, trembling, quivering, tottering.
परिस्पन्दन: परि-स्पन्दन, अम्, n. beating, throbbing, vibra-tion, moving about, motion.
परिस्पन्दमान: परि-स्पन्दमान, अस्, आ, अम्, throbbing, beat-ing; moving tremulously, gently agitated, shaking, trembling.
परिस्पर्धिन्: परिस्पर्धिन् परि-स्पर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. स्पर्ध् with परि), vying with, rivalling, emulating.
परिस्पृध्: परि-स्पृध्, त्, f., Ved. a rival.
परिस्पृश्: परिस्पृश् परि-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृशति, -स्पर्ष्टुम्, -स्प्रष्टुम्, to touch.
परिस्फुट: परिस्फुट परि-स्फुट, अस्, आ, अम्, very clear or manifest, quite evident or plain or distinct; fully developed.

परिस्फुरण: परि-स्फुरण, अम्, n. quivering, glancing, shoot-ing; budding.
परिस्फुरत्: परि-स्फुरत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, quivering; dart-ing, glancing, gleaming, moving quickly or suddenly; budding, expanding; bursting forth.
परिस्फुरित: परि-स्फुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, quivering, glancing, gleaming; opened, expanded; shot, glanced.
परिस्मापन: परिस्मापन परि-स्मापन, अम्, n. (fr. Caus. of rt. स्मि with परि), causing wonder, surprising, outwitting.
परिस्यन्द: परिस्यन्द परि-स्यन्द, अस्, m. (also परि-ष्यन्द, q. v.), flow, stream, river; oozing, drop-ping; train, retinue; decoration of the hair (= परि-स्पन्द).
परिस्यन्दन: परि-स्यन्दन, अम्, n. dropping, flowing, oozing.
परिस्रजिन्: परिस्रजिन् परि-स्रजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. wear-ing a garland.
परिस्रसा: परिस्रसा परि-स्रसा, f. (fr. rt. स्रंस् with परि), Ved. rubbish, lumber.
परिस्रु: परिस्रु परि-स्रु, cl. 1. P. -स्रवति, -स्रोतुम्, to flow round, flow, stream, trickle; to ask (?).
परिस्रव: परि-स्रव, अस्, m. (erroneously written परि-श्रव), flowing, streaming, stream; a river, torrent; birth (of a child); gliding down.
परिस्रवत्: परि-स्रवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flowing down.
परिस्राव: परि-स्राव, अस्, m. ‘flowing,’ N. of a morbid state ascribed to the overflowing of the moistures of the body; efflux, effluxion. —परिस्राव-कल्प, a kind of straining or filtering vessel.
परिस्रावण: परि-स्रावण, अम्, n. a straining or filtering vessel.
परिस्राविन्: परि-स्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, flowing; (ई), m., scil. भगन्-दर, a form of fistula of the anus; (इ), n., scil. उदर, an incurable form of intumescence of the belly.
परिस्रुत्: परि-स्रुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. streaming or flowing round or over, foaming, fermenting; (त्), f. a kind of intoxicating liquor prepared from herbs; dropping, flowing. —परिस्रुन्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possess-ing Pari-srut.
परिस्रुत: परि-स्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed, streamed round; trickled, oozed; (आ), f. a kind of intoxicating liquor.
परिस्वार: परिस्वार परि-स्वार, अस्, m., Ved. a par-ticular kind of singing.
परिहत: परिहत परि-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. हन् with परि), loosed, loosened.
परिहरण: परि-हरण, अम्, n. moving, carrying or placing round or about (Ved.); avoiding; leaving, abandon-ing; seizing, taking; refuting, repelling; disap-pearing (?).
परिहव: परिहव परि-हव, अस्, m., Ved. (fr. rt. ह्वे with परि), crying or calling upon (?); invoking (?).
परिहस्: परिहस् परि-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -हसितुम्, to laugh at, ridicule, deride.
परिहसित: परि-हसित, अस्, आ, अम्, laughed at, ridiculed.
परिहास: परि-हास, अस्, m. jesting, joking, mirth, merri-ment, a jest, joke; laughter; laughing at, deriding, ridiculing. —परिहास-कथा, f. an amusing story. —परिहास-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —परि-हास-वेदिन्, ई, m. a jester, a wag, wit. —परिहास-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, of a gay or joyous disposition. —परिहास-हरि, इस्, m., N. of a temple of Viṣṇu; [cf. परीहास-केशव।]
परिहास्य: परि-हास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, laughable, ridiculous.
परिहस्त: परिहस्त परि-हस्त, अस्, m., Ved. a ring for the hand, an amulet put round the hand to secure the birth of a child.
परिहा: परिहा परि-हा, Pass. -हीयते, to wane, fail, waste away, decrease; to be wanting; to want or be deficient in or be destitute of (with abl.); to be deprived of or excluded from (with abl.); to be abandoned; to be avoided or omitted; (in Mahā-bh. परिहाण: परि-हाण, अम्, n., Ved. suffering loss, losing; coming short of, being deficient, diminution, decrease.
परिहाणि: परि-हाणि, इस्, f. decrease, loss, deficiency.
परिहीण: परि-हीण, अस्, आ, अम्, waned, faded, wasted; deserted by; deprived of, destitute of; wanting, deficient in (with abl.).
परिहीयमान: परि-हीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, wasting away, dimin-ishing, becoming emaciated.
परिहाटक: परिहाटक परि-हाटक, अम्, n. a ring worn round the arm or leg, an armlet, anklet.
परिहार: परि-हार, अस्, m. leading round; avoiding, shunning, leaving, deserting, abandoning, giving up, resigning; taking away, removing (e. g. विरोध-परिहार, removing a contradiction); repelling (a charge), confutation; seizing, keeping back; omit-ting, concealing; reserve, concealment; omitting to mention, leaving out; an extraordinary grant, ex-emption from taxes, granting privileges, immunity; bounty, largess; a circuit of common land round a village or town; (in grammar) the repetition of a word before and after इति (= परि-ग्रह, q. v.); contempt, disrespect; any objectionable thing or per-son; objection; remedying or atoning for any im-proper action. —परिहार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, avoid-able.
परिहि: परिहि परि-हि, cl. 5. P. -हिनोति, -हेतुम्, Ved. to prepare.
परिहृ: परिहृ परि-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to avoid, shun, pass by; to abandon, desert, leave; to refute; to conceal; to embrace.
परि-हृ; add — to take away, remove.
परिहरणीय: परि-हरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shunned or avoided, avoidable; to be taken away; to be repelled or refuted or confuted. —परिहरणीय-ता, f. avoid-ableness; disappearance, unattainableness; refuta-tion (?).
परिहरत्: परि-हरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shunning, avoiding, illuding; setting aside, taking away, humbling.
परिहरमाण: परि-हरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, leaving, quitting; taking, seizing; confuting; concealing.
परिहर्तव्य: परि-हर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shunned or avoided, to be abstained from; to be taken away; to be confuted; (in Vedic grammar) to be constructed with the परि-हार, q. v.
परिहारक: परि-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, repelling, refuting; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. ? (a various reading has परि-हरक), an armlet; [cf. परि-हाटक।]
परिहारिन्: परि-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, avoiding, shunning.
परिहार्य: परि-हार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shunned or avoided; to be left undone; to be escaped from; to be taken off or away; to be severed or separated; to be con-structed with the परि-हार; (अस्), m. a bracelet.
परिहृत: परि-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, avoided, shunned; aban-doned, quitted; set aside, removed, rejected; taken away, repelled, refuted; taken, seized.
परिहृति: परि-हृति, इस्, f. shunning, avoiding, refuting.

परिहर्षण: परि-हर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, greatly delighting.

परिह्वृत्: परि-ह्वृत्, त्, f., Ved. falling to the ground, falling down, ruined.
परिह्वृति: परि-ह्वृति, इस्, f., Ved. damage, injury, ruin.

परीत: परीत, अस्, आ, अम्, encircling, surrounding; past, elapsed, expired; departed; surrounded, encompassed; filled; taken possession of, seized. —परीत-ता, f. the being surrounded or filled.
परीत परीत, &c. See परी, p. 551, col. 3.
परीतिन्: परीतिन्, ई, इनी, इ (at the end of a comp.), = परीत, filled with, seized by.
परीत्य: परीत्य, ind. having passed round or circum-ambulated; having encompassed.
परीयमाण: परीयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being penetrated or pervaded by.
पर्यय: पर्य्-अय, अस्, m. revolution (of time), passing away, lapse, expiration (e. g. काल-पर्ययात्, after the lapse of a certain time); waste or loss (of time); change, mutation, alteration [cf. वास-प्°]; inver-sion, irregular or inverted order, confusion; con-trariety, opposition; deviation from enjoined or customary observances, neglect of duty.
पर्यय पर्य्-अय, पर्य्-अयण। See under परी, p. 551, col. 3.
पर्ययण: पर्य्-अयण, अम्, n. going round, walking round, circumambulating, roving about; anything wound round (an arrow or other object); a horse's saddle or housings.
पर्याय: पर्य्-आय, अस्, m. going or turning round, revolv-ing, winding round; revolution, passing away (of time), course, lapse, expiration; regular recurrence, repetition; succession, turn; regular order, arrange-ment, methodical disposition, method; a regularly recurring series or formula, especially in the Ati-rātra ceremony (Ved.); a strophe or clause of a hymn (Ved.); a convertible term, synonym; a list of synonyms; N. of a particular figure in rhetoric; way, manner, mode, method of proceeding (e. g. अनेन पर्यायेण, in this manner); property, quality, generic or specific character; opportunity, occasion; formation, creation, manufacture, prepara-tion, artificial production; comprehensiveness, ag-gregation; पर्यायेण, in succession, in turn, by turns, by rotation, successively, alternately, (opposed to युग-पत्।) —पर्याय-क्रम, अस्, m. order of succession, regular rotation or turn. —पर्याय-च्युत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has lost his turn, su-perseded, supplanted. —पर्याय-रत्न-माला, f. ‘pearl-string of synonyms,’ N. of a lexicon. —पर्-याय-वचन, अम्, n. a convertible term, synonym. —पर्याय-वाचक, अस्, आ, अम्, expressing a cor-responding notion. —पर्याय-वृत्ति, इस्, f. alternate course or action. —पर्याय-शब्द, अस्, m. a con-vertible term, synonym. —पर्याय-शयन, अम्, n. alternate sleeping and watching. —पर्याय-शस्, ind. by phrases or sentences, &c. (Ved.); periodically; in succession, by rotation, by turns, seriatim. —पर्-यायान्न (°य-अन्°), अम्, n. food intended for an-other, food that should have been given to some one else (as that of a Śūdra to a Brāhman). —पर्या-यार्णव (°य-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘ocean of synonyms,’ N. of a lexicon. —पर्यायोक्त (°य-उक्°), अम्, n., N. of a particular figure in rhetoric.
पर्याय पर्य्-आय। See under परी, p. 551.
पर्यायिक: पर्यायिक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. composed in strophes.
पर्यायिन्: पर्यायिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. embracing, including; going round, encompassing (in a hostile manner); periodical.
परीक्ष्: परीक्ष् परीक्ष् (परि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to look round, inspect carefully, examine, investigate, scrutinize; to observe, perceive: Caus. -ईक्षयति, -यितुम्, to cause to examine or inves-tigate.
परीक्षक: परीक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, trying, testing, examin-ing; (अस्), m. a prover, examiner, experimenter, investigator, judge.
परीक्षण: परीक्षण, अम्, n. trying, testing, experiment, examination, putting to the test, trying, proving.
परीक्षणीय: परीक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be tried or investi-gated, fit to be brought to the test, to be submitted to ordeal.
परीक्षा: परीक्षा, f. investigation, examination, test, trial, experiment, discrimination; trial by ordeal of various kinds; N. of a commentary on Piṅgala's Chandaḥ-śāstra.
परीक्षित: 1. परीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, carefully inspected, tried, examined, tested, proved.
परीक्षितव्य: परीक्षितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be tried or tested, to be examined or proved.
परीक्षिन्: परीक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, proving, testing, one who tries or examines, an examiner.
परीक्ष्य: परीक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be tried or tested; to be examined or proved.
परीक्षित्: परीक्षित् परी-क्षित्, त्, m. (connected with and frequently written परि-क्षित्), N. of a son of Abhi-manyu and father of Janam-ejaya; of a son of Kuru; of a son of An-aśvan and father of Bhīma-sena; of a king of A-yodhyā.
परीज्या: परीज्या परीज्या (for परि-इज्या, fr. rt. यज् with परि), Ved. an accompanying or secondary rite (= परि-यज्ञ).
परीणस्: परीणस् परीणस्, आस्, m. (probably fr. rt. पॄ), Ved. plenty, abundance, wealth; (according to Sāy.) = परितो नद्ध; (असा), ind. = बहु, richly, abundantly.
परीणस: परीणस, अम्, n., Ved. plenty, abundance, wealth.
परीताप: परीताप परी-ताप, परी-तोष, = परि-ताप, परि-तोष, q. v.
परीध्य: परीध्य परीध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. इन्ध् with परि), Ved. to be lighted or kindled.
परीप्सत्: परीप्सत् परीप्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (pres. part. of Desid. of rt. आप् with परि), wishing to obtain, striving to reach.
परीप्सा: परीप्सा, f. the desire of obtaining; the wish to save or maintain or preserve; haste, hurry.
परीप्सु: परीप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of obtaining, wishing to save, desirous of maintaining or preserving.
परीमन्: परीमन् परीमन्, आ or अ, m. or n.? (fr. rt. पॄ), Ved. bounty, plenty, plenteousness.
परीर: परीर परीर, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ), fruit.
परीरण: परीरण परीरण, अस्, m. a tortoise; a stick or staff; = पट्ट-शाटक।
परीरम्भ: परीरम्भ परी-रम्भ, अस्, m. an embrace, &c. See परि-रम्भ।
परीवर्त: परीवर्त परी-वर्त, अस्, m. exchange, bar-ter, &c. See परि-वर्त।
परीवाद: परीवाद परी-वाद, अस्, m. reproof, censure, abuse, &c. See परि-वाद।
परीवार: परीवार परी-वार, अस्, m. retinue, depend-ants, family, &c. See परि-वार।
परीवाह: परीवाह परी-वाह, अस्, m. a drain, &c., see परि-वाह; a scabbard (?).
परीशास: परीशास परी-शास, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. शस् with परि), Ved. anything cut out, an excision; (औ), m. du. a kind of tongs used for raising a kettle from the fire.
परीष्: परीष् परीष् [cf. rt. 3. इष्], cl. 6. P. -इच्-छति, -एषितुम्, -एष्टुम्, Ved. to seek or search about for.
परीष्टि: परीष्टि, इस्, f. investigation, research, inquiry, (especially philosophical); service, attendance, rever-ence, respect, homage, worship; willingness, readi-ness, inclination.
परीसार: परीसार परी-सार, अस्, m. = परि-सार, q. v.; near approach (?).
परीहास: परीहास परी-हास = परि-हास, q. v. —प-रीहास-केशव, अस्, m., N. of a temple of Viṣṇu.
परु: परु परु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ), a limb, member; a knot or joint in a reed; a moun-tain; the ocean; the sky, paradise.
परुशस्: परु-शस् or परुश्-शस्, Ved. limb by limb, member by member.
परुष: परुष, अस्, आ, अम्, (in the earlier language, f. परुष्णी), containing knots, knotted (Ved.); spotted, variegated, party-coloured; dirty; rough, rugged, uneven, shaggy; keen, piercing (as the wind); harsh, discordant; unkind, cruel, stern, hard, severe, abusive, contumelious; coarse, gross; churlish, cruel, unkind; (अस्), m. a reed (Ved.); an arrow (Ved.); = परूष, q. v.; (आ), f. a kind of riddle; (ष्णी), f., Ved. ‘much indented’ or ‘winding’ or ‘reedy,’ N. of one of the rivers of the Pañjāb, in later times called Irā-vatī, and at the present day Rāvī; a cloud?; (अम्), n. harsh and contumelious speech, abuse; a species of Barleria with blue flowers; = परूष, q. v.; (आणि), n. pl. rough or harsh or stern words. —परुष-त्व, अम्, n. roughness, harshness. —परुष-वचन, अम्, n. harsh language, harsh or contumelious speech, reproach, abuse. —प-रुष-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, harsh-spoken; (क्), f. harsh or contumelious speech. —परुषाक्षर (°ष-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘harsh-worded,’ harsh. —परुषाह्व (°ष-आह्°), अस्, m., Ved. a species of reed. —परुषी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spotted, soiled, stained; treated roughly. —परुषेतर (°ष-इत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, other than rough, bright, light, beaming, mild. —परु-षोक्ति (°ष-उक्°), इस्, f. abusive or harsh language. —परुषोक्तिक, अस्, m. an abuser, one uttering harsh and scurrilous language.
परुष परुष। See under परु, col. 2.
परुषित: परुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, treated roughly or harshly, subjected to rude treatment.
परुषिमन्: परुषिमन्, आ, m., Ved. a rough or shaggy appearance.
परुष्य: परुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. party-coloured, varie-gated, piebald.
परुस्: परुस्, उस्, n., Ved. a knot or joint of a cane or reed; a member of the body, limb; a joint, junction; a part cut off, portion. —परुः-स्रंस, अस्, m., Ved. fracture of a joint or limb.
परूष: परूष or परूषक, अस्, m. Grewia Asiatica (from the berries of which a cooling beverage is pre-pared; Bengāli फलसा; Hindūstānī پهالسا ac-cording to others) Xylocarpus Granatum = Bengāli, परुष; (अम्), n. the fruit of this tree.
परुच्छेप: परुच्छेप परु-च्छेप, अस्, m. (perhaps irre-gularly formed fr. परुस् + क्षेप), N. of a Ṛṣi, son of Divo-dāsa and author of the hymns Ṛg-veda I. 127 sqq.
परुत्: परुत् परुत्, ind. (fr. पर + वत्?, occur-ring only in comp.), last year; [cf. Gr. πέρυσι, Dor. πέρυτι, πέρυτις: Old Germ. vert, vernent, vern, ‘last year:’ Goth. fairni-s, ‘old;’ fairnyō yēr, ‘the old year.’]
परुद्वार: परुद्वार परुद्वार or परुल, अस्, m. a horse; [cf. Lat. paraveredus.]
परे: परे परे (परा-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2, P. परैति, परैतुम्, to go away, run away; to go to, set out for, approach; to go to the other world, depart, die.
परेत: परेत, अस्, आ, अम्, departed, deceased, defunct, dead; (अस्), m. a kind of spectre; a ghost, spirit. —परेत-भूमि, इस्, f. ‘place of the departed,’ a cemetery. —परेत-राज्, ट्, m. ‘ruler of the dead,’ an epithet of Yama.
परेक्ष्: परेक्ष् परेक्ष् (परा-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. परे-क्षते, -षितुम्, Ved. to look at (anything at one's side).
परेद्यवि: परेद्यवि परे-द्यवि, परे-द्युस्, परे-प्राण। See under पर।
परेप: परेप परेप, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परा? + अप्), (any place) whence water has retired.
परेष्टु: परेष्टु परेष्टु, उस्, or परेष्टुका, f. a cow which has often calved.
परोक्ष: परोक्ष परो-ऽक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परस् + ४। अक्ष, opposed to प्रत्य्-अक्ष, q. v.), beyond the range of sight, out of sight, invisible, imper-ceptible, escaping observation; unknown, strange, unintelligible; absent, past; (अस्), m. an ascetic, religious hermit; N. of one of the sons of Anu; (आ), f. past or completed action (in grammar perhaps with वृत्ति); (अम्), n. invisibility, absence, secrecy; (in grammar) past time or tense. The acc., inst., abl., and loc. cases of परोक्ष are used adverbially, as follow: (अम्), ind. out of sight, behind one's back, in the absence of, without the knowledge of (in the earlier language with inst., in the later with gen.); surreptitiously; (एण), ind., Ved. out of sight, secretly, mysteriously, surreptitiously; (आत्), ind., Ved. secretly, without the knowledge of (with inst.); (ए), ind. behind one's back, in the absence of, imperceptibly, surreptitiously; [cf. अ-परोक्ष।] —परोक्ष-कृता, f., Ved., scil. ऋक्, a hymn or verse in which a deity is spoken of in the third person, the first person being kept out of sight (e. g. ‘Indra rules over heaven and earth,’ &c.). —प-रोक्ष-जित्, त्, त्, त्, conquering invisibly, an unseen conqueror. —परोक्ष-ता, f. or परोक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. the being beyond the sphere of observation, ob-scurity, invisibility, imperceptibility; keeping one's self as the first person out of sight, speaking of one's self in the third person (Ved.). —परोक्ष-भोग, अस्, m. enjoyment or possession of anything in the absence of the proprietor. —परोक्ष-मन्मथ, अस्, आ, अम्, inexperienced in love, a stranger to love. —परोक्ष-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, whose life is unseen, living out of sight; formed out of sight or unseen, formed in obscurity; (इस्), f. an unseen life. —प-रोक्षार्थ (°ष-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having an unseen meaning, secret, recondite; (अम्), n. an absent or invisible object.
परोगव्यूति: परो-गव्यूति, ind. (fr. परस् + ग्°), Ved. beyond or outside the pasture land; (Sāy.) = क्रोश-द्वयाद् देशात् परस्तात्, further than a Gavyūti, q. v.
परोबाहु: परो-बाहु, ind. (fr. परस् + ब्°), Ved. beyond the arm or reach.
परोमात्र: परो-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. परस् + म्°), Ved. immense, huge, vast.
परोरजस्: परो-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. परस् + र्°), Ved. being beyond the dust or above the world (Ved.); untouched by passion.
परोलक्ष: परो-लक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परस् + ल्°), over a lakh, more than 100, 000.
परोवरम्: परो-ऽवरम् (fr. परस् + अव्°), ind., Ved. from top to bottom; from hand to hand; in succession, one after another.
परोवरीण: परो-ऽवरीण, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परस् + अव्°), having both superior and inferior, prior and subsequent, &c.
परोवरीयस्: परो-वरीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (fr. परस् + व्°), Ved. broader on the outside or at the top; better than good, most excellent of all; (अस्), n. the highest happiness.
परोष्णिह्: परोष्णिह् (fr. परस् + उष्°), क्, f. a kind of metre (consisting of 8 + 8 + 12 syllables).
परोष्णी: परोष्णी परोष्णी, f. a cockroach, (some-times wrongly written परोष्टी); N. of a river.
पर्क: पर्क पर्क in मधु-प्°, q. v.
पर्कट: पर्कट पर्कट, अस्, m. a heron [cf. वकोट]; (अम्), n. regret, anxiety.
पर्कटिन्: पर्कटिन्, ई, m. or पर्कटी, f. the waved-leaved fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria; a fresh betel-nut.
पर्जनी: पर्जनी, f. the plant Cucumis Aromatica or Cu-cumis Xanthorrhiza.
पर्जन्य: पर्जन्य पर्जन्य, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. स्फुर्ज् for original स्पर्ज्; but said to be fr. rt. पृष्; sometimes wrongly written पर्यन्य), a rain-cloud, thunder-cloud, cloud; the muttering of clouds or distant thunder; rain; Rain personified; the rain-god, thunderer and fertilizer, i. e. Indra; N. of one of the twelve Ādityas; of a Deva-gandharva; of one of the seven Ṛṣis in several Manv-antaras; of a Prajā-pati and father of Hiraṇya-roman; (आ), f. = पर्जनी, col. 2. —पर्जन्य-क्रन्द्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. muttering like a rain-cloud or like Parjanya. —पर्जन्य-जिन्वित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. animated by Parjanya; (Sāy.) = पर्जन्येन प्रीत, agreeable to Parjanya. —पर्जन्य-नाथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having Parjanya as protector or patron. —पर्जन्य-पत्नी, f., Ved. having Parjanya for a husband, wedded to Parjanya (said of the earth). —पर्जन्य-रेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. generated or growing in the showers or in the rainy season, (said of a reed or arrow; Sāy. = पर्जन्यो रेतो यस्याः।) —पर्जन्य-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. nourished by Parjanya (as the Soma). —पर्जन्य-सूक्त, अम्, n., N. of a hymn contained in the Mantra-saṃhitā.
पर्ण्: पर्ण् पर्ण् (more properly regarded as a Nom. fr. पर्ण below), cl. 10. P. पर्णयति, -यितुम्, to be green or verdant.
पर्ण: पर्ण, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ), a pinion, feather, wing; the feather of an arrow; a leaf (re-garded as the plumage of a tree); the Pān or betel leaf; (अस्), m. Butea Frondosa (a beautiful sacred tree with leaves from eight to sixteen inches in length, of the wood of which particular sacrificial vessels are made, in later times generally called पलाश); N. of a man; of a teacher; of a place; (ई), f. an aquatic plant, Pistia Stratiotes; the leaf of the Asa Fœtida (?); [cf. अच्छिन्न-प्°, अश्व-प्°, उत्तान-प्°, &c.; cf. probably Gr. Πάρνης, Παρνασός, Παρνασσός; perhaps Lat. penna, if not fr. rt. पत्, q. v., frons; Old Germ. farn; Angl. Sax. fearn.] —पर्ण-कार, अस्, m. = वार-जीवी (commonly वा-rui), a vender of betel leaves. —पर्ण-कुटिका, f. or पर्ण-कुटी, f. a hut made of leaves. —पर्ण-कृच्छ्र, अस्, m. ‘leaf-penance,’ living for a time upon an infusion of leaves and Kuśa grass as a religious observance. —पर्ण-खण्ड, अस्, m. a tree without apparent blossoms; a tree in general. —पर्ण-चीर-पट, अस्, आ, अम्, clad in a garment made of strips of leaves; an epithet of Śiva. —पर्ण-चोरक, अस्, m. a kind of perfume; [cf. चोरक।] —पर्ण-धि, इस्, m., Ved. the part of an arrow to which the feathers are fastened. —पर्ण-ध्वस्, त्, त्, त्, causing the falling of leaves. —पर्ण-नर, अस्, m. ‘man of leaves,’ an effigy stuffed with leaves or the figure of a man made of leaves and burnt in place of a lost corpse. —पर्ण-नाल, अस्, m. a leaf-stalk, petiole. —पर्ण-प्रात्यिक, N. of a locality (perhaps in-correctly for पर्ण-प्रासिक). —पर्ण-भेदिनी, f. the Priyaṅgu tree. —पर्ण-भोजन, अस्, आ, अम्, feeding upon leaves; (अस्), m. any animal eating leaves, a goat. —पर्ण-मणि, इस्, m., Ved. a kind of magical instrument (made of the wood of the Parṇa tree ?). —पर्ण-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. made of the wood of the Butea Frondosa. —पर्ण-माचाल, अस्, m. the plant Averrhoa Carambola (= कर्मरङ्ग). —पर्ण-मुच्, ट्, ट्, ट्, causing leaves to fall (as the wind). —पर्ण-मृग, अस्, m. ‘leaf-animal,’ any wild animal lodging in the boughs of trees (as a monkey, sloth, squirrel, &c.). —पर्ण-रुह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, causing the leaves to grow (as the wind). —पर्ण-लता, f. the betel plant. —पर्ण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, abounding in leaves, leafy. —पर्ण-वल्क, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पर्ण-वल्ली, f. Butea Frondosa (= पलाशी-लता). —पर्ण-वाद्य, अम्, n. ‘leaf-music,’ sounds produced by blowing into a leaf. —पर्ण-वी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. ‘wing-borne,’ carried by wings. —पर्ण-वीटिका, f. the Areca nut cut in pieces, sprinkled with spices, and rolled up in betel leaves. —पर्ण-शद or पर्ण-शाद, अस्, m., Ved. the falling of leaves. —पर्ण-शद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to the falling of leaves. —पर्-ण-शय्या, f. a couch of leaves, leafy couch. —पर्ण-शर, अस्, m., Ved. a leaf-stalk, petiole; the stalk of a Parṇa leaf. —पर्ण-शवर, आस्, m., N. of a people, (Śavaras living upon leaves.) —पर्ण-शाला, f. ‘leaf-hut,’ an arbour or hut made of leaves and grass, hermitage; N. of a great settlement of Brāhmans between the Yamunā and Gaṅgā in Madhya-deśa. —पर्णशालाग्र (°ला-अग्°), अस्, m., N. of a mountain in Bhadrāśva. —पर्ण-शुष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, drying or shriveling the leaves (as the wind). —पर्ण-संस्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, having leaves for a bed, sleeping on leaves. —पर्ण-सन्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, having leaves for a bed, sleeping on leaves. —पर्णाढक (°ण-आढ्°), अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants. —पर्णाद (°ण-अद), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding upon leaves; (अस्), m., N. of an ancient sage; of a Brāhman. —पर्णा-शन (°ण-अश्°), अम्, n. feeding on leaves; (अस्), m. a cloud. —पर्णासि (°ण-असि), इस्, m. a species of basil with small leaves, Ocymum Sanctum. —पर्-णाहार (°ण-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding upon leaves. —पर्णोटज (°ण-उट्°), अम्, n. ‘leaf-hut,’ an an-chorite's hut or cottage, a hermitage. —पर्णोत्स (°ण-उत्°), अस्, m., N. of a village.
पर्णक: पर्णक, अस्, m., Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) = भिल्ल, q. v.; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants; (इका), f. a kind of vegetable; N. of an Apsaras.
पर्णय: पर्णय, अस्, m., Ved., N. of an enemy (according to Sāy. an Asura) slain by Indra. —पर्णय-घ्न, अम्, n., Ved. the slaying of Parṇaya.
पर्णल: पर्णल, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in leaves, full of leaves, leafy.
पर्णसि: पर्णसि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ), a house upon or by the water; a summer-house (?); a lotus; a vegetable; adorning, decoration, toilet.
पर्णाश: पर्णाश or पर्णास, अस्, m. a species of plant, a kind of basil with small leaves, Ocymum Sanctum; (आ), f., N. of various rivers; [cf. पूर्णाशा।]
पर्णिक: पर्णिक, अस्, आ, अम्, selling or dealing in Parṇī.
पर्णिन्: पर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, winged, plumed; leafy, having leaves, leaved; (ई), m. a tree; Butea Frondosa; (इनी), f. a species of plant; N. of an Apsaras.
पर्णिल: पर्णिल, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in leaves, leafy.
पर्ण्य: पर्ण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to leaves, leafy.
पर्णाल: पर्णाल पर्णाल, अस्, m. a boat; a spade or hoe; single combat.
पर्तृ: पर्तृ पर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. rt. 1. पृ), Ved. a protector; protection, means of defence, (Sāy. = पालन-साधनम्।)
पर्द्: पर्द् पर्द्, cl. 1. A. पर्दते, &c., to break wind, fart; [cf. Gr. πέρδ-ω, πέρδ-ο-μαι, ἔ-παρδ-ο-ν, πέ-πορδ-α, πορδ-ή, πέρδ-ιξ; Lat. pêd-o, pêd-or, pôdex; Old Germ. firz-u; Bohem. prd-u; Lith. perd-z-u, pérs-ti, pī1rd-i-s.]
पर्द: पर्द, अस्, m. a fart; a quantity of hair, thick hair.
पर्दन: पर्दन, अम्, n. breaking wind, a fart.
पर्प्: पर्प् पर्प् (a doubtful rt.; by some re-garded as a Sautra rt.; cf. Uṇādi-s. IV. 81), cl. 1. P. पर्पति, &c., to go or move.
पर्प: पर्प, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पृ), a wheel-chair, a chair in which a cripple is moved about; young grass; a house.
पर्पट: पर्पट, अस्, m. a species of medicinal plant with bitter leaves (= भेषजान्तर, तिक्ता क्षेत्र-पर्-पटी, apparently the Oldenlandia Biflora); a kind of thin cake, = चर्पटी; (ई), f. a kind of fragrant earth or a red aluminous earth (apparently a sort of Bol, brought from Surāt or Su-rāṣṭra); a sort of fragrant substance or perfume (= कृष्णा, चक्र-वर्तिनी, जतुका, commonly called पपरी); a thin crisp cake made of any pulse. —पर्पट-द्रुम or पर्पटी-द्रुम, अस्, m. bdellium.
पर्पटक: पर्पटक, अस्, m. a species of medicinal plant with bitter leaves, (probably) Oldenlandia Biflora.
पर्पिक: पर्पिक, अस्, ई, m. f. a cripple who moves about by the aid of a chair.
पर्परी: पर्परी पर्परी, f. a braid of hair.
पर्परीक: पर्परीक पर्परीक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ with reduplication), the sun; fire; a tank, reservoir, piece of water.
पर्फरीक: पर्फरीक पर्फरीक, अस्, m., Ved. one who tears to pieces or fills, (Sāy. = शत्रूणं विदार-यितृ or धनादि-दानेन पूरयितृ।)
पर्ब्: पर्ब् पर्ब्, cl. 1. P. पर्बति, &c., to go or move.
पर्माडि: पर्माडि पर्माडि, इस्, m., N. of a prince of Karṇāṭa, (also called Parmāṇḍi.)
पर्यगु: पर्यगु पर्य्-अगु in comp. with पारम-हंस्य, Bhāgavata-Purāṇa IV. 21, 40; according to a Scholiast = परितो न गच्छन्ति गावो यस्मात्, but variously taken, see पारमहंस्य-परि।
पर्यग्नि: पर्यग्नि पर्य्-अग्नि, इस्, m., Ved. circumam-bient fire; a torch carried round the sacrificial animal; the ceremony of carrying fire round the sacrificial animal; पर्यग्नि कृ, to carry fire round any one (with acc.).
पर्यग्निकृत: पर्यग्नि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. encircled with fire.
पर्यग्निक्रियमाण: पर्यग्नि-क्रियमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being encircled with fire; (ए), loc. during the encircling with fire.
पर्यङ्क: पर्य्-अङ्क, अस्, m. (fr. परि + अङ्क or perhaps directly fr. 1. पर्य्-अञ्च् above; also spelt पल्य्-अङ्क), a bed, couch, sofa; a litter, palanquin; a cloth thrown over the back, loins and knees while seated on the hams in the Oriental manner; sitting upon the hams (a particular posture especially practised by ascetics in meditation); N. of a mountain (son of Vindhya). —पर्यङ्क-ग्रन्थि-बन्ध, अस्, m. or -°बन्-धन, अम्, n. the bending of the legs in sitting on the hams. —पर्यङ्क-बन्ध, अस्, m. sitting in the Paryaṅka posture (= वीरासन). —पर्यङ्क-बन्धन, अम्, n. binding a cloth round the back, loins and knees while squatting on the hams. —पर्य्-अङ्क-भोगिन्, ई, m. ‘couch-serpent,’ a kind of ser-pent. —पर्यङ्क-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting on a sofa.
पर्यङ्ख्: पर्यङ्ख् पर्य्-अङ्ख्, cl. 10. P. A. -अङ्खयति, -ते, -यितुम्, Ved. to surround, clasp or encircle round.
पर्यङ्ग्य: पर्यङ्ग्य पर्यङ्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. परि + अङ्ग), Ved. being about or at the side.
पर्यञ्च्: पर्यञ्च् 1. पर्य्-अञ्च् or पर्य्-अच्, cl. 1. P. A. -अञ्चति, -ते, -अञ्चितुम्, Ved. to turn round, revolve.
2. पर्य्-अञ्च्, apparently only used in acc. sing. neut. पर्य्-अक्, ind. round about, all round, in every direction.
पर्यट्: पर्यट् पर्य्-अट्, cl. 1. P. A. -अटति, -ते, -अटि-तुम्, to roam or wander about, rove about.
पर्यट: पर्य्-अट, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
पर्यटन: पर्य्-अटन, अम्, n. wandering about, peregrina-tion, roaming through.
पर्यनुबन्ध: पर्यनुबन्ध पर्य्-अनुबन्ध, अस्, m. binding round.
पर्यनुयोग: पर्यनुयोग पर्य्-अनुयोग, अस्, m. asking, inquiring, question; blame, censure, reproach; con-testing, disputing (?).
पर्यन्त: पर्यन्त पर्य्-अन्त, अस्, m. an encircling boundary, circuit, circumference; limit, edge, skirt, border, verge, extremity; end, termination, close (e. g. काल-पर्यन्त, the end or close of an ap-pointed time; पर्यन्तात् पर्यन्तम्, from one end to the other); (अस्, आ, अम्), bounded, sur-rounded by a boundary; extending in all directions; (often at the end of comps., e. g. क्षुर-पर्य्-अन्तं चक्रम्, a discus with edges like a razor's; समुद्र-पर्यन्ता पृथिवी, the ocean-bounded earth or the earth extending to the ocean.) —पर्य्-अन्त-देश, अस्, m. a neighbouring or adjacent dis-trict. —पर्यन्त-पर्यन्तम्, ind. to the end of, as far as. —पर्यन्त-पर्वत, अस्, m. an adjoining hill. —पर्यन्त-भू, ऊस्, f. ground contiguous to the skirts of a river or mountain. —पर्यन्त-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, limitative, confining, adjoining, neighbour-ing. —पर्यन्त-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, bounding, con-fining.
पर्यन्तिका: पर्यन्तिका, f. loss of all good qualities, depravity.
पर्यन्य: पर्यन्य पर्यन्य, incorrectly for पर्जन्य, q. v.
पर्यन्विष्: पर्यन्विष् पर्य्-अन्व्-इष्, cl. 6. P. -इच्छति, -एष्टुम्, -एषितुम्, to seek for, search after.
पर्यर्षण: पर्यर्षण पर्य्-अर्षण। See under 2. पर्य्-ऋष्, p. 555, col. 3.
पर्य्-अर्षण, अम्, n., Ved. clasping round, sup-porting, making firm.
पर्यवकॄ: पर्यवकॄ पर्य्-अव-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -क-रितुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter round or about, shed over.
पर्यवच्छिद्: पर्यवच्छिद् पर्य्-अव-च्छिद् (°छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्त्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, Ved. to cut off on both sides or all round.
पर्यवदात: पर्यवदात पर्य्-अवदात, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. दै or 7. दा with पर्य्-अव), perfectly clean or pure; [cf. 7. दा, अव-दात।]
पर्यवदो: पर्यवदो पर्य्-अव-दो or पर्य्-अवदा (see rt. 3. दा), cl. 2. 4. P. -दाति, -द्यति, -दातुम्, Ved. to cut off or slice all round.
पर्यवधारण: पर्यवधारण पर्य्-अवधारण, अम्, n. pre-cise determination, refining, subtilizing.
पर्यवरोध: पर्यवरोध पर्य्-अवरोध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रुध् with पर्य्-अव), obstruction, hindrance.
पर्यवशेष: पर्यवशेष पर्य्-अवशेष, अस्, m. end, ter-mination.
पर्यवशेषित: पर्य्-अवशेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, regarded as the end of all (i. e. God).
पर्यवष्टम्भ्: पर्यवष्टम्भ् पर्य्-अव-ष्टम्भ्, cl. 5. 9. P., 1. A. -ष्टभ्नोति, -नाति, -ष्टम्भते, -ष्टम्भितुम्, to surround; to surround with a view to obstruct.
पर्यवष्टब्ध: पर्य्-अवष्टब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, in-vested.
पर्यवसो: पर्यवसो पर्य्-अव-सो, cl. 4. P. -स्यति, -सा-तुम्, to finish, complete, conclude; to endeavour.
पर्यवसान: पर्य्-अवसान, अम्, n. end, termination, con-clusion, issue.
पर्यवसानिक: पर्यवसानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, coming to a close, drawing to an end or conclusion.
पर्यवसायिन्: पर्य्-अवसायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, closing or ending with (often in comps.). —पर्यवसायि-त्व, अम्, n. ter-mination, close.
पर्यवसित: पर्य्-अवसित, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, completed, ended, terminated, concluded; perished, lost; re-solved; लोकान्तरम् पर्य्-अवसितः, gone to another world.
पर्यवस्कन्द: पर्यवस्कन्द पर्य्-अवस्कन्द, अस्, m. jumping or leaping down (from a carriage).
पर्यवस्था: पर्यवस्था 1. पर्य्-अव-स्था, cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to be present or exist everywhere; to rely upon: Caus. -स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to raise, rouse.
2. पर्य्-अवस्था, f. or पर्य्-अवस्थान, अम्, n. opposition, resistance, contradiction.
पर्यवस्थातृ: पर्य्-अवस्थातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, opposing, obstruct-ing, opposed to or against; (ता), m. an antagonist, opponent, adversary, enemy.
पर्यवस्थित: पर्य्-अवस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, opposed to, siding with an enemy.
पर्यवे: पर्यवे पर्य्-अवे (पर्य्-अव-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -अवैति, -अवैतुम्, Ved. to turn round, turn in the right direction; to pass, elapse.
पर्यवेक्ष: पर्यवेक्ष पर्य्-अवेक्ष् (पर्य्-अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -अवेक्षते, -क्षितुम्, to regard from every side, regard (?).
पर्यश्: पर्यश् 1. पर्य्-अश्, cl. 5. P. A. -अश्नोति, -नुते, अशितुम्, Ved. to arrive at, reach, attain (Sāy. = परितो व्य्-आप्).
पर्यश् 2. पर्य्-अश्, cl. 9. P. -अश्नाति, -अशितुम्, to eat.
पर्यश्रु: पर्यश्रु पर्य्-अश्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, bathed in or suffused with tears, shedding tears, tearful.
पर्यस्: पर्यस् 1. पर्य्-अस्, cl. 2. P. -अस्ति, Ved. to be in the way; to surpass; to pass or spend (time); (Sāy.) = परितो भू, to be everywhere about.

पर्यस् 2. पर्य्-अस्, cl. 4. P. A. -अस्यति, -ते, -असितुम्, to throw or cast round, put or place round, put on, spread round, diffuse; to surround, encircle, encompass; to enchase; to entrap, ensnare; to turn round, turn over; to turn away; to throw down, overturn, upset: Pass. -अस्यते, to fall down, drop, sink down: Caus. to cause to drop, to cause to roll down or shed (as tears).
पर्यसन: पर्य्-असन, अम्, n. throwing about, moving to and fro, wagging; casting, sending; putting off or away.
पर्यस्त: पर्य्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast round, placed round, put on, diffused; surrounded, encom-passed, ensnared; thrown off, thrown down; thrown or tossed up; overturned, upset; dismissed, laid aside; struck, killed; bound. —पर्यस्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the notion expressed by the word पर्य्-अस्त. —पर्यस्त-विलोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, or पर्यस्ताक्ष (°त-अक्ष), अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. having the eyes cast or directed round.
पर्यस्ति: पर्य्-अस्ति, इस्, f. sitting upon the hams (= पर्य्-अङ्क, q. v.).
पर्यस्यत्: पर्य्-अस्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, scattering; oversetting, upsetting; investing.
पर्यास: पर्य्-आस, अस्, m. edging, trimming (Ved.); end. conclusion; epithet of particular concluding strophes in certain hymns (Ved.); rotation, revolution; in-verted order or position.
पर्यास पर्य्-आस, पर्य्-आसन। See under 2. पर्य्-अस्, p. 554, col. 3.
पर्यासित: पर्य्-आसित, अस्, आ, अम्, upset, subverted, reversed.
पर्यस्तमयम्: पर्यस्तमयम् पर्य्-अस्तमयम्, ind., Ved. about sunset.
पर्याकुल: पर्याकुल पर्य्-आकुल, अस्, आ, अम्, filled, full; turbid on all sides (as water), turbid; confounded, confused, disordered, beside one's self, excited, agi-tated, anxious, bewildered, infatuated. —पर्याकुल-त्व, अम्, n. confusion, bewilderment.
पर्याकृ: पर्याकृ पर्य्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to turn round.
पर्याक्षिप्: पर्याक्षिप् पर्य्-आ-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षि-पति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to wind round, turn.
पर्यागम्: पर्यागम् पर्य्-आ-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to go round, perform a revolution, elapse; to last or live through a space of time; to come to an end or conclusion; to surround on every side, encircle, ensnare, get into one's power.
पर्यागत: पर्य्-आगत, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has finished the course or career of life.
पर्यागल्: पर्यागल् पर्य्-आ-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, -ग-लितुम्, to let fall in drops, drop, trickle.
पर्यागलत्: पर्य्-आगलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dropping, falling, trickling.
पर्यागा: पर्यागा पर्य्-आ-गा (occurring in Aor. पर्य्-आगात्, Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 8157), to perform a revo-lution, elapse.
पर्याचर्: पर्याचर् पर्य्-आ-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -च-रितुम्, Ved. to come near, approach, resort to.
पर्याचान्त: पर्याचान्त पर्य्-आचान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sipped, rinsed prematurely; (scil. अन्नम्) food left by a person who has rinsed his mouth out.
पर्याण: पर्याण पर्याण, अम्, n. (for परि-याण), a circuit (Ved.); a saddle, pack-saddle or cloth serving for one.
पर्याणह्: पर्याणह् पर्य्-आ-णह्, cl. 4. P. A. -णह्यति, -ते, -णद्धुम्, Ved. to cover up, cover.
पर्याणहन: पर्य्-आणहन, अम्, n., Ved. a covering.
पर्याणी: पर्याणी पर्य्-आ-णी, cl. 1. P. A. -णयति, -ते, -णेतुम्, to lead round; to lead or bring forward.
पर्यातन्: पर्यातन् पर्य्-आ-तन्, cl. 5. P. A. -तनोति, -नुते, -तनितुम्, Ved. to spread round, encompass, surround.
पर्यादा: पर्यादा पर्य्-आ-दा, cl. 3. A. -दत्ते, -दातुम्, to make one's own, appropriate, learn; to take pos-session of; to take anything (acc.) away from (abl.); to take off, remove; to seize, grasp.
पर्याद्रु: पर्याद्रु पर्य्-आ-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रो-तुम्, to run to and fro, hasten round about.
पर्याधा: पर्याधा पर्य्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, Ved. to lay round, surround with (fire).
पर्याप्: पर्याप् पर्य्-आप्, cl. 5. P. -आप्नोति, -आप्तुम्, to reach, obtain, gain (Ved.); to make an end of; to be content: Desid. परीप्सति, &c., to wish to obtain or reach; to try to get at; to ask for, request, desire; to wish to preserve, guard; to lie in wait or ambush.
पर्याप्त: पर्य्-आप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained, gained; finished, ended, completed, complete, large, extensive, spacious; full; able, adequate, enough, sufficient; many; (अम्), ind. willingly, readily; ably, powerfully; satis-factorily. —पर्याप्त-कल, अस्, आ, अम्, having full digits (as the moon). —पर्याप्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose desires are under control. —पर्याप्-त-ता, f. satisfaction, gratification. —पर्याप्त-दक्-षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied with liberal gifts. —पर्याप्त-भोग, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing or en-joying a sufficiency. —पर्याप्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, able, capable.
पर्याप्ति: पर्य्-आप्ति, इस्, f. attaining, obtaining, acquisition; end, conclusion, close; adequacy, competency, fitness, dexterity; entireness, fulness, sufficiency, enough; satisfaction, repletion, satiety; willingness, readiness; protecting, preserving, guarding, warding off a blow, self-defence; discrimination or distinction of objects according to their natural properties.
पर्यापत्: पर्यापत् पर्य्-आ-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -प-तितुम्, to hasten forth, hurry away, run away.
पर्याप्लु: पर्याप्लु पर्य्-आ-प्लु, cl. 1. A. -प्लवते, -प्लो-तुम्, to run round, encompass, encircle: Caus. -प्ला-वयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to float round.
पर्याप्लुत: पर्य्-आप्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encircled.
पर्याभू: पर्याभू पर्य्-आ-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भ-वितुम्, Ved. to turn round.
पर्याभृ: पर्याभृ पर्य्-आ-भृ, cl. 1. P. -भरति, -भर्-तुम्, Ved. to extract.
पर्याभृत: पर्य्-आ-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. extracted.
पर्यामृश्: पर्यामृश् पर्य्-आ-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति, -मर्ष्टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, to subdue, conquer, over-power.
पर्यारिन्: पर्यारिन् पर्य्-आरिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. 4. ऋ with परि), Ved. (perhaps) falling away, decaying, decrepit.
पर्यालोच्: पर्यालोच् पर्य्-आ-लोच्, cl. 10. P. -लोचयति, -यितुम्, to look after, attend to, consider (the in-terests of another), ponder.
पर्यालोचन: पर्य्-आलोचन, अम्, n. or पर्य्-आलोचना, f. look-ing round or about; circumspection, attentive observa-tion, mature consideration or reflection, deliberating; knowing, recognising.
पर्याविल: पर्याविल पर्य्-आविल, अस्, आ, अम्, very turbid, much soiled.
पर्यावृत्: पर्यावृत् पर्य्-आ-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to turn round, return: Caus. P. -वर्त-यति, -यितुम्, to roll round, turn round: Desid. -विवृत्सति, Ved. to wish to roll round.
पर्यावर्तन: पर्य्-आवर्तन, अस्, m., N. of a hell; (अम्), n. coming back, returning.
पर्यावर्तित: पर्य्-आवर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, sub-verted, reversed.
पर्याविवृत्सत्: पर्य्-आविवृत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. wishing to roll round.
पर्याश्वस्: पर्याश्वस् पर्य्-आ-श्वस्, Caus. P. -श्वासयति, -यितुम्, to comfort, console.
पर्यास्: पर्यास् पर्य्-आस्, cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to sit round any one (acc.); to remain sitting, remain inactive; to exclude one's self from (with acc.).
पर्याहार: पर्याहार पर्य्-आहार, अस्, m. a yoke worn across the shoulders in carrying a load; conveying, taking; a load; storing hay or grain; a ewer, pitcher.
पर्युक: पर्युक पर्युक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
पर्युक्ष्: पर्युक्ष् पर्य्-उक्ष्, cl. 6. P. -उक्षति, -उक्षि-तुम्, Ved. to sprinkle round.
पर्युक्षण: पर्य्-उक्षण, अम्, n. sprinkling round; sprink-ling; (ई), f. a vessel for sprinkling (Ved.).
पर्युत्थान: पर्युत्थान पर्य्-उत्थान, अम्, n. standing up, rising.
पर्युत्सुक: पर्युत्सुक पर्य्-उत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, afficted, sad, sorrowful, regretting; eagerly desirous, longing for (with dat.).
पर्युदयम्: पर्युदयम् पर्य्-उदयम्, ind., Ved. about sunrise.
पर्युदस्: पर्युदस् पर्य्-उद्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असि-तुम्, to heap round about, to construct here and there; to prohibit, object to; to expect, exclude.
पर्युदस्त: पर्य्-उदस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped round; prohibited, objected to (as a ceremony); excepted, excluded.
पर्युदास: पर्य्-उदास, अस्, m. or पर्य्-उदासन, अम्, n. a prohibitive rule or precept, exception.
पर्युद्भृत: पर्युद्भृत पर्य्-उद्भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. brought out, extracted; constructed, framed.
पर्युद्विज्: पर्युद्विज् पर्य्-उद्-विज्, cl. 7. P. -विनक्ति, -विजितुम्, to suffer pain, suffer.
पर्युपवेशन: पर्युपवेशन पर्य्-उपवेशन, अम्, n. sitting about.
पर्युपस्था: पर्युपस्था पर्य्-उप-स्था, cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्-ठति, -ते, -स्थातुम्, to stand round, surround; wait on, serve, minister; to be present.
पर्युपस्थान: पर्य्-उपस्थान, अम्, n. waiting upon, serving, maintaining; rising, elevation.
पर्युपस्थित: पर्य्-उपस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, drawing nigh, immi-nent, impending.
पर्युपस्पृश्: पर्युपस्पृश् पर्य्-उप-स्पृश्, cl. 6. P. -स्पृ-शति, -स्प्रष्टुम्, -स्पर्ष्टुम्, to touch or use for ablution or bathing.
पर्युपास्: पर्युपास् पर्य्-उपास् (पर्य्-उप-आस्), cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to sit round, surround, encompass, encircle; to sit on or upon; to live around; to be present at, partake of; to approach as an attendant or worshipper, show reverence, worship.
पर्युपासक: पर्य्-उपासक, अस्, आ, अम्, worshipping, honouring, a worshipper, one who honours or respects.
पर्युपासन: पर्य्-उपासन, अम्, n. encamping or sitting round; friendliness, amiability, courtesy; honour, service, worship; joining in or concurrence with any act of reverence.
पर्युपासितृ: पर्य्-उपासितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, moving round or about; showing respect or honour; a worshipper.
पर्युपासीन: पर्य्-उपासीन, अस्, आ, अम्, seated or sitting upon.
पर्युप्त: पर्युप्त पर्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वप् with परि), sown; set (as a gem in a ring).
पर्युप्ति: पर्य्-उप्ति, इस्, f. scattering seed, sowing.
पर्युषण: पर्युषण पर्य्-उषण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 6. वस् with परि or incorrectly for पर्य्-एषण), service, worship, adoration.
पर्युषित: पर्य्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, having passed the night; stale, not fresh; insipid; stupid, vain. —पर्युषित-भोजिन्, ई, m. the eater of stale food (said to become a maggot or worm in the next birth).
पर्यूह्: पर्यूह् पर्य्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 1. ऊह्], cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, -ऊहितुम्, Ved. to heap or pile round; to surround or fortify with mounds or embankments.
पर्यूहण: पर्य्-ऊहण, अम्, n., Ved. sweeping or heaping together.
पर्यृष्: पर्यृष् 1. पर्य्-ऋष्, cl. 1. P. -अर्षति, -अर्-षितुम्, Ved. to flow round, flow into.
पर्यृष् 2. पर्य्-ऋष्, cl. 6. P. -ऋषति, -अर्षि-तुम्, Ved. to embrace, clasp round, support.
पर्ये: पर्ये पर्य्-ए (परि-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्, Ved. to roam about; to come back, return.
पर्येतृ: पर्येतृ पर्य्-एतृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. परी), Ved. overpowering, mastering; (Sāy.) = नाशक, a de-spoiler; = परि-गमयितृ, a promoter.
पर्येष्: पर्येष् पर्य्-एष्, cl. 1. P. -एषति, -एषितुम्, to seek about for.
पर्येषण: पर्य्-एषण, अम्, n. search, inquiry, investigation; (आ), f. search, inquiry, research, investigation of duty by reasoning; serving, waiting upon, service.
पर्येषत्: पर्य्-एषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, seeking about for.
पर्येष्टव्य: पर्य्-एष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought after, to be sought.
पर्येष्टि: पर्य्-एष्टि, इस्, f. searching for, inquiry.
पर्व्: पर्व् पर्व्, cl. 1. P. पर्वति, पर्वितुम्, to fill; [cf. rts. पॄ, पूर्व्, मर्व्।]
पर्व: पर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) = पर्वन्, p. 556, col. 1.
पर्वण: पर्वण, अस्, m., N. of a demon; (ई), m. the period of a change of the moon; a festival; (also पर्वणिका and पर्वणीका), a particular disease of the so-called juncture (सन्धि) of the eye; (at the end of a comp.) = पर्वन्, a knot.
पर्वत: पर्वत, अस्, m. (probably connected with पर्वन्, p. 556, col. 1, as ‘having crags or elevations’), a moun-tain, mountain-range, height, hill, elevation, rock, (in Ṛg-veda 1. 37, 7, V. 56, 4, पर्वत is joined as an adj. with गिरि; and according to Sāy. = जगत्-पूर-कोदक-वत्, laden with water filling the world, or बहुविध-पर्व-युक्त, shelving, rugged); an artificial mountain or heap (of grain, salt, saffron, sugar, silver or gold presented to the Brāhmans); N. of the presiding genius of the mountains (personified in the Veda with Āptya, Rudra, and Ṛbhu as ruler of the clouds, and associated with Indra, Savitṛ, the Maruts, and other deities; in later times enumerated among the eight Vasus); a fragment of rock, bowl-der, stone, (अद्रयः पर्वताः, the stones with which the Soma plant is pressed); a cloud (Ved.; in some passages of the Ṛg-veda where पर्वत is interpreted by अद्रि, the sense ‘cloud’ seems equally applicable, especially when the battles of Indra or the deeds of the Maruts are described); a N. of the number 7 (from the 7 principal mountains); a tree; a kind of vegetable; a kind of fish (commonly called Pāvdā, the Silurus Pabda); N. of a divine Ṛṣi mentioned in several passages of the Mahā-bh. (regarded as a companion of Nārada and messenger of the gods, cf. Nala II. 14; he is the author of Ṛg-veda VIII. 12, IX. 104, 105, where he has the patronymics Kāṇva and Kāśyapa); N. of a son of Paurṇamāsa (a son of Marīci and Sam-bhūti); of a minister of king Purū-ravas; of a grammarian (?); of an ape; (ई), f. (Ved.) a rock, stone; [cf. Serv. brdo, ‘a mountain;’ perhaps Goth. fairguni.] —पर्वत-काक, अस्, m. a raven. —पर्वत-च्युत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. ‘causing mountains (clouds) to totter or fall,’ an epithet of the Maruts. —पर्वत-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, mountain-born; (आ), f. a river. —पर्वत-तृण, अम्, n. ‘mountain-grass,’ a species of grass (= तृणाढ्य). —पर्वत-पति, इस्, m. ‘moun-tain-prince,’ lord of the mountains. —पर्वत-मोचा, f. a species of plant (= गिरि-कदली). —पर्-वत-राज्, ट्, m. ‘mountain-king,’ a lofty mountain, ‘the highest mountain-range,’ the Himālaya. —पर्-वत-राज, अस्, m. ‘mountain-king,’ the Himālaya. —पर्वतराज-कन्या, f. ‘daughter of the moun-tain-king,’ N. of Pārvatī or Durgā (daughter of Hima-vat, sovereign of the snowy mountains). —पर्-वतराज-पुत्री, f. ‘daughter of the mountain-king,’ an epithet of Durgā. —पर्वत-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living in the mountains; (ई), m. a mountaineer; (इनी), f. nard, spikenard; a designation of Durgā; of the Gāyatrī. —पर्वत-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. the best of mountains. —पर्वत-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, situated on a mountain or hill. —पर्वताकार (°त-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, mountain-shaped, formed like a mountain. —पर्वतात्मजा (°त-आत्°), f. ‘daughter of the mountain,’ an epithet of Durgā. —पर्वताधारा (°त-आध्°), f. ‘receptacle of mountains,’ the earth. —पर्वतारि (°त-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the moun-tains,’ epithet of Indra (who clipped their wings). —पर्वता-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. delighting in moun-tains; (Sāy.) ‘delighting in the stones used to press the Soma plant’ or ‘produced in the mountains,’ an epi-thet of Soma. —पर्वताशय (°त-आस्°), अस्, m. ‘rest-ing on the mountains,’ a cloud. —पर्वताश्रय (°त-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, living on the mountains, a moun-taineer; (अस्), m. a fabulous animal, the Śarabha. —पर्वताश्रयिन् (°त-आश्°), ई, m. a dweller on the mountains, mountaineer. —पर्वती-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make into a mountain. —पर्-वतेश्वर (°त-ईश्°), अस्, m. a lord of the mountains. —पर्वते-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. ‘dwelling in the heights,’ an epithet of Indra.
पर्वत पर्वत, पर्वन्। See under rt. पर्व्।
पर्वतीय: पर्वतीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to a mountain, mountainous, hilly; a mountaineer.
पर्वत्य: पर्वत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to a moun-tain or rock; produced in mountains.
पर्वन्: पर्वन्, अ, n. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ, but con-nected with पर्वत above), a knot or joint, espe-cially of a cane or other plant; a joint of the body, knuckle, limb, member; a break, pause, division, section; book, chapter; (in Vedic grammar) a mem-ber of a compound; a division of time, period, fixed time (especially the Cāturmāsya festival), the days of the four changes of the moon, i. e. the full and change of the moon and the eighth and fourteenth of each half month; the days of conjunction and opposition or eclipse of the sun or moon; a sacrifice performed on the occasion of a change of the moon; a particular period of the year (as the equinox, solstice, &c.); the moment of the sun's entering a new sign; a festival, holiday; opportunity, occasion; a moment, instant; [cf. परुस्।] —पर्व-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, or पर्व-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who works on holidays; (according to others) a Brāhman who for the sake of gain performs on common days such ceremonies as should be performed only on festivals. —पर्व-काल, अस्, m. a periodic change of the moon; the time at which the moon at its conjunction or opposition passes through the node. —पर्व-गामिन्, ई, m. one who has intercourse with his wife on festivals or holi-days. —पर्व-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पर्-व-धि, इस्, m. ‘period-holder,’ the moon. —पर्व-नाडी, f. ‘moment of the Parvan,’ moment of opposi-tion or conjunction. —पर्व-पुष्पी or पर्व-पुष्-पिका, f. a plant, = राम-दूती, Tiaridium Indicum (= नाग-दन्ती). —पर्व-पूर्ण-ता, f. preparations for an assembly or festival; completion of a festival; joining, uniting. —पर्व-भेद, अस्, m. the fracture of a joint. —पर्व-मूल, अम्, n. the moment at which the fourteenth day passes into the fifteenth day of a month; (आ), f. a species of plant (= श्वेता). —पर्व-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, growing from joints or knots; (इस्), m. a cane or reed, the sugar-cane, &c. —पर्व-रुह्, ट्, m. a pomegranate tree. —पर्व-वर्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, except the forbidden days of a month. —पर्व-वल्ली, f. a species of Dūrvā (= ग्रन्थि-दूर्वा, मूल-दूर्वा). —पर्व-शर्क-रक, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पर्व-शस्, ind., Ved. limb by limb, limb from limb, piece by piece; पर्वशः कृत्, to cut to pieces. —पर्-व-सन्धि, इस्, m. a joint; the full and change of the moon, the junction of the fifteenth and first of a lunar fortnight or the precise moment of the full and change of the moon. —पर्वावधि (°व-अव्°), इस्, m. a particular period, the end of a Parvan, &c. —पर्वास्फोट (°व-आस्°), अस्, m. a par-ticular movement of the fingers (regarded as inde-corous). —पर्वेश (°व-ईश), अस्, m., Ved. the regent of an astronomical node.
पर्वरीण: पर्वरीण, अस्, m. = पर्ण-वृन्त-रस; = गर्व; = मारुत; = पर्ण-शिरा; = मृतक; = द्यूत-कम्बल; = पत्त्र-चूर्ण-रस; = पर्वन्।
पर्वित: पर्वित पर्वित, अस्, m. a species of fish, Silurus Pabda (= पर्वत).
पर्शान: पर्शान पर्शान, अस्, m. (probably connected with rts. पर्ष् and पृष्), Ved. a precipice, chasm; a well; (Sāy.) = पार्श्व-स्थान, the side; = पीड्य-मान, being oppressed; = स्पृश्यमान; = विमर्-शन-क्षम; (according to the Naighaṇṭuka I. 10) a cloud.
पर्शु: 1. पर्शु, उस्, m., Ved. a rib; a curved knife, pruning-hook, sickle; N. of a man; (अवस्), m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe; (उस्), f. (according to the Nirukta IV. 6) the supporting or side wall of a well (Ṛg-veda I. 105, 8, but according to Sāy. = पार्-श्वास्थि); N. of a woman. —पर्शु-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, shaped like a curved knife.
पर्शु 2. पर्शु, उस्, m. (fr. पृ, substituted for rt. स्पृश्), = परशु, an axe, hatchet. —पर्शु-पाणि, इस्, m. ‘axe in hand, ’ an epithet of Gaṇeśa; [cf. परशु-धर।] —पर्शु-राम = परशु-रा-म, q. v.
पर्श्वध: पर्श्वध, अस्, m. = परश्वध, an axe, hatchet.
पर्ष्: पर्ष् पर्ष् [cf. rts. पृष्, वर्ष्, स्पर्ष्], cl. 1. A. पर्षते, &c., to grow wet, be-come moist; to delight in, accept (Sāy. = स्वी-कृ).
पर्ष: पर्ष पर्ष, अस्, m. (probably connected with rt. पृष्), a bundle, sheaf.
2. पर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, = परुष, keen, piercing (said of the wind).
पर्षिन्: पर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. in इषु-प्°, (probably) carrying bundles (of arrows).
पर्षणि: पर्षणि पर्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. पृ), Ved. carrying over or across, ferrying across.
पर्षन्: पर्षन्, अ, n. (?), Ved. leading out, delivering.
पर्षिष्ठ: पर्षिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most mighty in delivering or rescuing.
पर्षद्: पर्षद् पर्षद्, त्, f. = परिषद्, an assem-bly, audience. —पर्षद्-भीरु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. shy in society. —पर्षद्-वल, अस्, आ, अम्, = परि-षद्-वल, surrounded by an assembly; (अस्), m. an assistant at an assembly, a spectator.
पल्: पल् पल्, cl. 1. P. पलति, पलितुम्, to go, move; cl. 10. पालयति, -यितुम्, see rt. 3. पा; [cf. Gr. πάλλω, παλμό-ς, πάλο-ς, πα-λάσσω, παλ-ύν-ω; Lat. pello, poll-en, pul-vi-s.]
पल: पल, अस्, m. = पाल (Gaṇa Jvalādi to Pāṇ. III. 1, 140); = पलाल, straw; (अम्), n. a particular weight (= 4 Karṣas = (1/100) of a Tulā); a particular measure of fluids; a particular measure of time (= विघटिका); flesh, meat; [cf. Lat. palea; Angl. Sax. flesc, flœsc, flec; Old Germ. fleisk; French paille; Hib. feol, feoile, ‘flesh.’] —पल-क्षार, अस्, m. ‘flesh-fluid,’ blood. —पल-गण्ड, अस्, m. a mason, bricklayer, plasterer. —पलङ्-कर, अस्, m. ‘flesh-maker,’ gall, bile. —पलङ्-कष, अस्, m. ‘flesh-hurter,’ a Rākṣasa, imp, goblin; bdellium; a species of bdellium (= कण-गुग्गुलु); (आ), f., N. of various plants (= गो-क्षुरक, Asteracantha Longifolia; = क्षुद्र-गोक्षुरक; = किंशुक, Butea Frondosa; = मुण्डीरी, a species of climbing plant; = रास्न; = महा-श्रावणी, bdellium); = लाक्-षा, cochineal; a fly. —पल-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘fond of meat,’ a Rākṣasa; a raven. —पल-भा or पल-विभा, f. the equinoctial shadow at midday, the midday shadow of a gnomon when the sun is in the equinoctial points (= विष्णुवत्-प्रभा). —पलाग्नि (°ल-अग्°), इस्, m. ‘flesh-fire,’ bile, the bilious humor. —पलाद (°ल-अद), अस्, m. ‘flesh-eater,’ a Rāk-ṣasa; (आ), f. a Rākṣasī. —पलादन (°ल-अद्°), अस्, or 1. पलाश (°ल-आश्°), अस्, or 1. पलाशिन् (°ल-आश्°), ई, m. ‘flesh-eater,’ a Rākṣasa.
पलद: पलद, अस्, m., Ved. a particular material for building, (perhaps) bundles of straw or reeds used for roofing and wainscoting; (ई), f., N. of a village.
पलल: पलल, अस्, m. a Rākṣasa; ground sesamum seeds, a kind of sweetmeat made of ground sesamum and sugar; mud, mire, clay; = पल, flesh, meat; [cf. पल्वल; Gr. πηλό-ς, πήλ-ινο-ς, προ-πηλακ-ίζω; Lat. păl-ū(d)s, palus-tri-s; Hib. poll, ‘mire, dirt.’] —पलल-ज्वर, अस्, m. gall, bile; [cf. प-लाग्नि, पलङ्-कर।] —पलल-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘fond of flesh,’ a raven (= पल-प्रिय). —पललाशय (°ल-आश्°), अस्, m. ‘flesh-receptacle,’ swelled neck, goitre.
पलिक: पलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp. after a numeral), weighing or containing so many Palas.
पलक्या: पलक्या पलक्या, f. a kind of vegetable (= पालङ्क्य).
पलक्ष: पलक्ष पलक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (a secondary form of बलक्ष), Ved. white.
पलङ्कट: पलङ्कट पलङ्कट, अस्, आ, अम्, shy, bashful, timid.
पलव: पलव पलव, अस्, m. (said to be connected with rt. पल्, probably for प्लव fr. rt. प्लु), a snare or basket of wicker-work for catching fish.
पलस: पलस पलस, अस्, m. = पनस, the bread fruit tree.
पलस्ति: पलस्ति पलस्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (according to Sāy.) = पलित, grey-haired.
पलाङ्ग: पलाङ्ग पलाङ्ग, अस्, m. Delphinus Gange-ticus; (perhaps an error for चपलाङ्ग।)
पलाण्डु: पलाण्डु पलाण्डु, उस्, उ, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. पल्), an onion. —पलाण्डु-भक्षित, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, one who has eaten onions.
पलाप: पलाप पलाप, अस्, m. a halter; an ele-phant's temples.
पलापहा: पलापहा पलापहा, f. a kind of collyrium (= कुलत्था; perhaps only an error for प्र-लाप-हा).
पलाय: पलाय पलाय (fr. अय् = rt. 5. इ with पला = परा), cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) पलायते (-ति), -यितुम्, to flee, run away, make off, take to one's heels, scamper off; to escape; to cease, die away, sink into oblivion.
पलायक: पलायक, अस्, आ, or इका (?), अम्, fleeing, flying, taking to flight; a fugitive, runaway, deserter.
पलायत्: पलायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fleeing, running away.

पलायमान: पलायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, fleeing, flying away, taking to flight.
पलायित: पलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, flown, run away, fled, retreated; defeated.
पलायिन्: पलायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fleeing, flying, running away, taking to flight.
पलाल: पलाल पलाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. पल्), straw; the stalk of the Sorghum, Indian millet; (अस्), m., Ved., N. of a demon (asso-ciated with Anu-palāla and considered dangerous to children); (आ), f., N. of one of the seven Mātṛs of Skanda; (ई), f. straw. —पलाल-दोहद, अस्, m. ‘longing for straw,’ the mango tree (the fruit of which is sometimes ripened in straw).
पलाव: पलाव पलाव, अस्, m., Ved. chaff, husks; [cf. Lat. palea.]
पलाश: पलाश 2. पलाश, अम्, n. (for 1. see under पल, rt. पल्, p. 556, col. 2), a leaf, petal, foliage; the blossom of the tree Butea Frondosa; (अस्), m. Butea Frondosa; Curcuma Zedoaria; a N. of ancient Behar or Magadha; (ई), f. cochineal; a species of climbing plant (= पत्त्र-वल्ली, पर्ण-वल्ली, पलाशिका); (अस्, आ, अम्), green; unfeeling, unmerciful, cruel; (at the end of a comp.) see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. पलाशक: पलाशक, अस्, m. Butea Frondosa; Curcuma Zedoaria (= शटी); N. of a place; (इका), f. a species of climbing plant (= पलाशी).
पलाशिन्: 2. पलाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 1. see under पल, rt. पल्), leafy, covered with foliage, having luxuriant foliage; (ई), m. a tree; a species of plant (= क्षीर-वृक्ष); N. of a city or a village (said to be the modern Plassey); (इनी), f., N. of a river issuing from the Śukti-mat.
पलिक्नी: पलिक्नी पलिक्नी, f. See पलित below.
पलिघ: पलिघ पलिघ, अस्, m. a water-pot, pitcher, glass water-vessel; a wall, rampart; the gate-way of a building; an iron club or one studded with iron (= परिघ).
पलित: पलित पलित, अस्, पलिक्नी, अम् (said to be fr. rt. फल् with substitution of प् for फ्; a doubtful fem. form पलिता is also given), grey, grey-haired, hoary, old, aged; (अस्), m., N. of a mouse in Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 4933; (पलिक्नी), f. a cow for the first time with calf; (अम्), n. grey hair; a tuft of hair (= केश-पाश); much or ornamented hair; mud, mire; heat, burning; benzoin; [cf. Gr. πελ-ὀ-ς, πελ-ιό-ς, πελ-λό-ς, πελιδνό-ς, παλ-ιό-ς: Lat. pall-e-o, pall-idu-s, pallu-s: Old Germ. falo (fal-w-er): Angl. पलीजक: पलीजक पलीजक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a demon.

पल्पूलन: पल्पूलन, अम्, n., Ved. lye, water impregnated with alkaline salt.
पल्पूलित: पल्पूलित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. curried, tanned; washed (in lye).
पल्य: पल्य पल्य, अम्, n. (perhaps fr. पल), a sack for corn (probably containing a certain measure, Ved.); a particular high number.
पल्यङ्क: पल्यङ्क पल्य्-अङ्क, अस्, m. = पर्य्-अङ्क, a bed, couch, bedstead; a cloth thrown round the loins while sitting (= पर्य्-अस्ति, पर्यस्तिका).
पल्यङ्ग्: पल्यङ्ग् पल्य्-अङ्ग् (for पर्य्-अङ्ग्), Caus. P. -अङ्गयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to go round, stir round: Pass. -अङ्ग्यते, to turn round, revolve.
पल्यय्: पल्यय् पल्य्-अय् (fr. अय् = rt. 5. इ with पलि = परि), cl. 1. A. -अयते, &c., Ved. to go round.
पल्ययन: पल्य्-अयन, अम्, n. = पर्याण, a saddle, pack-saddle; a rein, bridle.
पल्युल्: पल्युल् पल्युल् and पल्यूल् (various readings for पल्पूल्, q. v.), cl. 10. P. पल्युलयति, पल्यूलयति, -यितुम्, to wash, &c.; to cut, cut off (in this sense perhaps for परि-लू).
पल्ल्: पल्ल् पल्ल् [cf. rt. पल्], cl. 1. P. पल्लति, पल्लितुम्, to go, move.
पल्ल: पल्ल, अस्, m. a large granary, barn.

2. पल्लव, Nom. P. पल्लवति, पल्लवितुम्, to put forth young shoots, sprout, bud.
पल्लवक: पल्लवक, अस्, m. a libertine, gallant, the paramour of a harlot; a catamite; a species of fish, Cyprinus Denticulatus; (इका), f., N. of a female attendant.
पल्लवय: पल्लवय, Nom. P. पल्लवयति, -यितुम्, to put forth young shoots, sprout; to cause to sprout, to make diffuse or prolix (according to a Scholiast = विस्तारय).
पल्लविक: पल्लविक, अस्, m. a libertine, gallant; a catamite; a species of fish, Cyprinus Denticulatus.
पल्लवित: पल्लवित, अस्, आ, अम्, sprouting, having young shoots; spread, extended; dyed red with lac, pos-sessing the red dye; (अस्), m. the red dye of the lac insect.
पल्लविन्: पल्लविन्, ई, इनी, इ, sprouting, having young shoots; (ई), m. a tree.

पल्लिका: पल्लिका, f. a village, station [cf. आभीर-प्°]; a small house-lizard.
पल्लिवाह: पल्लिवाह पल्लिवाह, अस्, m. a species of grass.
