पिब्दन: पिब्दन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. firm, hard, solid, compact; (अम्), n. (according to Sāy.) a Rakṣas.
पियारु: पियारु पियारु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Sautra rt. 1. पीय्), Ved. censuring, blaming, deriding, mis-chievous (Sāy. = हिंसक).
पियाल: पियाल पियाल, अस्, m. (= प्रियाल, q. v., but said to be fr. the Sautra rt. 1. पीय्), the tree Buchanania Latifolia (called in Hindī also Chironji, whence it has been named Chironjia Sapida; in Bengal it is commonly called Piya or Piyal); (अम्), n. the fruit of Buchanania Latifolia.
पिल्: पिल् पिल्, cl. 10. P. पेलयति, -यितुम्, to throw, cast; to send; to incite; [cf. rts. पेल्, विल्।]
पिलु: पिलु, उस्, or पिलुक, अस्, m. a species of tree (= पीलु; cf. पैलव).
पिलुनी: पिलुनी, f. a species of plant (= मूर्वा; a wrong form for पिलु-पर्णी; cf. पीलु-पर्णी).
पिलि: पिलि पिलि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
पिलिन्दवत्स: पिलिन्दवत्स पिलिन्द-वत्स, अस्, m., N. of a disciple of Śākya-muni.
पिलिप्पिल: पिलिप्पिल पिलिप्पिल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. slip-pery.
पिल्ल: पिल्ल पिल्ल, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be a substi-tute for क्लिन्न), blear-eyed; (अस्), m. a bleared eye.
पिल्लका: पिल्लका, f. a female elephant, (the elephant's eye being usually moist.)
पिश्: पिश् 1. पिश्, cl. 6. P. A. पिंशति, -ते, पिपेश, पिपिशे, पेशिष्यति, -ते, अपेशीत्, पेशितुम्, Ved. to adorn, deck, decorate, embellish; to prepare, make ready (especially meat, by cutting it up and carving it); to shape, fashion, mould, form; to be decomposed, to be reduced to consti-tuent parts; to be organized; to light, enlighten: Caus. पेशयति, Aor. अपीपिशत्: Desid. पिपिशिषति, पिपेशिषति; Intens. पेपिश्यते, पेपेष्टि, to be richly adorned.
2. पिश्, f. an ornament, decoration; (Sāy.) = रूपं हिरण्यादि।
पिश: पिश, अस्, m., Ved. (according to Sāy.) = रुरु, a sort of deer (probably so called from its colour).
पिशङ्ग: पिशङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम्, reddish, reddish-brown, of a tawny or brown colour; (अस्), m. tawny colour; N. of a serpent-demon. —पिशङ्ग-ता, f. or पिशङ्ग-त्व, अम्, n. the being of a tawny colour, tawniness. —पिशङ्ग-भृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (perhaps) having red fangs; (Sāy.) = ईषद्-रक्त-वर्ण, being of a pale-red hue, tawny-coloured. —पिशङ्ग-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. giving reddish (i. e. golden) gifts (said of Indra); (Sāy.) = बहुरूप-धनेन्द्र, lord of manifold wealth. —पिशङ्ग-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being of a reddish or yellow appearance; (Sāy.) = हिरण्य-रूप, golden-coloured. —पिशङ्ग-सन्-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) being of a red or yellow colour; (according to Sāy.) = नाना-रूप, of various kinds. —पिशङ्गाश्व (°ग-अश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having reddish or tawny horses (said of the Maruts).
पिशङ्गक: पिशङ्गक, अस्, m., N. of an attendant of Viṣṇu.
पिशङ्गिन्: पिशङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, brown, tawny.
पिशङ्गिल: पिशङ्गिल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., N. of a colour (?); (according to Mahī-dhara) = पिशं + गिल।
पिशाच: पिशाच, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. पिश for पिशित, ‘flesh,’ and rt. 1. अञ्च्), N. of a class of demons (perhaps originally a personification of the ignis fatuus; in the Veda they are enumerated after gods, men, Manes, Asuras, and Rākṣasas; in later times they are described as the children of Krodhā); a sprite, fiend, goblin, ogre, malevolent being (some-thing between an infernal imp and a ghost, always described as fierce and malignant); N. of a Rakṣas; (ई), f. a female imp, a she-demon [cf. स्त्री-प्°]; N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and mother of the Piśācas; a species of Valeriana (= गन्ध-मांसी). —पिशाच-ता, f. or पिशाच-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of a Piśāca. —पिशाच-द्रु, उस्, m. a species of tree, Trophis Aspera (the favourite haunt of the Piśācas). —पिशाच-बाधा, f. demoniacal possession. —पि-शाच-भाषा, f. ‘Piśāca language,’ a gibberish or cor-ruption of Sanskrit used in plays. —पिशाच-मोचन, अम्, n. ‘release of the Piśāca,’ N. of a place of pilgrim-age. —पिशाचमोचन-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage. —पिशाच-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a species of tree, Trophis Aspera (= शाखोट). —पिशाच-सञ्-चार, अस्, m. demoniacal possession. —पिशाच-सभ, अम्, n. an assemblage of goblins or fiends; the place or hall of their assembly, pandemonium. —पिशाचा-लय (°च-आल्°), अस्, m. ‘abode of Piśācas,’ N. of a particular luminous phenomenon, phosphorescence. —पिशाची-करण, अम्, n. transforming into a Piśāca. —पिशाचोरग-राक्षस (°च-उर्°), आस्, m. pl. Piśācas, serpents, and Rākṣasas.
पिशाचक: पिशाचक, अस्, m. a Piśāca; (इका), f. = पिशाची (at the end of comps., e. g. गन्ध-प्°, धन-प्°); N. of a river; scil. भाषा, the language of the Piśā-cas. —पिशाचक-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a village.
पिशाचकिन्: पिशाचकिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Kuvera the god of wealth (the treasures of this deity being guarded by Piśācas and other malignant beings).
पिशाचि: पिशाचि, इस्, m., Ved. a Piśāca.
पिशित: पिशित, अम्, n. flesh which has been cut up or prepared, flesh, meat; a small piece; (आ), f. spikenard, Nardostachys Jatamansi (= जटा-मांसी). —पिशित-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, eating flesh; (क्), m. one who eats flesh. —पिशिताश (°त-आश), अस्, आ, अम्, eating flesh; (अस्), m. an epithet of flesh-eating demons, as Rāk-ṣasas or Piśācas; a fiend; a cannibal. —पिशिताशन (°त-अश्°), अस्, ई, अम्, flesh-eating, meat-eating; (अस्), m. a demon, fiend, cannibal, Rakṣas, Piśāca (de-scribed as a child of Ni-kaṣā); epithet of a wolf. —पिशिताशिन् (°त-आश्°), ई, इनी, इ, eating flesh or meat, carnivorous; (ई), m. a demon, goblin, can-nibal; N. of an attendant of Śiva. —पिशितेप्सु (°त-ईप्°), उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of flesh, eager for or greedy after meat.
पिशी: पिशी, f. spikenard, Nardostachys Jatamansi (= पिशिता).
पिशुन: पिशुन, अस्, आ, अम्, informing against, betraying, treacherous; disparaging, calumniating, backbiting, calumnious, slanderous; cruel, wicked, malignant, mischievous, harsh, unkind; exciting hopes and dis-appointing them; vile, low, contemptible, infamous; stupid, a fool; making known, indicating, evincing, displaying, reminding, commemorating, memorable for (at the end of comps., e. g. तुल्यानुराग-प्°, manifesting an equal attachment; क्षत्र-प्रध-न-प्°, memorable for the conflict of Kṣatriyas); (अस्), m. a betrayer, traitor, informer, spy, tale-bearer, backbiter, calumniator, slanderer; epithet of a goblin dangerous to pregnant women; cotton (which betrays by hanging to the clothes); an epi-thet of Nārada (the messenger and informant of the gods); a crow; N. of a Brāhman; N. of a minister of Dushyanta; (आ), f. a species of plant, Medicago Esculenta; (अम्), n. informing against, betraying, sycophancy; saffron (which betrays an unfaithful lover); [cf. Gr. πικ῏πό-ς, πευκεδανό-ς, πευκάλιμο-ς, ἐχε-πευκές: Lith. pī1k-ta-s, ‘bad;’ pýk-ti, ‘to be angry;’ peīk-ti, ‘to despise, to blame.’] —पिशुन-ता, f. slander, scandal, backbiting, betrayal, syco-phancy. —पिशुन-वचन or पिशुन-वाक्य, अम्, n. evil speech, bad report, detraction, slander.
पिशुनय: पिशुनय, Nom. P. पिशुनयति, -यितुम्, to betray, make known, indicate, make manifest.
पिशिक: पिशिक पिशिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people in the South.
पिशील: पिशील पिशील or पिशीलक, अम्, n., Ved. (a wooden) vessel or dish. —पिशील-वीणा, f. a kind of stringed instrument or guitar, the strings of which are stretched across a frame (= शूर्प-वीणा).
पिष्: पिष् पिष्, cl. 7. P. (ep. also A.) पिनष्टि, पिंष्टे (Impv. 2nd sing. पिण्ढि), पि-पेष, पेक्ष्यति, अपिषत्, पेष्टुम् (ep. Impf. अपिंषत्, Pot. पिषेत्), to grind, pound, crush; to bruise, hurt, injure, destroy; cl. 10. P. or Caus. पेष-यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अपीपिषत्, to grind, pound; to injure; to give; to be strong; to dwell; cl. 1. 10. P. पेषति, पेषयति, to go, move; [cf. Gr. πτίσσ-ω for πίσσ-ω, πίτυρον, πτίσ-μα, πίσ-ο-ς, πίσ-ινο-ς, πίσσο-; Lat. pins-o, pīs-o, pis-tor, pis-tillu-m, pistrīnum, pis-tura, pis-u-m, Piso, pī-lu-m, pī-la, pī-lu-s; Lith. pes-tà, ‘a mill.’]
पिष्ट: पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ground, pounded, crushed, bruised; rubbed together, squeezed, clasped (as the hands); kneaded; (अम्), n. anything ground, any finely ground substance, flour, meal, (न पिष्टम् पिनष्टि, he does not grind flour, i. e. he does no useless work or vain repetition); lead; (अस्), m. pastry; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants. —पिष्ट-पचन, अम्, n. a pan for parching flower; a boiler, seether, sauce-pan. —पिष्ट-पशु, उस्, m. an effigy of a beast or sacrificial victim made with flour or dough. —पिष्ट-पाक, अस्, m. food prepared by baking flour. —पिष्-टपाक-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, containing food prepared by baking flour; (त्), m. a boiler. —पिष्ट-पाचक, अम्, n. a boiler. —पिष्ट-पिण्ड, अस्, m. a cake of meal. —पिष्ट-पूर, अस्, m. meal made up into a sort of cake with clarified butter; [cf. घृत-पूर।] —पिष्ट-पेष, अस्, m. or पिष्ट-पेषण, अम्, n. ‘grinding flour,’ useless labour, vain repetition. —पिष्ट-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of meal or flour, mixed with flour; जलम् पिष्ट-मयम्, water sprinkled with meal. —पिष्ट-मेह, अस्, m. flour-like diabetes. —पिष्टमेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering from flour-like diabetes. —पिष्ट-रस, अस्, m. water mixed with flour. —पिष्ट-वर्ति, a small cake made of the meal of barley, rice, or pulse. —पिष्ट-सौरभ, अम्, n. (pulverized) sandal-wood. —पिष्-टाद (°ट-अद), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding on meal. —पिष्टोदक (°ट-उद्°), अम्, n. water mixed with flour.
पिष्टक: पिष्टक, अस्, m. a cake made of the flour or meal of any grain, any baked cake, bread; a disease of the eyes, opacity of the cornea; (इका), f. a kind of grits, the meal of pulse steeped in water and peeled and ground; (अम्), n. pounded sesamum seeds, oil-cake.
पिष्टात: पिष्टात, अस्, m. perfumed powder (for scenting rooms, garments, &c.); scented dust which the Hindūs sprinkle over each other at the Holi or spring festival.
पिष्टिक: पिष्टिक, अम्, n. a cake made of rice flour.
पिष्टोडी: पिष्टोडी, f. a species of shrub (= श्वेताम्लि).
पिष्टप: पिष्टप पिष्टप, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. पिश्, substituted for rt. विश्), a world, a division of the universe; [cf. विष्टप।]
पिस्: पिस् पिस्, cl. 4. P. पिस्यति, पेसितुम्, Ved. to go; (perhaps) to extend; cl. 1. P. पेसति, पेसितुम्, to go, move; cl. 10. P. पेसयति, यितुम्, to go; to hurt, injure; to be strong; to give; to take; to dwell; [cf. rts. पेस्, विस्, वेस्, बिश्, बेश्।]
पिस्पृक्षु: पिस्पृक्षु पिस्पृक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. स्पृश्), being about to touch; (with जलम्) being about to enter the water, being about to perform ablutions.
पी: पी 1. पी (probably originally Pass. of rt. 1. पा, q. v.), cl. 4. A. पीयते, पिप्ये, पेष्-यति, अपेष्ट, पेतुम्, to drink.
पी 2. पी, ईस्, ईस्, इ (fr. rt. प्यै, q. v.; at the end of a comp.) becoming fat.
पीच: पीच पीच, अम्, n. the lower jaw, the chin.
पीटिका: पीटिका पीटिका, a various reading for पीठिका, q. v.
पीठ: पीठ पीठ, अम्, n. (thought by some to be a Prākṛt form fr. पि-सद = पि-षद = पि-ष्ड or connected with rt. पिठ्), a stool, seat, chair, bench; a religious student's seat made properly of Kuśa grass; the seat of a deity, an altar (according to some native authorities in this and the preceding senses also अस्, ई, m. f.); a basis, basement, pedestal; an epithet of various temples (erected on the fifty-one spots on which, according to tradition, the various members of Pārvatī fell after she had been cut to pieces by the discus of Viṣṇu); a kind of orna-ment; a particular posture in sitting; (in geometry) the complement of a segment; N. of an Asura the minister of Kaṃsa. —पीठ-केलि, इस्, m. a particular dramatic character, a male confidant, a parasite. —पीठ-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, moving about in a wheel-chair, lame. —पीठ-गर्भ or पीठ-विवर, अस्, m. the cavity in the pedestal of an idol. —पीठ-चक्र, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a chariot with a seat. —पीठ-नायिका, f. a girl of fourteen (before menstruation) who impersonates Durgā at the festival of that goddess. —पीठ-न्यास, अस्, m. epithet of a particular mystical ceremony. —पीठ-भू, ऊस्, f. a basis, basement. —पीठ-मर्द, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘rub-bing the seat,’ (perhaps) riding on horseback, a rider; exceedingly impudent; (अस्), m. the companion of a hero in great undertakings; a companion, parasite; a dancing-master who teaches courtezans. —पीठ-सर्प, अस्, आ, अम्, or पीठ-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, moving about on a wheel-chair, lame, crippled, a cripple. —पीठ-स्थान, अम्, n. a place where one of the limbs of Pārvatī is supposed to have fallen and therefore consecrated to her worship; [cf. पीठ।]
पीठक: पीठक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a seat, chair, bench; a saddle ?; (इका), f. a bench; a base, pedestal; a sec-tion, chapter (sometimes wrongly spelt पीटिका).
पीड्: पीड् पीड् (perhaps connected with rt. पिष्), cl. 1. A. पीडते, पीडितुम्, Ved. to be squeezed or pressed out (as Soma): Caus. or cl. 10. P. (ep. also A.) पीडयति (-ते), -यितुम्, to squeeze, pinch, press, oppress, compress, suppress (e. g. कालं कालेन पीडयन्, Manu. I. 51, pressing time against time, or suppressing one period by means of another, according to Kullūka = सृष्टि-कालम् प्रलय-कालेन नाशयन्); to overpower; to hurt, harm, injure, pain, vex, harass, annoy, tor-ment; to break, violate (an oath); to beleaguer (a city); to neglect, cause suffering by neglect; to remove; to cover; (in augury) to cover with any-thing inauspicious; (in astrology) to eclipse; to oppose, resist; to stir, agitate.
पीड: पीड, अस्, अम्, m. n., in तिल-प्°, तृण-प्°, q. v. —पीड-यन्त्र-गृह, अस्, m. a workhouse for criminals, house of correction.
पीडक: पीडक, अस्, m. an oppressor; [cf. तालु-प्°।]
पीडन: पीडन, अस्, आ, अम्, molesting, paining, disagree-able; (अम्), n. the act of pressing, squeezing, rub-bing; an instrument for pressing, press; oppressing, inflicting pain, paining, distressing; laying a country waste, devastation; (in astrology) the oppression or suppression of a planet &c., i. e. eclipse [cf. ग्रह-प्°]; suppressing sounds, a fault in the pronunciation of vowels.
पीडनीय: पीडनीय or पीडयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be oppressed or molested, to be pained or harassed; used for pressing, serving for a press.
पीडयत्: पीडयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, squeezing, pressing; op-pressing, suppressing, harassing, paining; breaking, violating.
पीडा: पीडा, f. pain, suffering, anguish, annoyance; damage, injury, wrong; infraction, violation [cf. धर्म-प्°]; devastation, laying waste; restriction, limitation; the ‘pain or calamity’ of a planet, eclipse, occultation [cf. ग्रह-प्°]; compassion, pity, charity; a chaplet, garland for the head; the Saral tree, Pinus Longifolia; a basket (= पिटक, पेटा, पेडा). —पीडा-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, pain-causing, giving pain, afflicting, tormenting. —पीडा-करण, अम्, n. the causing of pain, torturing, tormenting. —पीडा-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, (according to Malli-nātha) = विमर्द-भाज् = भङ्ग-वत्. —पीडा-स्थान, अम्, n., Ved. (in astrology) an unlucky position, inauspicious dis-tance (of a planet).
पीडाय: पीडाय, Nom. A. पीडायते, -यितुम्, to feel pain, experience a sense of uneasiness.
पीडित: पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, squeezed, pressed; rubbed, chafed; griped, wrung; oppressed, harassed, dis-tressed, pained, afflicted, suffering pain or distress, injured, impaired; violated, transgressed; destroyed, laid waste, devastated; eclipsed; bound, tied; (अम्), n. injuring, harming, harassing; a kind of coitus; (अम्), ind. closely. —पीडित-ता, f. or पीडित-त्व, अम्, n. the being squeezed or pressed; the being afflicted or distressed.
पीड्यमान: पीड्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being squeezed or pressed; being pained or afflicted, suffering.
पीत: पीत 1. पीत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पा), drunk, quaffed; drunk in, imbibed; soaked, steeped, satu-rated, filled with; (अम्), n. drinking. —पीत-तैल, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has drunk oil, filled with oil, = तैल-पीत; (आ), f. a species of creeper; a kind of heart-pea, Cardiospermum Halicacabum (= ज्यो-तिष्-मती, = महा-ज्योतिष्मती). —पीत-दुग्धा, f. a cow whose milk has been pledged (lit. already drunk); a cow tied up to be milked [cf. धे-नुष्या]; any milch cow. —पीत-निद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, immersed in slumber. —पीत-प्रतिबद्ध-वत्स, आ, f. (a cow) whose calf has drunk milk and been tied up. —पीत-मद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has drunk wine or any other intoxicating liquor. —पीत-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, whose juice is drunk or quaffed. —पीत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having drunk or quaffed; con-taining the verb 1. पा (Ved.). —पीत-सोम, अस्, m. a Brāhman by whom the juice of the acid Asclepias is drunk at a ceremony. —पीताब्धि (°त-अब्°), इस्, m. an epithet of the Muni Agastya (‘by whom the ocean was drunk,’ this saint having on one occasion swallowed up the sea).

पीत 2. पीत, अस्, आ, अम् (probably connected with rt. प्यै, the colour of butter and oil being yellowish), of a yellow colour, yellow (the colour of the Vaiśyas, white being that of the Brāhmans, red that of the Kṣatriyas, and black that of the Śūdras); (अस्), m. yellow colour; a yellow gem, topaz; a yellow pigment prepared from the urine of kine; N. of several plants, Alangium Hexapetalum (= अङ्कोठ); safflower, Carthamus Tinctorius; Trophis Aspera (= शाखोट); (आ), f., N. of various plants, turmeric (= हरिद्रा); a medical plant, Betula, commonly called Atais; a kind of yellow pigment (= गो-रोचना); a mystical designation of the letter ष; (अम्), n. gold; yellow orpiment. —पीत-कदली, f. a species of banana (= स्वर्ण-कदली). —पीत-कन्द, अम्, n. the carrot, Daucus Carota. —पीत-करवीरक, अस्, m. oleander with yellow flowers. —पीत-कावेर, अम्, n. saffron; bell-metal. —पीत-काष्ठ, अम्, n. yellow sanders. —पीत-कीला, f. a species of plant (= आ-वर्तकी). —पीत-कौशेय-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, dressed in yellow silk; (अस्), m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —पीत-गन्ध, अम्, n. yellow sandal. —पीत-घोषा, f. yellow Gho-ṣā, a species of creeper with yellow flowers. —पीत-चन्दन, अम्, n. a yellow fragrant wood considered as a yellow species of sandal-wood; saffron; turmeric. —पीत-चम्पक, अस्, m. a lamp (‘yellow as the Campa’). —पीत-तण्डुला, f. millet, Panicum Itali-cum; a species of Solanum. —पीत-ता, f. or पीत-त्व, अम्, n. yellowness, yellow (the colour). —पीत-तुण्ड, अस्, m. ‘yellow-beak,’ N. of the Sylvia Sutoria (the whole bird being of a light yellow colour). —पी-त-दारु, उस्, m. a species of pine, Pinus Deodora (= देव-दारु); Pinus Longifolia; Curcuma Aromatica or Curcuma Xanthorrhiza (= हरिद्रु). —पीत-द्रु, उस्, m. a species of pine, Pinus Longifolia; Cur-cuma Aromatica or C. Xanthorrhiza. —पीत-नील, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘yellow-blue,’ green. —पीत-पर्णी, f. ‘yellow-leaved,’ a plant commonly called Bichati; a N. of the nettle or a plant of the same class, Tragia Involucrata. —पीत-पादा, f. ‘yellow-footed,’ a small bird, the Maina (Turdus Salica). —पी-त-पुष्प, अस्, m., N. of several plants (= कर्णि-कार), Pterospermum Acerifolium, or a species of Karṇikāra; Michelia Champaka; a species of Taber-næmontana Coronaria; a species of Barleria with yellow flowers; (आ), f. a species of Coloquintida (= इन्द्र-वारुणी, = झिञ्झरिष्टा), Cajanus Indicus (= आढकी); a species of yellow Barleria; (ई), f. Andropogon Acicularis (= शङ्ख-पुष्पी, सह-देवी, महा-कोषातकी, and त्रपुषी); a species of Barleria with yellow flowers; (अम्), n. Tabernæ-montana Coronaria (= आहुल्य). —पीत-प्रसव, अस्, m. = पीत-करवीरक, q. v. —पीत-फल, अस्, m. a tree, Trophis Aspera; Averrhoa Carambola. —पीतफलक, अस्, m. Trophis Aspera. —पीत-बालुका, f. turmeric; yellow sand. —पीत-बीजा, f. Trigonella Fœnum Græcum (= मेथिका). —पीत-भृङ्ग-राज, अस्, m. a species of Verbesina with yellow flowers. —पीत-मणि, इस्, m. a yellow gem, a topaz. —पीत-मस्तक, अस्, m. ‘yellow-head,’ a small bird, Loxia Philippensis (= कलि-कार; cf. पीत-मुण्ड). —पीत-माक्षिक, अम्, n. = मा-क्षिक, a species of mineral substance. —पीत-माञ्-जिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, yellowish-red. —पीत-मुण्ड, अस्, m. ‘yellow-head,’ a bird (= कलि-कार), Loxia Philippensis; a kind of gallinule. —पीत-मुद्ग, अस्, m. a species of bean, a yellow variety of the Phaseolus Mungo. —पीत-मूलक, अम्, n. the carrot, Daucus Carota. —पीत-यूथी, f. yellow jasmine. —पीत-रक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, yellowish-red, orange; (अम्), n. (or according to some अस् m.), a yellow-coloured gem, perhaps the topaz. —पीत-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, of a yellow colour; (अम्), n. (or according to some अस्, m.), a yellow colour; the fibres of the lotus; wax. —पीत-रोहिणी, f. the plant Gmelina Arborea. —पीत-लोह, अस्, m. yellow metal, queen's metal or a mixed metal resembling gold. —पीत-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, dressed in yellow; (आस्), m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu. —पीत-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a species of Śyonāka and Pinus Longifolia. —पीत-शाल or पीत-साल or पीत-सालक, अस्, m. the plant Terminalia Tomentosa. —पीत-सार, अस्, m. a yellow gem, a topaz; the sandal tree; the tree Alangium Hexapetalum; Citrus Medica; East-Indian incense, = तुरुष्क; (अम्), n. a yellow sandal-wood. —पीत-सारक, अस्, m. Alangium Hexapeta-lum; Azadirachta Indica. —पीत-सारि, इ, n. anti-mony. —पीत-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. ‘fat-shouldered,’ a hog. —पीत-स्फटिक, अस्, m. ‘yellow crystal,’ the topaz. —पीत-हरित, अस्, आ, अम्, yellowish-green. —पीताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, m. a species of Śyonāka. —पीताम्बर (°त-अम्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dressed in yellow clothes, clad in yellow; (अस्), m. a N. of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu; a dancer or actor; a religious mendicant wearing yellow garments; N. of a man. —पीतारुण (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, yellowish-red; (अस्), m. an epithet of the middle of day-break; [cf. ताम्रारुण, नीलारुण।] —पीताशमन् (°त-अश्°), आ, m. ‘yellow-stone,’ a topaz or any yellow gem.
पीति: 1. पीति, इस्, f. (for 2. and 3. see p. 578, col. 1), drinking, a draught; a tavern, dram-shop.
पीति 2. पीति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. 3. पा; for 1. see p. 577, col. 2), Ved. protection; [cf. नृ-प्°।]
पीति 3. पीति, इस्, m. a horse.
पीतिन्: 1. पीतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of comps.) drinking, having drunk. (For 2. पीतिन् see p. 578, col. 1.)
2. पीतिन्, ई, m. a horse. (For 1. पीतिन् see p. 577, col. 2.)
पीत्वा: पीत्वा, ind. having drunk or quaffed. —पीत्वा-स्थिरक, अस्, आ, अम्, somewhat refreshed by a draught (Gaṇa to Pāṇ. II. 1, 72).
पीत्वा पीत्वा। See under 1. पीत, p. 577.
पीथ: 1. पीथ, अस्, m. (for 2. and 3. see p. 578, col. 1), a drink, draught [cf. गो-प्°]; (अम्), n. water; melted butter.
3. पीथ, अस्, m. the sun; fire; time. (For 1. and 2. पीथ see p. 577, col. 2, and above.)
पीथिन्: पीथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) drinking; कोश-प्°, squandering away the treasury.
पीयमान: पीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being drunk or quaffed, being drunk or sucked in.
पीतक: पीतक, अस्, इका, अम्, of a yellow colour, yellow; (अस्), m. a species of gentian, Gentiana Cherayta; the Tūn tree, Cedrela Toona; (इका), f. saffron; turmeric; yellow jasmine; (अम्), n. yellow orpiment; brass; honey; saffron; yellow sandal; aloe wood, Amyris Agallocha; a species of Śyonāka; = पीत-शाल। —पीतक-द्रुम, अस्, m. Curcuma Xanthorrhiza (= हरि-द्रु).
पीतन: पीतन, अस्, m. the hog-plum, Spondias Mangifera; a tree, Pentaptera Tomentosa; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria; (अम्), n. yellow orpiment; saffron; a species of pine (= देव-दारु).
पीतनक: पीतनक, अस्, m. the hog-plum, Spondias Man-gifera.
पीतल: पीतल, अस्, आ, अम्, of a yellow colour; (अस्), m. yellow colour; (अम्), n. brass.
पीथ्य: पीथ्य पीथ्य। See under 2. पीति above.
पीथि: पीथि पीथि, इस्, m. See under 3. पीति above.
पीतु: पीतु पीतु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पा, but perhaps fr. rt. पिव्), the sun; fire; the chief elephant of a herd. —पीतु-दारु, उस्, m. = देव-दारु, q. v.; (according to others) = खदिर, a tree related to the Uḍumbara; (अम्), n. the resin of this tree; [cf. पूतु-दारु; Gr. πί-τυ-ς, πίσσα for πι-κ-ια; Lat. pī-nu-s, pix; Lith. pī1ki-s, ‘pitch.’]
पीथे: पीथे पीथे, m., N. of a chief builder (in an inscription).
पीन: पीन पीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्यै), fat, fleshy, brawny, muscular; swelling, swollen, large, corpulent, thick, plump; full, round; profuse (e. g. पीनः स्वेदः, profuse perspiration); [cf. पीवर; Gr. πῑαρός, πῖας, πΐων, πιμελή; Lat. pinguis; Iceland. feit-r, ‘fat;’ Angl. Sax. fœtt; Old Germ. feizt = Mod. Germ. feist, fett.] —पीन-तरल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a large central gem. —पीन-ता, f. fatness, corpulency (opposed to कृश-ता). —पीन-नितम्बा, f. ‘having full hips,’ N. of a metre, four times ¯¯¯¯ , ¯˘˘¯¯ , ¯¯¯˘˘¯¯ . —पीन-वक्-षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, large-chested, full-breasted, having a large or full breast. —पीन-श्रोणीपयोधरा, f. having swelling hips and breasts. —पीनोत्तुङ्ग-स्तनी (°न-उत्°), f. (a woman) having a large and prominent breast. —पीनोध्नी (°न-ऊध्°), f. a cow with full or swelling udders (also पीनोधस्, आस्, f.; cf. ऊधस्, घटोध्नी).
पीपिवस्: पीपिवस्, आन्, पिप्युषी, अत्, Ved. swelling, swollen, distended, overflowing, dropping (Sāy. = प्र-वृद्-ध, पीन, वर्धयत्, आ-प्यायितृ).
पीप्याना: पीप्याना, f., Ved. having a full or swelling breast (Sāy. = पुत्रं स्तनम् पाययन्ती).
पीयूष: 1. पीयूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. the Sautra rt. 1. पीय्), the first milk given by a cow after calving, biestings; the milk of a cow during the first seven days after calving; any thick fluid, cream, juice (Sāy. = रस-भूतम् पयः, अभिन-वम् पयः); the drink of immortality produced at the churning of the ocean of milk, the food of the gods, ambrosia, nectar; milk; [cf. पेयूष।] —पी-यूष-महस्, आस्, or पीयूष-रुचि, इस्, m. ‘bright with nectar,’ the moon (whose rays are said to be filled with nectar). —पीयूष-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, milk-white, white as milk. —पीयूष-वर्ष, अस्, अम्, m. n. a shower of nectar or ambrosia. —पी-यूषवर्षाय, Nom. A. पीयूषवर्षायते, -यि-तुम्, to become or turn into a shower of nectar.
2. पीयूष, Nom. P. पीयूषति, पीयूषितुम्, to become or turn into nectar.
पीयूष 1. 2. पीयूष। See under पीन, col. 1.
पीव: पीव, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to Sāy.) = आ-प्या-यित, fat.
पीव पीव, पीवन्, पीवर, पीवस्, पीवस, पीविष्ठ। See col. 2.
पीवत्: पीवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fat; (probably the original form of पीवन् below.)
पीवन्: पीवन्, आ, अरी, अ, swelling, full, fat, large; stout, strong, robust; (आ), m. wind; (अरी), f. Asparagus Racemosus, Desmodium Gangeticum (= शाल-पर्-णी); N. of a spiritual daughter of the Barhi-shad Pitṛs; of the wife of Veda-śiras; of a princess of Vi-darbha.
पीवर: पीवर, अस्, आ, or ई, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 1. पा), fat, stout, large, fleshy, corpulent, plump, thick, dense; (अस्), m. a tortoise; N. of one of the Sap-tarshis under Manu Tāmasa; (आ), f. Physalis Flex-uosa, Asparagus Racemosus; N. of a daughter of the Gandharva Huhu; (ई), f. a young woman; a cow; [cf. Gr. πιαρό-ς, πιερό-ς, πιαλέο-ς, πίειρα.]; —पी-वर-त्व, अम्, n. fatness, thickness, largeness, heavi-ness, density. —पीवर-स्तनी, f. a woman with large breasts; a cow with a large udder. —पीवरी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to fatten, make fat. —पीवरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, fattened.
पीवस्: पीवस्, आन्, असी, अस् (a kindred form to पीवन्), fat, stout; (अस्), n., Ved. fat; [cf. Zend pivanh, ‘fat;’ Gr. πῖαρ.] —पीव-स्फाक, अस्, आ, अम् (for पीवस्-स्फाक), Ved. swelling with fat. —पीवस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. abounding with, swollen. —पीवो-अन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having rich or abundant food. —पीवो-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having fat horses. —पीवोपवसन (°व-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. covered with fat; (according to Mahī-dhara) near to fat or fleshy parts of the body.
पीवस: पीवस, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abounding with fat, fat, abundant; swelling, swollen, inflated; (Sāy.) = पीन, robust; = अ-च्छिन्न, untorn.
पीविष्ठ: पीविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, extremely fat.
पीनस: पीनस पीनस, अस्, m. (probably अपि + नस् = नासा; by some connected with पीन), cough, catarrh; cold affecting the nose, inflammation of the schneiderian membrane [cf. अपी-नस]; (आ), f. the plant Cucumis Utilissimus (= कर्कटी).
पीनसिन्: पीनसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a cold.
पीपरि: पीपरि पीपरि, इस्, m. a species of Plaksha of low growth.
पीय्: पीय् 1. पीय् (a Sautra rt.), to gladden.
पीय् 2. पीय्, cl. 1. P. पीयति, &c., Ved. to blame, abuse, treat disrespectfully or with contempt; to give pleasure.
पीयक: पीयक, अस्, m., Ved. ‘an abuser,’ (probably) N. of a class of demons.
पीयत्नु: पीयत्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. scornful.
पीयु: पीयु, उस्, उस्, उ (said to be fr. rt. 1. पा), Ved. scornful, injurious (as an Asura); (उस्), m. an owl; a crow; time; fire; the sun (?); gold.
पीयूक्षा: पीयूक्षा पीयूक्षा, f. a species of plant.
पील्: पील् पील्, cl. 1. P. पीलति, पीलितुम्, to check, impede, obstruct; to stop, to cease to be or do; to become stupid.
पीलक: पीलक, अस्, m. the large black ant; [cf. पिपील and पीलुक।]
पीलु: पीलु, उस्, m. a species of tree, Careya Arborea, (according to others) Salvadora Persica; a flower; the blossoms of the Saccharum Sara; the metacarpus, the central part of the hand; a group of palm trees; the stem of the palm; an arrow; an atom; a worm, an insect; an elephant (Arabic فيل Persian پيل); (उ), n. the fruit of the Pīlu tree. —पीलु-कुण, अस्, m. the season of the ripening of the Pīlu fruit. —पीलु-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the plant Sanseviera Zeyla-nica (= मूर्वा). —पीलु-पर्णी, f. the plant Sanse-viera Zeylanica; Momordica Monadelpha; a kind of drug. —पीलु-मत्, अती, f., with द्यौस्, the central or middle region of the sky between Udan-vatī and Pra-dyaus. —पीलु-वह, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a district. —पीलु-सार, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
पीलुक: पीलुक, अस्, m., N. of a tree, Careya Arborea or Salvadora Persica or any other exotic or unknown tree [cf. काक-प्°, काल-प्°]; an ant.
पीलुनी: पीलुनी, f. the plant Sanseviera Zeylanica (= मूर्वा).
पीला: पीला पीला, f., Ved. epithet of a particular scent; N. of a woman.
पीव्: पीव् पीव्, cl. 1. P. पीवति, पीवितुम्, to be fat or corpulent, to be thick.
पीवा: पीवा पीवा, f. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पा), water.
पुंस्: पुंस् 1. पुंस् (perhaps a Nom. fr. 2. पुंस् below), cl. 10. P. पुंसयति, -यितुम्, to crush, grind; to pain, punish.

पुंस् 2. पुंस्, पुमान्, m. (voc. पुमन्, the strong cases being fr. पुमांस्, the middle fr. पुम्, and the weak fr. पुंस्, but loc. pl. पुन्सु not पुंसु by Pāṇ. VIII. 2, 65; said to be fr. rt. 3. पा), a male, male being, man [cf. न-प्°]; a human being; a servant, attendant; the soul, spirit (= पुरुष; परः पुमान्, the Supreme Spirit, soul of the universe, Viṣṇu); (in grammar) a word in the masculine gender; [cf. स्त्री-पुं-नपुंसक; Lat. mas, mar-is for mas-is, mas-culus, the syllable pu being rejected in these words but appearing in pu-sus, pu-sa, pu-bes perhaps for pu-mes.] —पुं-युग्, क्, or पुं-योग, अस्, m. connection with a man; cohabitation with men. —पुं-रत्न, अम्, n. ‘a jewel of a man,’ an excel-lent man. —पुं-राशि, इस्, m. a male sign of the zodiac, an epithet of Aries and the signs following. —पुं-रूप, अम्, n. the form or shape of a man; पुं-रूपं कृ, to assume the form of a man. —पुं-लिङ्ग, अम्, n. the characteristic sign of a man, virility, manhood, the male organ; (in gram-mar) the masculine gender; (अस्, आ, अम्), having the characteristics of a man; masculine. —पुंलिङ्ग-ता, f. masculineness, the being of the masculine gender. —पुंलिङ्ग-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m., N. of a part of the Nāma-liṅgānuśāsana by Amara-siṃha. —पुं-वत्, ind. like a man, as a man, as with a man; like the masculine gender, in the masculine form or gender. —पुं-वत्स, अस्, m. a bull-calf; (अस्, आ, अम्), having bull-calves, surrounded by bull-calves. —पुंवद्-विधान, अम्, n. ceremonies as on the birth of a male. —पुं-वृष, अस्, m. the musk rat. —पुं-वेश, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing male attire, dressed like a man. —पुंश्-चली, f. ‘running after men,’ a frequenter of men, harlot, an unchaste woman; N. of an Apsaras. —पुंश्चलीय, अस्, m. the son of a harlot. —पुंश्-चलू, ऊस्, f., Ved. a harlot; (उस्), m. a whoremonger. —पुंश्-चिह्न, अम्, n. the characteristic of a male, membrum virile. —पुंस-वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (पुंस substituted for पुंस्), Ved. having a son. —पुं-सवन, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth a male, causing the birth of a male child; (अम्), n. (with or without व्रत) the first of the essential ceremonies of Hindū initiation, a reli-gious and domestic festival held on the mother's per-ceiving the first signs of a living conception; a fetus; milk. —पुंसानुज (°सा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) having an elder brother. —पुं-सुवन, अम्, n., Ved. bringing forth a male child. —पुंस्-कटी, f. a man's hip. —पुंस्-कामा, f. ‘desirous of man,’ a woman wishing for a lover or husband. —पुंस्-कोकिल, अस्, m. the male of the Indian cuckoo. —पुंस्कोकिल-त्व, अम्, n. the being a male cuckoo, the state or con-dition of a male cuckoo. —पुंस्-त्व, अम्, n. the being a male, the state of a male, masculineness, manhood, virility; semen virile; (in grammar) the masculine gender. —पुंस्-पुत्र, अस्, m. a male child, boy. —पुंस्-प्रजनन, अम्, n. the male organ of generation. —पुंस्-प्रवाद, अस्, m. (in Vedic grammar) a masculine base. —पुंस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word पुंस् or the masculine gender. —पुङ्-खेऽट, अस्, m. a male planet. —पुङ्-गव, अस्, m. a bull; a kind of drug commonly called Māṣāṇi; (at the end of a comp.) a hero or eminent person, chief, best, most excellent [cf. कुरु-प्°, गज-प्°, नर-प्°।] —पुङ्गव-केतु, उस्, उस्, उ, characterized or symbolized by a bull; (उस्), m. an epithet of Śiva. —पुङ्-गुण-जन्तु-जीव, अस्, m. the living or animal soul combined with the qualities of man. —पुञ्-जन्म-कर, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), ‘effecting the birth of males,’ a constellation under which male children are born. —पुञ्-जन्म-द, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), ‘granting the birth of males,’ a constellation under which male children are born. —पुञ्-जन्मन्, अ, n. the birth of a male child. —पुञ्जन्म-योग, अस्, m. ‘star of the birth of males,’ a constellation under which male children are born. —पुन्-दास, अस्, m. a male slave. —पुन्-ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘having the mark of a male,’ the male of any species of animal. —पुन्-नक्षत्र, अम्, n. a Nakṣatra regarded as a male, male asterism; an asterism under which males are pro-created. —पुन्-नाग, अस्, m. ‘an elephant among men,’ a distinguished man; a white elephant; N. of a tree, Rottleria Tinctoria (from the blossoms of which a yellowish dye is prepared); a white lotus; a nutmeg. —पुन्-नाट or पुन्-नाड, अस्, m. the plant Cassia Tora (= चक्र-मर्द). —पुन्-नाम-धेय, अस्, m. ‘that which is called man,’ one of the male sex, a male. —१। पुन्-नामन्, आ, म्नी, अ (for 2. see under पुत्), having a masculine name; (आ), m. the tree Rottleria Tinctoria. —पुम्-अनुजा, f. (probably) ‘born after a male child,’ having an elder brother; born after or like a man. —पुम्-अपत्य, अम्, n. male offspring. —पुम्-अर्थ, अस्, m. the aim of man. —पुम्-आख्या, f. a name for male beings, a designation of a male being. —पुम्-आचार, अस्, m. the custom or usage of men. —पुम्-भू-मन्, आ, m. a word of the masculine gender in the plural number.
पुंस: पुंस (at the end of a comp.) = 2. पुंस्; [cf. न-प्°, महा-प्°, स्त्री-प्°।]
पुंस्क: पुंस्क (at the end of an adj. comp.) = 2. पुंस्, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. V. 4, 151; [cf. उक्त-प्°, भाषित-प्°।]
पुंस्ति: पुंस्ति पुंस्ति, N. of a Sāman.
पुक्कश: पुक्कश पुक्कश or पुक्कस, अस्, m. epithet of a degraded mixed caste (erroneously identified by lexicographers with the Cāṇḍālas), the offspring of a Ni-ṣāda by a Śūdrā female, a man of an impure or degraded tribe or occupation; (ई), f. a woman of the Pukkaśa caste; a bud, blossom; the indigo plant; (अस्, ई, अम्), low, vile.
पुक्कशक: पुक्कशक, अस्, m. a man of the Pukkaśa caste; (अस्, आ, अम्), low, vile.
पुङ्ख: पुङ्ख पुङ्ख, अस्, m. the feathered part of an arrow, the lower part of an arrow which comes in contact with the bow-string and contains the feathers and shaft; a hawk, falcon (= मङ्गलाचार, q. v.).
पुङ्खित: पुङ्खित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with a Puṅkha.
पुङ्खिलतीर्थ: पुङ्खिलतीर्थ पुङ्खिल-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage (= राम-तीर्थ).
पुङ्ग: पुङ्ग पुङ्ग, अस्, अम्, m. n. a heap, collec-tion, quantity; [cf. पुञ्ज।]
पुङ्गल: पुङ्गल पुङ्गल, अस्, m. the soul; [cf. पुद्-गल।]
पुच्छ: पुच्छ पुच्छ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a tail; the hinder part; the tail of a peacock; a horse's tail; any hairy tail; the end of anything; [cf. probably Gr. πῡγή, perhaps πύματος.] —पुच्छ-जाह, अम्, n. the root of the tail. —पुच्छ-दा, f. a bulbous plant used as a remedy for sterility, = लक्ष्म-ना-कन्द; (probably a corruption of पुत्र-दा।) —पुच्छ-धि, इस्, m., Ved. the root of the tail. —पुच्छ-मूल or पुच्छाग्र (°छ-अग्°), अम्, n. the tip of the tail. —पुच्छाण्डक (°छ-अण्°), अस्, m., N. of a Nāga of the race of Takṣaka. —पुच्छेश्वर (°छ-ईश्°), अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a place or of a temple.
पुच्छिका: पुच्छिका in क्रोष्टु-प्°, क्रोष्टुक-प्°, q. v.
पुच्छिन्: पुच्छिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a tail, tailed; a cock; Calotropis Gigantea (= अर्क).
पुच्छटि: पुच्छटि पुच्छटि, इ, n. snapping or cracking the fingers; [cf. मुचुटी।]
पुच्छ्: पुछ् पुछ् [cf. युछ्], cl. 1. P. पुच्छति, पुपुच्छ, पुच्छितुम्, to be careless or inattentive.
पुछ्: पुछ् पुछ् [cf. युछ्], cl. 1. P. पुच्छति, पुपुच्छ, पुच्छितुम्, to be careless or inattentive.
पुञ्ज: पुञ्ज पुञ्ज, अस्, m. (perhaps for अपि + युञ्ज fr. rt. युज्), a heap, lump, mass, quantity, collec-tion, multitude; [cf. नख-पुञ्ज-फला, पुङ्ग, पूग; Gr. πύξ perhaps an abbreviated dat. pl., πύκ-τη-ς, πύγ-μαχ-ο-ς, πυγ-μή, πυγ-ών, πυκ-νό-ς, πυκ-ι-νό-ς; Lat. pug-nu-s, pug-na, pug-nā-re, pug-io, pug-il, pugillu-s, pugillaris; Old Germ. fû-st; Old Slav. pe-stĭ.] —पुञ्ज-राज, अस्, m., N. of a grammarian and author of a commentary on the Sarasvatī-prakriyā. —पुञ्ज-शस्, ind. in heaps. —पुञ्जी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to heap, lay in a heap.
पुञ्जय: पुञ्जय, Nom. P. पुञ्जयति, -यितुम्, to heap, heap up, heap together.
पुञ्जि: पुञ्जि, इस्, f. a heap, quantity, collection. —पुञ्जि-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, heaped, accumulated; (अस्), m., Ved. a fisherman; (according to Mahī-dhara) a birdcatcher.
पुञ्जिक: पुञ्जिक, अस्, m. hail. —पुञ्जिक-स्थला or पुञ्-जिका-स्थला or पुञ्जिका-स्तना, f. an allegorical N. of an Apsaras; (scil. भूमि, ground thrown up in digging or having such ground?).
पुञ्जित: पुञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, piled up, heaped, heaped to-gether; made up into a ball, pressed or put together.
पुञ्जील: पुञ्जील पुञ्जील, अम्, n., Ved. = पिञ्जूल, q. v.
पुट्: पुट् पुट्, cl. 6. P. पुटति, पुटितुम्, to em-brace, clasp, fold; to intertwine; cl. 1. P. पोटति, to rub, to press, to grind or pound, (perhaps an incorrect form for मुट्); cl. 10. P. पुटयति, -यि-तुम्, to be in contact with; to bind together, fasten, string; पोटयति, -यितुम्, to reduce to powder, grind; to be or become small or shallow; to shine; to speak; [cf. rts. पट्, पठ्, पुट्ट्, पुथ्, मुट्, मुण्ट्, पुण्ट्, पुण्ड्।]
पुट: पुट, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. a fold, pocket; a tubular or hollow space, cavity, concavity [cf. कक्ष-प्°, कर्ण-प्°, गज-प्°]; a cup or concavity made of a leaf folded or doubled; a basket or vessel or dish made of leaves (Manu VI. 28; cf. पत्त्र-प्°, पर्ण-प्°, पलाश-प्°); the pod or capsule which envelops young shoots; a shallow cup or receptacle (as the hollow of the hand); an eyelid; a cover, covering, wrapper, cloth worn round the middle of the body to cover the privities; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a horse's hoof; (अस्), m. a casket (= सम्-पुट); a narrowing or contracting of anything; a folding or doubling of anything so as to form a cup or concavity; N. of a man; (अम्), n. a nutmeg; two vessels joined to-gether (the upper one being inverted, for the subli-mation of medicinal substances). —पुट-कन्द, अस्, m. a species of bulbous plant (= कोल-कन्द). —पु-ट-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘hollow-necked,’ a pot, jar, pitcher, vessel for butter; a copper vessel. —पुट-पाक, अस्, m. a particular method of preparing drugs (the various substances being wrapped up in leaves, covered with clay, and roasted in the fire); digesting, subliming. —पुट-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. causing to break through, opening (said of a rock under which a spring is discovered). —पुट-भेद, अस्, m. (probably) the fountain-head of a river; the bend of a river (?); the mouth of a river (?); a city, town; a kind of musical instrument. —पुट-भेदक, अस्, इका, अम्, Ved. = पुट-भिद्, q. v. —पुट-भेदन, अम्, n. a town, city. —पुटाह्वय (°ट-आह्°), अस्, m. = पुट-पाक, q. v. —पुटोटज (°ट-उट्°), अम्, n. a white umbrella or parasol. —पुटोदक (°ट-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘having water in its hollow or interior,’ a cocoa-nut.
पुटक: पुटक, अम्, n. a fold, pocket, &c. [cf. पुट]; any shallow cup or concavity (also पत्त्र-प्°), a bag or vessel made of a leaf doubled over in a funnel-like shape; a lotus; a nutmeg; (अस्), m. a particular position of the hands; (इका), f. cardamoms.
पुटकिनी: पुटकिनी, f. a lotus; a group of lotuses.
पुटित: पुटित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground; split, torn up; contracted; sewn, stitched; (अम्), n. closing or shutting the hands to hold anything, the hollow of the hands.
पुट्ट्: पुट्ट् पुट्ट्, cl. 10. P. पुट्टयति, -यितुम्, to decrease, diminish; to be or become small, be or become low or shallow.
पुड्: पुड् पुड्, cl. 6. P. पुडति, पुडितुम्, to leave, quit; to dismiss; to emit; to cover; cl. 1. P. पोडति, &c., to grind; [cf. rts. पुट्, 1. पुंस्, बुड्, मुड्, मुण्ट्, मुट्।]
पुण्: पुण् पुण् (connected with पुण्य, q. v.), cl. 6. P. पुणति, पुणितुम्, to be pure or virtuous; to do a pious or holy act; cl. 10. P. पोणयति, -यितुम्, to collect, heap up, accumulate.
पुणतामकर: पुणतामकर पुणतामकर, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Ātmatva-jāti-vicāra and Sādṛśya-vāda, (also called Mahā-deva.)
पुण्ट्: पुण्ट् पुण्ट्, cl. 10. P. पुण्टयति, -यितुम्, to speak; to shine.
पुण्ड्: पुण्ड् पुण्ड्, cl. 1. P. पुण्डति, पुण्डितुम्, to rub, grind, pound, reduce to dust or powder.
पुण्ड: पुण्ड पुण्ड, अस्, m. = पुण्ड्र, a mark, sign. —पुण्ड-वर्धन = पुण्ड्र-वर्धन, q. v.
पुण्डरीक: पुण्डरीक पुण्डरीक, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. पुण्), a lotus-flower, especially a white lotus, (used at the end of an adj. comp. as expressive of beauty, see Gaṇa Vyāghrādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 56); a white umbrella; a kind of drug; a mark on the forehead (in this sense perhaps also m.); N. of a sacred bathing-place; (अस्), m. a kind of sacrifice; a species of rice; a fragrant kind of mango; Artemisia Indica (= द-मनक); a variety of the sugar-cane; a silk-worm (?); a kind of leprosy; fever in an elephant; white (the colour); a tiger; a kind of serpent; N. of a Nāga; a pitcher, student's water-pot; N. of the elephant of the south-east quarter; N. of an ancient king; of a son of Nabha or Nabhas; (with Jainas) N. of a Gaṇa-dhara; N. of a hermit the son of Śveta-ketu and Lakṣmī; of a mountain; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras; of a daughter of Vasiṣṭha and wife of Prāṇa or Pāṇḍu. —पुण्डरि-स्रजा, f. (पुण्डरि substituted for पुण्डरीक), Ved. a wreath or garland of lotuses. —पुण्डरीक-नारद-संवाद, अस्, m., N. of the thirty-second chapter of the Pārtha Itihāsa-samuccaya. —पुण्डरीक-प-लाशाक्ष (°श-अक्ष), अस्, ई, अम्, having eyes like the petals of a lotus. —पुण्डरीक-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a city. —पुण्डरीक-प्लव, अस्, m. a kind of bird. —पुण्डरीक-मुखी, f. a kind of leech. —पुण्डरीकाक्ष (°क-अक्ष), अस्, m. ‘lotus-eyed,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu; a kind of drug (= पुण्डर्य, प्र-पौण्डरीक). —पुण्डरीकात-पत्र (°क-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the lotus for an umbrella (said of the autumn). —पुण्डरीकाव-तंस (°क-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having white lotus-flowers for ear ornaments. —पुण्डरीकोदर-प्र-भ (°क-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, resplendent as the in-terior of a white lotus.
पुण्डरीयक: पुण्डरीयक, अस्, m., N. of a divinity enu-merated among the Viśve Devāḥ; (अम्), n. Ketmia Mutabilis (= स्थल-पद्म); a kind of drug (com-monly called पुण्डरीय).
पुण्डर्य: पुण्डर्य, अम्, n. a creeper; a medicinal plant used as a remedy for diseased eyes (= प्र-पौण्डरीक).
पुण्ड्र: पुण्ड्र पुण्ड्र, अस्, m. a red variety of the common sugar-cane, Saccharum Officinarum; a white lotus, a lotus in general; a species of tree (= ह्रस्व-प्लक्ष); a kind of creeper, Gærtnera Racemosa (= अति-मुक्तक, वासन्ती); a mark or line made on the forehead with sandal &c., sectarial mark; a worm; N. of a Daitya or infernal being considered incarnate in Śiśu-pāla; N. of a son of Bali; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people and of their country (the modern Bengal and Behar, ‘the country of the sugar-cane’); N. of a mythical city between the mountains Hima-vat and Hema-kūṭa. —पुण्ड्र-केलि, इस्, m. an elephant. —पुण्ड्र-देश, अस्, m., N. of a district. —पुण्ड्र-नगर, अम्, n. ‘city of the Puṇḍras,’ N. of a town; [cf. पौण्ड्रनागर।] —पुण्ड्र-वर्धन, अम्, n., N. of a town in Gauḍa; (also spelt पुण्ड-वर्धन।)
पुण्ड्रक: पुण्ड्रक, अस्, m. a red variety of the common sugar-cane, Saccharum Officinarum; a kind of creeper, Gærtnera Racemosa; a species of tree; a mark on the forehead, sectarial mark; one who lives by breeding silk-worms; N. of a man (?).
पुण्ढ्र: पुण्ढ्र, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), a mark, sign, sectarial mark; [cf. पुण्ड्र।]
पुण्य: पुण्य पुण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. 1. पू; according to others fr. rt. 1. पुष् or rt. पुण्; not met with in the earliest language), good, pure, holy, right, righteous, virtuous, just, sacred; happy, prosperous, favourable, propitious, auspicious, lucky; bright, fine, beautiful, pleasing; sweet, fra-grant (as an odour); solemn, festive, ferial; (अम्), n. good, right, virtue, moral or religious merit; a good or meritorious act; purity, purification; a reli-gious ceremony, especially one performed by a wife in order to retain her husband's affections and to obtain a son; a brick trough for watering cattle, = कोष्ठक; (अस्), m., N. of a man; of a lake (in this sense perhaps n.); (आ), f. holy basil, Ocymum Sanctum; N. of a daughter of Kratu and San-natī. —पुण्य-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘right-doer,’ an upright or virtuous man. —पुण्य-कर्मन्, अ, n. a virtuous or meritorious act; पुत्र: पुत्र पुत्र, अस्, m. (perhaps connected with पितृ; said to be fr. rt. 1. पू, but according to others fr. rt. 1. पुष्; traditionally said to be a comp. पुत्-त्र, ‘preserving from the hell called Put,’ Manu IX. 138), a son, child, the young of an animal; (at the end of a comp.) used as a diminutive to express ‘any little thing of its kind’ [cf. शिला-प्°]; the fifth mansion from the point of conjunction of the sun and a zodiacal sign (in astrol.), the fifth house; N. of a son of Brahmiṣṭha; of a son of Priya-vrata; of a son of a Brāhman; (औ), m. du. two sons, a son and daughter; (ई), f. a daughter; a doll [cf. दारु-प्°]; (at the end of a comp.) used as a diminutive to express ‘any little thing of its kind’ [cf. असि-प्°]; an epithet of Pārvatī; a species of plant. पुत्र in the voc. sing. is sometimes used as a mode of addressing young persons, ‘my son,’ ‘my child;’ [cf. Pers. pusr, ‘a son;’ Gr. πῶλο-ς, πωλ-ίο-ν; Lat. pullu-s, (Marci-)por, pu-er, pu-era, pu-su-s, pusa, pû-pu-s, pû-pa, pûpilla, pu-tu-s; Goth. fula (n) = Old Germ. folo, ‘a foal;’ Armor. paotr, ‘a boy.’] —पुत्र-कन्दा, f. a bulbous plant supposed to cause fecundity (= लक्ष्-मणा-कन्द). —पुत्र-कर्मन्, अ, n. a ceremony or sacrifice on the birth of a son. —पुत्र-कलत्र-नाश-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, fearful or apprehensive of the destruction of wife and children. —पुत्र-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of sons or children. —पुत्रकामेष्टि (°म-इष्°), इस्, f., Ved. an obla-tion or sacrifice made by one desirous of offspring. —पुत्रकाम्य, Nom. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to adopt as a son. —पुत्री-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, adopted as a son. —पु-त्रेप्सु (°र-ईप्°), उस्, उस्, उ, wishing for a son. —पुत्रेष्टि (°र-इष्°), इस्, or पुत्रेष्टिका (°र-इष्°), f. a sacrifice performed to obtain male children, one performed at the time of adoption. —पुत्रै-श्वर्य (°र-ऐश्°), अम्, n. ‘son's proprietorship,’ a resignation of property or power by a father to his son. —पुत्रैषणा (°र-एष्°), f., Ved. desire or longing for a son.
पुत्तलक: पुत्तलक, अस्, m. or पुत्तलिका, f. a puppet, doll, small statue, image, idol, effigy.
पुत्तिका: पुत्तिका, f. the white ant or termite (so called from its doll-like form); = पतङ्गिका, a small kind of bee.
पुत्रक: पुत्रक, अस्, m. a little son, little boy, child, a son (often used as a term of endearment); a puppet, doll, figure of stone or wood or lac, &c.; a rogue, cheat; a small and venomous species of animal (enumerated among the Mūṣikas); a fabulous animal with eight legs (= शरभ); a grasshopper; hair; a species of tree; N. of a man, the supposed founder of the city of Pāṭali-putraka; a particular mountain; (अका or इका), f. a daughter; a daughter appointed to raise male issue to be adopted by a father who has no sons; a puppet, doll, figure of wood, &c.; the cotton or down of the tamarisk; (at the end of a comp.) used as a diminutive to express any little thing of its kind (e. g. असि-प्°, खड्ग-प्°). —पुत्रिका-पुत्र, अस्, m. a daughter's son who by agreement or adoption becomes the son of her father (one of the twelve heirs acknowledged by the old Hindū law); a grandson. —पुत्रिका-प्रसू, ऊस्, f. the mother of a daughter. —पुत्रिका-भर्तृ, ता, m. a daughter's husband. —पुत्रिका-सुत, अस्, m. a daughter's son, a grandson.
पुत्रिन्: पुत्रिन्, ई, इणि, इ, having a son or sons, possessing children; (ई), m. the father of a son; (इणी), f. the mother of a son or of children generally; a para-sitical plant; the plant Siphonanthus Indica.
पुत्रिय: पुत्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to a son, filial; procuring a son; अ-पुत्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. unfavourable to sons or children.

पुत्रीयत्: पुत्रीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing for a son.
पुत्रीया: पुत्रीया, f. the desire of or wish for a son.
पुत्रीयितृ: पुत्रीयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who wishes for a son.

पुद्गल: पुद्गल पुद्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, beautiful, hand-some, of a handsome form or figure; having form or property; (अस्), m. the body, matter; the soul, personal identity; an epithet of Śiva.

पुन: पुन पुन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पू), purifying, cleaning; [cf. किम्-प्°, कुलम्-प्°, &c.]
पुनच: पुनच पुनच (?), N. of a country in the north of India.
पुनर्: पुनर् पुनर्, ind. again, afresh, anew, once more; back, in an opposite direction, (with rt. 1. दा, to give back, requite, to give up; with rts. 5. इ or 1. गा or गम्, to go back, return home, to go away again, to escape; with भू, to exist again, to be renewed, to be-come a wife again, Manu IX. 175; cf. पुनर्-भू); पुनः पुनः, again and again, repeatedly; पुनर् — पुनर्, at one time — at another time.

पुनर् is often used to introduce further details or simply as a connecting particle in a sentence, in the sense of ‘further,’ ‘furthermore,’ ‘besides,’ ‘now.’ As an adversative particle पुनर् is equivalent to ‘on the other hand,’ ‘on the contrary,’ ‘but,’ ‘yet,’ ‘still,’ ‘and yet,’ ‘notwithstanding,’ ‘nevertheless,’ ‘however.’ The construction वा पुनर् often takes the place of the simple वा, e. g. अद्रोहेणैव भू-तानाम् अल्प-द्रोहेण वा, पुनः, with no injury or with the least possible injury to animated beings, Manu IV. 2. पुनर् अपि, even again, and on the other hand, also. किम् पुनर्, how much more! how much less! see किम्. —पुनः-पद, अम्, n., Ved. ‘a repeated portion of a verse,’ the burden (of a hymn), refrain; (अस्, आ, अम्), containing a refrain. —पुनः-पराजय, अस्, m. losing again (what has been won). —पुनः-पाक, अस्, m. cook-ing afresh, repeated boiling or cooking; a repeated baking (of earthen vessels); पुनःपाकं कृ, to cook afresh or again. —पुनः-पुना, f., N. of a river in Behar, the Poonpoon (perhaps so called from its meandering course). —पुनः-प्रत्युप-कार, अस्, m. retribution, requital, retaliation. —पु-नः-प्रवृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, grown again. —पु-नः-प्राप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained again, recoverable. —पुनः-संस्कार, अस्, m. renewed investiture, repetition of any essential ceremony (as the reinvestiture of a Brāhman with the sacrificial cord when he has forfeited it by unknowingly drink-ing spirits &c.). —पुनः-संस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fitted up again, repaired, mended. —पुनः-सङ्गम, अस्, m. coming together again, meeting again, reunion. —पुनः-सन्दर्शन, अम्, n. seeing one another again. —पुनः-सन्धान, अम्, n. uniting again, reuniting; restoring (the sacred fire when it has gone out). —पुनः-सम्भव, अस्, m. coming into existence again. —पुनः-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. running back (as a dog returning by the way that it came); an epithet of the Achyranthes Aspera (the flowers of which are turned back; cf. अपा-मार्ग, पराक्-पुष्पी, प्रत्यक्-पुष्पी). —पुनः-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, again agreeable or pleasant. —पुनः-स्तुति, इस्, f., Ved. repeated praise, a repeated ceremony. —पुनः-स्तोम, अस्, m., N. of an Ekāha. —पुनर्-अपगम, अस्, m. going away again. —पुनर्-अभिधान, अम्, n. mentioning again. —पुनर्-अभिषेक, अस्, m., Ved. anointing again. —पुनर्-अर्थिता, f. a reiterated request or entreaty. —पुनर्-असु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. breathing again, coming to life again. —पुनर्-आगत, अस्, आ, अम्, come back again, returned. —पुनर्-आगम, अस्, m. coming back, return. —पुनर्-आगमन, अम्, n. the act of coming back, returning to the place set out from. —पुनर्-आगामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, coming back, returning. —पुनर्-आदायम्, ind., Ved. repeatedly. —पुनर्-आदि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. begin-ning afresh, repeated. —पुनर्-आधान, अम्, n. renewing or replacing a consecrated fire (according to Kullūka पुनर्-आधानं कुर्यात् = स्मार्ताग्नीन् श्रौताग्नीन् वा आदध्यात्). —पुनर्-आधेय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be renewed or replaced (on the altar, said of fire); repeated birth. —पुनरावर्त-नन्दा, f., N. of a place of pilgrimage. —पुनर्-आवर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, returning (to mundane exist-ence); leading back (to mundane existence); sub-ject to successive births. —पुनर्-आवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. repeated. —पुनर्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. return (to mundane existence); repetition; revision (of a book &c.). —पुनर्-आहार, अस्, m., Ved. taking again, recapture. —पुनर्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, said again, reiterated, repeated, superfluous; (अम्), n. repetition, useless repetition, tautology. —पुनर्-उक्त-जन्मन्, आ, m. ‘whose birth is repeated,’ a Brāhman. —पुनरुक्त-ता, f. repetition, tautology. —पुनरुक्त-भुक्त-विषय, अस्, आ, अम्, (an occupation) in which the objects of sense are re-peatedly enjoyed. —पुनरुक्तवद्-आभास, अस्, m. appearance of repetition, seeming tautology (a figure of speech). —पुनर्-उक्ति, इस्, f. saying again, useless repetition, tautology; a mere word, empty word. —पुनरुक्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having repetition, tautological. —पुनर्-उत्थान, अम्, n. rising again, resurrection. —पुनर्-उत्पत्ति, इस्, f. the coming again into being, reproduction, new birth; metem-psychosis. —पुनर्-उत्सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. re-peatedly let loose (said of a bull). —पुनर्-उत्स्यूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sewed or mended again, patched up. —पुनर्-उपगमन, अम्, n. coming back, returning. —पुनर्-उपागम, अस्, m. return. —पु-नर्-उपोढा, f. married again, re-married. —पुनर्-गमन, अम्, n. going again, returning. —पुनर्-ग्रहण, अम्, n., Ved. repeatedly taking, repeated taking up (of ghee &c. with a ladle); repetition. —पुनर्जन्म-जय, अस्, m. ‘victory over future birth,’ liberation, final emancipation, freedom from transmigration. —पुनर्-जन्मन्, अ, n. new or second birth, regeneration, future birth by transmigration, metempsychosis; (आ, आ, अ), born again, regenerated. —पुनर्-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born again, regenerated. —पुनर्-दर्शन, अम्, n. seeing again, (पुनर्-दर्शनाय, ‘au revoir.’) —पुनर्-दातृ, ता, m. giving again, a rewarder, recompenser. —पुनर्-दार-कृया, f. taking a second wife (after the death of the first). —पुनर्-धेनु, उस्, f. a cow that again gives milk. —पुनर्-नव or पुनर्-णव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. becoming new or young again, being renewed or restored to youth; (अस्), m. a finger-nail; (आ), f. hog-weed, Boerhavia Procumbens. —पुनर्-निष्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. repaired or mended again. —पुनर्-बाल, अस्, आ, अम्, = παλίμ-παις, become a child again, become childish, being in second childhood. —पुनर्-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, born again; (ऊस्), f. a virgin widow re-married; re-existence. —पुनर्-भोग, अस्, m. repeated en-joyment; a return of fruition, perception of pleasure or pain as a reward of former actions. —पुनर्-मघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘having repeated gifts,’ covetous, avaricious; repeatedly offering oblations or granting gifts. —पुनर्-मन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) again thinking of, remembering; (Sāy.) = पुनः स्तोतव्य, to be praised or adored again. —पुनर्-मृत्यु, उस्, m., Ved. repeated or second death. —पुनर्-यज्ञ, अस्, m., Ved. a repeated sacrifice. —पुनर्-यात्रा, f. a repeated procession. —पुनर्-युवन्, आ, अती, अ, Ved. again young, re-stored to youth. —पुनर्-लाभ, अस्, m. obtaining again, recovery. —पुनर्-वक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be repeated. —पुनर्वक्तव्य-ता, f. necessity of being repeated. —पुनर्-वचन, अम्, n. saying again, repeating; repeated text or injunction. —पु-नर्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the word पुनर्. —पुनर्-वत्स, अस्, m. a weaned calf that begins to suck again; N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 9. —पुनर्-वरण, अम्, n., Ved. choosing again. —पुनर्-वसु, उस्, m. पुर् 3. पुर्, ऊर्, f. (probably fr. rt. पॄ), a rampart, wall; a stronghold, castle, fortress, fortified city, town; the body (considered as the stronghold of the पुरुष, q. v.); intellect (= महत्); N. of a Daśa-rātra (Ved.). —पुरञ्-जन, अस्, m. the living principle, life, the soul (personified as a king); (ई), f. understanding, intelligence (personified as the wife of a king). —पुरञ्-जय, अस्, m. ‘city-conqueror,’ N. of a hero on the side of the Kurus; of a son of Sṛñjaya and father of Janam-ejaya; of a son of Bhajamāna and Sṛñjarī; (= ककुत्-स्थ) N. of a son of Śaśāda; = काकुत्स्थ; N. of a son of Vindhya-śakti; of Medhāvin; of an elephant, the son of Airāvaṇa. —पुरन्-द, अस्, m. = पुरन्-दर। —पुरन्-दर, अस्, m. ‘town-splitter’ or ‘fortress-destroyer,’ an epithet of Indra (as breaking cities into fragments with his thunderbolt?); the Indra of the seventh Manv-antara; an epithet of Agni; of Śiva; a thief, house-breaker; (आ), f. an epithet of Gaṅgā; (अम्), n. a species of pepper, Piper Chaba. —पु-रन्दर-चाप, अस्, m. Indra's bow, the rainbow. —पुरन्दर-पुरी, f., N. of a town in Mālava. —पुरि-शय, अस्, आ, अम् (a word formed to explain पुरुष), reposing in the fortress or fastness (i. e. the body). —पुरो-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ (fr. पुरस्, acc. pl. of 3. पुर् + हन्), Ved. breaking castles, destroying strong-holds. —पूर्-द्वार्, र्, f. or पूर्-द्वार, अम्, n. the gate of a city. —पूर्-पति, इस्, m., Ved. the lord of a castle or city. —पूर्-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. breaking down strongholds or castles. —पूर्-भिद्य, अम्, n., Ved. the breaking of strongholds or castles; (Sāy.) = सङ्ग्राम, war. —पूर्-याण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. leading or conducting to the fastness (i. e. to the celestial world).

पुरतस्: पुरतस्, ind. before (said both of place and time), in front, in advance, in the presence of (with gen.); पुरतः कृ, to place in front, cause to precede, give the lead to.
पुरतस् पुरतस्। See rt. 2. पुर्, p. 582.
पुरन्धि: पुरन्-धि, इस्, f. (पुरम् connected with पुरस् and पुरा, but by some considered to be fr. rt. पॄ), Ved. understanding, intelligence, prudence, wisdom; praise; (अयस्), f. pl. good thoughts or reflections; (इस्, इस्, इ), intelligent, prudent, wise (said of Pūṣan, Indra, a Ṛbhu, Bhaga, Savitṛ, Heaven and Earth; perhaps also इस्, m., N. of a particular deity); (ac-cording to Sāy.) = स्त्री-रूप or रूप-वत्. —पु-रन्धि-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. endowed with wisdom or understanding.

पुरन्ध्रि: पुरन्-ध्रि, इस् or ई, f. an elderly married woman, respectable matron; a woman whose husband and children are living.
पुरस्: पुरस्, ind. before, in front, in advance, in the presence of, before the eyes of (with gen., e. g. तस्य पुरो वाचम् आददे, he commenced a speech in his presence; or in the earlier language with the abl. or loc., opposed to पश्चा, पश्चात्, पृष्ठे); in the east, from the east, towards the east, east-ward, (दक्षिणतः पुरः, towards the south-east); [cf. पुरा, पुरतस्, पूर्व: Zend para, ‘before:’ Gr. πάρος, προ-πάοι-θεν, πρόσθε, πρόσθιος, perhaps πρες in πρέσβυς: perhaps Lat. coram for poram, palam for param: Goth. faura, ‘before;’ faur, ‘for:’ Old Germ. vora, ‘before;’ furi, ‘for:’ Old Pruss. pirsdan, ‘before.’] —पुर-उष्णिह्, क्, f., Ved., N. of a metre of three Pādas, the first con-taining twelve, and the second and third eight syllables each. —पुर-एतृ, ता, m., Ved. one who goes before, a guide, leader. —पुरः-पाक, अस्, आ, अम्, having fulfilment at hand, near fulfilment. —पुरः-प्रस्रवण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pouring forth; sitting towards the east. —पुरः-सर, अस्, ई, अम्, going before or in advance; (अस्), m. one who goes before, a forerunner, precursor, har-binger, attendant; (at the end of comps. अस्, आ, अम्), having as an attendant, attended by, preceded by, connected with, with [cf. प्रियाख्यान-प्°]; (अम्), ind. with, after. —पुरः-स्थातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. standing at the head, a leader. —पुरः-स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, standing before one's eyes. —पु-रः-स्फुरत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, opening or be-coming manifest before any one. —पुरश्-चरण, अस्, आ, अम्, making preparation; P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to bring to the front, place before or in front, station in front, cause to precede, hold before one's self; to make one's leader; to lead; to place in office, appoint; advanced to the foremost rank, placed in office, appointed; accompanied or attended by, combined with, provided or furnished with, pos-sessing; distinguished, honoured, respected; revered, adored, worshipped;
