पूर्वक: पूर्वक, अस्, इका, अम्, earlier, former, previous, prior, anterior, preceding, antecedent (often like पूर्व, q. v., at the end of a comp.; cf. स्त्री-प्°); first; preceded by, accompanied by, connected with, attended with (at the end of comps. = पूर्व, q. v.; cf. व्याहृति-प्°); (अस्), m. a forefather, ancestor; (अम्), ind. preceded by, with, according to, in con-formity with (at the end of comps.; cf. विधि-प्°, प्रीति-प्°).
पूर्वतन: पूर्वतन, अस्, ई, अम्, former, earlier, older, more ancient.
पूर्वतस्: पूर्व-तस्, ind. in front of, before (with gen.); towards the east; first, in the first place.
पूर्वत्र: पूर्व-त्र, ind. in the former or preceding part (opposed to उत्तर-त्र, q. v.); पूर्वत्र जन्मनि, in a former birth.
पूर्वथा: पूर्व-था, ind., Ved. at first, formerly, of old, aforetime; as of old; in front, towards the east (?).
पूर्वय: पूर्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in उपाधाय्य-प्°, having an edge or border (of red braid), trimmed, edged.
पूर्वातिथ: पूर्वातिथ, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman (= पौर्-वातिथ).
पूर्विक: पूर्विक, अस्, आ, अम्, formerly or previously done; formerly invited; पूर्वक, previous; [cf. स्त्री-पूर्विक।]
पूर्विणेष्ठा: पूर्विणे-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. standing in the east (? probably a wrong reading).
पूर्विन्: पूर्विन्, ई, इणी, इ, derived from ancestors or fore-fathers, observed by ancestors, ancestral; having for-merly, having formerly been (at the end of a comp.; cf. कृत-प्°, भुक्त-प्°, स्त्री-प्°).
पूर्विन्; add — (ई), m. a particular Jaina saint.
पूर्वीण: पूर्वीण, अस्, आ, अम्, derived from ancestors or forefathers, ancestral.
पूर्व्य: पूर्व्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. former, previous, preceding, ancient, old (opposed to नवीयस्, नू-तन); first, next, nearest (Sāy. = नेदिष्ठ); ex-cellent; (according to a Scholiast) young; (अम्), ind. before, formerly, long since, hitherto, at first. —पूर्व्य-स्तुति, इस्, f., Ved. principal praise (Sāy. = मुख्या स्तुतिः).
पूल्: पूल् पूल्, cl. 1. 10. P. पूलति, पूलयति, यितुम्, to collect, gather, heap up, accu-mulate.
पूल: पूल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), or पूलक, अस्, m. a bundle, pack.
पूलिका: पूलिका पूलिका, f. a kind of pastry; [cf. पूरिका, पोलिका, पौलि।]
पूल्य: पूल्य पूल्य, अम्, n. an empty or shrivelled grain of corn.
पूष्: पूष् पूष् (= rt. 2. पुष्), cl. 1. P. पू-षति, पूषितुम्, to nourish; to increase, grow.
पूष: पूष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. पुष्), a kind of mul-berry tree, Morus Indica; (आ), f. epithet of the third Kalā of the moon.
पूषक: पूषक, अस्, m. a kind of mulberry tree, Morus Indica.
पूषण: पूषण, अस्, m. = पूषन् below; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
पूषन्: पूषन्, आ, m. (the अ of अन् is not lengthened in the nom. du. pl. and acc. sing. du., e. g. nom. du. पूषणौ, nom. pl. पूषणस्, acc. sing. पूष-णम्, acc. pl. पूष्णस्, or according to some also पूषस्, inst. sing. पूष्णा or पूषा, loc. sing. पूष्णि or पूषणि or पूषि, see Gram. 157), N. of a Vedic deity (regarded as the guardian of flocks and herds and of property in general, cf. पुष्टिम्-भर; in the character of a herdsman he is repre-sented as carrying an ox-goad and riding in a car drawn by goats, cf. अजाश्व; in that of a presiding deity of the sun he is all-seeing, the companion of travellers, guide of the soul on its way to the next world, and the lover of his sister Sūryā; he causes the alternation of day and night, and is associated with Soma or the Moon as protector of the universe; he is invoked together with various gods, but most frequently with Indra and Bhaga; his most remark-able epithets are आ-घृणि, कपर्दिन्, दस्र, द-स्म, दस्म-वर्चस्; in the Brāhmaṇas Pūṣan is represented as having lost his teeth and feeding on a kind of gruel, whence he is called करम्भाद्; in later times he is enumerated among the twelve Ādityas, and regent of the Nakṣatra Revatī or Pauṣṇa); N. of the sun. —पूषण्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. accompanied by Pūṣan; (Sāy.) = पुष्ट्या युक्त, filled with nutriment. —पूष-दन्त-हर, अस्, m. ‘taking away Pūṣan's teeth,’ an epithet of Śiva. —पूष-भासा, f. ‘sun-splendor,’ N. of the capital of Indra; (also spelt पूष-भाषा।) —पू-ष-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a man with the surname Gobhila. —पूष-राति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having Pūṣan as a giver, i. e. probably, among whom Pūṣan is the especial benefactor. —पूषात्मज (°ष-आत्°), अस्, m. ‘son of Pūṣan,’ an epithet of Indra. —पू-षासुहृद् (°ष-अस्°), त्, m. ‘enemy of Pūṣan,’ an epithet of Śiva.
पूषध्र: पूषध्र पूषध्र, अस्, m., N. of a son of Manu; (probably a wrong reading for पृषध्र।)
पूष्कर: पूष्कर पूष्कर, a word formed for the ex-planation of पुष्कर (Śatapatha-b. VII. 4, 1, 13).
पृ: पृ 1. पृ, cl. 3. P. पिपर्ति, पपार, प-रिष्यति, अपार्षीत् (mostly Ved.), to bring over, carry over or across, ferry over; to bring out of, deliver from (with abl.); to escort; to pro-tect, uphold, support, sustain, maintain; to bring forward, promote, advance; cl. 9. P. पृनाति, to protect: Caus. P. (ep. also A.) पारयति (-ते), -यितुम्, Aor. अपीपरत्, to ferry over or across, carry over, conduct through; to bring out, deliver, extricate, rescue, save, protect; to reach the other side of anything, to accomplish, achieve, perform, bring to a conclusion; to keep one's ground, withstand, oppose; to be able or capable; to live; [cf. Zend par, ‘to carry across:’ Gr. περά-ω, πόρο-ς, πορεύς, πορ-θ-μός, πορσύν-ω, πορεύ-ω, πορίζ-ω, ἄπορος, ἀπορέ-ω, ἔμ-πορο-ς, πεῖρ-α, πειρά-ω, παρών, πειράτης, πεπαρεῖν, πείρω, περόνη, πόρπη, πειρά, πηρό-ς: Lat. por-ta, por-tu-s, ex-per-i-o-r, peritus, perî-culu-m, par-a-re (?), parere, partus, portare: Goth. far-an, ‘to go;’ far-j-an, ‘to carry:’ Old Germ. ar-far-an, ‘to perceive;’ furt: Angl. Sax. fyrd.]
पृ 2. पृ [cf. rt. पृण्], cl. 5. P. पृणोमि, पपार, परिष्यति, अपार्षीत्, पर्तुम्, to please, gratify, delight; to be pleased or delighted.

पृ 3. पृ, cl. 6. A. प्रियते, पप्रे, परिष्-यते, अपृत, पर्तुम्, to be busy or active (in व्य्-आ-पृ, q. v.); [cf. Gr. περά-ω, πέρ-νη-μι, πι-πρά-σκ-ω, πρί-α-μαι, πρά-σι-ς, πρα-τία-ς, πόρ-νη, ἔμ-πορος, ἔμ-πολά-ω, πωλέω; Lat. prec-iu-m, prec-ari; Old Germ. feil, feili = Mod. Germ. feil, ‘cheap, venal.’]
पृ 4. पृ = rt. पॄ, to fill, q. v.
पृक्का: पृक्का पृक्का, f. a species of leguminous plant, Trigonella Corniculata; [cf. स्पृक्का।]
पृक्त: पृक्त पृक्त, पृक्ति। See under rt. 1. पृच्।

पृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed, mingled, combined; brought into contact, touched, united, being in com-bination with, touching [cf. मयूख-प्°]; filled, full (e. g. घृत-पृक्त, full of ghee); (अम्), n. possessions, property, wealth (in these senses a wrong reading for पृक्थ, q. v.).
पृक्थ: पृक्थ पृक्थ, अम्, n. possession, property, wealth; [cf. रिक्थ।]
पृक्ष्: पृक्ष् पृक्ष्, f. (the nom. sing. does not occur; perhaps connected with rt. 1. पृच्), Ved. refreshment, food, nourishment, satiation. —पृक्षु-धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. (according to Sāy.) = पशु-पुरोडाशादिषु दाह-मध्ये धीयमानः, being placed in the midst of the burnt offerings of animals, ghee, &c., or = प्र-क्षोध्यः। = प्रकर्षेण बुभुक्षितः; (perhaps a corruption for प्र-क्षुध, ‘hungry, eager.’)
पृक्ष: पृक्ष पृक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fleet, swift (? said of a horse); having food, (Sāy.) = घासाद्य्-अन्न-वत्, possessing grass and other food; (अस्), m. a swift horse, courser (an epithet especially of the horses of the Aśvins, Agni, and Indra); N. of a man; a battle. —पृक्ष-प्रयज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. (perhaps) hastening with swift horses; (Sāy.) in which oblations of food begin to be offered (said of the morning). —पृक्ष-याम, अस्, आ, अम्, driving swift horses; (Sāy.) = अन्नानां नियमनं यस्-मिन्, in which there is the offering of food; (अस्), m. a proper N. (?).
पृच्: पृच् 1. पृच्, cl. 7. P. पृणक्ति, पपर्च, पर्चिष्यति, अपर्चीत्, पर्चितुम्; cl. 2. A. पृक्ते or पृङ्क्ते (sometimes referred to a form पृञ्च्), पपृचे or पपृञ्चे, पर्चिता or पृञ्चिता, पर्चिष्यते, अपर्चिष्ट, पर्चितुम्; cl. 1. A. पर्चति, &c. (?), to mix, mingle; to bring into contact, connect, unite, join; to be in contact, touch; to fill, satisfy, sate, satiate; to give lavishly, grant bountifully, bestow anything (acc. or gen.) richly upon any one (dat.), lavish upon (Ved.); to increase, augment, multiply; (A.) to fill one's self (?); cl. 1. 10. P. पर्चति, पर्चयति, &c., to touch; to hin-der, restrain (?); [cf. Gr. πλέκ-ω, πλέγ-μα, πλοκή, πλόκαμο-ς, δί-πλαξ, perhaps πόρκο-ς, πόρκη-ς: Lat. plec-t-o, am-plec-t-or, plic-o, du-plex, Parca, plăg-a: Umbr. tribricu, ‘triplicity:’ Goth. flah-t-om, ‘with folds;’ fal-th-a, ‘I fold;’ flaht, flihtu, fluhtumês: Old Germ. flihtu, flahs = Mod. Germ. Flachs = Eng. flax; flehtan: Mod. Germ. flech-t-en: Angl. Sax. folg-ian: Slav. ple-t-a, ‘I plait.’]
2. पृच्, क्, f., Ved. refreshment; (Sāy.) = प्राप्-तुं कामयमान, desirous of attaining, or = भुज्, enjoying; [cf. घृत-प्°, मधु-प्°।]
पृच्छक: पृच्छक पृच्छक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रछ्), one who asks or inquires after (with gen.); inquiring; inquiring into the future; (अस्), m. an inquirer, querist, investigator, inquisitive person.
पृच्छा: पृच्छा, f. asking, questioning, a question, in-quiry; an inquiry into the future.
पृच्छ्य: पृच्छ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or inquired after.
पृज्: पृज् पृज्, पृञ्ज्, cl. 2. A. पृङ्क्ते, &c., various readings for rts. 1. पृच्, पृञ्च्, q. v.
पृञ्च्: पृञ्च् पृञ्च्, cl. 2. A. पृङ्क्ते, &c. See rt. 1. पृच् above.
पृड्: पृड् पृड्, cl. 6. P. पृडति, &c. [cf. rt. पृण्], to gladden, delight.
पृण्: पृण् पृण् [cf. rts. 2. and 4. पृ], cl. 6. P. A. पृणति, -ते, &c., Ved. to fill; to please, gratify.
पृत्: पृत् पृत्, त्, f., Ved. (usually in loc. pl. पृत्सु, in Ṛg-veda I. 129, 4. पृत्सुषु, but according to native grammarians also in other cases, viz. पृतस्, पृता, पृद्भ्याम्), battle, contest, strife. —पृत्-सुति, इस्, f., Ved. a hostile attack; (Sāy.) a host. —पृत्सु-तुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, उर्, Ved. vic-torious; (Sāy.) = पृतनासु तरण-शील = शूर।
पृतन: पृतन, अम्, n. a hostile encounter (Ved.); an army (Ved.); (आ), f. a battle, encounter, fight, con-test, (in the earlier language only in acc. and loc. plur.); a hostile armament, army; a small army or division consisting of 243 elephants, as many chariots, 729 horse, and 1215 foot, = 3 Vāhinīs; (आस्), m. pl. men, mankind (?). —पृतनाज् (°ना-अज्°), क्, क्, क्, Ved. running or rushing in battle. —पृतनाजि (°ना-अजि°), इस्, इस्, इ, = पृतनाज् (Atharva-veda VII. 85, 1). —पृतना-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. victorious in battle; (त्), m., N. of an Ekāha. —पृतनाज्य (°ना-अज्°), अम्, n., Ved. ‘running-match,’ a fight, battle. —पृतना-नी, ईस्, or पृतना-पति, इस्, m., Ved. a leader in battle, commander, general. —पृ-तना-षह् or पृथना-षाह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. winning battles, victorious, (Sāy.) = अ-मर्त्य, immortal; (ट्), m. an epithet of Indra. —पृतना-षाह्य, अम्, n., Ved. victory in battle (Sāy. = परकीय-सेनाभि-भव). —पृतनाहव (°ना-आह्°), अस्, m., Ved. a challenge to fight; a fight, battle; (Sāy.) = सङ्ग्रा-मेषु रक्षणार्थम् आह्वानम्।
पृतनायत्: पृतनायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. fighting together, engaged in combat, (according to Mahī-dhara = सङ्ग्राम-काम, eager for battle.)
पृतनायु: पृतनायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. hostile, inimical.
पृतन्य: पृतन्य, Nom. P. पृतन्यति, -यितुम्, Ved. to attack, assail, to fight against.
पृतन्यु: पृतन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. attacking, hostile; (Sāy.) = युद्धम् इच्छत्।
पृत्सुध: पृत्सुध, अस्, m. battle ?; (a various reading for पृत्सु in Naigh. II. 17.)
पृथ्: पृथ् पृथ्, cl. 10. P. पर्थयति, -यितुम्, to extend (= rt. 1. प्रथ्); to throw, cast; to send, direct; [cf. rt. 2. प्रथ्।]
पृथ: पृथ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पृथ् as another form of rt. 1. प्रथ्), Ved. the flat or palm of the hand; a par-ticular measure, the length of the hand from the tip of the fingers to the knuckles, or = 13 Aṅgulis; (आ), f., N. of a daughter of Śūra and adopted daughter of Kunti and one of the wives of Pāṇḍu (she was the mother of Karṇa before her marriage and of Yudhi-ṣṭhira, Bhīma, and Arjuna after her marriage, see कुन्ति). —पृथ-हर, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —पृथा-ज, अस्, m. ‘son of Pṛthā,’ an epithet of Arjuna; the tree Pentaptera Arjuna. —पृथा-पति, इस्, m. ‘the husband of Pṛthā,’ an epithet of Pāṇḍu. —पृथारणि (°था-अर्°), इस्, f. ‘the Araṇi Pṛthā,’ a N. of Kuntī the wife of Pāṇḍu (as the mystical wood from which the Pāṇḍavas were struck out or generated; cf. पाण्डव-वह्नि). —पृथा-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Pṛthā,’ an epithet of Arjuna.
पृथक्: पृथक्, ind. separately, singly, severally; apart from, besides, with exception of, except (with abl.); without (with abl., inst., or gen.); differently from (with abl.); पृथक् पृथक्, one by one, separately, with regular intervals; [cf. perhaps Gr. φάρ-σο-ς; Lat. par(t)s, prī-vus perhaps for prith-vus, pri-vare.] —पृथक्-करण, अम्, n. making separate, separating, distinguishing, setting apart. —पृथक्-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having different wishes, having various desires. —पृथक्-कार्य, अम्, n. a separate or private affair, the affair of an individual. —पृथक्-कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a separate or different family. —पृथक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -क-रोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make separate, sever, sunder; to keep off, avert. —पृथक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, separated, severed, sundered, cut off; made distinct. —पृथक्-क्रिया, f. separation, disunion. —पृथक्-क्षेत्र, आस्, m. pl. children of one father by different wives or by wives of different classes. —पृथक्-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, going separately, walking alone. —पृथक्-त्व, अम्, n. separateness, separation, diversity, severalty; singleness, individu-ality; (एन), ind. singly, one by one. —पृथक्-त्वचा, f. ‘diverse-barked,’ a species of aloe com-monly called Mūrvā, Sanseviera Zeylanica. —पृथक्-पर्णी, f. ‘diverse-leaved,’ a species of plant, Hemio-nitis Cordifolia. —पृथक्-पिण्ड, अस्, m. a distant kinsman who offers the funeral cake by himself and not together with the other relations; (according to Kullūka = समानोदक।) —पृथक्-शब्द, अस्, m. a separate word, a distinct or independant word. —पृ-थक्-शय्या, f. sleeping apart. —पृथक्-श्रुति, इस्, इस्, इ, uttering a distinct sound, distinctly heard. —पृथक्-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, existing separately, separate. —पृथक्-स्थिति, इस्, f. separate existence, separation. —पृथग्-अभिमति, इस्, इस्, इ, regarding the world as separate (from God). —पृथग्-आत्मता, f. separateness, severalty; discrimination, judgment. —पृथग्-आत्मन्, आ, आ, अ, ‘having a distinct nature or essence,’ separate, distinct, individual; (आ), m. individualized spirit, that of an individual as detached from universal spirit or the soul of the universe. —पृथग्-आत्मिका, f. separate or individual existence, individuality. —पृथग्-ईश-मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, regarding God as distinct from the universe; [cf. पृथग्-अभिमति।] —पृथग्-गण, अस्, m. a separate company. —पृथग्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing distinct properties. —पृथग्-जन, अस्, m. a man of the lower classes or of low caste, a man of low character or profession; (with Buddhists) a man in his natural state, one not yet illuminated; an ignorant man, fool, blockhead; a wicked or vicious man, sinner; the lower orders, low people, the mul-titude; (आस्), m. pl. children of one father by different mothers; the lower orders, populace. —पृथग्-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, beholding other objects (than those of sense). —पृथग्-बीज, अस्, m. the plant Semecarpus Ana-cardium (= भल्लातक). —पृथग्-भाव, अस्, m. separate state or existence, separateness, difference, individuality (= पृथक्-त्व, q. v.). —पृथग्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become separate, separated, dif-ferent. —पृथग्-योग, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) hav-ing a different lot. —पृथग्योग-करण, अम्, n. disuniting things connected with one another. —पृ-थग्-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, variously shaped, diverse, manifold, various, different, of different kinds. —पृ-थग्-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of different kinds, various, diversified, multiform, different from (with inst.).
पृथिवी: पृथिवी, f. (for पृथ्वी, f. of पृथु below), ‘the wide (world),’ the earth, Earth personified (as the mother of all beings, and often invoked together with the Sky; in the Veda there are three earths enumerated corresponding with the three heavens, that on which mankind lives being called भूमि; in the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa said to be the daughter of Pṛthu); land, ground, soil; earth regarded as one of the elements; (according to Naigh. I. 3) = अन्त-रिक्ष, sky; पृथिव्या व्रतम् or पृथिव्याः सं-सर्पम्, N. of a Sāman. [पृथिवी is sometimes shortened into पृथिवि, especially in comps.] —पृ-थिवि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of the earth. —पृ-थिवि-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. earth-giving. —पृथिवि-भाग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the earth as a share, one to whom the earth is allotted, entitled to the earth. —पृथिवि-लोक, अस्, m., Ved. the earth re-garded as a world, the terrestrial world. —पृथिवि-षद् or पृथिवि-सद्, त्, त्, त्, sitting on the ground. —पृथिवि-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. standing on the ground, stepping firmly (said of a horse; Sāy. = पृथिव्यां सु-प्रतिष्ठितः). —पृथिवी-कम्प, अस्, m. an earthquake. —पृथिवी-क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, dwelling on earth (Ved.); reigning over the earth; (त्), m. a prince, king, sovereign. —पृथिवी-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘earth-moon,’ N. of a prince of the Tri-gartas. —पृथिवीञ्-जय, अस्, आ, अम्, conquering the earth; (अस्), m. a prince, king, sovereign. —पृ-थिवी-तल, अम्, n. the surface of the earth, ground, bare ground, the very earth. —पृथिवी-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —पृथिवी-धरण, अम्, n. a prop or support of the earth. —पृथिवी-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ a prince, king, sovereign; an epithet of Yama the regent of the dead; a kind of drug (= ऋषभ). —पृथिवी-परिपालक, अस्, m. ‘guardian of the earth,’ a prince, king, sovereign. —पृथिवी-पार्वतक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), rock-oil, petroleum (?). —पृथिवी-पाल, अस्, m. ‘guardian of the earth,’ a king, sovereign, ruler. —पृथिवी-भुज्, क्, m. ‘earth-enjoying,’ a prince, sovereign. —पृथिवी-मण्ड, अस् or अम्, m. or n.
