पृश्निका: पृश्निका, f. an aquatic plant, Pistia Stratiotes.
पृष्: पृष् पृष् (akin to rt. प्रुष्; cf. rts. स्पृश् and वृष्), cl. 1. P. पर्षति, प-पर्ष, पर्षिष्यति, अपर्षीत्, पर्षितुम्, to sprinkle; to weary; to vex; to hurt, injure; to give; cl. 1. A. पर्षते, पर्षितुम् (a various reading for rt. वृष्), to become wet: Caus. पर्षयति, यितुम्, Aor. अपपर्षत्, अपीपृशत्: Desid. पि-पर्षिषति: Intens. परीपृश्यते, परीपर्ष्टि: [cf. पृश्नि; Zend परेष्, ‘to sprinkle.’]
पृषत्: पृषत्, अन्, अती, अत्, (Ved.) spotted, speckled, mottled, dappled, piebald, party-coloured, variegated; sprinkling (in this sense used as a part.); (अन्), m. the spotted antelope; the hog deer, porcine deer; पृषताम् पतिः, ‘lord of the spotted ante-lopes,’ a N. of the Wind; (अती), f. a spotted cow; epithet of the animals ridden by the Maruts (usually said by commentators to be spotted antelopes, ac-cording to Mahī-dhara piebald mares, and often apparently identified in the Ṛg-veda with the horses of the Maruts); the female spotted antelope, spotted doe; = पार्षती, the daughter of Pṛṣata; (अत्), n. a drop of water or of any other liquid. —पृषत्-ता, f. or पृषत्-त्व, अम्, n. the being spotted or variegated. —पृषद्-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘having piebald horses,’ an epithet of the Maruts; (according to Sāy.) riding on spotted antelopes; (अस्), m. air, wind, the god of air or wind divinely personified; an epithet of Śiva; N. of a man; of a son of An-araṇya and father of Hary-aśva; of a son of Vi-rūpa; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the descendants of Pṛṣad-aśva. —पृषद्-आज्य, अम्, n. sprinkled or clotted butter, ghee mixed with coagulated milk forming an oblation. —पृषद्-आज्य-प्रणुत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. driven away from the oblation of ghee and curds. —पृषद्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. party-coloured, variegated. —पृषद्-वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a spotted calf. —पृ-षद्-वरा, f. ‘the best among the variegated ante-lopes,’ N. of a wife of Ruru and daughter of a Vidhyā-dhara by Menakā (a sort of antelope). —पृषद्-वल, अस्, m. ‘piebald,’ N. of a horse of Vāyu or Wind; [cf. पृषद्-अश्व।] —पृषद्-वाण, अस्, m. ‘having variegated arrows,’ N. of a man. —पृ-षोदर, अस्, आ, अम् (पृष for पृषत् + उदर), Ved. ‘speckled-bellied,’ having the belly speckled, (see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 3, 109.)
पृषत: पृषत, अस्, आ, अम्, spotted, speckled, having white spots, variegated; (अस्), m. the spotted ante-lope, the porcine deer; a drop of water; a spot, mark; N. of the father of Dru-pada. —पृषताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, m. air, wind (= पृषद्-अश्व).
पृषत्क: पृषत्क, अस्, m. an arrow (so called as being variegated or as being as swift as an antelope).
पृषद्धर: पृषद्धर or पृषध्र, अस्, m. (probably a comp. fr. पृषत् + ध्र), N. of a man the son of Manu and author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 57 (= Vālakhilya 8).
पृषध्रु: पृषध्रु, उस्, m., N. of a warrior on the side of the Pāṇḍavas.
पृषन्ति: पृषन्ति, इस्, m. a drop of water (probably an error for पृषन्ति, n. pl. of पृषत्).
पृषातक: पृषातक, अम्, n. a mixture of ghee and coagu-lated milk or some similar compound; (अस्), m. an epithet of Rudra; (ई), f. a kind of disease or N. of a female demon causing this disease.
पृषोद्यान: पृषोद्यान, अम्, n. (fr. पृष for पृषत् + उद्यान), a small garden or grove.
पृष्ट: 1. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. and 3. see below), sprinkled.

पृष्ट 2. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for स्पृष्ट fr. rt. स्पृश्), Ved. cleaving or adhering to, in contact with (Sāy. = सं-स्पृष्ट, or = नि-षिक्त = नि-हित). —पृष्ट-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. (perhaps) having devoted relatives or attendants; (Sāy.) = स्तो-तॄणाम् बन्धुः, a friend to those who praise him.
पृष्ट 3. पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रछ्), asked, inquired, questioned, interrogated, demanded. —पृष्टाभिधायिन् (°ट-अभ्°), ई, इनी, इ, Ved. an-swering that which is asked, answering an inquiry.
पृषभाषा: पृषभाषा पृष-भाषा, f. = पूष-भासा, q. v.
पृषाकरा: पृषाकरा पृषाकरा, f. a small stone used as a weight.
पृष्टि: पृष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. a rib (= पर्शु); touch; a ray of light. —पृष्टि-वह्, वाट्, m., Ved. carrying on the back (as a horse). —पृष्ट्य्-आमय, अस्, m., Ved. a pain in the side. —पृष्ट्य्-आमयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. feeling a pain in the side.
पृष्ट्वा: पृष्ट्वा, ind. having asked or inquired, having questioned or interrogated.
पृष्टहायन: पृष्टहायन पृष्टहायन, अस्, m. an ele-phant; a species of grain.
पृष्ठ: पृष्ठ पृष्ठ, अम्, n. (probably fr. प्र-स्थ or perhaps fr. परा-स्थ), the back of any animal (as standing out prominently), the back in general (e. g. अश्व-पृष्ठे सम्मतः, admired on horse-back, i. e. a good rider; पृष्ठं दा, to bend the back, make a low obeisance); the hinder part of anything, the rear [cf. सेना-प्°]; the upper side, uppermost part, surface, superficies (e. g. दिवः पृष्ठम्, Ved. the surface of the sky, vault of heaven; cf. घृत-प्°, तृ-प्°, नाक-प्°); the flat roof of a house; a terrace; a page of a book; N. of a particular arrangement of Sāmans employed at the midday oblation, and formed from the Rathan-tara, Bṛhat, Vairūpa, Vairāja, Śākvara, and Raivata Sāmans, (in this sense more usually written as a comp. पृष्ठ-स्तोत्र, q. v.); N. of various Sā-mans; (एन, ए), ind. at the back, behind, from behind. —पृष्ठ-गोप, अस्, m. one who guards or protects the rear of a warrior while fighting. —पृष्ठ-ग्रन्थि, इस्, m. ‘back-knot,’ a hump on the back. —पृष्ठ-घ्न, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पृष्ठ-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. ‘having eyes in the back,’ a crab. —पृष्ठ-ज, अस्, m. a form of Skanda; (also considered as a son of Skanda.) —पृष्ठ-जाह, अम्, n. = पृष्ठस्य मूलम्, ‘the root of the back,’ (probably) os coccygis; [cf. जाह।] —पृष्ठ-तल्पन, अम्, n. the exterior muscles on an elephant's back (= तल्पन). —पृष्-ठ-दृष्टि, इस्, m. ‘looking backwards,’ a bear. —पृष्ठ-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being behind the back of a person, following, observing, controlling. —पृष्ठ-फल, अम्, n. the superficial contents of a figure. —पृष्ठ-भङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘breaking or bending the back,’ epithet of a mode of fighting. —पृष्ठ-भाग, अस्, m. the hinder part, back. —पृष्ठ-मध्य, अस्, m. the middle of the back. —पृष्ठ-मांस, अम्, n. the flesh on the back; पृष्ठमांसं खाद् or भक्ष्, ‘to eat the flesh of a person's back,’ i. e. to speak ill of any one behind his back. —पृष्ठमांसाद (°स-अद°) or पृष्ठमांसादन (°स-अद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘eating the flesh of the back,’ backbiting, speaking ill of a person behind his back, a backbiter, tale-bearer, slanderer; (अम्), n. backbiting. —पृष्ठ-यज्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one who sacrifices on high places (Sāy. = रथन्तर-बृहद्-आदिभिर् ईजान). —पृष्ठ-यान, अम्, n. ‘going on the back (of a horse &c.), riding; (अस्, आ, अम्), an animal for riding, riding horse. —पृष्ठ-रक्ष, अस्, m. one who covers the rear of a warrior while fighting; [cf. पृष्ठ-गोप।] —पृष्ठ-रक्षण, अम्, n. protection or defence of the back. —पृष्ठ-वंश, अस्, m. the back-bone. —पृष्ठ-वास्तु, उ, n. an upper story, the upper room of a building. —पृष्ठ-वाह्, ट्, m. (f. पृष्ठौही, see Gram. 182. c), a draught-ox, an ox employed for draught, (also read प्रष्ठ-वाह् and पष्ठ-वाह्); ‘borne on the back,’ riding. —पृष्ठ-वाह्य, अस्, m. a draught-ox, an ox carrying burdens. —पृष्ठ-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, lying or sleeping on the back. —पृष्ठ-शृङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘having horns over the back,’ a wild goat. —पृष्ठ-शृङ्गिन्, ई, m. a ram; a buffalo; a eunuch; an epithet of Bhīma-sena. —पृष्ठ-स्तोत्र, अम्, n., N. of a particular arrangement of Sāmans (= पृष्ठ, q. v.). —पृष्-ठानुग (°ठ-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, or पृष्ठानु-गामिन् (°ठ-अन्°), ई, इनी, इ, going behind, following (opposed to अग्र-ग). —पृष्ठास्थि (°ठ-अस्°), इ, n. the back-bone. —पृष्ठे-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the face in the back. —पृष्ठोदय (°ठ-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘rising from behind,’ an epithet of the signs of the zodiac, Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Sagittarius, and Capricorn.
पृष्ठक: पृष्ठक, अम्, n. the back; पृष्ठके कृ, to place behind, postpone; to resign, renounce.
पृष्ठतस्: पृष्ठ-तस्, ind. from the back, from behind, behind the back, at the back, behind (with gen.); to the back, backwards; on the back; behind the back, secretly, covertly; पृष्ठतः कृ, to place on the back (e. g. पर्वतम् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा, having placed the mountain on his back); to place behind the back, neglect, forsake, abandon; to re-sign, renounce, desist from; पृष्ठतो गम्, to go at the back, follow, pursue; पृष्ठतो भू, to be behind, i. e. to be disregarded, to be an object of indifference.
पृष्ठ्य: पृष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, relating or belonging to the back; belonging to or coming from the heights (Ved., e. g. पृष्ठ्यम् पयः, ‘milk from the heights,’ i. e. Soma, or according to Sāy. = धार-कम् पयः, sustaining milk); forming the Pṛṣṭha hymns (Ved.); having the Pṛṣṭha hymns (said of a particular period of six sacrificial days, Ved.); (अस्), m. with or without अश्व, a horse for riding or for draught, a pack-horse; (अस्, अम्), m. n. = पृष्ठा-नां समूहः [cf. Pāṇ. IV. 2, 42] = स्तोत्राणां समूहः (Ujjvala-datta on Uṇādi-s. II. 12); (आ), f. with or without अश्वा, a mare for riding or for draught; an edge or ridge along the back of the Vedi (Ved.). —पृष्ठ्य-स्तोम, अस्, m., Ved., N. of six Ekāhas or of a period of six sacrificial days. —पृष्ठ्यावलम्ब (°य-अव्°), अस्, m., Ved., scil. पञ्चाह, a period of five sacrificial days.
पृष्णि: पृष्णि पृष्णि, इस्, इस्, इ, small, short, or thin (= पृश्नि); (इस्), f. the heel (= पार्ष्णि); a ray of light (= पृश्नि).
पृष्णिपर्णी: पृष्णिपर्णी पृष्णि-पर्णी, f. a wrong read-ing for पृश्नि-पर्णी, q. v.
पृष्वा: पृष्वा पृष्वा, incorrectly for प्रुष्वा, q. v.
पॄ: पॄ पॄ [cf. rts. 1. and 2. पृ, पृण्], cl. 9. and 3. P. (Ved. also A.) पृणाति (-णीते), पिपर्ति (3rd du. पिपृतस् or पिपूर्तस्, Vopa-deva X. 5), पपार (3rd du. पपरतुस् or पप्रतुस्, 3rd pl. पपरुस् or पप्रुस्, Pāṇ. VII. 4, 12), परिष्यति, परीष्यति, अपारीत्, Prec. पूर्यात्, प-रितुम्, परीतु (Ved. forms, Impf. 3rd sing. A. अपिप्रत, Impv. 2nd sing. पूर्धि, Aor. पर्षि, पर्षत्, पारिषत्; irregular Impv. 2nd sing. A. पिपीपृहि?), to fill, fill up; to fulfil; to sate, satisfy, refresh (e. g. पितॄन् अपारीत्, he satisfied or refreshed the Manes); to cherish, nourish, nurture, foster, rear, bring up; to protect; to bestow bounti-fully, grant abundantly, give plentifully, lavish (with acc. of the thing and dat. of the person, Ved.); to collect, accumulate; (A.) to fill or sate one's self; cl. 4. A. (properly Pass. but ep. also P.), पूर्यते (-ति), Aor. अपूरि, अपूरिष्ट, to be filled, become full, to be fulfilled; to be sated or satisfied; Caus. पारयति, -यितुम् [cf. Caus. of rt. 1. पृ], to fill, fulfil (Ved.); पूरयति, -ते, -यितुम् (sometimes regarded as derived fr. a separate rt. पूर्, q. v.), to fill, fill up, replenish; to fulfil (a wish, hope, promise, &c.); to make full, fill out, intensify, strengthen (a sound); to fill with wind, blow, wind (a conch-shell or other wind instrument); to draw (a bow, or an arrow to the ear); to cover completely, cover up, surround, envelop; to load or enrich (with gifts); to spend the whole (of a period of time): Desid. पिपरिषति, पिपरीषति, पुपूर्षति, पु-पूर्षते: Intens. पोपूर्यते, पापर्ति, पोपूर्ति; [cf. rt. 1. प्रा, 3. पुर्, पुर, पुरु, पुलु: Zend par, ‘fill;’ perena, ‘full:’ Gr. πί-μ-πλη-μι, πλή-θ-ω, πλέ-ω-ς, πλή-ρ-ης, πλη-θ-ύ-ς, πλῆ-θ-ος, πλοῦ-το-ς: Lat. im-ple-o, plē-nu-s, plē-be-s, pŏ-pul-u-s, multus said to be for pūrtas, am-plu-s: Goth. full-s, ‘full;’ fullo, ‘fulness;’ full-yan, ‘to fill:’ Old Germ. fol, folc: Angl. Sax. fyll-an: Mod. Germ. voll = Eng. full: Slav. plŭ-nŭ, ‘full;’ plŭ-kŭ, ‘people;’ ple-me, ‘a tribe:’ Lith. pil-ti, ‘to fill;’ pī1l-na-s, ‘full;’ pùl-ka-s, ‘crowd:’ Hib. pailt, ‘abundant, plentiful, copious.’]
पेचक: पेचक पेचक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पच्), an owl; the tip or the root of an elephant's tail; a couch, bed; a louse; a cloud; (इका), f. a kind of owl.
पेचकिन्: पेचकिन्, ई, m. an elephant; (also read पिचकिन्।)
पेचु: पेचु पेचु, उ, n. or पेचुली, f. a species of bul-bous plant with esculent roots, Colocasia Antiquorum.
पेज: पेज पेज in तिल-पेज, q. v.; (आ), f. = पेया।
पेञ्जूष: पेञ्जूष पेञ्जूष, अस्, m. the wax of the ear (= पिञ्जूष).
पेट: पेट पेट, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, m. f. n. (said to be fr. rt. पिट्, q. v.), a basket, a large basket, bag; a chest; a multitude; a retinue; (अस्), m. the open hand with the fingers expanded (= प्र-हस्त).
पेटक: पेटक, अस्, इका, अम्, m. f. n. [cf. पिटक], a basket for holding clothes, books, &c.; (अम्), n. multitude, company, quantity; (इका), f. a species of plant (= कुलिङ्गाक्षी, कुवेराक्षी, कृष्ण-वृन्-तिका).
पेडा: पेडा, f. a basket, large basket (= पेटा, for which it is perhaps only a wrong reading).
पेट्टिभट्ट: पेट्टिभट्ट पेट्टि-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of a man the father of the commentator Viśveśvara.
पेढाल: पेढाल पेढाल, अस्, m., N. of the eighth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī.
पेण्: पेण् पेण् [cf. rts. पैण्, प्रैण्, लैण्], cl. 1. P. पेणति, &c., to go; to send (?); to grind (?); to embrace.
पेत्व: पेत्व पेत्व, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पा?), a ram, sheep (Ved.); a small part; (अम्), n. nectar, Amṛta; ghee or clarified butter.
पेदु: पेदु पेदु, उस्, m., Ved., N. of a man (under the especial protection of the Aśvins, by whom he was presented with a white horse that killed serpents).
पेपीयमान: पेपीयमान पेपीयमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. In-tens. of rt. 1. पा), drinking repeatedly.
पेब्: पेब् पेब्, cl. 1. A. पेबते, a various reading for rt. सेव्, q. v.
पेय: पेय पेय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पा), to be drunk or quaffed, fit to be drunk, drinkable, potable; tastable, sapid; (अस्), m., scil. यज्ञ-क्रतु, a drink offering, libation (Ved.); (आ), f. rice gruel; any drink with a small quantity of boiled rice; the decoction of anything after straining; a species of anise, = मिश्रेया; (अम्), n. a drink, beverage.
पेरु: 1. पेरु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) drinking; (उस्), m. the sun; fire; the ocean; the golden mountain.
पेरु 2. पेरु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. 1. पृ; for 1. पेरु see above), Ved. drawing through, carrying across; leading through, delivering, rescuing; (Sāy. = पूरक, as if fr. rt. पॄ।)
पेरु 3. पेरु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. प्यै), Ved. swelling; causing to ferment; (Sāy. = सर्वस्य रक्षक, as if fr. rt. 3. पा); (उस्), m. a limb, member (?).
पेयूष: पेयूष पेयूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (= पीयूष, q. v), the milk of a cow that has calved within seven days, biestings; fresh butter; nectar, Amṛta.
पेरज: पेरज पेरज, or पेरोज, अम्, n. a turquoise (= Pers. فيروزه).
पेरा: पेरा पेरा, f. a kind of musical instrument.
पेरुक: पेरुक पेरुक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
पेल्: पेल् पेल्, cl. 1. 10. P. पेलति, पेलितुम्, पेलयति, -यितुम्, to go, move.
पेल: पेल, अस्, m. going; a small part; (अम्), n. a testicle.
पेलव: पेलव, अस्, आ, अम्, delicate, fine, soft, tender; thin, slim, slender. —पेलव-पुष्प, अम्, n. a tender flower.
पेलि: पेलि, (perhaps) = पेलिन्, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. VI. 2, 86.
पेलिन्: पेलिन्, ई, m. a horse. —पेलि-शाला, f. a horse-stable.
पेलोज: पेलोज पेलोज, अस्, m., N. of one of the attendants of Śiva.
पेव्: पेव् पेव् [cf. rt. पेब्], cl. 1. A. पेवते, पेवितुम्, a various reading for rt. सेव्, q. v.
पेश: पेश पेश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पिश्), Ved. = पेशस्, q. v.; [cf. पुरु-प्°।]
पेशन: पेशन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. well formed, well made; decorated, adorned.
पेशल: पेशल, अस्, आ, अम्, artificially formed, adorned, decorated; beautiful, charming, lovely, pleasant; soft, smooth, tender; skilful, dexterous, expert, clever, ingenious; fraudulent, deceitful, crafty; (अम्), n. beauty, loveliness; [cf. Gr. ποικ-ίλο-ς, ποικἰλλ-ω: Lat. ping-o, pic-tor, pic-tura: Old Germ. feh, ‘variegated:’ Slav. pĭstrŭ, ‘variegated;’ pis-ati, ‘to write:’ Lith. pisz-nu-s, ‘splendid.’] —पेशल-त्व, अम्, n. dexterity, skill. —पेशल-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, slender-waisted, having a delicate or slender waist.
पेशस्: पेशस्, अस्, n., Ved. shape, form; an artificial figure, ornament, decoration, embroidery; variety of colour, brilliance; gold; [cf. अश्व-प्°, ऋत-प्°।] —पेशस्-कारी, f., Ved. a woman who weaves artistically or embroiders. —पेशस्-कृत्, त्, m. ‘the artist,’ an epi-thet of the hand; a species of insect, a kind of wasp. —पेशस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. decorated, adorned, ornamented.
पेशि: पेशि, इस्, m. a thunderbolt (for पेषि); (इस्), f. an egg; split pease.
पेशिका: पेशिका, f. (fr. पेशी), rind, shell (of fruit).
पेशितृ: पेशितृ, ता, m., Ved. one who cuts in pieces or carves, a carver.
पेशी: पेशी, f. a piece of flesh or meat [cf. पिशित]; a ball or mass of flesh; the fetus shortly after con-ception; a muscle (of which there are said to be five hundred in the human body); the peel or rind (of fruit); a kind of drum; a sheath, scabbard; a shoe; the egg of a bird; spikenard, Valeriana Jatamansi; a blown bud; N. of a Piśācī; of a Rākṣasī; of a river. —पेशी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to cut into pieces, to carve. —पेशी-कोश or पेशी-कोष, अस्, m. a bird's egg. —पेश्य्-अण्ड, अम्, n. a bird's egg; a piece of flesh; the fetus shortly after conception.
पेश्वर: पेश्वर, अस्, आ, अम् (? for पेष्वर fr. rt. पिष्), who or what grinds.
पेष्: पेष् पेष् [cf. rt. येष्], cl. 1. A. पेषते, पेषितुम्, to exert one's self or strive diligently.
पेष: पेष पेष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पिष्), pounding, grinding; [cf. शिला-प्°।]
पेषक: पेषक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who pounds or grinds, a grinder, grinding, pounding, pulverizing, masti-cating.
पेषण: पेषण, अम्, n. pounding, grinding, crushing, triturating, pulverizing by means of a mill, (पेषणं या, to be ground); a threshing-floor; a hand-mill, a stone and muller, any apparatus for grinding or pounding; a plant, a species of Euphorbia with three lobes, Euphorbia Antiquorum (= शत-गुप्ता, Ben-gālī तेकाटोसिज). —पेषण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, a word formed for the explanation of पिपिष्वत्।
पेषणि: पेषणि, इस्, ई, f. a stone slab on which condi-ments are ground, a muller, mill-stone, grind-stone.
पेषणीय: पेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ground or pounded, fit to be ground or pulverized.
पेषाक: पेषाक, अस्, m. a small slab for grinding anything upon, a grind-stone.
पेष्टृ: पेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who pounds or crushes, one who grinds, a grinder.
पेष्य: पेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pounded or ground, to be triturated or pulverized.
पेषल: पेषल पेषल, अस्, आ, अम्, = पेशल, q. v.
पेषी: पेषी पेषी, f., Ved. (according to Sāy.) = हिंसिका, पिशाचिका, a malevolent spirit, female Pi-śāca; (perhaps) a nurse; spikenard (in this sense a various reading for पेशी, q. v.). —पेषी-कृ, a various reading for पेशी-कृ, q. v.
पेष्ट्र: पेष्ट्र पेष्ट्र, अम्, n. (perhaps fr. rt. 1. पिश्), Ved. a bone.
पेस्: पेस् पेस् (= rt. पिस्), cl. 1. P. पेसति, पेसितुम्, to go, move.
पेसुक: पेसुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. पिस्), Ved. spreading, extending.
पेस्वर: पेस्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving; destructive; splendid.
पै: पै पै, cl. 1. P. पायति, पायितुम्, to dry, wither.
पैङ्ग: पैङ्ग पैङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिङ्ग), belong-ing or relating to a rat or mouse; derived from or composed by Paiṅgya (as a book); acknowledged by the Paiṅgins; (अम्), n., N. of a work; (अस्), m., N. of a teacher (in this sense perhaps a wrong reading for पैङ्ग्य). —पैङ्ग-राज, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of bird.
पैङ्गि: पैङ्गि, इस्, m. (fr. पिङ्ग), a patronymic of Yāska.
पैङ्गिन्: पैङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, derived from Paiṅgya; (ई), m. a follower of Paiṅgya.
पैङ्ग्य: पैङ्ग्य, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. पिङ्ग), N. of a teacher; (अम्), n. the doctrine or the manual of Paiṅgya. —पैङ्गी-पुत्र, अस्, m. (fr. पैङ्गी, f. of पैङ्ग्य, + पुत्र), Ved., N. of a teacher.
पैङ्गल: पैङ्गल पैङ्गल, आस्, m. pl. a patronymic from Piṅgala.
पैङ्गलायन: पैङ्गलायन, अस्, or पैङ्गलायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Piṅgala.
पैङ्गल्य: पैङ्गल्य, अम्, n. the treatise of Piṅgala; brown or tawny colour.
पैच्छिल्य: पैच्छिल्य पैच्छिल्य, अम्, n. (fr. पिच्छिल), sliminess, mucilaginousness.
पैजवन: पैजवन पैजवन, अस्, m. (fr. पिजवन), a patronymic of Su-dās.
पैञ्जूष: पैञ्जूष पैञ्जूष, अस्, m. the ear; [cf. पिञ्-जूष, पेञ्जूष।]
पैटकिक: पैटकिक पैटकिक or पैटाकिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पिटाकेन हरति, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 15.
पैठर: पैठर पैठर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिठर), cooked in a saucepan, boiled in a vessel or pot (as meat &c.).
पैठीनसि: पैठीनसि पैठीनसि, इस्, or पैठीनस्, आस्, m. patronymic of an ancient teacher, a Muni and author of a system of laws.
पैण्: पैण् पैण् [cf. rts. पेण्, लैण्, प्रैण्], cl. 1. P. पैणति, पैणितुम्, to go, approach; to command, direct (an act); to send; to touch or embrace; to pound, grind.
पैण्डपातिक: पैण्डपातिक पैण्डपातिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिण्ड-पात), living on alms.
पैण्डायन: पैण्डायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Piṇḍa.
पैण्डिन्य: पैण्डिन्य, अम्, n. (fr. पिण्डिन्), living on alms, mendicity.
पैतदारव: पैतदारव पैतदारव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पीत-दारु), see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 154.
पैतापुत्रीय: पैतापुत्रीय पैतापुत्रीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-पुत्र), relating to father and son.
पैतामह: पैतामह पैतामह, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-मह), belonging or relating to a paternal grand-father; derived or inherited from a grandfather; belonging or relating to Brahmā, derived from Brahmā, governed or presided over by Brahmā; (अस्), m. a son of Brahmā, a patronymic of Manu; (आस्), m. pl. forefathers, ancestors. —पैतामह-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
पैतामहिक: पैतामहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिता-मह), be-longing or relating to a grandfather.
पैतृक: पैतृक पैतृक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belong-ing or relating to a father or to ancestors generally, coming or derived from a father, paternal, ancestral; belonging or relating to the Manes, sacred to the Manes; (अम्), n. a sacred rite or Śrāddha in honour of the Manes or deceased ancestors. —पैतृक-धन, अम्, n. ancestral property, patrimony. —पै-तृक-भूमि, इस्, f. the country of one's ancestors, fatherland; a paternal estate.
पैतृमत्य: पैतृमत्य, अस्, m. (fr. पितृ-मत्), sprung from one who has an illustrious father, the grandson of an illustrious man.
पैतृयज्ञिक: पैतृयज्ञिक, Ved. or पैतृयज्ञीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ-यज्ञ), belonging or relating to a sacrifice to the Manes.
पैतृष्वसेय: पैतृष्वसेय or पैतृष्वस्रीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ-ष्वसृ), sprung from a father's sister or paternal aunt; (अस्), m. a father's sister's son, the son of a paternal aunt; (ई), f. a father's sister's daughter, the daughter of a paternal aunt (see Manu XI. 171).
पैत्र: पैत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belonging or re-lating to a father or to ancestors generally, paternal, ancestral; belonging or relating to the Manes, sacred or consecrated to the Manes; (अम्), n. the part of the hand between the thumb and fore-finger, (ac-cording to others) the root of the fore-finger [cf. पितृ-तीर्थ]; a year or month or day of the Pitṛs. —पैत्राहोरात्र (°र-अह्°), अस्, m. a day and night of the Pitṛs or progenitors (= one month).
पैत्रिक: पैत्रिक = पैतृक (for which it is probably an incorrect form).
पैत्र्य: पैत्र्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पितृ), belonging or re-lating to the Manes.
पैत्त: पैत्त पैत्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पित्त), relating to the bilious humor, proceeding from bile, bilious.
पैत्तिक: पैत्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, bilious, of a bilious tem-perament.
पैत्तल: पैत्तल पैत्तल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पित्तल), made of brass, brazen.
पैड्व: पैड्व पैद्व, अस्, m., Ved. scil. अश्व, the horse of Pedu said to be a serpent-killer (Ṛg-veda IX. 88, 4).
पैनाक: पैनाक पैनाक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिनाकिन्), belonging to or coming from Rudra-Śiva; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Pināka.
पैप्पल: पैप्पल पैप्पल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिप्पल), made of the wood of the holy fig-tree.
पैप्पलाद: पैप्पलाद, अस्, ई, अम्, derived from Pippalāda; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a school.
पैप्पलादक: पैप्पलादक, अस्, ई, अम्, peculiar to or taught by Pippalāda or Paippalāda; (अम्), n. the treatise or text of Pippalāda.
पैप्पलादि: पैप्पलादि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pippa-lāda; N. of a teacher.
पैयवन: पैयवन पैयवन, an incorrect form for पैजवन, q. v.
पैयूष: पैयूष पैयूष, अम्, n. = पीयूष, q. v.
पैल: पैल पैल, अस्, m. a metronymic from Pīlā; N. of a teacher (a sage and promulgator of the Ṛg-veda). —पैल-गर्ग, अस्, m., N. of a man. —पैल-गर्भ, अस्, m. ‘offspring of Paila,’ N. of a man.
पैलेय: पैलेय, अस्, m. a metronymic from Pīlā.
पैलव: पैलव पैलव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पीलु), made of the wood of the Pīlu tree (as the staff borne by a Vaiśya, Manu II. 45).
पैशल्य: पैशल्य पैशल्य, अम्, n. (fr. पेशल), kind-liness, graciousness, affability, mildness.
पैशाच: पैशाच पैशाच, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or be-longing to a Piśāca or kind of demon, infernal, demoniacal; पैशाचो ग्रहः, demoniacal possession; (अस्), m. the eighth and lowest from of marriage, one of the eight forms of marriage according to Manu (described in Manu III. 34 as taking place when a lover secretly embraces a damsel either sleeping or intoxicated or disordered in her intellect); a Piśāca or kind of demon; (ई), f. a present made at a religious ceremony to secure friendly regard; a sort of gibberish spoken by demons on the stage [cf. पि-शाच-भाषा]; night; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
पैशाचिक: पैशाचिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to a Piśāca or kind of demon, infernal, demoniacal.
पैशुन: पैशुन पैशुन or पैशुन्य, अम्, n. (fr. पि-शुन), the act of informing or giving information, tale-bearing, backbiting, calumny, espionage, report-ing evil of others, malignity, roguery, depravity, wickedness.
पैष्ट: पैष्ट पैष्ट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिष्ट), made of flour, ground or made up into a cake; (ई), f. spirituous liquor distilled from meal or extracted from bruised rice.
पैष्टिक: पैष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिष्ट), made of meal or flour; (अम्), n. a quantity of cakes; spirituous liquor distilled from meal.
पोगण्ड: पोगण्ड पोगण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, not full-grown or adult, young; deformed, deficient in a member; having a redundant member; (अस्), m. a boy, one from his fifth to his sixteenth year; [cf. अ-प्°।]
पौगण्ड: पौगण्ड, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to a boy, boyish; (अम्), n. boyhood (a period lasting from the fifth to the tenth year).
पोट: पोट पोट, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. पुट्), the foundation of a house [cf. पोत]; putting to-gether, uniting, mixing; (आ), f. a woman with a beard; a hermaphrodite; a female servant or slave; (ई), f. the rectum; a large alligator. —पोट-गल, अस्, m. a species of reed, Arundo Tibialis; a kind of grass, Saccharum Spontaneum; a fish.
पोटाय: पोटाय, Nom. A. पोटायते, &c., = पोटां कृ।
पोटलक: पोटलक पोटलक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), or पोटलिका, f. a bundle or packet.
पोटिक: पोटिक पोटिक, अस्, m. a boil.
पोट्टिल: पोट्टिल पोट्टिल, अस्, m. (with Jainas) N. of the ninth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī.
पोडु: पोडु पोडु, उस्, m. the parietal bone, the bone forming the upper part of the skull.
पोत: पोत पोत, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पू, but probably fr. a lost rt. पु, ‘to beget’), the young of any animal [cf. मृग-प्°]; a colt, foal; a young elephant ten years old; a young plant or tree, the young shoot of a plant; a fetus which has no enveloping mem-brane; cloth, a garment; the foundation of a house [cf. पोट]; the site of a house or dwelling; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a vessel, ship, boat; [cf. पुत्र, २। पुंस्; Gr. πῶλο-ς for ποϝ-λο-ς, πωλ-ίο-ν, πά-ϊ(δ)ς for παϝ-ι(δ)ς, πο-ία, πό-α, perhaps ποιέ-ω fr. a form ποιο as in παιδο-ποιό-ς; Lat. pullu-s, Marci-por, pu-er for pov-er, pu-era, pu-su-s, pusa, pū-pu-s, pū-pa, pūpilla, pu-tu-s, pūbes, pum-ilu-s, pumil-io, prœ-pu-tiu-m, pō-mu-m for pov-mu-m, pa-pav-er; Goth. fula (n), fula = Old Germ. folo = Eng. foal; Lith. pauta-s, ‘an egg.’] —पोत-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced or de-veloped from a fetus which has no enveloping mem-brane (said of elephants and certain other quadrupeds, as opposed to men, cattle, &c., which are called जरायु-ज). —पोत-धारिन्, ई, m. a ship-owner, master of a vessel. —पोत-प्लव, अस्, m., Ved. ‘floating in a ship,’ a seaman, mariner. —पोत-बणिज्, क्, m. ‘ship-merchant,’ a voyaging merchant, sea-faring trader. —पोत-भङ्ग, अस्, m. shipwreck. —पोत-रक्ष, अस्, m. ‘ship-governing,’ a large paddle used for a rudder, the rudder of a boat. —पोत-वाह, अस्, m. ‘boat-conductor,’ a rower, boatman, steersman, one of the crew who keeps watch at the mast-head. —पोताच्छादन (°त-आच्°), अम्, n. ‘cloth-covering,’ a tent. —पोता-धान (°त-आध्°), अम्, n. small fry, a shoal of young fish.
पोतक: पोतक, अस्, m. the young of any animal; a young plant or tree (e. g. चूत-पोतक, a young mango-tree); N. of a Nāga; the site or foundation of a house [cf. गृह-प्°]; (इका), f. a kind of vegetable, Basella Lucida or Rubra; Anethum Sowa, = शत-पुष्पा; (अकी), f. Basella Lucida or Rubra; a kind of bird, Turdus Macrourus (= श्यामा).
पोतल: पोतल, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a sea-port on the Indus (the Παράλα of the ancients); N. of the residence of the Dalai Lama in Lhassa (also called पोतरक).
पोतलक: पोतलक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a moun-tain (= पोतल?). —पोतलक-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘fond of the mountain Potalaka,’ N. of a Buddha; of a Jina or deified teacher of the Jainas.
पोतु: पोतु, उस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पू), = मानभाण्ड-शोधक।
पोतृ: पोतृ, ता, m. ‘the purifier,’ an epithet of one of the sixteen officiating priests (ऋत्व्-इज्) at a sacrifice, the assistant of the Brahman, (Sāy. = पोतृ-नाम-कर्त्विज् or यज्ञस्य शोधयितृ); an epithet of Viṣṇu.
पोत्या: पोत्या, f. = पोतानां समूहः, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 49.
पोत्र: पोत्र, अम्, n. the Soma vessel of the Potṛ, the office of the Potṛ, (Sāy. = पोत्रा कृतं कर्म, पोतुर् यज्ञः); a ship, boat [cf. पोत]; the snout of a hog; a ploughshare; a dress, garment (?); a thunderbolt (?). —पोत्र-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘snout-orb,’ the round snout (of a hog &c.). —पोत्रा-युध (°र-आय्°), अस्, m. ‘armed with a snout,’ a hog, boar.
पोत्रिन्: पोत्रिन्, ई, m. a hog, boar. —पोत्रि-दंष्ट्रा-ज, अस्, m. ‘produced in the tusk of a boar,’ a kind of gem supposed to be found in the tusk of a boar. —पोत्रि-रथा, f. ‘hog-vehicled,’ (with Buddhists) an epithet of Māyā; (with Jainas) N. of a Śakti or female divinity.
पोत्रीय: पोत्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating or belonging to the Potṛ.
पोपुव: पोपुव, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. Intens. of rt. 1. पू), purifying or cleansing much or repeatedly.
पौतिक: पौतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, connected with a boat (as a cargo &c.).
पोताल: पोताल पोताल, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman; a wrong reading for पोतल, p. 598, col. 3.
पोतास: पोतास पोतास, अस्, m. a species of camphor; [cf. Eng. potash.]
पोतिमत्सक: पोतिमत्सक पोतिमत्सक, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
पोथकी: पोथकी पोथकी, f. a kind of ulcer on the eyelids, red pimples on the eyelids.
पोथिक: पोथिक पोथिक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), in अव-प्°, a machine for hurling down stones, fire-brands, and fiery darts upon the enemy, a kind of ballista (?); [cf. सोल्कालातावपोथिक।]
पोयालदह: पोयालदह पोयालदह, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a tank or pool.
पोर: पोर पोर, अस्, m. in नील-प्°, q. v.
पोल: पोल पोल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पुल्), magnitude, bulk; a heap, quantity.
पोलिका: पोलिका पोलिका, f. flat cakes made of barley or wheat, &c.; [cf. पूलिका, पौली, पूपाली।]
पोली: पोली, f. a kind of cake.
पोलिन्द: पोलिन्द पोलिन्द, अस्, m. the mast or the ribs of a ship or boat; [cf. पदार, पादारक, पादालिन्द।]
पोविय: पोविय पोविय, अस्, m., N. of the father of the commentator Gaṅga-dāsa.
पोष: पोष पोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पुष्), thriving, growth, increase; welfare, prosperity, plenty, abun-dance; nourishing, cherishing; maintaining, sup-porting.
पोषक: पोषक, अस्, m. one who feeds or nourishes; a nourisher, supporter, breeder, keeper.
पोषण: पोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, nourishing, cherishing [cf. पक्ष-प्°]; bringing up, breeding; (अम्), n. the act of nourishing, cherishing, fostering, supporting.
पोषणीय: पोषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cherished or pro-tected, to be nourished.
पोषयितृ: पोषयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, nourishing, cherishing, one who breeds or rears.
पोषयित्नु: पोषयित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, causing to grow, nourish-ing, cherishing (Ved.); (उस्), m. (according to a Scholiast) the Koïl or Kokila or Indian cuckoo; (probably) a crow.
पोषयिष्णु: पोषयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. causing to thrive, nourishing, causing prosperity or welfare, advan-tageous.
पोषित: पोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, nourished, cherished, fostered, supported.
पोषितव्य: पोषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cherished or pro-tected.
पोषितृ: पोषितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, nourishing, feeding; one who breeds or rears.
पोषिन्: पोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, nourishing, bringing up, rearing.
पोषुक: पोषुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. prospering, growing.
पोष्टृ: पोष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a nourisher, cherisher, one who brings up; (टा), m. a protector, nourisher, cherisher; grey bonduc. —पोष्टृ-वर, अस्, आ, अम्, the best of nourishers, nourishing best.
पोष्य: पोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, well-fed, thriving; causing welfare or prosperity, prosperous; to be nourished or cherished, to be taken care of, to be fed, to be brought up; copious. —पोष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being one who is to be cherished; being taken care of. —पोष्य-पुत्र or पोष्य-पुत्रक, अस्, m. ‘a son to be brought up,’ an adopted son. —पोष्यपुत्र-करण, अम्, n. adoption. —पोष्य-वर्ग, अस्, m. a class of persons or objects to be cherished, as parents, children, guests, and the sacred fire; a family, house-hold. —पोष्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. causing pros-perity; (Sāy. = बहु-पोष्य-जन-युक्त।)
पोषध: पोषध पोषध, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) renewal of religious vows.
पोषधिक: पोषधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) one who renews religious vows.
पौंश्चलीय: पौंश्चलीय पौंश्चलीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुंश्-चली), belonging or relating to harlots, meretricious.
पौंश्चलेय: पौंश्चलेय, अस्, m., Ved. the son of a harlot.
पौंश्चल्य: पौंश्चल्य, अम्, n. female incontinency, harlotry.
पौंसवन: पौंसवन पौंसवन, अम्, n. (fr. पुं-स-वन), one of the Saṃskāras or essential ceremonies of the Hindū religion; a religious observance held when signs of a living conception take place (in order to obtain male offspring).
पौंस्न: पौंस्न पौंस्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. पुंस्), worthy of or fit for a man; relating to or good for man; manly, virile; human; (अम्), n. manhood, manly strength.
पौंस्य: पौंस्य, अम्, n., Ved. manhood, virility, manly power; the courage or virtue of a man, a manly deed (Sāy. = बल); (अस्, &c.), masculine.
पौञ्जिष्ठ: पौञ्जिष्ठ पौञ्जिष्ठ or पौञ्जिष्ट (?), अस्, m., Ved. (= पुञ्जिष्ठ), a fisherman; (आस्), m. pl. a patronymic.
पौण्डरीक: पौण्डरीक पौण्डरीक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुण्ड-रीक), consisting of lotus-flowers; (अस्), m. a kind of Soma sacrifice lasting twelve days (Ved.); a pa-tronymic of Kṣema-dhṛtvan; (अम्), n., scil. कुष्-ठ, a kind of leprosy; a species of plant (= प्र-पौण्डरीक). —पौण्डरीक-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a ritual work containing the prayers used at the Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice.
पौण्डर्य: पौण्डर्य पौण्डर्य, अम्, n. a kind of drug used as a remedy for diseased eyes (= पुण्डर्य, q. v.).
पौण्ड्र: पौण्ड्र पौण्ड्र, अस्, m. (fr. पुण्ड्र), a species of sugar-cane of a pale straw colour; N. of a country (said to include part of South Behar and Bengal); N. of a king of this country (regarded as a son of Vasu-deva); N. of the conch-shell of Bhīṣma; a mark, sectarial mark; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, the inhabitants of the Pauṇḍra country.
पौण्ड्रक: पौण्ड्रक, अस्, ई, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) = पौण्ड्र; (अस्), m. the pale straw-coloured species of sugar-cane; epithet of a particular mixed caste of hereditary sugar-boilers, (the son of a Vaiśya by a woman of the distiller class; regarded as one of the degraded races of Kṣatriyas, Manu X. 44); a king of the Pauṇḍras; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, the Pauṇḍras.
पौण्ड्रनागर: पौण्ड्रनागर, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 3, 24.
पौण्ड्रमात्स्यक: पौण्ड्रमात्स्यक, अस्, m. (probably) a king of the Puṇḍras and Matsyas.
पौण्ड्रवत्स: पौण्ड्रवत्स, आस्, m. pl. (fr. पुण्ड्र + वत्स), N. of a school.
पौण्ड्रवर्धन: पौण्ड्रवर्धन, अम्, n., N. of a city, = पुण्ड्र-वर्धन; (अस्), m., N. of a country, one of the divisions of central India, Behar.
पौण्ड्रिक: पौण्ड्रिक, अस्, m. a pale straw-coloured variety of the sugar-cane; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
पौण्य: पौण्य पौण्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुण्य), up-right, righteous, virtuous, deserving good treatment.
पौतन: पौतन पौतन (perhaps fr. पूतना), N. of a country or people.
पौतव: पौतव पौतव, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पू), a measure; (also spelt यौतव।)
पौतिकी: पौतिकी पौतिकी, f. = पूतिका, a kind of vegetable.
पौतिनासिक्य: पौतिनासिक्य पौतिनासिक्य, अम्, n. (fr. पूति-नासिका), fetor of the nostrils.
पौतिमाषीपुत्र: पौतिमाषीपुत्र पौतिमाषी-पुत्र, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a teacher.
पौतिमाष्य: पौतिमाष्य, अस्, m., Ved. (a patronymic fr. पूति-माष), N. of a teacher.
पौतिमाष्यायण: पौतिमाष्यायण, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from Pautimāṣya.
पौत्तिक: पौत्तिक पौत्तिक, अम्, n. (fr. पुत्तिका), scil. मधु, the honey of the small bee called पुत्तिका; pale-coloured honey.
पौत्र: पौत्र 1. पौत्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुत्र), de-rived from a son or from children, belonging or relating to a son or to children; (अस्), m. a son's son, grandson; (ई), f. a granddaughter (either in the male or female line, though more usually implying a son's daughter); an epithet of Durgā.
पौत्र 2. पौत्र, अम्, n. (fr. पोतृ, q. v.), Ved. the office of the Potṛ.
पौत्रजीविक: पौत्रजीविक, अम्, n. (fr. पुत्र-जीव), an amulet made of the nuts of the tree Putranjiva Roxburghii.
पौत्राघ: पौत्राघ (°र-अघ°), अम्, n., Ved. any injury or evil happening to children.
पौत्राद्य: पौत्राद्य, perhaps a wrong reading for the pre-ceding.
पौत्रायण: पौत्रायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pautra.
पौत्रिक: पौत्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुत्र or 1. पौत्र), belonging to a son or grandson; (अस्), m. the son of a Putrikā (?); a patronymic from Putrika (?).
पौत्रिकेय: पौत्रिकेय, अस्, m. (fr. पुत्रिका), the son of a daughter appointed to raise issue for her father. —पौत्रिकेय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having for a grand-son the son of a daughter appointed to raise issue.
पौत्रिन्: पौत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. 1. पौत्र), having a grandson.
पौदन्य: पौदन्य पौदन्य, अम्, n., N. of a city.
पौनःपुनिक: पौनःपुनिक पौनःपुनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनः-पुनः), frequently reiterated, repeated again and again.
पौनःपुन्य: पौनःपुन्य, अम्, n. frequent reiteration, con-stant repetition; (एन), ind. again and again, re-peatedly.
पौनराधेयिक: पौनराधेयिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-आधेय), Ved. relating to the rite of replacing or renewing the sacrificial fire; [cf. पुनर्-आधेयिक।]
पौनरुक्त: पौनरुक्त, अम्, n. (fr. पुनर्-उक्त), repe-tition, tautology.
पौनरुक्तिक: पौनरुक्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa Ukthādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 60.
पौनर्नव: पौनर्नव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-नवा), relat-ing or belonging to the plant Boerhavia Procumbens.
पौनर्भव: पौनर्भव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. पुनर्-भू), re-peated, additional; relating or belonging to a widow who has married a second husband; (अस्), m. the son of a widow remarried, the offspring of a twice-married woman by her second husband, one of the sons or heirs admitted by the old Hindū law; पौ-नर्भवो भर्ता, a woman's second husband.
पौनर्भविक: पौनर्भविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुनर्-भव), relating to regeneration.
पौम्पा: पौम्पा पौम्पा, f., N. of a sacred lake.
पौर: पौर 1. पौर, अस्, m. (fr. 1. पुर् or fr. rt. पॄ?), Ved. ‘filling, sating,’ an epithet of Soma (Sāy. = उदर-पूरक); ‘filler, increaser,’ an epithet of the Aśvins; an epithet of Indra (Sāy. = पूरयितृ); N. of a Ṛṣi the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda V. 73, 74; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a dynasty.

पौर 2. पौर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुर, see 3. पुर्), belonging to a town or city, produced in a town or city; (अस्), m. a townsman, burgher, citizen (op-posed to जानपद); = नागर, a term for a prince engaged in war under certain circumstances and (in astrology) applied to a planet in a state of opposition to other planets; (ई), f. the language or conversation of the servants in a palace; (अम्), n. a species of fragrant grass (= रौहिष). —पौर-जन, अस्, m. a person belonging to the town, townsman, citizen. —पौर-जानपद, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to town and country; (आस्), m. pl. citizens and rustics, towns-men and country people. —पौर-योषित्, त्, or पौर-स्त्री or पौराङ्गना (°र-अङ्°), f. a woman living in a town or city. —पौर-लोक, आस्, m. pl. city people, citizens. —पौर-वृद्ध, अस्, m. a distinguished or eminent citizen, alderman. —पौर-सख्य, अम्, n. fellow-citizenship, connection or equality with others formed by inhabiting the same city for ten years.
पौरक: पौरक, अस्, m. a garden in the neighbourhood of a city; a garden round a house.
पौरञ्जन: पौरञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung or descended from Purañ-jana and Purañ-janī.
पौरन्दर: पौरन्दर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरन्-दर), be-longing or relating to Indra, derived or coming from Indra, sacred to Indra; (अम्), n. the Nakṣatra Jyeṣṭhā.
पौरिक: पौरिक, अस्, m. (fr. पुर), a townsman, citizen; a governor of a city; N. of a prince of the city of Purikā; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
पौरेय: पौरेय, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to a town or city, civic.
पौरव: पौरव पौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूरु), be-longing to or descended from Pūru, of the race of Pūru; (अस्), m. a descendant of Pūru; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants or the race of Pūru; N. of a people in the north or north-east of India; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Vasu-deva; of the wife of Yudhi-ṣṭhira.
पौरवक: पौरवक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
पौरवतन्तव: पौरवतन्तव, अस्, m. (probably fr. पूरु + तन्तु), in पर-प्°, q. v.
पौरवीय: पौरवीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूरु), devoted to Paurava.
पौरस्त्य: पौरस्त्य पौरस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. पुरस्), situated in front, foremost; eastern; previous, pre-ceding, former, prior, first, initial.
पौराण: पौराण पौराण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुराण), belonging or relating to the past, of the past, of ancient occurrence, derived from or belonging to past ages, primeval, ancient; belonging to former times, former, previous; relating to the Purāṇas.
पौराणिक: पौराणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the past or to past ages; familiar with the events and legends of the past; relating or belonging to the Purāṇas, Paurānic; worth a Purāṇa, of the value of one Purāṇa; (अस्), m. a Brāhman well-read in the Purāṇas or a public expounder of them; a mythologist.
पौरुकुत्स: पौरुकुत्स पुरुकुत्स, अस्, or पौरुकुत्सि, इस्, or पौरुकुत्स्य, अस्, m. (fr. पुरु-कुत्स), a patronymic of Trasa-dasyu.
पौरुमड्ग: पौरुमड्ग पौरुमद्ग, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
पौरुमह्न: पौरुमह्न पौरुमह्न, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-मह्न), N. of various Sāmans.
पौरुमीढ: पौरुमीढ पौरुमीढ or पौरुमीऌह, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-मीढ), N. of various Sāmans.
पौरुशिष्टि: पौरुशिष्टि पौरुशिष्टि, इस्, m. (fr. पुरु + शिष्ट), Ved., N. of a teacher.
पौरुष: पौरुष पौरुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुष), belonging or relating to a man or to man in general, manly, virile, human; relating or belonging to Pu-rusha, sacred to Puruṣa; being of the length of a man with both arms elevated and the fingers ex-tended; (अस्), m. (according to Kullūka) = पुरुष-वाह्य-भार, a weight or load which can be carried by one man; (ई), f. a woman; (अम्), n. manhood, manliness, manly strength or courage, heroism, strength, power, vigour; human action, action of men, man's work, action; effort, exertion; the measure of a man, the height to which he reaches with both arms elevated and the fingers extended; generation; semen virile; the penis; a sun-dial. —पौरुष-ता, f. or पौरुष-त्व, अम्, n. man-hood, manly strength or spirit.
पौरुषमेधिक: पौरुषमेधिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुष-मेध), Ved. relating or belonging to a human sacrifice.
पौरुषविधिक: पौरुषविधिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पुरुष-विध, man-like, resembling man, human.
पौरुषांसकिन्: पौरुषांसकिन्, इनस्, m. pl. the school of Pu-ruṣāṃsaka.
पौरुषाद: पौरुषाद, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरुषाद), relating or belonging to man-eaters or cannibals.
पौरुषिक: पौरुषिक, अस्, m. a worshipper of Puruṣa.
पौरुषेय: पौरुषेय, अस्, ई, अम्, derived from or relating to man, incidental to man, made by man, human, manly, male, virile; coming from the soul, spiritual; (अस्), m. a hireling, day-labourer; a crowd or num-ber of men (?); manslaughter, murder; law as affecting persons; (अम्), n. human action, the work of man. —पौरुषेय-त्व, अम्, n. humanity, human origin, the human element (in sacred writings).
पौरुष्य: पौरुष्य, अस्, -षी, अम्, relating to Puruṣa; (अम्), n. manliness, manly strength or courage.
पौरुहन्मन: पौरुहन्मन पौरुहन्मन, अम्, n. (fr. पुरु-हन्मन्), N. of various Sāmans.
पौरुहूत: पौरुहूत पौरुहूत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरु-हूत), belonging to Indra.
पौरूरवस: पौरूरवस पौरूरवस, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Purū-ravas; (अस्), m. a patronymic.
पौरोगव: पौरोगव पौरोगव, अस्, m. (fr. पुरो-गव), an overseer or superintendent of a royal household, especially the inspector of the royal kitchen.
पौरोडाश: पौरोडाश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरो-डाश), see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 62; (अस्), m. a Mantra recited upon making an oblation of clarified butter.
पौरोडाशिक: पौरोडाशिक, अस्, m. (fr. पुरो-डाश), a priest who recites the Mantra used in offering an oblation of clarified butter.
पौरोधस: पौरोधस, अस्, m. a patronymic from Puro-dhas; (अम्), n. the office or function of a family priest.
पौरोभाग्य: पौरोभाग्य, अम्, n. (fr. पुरो-भागिन्), envy, jealousy, malevolence, ill-will, censoriousness; ob-trusiveness.
पौरोहित: पौरोहित, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुरो-हित), belonging to a Puro-hita, coming or proceeding from a family priest.
पौरोहित्य: पौरोहित्य, अस्, -ती, अम्, belonging to the family of a Puro-hita; (अम्), n. the character or office of a family priest.
पौर्णदर्व: पौर्णदर्व पौर्णदर्व, अम्, n. = पूर्ण-दर्व, q. v.
पौर्णमास: पौर्णमास, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्ण-मास), re-lating or belonging to the full moon, usual or cus-tomary at full moon, having the full moon; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a ceremony performed at the full moon by persons maintaining a perpetual fire; a patro-nymic; N. of a son of Marīci and Sambhūti; of a prince of the Āndhra dynasty; (अम्), n. a day of full moon; (ई), f. a day or night of full moon.
पौर्णमासायन: पौर्णमासायन, अम्, n. (fr. the preceding), Ved. a kind of sacrifice offered at the full moon.
पौर्णमासिक: पौर्णमासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पौर्णमास), used for the sacrifice offered at the full moon.
पौर्णमास्य: पौर्णमास्य, अम्, n., scil. कर्मन्, a sacrifice offered at the full moon.
पौर्णमी: पौर्णमी, f. a day of full moon (= पूर्णिमा).
पौर्णिम: पौर्णिम, अस्, m. (fr. पूर्णिमा), an ascetic; (आ), f. a day of full moon.
पौर्त: पौर्त पौर्त, अम्, n. (fr. पूर्त), scil. कर्-मन्, a meritorious work (= पूर्त).
पौर्तिक: पौर्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to a meritorious work (as the feeding of a Brāhman &c.).
पौर्व: पौर्व पौर्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व), relating or belonging to the past; relating to the east, eastern.
पौर्वदेहिक: पौर्वदेहिक or पौर्वदैहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-देह), belonging or relating to a former body, belonging or relating to a former life or existence; derived from a former existence, done in a former life.
पौर्वपञ्चालक: पौर्वपञ्चालक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-पञ्-चाल), = पूर्वः पञ्चालानाम्।
पौर्वपदिक: पौर्वपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व-पद), relating to the first member of a compound; (pro-bably) pronouncing the first member of a compound (in teaching).
पौर्ववर्षिक: पौर्ववर्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = पूर्वासु वर्-षासु भवः, Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 3, 11.
पौर्वशाल: पौर्वशाल, अस्, ई, अम्, = पूर्वस्यां शालायाम् भवः, Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 2, 107.
पौर्वातिथ: पौर्वातिथ, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from Pūrvātithi; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
पौर्वापर्य: पौर्वापर्य, अम्, n. (fr. पूर्वापर), priority and posteriority, the relation of prior and posterior, succession, continuity.
पौर्वार्ध: पौर्वार्ध or पौर्वार्धिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्वार्ध), living or situated on the eastern side of (with gen.).
पौर्वाह्णिक: पौर्वाह्णिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्वाह्ण), be-longing or relating to the morning, produced in the forenoon, matutinal; (often wrongly spelt पौर्वाह्-निक।)
पौर्विक: पौर्विक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पूर्व), former, pre-vious, prior, primary; ancient, old; ancestral; (ई), f. an ancestress.
पौलस्त्य: पौलस्त्य पौलस्त्य, अस्, -स्ती, अम्, relating to or descended from Pulasti or Pulastya; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Pulasti or Pulastya; an epithet of Kuvera; of Rāvaṇa; of Vibhīṣaṇa; of the moon; N. of an astronomer; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the brothers of Dur-yodhana; (पौलस्ती), f. a patro-nymic of Śūrpa-ṇakhā the sister of Rāvaṇa.
पौलि: पौलि पौलि, इस्, ई, m. f. grain half dressed or scorched or fried with ghee and made into a sort of cake.
पौलिका: पौलिका, f. a kind of cake (= पौलि; perhaps an error for पोलिका).
पौलिश: पौलिश पौलिश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुलिश), de-rived from or composed by Puliśa. —पौलिश-सिद्-धान्त, अस्, m., N. of an astronomical work.
पौलुषि: पौलुषि पौलुषि, इस्, m. (fr. पुलुष), Ved. a patronymic of Satya-yajña.
पौलोम: पौलोम पौलोम, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or treating of Pulomā, an epithet of Adhyāyas 4-12 of the Ādi-parva of the Mahā-bhārata; relating to Puloman or Pulomā or Paulomī; descended from Puloman or Pulomā; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of demons; (ई), f. the daughter of Puloman, an epithet of the wife of Indra; (अस्), m. an epithet of Indra; a Muni. —पौलोमी-मङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, as for-tunate or happy as Paulomī. —पौलोमी-सम्भव, अस्, m. born from Paulomī, son of Paulomī (an epithet of Jayanta, q. v.).
पौल्कस: पौल्कस पौल्कस, अस्, m., Ved. (= पुल्कस, said to be) the son of a Niṣāda or of a Śūdra father and of a Kṣatriyā mother.
पौष: पौष पौष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्य), relating to or occurring at the time when the moon is in the asterism Puṣya; (अस्), m., N. of a month, the month Pauṣa (December-January, when the full moon is in the asterism Puṣya); N. of the third year in the twelve years' cycle of Jupiter; (ई), f. the night or day of full moon in the month Pauṣa; (अम्), n. a festival or a particular festival; a fight, combat; N. of various Sāmans; [cf. पौष्य।]
पौष्कर: पौष्कर पौष्कर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्कर), relating to the blue lotus-flower, made or consisting of blue lotuses, treating of the blue lotus; (with प्रादुर्-भाव) the appearance of Viṣṇu in the form of a lotus-flower; belonging to or derived from Costus Speciosus or C. Arabicus; (अम्), n. the root or fruit of the plant Costus Speciosus or C. Arabicus.
पौष्करक: पौष्करक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the blue lotus-flower, consisting of blue lotuses; (with प्रा-दुर्-भाव) the appearance of Viṣṇu in the form of a lotus-flower.
पौष्करसादि: पौष्करसादि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. पुष्-कर-सद्), N. of a grammarian.
पौष्करिणी: पौष्करिणी, f. = पुष्करिणी, a lotus-pool, a large pond or reservoir.
पौष्करेयक: पौष्करेयक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 95.
पौष्कल: पौष्कल पौष्कल, अस्, m. (fr. पुष्कल), a species of grain; (अम्), n., N. of various Sāmans.
पौष्कलावति: पौष्कलावति, इस्, m. (fr. पुष्कला-वती), N. of a physician.
पौष्कल्य: पौष्कल्य, अम्, n. full growth, maturity, com-plete development.
पौष्टिक: पौष्टिक पौष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्टि), relating to or promoting growth or welfare; nutri-tious, nourishing, nutritive, fattening, invigorating; preservative, protective; (अम्), n. a cloth worn dur-ing the ceremony of tonsure.
पौष्टी: पौष्टी, f. (probably fr. पुष्ट), N. of the wife of Pūru.
पौष्ण: पौष्ण पौष्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Pūṣan, sacred to Pūṣan; relating to the sun; (अम्), n. the last of the twenty-eight lunar asterisms; the Nakṣatra Revatī.
पौष्प: पौष्प पौष्प, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पुष्प), re-lating or belonging to flowers, coming from flowers, made of flowers, flowery, floral; (ई), f. the city of Pāṭali-putra (= पुष्प-पुर).
पौष्पक: पौष्पक, अम्, n. oxide of brass considered as a collyrium, green vitriol.
पौष्पिञ्जि: पौष्पिञ्जि पौष्पिञ्जि, इस्, m. a patronymic; N. of a teacher; (also read पौष्यिञ्जि।)
पौष्पिण्ड्य: पौष्पिण्ड्य पौष्पिण्ड्य, अस्, m., N. of an ancient teacher.
पौष्य: पौष्य पौष्य, अस्, -षी (?) , अम् (fr. पुष्य), relating to the asterism Puṣya; (fr. पौष्य), re-lating to or treating of king Pauṣya, an epithet of the third Adhyāya of the Ādi-parva of the Mahā-bhārata; (अस्), m., N. of a prince the son of Pūṣan and king of Karavīra-pura.
प्ना: प्ना प्ना, f. the braided hair of Śiva.
प्याट्: प्याट् प्याट्, ind. a particle used in calling, ho! holla!
प्याय्: प्याय् प्याय्। See rt. प्यै below.
प्युक्ष्ण: प्युक्ष्ण प्युक्ष्ण, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a covering for a bow (made of sinews or of the skin of a serpent, see Kātyāyana's Śrauta-s. XV. 3, 31).
प्युष्: प्युष् प्युष्, cl. 4. 10. P. प्युष्यति, प्यो-षयति, &c., a various reading for rt. व्युष्, q. v.
प्युस्: प्युस् प्युस्, cl. 4. P. प्युस्यति, &c., a various reading for rt. व्युष्, q. v.
प्यै: प्यै प्यै or प्याय् (developed out of a Vedic rt. पी; cf. rt. पिन्व्), cl. 1. A. प्या-यते (Ved. पयते), पिप्ये (Ved. पीपाय), प्यास्-यते, प्यायिष्यते, अप्यास्त, अप्यायिष्ट, अप्यायि, प्यातुम्, प्यायितुम्, to swell, become swollen or distended; to be exuberant; to become full; to increase, grow; to overflow; to cause to swell, distend; to fill to excess, overfill, surcharge, cause to run over or overflow: Caus. प्याययति, -यितुम्, (with आ, see आ-प्यै।)
प्यान: प्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, fat, swollen, grown fat, = पीन, q. v.
प्यायन: प्यायन, अस्, ई, अम्, promoting growth or in-crease (according to a Scholiast = वृद्धि-हेतु), causing to thrive; invigorating; (अम्), n. growth, increase.
प्यायित: प्यायित, अस्, आ, अम्, fat, grown fat; increased; strengthened, refreshed; = पीन, q. v.
प्र: प्र 1. प्र (as a preposition or prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns, expressing) before, forward, in advance, in front, onward, forth, away (e. g. प्र-गम्, to go forward, proceed; प्र-स्था, to set out; प्र-स्थान, going away, departure; प्र-क्रम्, to walk onwards, to begin, commence).

प्र is also used in the Veda as a separable adverb, and the verb of motion is then sometimes to be supplied, e. g. प्र चक्रियेव रोदसी मरुद्भ्यः, heaven and earth (have been caused) by the Maruts (to roll) onward like two wheels.

प्र is also compounded with nouns not imme-diately connected with verbs in the sense of ‘forth,’ ‘away;’ and before adjectives in the sense of ‘pre-eminently,’ ‘excessively,’ ‘very,’ ‘much;’ [cf. प्र-पौत्र।] According to native lexicographers the senses in which प्र may be used are expressed by the follow-ing Sanskrit words, गति, आ-रम्भ, उत्-कर्ष, सर्वतो-भाव, प्राथम्य, ख्याति, उत्-पत्ति, व्य्-अवहार; [cf. प्र-तरम्, प्र-नप्तृ, प्रथम, परा, पूर्व, प्रातर्: Zend fra-, frā, ‘before, away:’ Gr. πρό, πρό-τερος, πρῶ-το-ς (Dor. πρᾶ-το-ς), πρό-μο-ς, πρύ-τανι-ς (Æol. πρό-τανι-ς), πρίν  for προ-ιν, πρω-ΐ, πρῴην (Dor. πράν), πρόσσω, πρό-σω, πόρ-σω, πόῥῥω: Lat. prō-d, prō, prŏ- in prŏ-nepos, prœ for prai, prīmu-s for pro-imus, pri-or, pris- = prius for pro-ios, pris-tinu-s, pris-cu-s, pran-diu-m, porro, perhaps pru-īna for provīna: Umbr. pru = pro; pre = prœ; perne, ‘in front;’ pernaio, ‘ancient;’ per, ‘for (?):’ Goth. fru-ma, ‘first;’ frum-ist, ‘at first;’ fairra, ‘far:’ Old Germ. fur-iro, ‘former;’ furisto, ‘a prince;’ fruo, ‘early;’ fer, ‘far:’ Angl. Sax. form: Slav. pra-, pro-, ‘before;’ prĭ-vy, ‘first:’ Lith. pra-, ‘before;’ pro, ‘through, for;’ pir-ma-s, ‘first;’ pirm, ‘before:’ Hib. fur, ‘for;’ foir, ‘before;’ perhaps fri, ‘with, by, through, on.’]
प्र 2. प्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. पॄ), filling, fulfilling (at the end of a comp., cf. आकूति-प्र, कक्ष्य-प्र, काम-प्र); like, resembling (in इक्षु-प्र, क्षुर-प्र, q. v.).
प्रउग: प्रउग प्र-üग, अम्, n. (according to the commentators fr. प्र-युग), Ved. the forepart of the pole or shafts of a chariot (Sāy. = ईषयोर् अग्रं युग-बन्धन-स्थानम्); उभयतः-प्रüग, having the foreparts of the shafts on both sides; (अस्, अम्), m. n., N. of the second Śastra or hymn at the morning libation. —प्रüग-चित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. arranged in the form of the forepart of a chariot-pole.
प्रकङ्कत: प्रकङ्कत प्र-कङ्कत, अस्, m., Ved. a veno-mous species of reptile; (Sāy.) = प्रकृष्ट-विषो (or प्रकृष्ट-गामी) महोरगः।
प्रकच: प्रकच प्र-कच, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) having the hair erect; [cf. उत्-क्°, वि-क्°।]
प्रकट: प्रकट 1. प्र-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, evident, clear, manifest, apparent, displayed, unfolded, open; public, commonly known, undisguised; visible; प्रकटः सो ऽस्तु, let him show himself; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (अम्), ind. evidently, clearly, manifestly, visibly; openly, undisguisedly, in public; अ-प्र-कटम्, unobservedly; [cf. अव-कट, उत्-क्°, नि-क्°, वि-क्°, सङ्-क्°।] —प्रकट-प्रीति-वर्धन, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva. —प्रकटी-करण, अम्, n. making visible or apparent, displaying, manifesting. —प्रकटी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to manifest, bring to light, unfold, display. —प्रकटी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested, brought to light, unfolded, displayed. —प्रकटी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become manifest, appear. —प्रकटी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested, manifest.
2. प्रकट, Nom. P. प्रकटति, प्रकटितुम्, to appear, become manifest.
प्रकटन: प्रकटन, अम्, n. manifesting, bringing to light.
प्रकटय: प्रकटय, Nom. P. प्रकटयति, -यितुम्, to manifest, make manifest, bring to light; to disclose, evince, display.
प्रकटाय: प्रकटाय, Nom. P. प्रकटायति, -यितुम्, to manifest, reveal, promulgate, proclaim.
प्रकटित: प्रकटित, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested; evident, ap-parent; unfolded, displayed, opened, expanded; publicly proclaimed or exhibited. —प्रकटित-ह-ताशेष-तमस् (°त-अश्°), अस्, ind. having openly destroyed utter darkness.
प्रकण्व: प्रकण्व प्र-कण्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) freed from evil (said of a place, Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 153).
प्रकथ्: प्रकथ् प्र-कथ्, cl. 10. P. -कथयति, -यि-तुम्, to announce, proclaim.
प्रकथन: प्र-कथन, अम्, n. announcing, proclaiming, relating, communicating.
प्रकम्प्: प्रकम्प् प्र-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्पते, -कम्-पितुम्, to tremble, shake, quake, quiver, shudder; to become lax or loose, to be loosened; to vibrate (said of sound): Caus. -कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble; to swing, wave, brandish, shake.
प्रकम्प: प्र-कम्प, अस्, m. trembling, quivering, shaking, quaking, staggering, violent motion.
प्रकम्पन: प्र-कम्पन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to tremble; (अस्), m. wind, air; N. of a hell; of an Asura; (अम्), n. great trembling, shaking, swaying to and fro, violent or excessive motion.
प्रकम्पनीय: प्र-कम्पनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to tremble.
प्रकम्पमान: प्र-कम्पमान, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling violently, shaking, quaking, quivering; becoming lax or loose.
प्रकम्पयत्: प्र-कम्पयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to tremble, shaking, agitating.
प्रकम्पिन्: प्र-कम्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, trembling, shaking, mov-ing to and fro.
प्रकम्प्य: प्र-कम्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to tremble, to be made to shake; [cf. दुष्-प्°।]
प्रकर: प्रकर 1. and 2. प्र-कर। See under प्र-कृ, p. 602, and प्र-कॄ, p. 603.

1. प्र-कर, अस्, ई, अम् (for 2. see under प्र-कॄ, p. 603), doing much, doing well; (अस्), m. aid, assist-ance, friendship; usage, custom, continuance of a similar practice; respect; seduction, abduction; (ई), f. an episodical incident or interlude inserted in a drama to explain that which follows; theatrical dress or disguise, as wearing a woman's garb, &c.

2. प्र-कर, अस्, m. (for 1. see under प्र-कृ, p. 602), a scattered heap, heap, multitude, quantity, plenty; a bunch of flowers, a nosegay; (ई), f. a kind of song; an open piece of ground; a place where four roads meet; the proper site of any magical opera-tions; (अम्), n. aloe wood, Agallochum.
प्रकरण: प्रकरण प्र-करण, प्र-कर्तव्य, प्र-कर्तृ। See प्र-कृ, p. 602, col. 3.

प्र-करण, अम्, n. treatment, discussion, ex-pounding, explanation; a subject, topic, province, department; a section, chapter, book, paragraph; opportunity, occasion; relation; an introduction, prologue, prelude; a poetical fiction or poem, in which the story and principal persons are wholly imaginary; a drama, a kind of drama with a fic-titious plot; treating with respect; doing much or well; (ई), f. a drama of the same character as the Pra-karaṇa but of less extent. —प्रकरण-त्व, अम्, n. the being a prelude or introduction. —प्र-करण-पञ्चिका, f., N. of a philosophical treatise by Śālika-nātha; (also called शालिका।) —प्रकरण-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist work. —प्रकरण-शस्, ind. according to species or kind (opposed to पृथक्त्वेन).
प्रकरितृ: प्र-करितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who sprinkles; one who spices or seasons (?).
प्रकर्ष: प्रकर्ष प्र-कर्ष, प्र-कर्षण, &c. See प्र-कृष्, p. 603.

प्र-कर्ष, अस्, m. pre-eminence, excellence, eminence, distinction, superiority, intensity of good qualities or merit, high degree (in these senses fre-quently at the end of comps.; cf. प्रणय-प्°, वपुः-प्°, वर्ण-प्°); might, strength; speciality; universality; absoluteness, definitiveness; protracted-ness, length; (in grammar) the effect of the prefix प्र upon roots; (आत्, एण), ind. in a high degree, intensely, eminently, exceedingly, mightily, strongly. —प्रकर्ष-गमन, अम्, n. going absolutely or finally (?). —प्रकर्ष-तन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, depend-ent on excellence or intensity of merit; dependent on superior strength or power. —प्रकर्ष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pre-eminent, eminent, excellent.
प्रकल्: प्रकल् प्र-कल् (see rt. 2. कल्), cl. 10. P. -कालयति, -यितुम्, to drive onwards, chase, pursue; to urge on, incite.
प्रकालन: प्र-कालन, अस्, आ, अम्, driving, driving on, chasing, pursuing; (अस्), m., N. of a Nāga of the race of Vāsuki.
प्रकला: प्रकला प्र-कला, f. part of a part, a minute portion. —प्रकल-विद्, त्, m., Ved. (according to the Nirukta) ‘knowing, i. e. calculating the smallest particles or sums,’ a merchant; (according to Sāy.) = अ-जानत्, ‘not knowing,’ knowing very little, desti-tute of knowledge, ignorant.
प्रकल्पना: प्र-कल्पना, f. fixing, settlement, allotting, allot-ment.
प्रकल्याण: प्रकल्याण प्र-कल्याण, अस्, आ, अम्, very excellent.
प्रकश: प्रकश प्र-कश, अस्, m., Ved. the thong or lash of a whip; hurting, killing.
प्रकस्: प्रकस् प्र-कस्, Caus. P. -कासयति, -यितुम्, to drive away, repel, repulse; to cause to bloom.
प्रकाङ्क्ष्: प्रकाङ्क्ष् प्र-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. -काङ्क्षति, काङ्क्षितुम्, to wish for, desire.
प्रकाण्ड: प्रकाण्ड प्र-काण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. the stem or trunk of a tree from the root to the branches; a branch, a shoot; (अस्), m. the upper part of the arm [cf. प्र-गण्ड]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. anything excellent of its kind (at the end of a comp.; cf. गो-प्°, मन्त्रि-प्°).
प्रकाण्डक: प्रकाण्डक, अस्, m. = प्र-काण्ड (at the end of a comp.; cf. रक्षः-प्°).
प्रकाम: प्रकाम प्र-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, amorous; (अस्), m. desire, delight, pleasure, luxury; (अम्), ind. according to wish or desire, with great pleasure, to the heart's content; voluntarily, willingly; sufficiently; very much; indeed. —प्रकाम-तस्, ind. willingly, with great pleasure or delight, to the heart's content; at will, according to the will. —प्रकाम-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, eating till satisfied, eating enough. —प्रकाम-विस्तार, अस्, m. great expansiveness (according to Malli-nātha = अत्यन्त-विशालता). —प्रकामालोक-नीय-ता (°म-आल्°), f. the being an object that may be viewed at pleasure. —प्रकामोद्य (°म-उद्°), अम्, n., Ved. talking to the heart's content, talkative-ness, garrulity.
प्रकार: प्र-कार, अस्, m. sort, kind, species; way, mode, fashion, manner (in these and the preceding mean-ings frequently at the end of a comp., e. g. नाना-प्रकार, of many kinds, manifold; त्रि-प्रकार, of three kinds, threefold; cf. बहु-प्रकारम्); similitude; difference; speciality. —प्रकार-ता, f. particularity, speciality. —प्रकार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, belonging to a species or kind. —प्रकारान्तर (°र-अन्°), अम्, n. another sort or kind, another manner; (ए), ind. in another way.
प्रकाश्: प्रकाश् प्र-काश्, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) -काशते (-ति), -काशितुम्, to become visible, come to light, come in sight, appear; to shine, gleam, glitter; to become evident or manifest: Caus. P. -काशयति, -यितुम्, to make visible, bring to light, cause to appear; to show, display; to lighten, illu-mine, irradiate; to discover, disclose, unfold, mani-fest, reveal; to make known, impart, communicate, proclaim: Pass. -काश्यते, to be illumined, &c.: Caus. A. -काशयते, -यितुम्, to cause to appear; to explain: Intens., Ved. -चाकशीति, to irradiate, illumine; to survey.
प्रकाश: प्र-काश, अस्, आ, अम्, visible, manifest, clear, evident; open, public; generally or universally known, noted, renowned, famous, celebrated; bright, shining, brilliant; expanded, blown; (at the end of a comp.) having the appearance of, looking like, resembling, like; (अस्), m. clearness, brightness, brilliance, lustre, splendor, light, elucidation (in this sense frequently at the end of the titles of explana-tory works; cf. अर्क-प्°, तत्त्व-प्°, तर्क-प्°); display, manifestation, expansion, diffusion; publicity, fame, renown, celebrity; sunshine; the open air, an open spot or space; (according to Mahī-dhara) = उपरितन-देह-कान्ति, the gloss on the upper part of a (horse's) body; a golden mirror (wrongly for प्राकाश); a chapter, section; laughter (perhaps wrongly for a form प्र-कास fr. प्र-कस्); N. of a Brāhman the son of Tamas or Darkness personified; of a son of Manu Raivata; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the messengers of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. white metal, bell-metal, brass; (अम्), ind. openly, pub-licly, undisguisedly, before all eyes (opposed to अ-प्°, प्र-च्छन्नम्, रहस्यम्); aloud, audibly (especially in dramatic language where it is opposed to आत्म-गतम्, स्व-गतम्, अप-वार्य, जनान्-तिकम्); (ए), ind. visibly, apparently; before the world, openly, publicly; in the presence of. —प्र-काश-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘maker of light,’ an epithet of the sun. —प्रकाश-कर्मन्, आ, m. ‘whose work is to give light,’ an epithet of the sun. —प्रकाश-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. wishing for a splendid ap-pearance or for distinction. —प्रकाश-क्रय, अस्, m. a purchase made publicly. —प्रकाश-ता, f. or प्रकाश-त्व, अम्, n. brightness, brilliance, splendor, luminousness; appearance, manifestation, visibility; celebrity, renown, fame. —प्रकाश-देवी, f., N. of a princess (Rāja-taraṅginī IV. 79). —प्रकाश-नारी, f. ‘public woman,’ a prostitute, harlot. —प्रकाश-वञ्चक, अस्, m. ‘an open rogue,’ public deceiver or cheat. —प्रकाश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bright, brilliant, shining; (आन्), m., N. of one of the feet of Brahmā. —प्रकाश-वर्ष, अस्, m., N. of a poet men-tioned in the Śārṅgadhara-paddhati. —प्रकाशा-काश-कान्ति (°श-आक्°), इस्, इस्, इ, bright as a clear sky. —प्रकाशात्मक (°श-आत्°), अस्, इका, अम्, brilliant in character or nature, shining, brilliant. —प्रकाशात्मक-त्व, अम्, n. the possession of a brilliant nature or character, brilliancy. —प्रका-शात्मन् (°श-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, brilliant in character or nature, brilliant, shining; (आ), m. an epithet of Śiva; the sun; N. of a man; of a philosophical writer (pupil of Ananyānubhava-svāmin). —प्रका-शात्म-पति, इस्, or प्रकाशात्म-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a philosophical writer (= प्रकाशात्मन्). —प्र-काशानन्द (°श-आन्°), अस्, m., N. of a philosophical writer. —प्रकाशी-करण, अम्, n. giving light, illuminating, irradiating. —प्रकाशी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to give light, illumine; to publish, make known. —प्रकाशी-भाव, अस्, m. the becoming light, morning twilight. —प्रकाशे-तर (°श-इत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘other than visible,’ invisible.
प्रकाशक: प्र-काशक, अस्, इका, अम्, clear, bright, shining, brilliant; universally known, noted, renowned; irra-diating, illuminating, giving light, luminous; making apparent or manifest, disclosing, discovering, pub-lishing; evincing, betraying; expressing; explaining; (अस्), m. ‘the giver of light,’ the sun; an expounder, illustrator; a publisher; a discoverer; (इका), f., N. of a commentary on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtra by Rāma-kṛṣṇa. —प्रकाशक-ज्ञातृ, ता, m. ‘knowing the giver of light, i. e. the sun,’ a cock. —प्रकाशक-त्व, अम्, n. luminousness, radiance.
प्रकाशन: प्र-काशन, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminating, giving light; making known; (अस्), m. ‘the giver of light,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. causing to appear, displaying; illuminating, giving light; bringing to light, making clear or manifest, making known, publicly showing or manifesting; (आ), f. propound-ing, explaining, teaching. —प्रकाशन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, irradiating, illuminating.
प्रकाशनीय: प्र-काशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be displayed, to be shown or manifested.
प्रकाशमान: प्र-काशमान, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming manifest, appearing; shining, splendid, brilliant, radiant.
प्रकाशित: प्र-काशित, अस्, आ, अम्, become visible, brought to light, visible, manifest, apparent, evident; dis-played, unfolded, discovered; illumined, enlightened, irradiated; published, promulgated.
प्रकाशिन्: प्र-काशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, visible, clear, bright, shin-ing; making visible or manifest. —प्रकाशि-ता, f. or प्रकाशि-त्व, अम्, n. clearness, brightness, brilliance, light.
प्रकाश्य: प्र-काश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be illuminated or en-lightened; to be brought to light or made manifest; (अम्), n. light, clearness, distinctness (in this sense a wrong form for प्राकाश्य, q. v.). —प्रकाश्य-ता, f. the being manifest; publicity; the being illu-minated.
प्रकिरण: प्र-किरण, अम्, n. scattering, strewing, throwing about.
प्रकीर्तन: प्रकीर्तन प्र-कीर्तन, प्र-कीर्तित, प्र-कीर्त्ति। See प्र-कॄत्, p. 604, col. 1.
प्र-कीर्तन, अम्, n. announcing, proclaiming; pronouncing aloud; praising aloud, lauding, extolling; (आ), f. mentioning, naming.
प्रकीर्य: प्र-कीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be strewed or scattered, to be spread abroad or about; to be diffused or promulgated; to be expanded or extended; (अस्), m. the plant Guilandina Bonduc.
प्रकुञ्च: प्रकुञ्च प्रकुञ्च, अस्, m. a particular measure of capacity (somewhat more or less than a handful).
प्रकुट्: प्रकुट् प्र-कुट् or प्र-कुट्ट्, cl. 10. P. -कुट-यति, -कुट्टयति, -यितुम्, to divide, reduce to small pieces.
प्रकुथ्: प्रकुथ् प्र-कुथ्, cl. 4. P. -कुथ्यति, -कोथि-तुम्, to become putrid, turn putrid, begin to stink.
प्रकुथित: प्र-कुथित, अस्, आ, अम्, putrid, putrescent.
प्रकोथ: प्र-कोथ, अस्, m. putrefaction, putridity, putres-cence. —प्रकोथोदक (°थ-उद्°), अम्, n. filthy water.
प्रकुप्: प्रकुप् प्र-कुप्, cl. 4. P. A. -कुप्यति, -ते, -कोपितुम्, to be moved or agitated; to become enraged, fly into a passion: Caus. -कोपयति, -यि-तुम्, to provoke to anger, incense.
प्रकुपित: प्र-कुपित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved, agitated, moving to and fro (Sāy. = इतस् ततश् चलित); very angry, wroth, enraged, incensed; disordered; अति-प्रकु-पित, excessively irritated.
प्रकुप्य: प्र-कुप्य, ind. having become angry, being enraged.
प्रकोप: प्र-कोप, अस्, m. effervescence, ebullition, excite-ment, emotion, violent anger, rage, fury, wrath, ire, anger; irritation, provocation, exasperation; political disturbance, insurrection, mutiny; an attack; (in medi-cine) excess, superabundance, vitiation [cf. पित्त-प्°, वात-प्°].
प्रकोपण: प्र-कोपण or प्र-कोपन, अस्, ई, अम्, exciting, agitating, irritating, provoking; (अम्), n. irritating, provoking, irritation, provocation, incensing.
प्रकोपणीय: प्र-कोपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be irritated or incensed, to be provoked to anger, irritable.
प्रकोपित: प्र-कोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, irritated, provoked, in-censed, enraged.
प्रकोपितृ: प्र-कोपितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, exciting, agitating, dis-quieting, an exciter, agitator.
प्रकुल: प्रकुल प्र-कुल, अम्, n. a handsome or excellent body; (also read प्रह्वल।)
प्रकूर्द्: प्रकूर्द् प्र-कूर्द्, cl. 1. P. A. -कूर्दति, -ते, कूर्दितुम्, to jump forward, leap about.
प्रकूष्माण्डी: प्रकूष्माण्डी प्र-कूष्माण्डी, f. an epithet of Durgā; [cf. कूष्माण्डी।]
प्रकृ: प्रकृ प्र-कृ, cl. 5. Ved. and cl. 8. P. A. -कृणोति, -कृणुते, -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make, accomplish, perform, achieve, effect; to make, render (with double acc., e. g. अन्धकारं शवलम् प्रकुर्वन्, rendering the darkness partly illumined); to bring to light, express, utter; to place before or in front, cause to precede, mention first; to place at the head, honour, worship; to appoint (to an office, with loc.); to gain, win, conquer (Ved.); to do away with, destroy (Ved.); to induce, move, incline (Ved.); to cause, enable (with inf., Ved.); Sāy. = प्रकृष्टं कृ, स्तुतिम् प्रकर्षेण कृ, to exalt, praise highly; to lay out, expend; (with बुद्धिम् or मनस्) to set the heart upon, apply the mind to, direct the thoughts towards anything (dat. or loc.); to resolve upon anything; (with दारान्) to marry; (with कन्याम्, &c.) to deflower, violate.
प्रकरणिका: प्रकरणिका, f. a kind of minor drama (= प्र-करणी).
प्रकरिका: प्र-करिका, f. an episodical incident or interlude inserted in a drama to explain that which follows (= प्र-करी).
प्रकर्तव्य: प्र-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be prepared; to be manifested or shown; to be appointed.
प्रकर्तृ: प्र-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes or occasions.
प्रकारक: प्रकारक, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-कार (at the end of comps., e. g. तत्-प्रकारक, of that kind, belonging to that).
प्रकार्य: प्र-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be evinced or mani-fested.
प्रकुर्वत्: प्र-कुर्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, doing much or well; behaving respectfully to, waiting upon, serving, honouring.
प्रकुर्वाण: प्र-कुर्वाण, अस्, आ, अम्, doing much or well; attending or behaving respectfully to.
प्रकृत: प्र-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made, accomplished, com-pleted; commenced, begun; one who has begun anything; original; that which is spoken of or is the original subject of discussion, that which is now in hand or under consideration; genuine, real; appointed, charged; wished, expected; mentioned; important, interesting; (अम्), n. original subject, present subject of discussion, present case; (अस्), m., N. of a man. —प्रकृत-ता, f. or प्रकृत-त्व, अम्, n. the being begun or in process of execu-tion, incipient state or condition; the being the subject of discussion. —प्रकृतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the original sense; real, true.
प्रकृति: प्र-कृति, इस्, f. the original or natural form of anything, natural condition, or state, original, primary substance (opposed to वि-कृति, change, modification, anything derived or secondary); cause, original source; origin, extraction, descent; nature, character, usual or natural state; constitution, disposition, tem-per; a rule, scheme, paradigm, pattern, model, standard (especially in ritual); (in the Sāṅkhya philosophy) = प्र-धान, the evolver of all material appearances, the ‘originant’ or original source of (or rather passive power of creating) the material world, (generally called Nature as opposed to Puruṣa or Spirit); (in mythology) a goddess, the personified will of the Supreme in the creation (identified with Māyā or Illusion and in an especial manner the prototype of the female sex; hence the same with the Śakti or personified energy or bride of a deity, as Lakṣmī, Durgā, &c.; in some systems Pra-kṛti is considered the same with the Supreme Being); (in grammar) the crude or elementary form of a word, an uninflected word, the radical form of a word before the case-terminations and other affixes are subjoined; N. of two classes of metres, consisting of eight and of eighty-four syllables respectively; (in arithmetic) a coefficient, multiplier; (in anatomy) temperament, the predominance of one of the humors at the time of generation; a woman, woman-kind; a mother; an animal; the male organ of generation; the female organ of generation; N. of a woman; तृतीया प्रकृतिः, the third nature, a eunuch; (अयस्), f. pl. (in the Sāṅkhya) the ma-terial archetypes of everything existing; the eight producers or primary elements out of which every-thing else is evolved (viz. अ-व्यक्त, बुद्धि or म-हत्, अहङ्कार, and the five तन्-मात्रस्); the con-stituent elements of the state (of which five are usually enumerated, viz. the minister, treasure, territory, fortresses, and army, to these are sometimes added the king himself and the sovereign who is his ally, and sometimes also the corporations of citizens); a king's ministers generally; the subjects of a king, the citizens, artizans, &c.; the various sovereigns to be considered in case of war (according to Manu VII. 155, viz. the मध्यम, वि-जिगीषु, उद्-आसीन, and शत्रु, to which according to Kullūka should be added eight remoter princes, viz. the मित्र, अरि-मित्र, मित्र-मित्र, अरिमित्र-मित्र, पार्ष्णि-ग्राह, आ-क्रन्द, पार्ष्णिग्राहासार, आक्रन्दा-सार; each of these twelve kings has the five Prakṛtis above-mentioned, so that the total number of Pra-kṛtis may be seventy-two, Manu VII. 157); N. of a class of divinities under Manu Raibhya; प्र-कृत्या, ind. by nature, naturally, by birth or extrac-tion; in the original state or condition, without change or alteration; properly. —प्रकृति-कृपण, अस्, आ, अम्, naturally plaintive or disposed to lament, naturally feeble (in discriminating). —प्रकृति-खण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘section on nature,’ N. of the second book of the Brahma-vaivarta-Purāṇa. —प्र-कृति-गुण, अस्, m. one of the three constituent quali-ties of nature (see गुण). —प्रकृति-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, springing from nature, inborn, innate. —प्रकृति-तरल, अस्, आ, अम्, naturally changeful, volatile, fickle, dissolute, voluptuous. —प्रकृति-पुरुष, अस्, m. a minister of state. —प्रकृति-प्रलय, अस्, m. = प्र-कृति-लय, q. v. —प्रकृति-भाव, अस्, m. natural state, original or unaltered condition; (अस्, आ, अम्), natural, usual, common. —प्रकृति-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the original state or condition, original. —प्रकृतिभूतेकार (°त-इक्°), अस्, m. the original sound or letter इ. —प्रकृति-मण्डल, अम्, n. the circle or aggregate of the Prakṛtis or of a king's subjects, the entire kingdom, whole empire. —प्रकृति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the original or natural form or shape, natural, usual, ordinary; in a natural or usual frame of mind. —प्रकृति-लय, अस्, m. absorption into Prakṛti, the dissolution of the universe. —प्रकृति-वत्, ind. as in the original form. —प्रकृति-विकृति-स्वभाव, अस्, m. the relation of (a word in its) radical form to (itself under the) mutations (of inflection &c.). —प्र-कृति-विषम, अस्, आ, अम्, naturally rough. —प्र-कृति-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, effected by nature, natural; (अम्), n. true or real nature. —प्रकृति-सुभग, अस्, आ, अम्, naturally pleasing or agreeable. —प्र-कृति-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the original or natural state, being in the natural condition, natural, genuine, unmixed;
