प्रखिद्: प्रखिद् प्र-खिद्, cl. 6. P. -खिदति, -खेत्-तुम्, Ved. to thrust away; to harass, afflict.
प्रखिदत्: प्र-खिदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. thrusting away; harassing, afflicting (according to Mahī-dhara = प्र-कर्षेण खेदयत्).
प्रख्या: प्रख्या प्र-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्या-तुम्, to see (Ved.); to announce, report; to praise, extol, celebrate: Pass. -ख्यायते, to be recognised or acknowledged, to be known; to shine: Caus. -ख्यापयति, -यितुम्, to make generally known, to be published.
प्रख्य: प्र-ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, visible, clear, distinct; looking or appearing like, resembling, like (at the end of comps., cf. शशाङ्क-किरण-प्°); (आ), f. look, appearance; perceptibility, visibility; making manifest, disclosure.
प्रख्यस्: प्र-ख्यस्, आस्, m. = प्रजा-पति, q. v.; the planet Jupiter.
प्रख्यात: प्र-ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, celebrated, renowned, famous, noted, notorious; recognised, acknowledged; bespoken, forestalled, claimed by right of pre-emp-tion; pleased, happy. —प्रख्यात-भाण्ड, अम्, n. a commodity the pre-emption of which is claimed by a king. —प्रख्यात-वप्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, having a celebrated father. —प्रख्यात-सद्-भर्-तृ, ता, m. known as a good husband.
प्रख्याति: प्र-ख्याति, इस्, f. perceptibility; publicity, no-toriety, celebrity; praise, eulogium, fame; अ-प्र-ख्यातिम् इ or गम्, to become imperceptible, vanish, disappear.
प्रख्यान: प्र-ख्यान, अम्, n. perception, the being per-ceived or being known; the making known, report-ing, communicating; a report, information.
प्रख्यानीय: प्र-ख्यानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be celebrated or made known.
प्रख्यापन: प्र-ख्यापन, अम्, n. the making known, pub-lishing; reporting, communicating; report, inform-ation.
प्रख्यापनीय: प्र-ख्यापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made gene-rally known, to be published.
प्रख्यायमान: प्र-ख्यायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being celebrated, being praised.
प्रख्याल: प्रख्याल प्र-ख्याल, probably a wrong reading for प्र-ख्यात above.
प्रग: प्रग प्र-ग। See under प्र-गम् below.

प्र-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going before or in advance, preceding; (ए), ind. early in the morning, at dawn, at day-break (‘when the sun goes forth?’). —प्रगे-तन, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to the morn-ing, to be performed in the morning, matutinal. —प्रगे-निश, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘one to whom it is night early in the morning,’ i. e. one who is asleep early in the morning. —प्रगे-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping early in the morning, asleep at day-break.
प्रगण्: प्रगण् प्र-गण्, cl. 10. P. -गणयति, -यितुम्, to reckon up, calculate.
प्रगण्ड: प्रगण्ड प्र-गण्ड, अस्, m. the upper part of the arm from the elbow to the shoulder [cf. प्र-काण्ड]; (ई), f. an outer wall or rampart.
प्रगदित: प्रगदित प्र-गदित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. गद् with प्र), spoken, speaking, beginning to speak.
प्रगाद्य: प्र-गाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. III. 1, 100.
प्रगम्: प्रगम् प्र-गम्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -गच्-छति (-ते), -गन्तुम्, to go forward, advance, pro-ceed; to set out towards, start for; to stride towards, go to; to reach, attain (Sāy. = प्राप्).
प्रगत: प्र-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forward, gone forth, started; separate, apart; gone with difficulty. —प्र-गत-जानु, उस्, उस्, उ, or प्रगत-जानुक, अस्, ई, अम्, having the knees far apart, bandy-legged, bow-legged.
प्रगम: प्र-गम, अस्, m. the first manifestation of affec-tion in conversation, first advance.
प्रगमन: प्र-गमन, अम्, n. progress, advance; going apart; the first manifestation of affection in the course of conversation; difficult progress (?); dis-puting (?).
प्रगमनीय: प्र-गमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 34.
प्रगामिन्: प्र-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, setting out, being about to depart.
प्रगयण: प्रगयण प्र-गयण, अम्, n. a various read-ing for प्र-गमन, q. v.
प्रगर्ज्: प्रगर्ज् प्र-गर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -गर्जति, -गर्जितुम्, to roar; to begin to thunder.
प्रगर्जन: प्र-गर्जन, अम्, n. roaring, roar; [cf. सिंह-प्°।]
प्रगर्जित: प्र-गर्जित, अम्, n. a roar, noise, din.
प्रगर्धिन्: प्रगर्धिन् प्र-गर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. गृध् with प्र), Ved. pressing onwards, pressing forwards; eager (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेणाभिकाङ्क्षन्).
प्रगल्भ्: प्रगल्भ् प्र-गल्भ्, cl. 1. A. -गल्भते, -गल्-भितुम्, to act with spirit or resolution, behave resolutely, act in a determined manner, be deter-mined; to be arrogant or proud; to be ready or able to (with inf.).
प्रगल्भ: प्र-गल्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, bold, confident; resolute, energetic; prompt, ready; spirited, courageous, brave, intrepid, daring; audacious, proud, arrogant; impudent, shameless; strong, able; eminent, illustrious; mature (as age); (अस्), m. an epithet of the fire employed at the Jāta-karman; N. of a philosophical writer; (आ), f. a bold or confident woman, a woman who courts her husband's caresses, a wanton woman; a scolding woman, shrew; an epithet of Durgā; (अम्), n. in a spirited or determined manner, resolutely. —प्र-गल्भ-कुलाल, अस्, m. a skilful potter. —प्रगल्-भ-ता, f. or प्रगल्भ-त्व, अम्, n. boldness, con-fidence; energy, resolution, resoluteness; audacity, arrogance; power, eminence, consequence; per-verseness, wilfulness.
प्रगल्भित: प्र-गल्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered proud, arro-gant; eminent, conspicuous.
प्रगा: प्रगा प्र-गा, cl. 2. 3. P. -गाति, -जिगाति, गातुम्, to go forwards, proceed, go away, move.
प्रगाण: 1. प्र-गाण, अम्, n. (for 2. see under प्र-गै, col. 3), access, approach; [cf. पृथु-प्°।]
2. प्र-गाण, अम्, n. (for 1. see under प्र-गा, col. 2), singing, song.
प्रगाह्: प्रगाह् प्र-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम्, गाढुम्, Ved. to dive into, enter, penetrate, pervade.
प्रगाढ: प्र-गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, dipped into, steeped, soaked, impregnated [cf. लवण-प्°]; much, exces-sive; hard, difficult; hard, firm; (अम्), n. pain, privation, penance; (अम्), ind. much, exceedingly; earnestly, forcibly; tightly, firmly; in due propor-tion. —प्रगाढ-ता, f. or प्रगाढ-त्व, अम्, n. abundance, excessiveness; hardness.
प्रगाहन: प्र-गाहन, अम्, n., Ved. dipping or plunging into.
प्रगुण: प्रगुण प्र-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, having excel-lent qualities, being in a good state or condition, being in the right state or order, straight; honest, upright. —प्रगुणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make straight, put in order, arrange, place in rank and file, array; to spread, make smooth or even.
प्रगुणय: प्रगुणय, Nom. P. प्रगुणयति, -यितुम्, to make straight.
प्रगुणित: प्र-गुणित, अस्, आ, अम्, made straight or even, made smooth, smoothed.
प्रगुणिन्: प्र-गुणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, straightened, made smooth or even, smoothed.
प्रगुण्य: प्र-गुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having excellent qualities, excellent; more, exceeding.
प्रगुप्: प्रगुप् प्र-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपयति, -यितुम्, to seek to protect, to guard.
प्रगोपन: प्र-गोपन, अम्, n. protection, preservation, salvation.
प्रगुर्: प्रगुर् प्र-गुर्, cl. 6. P. -गुरति, -गुरितुम्, Ved. to cry aloud, exclaim loudly; to make great efforts, make strenuous exertions (Sāy. = अत्यर्थम् उद्युज्).
प्रगॄ: प्रगॄ प्र-गॄ (see rt. 1. गॄ), cl. 9. P. A. -गृणाति, -गृणीते, -गरितुम्, -गरीतुम्, to announce, praise, extol, celebrate.
प्रगे: प्रगे प्र-गे। See under प्र-गम्, col. 1.
प्रगै: प्रगै प्र-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to begin to sing, sing of, sing, celebrate; to sound, resound.
प्रगातृ: प्र-गातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a singer, excellent singer.
प्रगाथ: प्र-गाथ, अस्, m. a strophe, a combination of two verses (viz. of a Bṛhatī or Kakubh followed by a Sato-bṛhatī which by an intermixture of the several Pādas is changed into a triplet); (अस्), m., N. of a man with the patronymics Kāṇva and Ghaura, the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda VIII. 1, 2, 10, 48, 51-54; (आस्), m. pl. an epithet of the hymns of the eighth Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda.
प्रगायिन्: प्र-गायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, singing, beginning to sing.
प्रगीत: प्र-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung; one who has begun to sing, singing; resonant with singing, vocal; (अम्), n. song; a sing-song or drawling recitation (regarded as a fault).
प्रगीति: प्र-गीति, इस्, f. a kind of metre, containing 30 + 29 syllabic instants.
प्रग्रथन: प्रग्रथन प्र-ग्रथन, अम्, n. the act of connecting or stringing together, intertwining.
प्रग्रस्: प्रग्रस् प्र-ग्रस्, cl. 1. P. A. -ग्रसति, -ते, -ग्रसितुम्, to eat up, devour, swallow, swallow up; to eclipse.
प्रग्रह्: प्रग्रह् प्र-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to hold forth, hold out, stretch forth; to offer; to seize, grasp, clutch, take hold of, take; to receive, accept; to draw up, stop; to draw towards one's self, unite with; to give a friendly reception to, act in a friendly manner towards, favour; to keep separate or isolated (as words &c. not subjected to the rules of Sandhi): Caus. -ग्रा-हयति, -यितुम्, to receive, accept.
प्रगृहीत: प्र-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, held in front, held out; received, accepted, admitted; pronounced separately without observing the usual rules of Sandhi [cf. 1. प्र-गृह्य]; collected, strung together (?). —प्रगृहीत-पद, अस्, m., scil. सन्धि, a suspension of Sandhi in which the vowels remain unaltered.
प्रगृह्य: 1. प्र-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or accepted, to be admitted; (in grammar) to be taken or pro-nounced separately, not subject to the rules of Sandhi or euphony (as the final ई, ऊ, and ए of the dual terminations whether of nouns, pronouns, or verbs, e. g. कवी एतौ, ‘these two poets;’ बन्धू एतौ, ‘these two relations’).
2. प्र-गृह्य, ind. having taken or grasped, car-rying away with; with.
प्रगृह्यमाण: प्र-गृह्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being taken or seized.
प्रग्रह: प्र-ग्रह, अस्, m. holding in front, holding forth, holding out, stretching forth; taking, taking or laying hold of, grasping, clutching, seizing (e. g. अङ्ग-प्°, the seizing of the limbs [by a demon], pain in the limbs); the seizing or grasping of the sun or moon, beginning of an eclipse [cf. ग्रह]; kind or friendly reception, kindness, favour; a rein, bridle, rope or halter for horses, lash, thong, whip, scourge; the cord or string suspending a balance; a guide, leader, ruler; a ray of light; a prisoner, captive, either man or beast in confinement; bind-ing; taming, breaking (a horse); the arm; a species of plant, Cassia Fistula; (in grammar) a vowel not subject to the rules of Sandhi; epithet of a particular sacrificial rite (more fully written प्रग्रह-होम); an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa. —प्रग्रह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, (at the end of a comp.) having seized, holding; giving a friendly reception, receiving kindly, obliging, kind.
प्रग्रहण: प्र-ग्रहण, अम्, n. taking, seizing, holding, assuming; shutting up, confining; the seizure of sun and moon, i. e. the commencement of an eclipse; offering; a rein, bridle; a check, restraint; the being a leader or guide.
प्रग्राह: प्र-ग्राह, अस्, m. seizing, taking, taking up, bearing, carrying; a rein; the string of a balance. —प्रग्राह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the string of a balance.
प्रग्रीव: प्रग्रीव प्र-ग्रीव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a window, lattice, balcony (‘projecting like a neck,’ cf. ग्रीवा); a summer-house, pleasure-house; a building on the top of a palace, a painted turret; a wooden balus-trade or fence round a building; a stable; the top of a tree.
प्रग्लै: प्रग्लै प्र-ग्लै, cl. 1. P. -ग्लायति, -ग्लातुम्, to fade or wither away: Caus. -ग्लापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fade or wither away.
प्रग्ल: प्र-ग्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearied, fatigued, exhausted.
प्रघट्: प्रघट् प्र-घट्, cl. 1. A. -घटते, -घटितुम्, to exert one's self, to apply or devote one's self to; to begin, commence.
प्रघटा: प्र-घटा, f. (perhaps) the rudiments or first elements of a science. —प्रघटा-विद्, त्, m. ‘know-ing the rudiments,’ a general reader but not a pro-found one.
प्रघट्टक: प्रघट्टक प्र-घट्टक, अस् or अम् (fr. rt. घट्ट् with प्र), a precept, rule, doctrine.
प्रघण: प्रघण प्र-घण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with प्र), a porch before the door of a house, a terrace be-fore a house; an iron mace or crowbar; a copper pot.
प्रघन: प्र-घन, अस्, m. a covered terrace before a house; a species of bean, Phaseolus Mungo (a wrong reading for प्रथन).
प्रघाण: प्र-घाण, अस्, m. a covered terrace or small portico before the door of a house; an iron mace or hand-spike; a copper pot; the trunk of a tree.
प्रघात: प्र-घात, अस्, m. a combat, battle; the edging of a garment.
प्रघान: प्र-घान, अस्, m. a covered terrace before the door of a house, porch, portico.
प्रघस: प्रघस प्र-घस, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. घस् with प्र), voracious; an epithet of false gods; (अस्), m., N. of a Rakṣas; N. of a monkey fol-lower of Rāma; a Daitya, demon; eating much, voracity; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
प्रघासिन्: प्र-घासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or प्र-घास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. voracious (an epithet of the Maruts, ac-cording to Mahī-dhara = पुरोडाश-भक्षण-शील).
प्रघुण: प्रघुण प्रघुण, अस्, m. a guest, visitor; (a wrong form for प्राघुण।)
प्रघुष्: प्रघुष् प्र-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -घो-षितुम्, to sound forth, sound: Caus. -घोषयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sound forth, cause to announce aloud, proclaim.
प्रघोषिन्: प्र-घोषिन्, ई, m., Ved. ‘roaring,’ an epithet of one of the nine classes of the Maruts.
प्रघूर्ण: प्रघूर्ण प्र-घूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, turning round or rolling violently; wandering, roaming; (अस्), m. a guest, a visitor (in this sense a wrong form for प्राघूर्णक).
प्रघृष्: प्रघृष् प्र-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, -घर्-षितुम्, to rub to pieces; to rub into, anoint.
प्रघृष्ट: प्र-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed in, embrocated, anointed.
प्रचकित: प्रचकित प्र-चकित, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, shuddering, terrified, startled.
प्रचक्र: प्रचक्र प्र-चक्र, अम्, n. an army in motion; a foraging army.
प्रचक्ष्: प्रचक्ष् प्र-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, -चष्-टुम्, to tell, relate, recount, inform; to suppose, consider as, regard as, deem; to call, name: Caus. -चक्षयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to irradiate, illumine.
प्रचक्षण: प्र-चक्षण, see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27, 57.
प्रचक्षस्: प्र-चक्षस्, आस्, m. the regent of the planet Jupiter, Bṛhas-pati.
प्रचण्ड: प्रचण्ड प्र-चण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, excessively violent, vehement, impetuous, passionate, furious, enraged, wrathful; very hot or burning; intolerable, insupportable; terrible, terrific; bold, confident, pre-suming; (अस्), m. a species of oleander with white flowers; N. of a Dānava; of a goblin; of a son of Vatsa-prī and Su-nanda; (आ), f. a species of Dūrvā with white flowers; a form or Śakti of Durgā. —प्रचण्ड-घोण, अस्, आ, अम्, large-nosed, hav-ing a large or prominent nose. —प्रचण्ड-ता, f. violence, vehemence; boldness. —प्रचण्ड-पाण्-डव, अम्, n. ‘the wrathful sons of Pāṇḍu,’ N. of a comedy by Rāja-śekhara (= बाल-भारत)। —प्रचण्ड-मूर्ति, इस्, f. ‘oleander-formed,’ a species of tree, Tapia Cratæva. —प्रचण्ड-वर्-मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince (a younger brother of Caṇḍa-varman). —प्रचण्ड-सूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing a hot or burning sun —प्रचण्ड-सेन, अस्, m. ‘having a formidable army,’ N. of a prince of Tāmra-liptikā. —प्रचण्डातप (°ड-आत्°), अस्, m. fierce or stifling heat.
प्रचत्: प्रचत् प्र-चत्, Caus. A. -चातयते, -यितुम्, Ved. to drive away, frighten or scare away; (ac-cording to Sāy.) to destroy utterly, consume.
प्रचता: प्र-चता, ind., Ved. secretly, in secret, clandestinely.
प्रचय: प्रचय प्र-चय, &c. See under प्र-चि, col. 3.

प्र-चय, अस्, m. collecting, gathering (as fruit or flowers, but especially by means of a stick or other implement); a heap, quantity, number; slight union or aggregation; the neutral accentless tone (also called एक-श्रुति); the common increase or difference of the terms in a progression (in algebra). —प्रचय-स्वर, अस्, m. (in Ved. gram.) ‘the most usual tone,’ the accentless or neutral tone neither raised nor depressed (= प्र-चय, प्र-चित, प्रचित-स्वर).
प्रचर्: प्रचर् प्र-चर्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -च-रति (-ते), -चरितुम्, to come forth, issue forth, appear; to proceed towards, arrive at, reach, attain; to visit; to roam, wander; to circulate, become current (as a story); to undertake, perform, discharge (especially sacred functions, with inst. of the object or of the means employed); to proceed, behave, act in a particular manner (e. g. भृत्य-वत् प्र-चर्, to act like a servant); to treat (e. g. मिथ्या प्र-चर्, to treat wrongly or unskilfully); to be busied about, to be occupied or engaged in (with loc.); to do, perform, fulfil, practise; to succeed, thrive, prosper: Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to allow to roam, cause to graze, turn out to graze; to make public.
प्रचर: प्र-चर, अस्, m. a road, way, path; usage, cus-tom, currency; going well or widely; N. of a people (in this sense also read प्रच्चर, प्रस्तर).

प्रचरितव्य: प्र-चरितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proceeded with or undertaken, to be performed.

प्रज: प्रज प्र-ज। See under प्र-जन् below.

प्र-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing forth, bearing (in अ-प्°, q. v.); (अस्), m. a husband; (आ), f. progeny, offspring, brood, children and children's children, posterity, descendants, race, family; a creature, created being; man, mankind, people, subjects; seed, semen; birth, generation, propagation. —प्र-जा-कर, अस्, m. a symbolical expression for ‘a sword;’ (perhaps an error for प्रज्ञा-कर।) —प्रजा-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of offspring, wishing for children. —प्रजा-कार, अस्, m. the maker of created beings, author of creation. —प्र-जा-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. killing offspring, destroying progeny. —प्रजा-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘a moon to his subjects,’ epithet of a prince. —प्रजा-तन्तु, उस्, m. a line of descendants, a race. —प्रजा-द, अस्, आ, अम्, granting offspring; removing barrenness (as a medicine &c.); (आ), f. a species of shrub (= गर्-भ-दात्री). —प्रजा-दान, अम्, n. ‘people's gift,’ silver. —प्रजा-द्वार, अम्, n. ‘a gate or means of obtaining progeny,’ epithet of the sun. —प्रजा-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty of children or of subjects. —प्रजाध्यक्ष (°जा-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘the super-intendent or leader of created beings,’ an epithet of the sun; of Kardama; of Dakṣa; [cf. प्रजा-पति।] —प्रजा-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘protector or lord of created beings,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Manu; of Dakṣa; a protector of subjects, a king, prince. —प्रजा-निषेक, अस्, m. ‘infusion of offspring,’ impregnation; the infused germ itself, offspring. —प्रजान्तक (°जा-अन्°), अस्, m. the god of death. —प्रजा-प, अस्, m. ‘protector of subjects,’ a king, prince. —प्रजा-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of creatures,’ an epithet in the Veda originally applied to Savitṛ, Soma, Tvaṣṭṛ, Hiraṇya-garbha, Indra, and Agni, afterwards the name of a separate god presiding over procreation [cf. Manu XII. 121] and the be-stower of progeny and cattle, sometimes invoked as the ‘Creator’ and sometimes invoked only as one of the thirty-three deities, (in more recent hymns and Brāhmaṇas sometimes identified with the uni-verse, and described like Brahma as the original self-existent Being or source out of which the uni-verse was evolved); an epithet of the ten lords of created beings first created by Brahmā (according to Manu I. 34; their names are Marīci, Atri, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Vasiṣṭha, Pra-cetas or Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, and Nārada; some authorities make these Prajā-patis only seven in number, counting only the first seven in the above list, others reduce them to the last three, viz. Dakṣa, Bhṛgu, and Nārada); an epithet of Śiva; ‘lord of the people,’ a king, sovereign, prince; a daughter's husband, son-in-law; a creator, procreator, father (as generator); a kind of insect; the fifth (or thirty-ninth) year in a sixty years' cycle of Jupiter; a particular star, ò Aurigæ; (in astrol.) = 2. काल-नर, q. v.; the sun; fire; N. of a man; of a Ṛṣi; (ई), f., N. of Śākya-muni's aunt and nurse with the patronymic Gautamī (the first woman who assented to the doctrines of Buddha; cf. महा-प्रजापती, महा-प्रजावती). —प्रजापति-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. created by Prajā-pati (according to Mahī-dhara = प्रजापति-सृष्ट). —प्रजापति-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the lords of created beings,’ an epithet of Dakṣa. —प्र-जापति-भक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. eaten by Prajā-pati. —प्रजापति-यज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘the sacrifice per-formed to Prajā-pati (as the deity presiding over procreation of offspring),’ the procreation of children enjoined by law. —प्रजापति-लोक, अस्, m. the world of Prajā-pati situated between the sphere of Brahmā and that of the Gandharvas. —प्रजापति-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man. —प्रजापति-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, created by Prajā-pati. —प्रजापति-हृदय, अम्, n., Ved. ‘Prajāpati's heart,’ N. of a Sāman (also called प्रजापतेर् हृदयम्). —प्र-जापत्य, an incorrect form for प्राजापत्य, q. v. —प्रजा-पाल or प्रजा-पालक, अस्, m. ‘protector of created beings,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa; a protector of subjects, a king, sovereign; N. of a prince. —प्रजा-पालन, अम्, n. the protection of subjects. —प्रजा-पालि, इस्, m. an epithet of Śiva; [cf. गो-पालि।] —प्रजापाल्य, अम्, n. the office of protector of the people, royal office. —प्रजामृतत्व (°जा-अम्°), अम्, n., Ved. perpetuity of posterity. —प्र-जार्थम् or प्रजार्थे (°जा-अर्°), ind. for the sake of offspring. —प्रजा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, accompanied by progeny, having offspring or children, abounding in progeny, prolific; pregnant; having subjects; (अती), f. a brother's wife; the wife of an elder brother; a mother, matron; N. of a tutelary deity of the Su-mantus; of the wife of Priya-vrata. —प्रजा-विद्, त्, त्, त्, or प्रजा-सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. bestowing or granting progeny. —प्रजा-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase of progeny. —प्रजा-सृज्, ट्, m. ‘the creator of beings,’ an epithet of Brahmā; of Kaśyapa. —प्रजा-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, favourable to or good for children or subjects, kind or useful to children or subjects; (अम्), n. water. —प्रजेप्सु (°जा-ईप्°), उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to obtain offspring, desirous of progeny. —प्रजेश (°जा-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of created beings,’ an epithet of the god presiding over the procreation of offspring; ‘lord of the people,’ a prince, king, sovereign. —प्रजेश्वर (°जा-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of the people,’ a sovereign, king. —प्रजोत्पत्ति (°जा-उत्°), इस्, f. or प्रजोत्पादन (°जा-उत्°), अम्, n. the raising up of progeny.
प्रजङ्घ: प्रजङ्घ प्र-जङ्घ, अस्, m., N. of a monkey; of a Rākṣasa; (आ), f. a particular portion of the lower part of the thigh.
प्रजन्: प्रजन् प्र-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be born, be produced, come into existence, spring up; to become an embryo; to be born again; to propagate offspring (with inst.), beget, generate, cause to conceive; to bring forth, be delivered of, bear: Caus. -जनयति, -यितुम्, to cause any one (acc.) to propagate offspring (inst., Ved., Sāy. = प्रोद्भूतं कृ); to cause to be born; to beget, generate; to bring forth, bear; to produce, cause, occasion: Desid. -जिजनिषते, to wish to be born: Desid. of Caus. -जिजनयिषति, to wish to cause to be conceived.
प्रजज्ञि: 1. प्र-जज्ञि, इस्, इस्, इ, able to beget (in अ-प्°, q. v.; for 2. प्र-जज्ञि see under 1. प्र-ज्ञा, col. 3).
2. प्र-जज्ञि, इस्, इस्, इ (for 1. see col. 2), Ved. conversant with.
प्रजन: प्र-जन, अस्, अम्, m. n. (usually m.), begetting, generating, impregnating, generation; impregnation or pregnancy of cattle; bearing, bringing forth; (अस्), m. one who begets, a generator, impregnator, progenitor. —प्रजनार्थम् (°न-अर्°), ind. for the sake of procreation.
प्रजनन: प्र-जनन, अस्, ई, अम्, begetting, generating, generative, procreative, vigorous (according to Mahī-dhara = प्रजोत्पादक); (अम्), n. the act of gene-ration, procreation, propagation, conception in the womb; the act of bringing forth, delivery, birth; production; generative energy, procreative power, semen; the generative organ, penis, vulva; off-spring, children; = प्र-गम; = प्र-गत. —प्र-जनन-कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in midwifery. —प्रजनन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing generative power.
प्रजनयितृ: प्र-जनयितृ, ता, m., Ved. a generator, begetter, progenitor.
प्रजनिष्णु: प्र-जनिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, generative, procreative, prolific, productive, generating, producing; being born or produced; growing or standing (as corn).
प्रजनिष्यमाणा: प्र-जनिष्यमाणा, f. about to bring forth, being near the time of delivery.
प्रजनुक: प्र-जनुक, अस्, m. the body; (perhaps an in-correct form.)
प्रजनू: प्र-जनू, ऊस्, f., Ved. the vulva, pudenda muli-ebria.
प्रजस्: प्र-जस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, = प्र-ज (at the end of a comp.; cf. दुष्-प्°, बहु-प्°).
प्रजात: प्र-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born, produced; impreg-nating; (आ), f. a woman who has borne a child.
प्रजाति: प्र-जाति, इस्, f. generating, generation, procreation, propagation, production; bringing forth, delivery, travail, labour; generative power; (इस्), m., N. of a prince. —प्रजाति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing words relating to generation.
प्रजायिनी: प्र-जायिनी, f. being about to bring forth; bearing, bringing forth, a mother (at the end of comps., e. g. अभिरूप-प्रजायिनी, bearing handsome children; cf. वीर-प्°).
प्रजिजनिषमाण: प्र-जिजनिषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. wishing to be born.
प्रजप्: प्रजप् प्र-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -जपितुम्, to recite in a low tone, whisper, mutter.
प्रजय: प्रजय प्र-जय। See under प्र-जि, col. 3.
प्र-जय, अस्, m., Ved. victory, conquest.
प्रजल्प्: प्रजल्प् प्र-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -जल्पि-तुम्, to prattle, gossip, chatter; to speak, talk; to communicate, proclaim, announce.
प्रजल्प: प्र-जल्प, अस्, m. prattle, gossip, heedless or frivolous words (especially such as used in greeting a lover).
प्रजल्पित: प्र-जल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, talked, chattered; one who has begun to talk; (अम्), n. spoken words, talk.
प्रजव: प्रजव प्र-जव। See under प्र-जू, col. 3.
प्र-जव, अस्, m., Ved. haste, rapidity; (अम्), ind. hastily, rapidly.
प्रजागृ: प्रजागृ प्र-जागृ, cl. 2. P. -जागर्ति, -जागरि-तुम्, to watch, keep watch, watch over (with loc.); to lie in wait for (with gen.): Caus. -जागरयति, -यितुम्, to wake (trans.).
प्रजागर: प्र-जागर, अस्, आ, अम्, one who wakes, waking, an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अस्), m. a guardian; the act of waking or watching, lying awake at night, sleep-lessness, being awake, being roused, awaking; taking care; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras.
प्रजागरण: प्र-जागरण, अम्, n. being awake, sleeplessness.
प्रजानि: प्रजानि प्र-जानि, इस्, m., N. of a prince; (a various reading for प्र-जाति।)
प्रजि: प्रजि प्र-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to win, conquer, overpower, subdue.
प्रजित्: प्र-जित्, त्, त्, त्, conquering, defeating.
प्रजित: प्रजित प्रजित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, urged on; (probably a wrong form for प्राजित fr. rt. अज् with प्र।)
प्रजिन: प्रजिन प्रजिन, अस्, m. wind, air; (also read प्रजीन।)
प्रजिन्व्: प्रजिन्व् प्र-जिन्व्, cl. 1. P. -जिन्वति, -जिन्वि-तुम्, Ved. to refresh, animate; to promote, help, assist.
प्रजिहीर्षु: प्रजिहीर्षु प्र-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. हृ with प्र), being about to strike or hit, wishing to strike.
प्रजीवन: प्रजीवन प्र-जीवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जीव् with प्र), livelihood, subsistence.
प्रजीविन्: प्र-जीविन्, ई, m., N. of a minister of Megha-varṇa the king of the crows.
प्रजुष्ट: प्रजुष्ट प्र-जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जुष् with प्र), strongly attached to, devoted to, intent on (= प्र-सक्त, Manu II. 96).
प्रजू: प्रजू प्र-जू, cl. 1. P. A. -जवति, -ते, &c., to hasten forwards; to set in rapid motion, push or drive on; to urge on, incite: Caus. -जावयति, -यितुम्, to set in rapid motion, let fly, dart, shoot.
प्रजवित: प्र-जवित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven on, impelled; in-cited, urged on.
प्रजविन्: प्र-जविन्, ई, इनी, इ, hastening, rapid, swift, speedy; (ई), m. a runner, courier, express.
प्रजृम्भ्: प्रजृम्भ् प्र-जृम्भ्, cl. 1. A. -जृम्भते, जृम्भितुम्, to begin to yawn.
प्रजॄ: प्रजॄ प्र-जॄ, cl. 4. P. -जीर्यति, -जरितुम्, -जरीतुम्, to be digested.
प्रज्जटिक: प्रज्जटिक प्रज्जटिक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a kind of Prākṛt metre (= Prākṛt पज्जलिआ).
प्रज्जि: प्रज्जि प्रज्जि, इस्, m., N. of a man.
प्रज्ञ: प्रज्ञ 1. प्र-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-ज्ञु, q. v.

2. प्र-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, intelligent, learned; (at the end of a comp.) knowing, conversant with; (आ), f. a clever or sensible woman; intelligence, un-derstanding, intellect, wisdom, knowledge; discern-ment, discrimination, judgment; device, design, de-termination; Wisdom personified as the goddess of arts and eloquence, Sarasvatī; (with Buddhists) the energy of the Ādi-buddha. —प्रज्ञ-ता, f., Ved. knowledge. —प्रज्ञा-कर, अस्, m., N. of the author of a commentary on the Nalodaya. —प्रज्ञा-काय, अस्, m. an epithet of Mañju-śrī a Buddhist saint. —प्रज्ञा-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —प्रज्ञा-गुप्त-शरीर, अस्, आ, अम्, having the body protected by understanding. —प्रज्ञा-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, ‘mind-eyed,’ ‘having the understanding or wisdom as the only eyes,’ blind; (उस्), m. an epithet of the blind king Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —प्रज्ञा-ढ्य (°ञा-आढ्°), अस्, m. ‘rich in wisdom,’ N. of a man. —प्रज्ञादित्य (°ञा-आद्°), अस्, m. ‘sun of wisdom,’ N. of a man. —प्रज्ञा-पारमिता, f. (with Buddhists) one of the six perfections, perfection in wisdom, (the other five are दान-प्°, शील-प्°, क्षान्-ति-प्°, वीर्य-प्°, and ध्यान-प्°); N. of a Buddhist work. —प्रज्ञा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consist-ing of wisdom. —प्रज्ञा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing wisdom, wise, knowing, intelligent. —प्रज्ञा-वर्-मन्, आ, m. ‘having wisdom for armour,’ N. of a man. —प्रज्ञा-वाद, अस्, m. a wise speech, wise saying. —प्रज्ञा-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, old in wisdom or knowledge. —प्रज्ञा-सहाय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘hav-ing wisdom for a companion,’ wise, intelligent. —प्रज्ञा-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of wisdom, ignorant, silly, unwise.
प्रज्ञा: प्रज्ञा 1. प्र-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जा-नीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to know, understand (especially said of knowing a way or mode of action); to distinguish, discern, discriminate; to know of, know about, be acquainted with; to become aware of, to find out, discover: Caus. -ज्ञपयति, -ज्ञापयति, -यितुम्, to show or point out (the way); to discover, betray; to summon, invite.
प्रज्ञप्ति: प्र-ज्ञप्ति, इस्, f. teaching, informing, doctrine, communication; an appointment, agreement, en-gagement; (with Jainas) a particular magical art per-sonified as one of the Vidyā-devīs (also प्र-ज्ञप्ती). —प्रज्ञप्ति-कौशिक, अस्, m., N. of a teacher acquainted with the magical art called Pra-jñapti. —प्रज्ञप्ति-वादिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a Buddhist sect. —प्रज्ञप्ति-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work.
प्रज्ञात: प्र-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, known, understood; dis-tinguished, discriminated, discerned, discernible, dis-tinct, clear; renowned, famous, notorious.
प्रज्ञाति: प्र-ज्ञाति, इस्, f., Ved. knowing the way (to any place), knowing the right way.
प्रज्ञातृ: प्र-ज्ञातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who knows the right way, a skilful guide, conductor.
प्रज्ञात्र: प्र-ज्ञात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in अ-प्°, losing or missing the way.
प्रज्ञान: प्र-ज्ञान, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, prudent, wise, clever, learned; easily known (Ved.); (अम्), n. knowledge, knowing one's duty, wisdom, intelligence; discrimina-tion; a mark, sign, token, memorial. —प्रज्ञान-सन्तति, इस्, f. a train of thought.
प्रज्ञापित: प्र-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, betrayed, disclosed, dis-covered.
प्रज्ञाल: प्रज्ञाल, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, prudent.
प्रज्ञिन्: प्रज्ञिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wise, prudent; (ई), m. a wise or learned man, sage, scholar.
प्रज्ञिल: प्रज्ञिल, अस्, आ, अम्, wise, prudent, clever.
प्रज्ञु: प्रज्ञु प्र-ज्ञु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the knees far apart, bandy-legged, bow-legged; (also written प्र-ज्ञ।)
प्रज्वल्: प्रज्वल् प्र-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -ज्वलति (-ते), -ज्वलितुम्, to catch fire, begin to burn or blaze, be in flames, flame, blaze up; to blaze brightly, shine, gleam; to be inflamed or incensed, become wrathful, to be kindled (e. g. तेषां क्रो-धः प्रजज्वाल, their wrath was kindled): Caus. -ज्वलयति, -ज्वालयति, -यितुम्, to set on fire, light, kindle, inflame; (with Buddhists) to explain, illus-trate.
प्रज्वलन: प्र-ज्वलन, अम्, n. blazing up, flaming, burn-ing, taking fire, kindling.
प्रज्वलनीय: प्र-ज्वलनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set on fire, inflammable.
प्रज्वलित: प्र-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in flames, flaming, burning, blazing, shining, bright, radiant; blazed forth, burnt; (अम्), n. flaming up, blazing, burning.
प्रज्वालित: प्र-ज्वालित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted, kindled, set on fire.
प्रज्वार: प्रज्वार प्र-ज्वार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ज्वर् with प्र), the heat of fever (sometimes personified).
प्रडी: प्रडी प्र-डी, cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते, -डीयते, -डयितुम्, to fly forward, fly away, fly up.
प्रडीन: प्र-डीन, अम्, n. flying rapidly, flying in every direction; taking flight, beginning to fly; the act of flying; flying forward.
प्रण: प्रण प्रण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. प्र), ancient, old (see Vārttika 3. to Pāṇ. V. 4, 30).
प्रणख: प्रणख प्र-णख, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), the point of the nails.
प्रणद्: प्रणद् प्र-णद्, cl. 1. P. -णदति, -णदितुम्, to resound, begin to sound, begin to roar or cry.
प्रणदित: प्र-णदित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, sounding; buzzing, humming (as a bee).
प्रणाद: प्र-णाद, अस्, m. a loud sound, clangour, noise, shout, cry; any loud noise, especially one expressing approbation or delight, huzza; neighing, braying, bray; roar, roaring; a cry for help; a low sound expressive of great pleasure, a murmur or sigh of rapture; a disease of the ear, a noise or buzzing in the ear from thickening of the membranes &c.; N. of a Cakra-vartin.
प्रणादक: प्र-णादक, अस्, इका, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 16.
प्रणपात्: प्रणपात् प्र-णपात्, त्, m., Ved. a great-grandson; [cf. Lat. pro-nepo-(t)-s.]
प्रणभ्: प्रणभ् प्र-णभ्, cl. 1. A. -णभते, &c., Ved. to burst, split, cleave (intrans.).
प्रणम्: प्रणम् प्र-णम्, cl. 1. P. A. -णमति, -ते, -णन्तुम्, to bend or bow down before, make obei-sance to (with dat., gen., loc., or acc.): Caus. -णम-यति, -यितुम्, to cause any one (acc.) to bow before another (dat.); to bend, incline; to do anything reverentially.
प्रणत: प्र-णत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent forwards, crooked; bowed, bowing to (with gen. or acc.); bending, stooping, stooped; inclined; humble; skilful, clever. —प्रणत-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the head or top bent down or bowed; inclined, stooping. —प्र-णताशेष-सामन्त (°त-अश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one before whom all (his) neighbours bow, receiving homage from all the neighbouring princes.
प्रणतवत्: प्र-णतवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having bent, bowed, bowing, bent.
प्रणति: प्र-णति, इस्, f. bending, bowing, inclination, salutation, reverence, obeisance, courtesy.
प्रणमत्: प्र-णमत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bowing to, saluting with reverence or respect.
प्रणमित: प्र-णमित, अस्, आ, अम्, bending, bowing.
प्रणम्य: प्र-णम्य, ind. having bowed, having done homage or made obeisance.
प्रणाम: प्र-णाम, अस्, m. bending, bowing, a bow; respectful or reverential salutation, prostration, obei-sance (especially to a Brāhman or to a deity). —प्र-णामाञ्जलि (°म-अञ्°), इस्, m. reverential salutation with the hands opened and hollowed. —प्रणामा-दर (°म-आद्°), अस्, m. reverential salutation.
प्रणामिन्: प्र-णामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bending, bowing before, sa-luting, honouring, worshipping, prostrating one's self.
प्रणय: प्रणय प्र-णय। See 1. प्र-णी, p. 610, col. 1.

प्र-णय, अस्, m. a leader (Scholiast on Pāṇ. III. 1, 142); leading, conduct, guidance; confidence, familiarity, trust, intimacy; friendly acquaintance, confidential relationship, friendly or fond regard, friendship, affection, love, fondness, favour, kindness; wish, desire, longing; affectionate solicitation, re-quest, asking, begging; reverence, obeisance; final emancipation or beatitude; (एण), ind. confidentially, candidly; of one's own accord; without ceremony; (आत्), ind. candidly, openly, frankly. —प्रणय-कलह, अस्, m. a lovers' quarrel, mere wanton quarrelsomeness. —प्रणय-कुपित, अस्, आ, अम्, according to a Scholiast = प्रेमातिशयेन कुपित, angry through excess of affection. —प्रणय-कोप, अस्, m. the (feigned) anger of a coquette towards her lover, anger indulged for the sake of the pleasure of being pacified. —प्रणय-प्रकर्ष, अस्, m. excess of affection, unwonted or extraordinary attachment. —प्रणय-भङ्ग, अस्, m. a breach of confidence or friendship, faithlessness. —प्रणय-मान, अस्, m. ‘love-pride,’ the arrogance of love, lovers' quarrels. —प्रणय-वचन, अम्, n. a declaration of love or affection (according to a Scholiast = प्रेम-कथन). —प्रणय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing candour, acting frankly or openly, free from con-straint, unceremonious, frank, open, confident; pos-sessing affection, attached to, feeling an attraction towards, loving. —प्रणय-विमुख, अस्, ई, अम्, averse from acquaintance, disinclined to friendship. —प्रणय-विहति, इस्, f. refusal of a request, denial, refusal, non-compliance. —प्रणय-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, exciting affection, affectionate. —प्रणयापराध (°य-अप्°), अस्, m. an offence against (mutual) affec-tion or confidence. —प्रणयापहारिन् (°य-अप्°), ई, इणी, इ, taking with confidence, taking without shy-ness or constraint. —प्रणयी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become attached, to become affec-tionate. —प्रणयोन्मुख (°य-उन्°), अस्, ई, अम्, intending or about to make a declaration of love. —प्रणयोपेत (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, possessing candour, frank, open, candid.
प्रणव: प्रणव प्र-णव। See प्र-णु, p. 610, col. 3.
प्र-णव, अस्, m. the mystical or sacred syllable ॐ (Manu II. 74); a small kind of drum or tabor (= पणव). —प्रणवोपनिषद् (°व-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.
प्रणश्: प्रणश् 1. प्र-णश् (see rt. 1. नश्), cl. 1. P. A. -णशति, -ते, &c., Ved. to reach, attain.

प्रणश् 2. प्र-णश् (see rt. 2. नश्), cl. 1. 4. P. -णशति, -णश्यति, -णशितुम्, -नंष्टुम्, -नष्-टुम् (the न् of the rt. is not changed to ण् when श् passes into ष् or is otherwise changed, e. g. प्र-नष्ट, प्र-नङ्क्ष्यति), to be lost, disappear, vanish; to escape: Caus. -णाशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to disappear or perish; to allow to be lost, i. e. to leave unrewarded.
प्रणश्यत्: प्र-णश्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, perishing, falling away; endeavouring to escape.
प्रणाश: प्र-णाश, अस्, m. vanishing, disappearance, cessa-tion, loss [cf. लब्ध-प्°]; death, destruction, per-dition, decay.
प्रणाशन: प्र-णाशन, अस्, ई, अम्, (at end of comps.) causing to disappear or cease, removing, destroying, annihilat-ing; (अम्), n. destroying, destruction, annihilation.
प्रणाशिन्: प्र-णाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing to disappear or cease, removing, destroying.
प्रनष्ट: प्र-नष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (often incorrectly written प्र-णष्ट), lost, disappeared, vanished, not to be seen; departed, escaped; perished, destroyed, ruined, decayed, annihilated. —प्रनष्ट-ज्ञानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose knowledge is destroyed,’ without know-ledge. —प्रनष्ट-विनय, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose politeness has vanished,’ lost to propriety, uncivil, uncomplaisant, rude.
प्रनष्ट प्र-नष्ट। See under 2. प्र-णश्, p. 609.
प्रणस: प्रणस प्र-णस, अस्, आ, अम्, having a pro-minent nose.
प्रणाडी: प्रणाडी प्र-णाडी, f., Ved. a channel from a pond, a water-course, waste-pipe, drain; interven-tion, interposition; (ड्या), ind. mediately, indirectly.
प्रणाल: प्र-णाल, अस्, ई, m. f. or प्र-णालिका, f. a channel from a pond, gutter, drain, water-course; प्रणा-लिकया, through a particular channel, through the medium of, mediately.
प्रणिंसित: प्रणिंसित प्र-णिंसित or प्र-निंसित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. निंस् with प्र), kissed.
प्रणिंसितव्य: प्र-णिंसितव्य or प्र-निंसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kissed, what may or ought to be kissed.
प्रणिगद्: प्रणिगद् प्र-णि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, -ग-दितुम्, to begin to address.
प्रणिघ्नत्: प्रणिघ्नत् प्र-णिघ्नत्। See प्र-णि-हन्, p. 610, col. 1.
प्र-णिघ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, preparing or threatening to strike.
प्रणिज्: प्रणिज् प्र-णिज्, cl. 3. P. A. -णेनेक्ति, -णे-निक्ते, -णेक्तुम्, Ved. to wash away, cleanse.
प्रणेजन: प्र-णेजन, अस्, ई, अम्, washing away, wiping away; (अम्), n. washing away, wiping away, bathing; water for washing.
प्रणिज्ञा: प्रणिज्ञा प्र-णि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to consider, recollect.
प्रणिधा: प्रणिधा प्र-णि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to set in front, place in advance, cause to precede; to lay down, deposit; to lay on, impose, apply; to place in, lay in, bring into, infix, enchase; to include, inclose; to stretch out, stretch forth (the hand); to touch; to turn or direct (the eyes or thoughts) upon; (with मनस्) to concentrate the thoughts upon, give the whole attention to; to re-solve; to think; to send out or employ (a spy or emissary), spy.
प्रणिधान: प्र-णिधान, अम्, n. laying on, imposing, ap-plying, employing, application, employment, use; access, entrance; respectful conduct or behaviour towards, attention paid to (with loc.); profound re-ligious meditation; great effort, stress, energy; (with Buddhists) prayer, entreaty, supplication.
प्रणिधि: प्र-णिधि, इस्, m. observing, scrutinizing, spying out; sending out (spies or emissaries); a spy, secret agent, emissary; an attendant, a follower; care, attention; asking, solicitation, request; N. of a son of Bṛhad-ratha.
प्रणिधेय: प्र-णिधेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be applied or injected (as a clyster); to be sent out (as a spy); (अम्), n. employing; sending out (of emissaries).
प्रणिहित: प्र-णिहित, अस्, आ, अम्, laid on, applied, imposed; deposited; outstretched, stretched forth; delivered, entrusted, consigned; having the attention fixed, having the thoughts concentrated on one point, intent (= सम्-आहित); resolved, determined, de-cided; prudent, advised, careful, wary, cautious; discovered by spies, spied out; obtained, attained, received, acquired; acknowledged, previously agreed to or admitted.
प्रणिहित प्र-णिहित। See under प्र-णि-धा, p. 609, col. 3.
प्रणिध्यै: प्रणिध्यै प्र-णि-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्यायति, -ध्यातुम्, to give the attention to (with acc.).
प्रणिनद्: प्रणिनद् प्र-णि-नद्, cl. 1. P. -नदति, -न-दितुम्, to sound loudly, thunder.
प्रणिनदत्: प्र-णिनदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding deep or like thunder.
प्रणिनाद: प्र-णिनाद, अस्, m. a deep sound, that of thunder or the like.
प्रणिन्द्: प्रणिन्द् प्र-णिन्द् or प्र-निन्द्, cl. 1. P. -णिन्दति, -णिन्दितुम्, to blame, censure, upbraid.
प्रणिन्दन: प्र-णिन्दन or प्र-निन्दन, अम्, n. censuring, upbraiding.
प्रणिन्द्य: प्र-णिन्द्य or प्र-निन्द्य, ind. having censured or upbraided.
प्रणिपत्: प्रणिपत् प्र-णि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पति-तुम्, to throw one's self down before, fall prostrate before, bow down before, bow respectfully to (with acc. and sometimes with dat. or loc.): Caus. -पात-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to bow down, induce or cause to fall prostrate.
प्रणिपतन: प्र-णिपतन, अम्, n. falling down before, throw-ing one's self down at any one's feet, prostration; bowing or doing homage to, saluting.
प्रणिपतित: प्र-णिपतित, अस्, आ, अम्, bowed down in reverence, saluting.
प्रणिपत्य: प्र-णिपत्य, ind. having bowed down or in reverence, having saluted respectfully, having done homage to.
प्रणिपात: प्र-णिपात, अस्, m. falling at any one's feet, pros-tration, humble submission to (with gen.); saluta-tion, reverence, obeisance. —प्रणिपात-पुरः-सरम्, ind. preceded by prostration, with an obei-sance. —प्रणिपात-प्रतीकार, अस्, आ, अम्, having submission for a remedy, counteracted by submission. —प्रणिपात-रस, अस्, m. ‘taking pleasure in sub-mission,’ a magical formula pronounced over weapons.
प्रणिपातिन्: प्र-णिपातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, throwing one's self down or falling at the feet of, submitting, submissive.
प्रणिमा: प्रणिमा 1. प्र-णि-मा, cl. 3. A. -मिमीते, मातुम् (fr. rt. 2. मा), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 17.
प्रणिमा 2. प्र-णि-मा, cl. 2. P., 3. A. -माति, -मिमीते, -मातुम् (fr. rt. 4. मा), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 17, Vopa-deva VIII. 22, IX. 16.
प्रणिमि: प्रणिमि प्र-णि-मि, cl. 5. P. A. -मिनोति, -मिनुते, &c., see Vopa-deva XXVI. 212.
प्रणिया: प्रणिया प्र-णि-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to advance, proceed.
प्रणिशम्: प्रणिशम् प्र-णि-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमितुम्, to become calm, be pacified or appeased; to hear.
प्रणिहन्: प्रणिहन् प्र-णि-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्-तुम्, to slay, to kill (with gen.).
प्रणी: प्रणी 1. प्र-णी, cl. 1. P. A. -णयति, -ते, -णेतुम्, to lead forwards, advance, conduct, promote; to bring forwards, show, display; to bring; to offer, present; to direct or turn (the eyes) towards; (in liturgical language) to convey the sacrificial fire or water or Soma to its place at the altar; to bring into, reduce to (e. g. वशम् प्र-णी, to reduce to submission); to bring to pass, effect, accomplish, perform, execute, complete, finish; to apply; to manifest affection, show love or affection, love; to establish, institute, promulgate, teach; to write, com-pose; to cast, shoot, discharge; to do away with, remove, dispel; (with दण्डम्) to carry the rod, inflict punishment; (A.) to draw in (the breath): Desid. -णिनीषति, to desire to lead, wish to conduct (Ved.).
2. प्र-णी, ईस्, m., Ved. a leader, conductor; (ईस्), f. (according to Sāy.) = प्रणीयमाना स्तुतिः।
प्रणयत्: प्र-णयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, leading forwards, con-ducting; dispensing; decreeing, awarding.
प्रणयन: प्र-णयन, अम्, n. bringing forwards, conduct-ing; conveying, bringing, fetching [cf. अग्नि-षोम-प्°]; carrying out, executing, performing, practising; bringing forward, adducing; composing, writing; that in which anything is brought [cf. प्रणीता-प्°]; dispensing, distributing; decreeing, awarding, sen-tencing; (with दण्डस्य or दण्ड-प्°) carrying the rod, inflicting punishment.
प्रणयनीय: प्रणयनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, used in bringing or fetching (as wood employed in carrying the sacred fire; cf. अग्नि-प्°).
प्रणयिन्: प्र-णयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, feeling attracted towards, attached to, affectionate, loving, kind; liking, wish-ing or longing for, desirous of; beloved, dear; inti-mate, familiar; (ई), m. a friend, favourite; a lover, husband; a petitioner; a humble servant; (इनी), f. a female friend; a mistress, wife. —प्रणयि-क्रिया, f. the act of a lover or affectionate person. —प्रणयि-जन, अस्, m. a friendly person, a friend; a number of friends, friendly circle. —प्रणयि-ता, f. desire or longing for.
प्रणायक: प्र-णायक, अस्, m. a leader or commander (of an army), guide, chief.
प्रणाय्य: प्र-णाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be regarded with affec-tion, dear, beloved; blameless, upright, straight-forward; devoid of passion or desire (?) ; disap-proved, disagreeing.
प्रणिनीषेण्य: प्र-णिनीषेण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. appointed to lead or begin, appointed to be a commencement.
प्रणीत: प्र-णीत, अस्, आ, अम्, led forwards, advanced, promoted; brought; offered, presented, delivered, given; directed; conveyed (to the altar, as fire or water or Soma); brought into, reduced to; effected, accomplished, performed, executed, completed, finish-ed; made, done, constructed; prepared, dressed (as food), cooked; established, instituted, taught, said, declared; written, composed, compiled; thrown, cast, shot, discharged, sent; set aside, removed, dis-pelled, (exposed as a child?); beloved, dear [cf. मनः-प्°]; inflicted, decreed, sentenced, awarded; entered, approached; (अस्), m. fire consecrated by prayers or mystical formulas; (आ), f. a vessel used at sacrifices, a sort of cup; N. of a river; (आस्), f. pl., scil. आपस्, water fetched on the morning of a festi-val for sacrificial uses, holy water. —प्रणीता-प्रण-यन, अम्, n., Ved. the vessel in which holy water is fetched.
प्रणीति: प्र-णीति, इस्, f., Ved. conduct, leading, guidance; leading away; favour.
प्रणीय: प्र-णीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be led on, see Pāṇ. III. 1, 123.
प्रणेतव्य: प्र-णेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be led or guided; to be accomplished or executed, to be used or applied.
प्रणेतृ: प्र-णेतृ, ता, m. a leader, guide; a maker, framer, creator; an author, promulgator of a doctrine, teacher; a performer or one who plays a musical instrument. —प्रणेतृ-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. con-taining the notion of leading.
प्रणेनी: प्र-णेनी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. leading or guiding con-stantly or repeatedly; (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण नेता।)
प्रणेय: प्र-णेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guided or led, ductile, docile, submissive, obedient, tamable, yielding; to be executed or accomplished; to be fixed or settled; agreeable (?).
प्रणु: प्रणु प्र-णु, cl. 2. 6. P. and Ved. 1. A. -णौति, -णुवति, -णवते, -णवितुम्, -णुवितुम्, to roar, bellow, low; to resound, reverberate; to make a humming or droning sound, to utter the sacred syllable ॐ; to praise.
प्रणवक: प्र-णवक, अस्, m. (at the end of comps.) the mystical or sacred syllable ॐ।
प्रणुत: प्र-णुत, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, celebrated, lauded.
प्रणुद्: प्रणुद् 1. प्र-णुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -णुदति, -ते, -णोत्तुम्, to push or thrust forward, press forward, push on; to drive away, send away, repel, dispel; to scare or frighten away; to set in motion, drive; to stir: Caus. -णोदयति, -यितुम्, to push or thrust away; to move, excite; to press any one to do any-thing; to request any one for anything (with two acc.).
2. प्र-णुद्, त्, त्, त्, driving away, frightening or scaring away; forcing away, removing; directing, enjoining, who or what commands or enjoins.
प्रणुत्त: प्र-णुत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, pushed away, driven away, repelled; frightened or scared away.
प्रणुद: प्र-णुद, अस्, आ, अम्, driving away, frightening away; forcing away.
प्रणुदत्: प्र-णुदत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, driving away, dispelling.
प्रणुदित: प्र-णुदित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven away.

प्रति is also prefixed to nouns not immediately connected with verbs, to express equality, likeness, resemblance, or comparison; [cf. प्रति-चक्र, प्रति-चन्द्र।] (As a separable preposition with acc. and usu-ally but not invariably following its substantive), towards, to, unto, in the direction of (e. g. शब्दम् प्रति, in the direction of the sound, towards the place whence the sound came); down upon, upon; against, in opposition to, counter (e. g. यायाद् रिपुम् प्रति, he should march against the enemy; पाहि नस् त्वम् प्रति रीषतः, defend thou us against the enemy); over against, opposite, contra; in the presence of, before; in comparison with, in propor-tion to, on a par with (e. g. त्वं सहस्राणि प्रति, thou art on a par with, i. e. equivalent to, thousands); in the vicinity of, near, beside, by, at, on (e. g. गङ्गाम् प्रति, at or on the Ganges; आयोधनम् प्रति, on the field of battle); on the side of, in favour of; (distributively) in each, at or in every, according to each, severally (e. g. यज्ञम् प्रति, at every sacrifice; वर्षम् प्रति, every year, annually; in this sense प्रति is frequently used at the beginning of adv. comps., cf. प्रति-क्षणम्, प्रति-गृहम्); about, at the time of, during (e. g. फाल्गुनम् मासम् प्रति, about the month Phālguna; चिरम् प्रति, for a long time); in relation to, with refer-ence to, with regard to (e. g. धर्मम् प्रति, with regard to justice); concerning; on account of; according to (e. g. माम् प्रति, according to me, i. e. in my opinion), in conformity with, in pursuance of; a little (at the end of a comp., e. g. सूप-प्रति, a little broth, see Pāṇ. II. 1, 9). (As a separable preposition, with abl.), on a par with, on an equality with (also with adverbs ending with the affix तस्, e. g. नारायणतः प्रति, on an equality with Nārāyaṇa); in return for, as compen-sation for (e. g. उक्षा कपोतात् प्रति, an ox in return for a dove); in the place of, in lieu of, instead of. Native lexicographers explain the senses of प्रति by the following Sanskrit words: प्र-धान, क्षेप, निश्-चय, व्य्-आवृत्ति, प्र-शस्ति, वि-रोध, सम्-आधि: [cf. Zend paiti: Old Pers. pati-sh, ‘against:’ Gr. προ-τί, πα-τί, πρός for πρότ, πρόσ-θε-(ν): Lat. red- as in red-dere, red-ire; re- as in re-ferre; prœ for prai; por, pol, pos for port in the forms por-rigo, pol-liceor, pol-lus, pos-sides: Old Slav. proti: Lith. prësz, ‘against:’ Bohem. proti: Hib. frith, frioth, as in frithbeart, ‘I object, oppose;’ frithbuille, ‘a back-stroke;’ frithshearc, ‘a return of love, mutual regard;’ frithcuirim, ‘I oppose, obstruct;’ frithbharamhuil, ‘a paradox.’]

प्रतिकर्मन्: प्रति-कर्मन्, अ, n. requital, retaliation; redress, remedy; counteraction, counterworking; opposing, opposition; dress, decoration, toilet, personal embel-lishment; (अ), ind. at each celebration or perform-ance; in every work; अ-प्रतिकर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, (either) whose deeds are unmatched, (or) not offer-ing opposition; obedient.
प्रतिकारिन्: प्रति-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, counteracting, obviating, opposing; अ-प्रतिकारिन्, one who uses no remedies, one who does not allow himself to be attended by a physician.
प्रतिकार्य: प्रति-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be retaliated or re-venged; (अम्), n. retribution.
प्रतिकृत: प्रति-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered back, returned, repaid, recompensed, requited, retaliated; opposed, counteracted, remedied; (अम्), n. recompense, re-quital; resistance, opposition.
प्रतिकृति: प्रति-कृति, इस्, f. resistance, defence; retaliation, return, revenge; a reflected image, reflection, a shadow; an effigy, figure, image, statue, picture; a substitute.
प्रतिकृत्य: प्रति-कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be counteracted or remedied, remediable.
प्रतिक्रिया: प्रति-क्रिया, f. requital, retaliation, revenge; a re-turn for kindness received, recompense; opposition; counteracting, remedying; (medical) attendance; embellishment, decoration; defence, protection; a fence; succour, help, care.
प्रतिकॄ: प्रतिकॄ प्रति-कॄ, cl. 6. P. A. -किरति, -ते, -करितुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter towards; [cf. प्रति-स्-कॄ।]
प्रतिकॢप्: प्रतिकॢप् प्रति-कॢप्, cl. 4. A. -कल्पते, -कल्पितुम्, -कल्प्तुम्, Ved. to be at the service of (with acc.); to receive hospitably: Caus. -कल्-पयति, -यितुम्, to regulate, arrange.
प्रतिकोप: प्रतिकोप प्रति-कोप, अस्, m. anger against (any one), wrath; vexation.
प्रतिक्रम्: प्रतिक्रम् प्रति-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to come back, return.
प्रतिक्रम: प्रति-क्रम, अस्, m. reversed or inverted order.
प्रतिक्रमण: प्रति-क्रमण, अम्, n. (Ved.) stepping towards; (with Buddhists) confessing, making confession.
प्रतिक्रुध्: प्रतिक्रुध् प्रति-क्रुध्, cl. 4. P. -क्रुध्यति, -क्रोद्धुम्, to be angry with any one (acc.) in return (Manu VI. 48).
प्रतिक्रोध: प्रति-क्रोध, अस्, m. anger in return.
प्रतिक्रुष्ट: प्रतिक्रुष्ट प्रति-क्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. क्रुश् with प्रति), miserable, poor (said of a kind of soil).
प्रतिक्रोश: प्रति-क्रोश, अस्, m., Ved. crying out to, hallooing.
प्रतिक्रूर: प्रतिक्रूर प्रति-क्रूर, अस्, आ, अम्, cruel or harsh in return, returning harshness for harshness.
प्रतिक्षणम्: प्रतिक्षणम् प्रति-क्षणम्, ind. at every moment, every moment, momentarily, every in-stant; constantly, continually.
प्रतिक्षत्र: प्रतिक्षत्र प्रति-क्षत्र, अस्, m., N. of a descendant of Atri, author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 46; of a son of An-enas; of a son of Kṣatra-vṛddha; of a son of Śamin.
प्रतिक्षय: प्रतिक्षय प्रति-क्षय, अस्, m. a guard, at-tendant (‘protecting from injury or loss’).
प्रतिक्षि: प्रतिक्षि प्रति-क्षि (see rt. 2. क्षि), cl. 2. 6. P. -क्षेति, -क्षियति, -क्षेतुम्, Ved. to settle near.
प्रतिक्षिप्: प्रतिक्षिप् प्रति-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. -क्षिपति, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw or cast into; to push against, hurt; to revile, ridicule, reject.
प्रतिक्षिप्त: प्रति-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown into; turned away, rejected, dismissed; sent, dispatched; repelled, opposed, resisted; abused, reviled; calumniated, falsely accused; (अम्), n. medicine.
प्रतिक्षिप्य: प्रति-क्षिप्य, ind. having thrown into, having thrown.
प्रतिक्षेप: प्रति-क्षेप, अस्, m. contradicting, contradiction; opposing, controverting, contravening; contest, con-testing; not acknowledging, rejecting.
प्रतिक्षेपण: प्रति-क्षेपण, अम्, n. contradicting, opposing, controverting, contesting.
प्रतिक्षुत: प्रतिक्षुत प्रति-क्षुत, अम्, n. sneezing, wheezing.
प्रतिखुर: प्रतिखुर प्रति-खुर, अस्, m. a particular wrong position of a child at birth.
प्रतिख्या: प्रतिख्या प्रति-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्या-तुम्, to see, behold.
प्रतिख्याति: प्रति-ख्याति, इस्, f. renown; (also read प्र-विख्याति।)
प्रतिगज: प्रतिगज प्रति-गज, अस्, m. a hostile ele-phant, elephant standing opposite; [cf. प्रति-कुञ्-जर।]
प्रतिगद्: प्रतिगद् प्रति-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, -गदि-तुम्, to speak in return, answer.
प्रतिगम्: प्रतिगम् प्रति-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-तुम्, to go or advance towards, go to meet; to go back, return, go home.
प्रतिगत: प्रति-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, flying backwards and for-wards, wheeling in flight; lost from the memory.
प्रतिगमन: प्रति-गमन, अम्, n. going back, returning, return.
प्रतिगर: प्रति-गर, अस्, m., Ved. the Adhvaryu's response to the address of the Hotṛ.
प्रतिगर्ज्: प्रतिगर्ज् प्रति-गर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -गर्जति, -गर्-जितुम्, to roar at, roar against, roar at one another; to answer with roars; to resist, oppose.
प्रतिगर्जत्: प्रति-गर्जत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, roaring against; mur-muring against, rebelling; reverberating, echoing.
प्रतिगर्जना: प्रति-गर्जना, f. roaring against, answering roar.
प्रतिगर्हित: प्रतिगर्हित प्रति-गर्हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. गर्ह् with प्रति), blamed (Rām. VI. 103, 15; per-haps wrongly for प्रति गर्हित).
प्रतिगा: प्रतिगा प्रति-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to go back, return.
प्रतिगात्रम्: प्रतिगात्रम् प्रति-गात्रम्, ind. in every limb.
प्रतिगाह्: प्रतिगाह् प्रति-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गा-हितुम्, -गाढुम्, to penetrate, enter.
प्रतिगिरि: प्रतिगिरि प्रति-गिरि, इस्, m. an opposite mountain; an inferior mountain or anything like a mountain.
प्रतिगीर्य: प्रति-गीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be answered with a response in singing.
प्रतिगु: प्रतिगु प्रति-गु, Caus. P. -गावयति, -यि-तुम्, Ved. to proclaim.
प्रतिगुप्त: प्रतिगुप्त प्रति-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, guarded, protected.
प्रतिगुप्य: प्रति-गुप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guarded or pro-tected.
प्रतिगृध्: प्रतिगृध् प्रति-गृध्, cl. 4. P. -गृध्यति, -गर्धितुम्, to be greedy or eager for (with acc.).
प्रतिगृहम्: प्रतिगृहम् प्रति-गृहम्, ind. in every house.
प्रतिगृहीत: प्रतिगृहीत प्रति-गृहीत। See under प्रति-ग्रह्, p. 613, col. 1.
प्रति-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken hold of; taken, accepted, received; assented to, admitted; taken as a wife, married.
प्रतिगॄ: प्रतिगॄ प्रति-गॄ, cl. 9. P. A. -गृणाति, -गृ-णीते, -गरितुम्, -गरीतुम्, to invoke, salute (Ved.); to answer or make responses in recitation or singing (Ved.); to agree with any one (with dat.).
प्रतिगरितृ: प्रति-गरितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who ejaculates or utters a response.
प्रतिगेहम्: प्रतिगेहम् प्रति-गेहम्, ind. in every house.
प्रतिग्रह्: प्रतिग्रह् प्रति-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम् (an irreg. 2nd sing. Impv. प्रति-गृह्ण is used in Rāmāyaṇa III. 9, 27), to take hold of, grasp, seize; to eclipse; to take up, collect, admit; to take, eat, drink; to take posses-sion of, occupy; to take away, deprive of; to receive, accept (शिरसा प्रति-ग्रह्, to accept anything and place it on the head as a mark of respect); to receive an enemy, attack, assault, assail; to receive a friend, give a friendly reception to, welcome; to take as a wife, choose for a husband, wed, marry; to hear, hear with pleasure; to accept what is said as a good omen; to express assent, approve, attend, pay attention to: Caus. -ग्राहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to accept, give, present.
प्रतिगृहीतव्य: प्रति-गृहीतव्य, a wrong form for प्रति-ग्र-हीतव्य, q. v.
प्रतिगृहीतृ: प्रति-गृहीतृ, a wrong form for प्रति-ग्र-हीतृ, q. v.
प्रतिगृह्य: 1. प्रति-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accepted, acceptable; one from whom anything may be ac-cepted.
2. प्रति-गृह्य, ind. having taken or received; bringing up the rear.
प्रतिग्रह: प्रति-ग्रह, अस्, m. receiving, accepting, accept-ance, receiving a donation; the right of accepting gifts (as the peculiar prerogative of Brāhmans); one who receives, a receiver; a gift, present; a proper donation or fit present to a Brāhman at suitable periods; receiving kindly, friendly reception; taking a wife, marrying; favour, grace; hearing, hearken-ing, listening; the reserve of an army, a detach-ment posted with the general four hundred yards in the rear of the line; a spitting-pot, spittoon; the sun near the moon's node; = क्रिया-कार।
प्रतिग्रहण: प्रति-ग्रहण, अस्, ई, अम्, receiving, accepting; (अम्), n. receiving, reception, receiving presents; receiving a bride, marrying; a vessel.
प्रतिग्रहणीय: प्रति-ग्रहणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or accepted, acceptable.
प्रतिग्रहिन्: प्रति-ग्रहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who receives, a receiver (opposed to दातृ).
प्रतिग्रहीतव्य: प्रति-ग्रहीतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or accepted, allowed to be taken or received; to be received (in a friendly manner), to be welcomed.
प्रतिग्रहीतृ: प्रति-ग्रहीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who receives or accepts, a receiver; one who takes in marriage, one who marries.
प्रतिग्राह: प्रति-ग्राह, अस्, m. receiving, accepting gifts; a spitting-pot, spittoon.
प्रतिग्राहक: प्रति-ग्राहक, अस्, इका, अम्, receiving gifts or presents.
प्रतिग्राहिन्: प्रति-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who accepts, re-ceiving presents.
प्रतिग्राह्य: 1. प्रति-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken or ac-cepted, acceptable, admissible; one from whom anything may be received.
2. प्रति-ग्राह्य, ind. having caused to accept, having offered.
प्रतिग्रामम्: प्रतिग्रामम् प्रति-ग्रामम्, ind. in every village.
प्रतिघ: प्रतिघ प्रति-घ, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-हन्), resistance, opposing, opposition; mutual beating, striking back again, fighting, combat; anger, wrath, rage, passion; an enemy; fainting; (अस्, आ, अम्), inimical, adverse.
प्रतिघात: प्रति-घात, अस्, m. (or प्रती-घात, q. v.), ward-ing off a blow, keeping back, repulse; hinderance, opposition, resistance; reaction; preventing, prohi-biting; a blow in return; rebound.
प्रतिघातक: प्रति-घातक, अस्, इका, अम्, disturbing, inter-rupting, troubling; (at the end of an adj. comp.) = प्रति-घात।
प्रतिघातन: प्रति-घातन, अम्, n. warding off, repulsing; killing, slaughter.
प्रतिघातिन्: प्रति-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, keeping off, repelling, repulsing; troubling, encroaching, injuring; hostile, opposed to; reacting.
प्रतिघ्नत्: प्रति-घ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, opposing, impeding; destructive; hostile.
प्रतिघोषिन्: प्रतिघोषिन् प्रति-घोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. घुष् with प्रति), Ved. roaring against, sounding against.
प्रतिचक्र: प्रतिचक्र प्रति-चक्र, अम्, n. a discus that will bear comparison with others, a discus which is a match for any other; (perhaps) a corresponding or subordinate wheel.
प्रतिचक्ष्: प्रतिचक्ष् प्रति-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, &c., to see, perceive, become aware of; to expect; to cause to see, cause to appear, bring to light.
प्रतिचक्षण: प्रति-चक्षण, अम्, n. looking at, viewing; making visible; appearance, look, aspect.
प्रतिचक्ष्य: प्रति-चक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. visible.
प्रतिचन्द्र: प्रतिचन्द्र प्रति-चन्द्र, अस्, m. a mock moon, paraselene.
प्रतिचर्: प्रतिचर् प्रति-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -चरि-तुम्, to advance towards, approach (Ved.): Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to make current, circulate, pro-claim, publish.
प्रतिचारित: प्रति-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, circulated, proclaimed, published.
प्रतिचरणम्: प्रतिचरणम् प्रति-चरणम्, ind. in every school or branch.
प्रतिचिकीर्षा: प्रतिचिकीर्षा प्रति-चिकीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of प्रति-कृ), wish to requite, desire of retaliation or revenge, desire to be avenged upon (with acc. or loc.).
प्रतिचिकीर्षु: प्रति-चिकीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to requite, desirous of retaliating.
प्रतिचिति: प्रतिचिति प्रति-चिति, ind., Ved. in every layer or pile, in each layer or course (of faggots, bricks, &c.).
प्रतिचिन्त्: प्रतिचिन्त् प्रति-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. A. -चिन्त-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to think or reflect on; to consider again, remember.
प्रतिचिन्तन: प्रति-चिन्तन, अम्, n. thinking repeatedly, con-sidering, meditating upon.
प्रतिचिन्तनीय: प्रति-चिन्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reflected upon anew, to be thought over again.
प्रतिचुद्: प्रतिचुद् प्रति-चुद्, cl. 10. P. -चोदयति, -यितुम्, to drive on, push on, impel, urge on, insti-gate; to fall upon, assail, attack.
प्रतिचोदनम्: प्रति-चोदनम्, ind. (fr. प्रति + चोदन), Ved. according to order or injunction.
प्रतिचोदित: प्रति-चोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled, one who has pushed against or assailed (with acc.).
प्रतिच्छद्: प्रतिच्छद् प्रति-च्छद् (प्रति-छद्), cl. 10. P. (poet. also A.) -च्छादयति (-ते), -यितुम्, to cover over, cover, clothe, envelop; to obscure; to hide, conceal, disguise; to endow.
प्रतिच्छदन: प्रति-च्छदन, अम्, n. a cover, a piece of cloth for a covering.
प्रतिच्छन्न: प्रति-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, covered, overlaid, clotted, enveloped; obscured; hidden, con-cealed, disguised; beset, enclosed, hemmed in; fur-nished with, provided with.
प्रतिच्छन्द: प्रतिच्छन्द प्रति-च्छन्द, अस्, m. a reflected image, likeness, any image, picture, statue; a sub-stitute.
प्रतिच्छन्दक: प्रति-च्छन्दक, अस्, m. an image; a substitute.
प्रतिच्छाया: प्रतिच्छाया प्रति-च्छाया (प्रति-छाया), f. a reflected image, a shade, shadow; an image, statue, picture, bas-relief.
प्रतिच्छिद्: प्रतिच्छिद् प्रति-च्छिद् (प्रति-छिद्), cl. 7. P. A. -च्छिनत्ति, -च्छिन्त्ते, -च्छेत्तुम्, to tear off, cut off; to retaliate by cutting to pieces.
प्रतिच्छेद: प्रति-च्छेद, अस्, m. cutting off; resistance, oppo-sition.
प्रतिच्यवीयस्: प्रतिच्यवीयस् प्रति-च्यवीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (fr. rt. च्यु), Ved. pressing closer against or towards; (Sāy. प्र-च्यवीयसी = पुमांसम् प्रति शरीर-स्यात्यन्तं च्यावयित्री।)
प्रतिजङ्घा: प्रतिजङ्घा प्रति-जङ्घा, f. the shin-bone; the fore part of the leg.

प्रतिजन: प्रतिजन प्रति-जन, अस्, m., Ved. an ad-versary.

प्रतिजप्: प्रतिजप् प्रति-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -जपि-तुम्, Ved. to mutter in response.
प्रतिजल्प्: प्रतिजल्प् प्रति-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -जल्-पितुम्, to answer, reply.
