प्रतिजल्पक: प्रति-जल्पक, अस्, m. a reply expressing assent, respectful concurrence; a polite but evasive answer (?).
प्रतिजागृ: प्रतिजागृ प्रति-जागृ, cl. 2. P. -जागर्ति, जागरितुम्, Ved. to watch beside (another).
प्रतिजागर: प्रति-जागर, अस्, m. vigilance, watchfulness, attention.
प्रतिजागरण: प्रति-जागरण, अम्, n. watching, guarding, attending to.
प्रतिजागरणक: प्रति-जागरणक, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?), a district.
प्रतिजि: प्रतिजि प्रति-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, Ved. to conquer, defeat (at play): Desid. -जिगीषति, to wish to conquer or defeat, to attack, assault, assail.
प्रतिजिह्वा: प्रतिजिह्वा प्रति-जिह्वा or प्रति-जिह्विका, f. the uvula or soft palate.
प्रतिजीवन: प्रतिजीवन प्रति-जीवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जीव् with प्रति), returning to life, resuscitation.
प्रतिजुष्: प्रतिजुष् प्रति-जुष्, cl. 6. A. -जुषते, -जो-षितुम्, Ved. to be kind, act tenderly towards; to receive with pleasure, delight in, be gratified by: Caus. -जोषयति, -यितुम्, to coax, caress.
प्रतिजूतिवर्पस्: प्रतिजूतिवर्पस् प्रतिजूति-वर्पस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. victorious over enemies (Sāy. = प्रतिपक्षा-भिभवन-शील-तेजो-युक्त).
प्रतिजॄ: प्रतिजॄ प्रति-जॄ, cl. 1. A. -जरते, -जरितुम्, -जरीतुम्, Ved. to roar (as fire) in the direction of (Sāy. = अभि-वृध्, to increase); to call out to, salute (Sāy. = स्तु, to praise).
प्रतिज्ञा: प्रतिज्ञा 1. प्रति-ज्ञा, cl. 9. A. (ep. also P.) -जानीते, -जानाति, -ज्ञातुम्, to admit, own, acknow-ledge, recognise, allow, take in good part; to ap-prove, consent; to promise (with gen., dat., or loc. of the person, and acc. or dat. of the thing); to maintain, uphold, assert, affirm, allege; to bring forward or introduce (a topic); to perceive, observe, learn, discern, become aware of; (A.) to confirm, assent, answer in the affirmative; to propose; (P. A.) to remember with regret, remember sorrowfully.

2. प्रति-ज्ञा, f. admission, acknowledgment; as-sent; a solemn declaration, agreement, engagement, promise, vow; a statement, assertion, affirmation, declaration, allegation; (in logic) a proposition, the assertion to be proved, the first member or अवयव of the five-membered Nyāya syllogism (in the usual standing example = ‘this hill is fiery’); (in law) a plaint, complaint, indictment; (अया), ind. by ex-press rule; in the manner laid down. —प्रतिज्ञान्-तर (°ज्ञा-अन्°), अम्, n. (in logic) a subsequent proposition on failure of the first. —प्रतिज्ञा-पत्त्र or प्रतिज्ञा-पत्त्रक, अम्, n. a promissory note, a written contract, bond. —प्रतिज्ञा-परि-शिष्ट, अम्, n., N. of a treatise by Kātyāyana. —प्रतिज्ञा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the breaking or breach of a promise. —प्रतिज्ञाभङ्ग-भीरु, उस्, उस्, उ, fearful or apprehensive of breaking a promise. —प्र-तिज्ञा-विरोध, अस्, m. acting contrary to promise or agreement; denial of a logical proposition. —प्र-तिज्ञा-विवाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, promised in marriage, betrothed. —प्रतिज्ञा-सन्न्यास, अस्, m. breaking a promise; abandonment of the original proposition (in logic). —प्रतिज्ञा-हानि, इस्, f. giving up the pro-position or argument.
प्रतिज्ञात: प्रति-ज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम्, asserted, propounded, declared, stated, proposed, deposed, alleged; admitted, acknowledged; promised, agreed; agreeable, desira-ble; (अम्), n. anything promised, a promise. —प्र-तिज्ञातार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. a statement, averment.
प्रतिज्ञातव्य: प्रति-ज्ञातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be assented to, to be promised, &c.
प्रतिज्ञाति: प्रति-ज्ञाति, इस्, f. a wrong form for प्रति-प्र-ज्ञाति, q. v.
प्रतिज्ञान: प्रति-ज्ञान, अम्, n. admission, assent, agreement, engagement, promise; asserting, assertion; bringing forward or introducing (a topic).
प्रतिज्ञापित: प्रति-ज्ञापित, अस्, आ, अम्, betrayed; (a various reading for प्र-ज्ञापित।)
प्रतिज्ञाय: प्रति-ज्ञाय, ind. having admitted or acknow-ledged; having promised; having maintained or asserted.
प्रतिज्ञेय: प्रति-ज्ञेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be promised or assented to; (अस्), m. the reciter or pronouncer of a pane-gyric, a proclaimer of rank and titles, herald, bard, panegyrist.
प्रतिज्वल्: प्रतिज्वल् प्रति-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति, -ज्व-लितुम्, to flame, blaze, shine.
प्रतितड्: प्रतितड् प्रति-तड्, cl. 10. P. -ताडयति, -यि-तुम्, to strike in return, strike again.
प्रतितत्त्वसिद्धान्त: प्रतितत्त्वसिद्धान्त प्रति-तत्त्व-सिद्धान्त, अस्, m. a conclusion adopted by each disputant.
प्रतितन्त्रम्: प्रतितन्त्रम् प्रति-तन्त्रम्, ind. according to each Tantra, according to each opinion.
प्रतितप्: प्रतितप् प्रति-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्, to throw out heat towards; to heat, warm, foment.
प्रतितर: प्रतितर प्रति-तर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. तॄ with प्रति), a sailor, oarsman, ferryman.
प्रतितराम्: प्रतितराम् प्रति-तराम्, ind. (compar. fr. 1. प्रति), Ved. with rt. भू, to become shorter or more contracted; (according to a Scholiast = अत्यन्-तम् प्रतिकूल।)
प्रतितरु: प्रतितरु प्रति-तरु, ind. at each tree.
प्रतिताल: प्रतिताल प्रति-ताल or प्रति-तालक, अस्, m. (in music) a particular time, a kind of air or melody; (ई), f. the key of a door or padlock, an instrument to open a door.
प्रतितूणी: प्रतितूणी प्रति-तूणी, f. a modification of the nervous disease called Tūṇī; [cf. प्र-तूणी।]
प्रतित्र्यहम्: प्रतित्र्यहम् प्रति-त्र्यहम्, ind. for three days at a time.
प्रतिथि: प्रतिथि प्र-तिथि, इस्, m., N. of a teacher with the epithet Deva-ratha.
प्रतिदण्ड: प्रतिदण्ड प्रति-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. re-fractory, disobedient, obstinate.
प्रतिदर्श: प्रति-दर्श, अस्, m., Ved. looking at, viewing.
प्रतिदह्: प्रतिदह् प्रति-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्-धुम्, Ved. to burn towards, encounter with flames, consume (Sāy. = सर्वथा भस्मी-कृ): Pass. -दह्-यते, to be burnt or consumed by fire.
प्रतिदा: प्रतिदा प्रति-दा, cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, दातुम्, to give in return, give as a reward, give back, return, restore; to retort; to give: Caus. -दापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be given back, cause to be restored.
प्रतिदत्त: प्रति-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, given back. See प्रती-त्त।
प्रतिदातव्य: प्रति-दातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given back, to be restored.
प्रतिदान: प्रति-दान, अम्, n. giving back, restoring (a deposit), restitution, restoration; returning, a gift in return; exchange, barter.
प्रतिदेय: प्रति-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given back or returned, to be given as an equivalent; (अम्), n. a pledge, pawn; an article purchased and given back.
प्रतिदारण: प्रतिदारण प्रति-दारण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. दॄ with प्रति), battle, fighting, fierce conflict.
प्रतिदिनम्: प्रतिदिनम् प्रति-दिनम्, ind. day by day, daily, every day.
प्रतिदिवन्: प्रतिदिवन् प्रति-दिवन्, आ, m. (fr. rt. 2. दिव् with प्रति), the sun; a day.
प्रतिदीवन्: प्रति-दीवन्, आ, m. an adversary at play (Ved.); the sun.
प्रतिदिवसम्: प्रतिदिवसम् प्रति-दिवसम्, ind. day after day, daily, day by day.
प्रतिदिश्: प्रतिदिश् प्रति-दिश्, Caus. P. -देशयति, -यि-तुम्, to point towards, point out; to enjoin, teach; to direct; to confess.
प्रतिदिशम्: प्रति-दिशम्, ind. (fr. प्रति + २। दिश्), in every di-rection, from every quarter; everywhere, all around.
प्रतिदेशम्: प्रति-देशम्, ind. (fr. प्रति + देश), in every re-gion, in each district or country, in every country.
प्रतिदुह्: प्रतिदुह् प्रति-दुह्, धुक् (gender doubtful; inst. -दुहा or -धुषा, gen. -दुहस् or -धुषस्), Ved. fresh milk, milk still warm.
प्रतिदूत: प्रतिदूत प्रति-दूत, अस्, m. a messenger or ambassador sent in return.
प्रतिदूषित: प्रतिदूषित प्रति-दूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, defiled, rendered unclean, contaminated.
प्रतिदृश्: प्रतिदृश् प्रति-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्, to look at, behold; to become aware of, experience, know; A. -पश्यते or Pass. -दृश्-यते, to come in sight, become visible or perceptible, appear: Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to see, to show; to teach.
प्रतिदर्शन: प्रति-दर्शन, अम्, n. seeing, perceiving; (at the end of comps.) appearance, look.
प्रतिदृशम्: प्रति-दृशम्, ind. (fr. प्रति + २। दृश्), in every eye, for every eye.
प्रतिदृष्ट: प्रति-दृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, beheld; become visible, come in sight.
प्रतिदेवतम्: प्रतिदेवतम् प्रति-देवतम्, ind., Ved. for every deity.
प्रतिदेवता: प्रति-देवता, f., Ved. a corresponding deity.
प्रतिदेहम्: प्रतिदेहम् प्रति-देहम्, ind. in each body, in every body.
प्रतिदोषम्: प्रतिदोषम् प्रति-दोषम्, ind., Ved. in the evening, in the dark.
प्रतिद्रु: प्रतिद्रु प्रति-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रो-तुम्, to run towards, run to.
प्रतिद्रुह्: प्रतिद्रुह् 1. प्रति-द्रुह्, cl. 4. P. -द्रुह्यति, -द्रोहितुम्, -द्रोग्धुम्, -द्रोढुम्, to injure in return, retaliate an injury.
2. प्रति-द्रुह्, ध्रुक्, क्, क्, or ध्रुट्, ट्, ट्, seeking to injure in return, wishing to retaliate an injury.
प्रतिद्वन्द्व: प्रतिद्वन्द्व प्रति-द्वन्द्व, अस्, m. an oppo-nent, antagonist, adversary, rival; an enemy, foe; (अम्), n. opposition, hostility.
प्रतिद्वन्द्विन्: प्रति-द्वन्द्विन्, ई, m. an opponent, adversary, rival; (ई, इनी, इ), hostile, opposed; (at the end of a comp.) rivalling, vying with.
प्रतिद्वारम्: प्रतिद्वारम् प्रति-द्वारम्, ind. at every gate, at each door.
प्रतिद्विरद: प्रतिद्विरद प्रति-द्विरद, अस्, m. an opposite elephant, a hostile elephant; [cf. प्रति-कुञ्जर।]
प्रतिधर्तृ: प्रतिधर्तृ प्रति-धर्तृ। See under प्रति-धृ, col. 3.
प्रति-धर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who keeps back or stops, one who checks; (according to Mahī-dhara = निर्-आकर्तृ।)
प्रतिधा: प्रतिधा 1. प्रति-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम् (mostly Ved.), to place on, place within; to put back; to replace, restore, give back to (with loc. or dat.); to fix (an arrow on the bow-string); to put to the lips (in drinking, Ṛg-veda IV. 27, 5); to set (the foot) upon; to offer, pre-sent; to use, employ; (A.) to begin, commence; to draw near, come on (said of the night).
2. प्रति-धा, f., Ved. putting to the lips (in drinking); a draught.
प्रतिधान: प्रति-धान, अम्, n. putting on; adopting pre-cautions.
प्रतिधि: प्रति-धि, इस्, m., Ved. a particular part of a chariot, pieces of wood fastened across the pole; (according to Mahī-dhara) = अन्न।
प्रतिधाव्: प्रतिधाव् प्रति-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run back; to rush upon, assail, attack.
प्रतिधावन: प्रति-धावन, अम्, n. running against, rushing upon, assailing, attacking.
प्रतिधुर: प्रतिधुर प्रति-धुर, अस्, m. a horse har-nessed by the side of another, one horse of a pair.
प्रतिधृ: प्रतिधृ प्रति-धृ, cl. 10. P. -धारयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to keep back, stop, check; to keep erect, support.
प्रतिधृष्: प्रतिधृष् प्रति-धृष्, cl. 1. 5. P. -धर्-षति, -धृष्णोति, -धर्षितुम् (Ved. -धृषे), to be bold against, brave, defy; to withstand, resist; to sustain, endure.
प्रतिधृष्य: प्रति-धृष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be braved or defied, to be withstood or resisted, resistible.
प्रतिध्यै: प्रतिध्यै प्रति-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्यायति, -ध्यातुम्, to think upon, hit upon an idea, devise.
प्रतिध्यात: प्रति-ध्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, thought upon, medi-tated on, devised.
प्रतिध्वनि: प्रतिध्वनि प्रति-ध्वनि, इस्, m. or प्रति-ध्वान, अस्, अम्, m. n. echo, reverberated sound.
प्रतिध्वस्त: प्रतिध्वस्त प्रति-ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cast down, downcast; forsaken (?).
प्रतिनद्: प्रतिनद् प्रति-नद्, cl. 1. P. -नदति, -नदि-तुम्, to sound back, repeat or re-echo a sound; to answer with a cry or with a shout: Caus. -नादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to resound, make resonant, fill with repeated roaring, fill with cries; to cry aloud.
प्रतिनाद: प्रति-नाद, अस्, m. echo, resonance, reverberation.
प्रतिनादित: प्रति-नादित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to resound, resonant, resounding, echoing, echoed.
प्रतिनिनद: प्रति-निनद, अस्, m. an echo, a reverberation.
प्रतिनन्द्: प्रतिनन्द् प्रति-नन्द्, cl. 1. P. -नन्दति, -नन्दितुम्, to greet cheerfully, accept or receive gladly, take thankfully (Manu II. 54); to greet in return, return a salute, salute, bid welcome, bid farewell; to address kindly, express gratification, display affection or devotion; to favour; (with न), to decline, refuse: Caus. -नन्दयति, -यितुम्, to gladden, delight, gratify.
प्रतिनन्दन: प्रति-नन्दन, अम्, n. greeting, salutation (Ved.); thankful acceptance; the act of returning thanks at meals, thanksgiving.
प्रतिनप्तृ: प्रतिनप्तृ प्रति-नप्तृ, ता, m. a great grand-son, a son's grandson; [cf. प्र-णपात्।]
प्रतिनम्: प्रतिनम् प्रति-नम्, cl. 1. P. -नमति, -नन्-तुम्, Ved. to bow or incline towards.
प्रतिनमस्कार: प्रति-नमस्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. returning a salutation.
प्रतिनर्द्: प्रतिनर्द् प्रति-नर्द्, cl. 1. P. -नर्दति, -नर्-दितुम्, to utter sounds or cries against; to greet or hail with cries; to roar after (prey or food).
प्रतिनव: प्रतिनव प्रति-नव, अस्, आ, अम्, new, young, fresh, recent; blown, budded. —प्रतिनव-जवा, f. a fresh or newly opened China rose.
प्रतिनाग: प्रतिनाग प्रति-नाग, अस्, m. an elephant standing opposite, a hostile elephant; [cf. प्रति-कुञ्जर।]
प्रतिनाडी: प्रतिनाडी प्रति-नाडी, f. a branch vein.
प्रतिनामन्: प्रतिनामन् प्रति-नामन्, आ, म्नी, अ, Ved. having corresponding names, related by name.
प्रतिनायक: प्रति-नायक, अस्, m. ‘counter hero,’ the adver-sary of the hero of a play.
प्रतिनिक्षिप्: प्रतिनिक्षिप् प्रति-नि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to put down again, de-posit again.
प्रतिनिगद्: प्रतिनिगद् प्रति-नि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, -गदितुम्, Ved. to speak to, address.
प्रतिनिग्रह्: प्रतिनिग्रह् प्रति-नि-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्-णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, Ved. to take up (liquids with a ladle or other vessel), ladle out.
प्रतिनिधा: प्रतिनिधा प्रति-नि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put in the place of another, substitute; to set aside, slight, disregard; to command, order.
प्रतिनिधाय: प्रति-निधाय, ind. having placed in, having implanted.
प्रतिनिधि: प्रति-निधि, इस्, m. substitution; a substitute, re-presentative, proxy, deputy, vicegerent; a surety; a resemblance of a real form, an image, likeness, statue, picture.
प्रतिनिन्द्: प्रतिनिन्द् प्रति-निन्द्, cl. 1. P. -निन्दति, -निन्-दितुम्, to inveigh against, abuse, blame, censure.
प्रतिनिपात: प्रतिनिपात प्रति-निपात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. पत् with प्रति-नि), falling down, alighting.
प्रतिनियत: प्रतिनियत प्रति-नियत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. यम्), settled, predestined.
प्रतिनियम: प्रति-नियम, अस्, m. a general rule, general prevalence.
प्रतिनिर्जि: प्रतिनिर्जि प्रति-निर्-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to prevail against, overcome, vanquish; to rescind.
प्रतिनिर्जित: प्रति-निर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, prevailed against, van-quished; rescinded.
प्रतिनिर्दिश्: प्रतिनिर्दिश् प्रति-निर्-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to point back, refer back.
प्रतिनिर्देश: प्रति-निर्देश, अस्, m., Ved. pointing or referring back to (with gen.).
प्रतिनिर्देशक: प्रति-निर्देशक, अस्, इका, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) pointing back, referring back.
प्रतिनिर्यत्: प्रतिनिर्यत् प्रति-निर्-यत्, Caus. P. -यात-यति, -यितुम्, to give back, return.
प्रतिनिर्यातन: प्रति-निर्यातन, अम्, n. giving back, returning; rewarding, retaliation.
प्रतिनिवारण: प्रतिनिवारण प्रति-निवारण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वृ with प्रति-नि), keeping off, warding off.
प्रतिनिवासन: प्रतिनिवासन प्रति-निवासन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 5. वस् with प्रति-नि), a kind of garment (with Buddhists).
प्रतिनिविष्ट: प्रतिनिविष्ट प्रति-निविष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, har-dened, obstinate, obdurate. —प्रतिनिविष्ट-मूर्ख, अस्, m. an obstinate fool, confirmed blockhead.
प्रतिनिवृत्: प्रतिनिवृत् प्रति-नि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to turn back or round, turn away from; to return; to run away, take flight.
प्रतिनिवर्तन: प्रति-निवर्तन, अम्, n. turning back, turning away from; returning, return.
प्रतिनिवृत्त: प्रति-निवृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, turned away from, desisted from, leaving, withdrawn from; come back, returned.
प्रतिनिशम्: प्रतिनिशम् प्रति-निशम्, ind. every night, nightly, by night.
प्रतिनिष्पू: प्रतिनिष्पू प्रति-निष्-पू (-निस्-पू), cl. 9. P. A. -पुनाति, -पुनीते, -पवितुम्, Ved. to cleanse or winnow close at hand (?).
प्रतिनी: प्रतिनी प्रति-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to lead back; to lead to, bring towards; to put into, mix.
प्रतिनुद्: प्रतिनुद् प्रति-नुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -नुदति, -ते, -नोत्तुम्, to thrust back, repel, repulse, ward off.
प्रतिनोद: प्रति-नोद, अस्, m. thrusting back, repelling, repulse.
प्रतिनृत्: प्रतिनृत् प्रति-नृत्, cl. 4. P. -नृत्यति, -नर्-तितुम्, to dance before (in token of contempt), to mock in turn by dancing before (with acc.).
प्रतिन्यस्: प्रतिन्यस् प्रति-न्य्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असि-तुम्, to place apart or lay down separately (for different persons), deposit.
प्रतिन्यायम्: प्रतिन्यायम् प्रति-न्यायम्, ind., Ved. in inverted order.
प्रतिन्यूङ्ख: प्रतिन्यूङ्ख प्रति-न्यूङ्ख, अस्, m., Ved. a cor-responding insertion of the vowel ओ; [cf. न्यूङ्ख।]
प्रतिप: प्रतिप प्रतिप, अस्, m., N. of a king of the lunar race the father of Śāntanu and grandfather of Bhīṣma; (more correctly spelt प्रतीप, q. v.)
प्रतिपक्ष: प्रतिपक्ष प्रति-पक्ष, अस्, m. the opposite side or party, opposite faction, opposition, hostility; an adversary, enemy, foe, opponent, rival; a respond-ent, defendant; N. of a prince; (also read प्रति-क्षत्र।) —प्रतिपक्ष-ता, f. or प्रतिपक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. opposition, enmity; obstacle. —प्रति-पक्ष-वादित्व, अम्, n. contradictory or deceitful conversation, double dealing.
प्रतिपक्षित: प्रतिपक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, containing a contra-diction; nullified by a contradictory premiss (one of the five kinds of fallacious middle terms).
प्रतिपक्षिन्: प्रतिपक्षिन्, ई, m. an opponent, adversary. —प्रतिपक्षि-ता, f. self-contradiction, the being self-contradictory.
प्रतिपण: प्रतिपण प्रति-पण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. पण् with प्रति), barter, exchange (Ved.); (fr. प्रति + पण), the stake of an adversary at play.
प्रतिपत्: प्रतिपत् प्रति-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पति-तुम्, to fly or hasten towards, hasten to meet.
प्रतिपथम्: प्रतिपथम् प्रति-पथम्, ind. along the road, by the way; straightway (?). —प्रतिपथ-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, going on the road, wending the way.
प्रतिपथिक: प्रतिपथिक, अस्, आ, अम्, going along the road, wending the way.
प्रतिपद्: प्रतिपद् 1. प्रति-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to set foot on, step upon, step up to; to light upon, meet with, find; to go towards, approach, betake one's self to, resort to, take refuge with; to go into, enter; to arrive at, reach, attain; to gain, get, obtain, share, partake of; to receive back, re-gain, reobtain, recover; to go back, return; to walk, roam, wander, go; to perceive, observe, become aware of, become conscious of; to find out, discover; to obtain a knowledge of, become acquainted with, learn; to comprehend, understand, know; to regard as, consider, deem; to affirm, admit; to answer affirmatively, express assent, comply with, consent, agree, promise; to permit, allow; to avow, acknow-ledge; to begin to speak, begin to answer, commence a reply; to apply one's self to, perform, practise, observe, fulfil, accomplish; to do anything to any one (with loc. or gen.), undertake anything against, pro-ceed against; to act towards; to take place, occur, transpire; to give, give up, restore, return; उत्तरम् प्रति-पद्, to give an answer: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go back, bring back, lead back; to convey or transport to (a place); to cause to attain, cause to share in, cause to partake of; to give to (with loc., dat., or gen.), deliver over, present, bestow; to communicate, impart, teach; to declare, represent, assert; to establish, substantiate, prove; to explain, expound, make clear; to consider, regard as, deem; to appoint to, install in (with loc.); to procure; to prepare; to effect, cause: Desid. of Caus. -पिपादयिषति, to wish or intend to explain or analyze.

2. प्रति-पद्, त्, f. access, ingress, entrance, way; beginning, commencement; an introductory verse or stanza; the first day of a lunar fortnight, the first day of the moon's increase or wane (especially of the former, cf. प्रति-पदा); understanding, intel-ligence, intellect; rank, consequence; a kettle-drum. —प्रतिपत्-तूर्य, अम्, n. a kind of kettle-drum; [cf. प्रतिपत्ति-पटह।]
प्रतिपत्तव्य: प्रति-पत्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be obtained, to be received; to be assumed or supposed, to be stated; to be given (as an answer); to be begun; to be done or performed.
प्रतिपत्ति: प्रति-पत्ति, इस्, f. gaining, getting, obtaining, acquirement, gain; becoming aware of, perception, observation, ascertainment, determination, knowledge; intelligence, intellect; assertion, affirmation, state-ment, opinion; acknowledgment, admitting, admis-sion, assent; undertaking, beginning, commence-ment; doing, acting, action, proceeding; worldly action; mode of acting, procedure; method, means; use, application; giving, imparting, bestowing, pre-sentation; causing; elevation, exaltation, promotion, preferment; acquirement of rank or dignity, repu-tation, fame, renown; honouring, worshipping, honour, respectful behaviour; inspiring trust or con-fidence; resoluteness, boldness, assurance, reliance, confidence; comprehending, including, conclusion; conviction, proof; misleading, deceiving (?); a rite from which no advantage is expected (?). —प्रति-पत्ति-कर्मन्, अ, n., Ved. a concluding rite or ceremony. —प्रतिपत्ति-दक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, know-ing how to act, knowing what is to be done. —प्र-तिपत्ति-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, showing what ought to be done. —प्रतिपत्ति-निष्ठुर, अस्, आ, अम्, hard to understand, difficult to be understood. —प्रतिपत्ति-पटह, अस्, m. a kind of kettle-drum, the state drum allowed only to chiefs of a certain rank; [cf. प्रति-पत्-तूर्य below.] —प्रतिपत्ति-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, averse from compliance, obstinate, unyielding. —प्रतिपत्ति-प्रदान, अम्, n. the giving of pre-ferment, conferring promotion. —प्रतिपत्ति-भेद, अस्, m. diversity of views, difference of opinions. —प्रतिपत्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing appro-priate knowledge, knowing what is to be done; in-telligent; active, prompt; celebrated, high in rank. —प्रतिपत्ति-विशारद, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing how to act, knowing what is to be done, expert, clever.
प्रतिपत्तृ: प्रति-पत्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who maintains or asserts.
प्रतिपद: प्रति-पद, अम्, n., N. of an Upāṅga; (आ or ई), f. the first day of a lunar fortnight, the first day of the moon's increase or wane (especially of the former, cf. 2. प्रति-पद्); (अम्), ind. (fr. प्रति + पद), see p. 616, col. 1.
प्रतिपन्न: प्रति-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, come up to, approached, reached, obtained, gained; overcome, conquered, subdued; done, effected, accomplished; undertaken; answered, replied; offered, promised, engaged; as-sented to, agreed to, accepted, admitted; known, understood, ascertained, determined; convicted, proved, demonstrated; conversant or familiar with; acting.
प्रतिपन्नक: प्रतिपन्नक, अस्, m. ‘arrived at an aim,’ (with Buddhists) a collective epithet of the four orders of Āryas, viz. the Śrota-āpanna, Sakṛd-āgāmin, An-āgāmin, and Arhat.
प्रतिपादक: प्रति-पादक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to obtain, giving, granting, bestowing, presenting to (with loc.); stating, establishing, supporting, demonstrating, communicating, treating of, speaking about; explain-ing, explanatory, illustrating, teaching; productive, effective, efficient, accomplishing; advancing, for-warding, furthering, promoting; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), a receptacle for hair. —प्रतिपादक-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of one who explains, explaining.
प्रतिपादन: प्रति-पादन, अम्, n. causing to come back, bringing back; causing to reach or attain, causing to obtain; imparting, giving, presenting, donation, gift; giving back, returning, restoring; appointing; producing, exciting, causing; accomplishing, effect-ing; action, worldly conduct; repeated action, prac-tice; treating of, discussing, rendering clear or intel-ligible, expounding, explaining, teaching, declaring, affirming, declaration; establishing, proving, substan-tiating; beginning, commencement.
प्रतिपादनीय: प्रति-पादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given, to be given in marriage; to be accomplished; to be dis-cussed, to be treated of or expounded; to be esta-blished or proved, to be maintained.
प्रतिपादम्: प्रति-पादम्, ind. (fr. प्रति + पाद), in every Pāda, in each quarter or fourth part of a verse.
प्रतिपादयितृ: प्रति-पादयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who discusses or expounds, a teacher, instructor.
प्रतिपादित: प्रति-पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to attain; given, delivered, presented; caused, produced; declared, represented, stated, asserted, proved, maintained; explained, expounded.
प्रतिपादुक: प्रति-पादुक, अस्, ई, अम्, determining, ascertain-ing; making manifest or clear; causing, effecting.
प्रतिपाद्य: प्रति-पाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be treated of or dis-cussed, to be explained or expounded.
प्रतिपित्सा: प्रति-पित्सा, f. desire of obtaining, longing for.
प्रतिपित्सा प्रति-पित्सा, प्रति-पित्सु, प्रति-पिपादयिषु। See col. 1.
प्रतिपित्सु: प्रति-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to obtain, striv-ing for.
प्रतिपिपादयिषु: प्रति-पिपादयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to explain, about to treat of.
प्रतिपदम्: प्रतिपदम् प्रति-पदम्, ind. at every step, on every occasion; at every place, everywhere; in every word; verbally, expressly, especially. —प्रति-पद-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. advancing step by step.
प्रतिपराणी: प्रतिपराणी प्रति-परा-णी, cl. 1. P. A. -ण-यति, -ते, -णेतुम्, Ved. to lead back.
प्रतिपरी: प्रतिपरी प्रति-परी (-परि-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -पर्य्-एति, -एतुम्, Ved. to go round in a reverse direction.
प्रतिपरे: प्रतिपरे प्रति-परे (-परा-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2. P. -परैति, -परैतुम्, Ved. to return again.
प्रतिपर्णशिफा: प्रतिपर्णशिफा प्रति-पर्ण-शिफा, f. the plant Anthericum Tuberosum (= द्रवन्ती).
प्रतिपर्व: प्रतिपर्व प्रति-पर्व, ind., Ved. at each Parvan.
प्रतिपल्लव: प्रतिपल्लव प्रति-पल्लव, अस्, m. an opposite branch.
प्रतिपा: प्रतिपा प्रति-पा (see Caus. of rt. 3. पा), Caus. P. -पालयति, -यितुम्, to protect, defend; to cherish, nourish, foster, rear, patronize; to observe, keep, maintain; to wait, wait for, expect.
प्रतिपालक: प्रति-पालक, अस्, इका, अम्, protecting, defending, preserving, cherishing; (अस्), m. a protector, guardian, a king.
प्रतिपालन: प्रति-पालन, अम्, n. protecting, guarding, de-fending, cherishing; keeping up, observing, follow-ing, practising.
प्रतिपालनीय: प्रति-पालनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be protected or cherished; to be observed or followed; to be awaited, to be waited for, to be watched.
प्रतिपालयितव्य: प्रति-पालयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be protected or guarded; to be awaited, to be waited for, to be watched.
प्रतिपालित: प्रति-पालित, अस्, आ, अम्, protected, cherished; practised, followed.
प्रतिपालिन्: प्रति-पालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, protecting, guarding, screening.
प्रतिपाल्य: प्रति-पाल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be protected or che-rished; to be awaited, to be waited for.
प्रतिपाण: प्रतिपाण प्रति-पाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. पण् with प्रति), ready to exchange, bartering (Ved.); (अस्), m. a stake, gage, the thing played for; a counter-pledge, anything staked against another thing; a counter-stake, counter-game; [cf. प्रति-पण।]
प्रतिपात्रम्: प्रतिपात्रम् प्रति-पात्रम्, ind. (in dramatic language) in each part, in each character, by every actor.
प्रतिपादपम्: प्रतिपादपम् प्रति-पादपम्, ind. in every tree.
प्रतिपान: प्रतिपान प्रति-पान, अम्, n. water for drinking.
प्रतिपाप: प्रतिपाप प्रति-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, wicked or evil in return, recompensing evil for evil.
प्रतिपिष्: प्रतिपिष् प्रति-पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि, -पेष्टुम्, to rub one thing against another, rub together; to rub one's self against; to bruise, grind, crush, destroy in turn.
प्रतिपीड्: प्रतिपीड् प्रति-पीड्, Caus. P. -पीडयति, -यि-तुम्, to press, press hard, oppress, harass, distress.
प्रतिपीडन: प्रति-पीडन, अम्, n. oppressing, harassing, mo-lesting.
प्रतिपीय्: प्रतिपीय् प्रति-पीय् (see rt. 2. पीय्), cl. 1. P. -पीयति, -पीयितुम्, Ved. to revile, abuse, treat with contempt or disrespect.
प्रतिपुरुष: प्रतिपुरुष प्रति-पुरुष or प्रति-पूरुष, अस्, m. ‘a counter-person,’ a corresponding or similar man; a companion, assistant; a deputy, substitute; an effigy, the effigy of a man which thieves push into the interior of a house before entering it them-selves; (अम्), ind. man by man, every man, for each man; for each soul.
प्रतिपुष्यम्: प्रतिपुष्यम् प्रति-पुष्यम्, ind., Ved. at each time of the moon's entrance into the asterism Puṣya.
प्रतिपुस्तक: प्रतिपुस्तक प्रति-पुस्तक, अम्, n. a copy of an original manuscript, a copy in general.
प्रतिपूज्: प्रतिपूज् प्रति-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यितुम्, to show respect towards, honour; to salute respectfully, salute in turn, return a salutation, honour; to praise, commend, approve.
प्रतिपूजक: प्रति-पूजक, अस्, इका, अम्, doing homage, honouring; (अस्), m. one who does homage, a reverer.
प्रतिपूजन: प्रति-पूजन, अम्, n. or प्रति-पूजा, f. doing homage, showing respect, honouring; exchange of civilities, mutual obeisance or reverence.
प्रतिपूजित: प्रति-पूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured, respected, treated with reverence or respect; exchanged as civilities.
प्रतिपूज्य: 2. प्रति-पूज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be treated with respect, to be honoured.
2. प्रति-पूज्य, ind. having done homage to, having exchanged respectful salutations.
प्रतिपूर्वाह्णम्: प्रतिपूर्वाह्णम् प्रति-पूर्वाह्णम्, ind. every forenoon, every morning.
प्रतिपॄ: प्रतिपॄ प्रति-पॄ, Caus. P. -पूरयति, -यि-तुम्, to fill up, fill, make full; to fill with, to sate, satiate, satisfy, content.
प्रतिपूरण: प्रति-पूरण, अम्, n. filling up, filling; injecting a fluid or other substance, pouring a fluid over.
प्रतिपूरित: प्रति-पूरित, अस्, आ, अम्, filled up, filled; satisfied, contented.
प्रतिपूर्ण: प्रति-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, filled with, full, full of; satisfied.
प्रतिप्रग्रह्: प्रतिप्रग्रह् प्रति-प्र-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्-णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to take up or receive again.
प्रतिप्रछ्: प्रतिप्रछ् प्रति-प्रछ्, cl. 6. P. -पृच्छति, -प्रष्टुम्, to ask, question, interrogate, inquire of.
प्रतिप्रश्न: प्रति-प्रश्न, अस्, m. a question asked in return; an answer; (Ved.) an umpire (?).
प्रतिप्रश्न प्रति-प्रश्न। See under प्रति-प्रछ् above.
प्रतिप्रज्ञा: प्रतिप्रज्ञा प्रति-प्र-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, Ved. to seek out or find again.
प्रतिप्रज्ञाति: प्रति-प्रज्ञाति, इस्, f., Ved. distinguishing; recog-nition, acknowledgment.
प्रतिप्रणवम्: प्रतिप्रणवम् प्रति-प्रणवम्, ind. at every repetition of the sacred syllable ॐ. —प्रतिप्रणव-संयुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied each time with the syllable ॐ।
प्रतिप्रणाम: प्रतिप्रणाम प्रति-प्रणाम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. नम् with प्रति-प्र), a bow or obeisance in return, saluting in turn.
प्रतिप्रति: प्रतिप्रति प्रति-प्रति, इस्, इनी, इ, Ved. being a counterpart, counter-balancing; being a match for, equal to (with acc.).
प्रतिप्रतीकम्: प्रतिप्रतीकम् प्रति-प्रतीकम्, ind., Ved. at each beginning, at every commencement.
प्रतिप्रदा: प्रतिप्रदा प्रति-प्र-दा, cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, -दातुम्, to give back again; to give up, deliver.
प्रतिप्रत्त: प्रति-प्रत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. given up, delivered.
प्रतिप्रदान: प्रति-प्रदान, अम्, n. giving back, returning, restoring; giving in marriage.
प्रतिप्रब्रू: प्रतिप्रब्रू प्रति-प्र-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. -ब्रवीति, &c., Ved. to speak to in return, address in reply, reply, answer.
प्रतिप्रभ: प्रतिप्रभ प्रति-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a de-scendant of Atri, author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 49; (आ), f. reflection, reflected light.
प्रतिप्रयम्: प्रतिप्रयम् प्रति-प्र-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्, to give back, return, restore.
प्रतिप्रयवण: प्रतिप्रयवण प्रति-प्रयवण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. यु with प्रति-प्र), repeated mixture.
प्रतिप्रया: प्रतिप्रया प्रति-प्र-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -या-तुम्, to go back, come back, return.
प्रतिप्रयाण: प्रति-प्रयाण, अम्, n. going back, return, retreat.
प्रतिप्रसव: प्रतिप्रसव प्रति-प्रसव, अस्, m. a counter-order, countermand, suspension of a general prohi-bition in a particular case, license for an act which under other circumstances is forbidden; the laying down of excepted cases; contrary effect.
प्रतिप्रसूत: प्रति-प्रसूत, अस्, आ, अम्, re-enjoined after having been forbidden.
प्रतिप्रस्थातृ: प्रतिप्रस्थातृ प्रति-प्रस्थातृ, ता, m. (fr. rt. स्था with प्रति-प्र), Ved., N. of a priest who assists the Adhvaryu.
प्रतिप्रस्थान: प्रति-प्रस्थान, अम्, n. the office of the Prati-prasthātṛ; N. of a particular Soma-graha (Ved.).
प्रतिप्रास्थानिक: प्रतिप्रास्थानिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the work or office of the Prati-prasthātṛ; प्रतिप्रास्थानिकं कर्म, the office of the Prati-prasthātṛ.
प्रतिप्रहार: प्रतिप्रहार प्रति-प्रहार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हृ with प्रति-प्र), a counter-blow, returning a blow or stroke.
प्रतिप्रह्वे: प्रतिप्रह्वे प्रति-प्र-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्व-यति, -ते, -ह्वातुम्, Ved. to invite to (a sacrifice), invoke.
प्रतिप्राकार: प्रतिप्राकार प्रति-प्राकार, अस्, m. an outer wall or rampart.
प्रतिप्राश्: प्रतिप्राश् प्रति-प्राश्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. consuming another's food.
प्रतिप्रास्: प्रतिप्रास् प्रति-प्रास् (-प्र-अस्; see rt. 2. अस्), cl. 4. P. -प्रास्यति, -प्रासितुम्, to throw or cast upon.
प्रतिप्रिय: प्रतिप्रिय प्रति-प्रिय, अम्, n. kindness in turn, service in return.
प्रतिप्रैष: प्रतिप्रैष प्रति-प्रैष, अस्, m., Ved. a cry or call in return, direction given in return.
प्रतिप्लवन: प्रतिप्लवन प्रति-प्लवन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. प्लु with प्रति), jumping back, leaping back.
प्रतिफल्: प्रतिफल् प्रति-फल्, cl. 1. P. -फलति, -फ-लितुम्, to bound against, rebound; to shine back, be reflected; to requite.
प्रतिफल: प्रति-फल, अस्, m. or प्रति-फलन, अम्, n. a reflection, reflected image, image, shadow; return, reward, remuneration, requital, retaliation, retribution.
प्रतिफलित: प्रति-फलित, अस्, आ, अम्, reflected, shadowed, represented; requited, returned.
प्रतिफुल्लक: प्रतिफुल्लक प्रति-फुल्लक, अस्, आ, अम्, flower-ing, in blossom.
प्रतिबन्ध्: प्रतिबन्ध् प्रति-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. A. -बध्-नाति, -बध्नीते, -बन्द्धुम्, to bind to, make fast, moor; to set, enchase; to fix, direct; to shut out, exclude, preclude, cut off; to keep off, keep at a distance; to obstruct.
प्रतिबद्ध: प्रति-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound to, tied to, bound, tied, moored; attached, hanging to; con-nected with, subject, dependant; furnished with, possessing; set, enchased, inlaid, bestudded; fixed, directed; excluded, cut off; hindered, impeded, ob-structed, opposed, precluded, prevented; disappointed, thwarted, crossed, vexed; kept off, kept at a dis-tance; tangled, entangled, involved, hard to loose; (in philosophy) that which is always connected and implied, as fire is implied in smoke. —प्रतिबद्ध-प्रसर, अस्, आ, अम्, hindered or blunted in its course (as a thunderbolt). —प्रतिबद्ध-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, pervaded by passion or having passion in harmonious connection (with gesture).
प्रतिबधक: प्रति-बधक, अस्, m. an opposer, injurer (?).
प्रतिबध्य: प्रति-बध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bound or tied to; to be hindered or obstructed.
प्रतिबन्ध: प्रति-बन्ध, अस्, m. binding or tying to; con-nection, conjunction; investment, blockade, beleaguer-ing, siege; blocking up, obstacle, hinderance, impedi-ment; resistance; cessation; disappointment. —प्र-तिबन्ध-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creating obstacles, hin-dering, preventing. —प्रतिबन्ध-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, beset with obstacles, in which obstacles are met with, difficult to attain.
प्रतिबन्धक: प्रति-बन्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, binding or tying to; obstructing, obstructive, hindering, impeding, being an obstacle; resisting; (अस्), m. a branch, shoot; N. of a prince; (at the end of a comp.) an obstacle, impediment, hinderance.
प्रतिबन्धन: प्रति-बन्धन, अम्, n. binding or tying to, binding, confinement; obstructing, impeding.
प्रतिबन्धि: प्रति-बन्धि, इस्, m. a contradiction, objection.
प्रतिबन्धिन्: प्रति-बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, binding or tying to; encountering obstacles, impeded, interrupted; (at the end of a comp.) hindering, obstructing. —प्रतिबन्-धि-ता, f. the being an obstacle, obstructiveness, im-peding, checking.
प्रतिबन्धु: प्रतिबन्धु प्रति-बन्धु, उस्, m. an equal in rank or station.
प्रतिबल: प्रतिबल प्रति-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, having equal strength or power, of equal strength, equally matched, a match for (with gen. or at the end of a comp., e. g. अस्त्र-प्°, equal in arms); able, adequate, powerful.
प्रतिबाणि: प्रतिबाणि प्रति-बाणि, इस्, इ, f. n. an answer; (इस्, इस्, इ), improper, unseemly, unsuitable.
प्रतिबाध्: प्रतिबाध् प्रति-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, बाधितुम्, to beat back, repel, ward off, to keep off, combat; to restrain, check; to pain, torment, torture.
प्रतिबाधक: प्रति-बाधक, अस्, इका, अम्, thrusting back, re-jecting, repelling; opposing, obstructing, withstanding, precluding, preventing.
प्रतिबाधन: प्रति-बाधन, अम्, n. beating back, repelling, rejecting, keeping off.
प्रतिबाधिन्: प्रति-बाधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, opposing; (ई), m. an opponent.
प्रतिबाहु: प्रतिबाहु प्रति-बाहु, उस्, m. a particular part of the arm; N. of one of the sons of Śvaphalka.
प्रतिबीज: प्रतिबीज प्रति-बीज, अम्, n. bad or rotten seed.
प्रतिबुध्: प्रतिबुध् प्रति-बुध्, cl. 4. A. -बुध्यते, -बोधितुम्, to awaken, awake, wake; to perceive, observe, remark, learn: Caus. -बोधयति, -यितुम्, to awaken; to instruct, inform, admonish; to com-mission, charge, order.
प्रतिबुद्ध: प्रति-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened, awake (Manu I. 74); illuminated, enlightened; recognised, observed; known, celebrated; exalted, rendered prosperous or great. —प्रतिबुद्ध-वस्तु, उस्, उस्, उ, understanding the real nature of things. —प्रति-बुद्धात्मन् (°ध-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, having the mind roused or awakened, awake.
प्रतिबुद्धक: प्रति-बुद्धक, अस्, आ, अम्, in अ-प्°, not recog-nised.
प्रतिबुद्धि: प्रति-बुद्धि, इस्, f. awakening; hostile disposition or purpose (= शत्रु-बुद्धि). —प्रतिबुद्धि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having hostile intentions.
प्रतिबोध: प्रति-बोध, अस्, m. awaking, waking; percep-tion, knowledge; instructing, instruction; admonish-ing; N. of a man. —प्रतिबोध-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, endowed with knowledge or reason, possessed of understanding. —प्रतिबोधी-पुत्र (?), अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
प्रतिबोधक: प्रति-बोधक, अस्, इका, अम्, awakening; admon-ishing, instructing.
प्रतिबोधन: प्रति-बोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, awakening [cf. दुः-स्वप्न-प्°]; refreshing; (अम्), n. awaking, awaken-ing; instructing, instruction, explanation.
प्रतिबोधित: प्रति-बोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened; instructed, taught.
प्रतिबोधिन्: प्रति-बोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, awaking, about to awake.
प्रतिब्रू: प्रतिब्रू प्रति-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. A. -ब्रवीति, -ब्रूते, -वक्तुम्, to answer (with acc. of the person or two acc.); (A.) to contradict, deny, refuse; to resist.
प्रतिभक्ष्: प्रतिभक्ष् प्रति-भक्ष्, cl. 10. P. -भक्ष-यति, -यितुम्, Ved. to eat separately, eat alone.
प्रतिभज्: प्रतिभज् प्रति-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते, -भक्तुम्, to receive back as a part or share; to fall again to one's share; to return to (with acc.).
प्रतिभाग: प्रति-भाग, अस्, m. division; a share, portion, small daily present of fruit, flowers, vegetables, &c. offered to a Rājā or prince (Manu VIII. 307); (अम्), ind. for every portion or degree. —प्रति-भाग-शस्, ind. according to particular divisions or classification; in divisions or classes.
प्रतिभञ्ज्: प्रतिभञ्ज् प्रति-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, -भङ्क्तुम्, Ved. to fracture, break in pieces.
प्रतिभट: प्रतिभट प्रति-भट, अस्, आ, अम्, vying with, rivalling, emulating. —प्रतिभट-ता, f. emulous-ness, emulation.
प्रतिभण्: प्रतिभण् प्रति-भण्, cl. 1. P. -भणति, -भ-णितुम्, to speak in reply, answer.
प्रतिभणित: प्रति-भणित, अस्, आ, अम्, answered, replied.
प्रतिभय: प्रतिभय प्रति-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, exciting fear, formidable, terrible, terrific, horrific, fearful, frightful; dangerous; (अम्), n. anything formidable or dangerous, fear, danger; (अम्), ind. formidably, frightfully. —प्रतिभयङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing fear. —प्रतिभयाकार (°य-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing a formidable aspect.
प्रतिभा: प्रतिभा 1. प्रति-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भा-तुम्, to shine upon (with acc.); to appear, seem (e. g. इति प्रतिभाति मे मनः, so it seems to my mind); to come in sight, present one's self, offer one's self to (with gen. or acc.); to appear clear to the mind, flash upon the thoughts, come into the mind, occur to (e. g. नोत्तरम् प्रतिभाति मे, no answer occurs to me); to fall to the lot of, come into the possession of (with gen. or acc.); to seem fit, appear good, please (with acc.).

2. प्रति-भा, f. an image; look, appearance, manifestation; light, splendor [cf. निष्-प्रतिभ]; reflected light; a flashing thought, bright idea, bril-liant conception; understanding, intelligence, intel-lect (especially as opening or expanding); genius, wit, ingenuity; audacity, boldness, impudence, confi-dence; pleasingness, suitableness; (अस्, आ, अम्), clear, bright; intelligent, clever (?). —प्रतिभान्वित (°भा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, endowed with or acquiring knowledge or experience, intelligent; confident, proud, audacious, bold. —प्रतिभा-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘bold-faced,’ arrogant, bold, confident. —प्रति-भा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bright, luminous; knowing, shrewd; confident, bold; (आन्), m. the sun; the moon; fire. —प्रतिभा-विलास, अस्, m., N. of a philosophical work (also called Vedārtha-pradīpa and Vedārtha-candra). —प्रतिभा-हानि, इस्, f. privation of light, dulness, darkness; loss or absence of know-ledge, want of sense.
प्रतिभान: प्रति-भान, अम्, n. light, splendor, brilliancy; intelligence, understanding; brilliance of conception; confidence, boldness, audacity. —प्रतिभान-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —प्रतिभान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bright, brilliant, luminous, splendid; intelligent, acute, shrewd; endowed with presence of mind, bold, prompt, audacious.
प्रतिभानु: प्रति-भानु, उस्, m., N. of a descendant of Atri, author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 48.
प्रतिभाव: प्रतिभाव प्रति-भाव। See under 1. प्रति-भू below.
प्रति-भाव, अस्, m. corresponding character or disposition. —प्रतिभाव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having corresponding or congenial characters, social.
प्रतिभाष्: प्रतिभाष् प्रति-भाष्, cl. 1. A. -भाषते, -भाषितुम्, to address in turn, answer; to address, speak to (with acc.); to tell, relate; to call, name.
प्रतिभाषा: प्रति-भाषा, f. an answer, reply, rejoinder.
प्रतिभास्: प्रतिभास् प्रति-भास्, cl. 1. A. -भासते, -भासितुम्, to appear, become clear or evident, manifest or reveal one's self; to reflect.
प्रतिभास: प्रति-भास, अस्, m. appearance, look, similitude; appearing or occurring to the mind; illusion.
प्रतिभासन: प्रति-भासन, अम्, n. appearing, appearance, look, semblance.
प्रतिभिद्: प्रतिभिद् प्रति-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति, -भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to pierce through, pierce, pene-trate; to disclose, betray; to express displeasure, reproach, censure; to disown, reject, part from.
प्रतिभिद्य: प्रति-भिद्य, ind. having pierced or penetrated; having betrayed.
प्रतिभिन्न: प्रति-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, pierced through, pierced; separated, divided; in immediate contact, closely con-nected with (with inst.).
प्रतिभेद: प्रति-भेद, अस्, m. splitting, cleaving, dividing; discovery, betrayal.
प्रतिभेदन: प्रति-भेदन, अम्, n. piercing, penetrating; splitting, cleaving, cutting; separating, dividing.
प्रतिभुज्: प्रतिभुज् प्रति-भुज्, cl. 7. P. -भुनक्ति, -भोक्तुम्, to enjoy.
प्रतिभू: प्रतिभू 1. प्रति-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to be equal to or on a par with (with acc.): Caus. -भावयति, -यितुम्, to observe, con-sider, become acquainted with: Pass. of Caus. -भा-व्यते, to be considered or regarded as.
2. प्रति-भू, ऊस्, m. a surety, security, bail.
प्रतिभूष्: प्रतिभूष् प्रति-भूष्, cl. 1. P. -भूषति, -भूषितुम्, Ved. to make ready, prepare, fit out, equip; to adorn; to serve, wait upon; to honour, worship; to accord, accede, acquiesce, comply.
प्रतिभृ: प्रतिभृ प्रति-भृ, cl. 1. 3. P. A. -भरति, -ते, -बिभर्ति, -बिभृते, -भर्तुम्, Ved. to carry towards, offer, present.
प्रतिभृत: प्रति-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. offered, presented (as Soma).
प्रतिमङ्गलवार: प्रतिमङ्गलवार प्रतिमङ्गल-वार, आस्, m. pl. (probably) every festive day, all festivals.
प्रतिमण्ठक: प्रतिमण्ठक प्रति-मण्ठक, a particular term in music (= मण्ठक).
प्रतिमण्ड्: प्रतिमण्ड् प्रति-मण्ड्, cl. 1. P. -मण्डति, -मण्डितुम्, to decorate, adorn.
प्रतिमण्डित: प्रति-मण्डित, अस्, आ, अम्, decorated, adorned.
प्रतिमण्डल: प्रतिमण्डल प्रति-मण्डल, अम्, n. a se-condary disk (of the sun &c.); an eccentric orbit.
प्रतिमत्स्य: प्रतिमत्स्य प्रतिमत्स्य, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (also read प्रतिमास्य।)
प्रतिमन्: प्रतिमन् प्रति-मन्, cl. 8. A. -मनुते, -म-नितुम्, to reply, rejoin (Ved.); to compare with (Ved.): Caus. -मानयति, -यितुम्, to honour, hold in honour; to applaud; to consider, regard.
प्रतिमन्त्र्: प्रतिमन्त्र् प्रति-मन्त्र्, cl. 10. P. -मन्त्र-यति, -यितुम्, to call out or reply to (Ved.); to consecrate with sacred texts.
प्रतिमन्त्रण: प्रति-मन्त्रण, अम्, n., Ved. an answer, reply.
प्रतिमन्त्रम्: प्रति-मन्त्रम्, ind., Ved. with or at every for-mula or verse.
प्रतिमन्त्रित: प्रति-मन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, consecrated with sacred texts.
प्रतिमन्दिरम्: प्रतिमन्दिरम् प्रति-मन्दिरम्, ind. in every house.
प्रतिमन्यूय: प्रतिमन्यूय प्रति-मन्यूय (fr. प्रति + मन्-यु), Nom. A. प्रतिमन्यूयते, &c., to manifest resentment towards, pour out one's fury upon.
प्रतिमर्श: प्रतिमर्श प्रति-मर्श, अस्, m. (fr. rt. मृश् with प्रति), a kind of powder used as a sternutatory.
प्रतिमल्ल: प्रतिमल्ल प्रति-मल्ल, अस्, m. an opponent in wrestling or boxing, antagonist; a rival.
प्रतिमा: प्रतिमा 1. प्रति-मा, cl. 2. P., 3. 4. A. -माति, -मिमीते, -मायते, -मातुम्, to imitate, copy (Ved.); to compare.

2. प्रति-मा, आस्, m. a creator, maker, framer (Ved.); (आ), f. an image, likeness, resemblance (frequently at the end of comps. in the sense of ‘like, similar, resembling, equal to,’ e. g. अमर-प्°, like an immortal), picture, figure, idol; a symbol; a reflection; measure, extent; the part of an ele-phant's head between the tusks; a metre consist-ing of twelve syllables. —प्रतिम-ता (?), f. or प्रतिम-त्व (?), अम्, n. reflection, image, shadow. —प्रतिमा-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘gone to a statue,’ present in an idol (as a deity). —प्रतिमा-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘reflection-moon,’ the reflected moon, image of the moon. —प्रतिमा-परिचारक, अस्, m. an attendant upon an idol (= देवल, q. v.). —प्रतिमा-विशेष, अस्, m. a sort of image, a kind of figure or character. —प्रतिमा-शशाङ्क, अस्, or प्रतिमेन्दु (°मा-इन्°), उस्, m. ‘reflection-moon,’ the reflected moon, image of the moon.

प्रतिमित: प्रति-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, imitated, copied; com-pared; reflected, mirrored.
प्रतिमेय: प्रति-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be likened or com-pared, comparable.
प्रतिमाया: प्रतिमाया प्रति-माया, f. illusion or magical power applied in return, counter-spell, counter-charm.
प्रतिमार्गक: प्रतिमार्गक प्रति-मार्गक, अस्, m. the city of Hari-ścandra (said to hover in the air).
प्रतिमार्गम्: प्रति-मार्गम्, ind. the way back, back, back-wards.
प्रतिमाला: प्रतिमाला प्रति-माला, f. an exercise ana-logous to capping verses, reciting verse for verse as a trial of memory or skill.
प्रतिमासम्: प्रतिमासम् प्रति-मासम्, ind. every month, month by month, monthly.

प्रतिमित्: प्रतिमित् प्रति-मित्, त्, f., Ved. (fr. rt. मि with प्रति), a prop, stay, support.

प्रतिमिह्: प्रतिमिह् प्रति-मिह्, cl. 1. P. -मेहति, -मे-ढुम्, to make water in the direction of (with acc.).
प्रतिमीव्: प्रतिमीव् प्रति-मीव्, cl. 1. P. -मीवति, -मी-वितुम्, Ved. to push or press back; to close by pressing, shut.
प्रतिमुकुलम्: प्रतिमुकुलम् प्रति-मुकुलम्, ind. in or upon every bud.

(in dramatic language) a secondary plot or inci-dent calculated either to hasten or retard the catas-trophe; (अम्), ind. towards; in front, in the presence of, before. —प्रतिमुखागत (°ख-आग्°), अस्, आ, अम्, come against or into collision; come before or in front of. —प्रतिमुखाङ्ग (°ख-अङ्°), अम्, n. (in dramatic language) progressive narration of events.

प्रतिमोचन: प्रति-मोचन, अम्, n. loosening, loosing; libera-tion, release.
प्रतिमोचित: प्रति-मोचित, अस्, आ, अम्, released, liberated; rescued, saved, delivered.

प्रतिमुद्रा: प्रतिमुद्रा प्रति-मुद्रा, f. a counter-seal; the impression of a seal.

प्रतिमुहुस्: प्रति-मुहुस्, ind. again and again, repeatedly.
प्रतिमोहयत्: प्रति-मोहयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. bewildering, confounding.
प्रतिमुहूर्तम्: प्रतिमुहूर्तम् प्रति-मुहूर्तम्, ind. every mo-ment, constantly.
प्रतिमूर्ति: प्रतिमूर्ति प्रति-मूर्ति, इस्, f. a corresponding form, the counterpart of any real form, an image, resemblance, likeness.
प्रतिमषिका: प्रतिमषिका प्रति-मूषिका, f. a species of rat.
प्रतिमोक्ष: प्रतिमोक्ष प्रति-मोक्ष, अस्, m. liberation, deliverance; (with Buddhists) emancipation.
प्रतिमोक्षण: प्रति-मोक्षण, अम्, n. liberation, deliverance; emancipation.
प्रतियत्: प्रतियत् प्रति-यत्, Caus. or cl. 10. P. -यातयति, -यितुम्, to retaliate, requite.
प्रतियत्न: प्रति-यत्न, अस्, m. care bestowed upon anything, exertion for anything, effort, endeavour; a making or preparing, elaboration; making complete or per-fect; acquiring a new virtue or quality; acting well or properly; comprehension; taking prisoner, mak-ing captive; desire, wish; making an effort against, opposition, counteraction, resistance; retaliating, re-crimination, revenge; (अस्, आ, अम्), exerting one's self for, troubling about; making effort or exertion, strenuous, diligent, active, vigorous.
प्रतियातन: प्रति-यातन, अम्, n. requital, retaliation; (आ), f. the counterpart or resemblance of a real form, a picture, image, statue.
प्रतियम्: प्रतियम् प्रति-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्, Ved. to grant, present, bestow.
प्रतिया: प्रतिया प्रति-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go back, return.
प्रतियात: प्रति-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone against, opposed, resisted.
प्रतियान: प्रति-यान, अम्, n. going back, return.
प्रतियायिन्: प्रति-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going towards, meeting; going against, attacking, assailing.

प्रतियुद्ध: प्रति-युद्ध, अम्, n. fighting against, battle in return.
प्रतियोद्धव्य: प्रति-योद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attacked in return.

प्रतियोधन: प्रति-योधन, अम्, n. fighting against, assailing in turn.
प्रतियोधिन्: प्रति-योधिन्, ई, m. an antagonist, adversary, well-matched opponent.
प्रतियूथप: प्रतियूथप प्रति-यूथप, अस्, m. the leader of a hostile herd (of elephants).
प्रतियोग: प्रतियोग प्रति-योग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. युज् with प्रति), opposition, resistance, enmity; contro-versy, contradiction; an antidote, remedy; co-opera-tion, association; the being a counterpart of anything.
प्रतियोगिक: प्रतियोगिक, अस्, आ, अम्, antithetical, related to, relative, correlative. —प्रतियोगिक-त्व, अम्, n. relativeness, relativity, correlativeness.

प्रतिरक्षण: प्रति-रक्षण, अम्, n. preserving, preservation, protection.

प्रतिरथ: प्रतिरथ प्रति-रथ, अस्, m. an opposite fighter in a war-chariot, an adversary in war, an-tagonist; N. of a descendant of Atri, author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 47; N. of a son of Mati-nāra and father of Kaṇva; N. of a son of Vajra and father of Su-cāru.
प्रतिरम्भ: प्रतिरम्भ प्रति-रम्भ, अस्, m. passion, rage, violent or passionate abuse (= प्रति-लम्भ).
प्रतिरव: प्रतिरव प्रति-रव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रु with प्रति), crying or calling out to; quarrelling; echo; (probably) = उप-रव, q. v.
प्रतिरुरूषु: प्रति-रुरूषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to speak or tell.
प्रतिरुरूषु प्रति-रुरूषु। See under प्रति-रव above.
प्रतिराज: प्रतिराज प्रति-राज, अस्, or प्रति-राजन्, आ, m. a hostile king, royal adversary.
प्रतिरात्रम्: प्रतिरात्रम् प्रति-रात्रम्, ind. each night, every night, nightly.
प्रतिराध: प्रतिराध प्रति-राध or प्रती-राध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. राध् with प्रति), Ved. ‘obstacle, hinderance,’ N. of the verses Atharva-veda XX. 135, 1-3.

प्रतिरुद्ध: प्रति-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, impeded, hindered, obstructed; stopped, interrupted; opposed; rendered imperfect, impaired; disabled; invested, blockaded.
प्रतिरुध्य: प्रति-रुध्य, ind. having accused unjustly (Manu XI. 88).
प्रतिरोद्धृ: प्रति-रोद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, withstanding, opposing, resisting; a hinderer, preventer, opposer.
प्रतिरोध: प्रति-रोध, अस्, m. opposition, impediment, ob-struction, hinderance, stoppage; an opponent; con-cealing, hiding; siege, blockade; theft, robbery.
प्रतिरोधक: प्रति-रोधक, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing, opposing, hindering, stopping; besieging; (अस्), m. a robber, thief; an opponent; an obstacle.
प्रतिरोधन: प्रति-रोधन, अम्, n. obstructing, opposing, hindering.

प्रतिरुह्: प्रतिरुह् प्रति-रुह्, Caus. P. -रोपयति, -यि-तुम्, to place back, restore, re-establish.

प्रतिरूपक: प्रतिरूपक, अम्, n. an image, a picture; a forged edict; (अस्, इका, अम्), similar, resembling, corresponding, having the appearance of anything (generally at the end of a comp.; cf. सप्तमी-प्°).
प्रतिरूप्य: प्रतिरूप्य, अम्, n. ‘similarity of form,’ in अ-प्र-तिरूप्य, incomparableness.

प्रतिवर्त्मन्: प्रतिवर्त्मन् प्रति-वर्त्मन्। See under प्रति-वृत्, p. 620, col. 2.
प्रति-वर्त्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. taking an opposite road or course.
प्रतिवर्धिन्: प्रतिवर्धिन् प्रति-वर्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, grown strong enough for, being a match for, superior to.
प्रतिवर्षम्: प्रतिवर्षम् प्रति-वर्षम्, ind. every year, year by year, yearly.
प्रतिवस्: प्रतिवस् 1. प्रति-वस् (see rt. 5. वस्), Caus. P. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to dress, clothe.
प्रतिवस् 2. प्रति-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to dwell near, live at; to live, dwell.
प्रतिवसति: प्रति-वसति, ind. in every habitation, on every house, house by house.
प्रतिवसथ: प्रति-वसथ, अस्, m. a settlement, village.
प्रतिवस्तु: प्रति-वस्तु, उ, n. (fr. प्रति + वस्तु), a counter-part, an equivalent; anything given in return; any-thing contrasted with another, a parallel.
प्रतिवासिन्: प्रति-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling near, neighbouring, a neighbour.
प्रतिवहन: प्रतिवहन प्रति-वहन, अम्, n. leading back.
प्रतिवाह: प्रति-वाह, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śva-phalka.
प्रतिवोढव्य: प्रति-वोढव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be carried home.
प्रतिवोढव्य प्रति-वोढव्य। See under प्रति-वहन, p. 619, col. 3.
प्रतिवह्निप्रदक्षिणम्: प्रतिवह्निप्रदक्षिणम् प्रति-वह्नि-प्रदक्षि-णम्, ind. at each perambulation from left to right of the sacred fire.
प्रतिवाणि: प्रतिवाणि प्रति-वाणि, इस्, f. an answer, reply, rejoinder (see प्रति-बाणि).
प्रतिवात: प्रतिवात प्रति-वात, अस्, m. a contrary wind; (अम्), ind. against the wind, to leeward; (ए), ind. on the lee side.
प्रतिवार: प्रतिवार प्रति-वार, प्रति-वारण, &c. See under प्रति-वृ, p. 620, col. 2.
प्रति-वार, अस्, m. keeping or warding off, de-fence; अ-प्°, not to be warded off, irresistible.
प्रतिवाश: प्रतिवाश प्रति-वाश, अस्, ई, अम्, howling against; अ-प्°, not contradicting.
प्रतिवासरम्: प्रतिवासरम् प्रति-वासरम्, ind. every day, day by day, daily.
प्रतिवासुदेव: प्रतिवासुदेव प्रति-वासुदेव, अस्, m. ‘oppo-nent of a Vāsudeva,’ (with Jainas) N. of nine beings at enmity with Vāsudeva (= विष्णु-द्विष्).
प्रतिविघात: प्रतिविघात प्रति-विघात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with वि), striking back, warding off, defence.
प्रतिविज्ञा: प्रतिविज्ञा प्रति-वि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to behave wisely or prudently.
प्रतिविटपम्: प्रतिविटपम् प्रति-विटपम्, ind. in every bough, to every branch, branch by branch.
प्रतिविद्: प्रतिविद् प्रति-विद्, cl. 2. P. -वेत्ति, -वेद, -वेदितुम्, to acknowledge, receive; cl. 6. P. A. -विन्दति, -ते, -वेदितुम्, -वेत्तुम्, to obtain, get, receive: Caus. -वेदयति, -यितुम्, to make known, report, announce, relate; to deliver, give.
प्रतिवेदम्: प्रति-वेदम्, ind. at or for every Veda.
प्रतिवेदयत्: प्रति-वेदयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making known, announcing.
प्रतिवेदशाखम्: प्रति-वेद-शाखम्, ind. for every branch or school of the Veda.
प्रतिविधा: प्रतिविधा प्रति-वि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -द-धाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place or dispose in order, arrange, prepare, make ready, fit out, equip; to dispatch; to counteract, counterwork, frustrate.
प्रतिविधातव्य: प्रति-विधातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be arranged; to be used or employed.
प्रतिविधान: प्रति-विधान, अम्, n. arrangement, array; ar-rangement against, prevention; counteracting, coun-terworking, counteraction, taking measures against; a subsidiary or substituted ceremony.
प्रतिविधि: प्रति-विधि, इस्, m. a means of counteracting, an act or ordinance designed to counterwork or counteract, remedy; retaliation.
प्रतिविधेय: प्रति-विधेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be performed or done in any special case; to be counteracted or remedied.
प्रतिविहित: प्रति-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, arranged, arrayed.
प्रतिविन्ध्य: प्रतिविन्ध्य प्रति-विन्ध्य, अस्, m., N. of a king who ruled over a particular part of the Vindhya mountains; of a son of Yudhi-ṣṭhira.
प्रतिविपरी: प्रतिविपरी प्रति-वि-परी (-परि-इ), cl. 2. P. -पर्य्-एति, -एतुम्, to turn back again.
प्रतिविभज्: प्रतिविभज् प्रति-वि-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भ-जति, -ते, -भक्तुम्, Ved. to distribute severally, apportion.
प्रतिविभाग: प्रति-विभाग, अस्, m. division, distribution, ap-portionment.
प्रतिविम्ब: प्रतिविम्ब प्रति-विम्ब, अम्, अस्, n. m. the disk (of the sun or moon) reflected (in water), a reflection, reflected image, mirrored form; a resem-blance or counterpart of real forms, a picture, image, shadow; epithet of the chapters of the Kāvya-pra-kāśādarśa. —प्रतिविम्ब-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being reflected or mirrored. —प्रतिविम्बात (°ब-अत)?, अस्, m. a mirror.
प्रतिविम्बन: प्रति-विम्बन, अम्, n. the being reflected; re-flection; comparing together, comparison.
प्रतिविम्बय: प्रतिविम्बय, Nom. P. प्रतिविम्बयति, -यितुम्, to reflect, mirror.
प्रतिविम्बित: प्रतिविम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, reflected, mirrored.
प्रतिविरति: प्रतिविरति प्रति-विरति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. रम् with प्रति), desisting from anything (with abl.), leaving off; (इ), ind. at every pause, at each cessa-tion or disappearance.
प्रतिविशिष्ट: प्रतिविशिष्ट प्रति-विशिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, most excellent; (with abl.) more excellent.
प्रतिविशेष: प्रति-विशेष, अस्, m. peculiarity, a peculiar cir-cumstance.
प्रतिविश्व: प्रतिविश्व प्रति-विश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, every single one, one and all.
प्रतिविष: प्रतिविष प्रति-विष, अम्, n. ‘counter-poison,’ an antidote; (आ), f. a birch tree (commonly called Ataich or Atis Betula).
प्रतिविषय: प्रतिविषय प्रति-विषय, आस्, m. pl. the several objects of sense; (अम्), ind. in relation to each single object of sense.
प्रतिविष्णु: प्रतिविष्णु प्रति-विष्णु, ind. at every (image of) Viṣṇu; towards Viṣṇu, in place of Viṣṇu.
प्रतिविष्णुक: प्रतिविष्णुक, अस्, m. a species of tree (= मुचुकुन्द).
प्रतिविहाय: प्रतिविहाय प्रति-विहाय, ind. (fr. rt. हा with प्रति and वि), having quitted, having aban-doned.
प्रतिवीक्ष्: प्रतिवीक्ष् प्रति-वीक्ष् (-वि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -वीक्षते, -वीक्षितुम्, to look upon; to observe, perceive.
प्रतिवीक्षण: प्रति-वीक्षण, अम्, n. looking upon, returning a look.
प्रतिवीक्षणीय: प्रति-वीक्षणीय or प्रति-वीक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked upon; to be observed or perceived.
प्रतिवीर: प्रतिवीर प्रति-वीर, अस्, m. a well-matched opponent, antagonist. —प्रतिवीर-ता, f. the being a well-matched opponent, antagonism.
प्रतिवीर्य: प्रति-वीर्य, अम्, n. sufficient strength or power for resistance, the being equal to or a match for; अ-प्रतिवीर्य, unequalled, matchless, irresistible; अप्रतिवीर्यारम्भ, one who has not sufficient strength to undertake anything.
प्रतिवृ: प्रतिवृ प्रति-वृ, Caus. or cl. 10. P. -वार-यति, -यितुम्, to keep or ward off, keep back, repel; to oppose.
प्रतिवारण: प्रति-वारण, अस्, ई, अम्, keeping or warding off [cf. वारण-प्°]; (अस्), m. a hostile elephant; scil. दैत्य, a Daitya in the form of an elephant; (अम्), n. keeping back, keeping or warding off.
प्रतिवार्य: प्रति-वार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, in अ-प्°, not to be kept back, not to be impeded, not to be warded off.
प्रतिवृत्: प्रतिवृत् प्रति-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -वर्-तितुम्, to approach; to accrue.
प्रतिवृत्ति: प्रति-वृत्ति, ind. (in Ved. gram.) according to the modulation (of the voice).
प्रतिवृष्: प्रतिवृष् प्रति-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -वर्षितुम्, to rain or shower upon (with arrows), to shoot; to assail.
प्रतिवृष: प्रति-वृष, अस्, m. a hostile bull.
प्रतिवेलम्: प्रतिवेलम् प्रति-वेलम्, ind. on every oc-casion.
प्रतिवेश: प्रतिवेश प्रति-वेश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. विश् with प्रति), neighbouring; auxiliary; (अस्), m. a neighbour; the residence of a neighbour, neighbour-ing house, neighbourhood; [cf. प्रती-वेश।] —प्र-तिवेश-तस्, ind., Ved. from the neighbourhood. —प्रतिवेश-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living in the neigh-bourhood, neighbouring; (ई, इनी), m. f. a neighbour.
प्रतिवेशिन्: प्रतिवेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, neighbouring, a neighbour.
प्रतिवेश्मन्: प्रति-वेश्मन्, अ, n. a neighbour's house.
प्रतिवेष्टित: प्रतिवेष्टित प्रति-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolled back, reverted.
प्रतिवैर: प्रतिवैर प्रति-वैर, अम्, n. requital of hos-tilities, revenge.
प्रतिव्यध्: प्रतिव्यध् प्रति-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to hit, wound.
प्रतिव्यूह्: प्रतिव्यूह् प्रति-व्य्-ऊह् (-वि-ऊह्; see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, -ऊहितुम्, to draw out in opposite battle-array.
प्रतिव्यूढ: प्रति-व्यूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn out in array against; broad.
प्रतिव्यूह: प्रति-व्यूह, अस्, m. drawing out an army in opposite battle-array, arraying an army against an enemy; a multitude; N. of a prince (in this sense a various reading for प्रति-व्योमन्, q. v.).
प्रतिव्योम: प्रतिव्योम प्रति-व्योम, अस्, or प्रति-व्योमन्, आ, m., N. of a prince.
प्रतिव्रज्: प्रतिव्रज् प्रति-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. -व्रजति, -व्र-जितुम्, to go towards, go near, approach.
प्रतिशङ्कनीय: प्रतिशङ्कनीय प्रति-शङ्कनीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शङ्क् with प्रति), to be doubted about or feared.
प्रतिशङ्का: प्रति-शङ्का, f. fear or anxiety on account of (with loc.); constant fear or doubt.
प्रतिशत्रु: प्रतिशत्रु प्रति-शत्रु, उस्, m., Ved. an ad-versary, opponent, enemy.
प्रतिशब्द: प्रतिशब्द प्रति-शब्द, अस्, m. echo, reso-nance, reverberation; a roar. —प्रतिशब्द-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going after a sound, going in the direction of a sound.
प्रतिशम: प्रतिशम प्रति-शम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शम् with प्रति), deliverance, cessation.
प्रतिशर: प्रतिशर प्रति-शर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शॄ with प्रति), Ved. breaking to pieces.
प्रतिशशिन्: प्रतिशशिन् प्रति-शशिन्, ई, m. a mock moon, paraselene.
प्रतिशाखम्: प्रतिशाखम् प्रति-शाखम्, ind. for every branch or school (of the Veda); (आ), f. a side branch, side shoot. —प्रतिशाखा-नाडी, f. a branch vein.
प्रतिशाप: प्रतिशाप प्रति-शाप, अस्, m. a curse in return, retorted imprecation, curse for curse.
प्रतिशासन: प्रतिशासन प्रति-शासन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. शास्), giving orders, ordering, commissioning; sending a servant on a message, ordering or dispatching an inferior after calling him to attend; a counter-order, rival command or authority; अ-प्रतिशासन, अस्, आ, अम्, without rival authority, completely under sub-jection.
प्रतिशास्ति: प्रति-शास्ति, इस्, f. sending on a message, ordering or dispatching an inferior after calling him to attend.
प्रतिशिष्ट: प्रति-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sent, ordered, dis-patched; celebrated, famous.
प्रतिशी: प्रतिशी प्रति-शी, cl. 2. A. -शेते, -शयितुम्, to lie down opposite to (with acc.).
प्रतिशीवन्: प्रति-शीवन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. serving as a couch or resting-place.
प्रतिशीन: प्रतिशीन प्रति-शीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्यै with प्रति), melted, fluid, dropping, oozing.
प्रतिश्या: प्रति-श्या, f. or प्रति-श्याय, अस्, m. a cold, catarrh.
प्रतिशुक्रम्: प्रतिशुक्रम् प्रति-शुक्रम्, ind. towards the planet Venus.
प्रतिशुष्: प्रतिशुष् प्रति-शुष्, cl. 4. P. -शुष्यति, -शोष्टुम्, to be dried up, become dry; to perish.
प्रतिश्रय: प्रतिश्रय प्रति-श्रय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रि with प्रति), refuge, help, assistance; a place of refuge, shelter, asylum, an alms-house; a place where food &c. is given away; a house, dwelling; a receptacle; a place of sacrifice, the room or building where the sacrifice is performed; an assembly.
प्रतिश्रु: प्रतिश्रु प्रति-श्रु, cl. 5. P. -शृणोति, -श्रो-तुम्, to promise (with dat. or gen. of the person and acc. of the thing).
प्रतिश्रव: प्रति-श्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. overhearing, dis-covering by listening; (अस्), m. promise, agreement, assent; (according to Mahī-dhara) = प्रति-शब्द। —प्रतिश्रवान्त (°व-अन्°), अस्, m. the expiration of a promise, i. e. lapse of a promised period.
प्रतिश्रवण: प्रति-श्रवण, अम्, n. hearkening to, listening to (with attention and obedience); assenting to, agreeing, promising; a promise; maintaining; a particular part of the ear. —प्रतिश्रवण-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by a promise, promised.
प्रतिश्रवस्: प्रति-श्रवस्, आस्, m., N. of a son of Bhīma-sena.
प्रतिश्रुत्: प्रति-श्रुत्, त्, f. an echo, resonance, reverberation; a promise.
प्रतिश्रुत: प्रति-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, promised, assented, agreed, accepted; (अम्), n. a promise, assent; an engagement.
प्रतिश्रुति: प्रति-श्रुति, इस्, f., Ved. an echo, repeated sound, resonance, reverberation.
प्रतिश्रोतृ: प्रति-श्रोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who promises or assents, a promiser.
प्रतिश्लोकम्: प्रतिश्लोकम् प्रति-श्लोकम्, ind. at every Śloka.
प्रतिषिच्य: प्रतिषिच्य प्रति-षिच्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. सिच् with प्रति), Ved. to be besprinkled or moistened.
प्रतिषेक: प्रति-षेक, अस्, m., Ved. besprinkling, moist-ening.
प्रतिषिध्: प्रतिषिध् प्रति-षिध् (-सिध्), cl. 1. P. -षे-धति, -षेधितुम्, -षेद्धुम्, to keep off, ward off; to restrain; to hinder; to interdict, prohibit, forbid, disallow: Caus. -षेधयति, -यितुम्, to keep off, keep back, ward off; to restrain; to pro-hibit, interdict.
प्रतिषिद्ध: प्रति-षिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, forbidden, prohibited; refused, denied, disallowed; contradicted. —प्रति-षिद्ध-सेवन, अम्, n. doing what is prohibited. —प्रतिषिद्ध-सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, following or doing what is forbidden.
प्रतिषेद्धव्य: प्रति-षेद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be warded off, to be kept back; to be prohibited or forbidden.
प्रतिषेद्धृ: प्रति-षेद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, one who wards off or keeps back; hindering, a hinderer; prohibiting, prohibitive, a prohibitor, forbidding; resisting.
प्रतिषेध: प्रति-षेध, अस्, m. keeping or warding off, keeping back, expulsion (of a disease &c.); forbid-ding, prohibition; denial, refusal, disallowal; nega-tion, contradiction; a negative particle; an exception; enforcing a prohibition, reminding of a prohibition. —प्रतिषेधाक्षर (°ध-अक्°), अम्, n. ‘words of denial,’ a negative answer. —प्रतिषेधोक्ति (°ध-उक्°), इस्, f. expression of denial or refusal, expression of prohibition or contradiction. —प्रति-षेधोपमा (°ध-उप्°), f. a negative comparison.
प्रतिषेधक: प्रति-षेधक, अस्, इका, अम्, prohibiting, prohi-bitive, interdicting, preventive; denying, negative; contradicting; excepting.
प्रतिषेधन: प्रति-षेधन, अस्, ई, अम्, keeping or warding off; (अम्), n. the act of keeping or warding off, keeping back, expulsion; preventing, prohibiting, inhibition, refusal, refutation.
प्रतिषेधनीय: प्रति-षेधनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept back; to be hindered or prevented; to be prohibited.
प्रतिष्कश: प्रतिष्कश प्रति-ष्-कश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कश् with प्रति), a messenger; a secret emissary, spy; a whip, a leather thong; [cf. कशा।]
प्रतिष्क: प्रति-ष्क, अस्, m. a messenger, an emissary, spy.
प्रतिष्कष: प्रति-ष्कष, अस्, m. a whip, a leather thong.
प्रतिष्कस: प्रति-ष्कस, अस्, m. a messenger, an emissary, spy.
प्रतिष्कु: प्रतिष्कु प्रति-ष्कु (प्रति-स्कु), cl. 5. P. -ष्कुनोति, -ष्कोतुम्, to cover in return (with arrows &c.).
प्रतिष्टब्ध: प्रतिष्टब्ध प्रति-ष्टब्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्तम्भ् with प्रति), obstructed, impeded, stopped, withstood.
प्रतिष्टम्भ: प्रति-ष्टम्भ, अस्, m. obstruction, impediment, obstacle, opposition, resistance, hinderance.
प्रतिष्टुति: प्रतिष्टुति प्रति-ष्टुति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. स्तु with प्रति), Ved. a song of praise, praise.
प्रतिष्टोतृ: प्रति-ष्टोतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who rivals in praising.
प्रतिष्टुभ्: प्रतिष्टुभ् प्रति-ष्टुभ्, cl. 1. A. -ष्टोभते, -ष्टोभितुम्, Ved. to praise severally, glorify indi-vidually; (Sāy. = प्रत्येकं स्तु।)
प्रतिष्ठा: प्रतिष्ठा प्रति-ष्ठा (प्रति-स्था), cl. 1. P. A. -तिष्ठति, -ते, -ष्ठातुम्, to stand firmly, stand or rest upon, to be supported; to depend upon; to stay: Caus. P. -ष्ठापयति, -यितुम्, to place firmly, to set up, erect; to place; to place with, consign to (with loc.); to offer.
प्रतिष्ठ: प्रति-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. standing firmly; resisting; famous; (अस्), m., N. of the father of Su-pārśva who was the seventh Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; (आ), f. standing still, resting, remaining in, staying, standing, fixing; a resting-place, site, ground, base, foundation; a prop, stay; fixity, con-stitution, strength; the state of rest, quiet, tranquillity, comfort; the foot (regarded as the basis on which men and animals stand); a halting-place, dwelling-place, house, home, residence; the earth; a limit, boundary; a receptacle; a high or honourable posi-tion, high authority, pre-eminence; celebrity, fame, notoriety; the accession (of a king to the throne); installation, inauguration, the consecration of a monu-ment or image in honour of a deity or the setting up of an idol; the performance or institution of any rites (e. g. the endowment of a temple, portioning a daughter, completion of a vow, or any ceremonies for obtaining supernatural and magical powers); ac-complishment, completion in general; a metre of four lines of four syllables each; a variety of the Gāyatrī metre consisting of three lines of eight, seven, and six syllables respectively; a mystical designation of the letter आ; N. of one of the Mātṛs attending upon Skanda; प्रजापतेः प्र-तिष्ठा or प्रतिष्ठा-सामन्, N. of a Sāman; (आ), ind., Ved. (perhaps) on the spot. —प्रतिष्ठा-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of a firm basis; wishing for a home or residence; wishing for emi-nence or distinction. —प्रतिष्ठा-तिलक, N. of a work by Rāma-candra (on the erection of the images of the twenty-four Jaina Tīrthaṅ-karas). —प्रति-ष्ठा-त्व, अम्, n. the being a ground or basis, being a foundation. —प्रतिष्ठान्वित (°ठा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of fame, renowned, illustrious, celebrated. —प्रतिष्ठा-मयूख, अस्, m., N. of the ninth section of the Bhāskara. —प्रतिष्ठा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a foundation or support.
प्रतिष्ठातृ: प्रति-ष्ठातृ, ता, m. epithet of a particular priest (also called प्रति-प्रस्थातृ, q. v.).
प्रतिष्ठान: प्रति-ष्ठान, अम्, n. resting or standing firmly, being firmly stationed; a standing-place, ground, foundation; the foundation of a city; site, situation; a leg, foot; N. of a town at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā on the left bank of the Gaṅgā opposite to Allahabad, the capital of the early kings of the lunar dynasty; N. of a town on the Go-dāvarī, the capital of Śāli-vāhana; (औ), m. du. the constellation Proṣṭha-pada.
प्रतिष्ठापन: प्रति-ष्ठापन, अम्, n. fixing, placing, locating; erecting or consecrating the image of a deity, instal-lation.
प्रतिष्ठापम्: प्रति-ष्ठापम्, ind., Ved. having fixed or placed.
प्रतिष्ठापयितव्य: प्रति-ष्ठापयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed or established.
प्रतिष्ठापयितृ: प्रति-ष्ठापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who erects or fixes; one who founds, a founder.
प्रतिष्ठापित: प्रति-ष्ठापित, अस्, आ, अम्, set up, erected, placed, located; fixed, appointed.
प्रतिष्ठाप्य: प्रति-ष्ठाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed or located or fixed; to be consigned or made over to (with loc.).
प्रतिष्ठि: प्रति-ष्ठि, इस्, f., Ved. resistance; (Sāy.) = आश्रय।
प्रतिष्ठित: प्रति-ष्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, set up, erected; esta-blished, fixed, infixed; comprised, included; placed, situated; staying; established in life, married; por-tioned, endowed; consecrated, inaugurated, installed; completed, finished, effected; applied, applicable; experienced, conversant with; famous, celebrated, renowned, illustrious; prized, valued; secured, ac-quired. —प्रतिष्ठित-सन्तान, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has progeny or offspring secured.
प्रतिष्ठिति: प्रति-ष्ठिति, इस्, f., Ved. standing firmly, re-maining firm or fixed; a station.
प्रतिष्ठासु: प्रतिष्ठासु प्र-तिष्ठासु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to remain, &c. See प्र-स्था।
प्रतिष्णात: प्रतिष्णात प्रति-ष्णात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्ना), pure.
प्रतिष्णिका: प्रतिष्णिका, f., see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 98.
प्रतिस्नात: प्रतिस्नात प्रति-स्नात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्ना with प्रति), bathed, washed; [cf. प्रति-ष्णात।]
प्रतिसंयोद्धृ: प्रतिसंयोद्धृ प्रति-संयोद्धृ, धा, m. an adversary in war.
प्रतिसंलयन: प्रतिसंलयन प्रति-संलयन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ली with प्रति-सम्), complete absorption.
प्रतिसंवत्सरम्: प्रतिसंवत्सरम् प्रति-संवत्सरम्, ind. every year, year by year, yearly.
प्रतिसंविद्: प्रतिसंविद् प्रति-संविद्, त्, f. (fr. rt. विद् with प्रति-सम्), an accurate understanding of the particulars of anything. —प्रतिसंवित्-प्राप्त, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
प्रतिसंवेदक: प्रति-संवेदक, अस्, आ, अम्, giving detailed information, informing about the particulars of any-thing.
प्रतिसंसर्ग: प्रतिसंसर्ग प्रति-संसर्ग, अस्, m. = प्रति-सर्ग, q. v.
प्रतिसंस्कृ: प्रतिसंस्कृ प्रति-संस्-कृ (-सम्-कृ), cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to mend, repair; to re-establish, restore; to unite one thing with another.
प्रतिसंस्थान: प्रतिसंस्थान प्रति-संस्थान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. स्था with प्रति), settling in, entering into.
प्रतिसंहृ: प्रतिसंहृ प्रति-सं-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to draw back, withdraw, drag back; to place back, replace (an arrow in the quiver); to retract; to change: Caus. -हारयति, -यितुम्, to retract.
प्रतिसंहार: प्रति-संहार, अस्, m. taking back, drawing in, withdrawing; compression, diminution; comprehen-sion; retracting; giving up, yielding, resigning.
प्रतिसंहृत: प्रति-संहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, comprehended, in-cluded; compressed, reduced in bulk.
प्रतिसञ्जिहीर्षु: प्रति-सञ्जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to with-draw from, wishing to be freed from.
प्रतिसंहृष्: प्रतिसंहृष् प्रति-सं-हृष्, cl. 4. P. -हृष्-यति, -हर्षितुम्, to be glad.
प्रतिसङ्काश: प्रतिसङ्काश प्रति-सङ्काश, अस्, m. a similar appearance, resemblance.
प्रतिसङ्क्रम्: प्रतिसङ्क्रम् प्रति-सङ्-क्रम् (-सम्-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go back again, return; to cease moving on, come to an end, cease: Caus. -क्रामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go back or return.
प्रतिसङ्क्रुध्: प्रतिसङ्क्रुध् प्रति-सङ्-क्रुध् (-सम्-क्रुध्), cl. 4. P. -क्रुध्यति, -क्रोद्धुम्, to be angry with (with acc.).
प्रतिसङ्क्रुद्ध: प्रति-सङ्क्रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, angry with, wroth against.
प्रतिसङ्ख्या: प्रतिसङ्ख्या 1. प्रति-सङ्-ख्या (-सम्-ख्या), cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्यातुम्, Ved. to count or reckon up, count, number.
2. प्रति-सङ्ख्या, f. consciousness. —प्रतिसङ्-ख्या-निरोध, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) conscious cessation of existence; wilful destruction of any existent thing (?).
प्रतिसङ्गक्षिका: प्रतिसङ्गक्षिका प्रति-सङ्गक्षिका, f. a cloak to keep off the dust (worn by Buddhist mendicants).
प्रतिसङ्गिन्: प्रतिसङ्गिन् प्रति-सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. सञ्ज् with प्रति), cleaving or clinging to, adhering; अ-प्रतिसङ्गिन्, not meeting with any obstacle, irresistible.
प्रतिसङ्ग्रह्: प्रतिसङ्ग्रह् प्रति-सङ्-ग्रह् (-सम्-ग्रह्), cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to re-ceive, accept.
प्रतिसञ्चर्: प्रतिसञ्चर् प्रति-सञ्-चर् (-सम्-चर्), cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to come together, come towards, meet with, meet.
प्रतिसञ्चर: प्रति-सञ्चर, अस्, m. going or moving back-wards; reabsorption or resolution (back again into Prakṛti); that into which anything is reabsorbed or resolved; a place of resort, haunt.
प्रतिसञ्जन्: प्रतिसञ्जन् प्रति-सञ्-जन् (-सम्-जन्), cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्, to be born again, to be born or produced; to spring up, arise, appear.
प्रतिसञ्जीव्: प्रतिसञ्जीव् प्रति-सञ्-जीव् (-सम्-जीव्), cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -जीवति (-ते), -जीवितुम्, to come to life again, return to life, revive.
प्रतिसञ्ज्ञा: प्रतिसञ्ज्ञा प्रति-सञ्-ज्ञा (-सम्-ज्ञा), cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, Ved. to be friendly towards, to be kindly disposed towards.
प्रतिसदृक्ष: प्रतिसदृक्ष प्रति-सदृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, or प्रति-सदृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. similar.
प्रतिसन्दिश्: प्रतिसन्दिश् प्रति-सन्-दिश् (-सम्-दिश्), cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to give an errand or commis-sion in return; to send back a message to (with gen.); to order, command.
प्रतिसन्देश: प्रति-सन्देश, अस्, m. a message given in return, tidings in return, an answer to a message.
प्रतिसन्धा: प्रतिसन्धा प्रति-सन्-धा (-सम्-धा), cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put together again, readjust; to put on, fasten; to aim at, direct against; to give back, replace, restore; to grasp men-tally, conceive, comprehend, understand; (A.) to com-pose one's self; to fit an arrow to the bow-string.
प्रतिसंहित: प्रति-संहित, अस्, आ, अम्, aimed at, directed against.
प्रतिसन्धान: प्रति-सन्धान, अम्, n. putting together again, joining together; a juncture, the period of transition between two ages; a remedy; self-command, sup-pression of feeling; praise, panegyric.
प्रतिसन्धि: प्रति-सन्धि, इस्, m. reunion; entering into the womb [cf. भव-प्°]; a juncture, the period of transition between two ages.
प्रतिसन्धेय: प्रति-सन्धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opposed, re-sistible; अ-प्रतिसन्धेय, irresistible.
प्रतिसान्धानिक: प्रतिसान्धानिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-सन्धान), a bard, a panegyrist.
प्रतिसान्धानिक प्रतिसान्धानिक। See under प्रति-सन्-धा above.
प्रतिसम: प्रतिसम प्रति-सम, अस्, आ, अम्, equal to, a match for.
प्रतिसमन्तम्: प्रतिसमन्तम् प्रति-समन्तम्, ind., Ved. on every side, everywhere.
प्रतिसमादिश्: प्रतिसमादिश् प्रति-सम्-आ-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दि-शति, -देष्टुम्, to return an answer, reply, answer; to direct in return; to order, command.
प्रतिसमादिष्ट: प्रति-समादिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, enjoined, directed, ordered.
प्रतिसमाधा: प्रतिसमाधा प्रति-सम्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put back again, replace, affix again; to rearrange, readjust; to re-dress, remedy; to fit an arrow to the bow-string.
प्रतिसमास्: प्रतिसमास् प्रति-सम्-आस् (see rt. 4. आस्), cl. 2. A. -आस्ते, -आसितुम्, to be a match for, cope with; to withstand, resist.
प्रतिसमासन: प्रति-समासन, अम्, n. the being a match for, coping with (with gen.); withstanding, resisting.
प्रतिसमिन्ध्: प्रतिसमिन्ध् प्रति-सम्-इन्ध्, cl. 7. A. -इन्द्-धे, -इन्धितुम्, to kindle again, rekindle.
प्रतिसमीक्षण: प्रतिसमीक्षण प्रति-समीक्षण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ईक्ष् with प्रति-सम्), looking at again, return-ing a glance.
प्रतिसमुच्: प्रतिसमुच् प्रति-सम्-उच् (?) , cl. 4. A. -उच्यते, उचितुम्, Ved. to deserve, be worthy of.
प्रतिसम्बुध्: प्रतिसम्बुध् प्रति-सम्-बुध्, cl. 1. P. A., 4. A. -बोधति, -ते, -बुध्यते, -बोधितुम्, to become conscious again, recover consciousness.
प्रतिसम्बुद्ध: प्रति-सम्बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, become conscious again, restored to consciousness, recovered.
प्रतिसम्भू: प्रतिसम्भू प्रति-सम्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to apply or give one's self to (with acc.).
प्रतिसर: प्रति-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, going towards; dependent, subject; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a cord or ribbon used as an amulet worn round the neck or wrist at nup-tials &c.; an ornament, adorning; a watch, guard, ward; the junction of an elephant's frontal sinuses (?); (अस्), m. a follower, servant; a bracelet; a wreath, garland; a form of magic or incantation; the rear of an army; day-break; cicatrizing or healing (as a sore); (आ), f. a female servant; a thread, fillet, ribbon.
प्रतिसर्ग: प्रतिसर्ग प्रति-सर्ग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सृज् with प्रति), continued creation out of primitive matter; secondary creation or the creation of the world by the agency of Brahmā and other divinities regarded as the agents of one supreme being; disso-lution; the portion of a Purāṇa which treats of the destruction and renovation of the world.
प्रतिसृष्ट: प्रति-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sent, dispatched; given; celebrated.
प्रतिसव्य: प्रतिसव्य प्रति-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, in inverted order, inverted, reverse.
प्रतिसह्: प्रतिसह् प्रति-सह्, cl. 1. A. -सहते, -सहि-तुम्, -सोढुम्, to sustain, uphold, support.
प्रतिसाम: प्रतिसाम प्रति-साम, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) unkind, unfriendly.
प्रतिसामन्त: प्रतिसामन्त प्रति-सामन्त, अस्, m. ‘an ad-verse neighbour,’ an enemy, adversary.
प्रतिसीरा: प्रतिसीरा प्रति-सीरा, f. a curtain, a screen or wall of cloth, an outer tent.
प्रतिसूर्य: प्रतिसूर्य प्रति-सूर्य, अस्, m. a mock sun, parhelion; a kind of lizard, a chameleon (which lies or basks in the sun); (अम्), ind. opposite to the sun, in the sun. —प्रतिसूर्य-शयानक, अस्, m. ‘lying or basking in the sun,’ a kind of lizard, a chameleon.
प्रतिसृ: प्रतिसृ प्रति-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to go towards, go back, [only used in Caus.]: Caus. P. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go back; to remove, replace.
प्रतिसरण: प्रति-सरण, अम्, n. leaning on, resting upon.
प्रतिसर्य: प्रति-सर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) present in the cord used as an amulet, present at an incantation.
प्रतिसारण: प्रति-सारण, अम्, n. dressing or anointing the edges of a wound; an instrument used for anointing a wound.
प्रतिसारणीय: प्रति-सारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be dressed or anointed (as a wound).
प्रतिसारित: प्रति-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, repelled, repulsed; re-moved; dressed (as a wound).
प्रतिसारिन्: प्रति-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going round, going from one to another.
प्रतिसेना: प्रतिसेना प्रति-सेना, f. an opposing or hos-tile army.
प्रतिसोमा: प्रतिसोमा प्रति-सोमा, f. a kind of plant (= महिष-वल्ली).
प्रतिस्कन्ध: प्रतिस्कन्ध प्रति-स्कन्ध, अस्, m. every shoulder; N. of an attendant of Skanda; (अम्), ind. upon the shoulders.
प्रतिस्कॄ: प्रतिस्कॄ प्रति-स्-कॄ (प्रति-कॄ with स् in-serted), cl. 6. P. A. -किरति, -ते, -करितुम्, -करीतुम्, to hurt, injure; [cf. प्रति-कॄ।]
प्रतिस्कीर्ण: प्रति-स्-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, hurt, injured.
प्रतिस्तब्ध: प्रतिस्तब्ध प्रति-स्तब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopped, restrained; stupefied; propped up, stayed, supported; [cf. प्रति-ष्टब्ध।]
प्रतिस्त्री: प्रतिस्त्री प्रति-स्त्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. lying on a woman.
प्रतिस्थानम्: प्रतिस्थानम् प्रति-स्थानम्, ind. in every place, everywhere.
प्रतिस्नेह: प्रतिस्नेह प्रति-स्नेह, अस्, m. love in return, requital of love, mutual love.
