(rarely in the earlier language A.) -ददाति (-दत्ते), -दातुम्, to give away, give to, give; to give up, deliver; to offer, present, grant; to give a daughter in marriage; to sell (with inst. of the price); to restore; to put in, place in; (with ऋणम्) to pay, discharge a debt; (with विद्याम्) to communicate or impart know-ledge; (with प्रतिवचः) to give an answer; (with युद्धम्) to give battle; (with द्वन्द्व-युद्-धम्) to engage in single combat; (with प्र-वृत्तिम्) to give information of an event; (with हुताशनम्) to set fire to: Pass. -दीयते, to be given away, to be given: Caus. -दापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to give, compel to give back or to repay; to cause to put or place in: Desid. -दित्सते, to wish to give in marriage.
प्रत्ति: प्र-त्ति, इस्, f. (for प्र-दत्ति), Ved. giving away, giving.
प्रददि: प्र-ददि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. liberal, bountiful.
प्रदातव्य: प्र-दातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given away, to be given; to be given back; to be given in marriage; to be placed in or put into.
प्रदातृ: प्र-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who gives or bestows, giving, liberal; a giver, donor; one who gives a daughter away in marriage; ‘the giver,’ an epithet of Indra; N. of a divinity enumerated among the Viśve Devāḥ.
प्रदान: 1. प्र-दान, अम्, n. (for 2. प्र-दान see below), giving, offering, presenting, bestowing, granting [cf. पाणि-प्°, वर-प्°]; an oblation (especially one made by fire); the words or sacred texts recited during an oblation by fire (for प्रदान-मन्त्र); impart-ing, communicating, teaching [cf. वेद-प्°, and see Manu II. 171]; giving away in marriage; applying (a clyster); a gift, present. —प्रदान-कृपण, अस्, आ, अम्, mean or niggardly in making presents. —प्रदान-पूर्वम्, ind. with a present. —प्र-दान-रुचि, इस्, f. ‘delighting in giving,’ N. of a man. —प्रदान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, giving, liberal. —प्रदान-शूर, अस्, m., lit. a hero in giving, i. e. an excessively liberal man [cf. दान-शूर, दान-वीर]; N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
प्रदान 2. प्र-दान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 3. दा with प्र), a goad. (For. 1. प्र-दान see above.)
प्रदानक: प्रदानक, अम्, n. an offering, oblation.
प्रदानिक: प्रदानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) relating to giving or offering; [cf. दत्ताप्°।]
प्रदापयितृ: प्र-दापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes to give; (Ved.) one who gives, a giver.
प्रदाप्य: प्र-दाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to give, to be compelled to pay.
प्रदायक: प्र-दायक, अस्, इका, अम्, giving, granting, pre-senting, bestowing. —प्रदायक-त्व, अम्, n. the being a giver, giving.
प्रदायिन्: प्र-दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, giving away, giving, a giver, granting, presenting. —प्रदायि-त्व, अम्, n. the being a giver, giving.
प्रदि: प्र-दि, इस्, m. a gift, present (Schol. on Pāṇ. III. 3, 92).
प्रदित्सु: प्र-दित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to give (with acc.).
प्रदेय: प्र-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given or granted, to be offered or awarded to (in these senses sometimes compounded with a word denoting the recipient, cf. राज-प्°, शिष्य-प्°); to be imparted, to be taught or instructed; to be given in marriage, marriageable; (अस्), m. a present.
प्रदिग्ध: प्र-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, smeared over, besmeared, daubed, bedaubed, anointed, overspread; (अम्), n., scil. मांस, a kind of dish prepared with meat; (अस्), m. a kind of sauce or gravy.
प्रदिव्: प्रदिव् प्र-दिव्, -द्यौस्, f., Ved. the third or highest heaven (in which the Pitṛs are said to dwell); the fifth of the seven heavens; (according to Sāy.) = पुराण, existing from olden times, ancient; प्र-दिवस्, ind. from the remotest or earliest times, from of old, long since, always, constantly, ever; अनु प्रदिवः, as of old, as formerly; (प्र-दिवि), ind. at all times, always, constantly, ever.
प्रदिश्: प्रदिश् 1. प्र-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to point out, show; to signify, announce, declare, communicate, make known; to direct; to appoint, ordain, prescribe, instruct; to urge on, incite; to assign; cl. 4. P. -दिश्यति, &c., to grant: Caus. -देशयति, -यितुम्, to urge on, incite: Intens. -देदेष्टि, to animate (Ved.).

2. प्र-दिश्, क्, f. pointing to, pointing out; direc-tion, order, command, instruction; a direction, quarter, region of the sky (of which from four to seven are enumerated in the Veda; पित्र्या प्रदिश्, the region of the Pitṛs, i. e. the south; प्रदिशो गतम्, gone towards all quarters of the heavens); an intermediate point of the compass or half quarter, as north-east, south-west, &c.
प्रदिश्यमान: प्र-दिश्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pointed out, being urged on or incited.
प्रदिष्ट: प्र-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pointed out, announced, declared; directed, ordained, appointed.
प्रदेश: प्र-देश, अस्, m. pointing out, showing; direc-tion, decision, determination; appealing to a pre-cedent; an example (in grammar &c.); a place, (प्रदेशेषु, in various places), spot, region; a country, district, foreign country; a wall; a short span measured from the tip of the thumb to that of the forefinger. —प्रदेश-कारिन्, ई, m. epithet of a kind of ascetic. —प्रदेश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possess-ing or occupying a place. —प्रदेश-शास्त्र, अम्, n. a book containing examples (in grammar). —प्रदेश-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being or situated in a district.
प्रदेशन: प्र-देशन, अम्, n. a gift, present, bribe; an offering, anything given to the gods, to superiors, or friends; (ई), f. the index finger, forefinger; the corresponding toe.
प्रदेशित: प्र-देशित, अस्, आ, अम्, urged, directed.
प्रदेशिनी: प्र-देशिनी, f. the index finger, forefinger; the corresponding toe.
प्रदेष्टृ: प्र-देष्टृ, टा, m. one who pronounces judg-ment, a judge.
प्रदिह्: प्रदिह् प्र-दिह्, cl. 2. P. -देग्धि, -देग्धुम्, to smear over, besmear, smear, daub, anoint.
प्रदेह: प्र-देह, अस्, m. a plaster, a thick or viscid ointment; applying a plaster, unction; solid food (perhaps inspissated juice and the like).
प्रदीधी: प्रदीधी प्र-दीधी (see rt. 1. दीधी), cl. 2. A. -दीधीते, &c., Ved. to shine forth, shine brilliantly.
प्रदीध्यान: प्र-दीध्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. shining forth, shining brilliantly.
प्रदीप्: प्रदीप् प्र-दीप्, cl. 4. A. -दीप्यते, -दीपितुम्, to flame forth, blaze, burst into flames: Caus. -दीप-यति, -यितुम्, to set on fire, set fire to, light, kindle, inflame.
प्रदीप: प्र-दीप, अस्, m. a light, a lamp, lantern; that which illuminates or illustrates, an enlightener; (often at the end of a comp., e. g. कुल-प्°, ‘the light of a family;’ especially in titles of explanatory works, cf. महाभाष्य-प्°।) —प्रदीप-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a commentary by Rāmeśvara on the Amara-koṣa. —प्रदीप-शरण-ध्वज, अस्, m., N. of a Mahoraga-rāja. —प्रदीप-साह, अस्, m. (साह = شاه), N. of a prince.
प्रदीपक: प्रदीपक, अस्, इका, m. f. a small lamp, a lamp; (अस्, इका, अम्), illuminating, illustrating, clearing up.
प्रदीपन: प्र-दीपन, अस्, ई, अम्, inflaming, illuminating; stimulating, exciting; (अम्), n. the act of kindling, inflaming, igniting, exciting, &c.; (अस्), m. a sort of mineral poison (of a red colour and caustic in its action).
प्रदीपाय: प्रदीपाय, Nom. A. प्रदीपायते, -यितुम्, to re-present a lamp, to act as a lamp, act the part of a lamp.
प्रदीपीय: प्रदीपीय or प्रदीप्य। See Gaṇa to Pāṇ. V. 1, 4.
प्रदीप्त: प्र-दीप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, kindled, inflamed, lighted up, illuminated; blazing, burning, shining; excited, stimulated; clear, shrill (opposed to पूर्ण, as a term of augury?).
प्रदीप्ति: प्र-दीप्ति, इस्, f. light, lustre, splendor, brilliancy. —प्रदीप्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bright, radiant, lu-minous.
प्रदीर्घ: प्रदीर्घ प्र-दीर्घ, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly long.
प्रदु: प्रदु प्र-दु, cl. 4. A. -दूयते, -दोतुम्, to be consumed by fire; cl. 5. P. -दुनोति, &c., to distress, pain, torment, torture; to press hard.
प्रदव्य: प्र-दव्य or प्र-दाव्य, अस्, m., Ved., scil. अग्नि, a forest fire (= दावाग्नि).
प्रदुष्: प्रदुष् प्र-दुष्, cl. 4. P. -दुष्यति, -दोष्टुम्, to become worse, deteriorate; to be defiled or pol-luted; to do amiss, act improperly, fall (morally); to commit an offence against (with acc.): Caus. -दूषयति, -यितुम्, to spoil, deprave, corrupt; to defile, pollute, contaminate, vitiate, damage; to speak ill of, abuse, blame, censure.
प्रदुष्ट: प्र-दुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, corrupt, wicked, bad, wrong, sinful; licentious, wanton, infamous.
प्रदूषण: प्र-दूषण, अस्, ई, अम्, corrupting, spoiling; defiling, contaminating.
प्रदूषित: प्र-दूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, corrupted, spoilt; de-praved, vitiated; defiled, polluted.
प्रदोष: प्र-दोष, अस्, आ, अम्, corrupt, bad, wicked; (अस्), m. defect, fault, offence, sin, transgression, guilt; a disordered condition (of the body or of the state), mutiny, insurrection, rebellion; the first part of the night, evening twilight, evening, nightfall; Evening personified (and associated with Niśitha and Vyuṣṭa as a son of Doṣā); (अम्), ind., Ved. in the evening, in the dark. —प्रदोष-काल, अस्, m. evening tide. —प्रदोष-तिमिर, अम्, n. evening darkness, the dusk of early night. —प्रदोष-पूजा-विधि, इस्, m. and प्रदोष-शिव-पूजा, f., N. of two works. —प्रदोष-रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, plea-sant or delightful in the evenings. —प्रदोषागम (°ष-आग्°), अस्, m. the coming on of evening, nightfall.
प्रदोषक: प्रदोषक, अस्, आ, अम्, born in the evening; (according to a Scholiast) a proper N.
प्रदुह्: प्रदुह् 1. प्र-दुह्, cl. 2. P. A. -दोग्धि, -दुग्-धे, -दोग्धुम्, to milk; to yield milk or any desired object.
2. प्र-दुह्, -धुक्, क्, क्, milking, milking well.
प्रदोहन: प्र-दोहन, अस्, m., N. of a man.
प्रदृश्: प्रदृश् प्र-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्-टुम्, to look forward, see in front, foresee; to see, behold, view; to perceive, observe, discern, distin-guish, learn; to look at, look upon; to regard, judge; to have a view or opinion; to be intelligent: Pass. -दृश्यते, to become visible, to be seen or observed; to look, appear: Caus. -दर्शयति, -यि-तुम्, to foreshow, show forth, bring to light, make visible, display, exhibit; to describe; to make clear, explain, teach: Desid. -दिदृक्षति, to wish to see.
प्रदर्शक: प्र-दर्शक, अस्, इका, अम्, foreshowing, fore-telling, presaging; a prophet; showing, exhibiting, displaying; presenting; proclaiming, announcing; propounding, teaching, instructing; a teacher, in-structor, expounder; a doctrine, principle.
प्रदर्शन: प्र-दर्शन, अम्, n. foreshowing, prophesying; look, appearance, aspect, (often at the end of comps., e. g. घोर-प्°, of terrible aspect); showing, pointing out, manifesting, displaying, bringing to light, indi-cating; explaining, specifying, teaching; an example; (आस्), m. pl. a class of deities under Manu Auttami.
प्रदर्शित: प्र-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, foreshown, prophesied; shown forth, shown, brought to light, manifested, exhibited, evinced; made known, signified; rendered clear, taught; mentioned, declared, specified.
प्रदर्शिन्: प्र-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing, viewing; pointing out, showing, indicating.
प्रदर्श्य: प्र-दर्श्य, ind. having exhibited or shown.
प्रपश्यत्: प्र-पश्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, foreseeing, looking.
प्रदॄ: प्रदॄ प्र-दॄ, cl. 9. P. -दृणाति, -दरितुम्, -दरीतुम्, to break or tear to pieces (Ved.): Pass. -दीर्यते, to cleave asunder, split open (intrans.); to be dispersed or scattered: Caus. -दारयति, -यि-तुम्, to split, cleave, tear asunder.
प्रद्यु: प्रद्यु प्र-द्यु, उ, n. (fr. प्र + 3. द्यु or 3. दिव्), good works leading to heaven, works securing heaven.
प्रद्युत्: प्रद्युत् प्र-द्युत्, cl. 1. A. -द्योतते, -द्योति-तुम्, to begin to shine or to be brilliant: Caus. -द्यो-तयति, -यितुम्, to irradiate, illumine.
प्रद्युतित: प्र-द्युतित, अस्, आ, अम्, beginning to shine or to be brilliant; illuminated, irradiated, lighted.
प्रद्योत: प्र-द्योत, अस्, m. illumining, irradiating; splen-dor, lustre, light; a ray of light; N. of a Yakṣa; of a king of Magadha and founder of a dynasty; of a king of Ujjayinī.
प्रद्योतन: प्र-द्योतन, अस्, m. the sun; N. of a prince of Ujjayinī; (अम्), n. blazing, shining, light.
प्रद्योतिन्: प्र-द्योतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, illumining, irradiating.
प्रद्युम्न: प्रद्युम्न प्र-द्युम्न, अस्, m. (fr. प्र + द्युम्न, see p. 438, col. 1), ‘the pre-eminently mighty one,’ an epithet of Kāma-deva the god of love, or of that deity in another birth (regarded as a son of Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī, or as a son of Saṅkar-ṣaṇa and then identified with Sanat-kumāra); N. of a son of Manu and Naḍvalā; of an astronomer; of a mountain (?); of a river. —प्रद्युम्न-पुर, अम्, n. ‘Pradyumna's city,’ N. of a town on the Candra-bhāgā or Chenab. —प्रद्युम्न-विजय, अस्, m. ‘Pradyumna's victory (over Vajra-nābha),’ N. of a drama by Śaṅkara-dīkṣita. —प्रद्युम्नागमन (°न-आग्°), अम्, n. the arrival of Pradyumna. —प्र-द्युम्नागमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, treating of the arrival of Pradyumna.
प्रद्रव: प्र-द्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, fluid, liquid.
प्रद्राणक: प्रद्राणक प्र-द्राणक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. द्रा with प्र), sorely distressed, very needy or indigent, very poor.
प्रद्रु: प्रद्रु प्र-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, to run forwards, run away, flee, escape, escape to (with acc.); to hasten, hasten away, go away; to hasten towards, rush against; to fall upon, assail; to attain: Caus. -द्रावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to run away, put to flight, rout.
प्रद्राव: प्र-द्राव, अस्, m. running away, running, flight, retreat, escape; going, going quickly or well.
प्रद्राविन्: प्र-द्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, runaway, fugitive; one who retreats or flies, retreating, flying, going.
प्रद्रुह्: प्रद्रुह् प्र-द्रुह्, -ध्रुक्, क्, क्, one who hurts or injures, trying to hurt.
प्रद्रेक्: प्रद्रेक् प्र-द्रेक्, cl. 1. A. -द्रेकते, -द्रेकि-तुम्, to shout out; to neigh, to roar, bellow.
प्रद्वार्: प्रद्वार् प्र-द्वार्, f. or प्र-द्वार, अम्, n. a place before a door or gate.
प्रद्विष्: प्रद्विष् 1. प्र-द्विष्, cl. 2. P. A. -द्वेष्टि, -द्विष्टे, -द्वेष्टुम्, to feel dislike or repugnance for, dislike, hate; to show one's hatred.
2. प्र-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, feeling dislike or repugnance for, disliking, hating.
प्रद्विषत्: प्र-द्विषत्, अन्, अती, अत्, feeling dislike or re-pugnance for, hating, hostile, an enemy.
प्रद्वेष: प्र-द्वेष, अस्, m. dislike, repugnance, aversion, disinclination, hatred, hostility; (ई), f., N. of the wife of Dīrgha-tamas.
प्रद्वेषण: प्र-द्वेषण, अम्, n. hating, hatred, hostility.
प्रद्वेष्टृ: प्र-द्वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who dislikes or hates, a disliker, hater.
प्रध: प्रध प्र-ध। See under प्र-धा, col. 3.
प्र-ध, अस्, आ, अम्, holding, having; (आ), f., see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 4, 64; N. of a daughter of Dakṣa.
प्रधन: प्रधन प्र-धन, अम्, n. spoil taken in battle, a prize gained by a victor; a contest, conflict, combat, fight, war, battle [cf. धन]; tearing, rending, destruction, destroying; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants. —प्र-धनोत्तम (°न-उत्°), अम्, n. ‘best of battles,’ a great battle or contest.
प्रधन्य: प्रधन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. forming or consti-tuting the spoil or booty (as cattle).
प्रधमन: प्रधमन प्र-धमन। See under 1. प्र-ध्मा, p. 632, col. 1.
प्र-धमन, अम्, n. blowing in, blowing into (the nose, as powder &c.); a sternutatory.
प्रधर्ष: प्रधर्ष प्र-धर्ष, &c. See under प्र-धृष्, p. 632, col. 1.
प्र-धर्ष, अस्, m. attacking, assaulting, assail-ing; [cf. दुष्-प्°।]
प्रधा: प्रधा प्र-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place or set before, offer; to give up, deliver.
प्रधान: प्र-धान, अस्, आ, अम्, chief, main, principal, capital (city); pre-eminent, most eminent, most ex-cellent, best; prevalent, predominant, preponderant, principally or pre-eminently inherent; (अम्), n. a chief or principal thing, chief object, the most important thing, the head, chief, (often at the end of a comp., e. g. इन्द्र-प्रधान, having Indra as the chief object; cf. धर्म-प्°, विनय-प्°, यथा-प्रधा-नम्); (in Sāṅkhya phil.) = प्रकृति, ‘the Ori-ginant,’ primary or original matter or rather the primary germ out of which all material appearances are evolved, the first evolver or source of the material world (hence in a general acceptation ‘nature’ or rather ‘matter’ as opposed to पुरुष or ‘spirit’); the Supreme Spirit, the Supreme Deity; intellect, un-derstanding; (in grammar) the principal member of a compound (opposed to the उप-सर्जन or secondary member by which the primary member is qualified); (अस्, अम्), m. n. the first companion or attendant of a king, his minister or counsellor, his eunuch or con-fidant; a courtier, a noble; an elephant-driver; (अस्), m., N. of an ancient king. —प्रधान-कर्मन्, अ, n. or प्रधान-कार्य, अम्, n. chief or principal action; the principal mode of treatment (in medi-cine). —प्रधान-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, the most excellent or distinguished, most important, chiefest. —प्रधान-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more excellent, better. —प्रधान-तस्, ind. according to eminence or superiority. —प्रधान-ता, f. pre-eminence, excellence, superiority, supremacy, prevalence; the being Pra-dhāna, q. v., (in Mahā-bh. Vana-p. 173 = जगत्-कारणता; cf. शरीर-प्°।) —प्रधान-त्व, अम्, n. pre-eminence, superiority, excellence; (in Sāṅkhya phil.) the being Pra-dhāna, q. v. —प्रधान-धातु, उस्, m. the chief element or ingredient of the body, semen virile. —प्रधान-पुरुष, अस्, m. a chief person, most distinguished personage; an epithet of Śiva. —प्रधान-पुरु-षातीत (°ष-अत्°), अस्, m. transcending Pradhāna and Puruṣa (matter and spirit); an epithet of Śiva. —प्रधान-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, receiving the chief share, presiding over; the most excellent or distinguished. —प्रधान-मन्त्रिन्, ई, m. a prime minister. —प्रधान-मित्र, अम्, n. a chief friend. —प्र-धान-वासस्, असी, n. du. two principal garments, best clothes. —प्रधान-वृष्टि, इस्, f. very copious rain, heaviest rain. —प्रधान-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, taught or laid down as of primary importance; [cf. अन्वा-चय-शिष्ट।] —प्रधान-सेवा, f. chief or prin-cipal service. —प्रधानाङ्ग (°न-अङ्°), अम्, n. a chief member, the chief member of the body; most eminent person in a state; principal branch of a science, &c. —प्रधानात्मन् (°न-आत्°), आ, m. the highest personal principle, the chief soul, an epithet of Viṣṇu; one with crude nature or Viśva-bhāvana. —प्रधानाध्यक्ष (°न-अध्°), अस्, m. a chief superintendent. —प्रधानाध्यक्ष-ता (°न-अध्°), f. the office of chief superintendent. —प्र-धानामात्य (°न-अम्°), अस्, m. a prime minister. —प्रधानोत्तम (°न-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, best of the eminent, eminent, illustrious; warlike, brave.
प्रधानक: प्रधानक, अम्, n. (in Sāṅkhya phil.) primary or original matter (= प्र-धान, अ-व्यक्त, q. q. v. v.).
प्रधान्य: प्रधान्य, a wrong reading for प्राधान्य, q. v.
प्रधि: प्र-धि, इस्, m. that which is placed round the nave of a wheel, the circumference or periphery of a wheel; a well. —प्रधि-मण्डल, अम्, n. the circumference of a wheel.
प्रधाव्: प्रधाव् 1. प्र-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to run forwards, run forth, run away; to set out, start; to become diffused, spread; to pervade, permeate: Caus. P. -धावयति, -यितुम्, to drive away, drive.
प्रधाव् 2. प्र-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to wash; to rub off: Caus. -धाव-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to wash; to wash.
प्रधावित: प्र-धावित, अस्, आ, अम्, run forwards, run away; set out, started.
प्रधावन: प्र-धावन, अम्, n. rubbing or washing off; (अस्), m. air, wind (regarded as a ‘purifier,’ cf. प-वन; or perhaps fr. 1. प्र-धाव्, regarded as a ‘runner’).
प्रधी: प्रधी प्र-धी, ईस्, f. great intelligence; (ईस्, ईस्, इ), of superior intelligence, pre-eminently intelligent.
प्रधूपित: प्रधूपित प्र-धूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, fumigated, perfumed; heated, burnt; lighted, inflamed; afflicted; excited; (आ), f. a woman in trouble or affliction; the quarter to which the sun is proceeding.
प्रधृ: प्रधृ प्र-धृ, Caus. -धारयति, -यितुम्, to direct towards, place or fix upon; (with मनस्) to set the mind upon anything (dat.), resolve, deter-mine; to bear in mind, keep in remembrance; to reflect, consider; to chastise, punish, inflict a punish-ment or penalty on any one (with loc.; cf. दण्डं धृ).
प्रधारण: प्र-धारण, अस्, ई, अम्, keeping, preserving, protecting [cf. पाद-प्°]; (आ), f. (probably) a parti-cular high order of intelligence.
प्रधृष्: प्रधृष् प्र-धृष्, cl. 1. 5. P. -धर्षति, -धृष्णोति, -धर्षितुम्, to be bold against, assail with courage or daring; to lay hands on, hurt, injure, harass; to overpower, overcome: Caus. -धर्षयति, -यितुम्, to attack, assault, assail; to hurt, injure; to overcome; to violate (a woman); to destroy, lay waste, devastate.
प्रधर्षक: प्र-धर्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, attacking, assailing; molesting, troubling, harassing.
प्रधर्षण: प्र-धर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, attacking, assailing; molesting, troubling, harassing; (अम्, आ), n. f. attack-ing, assailing, an attack, assault; ill treatment, molesta-tion; केश-प्रधर्षण, dragging by the hair.
प्रधर्षणीय: प्र-धर्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be assailed or attacked, assailable, open to attack, exposed to injury or ill treatment.
प्रधर्षित: प्र-धर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, attacked, assailed; hurt, injured; haughty, arrogant. —प्रधर्षित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, arrogant, proud.
प्रधृष्ट: प्र-धृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, treated with contumely; proud, arrogant.
प्रधृष्टि: प्र-धृष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. overpowering, subju-gation.
प्रधृष्य: प्र-धृष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hurt or injured, violable; [cf. दुष्-प्°, सु-प्°।]
प्रध्मा: प्रध्मा 1. प्र-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति, -ध्मातुम्, to blow before or in front, blow forth, blow away, destroy; to blow into (with acc.): Pass. -ध्मायते, to be blown or tossed about, wander about: Caus. P. A. -ध्मापयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to blow into, blow (a conch shell).
2. प्र-ध्मा, आस्, आस्, अम्, blowing violently.
प्रध्मापन: प्र-ध्मापन, अम्, n. (in medicine) a remedy for assisting respiration in any obstruction of the air-passages.
प्रध्मापित: प्र-ध्मापित, अस्, आ, अम्, blown into, blown (as a conch shell).
प्रध्यै: प्रध्यै प्र-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. A. -ध्यायति, -ते, -ध्यातुम्, to meditate upon, reflect upon, think of (with acc. or with प्रति); to reflect, consider; to excogitate, devise, hit upon.
प्रध्यान: प्र-ध्यान, अम्, n. reflecting, reflection, think-ing, thought; deep thought, subtile speculation.
प्रध्वंस्: प्रध्वंस् प्र-ध्वंस्, cl. 1. P. -ध्वंसति, -ध्वंसितुम्, to fall to pieces, fall in ruins, be de-stroyed, perish: Caus. -ध्वंसयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall, destroy, cause to perish; to scatter, sprinkle (Ved.).
प्रध्वंस: प्र-ध्वंस, अस्, m. utter destruction, annihila-tion; loss. —प्रध्वंस-त्व, अम्, n. a state of destruction, ruin. —प्रध्वंसाभाव (°स-अभ्°), अस्, m. non-existence in consequence of annihilation, ceasing to exist, complete extinction.
प्रध्वंसन: प्र-ध्वंसन, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying, annihi-lating; (अस्), m., Ved. one who destroys or anni-hilates, a destroyer.
प्रध्वंसिन्: प्र-ध्वंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, passing, transitory, perish-able; destroying, annihilating.
प्रध्वस्त: प्र-ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen to pieces, disap-peared, perished, destroyed, annihilated.
प्रध्वन्: प्रध्वन् प्र-ध्वन्, cl. 1. P. -ध्वनति, -ध्व-नितुम्, to sound forth, resound.
प्रध्वनयत्: प्र-ध्वनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to sound.
प्रनक्ष्: प्रनक्ष् प्र-नक्ष्, cl. 1. P. A. -नक्षति, -ते, -नक्षितुम्, Ved. to draw near, approach; (Sāy.) = सर्वतो व्याप्, to be everywhere present.
प्रनर्द्: प्रनर्द् प्र-नर्द्, cl. 1. P. -नर्दति, -नर्दि-तुम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 14.
प्रनायक: प्रनायक प्र-नायक, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose leader is away, whose rulers are abroad; destitute of a guide.
प्रनाल: प्रनाल प्र-नाल, प्र-नाली = प्र-णाल, प्र-णाली, p. 609, col. 3.
प्रनाशिन्: प्रनाशिन् प्र-नाशिन्, incorrectly for प्र-णाशिन्, p. 609, col. 2.
प्रनिंसित: प्रनिंसित प्र-निंसित, प्र-निंसितव्य = प्र-णिंसित, प्र-णिंसितव्य, p. 609, col. 3.
प्रनिघातन: प्रनिघातन प्र-निघातन, अम्, n. (fr. Caus. of rt. हन् with प्र-नि), killing, slaughter, murder.
प्रनिभिद्: प्रनिभिद् प्र-नि-भिद्, cl. 7. P. -भिनत्ति, -भेत्तुम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 18.
प्रनिरक्ष्: प्रनिरक्ष् प्र-नि-रक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -रक्षति, -रक्षितुम्, to protect, defend, maintain.
प्रनीड: प्रनीड प्र-नीड, अस्, आ, अम्, flown from the nest, having left a nest.
प्रनुद्: प्रनुद् प्र-नुद्, incorrectly for प्र-णुद्, q. v.
प्रनृत्: प्रनृत् प्र-नृत्, cl. 4. P. -नृत्यति, -नर्तितुम्, to dance forwards, begin to dance, dance; to gesti-culate as in dancing (in token of derision).
प्रनर्तित: प्र-नर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to dance forwards, set in motion, shaken, agitated; dandled.
प्रनृत्त: प्र-नृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has begun to dance, dancing; (अम्), n. a dance; (also incorrectly written प्र-नृत्य।) —प्रनृत्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having danced forward, having begun to dance.
प्रनृत्यत्: प्र-नृत्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dancing forward, beginning to dance, dancing.
प्रपक्ष: प्रपक्ष प्र-पक्ष, अस्, m. the extremity of a wing (of an army drawn out in the form of a bird); (अस्, आ, अम्), forming the extremity of a wing (in an army so arranged).
प्रपच्: प्रपच् प्र-पच्, cl. 1. P. A. -पचति, -ते, -पक्-तुम्, to begin to cook; to be accustomed to cook.
प्रपक्व: प्र-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (in medicine) inflamed.
प्रपाक: प्र-पाक, अस्, m. ripening (of a boil &c.); in-flammation.
प्रपञ्च: प्रपञ्च प्र-पञ्च, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. पच् or पञ्च् with प्र), spreading out, development, dif-fusion, display, amplification, expansion; expanse, ex-tent; (in philosophy) the expansion of the universe, the world as the scene of manifold action, the visible world or universe; prolixity, diffuseness, copiousness (in style or composition); heap, abundance, quantity; manifoldness, diversity; phenomenon, appearance; illusion, delusion, deceit, trick, fraud, error; reci-procal false praise; reverse, opposition, reversion, inversion; analysis; (in grammar) the repetition of an obscure rule in a clearer form; a joke, jest (?); (as an enclitic after a finite verb) see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27, 57; प्रपञ्चेन or प्रपञ्च-तस्, ind. diffusely, in detail. —प्रपञ्च-निर्माण, अम्, n. the creation of the visible world. —प्रपञ्च-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, deceitful-minded, artful, cunning; (इस्), m., N. of a man. —प्रपञ्च-वचन, अम्, n. a diffuse or prolix discourse. —प्रपञ्च-विवेक and प्रपञ्च-सार, अस्, m., N. of two works.
प्रपञ्चक: प्र-पञ्चक, अस्, इका, अम्, developing, displaying; explaining, copiously expounding.
प्रपञ्चन: प्र-पञ्चन, अम्, n. development, display, diffu-sion; copious explanation or exposition, explication.
प्रपञ्चय: प्रपञ्चय, Nom. P. प्रपञ्चयति, -यितुम्, to develop, amplify; to display, explain in detail, analyze; to dwell upon a note (in music); to cause to appear in a false light.
प्रपञ्चित: प्रपञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Nom.), amplified, expanded, extended, diffused; declared fully, ex-plained, expatiated upon, treated at length; caused to appear in a false light; mistaken, erring; tricked, deceived, beguiled.
प्रपठ्: प्रपठ् प्र-पठ्, cl. 1. P. -पठति, -पठितुम्, to recite aloud: Caus. -पाठयति, -यितुम्, to teach, lecture, expound.
प्रपाठक: प्र-पाठक, अस्, m. a lesson, lecture, a division, chapter or subdivision of a book (sometimes read प्र-पाठ).
प्रपण: प्रपण प्र-पण, अस्, m., Ved. (fr. rt. 2. पण् with प्र), exchange, barter.
प्रपत्: प्रपत् प्र-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to fly forwards, fly along, fly forth, fly away; to hasten forwards, hasten away; to fly down, rush or dart down; to fall down, fall; to fall into; to come to; to fall from, be deprived of, lose (with abl.): Caus. -पातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fly away, put to flight; to chase, pursue: Desid. -पिपतिषति, Ved. to wish to hurry away: Intens. -पापतीति, Ved. to shoot forth; (Sāy.) = पुनः पुनः पत्, to fall again and again, descend repeatedly.
प्रपतन: प्र-पतन, अम्, n. flying forwards, flying forth, flying away; falling, falling down or into, precipi-tating one's self from; alighting; dying, death, destruction; a steep rock, precipice.
प्रपतित: प्र-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, flown forwards, flown away, flown; fallen, come down; decayed, dead.
प्रपात: प्र-पात, अस्, m. a particular mode of flying; starting off, hastening away, going away, departure; springing forth, sudden attack, facing an enemy; falling down or into, a fall; precipitating one's self down from a rock; falling out, (दन्त-केश-प्रपात, the falling out or loss of the teeth and hair); discharge, emission, flux [cf. वीर्य-प्°]; a steep rock, cliff, precipice; a steep bank or shore; a cascade, water-fall. —प्रपाताभिमुख (°त-अभ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, inclined to precipitate one's self from a rock. —प्रपाताम्बु (°त-अम्°), उ, n. falling water, water falling from a rock.
प्रपातन: प्र-पातन, अम्, n. the causing to fall, throwing down, throwing on the ground; अक्ष-प्रपातन, throwing dice.
प्रपातिन्: प्र-पातिन्, ई, m. a precipitous mountain, moun-tain, rock, cliff.
प्रपित्सु: प्र-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to de-scend or alight, wishing to fall or throw one's self down.
प्र-पित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of attaining, de-sirous of entering upon.
प्रपथ: प्रपथ प्र-पथ, अस्, m., Ved. a long way or journey, a journey to a distant place; a remote place; a broad road or street; (अस्, आ, अम्), loose, relaxed, languid, enervated.
प्रपथिन्: प्रपथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. roaming on distant paths (Sāy. = प्रकृष्ट-मार्ग); (ई), m., N. of a man (?).
प्रपथ्य: प्रपथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in the streets or on the road (Mahī-dhara = बहु-सेवितो मार्गस् तत्र भवः, being in a much frequented road); an epithet of Pūṣan, the tutelary deity of travellers.
प्रपाथ: प्रपाथ, अस्, m. a road, way.
प्रपद्: प्रपद् 1. प्र-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्-तुम्, to go forwards, set out for, betake one's self to, resort to; to attain to, arrive at, reach; to take refuge with, flee to for safety, fly to for succour; to enter upon, enter into, set foot on; to come to a par-ticular state, arrive at a condition; to become (with adv. ending in सात्, e. g. सर्प-सात् प्रपद्, to become a serpent); to attain, obtain, gain, partake of, share in; to perceive; to come on, draw near, approach, appear (said of periods of time); to be going on, to proceed; to take effect, prosper; to deal with, act towards, behave towards; to allow, admit, assent, agree to; to throw one's self down, fall down (at another's feet); to fall upon, attack, assault, assail (Ved.); अध्वानम् प्रपद्, to set forth on the way, begin a journey; जिन-शाशनम् प्रपद्, to embrace the doctrines of Jina: Caus. P. A. -पादयति, -ते, -यि-तुम्, to cause to enter, introduce: Desid. P. A. -पित्सति, -ते, to wish to enter; to desire to obtain; to be going to undertake.
2. प्र-पद्, त्, f., Ved. a way; N. of particular sacred texts; (fr. प्र + 3. पद्), the fore part of the foot.
प्रपद: प्र-पद, अम्, n. (fr. प्र + पद), the fore part of the foot; the point of the foot, tip of the toes; (ऐस्), ind. on tiptoe.
प्रपदम्: प्रपदम्, ind. a term applied to a particular mode of recitation (in which the Vedic verses are divided, without reference to the sense and construction, into parts of an equal number of syllables, and between these parts particular formulas inserted containing the word प्र-पद्ये).
प्रपदीन: प्रपदीन, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the fore part of the foot; extending to it, (wrongly for आप्रप-दीन, q. v.)
प्रपन्न: प्र-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, arriving at, reaching; seeking, adhering to; one who seeks for protection or takes refuge, a suppliant; attained, obtained; pos-sessed of, furnished with, provided with; promised, assented to; effecting, producing; poor, distressed. —प्रपन्न-पाल, अस्, m. ‘the protector of sup-pliants or of those who seek protection,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —प्रपन्नामृत (°न-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘nectar for suppliants,’ N. of a work. —प्रपन्-नार्ति-हर (°न-आर्°), अस्, ई, अम्, relieving or re-liever of the distress of suppliants.
प्रपाद: प्र-पाद, अस्, m., Ved. premature delivery, mis-carriage.
प्रपादुक: प्र-पादुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. going off, coming forth.
प्रपर्ण: प्रपर्ण प्र-पर्ण, अस्, m. a fallen leaf.
प्रपलाय: प्रपलाय प्र-पलाय, cl. 1. A. -पलायते, -यितुम्, to run away, flee away, escape.
प्रपलायन: प्र-पलायन, अम्, n. running away, flight, rout.
प्रपलायित: प्र-पलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, run away; routed, defeated.
प्रपलायिन्: प्र-पलायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, running away, flying, escaping; a fugitive, one who deserts his cause.
प्रपवण: प्रपवण प्र-पवण or प्र-पवन, अम्, n. (rt. 1. पू), purifying, straining (Soma juice).
प्रपवणीय: प्र-पवणीय or प्र-पवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cleansed or purified.
प्रपा: प्रपा 1. प्र-पा (see rt. 1. पा), cl. 1. P. -पिबति (Ved. -पाति), -पातुम्, to begin to drink, drink, quaff, sip; (with चक्षुषा) to drink in with the eyes, feast the eyes upon.

2. प्र-पा, f. (according to the usual rule the nom. sing. would be प्र-पास्), a place for watering cattle, a shed on the road-side for accommodating travellers with water, place where water is distributed, cistern, (according to Kullūka = पानीय-दान-गृह); a draught; a supply of water. —प्रपा-पूरण, अम्, n. filling a place for watering cattle, furnishing a cistern with water. —प्रपापूरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, serving to fill a cistern. —प्रपा-वन, अम्, n. ‘cistern-grove,’ a pleasure-garden, a cool grove.
प्रपा 3. प्र-पा (see rt. 3. पा), cl. 2. P. -पाति, -पातुम्, to protect, defend from (with abl.): Caus. -पालयति, -यितुम्, to guard, screen, defend, protect.
प्रपाणीय: प्र-पाणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drunk, drinkable, potable.
प्रपान: प्र-पान, अम्, n. drinking, sipping; the under part of a horse's upper lip (which he uses in drinking).
प्रपानक: प्रपानक, अम्, n. (probably) a draught, beverage.
प्रपायिन्: 1. प्र-पायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, drinking, one who drinks.
प्रपालन: प्र-पालन, अम्, n. guarding, protecting, pro-tection.
प्रपालिन्: प्र-पालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, guarding, protecting; (ई), m. an epithet of Bala-rāma.
प्रपाणि: प्रपाणि प्र-पाणि, इस्, m. the flat or palm of the hand.
प्रपाण्डु: प्रपाण्डु प्र-पाण्डु, उस्, उस्, उ, very white, of a dazzling white colour.
प्रपादिक: प्रपादिक प्रपादिक, अस्, m. a peacock; (also read प्रपादीक।)
प्रपितामह: प्रपितामह प्र-पितामह, अस्, m. a paternal great-grandfather; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (regarded as great-grandfather of the three worlds); an epithet of Brahmā; (ई), f. a paternal great-grandmother; (आस्), m. pl. great-grandfathers, ancestors in general.
प्रपितृव्य: प्र-पितृव्य, अस्, m. a paternal grand-uncle.
प्रपित्व: प्रपित्व प्र-पित्व, अम्, n., Ved. going towards, going to meet, meeting with, encountering (Sāy. = सङ्ग्राम, combat); the coming on or ap-proach of day, day-break (Sāy. = प्र-क्रम); [cf. अप-पित्व, अभि-पित्व।]
प्रपिन्व्: प्रपिन्व् प्र-पिन्व्, cl. 1. P. A. -पिन्वति, -ते, -पिन्वितुम्, Ved. to swell, be full of, be rich, flow over.
प्रपिष्: प्रपिष् प्र-पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि, -पेष्-टुम्, to crush, pound: Caus. -पेषयति, -यितुम्, to pound, grind or crush to pieces.
प्रपिष्ट: प्र-पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pounded, ground or crushed to pieces.
प्रपीड्: प्रपीड् प्र-पीड्, Caus. -पीडयति, -यितुम्, to press hard, press, squeeze; to check, suppress; to oppress, molest, injure, pain, torment, torture.
प्रपीडन: प्र-पीडन, अम्, n. pressing, squeezing; (in medicine) an astringent.
प्रपीडित: प्र-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed, oppressed; pained, tortured.
प्रपीत: प्र-पीत or प्र-पीन, अस्, आ, अम्, swollen out, swollen up, distended.
प्रपुत्र: प्रपुत्र प्र-पुत्र, अस्, m. a grandson, de-scendant.
प्रपुनाट: प्रपुनाट प्रपुनाट, or प्रपुनाड, or प्र-पुन्नड, or प्रपुन्नाट, or प्रपुन्नाड, or प्रपुन्नाल, अस्, m. a species of tree, Cassia Tora; the ringworm shrub, Cassia Alata.
प्रपुष्: प्रपुष् प्र-पुष्, cl. 4. 9. P. -पुष्यति, -पुष्णाति, -पोषितुम्, to nourish, feed, support, maintain.
प्रपुष्पित: प्रपुष्पित प्र-पुष्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, flowering, in blossom, blooming.
प्रपूज्: प्रपूज् प्र-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यितुम्, to show respect or honour to, praise, esteem, honour.

The Nyāya admits only four, excluding the last two. The Sāṅkhya only three, viz. Pratyakṣa, Anumāna, and Śabda, excluding the third or Upamāna as well as the fifth and sixth: besides the Pramāṇas of the three orthodox schools, with their branches, other schools increase the number to nine by adding 1. सम्भव, equi-valence; 2. ऐतिह्य, tradition or fallible testimony; 3. चेष्टा, gesture); testimony, evidence; a scrip-ture, a work of sacred authority; a speaker of the truth; a correct notion, right conception; cause, motive; a sense of security, freedom from appre-hension; the prosodial length of a vowel; physical power or strength; the first term in a rule of three sum; principal, capital; oneness, unity; constant, eternal; a title of Viṣṇu; (अस्), m. rule, standard, authority; N. of a large fig-tree on the bank of the Ganges (Mahā-bh. 2. प्र-मुद्, त्, त्, त्, pleased, happy; (त्), f., Ved. gladness, delight, pleasure; sensual pleasure.

प्रमोद प्र-मोद, &c. See under 1. प्र-मुद्, col. 2.
प्रमोदक: प्र-मोदक, अस्, m. a kind of grain (= षष्-टिका).
प्रमोदन: प्र-मोदन, अस्, ई, अम्, making glad, gladdening, exhilarating; an epithet of Viṣṇu; (अम्), n. making glad, gladdening; gladness, joyousness.
प्रमोदमान: प्र-मोदमान, अम्, n. ‘rejoicing,’ epithet of one of the eight perfections in the Sāṅkhya phi-losophy.
प्रमोदित: प्र-मोदित, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted, rejoiced, pleased, happy; (अस्), m. an epithet of Kuvera; (अम्), n. epithet of one of the eight perfections in the Sāṅkhya philosophy; [cf. प्र-मोदमान above.]
प्रमोदिन्: प्रमोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing excessive joy, de-lighting, making happy, gladdening; delighted, happy; (इनी), f., N. of a plant (= जिङ्गिनी).
प्रमुर्छ्: प्रमुर्छ् प्र-मुर्छ्, cl. 1. P. -मूर्छति, -मूर्-छितुम्, Ved. to become thick or solid, congeal.

प्रमोहन: प्र-मोहन, अस्, ई, अम्, infatuating the mind.
प्रमोहित: प्र-मोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, infatuated.
प्रमोहिन्: प्रमोहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bewildering, infatuating.

प्रमृत: प्र-मृत, अस्, आ, अम्, dead, deceased; with-drawn or gone out of sight; covered, concealed; (अम्), n. death; tillage, cultivation.
प्रमृगम्: प्रमृगम् प्र-मृगम्, ind., see Gaṇa Tish-ṭhadgv-ādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 17.
प्रमृग्य: प्र-मृग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought or searched after; peculiarly adapted to or fitted for (with dat.).
प्रमृज्: प्रमृज् प्र-मृज्, cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि, -मार्जि-तुम्, -मार्ष्टुम्, to wash out, wash, clean, cleanse; to wash off, wipe off, wipe away; to wipe out, re-move, expel, rid one's self of; to rub gently, stroke, pass the hand over, rub; to make ready, prepare; to render unavailing, frustrate.
प्रमार्जन: प्र-मार्जन, अम्, n. the act of rubbing off, wiping off; अश्रु-प्रमार्जन, the wiping away or drying of tears, consoling.
प्रमृष्ट: प्र-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, washed or rubbed off; rubbed; polished, bright, clear.
प्रमृण्: प्रमृण् प्र-मृण्, cl. 6. P. -मृणति, &c., Ved. to crush, destroy.
प्रमृण: प्र-मृण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. destroying, crushing.
प्रमृद्: प्रमृद् प्र-मृद्, cl. 9. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्-दितुम्, to crush down, destroy, lay waste, ravage, devastate.
प्रमर्दन: प्र-मर्दन, अस्, ई, अम्, crushing down, crush-ing, destroying; rubbing out or away; (अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; N. of an attendant of Śiva; of a Vidyā-dhara; of a general of Śambara; (अम्), n. crushing, destroying.
प्रमर्दितृ: प्र-मर्दितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who crushes or destroys, a destroyer.
प्रमर्दिन्: प्र-मर्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, destroying, crushing.

प्रमृष्य: प्र-मृष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, in अ-प्°, q. v.

प्रम्लोचन्ती: प्र-म्लोचन्ती or प्र-म्लोचा, f., N. of an Apsaras or nymph of heaven.

प्रयन्तृ: प्र-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who offers or presents, a giver, bringer.
प्रयाम: प्र-याम, अस्, m. checking, restraining; dearth, scarcity, dearness; competition of buyers in conse-quence of scarcity; length (either of space or time).
प्रयाम्य: प्र-याम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be checked or con-trolled.
प्रयस्: प्रयस् 1. प्र-यस्, cl. 4. 1. P. -यस्यति, -य-सति, -यसितुम्, to endeavour, labour, strive after (with dat.).

प्रयस् 2. प्रयस्, अस्, n. (fr. rt. 1. प्री), Ved. pleasure, enjoyment, delight; an object of enjoy-ment, delicate or dainty food, refreshing draught or beverage; a sacrifice; प्रयांसि नदीनाम्, the re-freshing waters of rivers (Sāy. = नदीनाम् प्रीणयि-त्रीणि जलानि); (आस्, आस्, अस्), valuable, precious (?). —प्रयस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having or bestow-ing pleasant food, offering refreshing food (Sāy. = हविर्-लक्षणान्न-वत्); (अत्), n., N. of a Sā-man; प्रयस्वन्तो ऽत्रयः, N. of the authors of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 20. —१। प्रयो-ग, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. प्र-योग see p. 640, col. 1), Ved. coming to a meal; (अस्), m., N. of a Ṛṣi with the patronymic Bhārgava, author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 91.

प्रयोजयत्: प्र-योजयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, combining; behaving to, acting towards; showing, displaying.

प्रराध्य: प्र-राध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be satisfied or made content.

प्ररुच्: प्ररुच् प्र-रुच्, cl. 1. A. -रोचते, -रोचितुम्, to shine forth, shine, be brilliant.

प्ररुज: प्र-रुज, अस्, m., N. of a mythical being con-quered by Garuḍa; N. of a Rākṣasa.

प्रलभ्: प्रलभ् प्र-लभ्, cl. 1. A. -लभते (ep. also -लम्भते), -लब्धुम्, to overreach, cheat, deceive.

प्रलब्धव्य: प्र-लब्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cheated or deceived.

प्रलिख्: प्रलिख् प्र-लिख्, cl. 6. P. -लिखति, -लेखि-तुम्, to draw lines along (the ground); to scratch.
प्रलिप: प्रलिप प्र-लिप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लिप् with प्र), one who smears or plasters, smearing, plas-tering.
प्रलेप: प्र-लेप, अस्, m. an unguent, ointment, plaster, salve.
प्रलेपक: प्र-लेपक, अस्, इका, अम्, anointing, smearing, plastering; (अस्), m. a plasterer, an anointer; a par-ticular marine substance, lime made of calcined shells (?); a hectic or slow fever.
प्रलेपन: प्र-लेपन, अम्, n. the act of anointing or smearing.
प्रलेप्य: प्र-लेप्य, अस्, m. clean or well-trimmed hair; (perhaps incorrectly for a form प्र-लेभ्य।)
प्रली: प्रली प्र-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम्, -ला-तुम्, to become dissolved or reabsorbed, dissolve, melt away; to disappear, vanish; to die, perish.
प्रलयन: प्र-लयन, अम्, n., Ved. a place of rest or repose, a bed.
प्रलीन: प्र-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, dissolved, melted away; de-stroyed, annihilated; unconscious, insensible. —प्र-लीन-ता, f. or प्रलीन-त्व, अम्, n. dissolution, de-struction, annihilation, the end of the universe; unconsciousness, loss of sense, fainting. —प्रलीन-भूपाल, अस्, आ, अम्, whose monarchs have been destroyed.
प्रलुठ्: प्रलुठ् प्र-लुठ्, cl. 1. P. -लोठति, -लोठितुम्, to roll forwards, roll along the ground, roll round, turn round; to be agitated, heave, toss.
प्रलोठन: प्र-लोठन, अम्, n. rolling forwards, rolling on the ground; heaving, tossing (as of the ocean).
प्रलोठित: प्र-लोठित, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling forwards, rolling; heaving, tossing.
प्रलुप्: प्रलुप् प्र-लुप्, Pass. -लुप्यते, to be in-terrupted; to be destroyed; to be violated; to be disturbed.
प्रलुभ्: प्रलुभ् प्र-लुभ्, cl. 4. P. A. -लुभ्यति, -ते, -लोब्धुम्, to be lustful, follow one's lusts, lust after; to pollute (through lust); to allure, entice, seduce: Caus. -लोभयति, -यितुम्, to cause to lust, allure, entice, seduce.
प्रलोभ: प्र-लोभ, अस्, m. allurement, seduction; desire, covetousness, cupidity, greediness.
प्रलोभक: प्र-लोभक, अस्, m. ‘allurer,’ N. of a jackal.
प्रलोभन: प्र-लोभन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to lust after, alluring, seducing; (अम्), n. seducing, attracting, attraction; allurement, inducement; that which allures, a lure, bait; (ई), f. gravel, sand.
प्रलोभित: प्र-लोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, allured, enticed, seduced.
प्रलोभिन्: प्र-लोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lusting after, desiring; alluring, seducing.
प्रलोभ्य: प्र-लोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be lusted after or desired, desirable, attractive, alluring.
प्रलेह: प्रलेह प्र-लेह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लिह् with प्र), a kind of broth.
प्रलेहन: प्र-लेहन, अम्, n. the act of licking.
प्रलोल: प्रलोल प्र-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, being in violent motion, agitated.
प्रलोलुप: प्रलोलुप प्र-लोलुप, अस्, m., N. of Kunti (a descendant of Garuḍa).
प्रल्कारीय: प्रल्कारीय प्रल्कारीय, Nom. (fr. प्र + ऌ-कार), प्रल्कारीयति, -यितुम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 92; (also प्राल्कारीय।)
प्रव: प्रव प्रव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. प्रु), Ved. fluttering, hovering; (Sāy.) = गच्छत्. —प्रव-ग, अस्, m. = प्लव-ग, a monkey. —प्रवङ्-ग, अस्, m. = प्लवङ्-ग, a monkey; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people. —प्रवङ्-गम, अस्, m. = प्लवङ्-गम, a monkey.
प्रवक: प्रवक, अस्, आ, अम्, going, one who goes.
प्रवच्: प्रवच् प्र-वच्, cl. 2. P. -वक्ति, -वक्तुम्, to speak forth, begin to speak, declare, announce, relate, tell (with acc. of the thing and gen. or dat. of the person); to speak to, address; to speak, say; to explain; to recite; to celebrate.
प्रवक्तव्य: प्र-वक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declared or announced; to be imparted or taught; to be ex-pounded or explained.
प्रवक्तृ: प्र-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who speaks or de-clares, one who announces or informs, a speaker, declarer, announcer, informer; a propounder, teacher, expounder (Manu VII. 20); a fine speaker, good orator, eloquent man. —प्रवक्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. the being an expounder or teacher.
प्रवचन: प्र-वचन, अम्, n. speaking, talking; declara-tion, announcement, proclamation; recitation, oral instruction, teaching, expounding, exposition, inter-pretation [cf. साङ्ख्य-प्रवचन-भाष्य]; ex-cellent speech or language, eloquence; an expression, term; a system of doctrines propounded in a treatise or dissertation; sacred writings, especially the Brāh-maṇas; the fundamental doctrine of Buddhists; the sacred writings of the Jainas; प्र-वचन is also said to be used as an enclitic after a simple verb, see Gaṇa Gotrādi to Pāṇ. VIII. 1, 27. —प्रवचन-पटु, उस्, उस्, उ, skilled in speaking, eloquent.
प्रवचनीय: प्र-वचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be declared; to be taught or propounded; to be well or elegantly spoken; a good speaker; a propounder, teacher.
प्रवाक: प्र-वाक, अस्, m. proclaiming, announcing, a pro-claimer, announcer.
प्रवाक प्र-वाक, प्र-वाच्, &c. See p. 641, col. 3.
प्रवाच्: प्र-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, eloquent, oratorical, speaking, a speaker.
प्रवाचक: प्र-वाचक, अस्, इका, अम्, declaratory, explana-tory; speaking well, eloquent.
प्रवाचन: प्र-वाचन, अम्, n. a proclamation, promulgation; a designation; द्वि-प्रवाचन, having a twofold designation.
प्रवाच्य: प्र-वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proclaimed aloud; praiseworthy, glorious (Ved., Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण वक्तव्य); to be spoken to or addressed; (अम्), n. a literary production.
प्रवट: प्रवट प्र-वट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वट् with प्र), wheat.
प्रवण: प्रवण प्रवण, अम्, n. (probably fr. 1. प्र; but according to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 5, said to be fr. 1. प्र + वन, a forest), the side of a hill, a declivity, steep descent, precipice, an abyss, depth, (in the earlier language used only in loc. sing.; Sāy. = निम्न-प्रदेश); (अस्), m. a place where four roads meet; (ए), ind. in a precipitous course, pre-cipitously, precipitately, suddenly, hurriedly, hastily; (अस्, आ, अम्), declining, bent, bowed, sloping down, shelving, flowing down (often in comps., e. g. निम्न-प्°, flowing downwards; cf. उदक्-प्°, दक्षिणा-प्°); precipitous, inclining downwards, steep, abrupt; curved, crooked; inclining, inclined to, directed towards, disposed to, tending to [cf. वञ्चन-प्°]; ready, willing; applying one's self to, devoted to, attached or adhering to, addicted, prone [cf. वि-षय-प्°]; filled with, possessed of, endowed with; generous; humble, modest; waning or fading away, wasted, decayed, disappeared. —प्रवण-ता, f. pre-cipitousness, inclination, proclivity, propensity, pro-pension, attachment, devotion. —प्रवण-प्रहर्-ष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose joy has faded away, whose happiness has disappeared. —प्रवण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a steep descent or declivity, having a downward course, downward, precipitous.
प्रवणाय: प्रवणाय, Nom. P. प्रवणायति, -यितुम्, to feel inclined or disposed towards.
प्रवणायित: प्रवणायित, अम्, n. inclination, propensity, bias.
प्रवत्: प्रवत्, त्, f. (fr. 1. प्र), Ved. the side of a moun-tain, a declivity, precipice; an elevation, height, the heavenly height; a sloping path, easy course, rapid pro-gress; प्रवतो नपात्, ‘son of the heavenly height,’ an epithet of lightning; प्रवतस्, pl. the heavenly heights (sometimes said to be three, sometimes seven in number; Sāy. = आपस्); flowing down declivities (said of rivers; Sāy. = प्रवण-देशे गच्-छत्); (आन्, अती, अत्), directed forwards or towards; containing the syllable प्र or पृ; (in the preceding adj. senses fr. 1. प्र + वत्); प्रवता or प्रवद्भिः, ind. down hill, downwards (Sāy. = प्रवणवता मार्गेण); precipitately, rapidly, swiftly. —प्रवत्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a downward course, de-scending; precipitous, headlong, rapid; affording a downward path, suited for rapid motion; hilly. —प्र-वद्-भार्गव, N. of a Sāman. —प्रवद्-यामन्, आ, m., Ved. having a downward path, rapid in its course (as a chariot; Sāy. = शीघ्र-गामिन्).
प्रवत्स्यत्: प्र-वत्स्यत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, about to dwell abroad. —प्रवत्स्यत्-पतिका, f. the wife of a man who intends to make a journey.
प्रवद्: प्रवद् प्र-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -वदितुम्, to speak forth, speak out, pronounce, utter; to proclaim, declare; to speak to, address; to say, speak, tell; to converse with; to explain: Caus. -वादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to speak or sound forth, to play (a musical instrument).
प्रवद: प्र-वद, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sounding forth, sound-ing (as a drum).
प्रवदत्: प्र-वदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking forth, speaking to or with, conversing, addressing; speaking much or well; arguing, a disputant.
प्रवदन: प्र-वदन, अम्, n., Ved. a proclamation, an-nouncement.
प्रवदितृ: प्र-वदितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who speaks forth or speaks out, speaking out.
प्रवाद: प्र-वाद, अस्, m. speaking forth, uttering a word or sound; expressing, naming, mentioning; declar-ing, declaration [cf. वेद-प्°]; discourse, conversa-tion; a saying, popular talk, rumour, report; spread-ing a report, (द्यूत-प्°, report of gambling); a fable, myth; mutual defiance, the conversation of antagonists prior to combat; litigious language; (in Ved. gram.) a base or crude form (opposed to a word with a case termination &c.); (आ), f., Ved. in गन्ध-प्रवादास्, f. pl. all that is called perfume (?) .
प्रवाद प्र-वाद, प्र-वादक, प्र-वादिन्। See col. 1.
प्रवादक: प्र-वादक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to sound forth, playing on (a musical instrument).
प्रवादिन्: प्र-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, giving forth a sound, uttering a cry; speaking, speaking of, reporting; (in Ved. gram.) being in the crude form.
प्रवाद्य: प्र-वाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said or spoken; to be proclaimed.
प्रवध्य: प्रवध्य प्र-वध्य, ind. (fr. rt. वध् with प्र), having killed or slain.
प्रवन्द्: प्रवन्द् प्र-वन्द्, cl. 1. A. -वन्दते, -वन्-दितुम्, Ved. to praise highly, extol.
प्रवप्: प्रवप् प्र-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to scatter forth, scatter, strew; to throw, cast, shoot.
प्रवप: प्र-वप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + वपा), having much fat, very fat.
प्रवपण: प्र-वपण, अम्, n., Ved. scattering forth, sow-ing; shaving off (of the beard &c.).
प्रवापयितृ: प्र-वापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who scatters forth or pours out, scattering forth, pouring out.
प्रवापयितृ प्र-वापयितृ, प्र-वापिन्। See under प्र-वप्, col. 1.
प्रवापिन्: प्र-वापिन्, ई, इणी, इ, one who sows seed, sowing, a sower.
प्रवयण: प्रवयण 1. प्र-वयण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वी = rt. अज्; for 2. see under प्र-वे, p. 645, col. 1), a goad; [cf. प्राजन।]
2. प्र-वयण, अम्, n. (for 1. see p. 642, col. 1), the upper part of a piece of woven cloth.
प्रवयणीय: प्र-वयणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be driven forwards (?) .
प्रवय्या: प्रवय्या, f., Ved. (a cow) to be driven on with a goad (?) .
प्रवयस्: प्रवयस् प्र-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, (Ved.) strong, vigorous, in the prime of life; advanced in age, aged, ancient; (Sāy.) = प्रवृद्धान्न or पुरातन।
प्रवर: प्रवर प्र-वर। See प्र-वृ, p. 644, col. 1.

प्र-वर, अस्, m. a call, summons (especially of a Brāhman to priestly functions); an invocation ad-dressed by a Brāhman at the consecration of his own fire to Agni Havya-vāhana (in such invocations Agni is invited to bear the oblations to the gods as he did for the sacrificer's ancestors, and the names of the first four or five of these ancestors, who are most nearly connected with the ancient Ṛṣis, must then be added to each invocation of Agni, thus Gotama invokes Agni Āṅgirasa, Agni Āyāsya, Agni Gautama, &c.); a line of ancestors (so named in the preceding invocation to Agni); one of the forty-nine Gotras, as opposed to the eight original Gotras; a member of a line of ancestors, an ancestor; a Muni who contributes to the credit of a particular Gotra or family; family, race, lineage, kindred; offspring, descendants; a covering, cover, screen; an upper garment; a black variety of Phaseolus Mungo, Oppuntia Dillenii; N. of a messenger of the gods and friend of Indra; of a Dānava; (आ), f., N. of a river which falls into the Go-dāvarī near Tokā, and is celebrated for the sweetness of its water; (अम्), n. aloe wood; a particular high number; (अस्, आ, अम्), most excellent, chief, principal, best [cf. शङ्ख-प्°]; prominent, distinguished, exalted, emi-nent; better, greater (e. g. ततः प्रवरः, better or greater than that); eldest (e. g. पुत्र-प्रवर, the eldest son; in some of the preceding adj. senses perhaps fr. प्र + वर). —प्रवर-दीपिका, f., N. of a work. —प्रवर-धातु, उस्, m., Ved. a precious metal. —प्रवर-भूपति, इस्, m. = प्र-वर-सेन. —प्रवर-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a work by Puruṣottama. —प्रवर-मूर्धज, अस्, m. excellent hair (of the head). —प्रवर-ललित, अम्, n. a kind of metre, four times ˘¯¯¯¯¯˘˘˘˘˘¯¯˘¯¯. —प्रवर-वाहन, औ, m. du. ‘having the best of horses,’ an epithet of the Aśvins. —प्रवर-सेन, अस्, m., N. of two princes of Kaśmīra, one of whom is also called Śreṣṭha-sena. —प्रवरा-ध्याय (°र-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘book of ancestral lines,’ N. of the eleventh of the eighteen Pari-śiṣṭas belonging to the White Yajur-veda. —प्रवरेश (°र-ईश), अस्, m. a distinguished nobleman (?); = प्रवर-सेन. —प्रवरेश्वर (°र-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a temple built by Pravara-sena.
प्रवर्ग: प्रवर्ग प्र-वर्ग, प्र-वर्ग्य, प्र-वर्जन। See under प्र-वृज्, p. 644, col. 2.
प्र-वर्ग, अस्, m. sacrificial fire (= महा-वीर); an excellent assemblage [cf. दास-प्°]; (perhaps a wrong reading for प्र-वर्ग्य।) —प्रवर्गावर्त-भूषण (°ग-आव्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रवर्त: प्र-वर्त, अस्, m. engaging in, undertaking; ex-citement, stimulus; (Ved.) a round ornament.
प्रवर्धक: प्रवर्धक प्र-वर्धक, प्र-वर्धन। See under प्र-वृध्, p. 644, col. 3.
प्र-वर्धक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to grow, increasing, enhancing.
प्रवर्ष: प्रवर्ष प्र-वर्ष, प्र-वर्षण, प्र-वर्-षिन्। See under प्र-वृष्, p. 645, col. 1.
प्र-वर्ष, अस्, m. raining fast, rain.
प्रवर्ह: प्रवर्ह प्र-वर्ह। See प्र-वृह्, p. 645, col. 1.
प्र-वर्ह, अस्, आ, अम्, chief, principal, first.
प्रवलाकिन्: प्रवलाकिन् प्रवलाकिन्, ई, m. a peacock; a snake; (incorrectly for प्रचलाकिन्।)
प्रवल्ह: प्रवल्ह प्र-वल्ह, अस्, m., Ved. a riddle, enigma.
प्रवल्हिका: प्रवल्हिका, f., Ved. a riddle, enigma; N. of the formulas Atharva-veda XX. 133; [cf. प्रवह्लिका।]
प्रवस्: प्रवस् 1. प्र-वस् (see rt. 5. वस्), cl. 2. A. -वस्ते, -वसितुम्, to put on (clothes), to dress.

प्रवस् 2. प्र-वस् (see rt. 6. वस्), cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to live afar off, dwell abroad; to order to live abroad, banish to (with loc.): Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to live afar off, order to dwell abroad, banish, exile.
प्रवसत्: प्र-वसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dwelling or residing abroad.
प्रवसथ: प्र-वसथ, अम्, n., Ved. going abroad, de-parting.
प्रवसन: प्र-वसन, अम्, n. going abroad, setting out on a journey, departing; sojourning in a foreign country.
प्रवस्तव्य: प्र-वस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be gone abroad, to be departed.
प्रवास: प्र-वास, अस्, m. sojourning abroad, foreign resi-dence, being away from home, being abroad; a tem-porary sojourn; (in astronomy) heliacal setting of the planets; प्रवासं गम्, to go abroad. —प्र-वास-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone abroad, gone away from home. —प्रवास-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, addicted to living abroad or away from home. —प्रवास-स्थ or प्रवास-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling abroad, being absent from home.
प्रवासत्: प्र-वासत् (?) , अन्, अन्ती, अत् (see प्र-वसत् above), dwelling abroad, being absent from home.
प्रवासन: प्र-वासन, अम्, n. causing to live abroad, send-ing away from home, exile, banishment; dwelling abroad, sojourning, lodging; killing, slaying.
प्रवासित: प्र-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to dwell abroad, banished, exiled, expatriated, expelled.
प्रवासिन्: प्र-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling or residing abroad, being or living away from home; being on a journey, a traveller, sojourner; परलोक-नव-प्रवासिन्, one who has lately set out for the next world.
प्रवास्य: प्र-वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to live abroad, to be sent into exile, to be banished.
प्रवसु: प्रवसु प्र-वसु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Īlina.
प्रवह्: प्रवह् प्र-वह्, cl. 1. P. -वहति, -वोढुम्, to carry forwards, drag onwards, draw; to carry forth, carry off; to breathe.
प्रवह: प्र-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing forwards, carrying off, bearing away; (अस्), m. ‘bearing forwards,’ N. of one of the seven winds said to cause the motion of the planets; wind, air; N. of one of the seven tongues of Fire; a reservoir into which water is carried off [cf. वर्षाम्बु-प्°]; flowing or stream-ing forth; going forth, going from a town; [cf. प्र-वाह below.]
प्रवहण: प्र-वहण, अम्, n. a covered carriage, a litter or carriage for women; a ship; (अस्), m., N. of a Dānava.
प्रवहत्: प्र-वहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, carrying forwards, bear-ing; breathing; receiving, enjoying (?).
प्रवाह: प्र-वाह, अस्, m. a stream, current, flow, flux, course; running water; continuous flow or passage; unbroken succession, continuity; flowing or streaming forth [cf. प्र-वह above]; course or direction towards; anything moving onwards like a current, current of human affairs &c., course of action, active life, occupation; a pond; N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; a beautiful or swift horse; (ई), f. sand. —प्रवाहे-मूत्रित, अम्, n. ‘making water in a river,’ a metaphorical expression for a useless action.
प्रवाहक: प्र-वाहक, अस्, इका, अम्, carrying forwards, car-rying off, bearing or carrying well; (अस्), m. a Rākṣasa, an imp, goblin; (इका), f. a sudden desire to evacuate, diarrhœa; (आ), ind. = प्र-बाहुक्, q. v., see Gaṇa Svar-ādi to Pāṇ. I. 1, 37.
प्रवाहण: प्र-वाहण, अस्, ई, अम्, carrying off, carrying away (Ved.); (अस्), m., N. of a man (Ved.); (ई), f. the sphincter muscle which ejects the feces from the rectum; (अम्), n. driving forth; evacuation by stool (especially if from sudden desire).
प्रवाहणेय: प्रवाहणेय, अस्, or प्रवाहणेयि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pravāhaṇa.
प्रवाहणेयक: प्रवाहणेयक, अस्, इका, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VII. 3, 29.
प्रवाहिन्: प्र-वाहिन्, ई, इणी, or इनी, इ, carrying forwards, drawing; carrying off, carrying away (said of a river); flowing, streaming [cf. लोक-प्°]; (इणी or इनी), f. a region abounding in streams (?) .
प्रवाह्य: प्रवाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fluviatic, fluvial; (Mahī-dhara = स्रोतसि भवः।)
प्रवोढृ: प्र-वोढृ, -ढा, -ढ्री, -ढृ, or Ved. प्र-वोऌहृ, carrying off, bearing away, one who carries off or bears away.
प्रवह्लि: प्रवह्लि प्र-वह्लि, इस्, or प्र-वह्ली, or प्र-वह्लिका, f. a riddle, enigma, conundrum, charade; [cf. प्र-वल्ह, प्रवल्हिका।]
प्रवा: प्रवा 1. प्र-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -वातुम्, to blow forth, blow violently, blow; to smell, yield a scent: Caus. -वापयति, -यितुम्, to dry up, dry.
2. प्र-वा (आस्?), f., Ved. blowing, blowing away, (प्र-वा उप-वा, blowing to and fro); N. of a daughter of Dakṣa.
प्रवात: प्र-वात, अस्, आ, अम्, blown forwards, agitated by the wind; (अम्), n. a current or draught of air; an airy place; windy or stormy weather. —प्रवात-शयन, अम्, n. a bed placed in the middle of a current of air. —प्रवात-सार, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha; (also read प्रवाट-सागर, i. e. प्रवाड-सागर।) —प्रवाते-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. growing in an airy place.
प्रवाय्य: प्र-वाय्य, अम्, n., Ved. (perhaps) fleetness, rapidity.
प्रवाड: प्रवाड प्रवाड, a various reading for प्र-बाल, q. v. —प्रवाड-सागर or प्रवाट-सागर, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha; [cf. प्रवात-सार।]
प्रवाण: प्रवाण प्र-वाण, प्र-वाणि। See under प्र-वे, p. 645, col. 1.
प्र-वाण, अम्, n. the edging or trimming of a piece of woven cloth.
प्रवायक: प्रवायक प्र-वायक। See Scholiast on Pāṇ. II. 4, 56.
प्रवार: प्र-वार, अस्, m. a covering, cover, clothing, woollen cloth.
प्रविकस्: प्रविकस् प्र-वि-कस्, cl. 1. P. -कसति, -क-सितुम्, to open out, expand (intrans.).
प्रविकसत्: प्र-विकसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, expanding, opening, blossoming; (also spelt प्र-विकशत्।)
प्रविकॄ: प्रविकॄ प्र-वि-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करि-तुम्, -करीतुम्, to scatter apart, scatter abroad, strew about, cast asunder; to disperse, diffuse.
प्रविकीर्ण: प्र-विकीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, scattered apart, strewed about; dispersed, diffused.
प्रविख्यात: प्रविख्यात प्र-विख्यात, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ख्या), universally known, renowned; known as, named, called.
प्रविख्याति: प्र-विख्याति, इस्, f. fame, renown, reputation, celebrity.
प्रविगम्: प्रविगम् प्र-वि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, Ved. to pass away, perish, disappear.
प्रविगत: प्र-विगत, अस्, आ, अम्, passed away, perished, disappeared.
प्रविगाह्: प्रविगाह् प्र-वि-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गा-हितुम्, -गाढुम्, to dive into, enter.
प्रविगाह्य: प्र-विगाह्य, ind. having dived into, having entered.
प्रविग्रह: प्रविग्रह प्र-विग्रह, अस्, m. (in Ved. gram.) exhibiting distinctly the separation of words, dividing or breaking up the Sandhi.
प्रविघट्: प्रविघट् प्र-वि-घट्, cl. 10. P. -घाटयति, -यितुम्, to divide, disunite (Kirātārj. II. 46).
प्रविचक्ष्: प्रविचक्ष् प्र-वि-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे (see rt. चक्ष्), to declare, mention, name.
प्रविचर्: प्रविचर् प्र-वि-चर्, cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते, -चरितुम्, to go forwards, move onwards, ad-vance; to rove about, roam about; to go through, walk through, roam or wander through: Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to examine or investigate accu-rately.
प्रविचरन्: प्र-विचरन्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forwards, mov-ing onwards; going through, roaming through.
प्रविचारित: प्र-विचारित, अस्, आ, अम्, examined or investi-gated accurately.
प्रविचल्: प्रविचल् प्र-वि-चल्, cl. 1. P. -चलति, -चलि-तुम्, to move about, shake, quake, tremble; to go astray, deviate; to become confused, be thrown into confusion: Caus. -चालयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion, cause to tremble, shake.
प्रविचलित: प्र-विचलित, अस्, आ, अम्, set in motion, moved, shaking, quaking.
प्रविचि: प्रविचि प्र-वि-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चि-नुते, -चेतुम्, to search through, investigate, examine, test, prove.
प्रविचिन्त्: प्रविचिन्त् प्र-वि-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति, -यितुम्, to think about, reflect upon.
प्रविचिन्तक: प्र-विचिन्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, reflecting before-hand, foreseeing.
प्रविचिन्त्य: प्र-विचिन्त्य, ind. having thought about or re-flected upon.
प्रविचेतन: प्रविचेतन प्र-विचेतन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 4. चित् with प्र), comprehending, understanding.
प्रविजय: प्रविजय प्र-विजय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
प्रविज्ञा: प्रविज्ञा प्र-वि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. A. -जानाति, जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्, to know severally or in detail, know accurately.
प्रवितन्: प्रवितन् प्र-वि-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -तनुते, -तनितुम्, to stretch forwards, spread out, extend; to begin a sacred rite; to commence.
प्रवितत: प्र-वितत, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched forwards, spread out, expanded; dishevelled.
प्रवितप्: प्रवितप् प्र-वि-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्-तुम्, to scorch up, pain with heat.
प्रवितप्त: प्र-वितप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, scorched up, pained with heat.
प्रविद्: प्रविद् 1. प्र-विद्, Caus. -वेदयति, -यितुम्, to make known; to possess knowledge or wisdom, know, understand (Ved.): Intens., Ved. -वेविदीति, to find often, obtain frequently.
2. प्र-विद्, त्, f. making known, proclaiming, pro-clamation (Sāy. = प्र-वेदन).
प्रविद्वस्: प्र-विद्वस्, वान्, उषी, वत्, very knowing, wise (?) .
प्रवेद: प्र-वेद, अस्, m. in अ-प्°, q. v. —प्रवेद-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. (perhaps) making known.
प्रवेदन: प्र-वेदन, अम्, n. the act of making known, proclaiming, announcing.
प्रवेदिन्: प्र-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, knowing accurately, well acquainted with.
प्रवेद्य: प्र-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made known.
प्रविदार: प्रविदार प्र-विदार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. दॄ with प्र-वि), bursting asunder.
प्रविदारण: प्र-विदारण, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), causing to burst asunder, bursting, tearing, rending, breaking; budding; conflict, war, battle, combat; tumult, crowd, confusion.
प्रविदारित: प्र-विदारित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn, rent, severed; opened, expanded.
प्रविद्ध: प्र-विद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown away, cast away.
प्रविद्रु: प्रविद्रु प्र-वि-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रो-तुम्, to run or rush apart, disperse, retreat.
प्रविद्रुत: प्र-विद्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, running apart, dispersed, scattered.
प्रविधा: प्रविधा प्र-वि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, धत्ते, -धातुम्, to place apart, divide; to medi-tate or think upon; to place in front, put at the head, pay attention to.
प्रविधाय: प्र-विधाय, ind. having placed in front, having paid attention to.
प्रविध्वस्त: प्रविध्वस्त प्र-विध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown away; tossed about, agitated.
प्रविनश्: प्रविनश् प्र-वि-नश्, cl. 4. P. (ep. also A.) -नश्यति (-ते), -नशितुम्, -नंष्टुम्, to perish utterly, be destroyed.
प्रविपल: प्रविपल प्र-विपल, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?) , a particular minute division of time, a small part of a Vipala.
प्रविभज्: प्रविभज् प्र-वि-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते, -भक्तुम्, to part asunder, sever, sunder, sepa-rate; to divide, distribute, apportion.
प्रविभक्त: प्र-विभक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, parted asunder, severed, sundered, separated; divided, distributed, partitioned, apportioned, shared; variously situated. —प्रवि-भक्त-रश्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the rays distributed, distributing rays.
प्रविभज्य: प्र-विभज्य, ind. having parted asunder, having separated; having divided or apportioned.
प्रविभाग: प्र-विभाग, अस्, m. parting asunder, division, separation, distribution, classification; a part, portion. —प्रविभाग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having subdivisions, subdivided. —प्रविभाग-शस्, ind. according to the several portions or divisions.
प्रविभिन्न: प्रविभिन्न प्र-विभिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken or torn off, wounded.
प्रविभुज्: प्रविभुज् प्र-वि-भुज्, cl. 6. P. -भुजति, -भोक्तुम्, to bow.
प्रविमुच्: प्रविमुच् प्र-वि-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते, -मोक्तुम्, to set free, release, liberate; to lay aside, relinquish, resign, abandon: Pass. -मुच्यते, to be freed from, be rid of (with abl.).
प्रविमृश्: प्रविमृश् प्र-वि-मृश्, cl. 6. P. -मृशति, -मर्ष्टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, to think upon, meditate, ponder, reflect, deliberate.
प्रविमृश्य: प्र-विमृश्य, ind. having thought upon, having pondered or considered.
प्रविर: प्रविर प्रविर, अस्, m. a species of fragrant wood, yellow sandal.
प्रविरल: प्रविरल प्र-विरल, अस्, आ, अम्, separated by a considerable interval, separate, isolated, few, very rare, very scanty.
प्रविलम्बिन्: प्रविलम्बिन् प्र-विलम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. लम्ब् with प्र-वि), hanging forwards, projecting, prominent.
प्रविलय: प्र-विलय, अस्, m. becoming dissolved, melting away; complete dissolution or absorption.
प्रविलसेन: प्रविलसेन प्रविल-सेन, अस्, m. (प्रविल probably fr. प्र + विल with सेना), N. of a prince.
प्रविलापिन्: प्रविलापिन् प्र-विलापिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. लप् with प्र-वि), grieving, sorrowing, lamenting.
प्रविली: प्रविली प्र-वि-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम्, लातुम्, to become dissolved, melt away; to vanish away, disappear, fade away.
प्रविलुप्त: प्रविलुप्त प्र-विलुप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लुप् with प्र-वि), cut away, removed, lost, fallen or rubbed off.
प्रविलोक्: प्रविलोक् प्र-वि-लोक्, cl. 10. P. -लोकयति, -यितुम्, to look forwards, look about.
प्रविलोकयत्: प्र-विलोकयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking forwards, looking about.
प्रविवा: प्रविवा प्र-वि-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -वातुम्, Ved. to blow asunder, disperse, scatter; (Sāy.) = नितरां गमय।
प्रविवाद: प्रविवाद प्र-विवाद (?) , अस्, m. altercation, dispute (= वि-वाद).
प्रविविक्त: प्रविविक्त प्र-विविक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. विच् with प्र-वि), separated, detached; solitary.
प्रविवेक: प्र-विवेक, अस्, m. probably = वि-वेक, q. v.
प्रविव्राजयिषु: प्रविव्राजयिषु प्र-विव्राजयिषु। See under प्र-व्रज्, p. 645, col. 2.
प्र-विव्राजयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to send into exile, desirous of banishing.
प्रविश्: प्रविश् प्र-विश्, cl. 6. P. (ep. also A.) -वि-शति (-ते), -वेष्टुम्, to enter into, enter, come into, go into; to enter upon, begin, commence; to appear: Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to enter into, allow to enter, bring into, introduce to (with double acc.); to lead into (one's home), lead (home, as a wife); to lay up, store up: Desid. -विविक्षति, to wish to enter into.
प्रविविक्षु: प्र-विविक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to enter into, being about to go into.
प्रविशत्: प्र-विशत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, entering.
प्रविष्ट: प्र-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, entered into, entered, gone into, come into; entered upon, engaged in, occupied with, begun, commenced; (आ), f., N. of the mother of Paippalādi and Kauśika.
प्रविष्ट प्र-विष्ट, प्रविष्टक। See under प्र-विश्, p. 643, col. 3.
प्रविष्टक: प्रविष्टक, अम्, n. entering a room; entrance on the stage.
प्रवेश: प्र-वेश, अस्, m. entering into, entering, entrance, ingress, penetrating, penetration; the entrance or door of a house, &c.; the entrance of the sun into a sign of the zodiac; entrance on the stage; coming on, setting in (of night); going into, being contained in; income, revenue; intentness on an object, engaging closely in a pursuit or purpose; the syringe of a clyster-pipe; प्रवेशं कृ, to make one's entrance, enter.
प्रवेशक: प्र-वेशक, अस्, इका, अम्, going into, entering, penetrating, one who enters; (at the end of comps.) = प्र-वेश; (अस्), m. an interlude or introductory scene acted by inferior characters for the purpose of acquainting the audience with any events supposed to have occurred between the two acts, a knowledge of which is requisite for the understanding of what follows; (according to Kāṭavema in the opening scene in Śakuntalā, Act 2, the object of the Praveśaka, as of the Vi-ṣkambha, q. v., is to connect or bind together the story of the drama and the subdivisions of the plot by concisely alluding to what has hap-pened in the intervals of the acts, or what is likely to happen at the end.)
प्रवेशन: प्र-वेशन, अम्, n. entering into, entering, en-trance, going into; sexual intercourse; an entrance to a house, principal door or gate; conducting into, leading into, introducing.
प्रवेशनीय: प्र-वेशनीय, to be entered, to be introduced, &c. (See also Gaṇa Anupravacanādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 111.)
प्रवेशयितव्य: प्र-वेशयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to enter, to be led or conducted into.
प्रवेशित: प्र-वेशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to go in, caused to enter, introduced, brought in, sent in.
प्रवेशिन्: प्र-वेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, entering; (at the end of an adj. comp.) having an entrance.
प्रवेश्य: 1. प्र-वेश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be entered; to be pervaded; to be played (as a musical instrument); to be led or conducted into, to be brought into; to be placed in or upon.
2. प्र-वेश्य, ind. having caused to enter into, hav-ing sent or thrown in, having sent or thrown into.
प्रवेष्टव्य: प्र-वेष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be entered; to be penetrated or pervaded; to be caused or allowed to enter, to be admitted.
प्रवेष्टव्य प्र-वेष्टव्य, प्र-वेष्टृ। See under प्र-विश्, p. 643, col. 3.
प्रवेष्टृ: प्र-वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who enters or goes into, entering, going in.
प्रविश्लेष: प्रविश्लेष प्र-विश्लेष, अस्, m. separation, parting.
प्रविषण: प्रविषण प्र-विषण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, dejected, sad, spiritless.
प्रविषा: प्रविषा प्र-विषा, f. a birch tree; [cf. उप-विषा, प्रति-विषा।]
प्रविस्तर: प्रविस्तर प्र-विस्तर or प्र-विस्तार, अस्, m. circumference, compass.
प्रवी: प्रवी प्र-वी, cl. 2. P. -वेति, -वेतुम्, Ved. to desire, love.
प्रवीण: प्रवीण प्र-वीण, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. वीणा], skilful, clever, proficient, conversant with, skilled in, versed in, an adept; (अस्), m., N. of a son of the fourteenth Manu. —प्रवीण-ता, f. or प्रवीण-त्व, अम्, n. skill, proficiency.
प्रवीर: प्रवीर प्र-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, heroic, strong, powerful; best, most excellent; (अस्), m. a hero, warrior, chief, prince, a person of rank or distinction; N. of a son of Pūru; of a son of Pra-cinvat and grandson of Pūru; of a son of Dharma-netra; of a son of Hary-aśva; of a son of the fourteenth Manu; of a Caṇḍāla; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the descendants of Pravīra (son of Pūru). —प्रवीर-बाहु, उस्, m. ‘strong-armed,’ N. of a Rākṣasa. —प्रवीर-वर, अस्, m. ‘best of heroes,’ N. of an Asura.
प्रवृ: प्रवृ प्र-वृ, cl. 5. 9. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृ-णुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम्, to choose out, choose, select; to cover; to put on (a garment); to keep off, ward off (Ved.): Caus. -व-रयति, -यितुम्, to ask for, prefer; -वारयति, -यि-तुम्, to cover; to defend; to present (?) .
प्रवरण: प्र-वरण, अम्, n. a call, summons, invocation, (अति-प्रवरण, excessive invocation, invoking in too great a number); (with Buddhists) the festivities at the end of the rainy season.
प्रवारक: प्र-वारक, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) the festi-vities at the end of the rainy season; (अम्), n. a covering, cover, clothing.
प्रवारण: प्र-वारण, अम्, n. priority of choice; satis-fying, granting what is desired; prohibition, objec-tion, opposition; (with Buddhists) the festivities at the end of the rainy season.
प्रवार्य: प्र-वार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be satisfied, to be gratified.
प्रवृत: प्र-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, chosen out, chosen, selected. —प्रवृत-होम, अस्, m. or प्रवृताहुति (°त-आह्°), इस्, f., Ved. ‘election-sacrifice,’ a sacrifice offered at the election of a priest. —प्रवृतहोमीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to a sacrifice offered at the election of a priest.
प्रवृज्: प्रवृज् प्र-वृज्, cl. 2. A. -वृक्ते, -वर्जितुम्, Ved. to purify; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण छिद्, to cut or strew in abundance; = प्र-भृ, q. v.
प्रवर्ग्य: प्र-वर्ग्य, अस्, m. a ceremony introductory to the Soma sacrifice, pouring fresh milk into a heated vessel (called महा-वीर or घर्म), or according to others into boiling ghee (Sāy. = तप्ते घृते पयः-प्रक्षेपः). —प्रवर्ग्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. connected with the Pravargya ceremony. —प्रवर्ग्याभरण-भूषण (°य-आभ्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रवर्जन: प्र-वर्जन, अम्, n. the performance of the Pravargya ceremony, pouring fresh milk into a heated vessel or into boiling ghee.
प्रवृञ्जनीय: प्रवृञ्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. used at the Pra-vargya ceremony (said of the महा-वीर, q. v.).
प्रवृत्: प्रवृत् 1. प्र-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut., Cond., and Aor.) -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to go or roll forwards, roll on, flow onwards, proceed, make progress, go on well; to come forth, come into being, arise, be produced; to become, exist; to happen, take place, come to pass; to begin, com-mence (with acc. or inf.); to engage in, enter upon, be occupied in (with loc.); to behave, conduct one's self; to hold good: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to proceed; to cause to flow onwards; to set in motion or action, instigate, urge, excite; to throw, cast; to produce, create; to devise, invent.
प्रवर्तक: प्र-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, setting in motion or action, setting on foot; advancing, promoting, forward-ing; producing, causing, effecting, inducing, inciting, prompting, instigating, stimulating, urging; (अस्), m. the original instigator of any act, originator, author, principal, founder; an arbiter, judge; (अम्), n. (in dramatic language) the entrance of a character on the stage.
प्रवर्तन: प्र-वर्तन, अम्, n. rolling forwards, revolving, rolling on, flowing forwards, going or moving for-wards, coming forth, walking, roaming, wandering; activity, action, acting; applying one's self to, en-gaging in, occupying one's self in, having dealings with (with loc. or inst.); beginning, commencing; behaviour, conduct, procedure, mode of living; hap-pening, coming to pass, coming to light, appearing; bringing forward, presenting (Ved.); pushing for-ward, setting on foot, setting up, establishing, insti-tuting, erecting [cf. महायन्त्र-प्°]; instigating to action; inciting, prompting, stimulating; directing, superintending; employing, employment; exhorta-tion; informing; (आ), f. inciting or stimulating to action; ordering, the sense of the imperative or of the precative tense (?).
प्रवर्तनीय: प्र-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set in motion, to be instigated; to be used or employed.
प्रवर्तमान: प्र-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, moving on, rolling on, proceeding, going forth; engaging in, practising, being occupied with, doing; being used or employed.
प्रवर्तमानक: प्रवर्तमानक, अस्, m., Ved. a diminutive of the preceding; (Sāy.) = अति-शीघ्रम् अभि-गच्छत्, going forth hastily, hastening forth.
प्रवर्तयितृ: प्र-वर्तयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sets in motion or action, exciting activity, instigating to action; establishing, erecting, a builder, founder; applying or inflicting, one who applies or inflicts.
प्रवर्तित: प्र-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to roll on or for-wards, caused to turn, going round, revolving; set in motion, set on foot; set up, established; stimu-lated, excited, incited, instigated; lighted, kindled; caused, made, rendered; informed, apprized; made pure (= पवित्री-कृत, Manu XI. 196).
प्रवर्तितव्य: प्र-वर्तितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be proceeded, to be acted, to be practised.
प्रवर्तितृ: प्र-वर्तितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes or effects; one who establishes or determines.
प्रवर्तिन्: प्र-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, moving forwards, proceeding, advancing, moving, flowing; coming forth, flowing forth, streaming; being active; causing to flow; setting in motion or action, causing, effecting, pro-ducing; spreading, introducing; using, employing; अ-प्रवर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, immovable, unchangeable, unalterable, invariable.
प्रवर्त्य: प्र-वर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excited to activity, to be instigated or stimulated.
प्रवृत्त: प्र-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, proceeded, going to, bound for, (कुत्र प्रवृत्तो ऽसि, where are you going?); settled, fixed, determined; done; begun, commenced; beginning; engaged in, occupied with, entered or embarked upon; undertaking, doing, acting; unim-peded, undisputed (as dominion); round; (अस्), m. a round ornament; [cf. प्र-वर्त।] —प्रवृत्त-कर्मन्, अ, n. any act leading to a future birth. —प्रवृत्त-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘whose wheels roll on unimpeded,’ having universal dominion. —प्र-वृत्तचक्र-ता, f. unimpeded or universal dominion.
प्रवृत्तक: प्रवृत्तक, अम्, n. the entrance of a character on the stage (= प्र-वर्तक); a kind of metre.
प्रवृत्ति: प्र-वृत्ति, इस्, f. continuous flow onwards, pro-gress, advance, advancement; success; coming forth, appearing, appearance, manifestation; rise, source, origin, beginning; activity, effort, employment, oc-cupation; active life (as opposed to नि-वृत्ति, q. v., and to contemplative devotion, and defined as con-sisting of the wish to act, knowledge of the means, and accomplishment of the object); giving or apply-ing one's self to, devoting one's self to (with loc.); course or tendency towards, addiction to, inclination or predilection for; application, use, employment; continued application, perseverance; practice, conduct, behaviour; currency, continuance, continuity, pre-valence, permanence, endurance; the applicableness or validity of a rule; fate, lot, destiny; news, tidings, intelligence [cf. दुष्-प्°]; cognition, (विषयवती प्रवृत्तिः, a sensuous immediate cognition); the juice that exudes from the temples of an elephant in rut; N. of Avantī or Oujein or any holy place; (in arithmetic) the multiplier. —प्रवृत्ति-ज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘knowing the news,’ an emissary, agent, spy. —प्र-वृत्ति-निमित्त, अम्, n. the reason for the use of any term in the particular significations which it bears. —प्रवृत्ति-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, dis-inclined to give tidings. —प्रवृत्ति-मार्ग, अस्, m. active or worldly life, occupancy about the business and pleasures of the world or with the rites and works of religion.
प्रवृध्: प्रवृध् प्र-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -वर्-धितुम्, to grow up, grow, increase.
प्रवर्धन: प्र-वर्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what causes to grow or increase; (अम्), n. augmenting, increase.
प्रवृद्ध: प्र-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, grown up, full grown; increased, expanded, enlarged, diffused, spread abroad, dispersed; large; swollen (as a river); full, deep (as a sigh); haughty, arrogant; violent.
प्रवृद्धि: प्र-वृद्धि, इस्, f. growth, increase [cf. सस्य-प्°, श्मश्रु-प्°]; rising, rise, (अर्घस्य प्°, rising of the price of anything); prosperity, increasing welfare, rising in rank or reputation.
प्रवृश्च्य: प्र-वृश्च्य, ind. having lacerated, having wounded.
प्रवृष्: प्रवृष् प्र-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -वर्-षितुम्, to begin to rain, rain.
प्रवर्षण: प्र-वर्षण, अम्, n. raining, causing to rain; the first rain; N. of the twenty-third Adhyāya of the Bṛhat-saṃhitā of Varāha-mihira.
प्रवर्षिन्: प्र-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raining, causing to rain, showering, discharging; ऊर्ध्व-प्रवर्षिन्, ‘rain-ing upwards,’ offering sacrifices.
प्रवृह्: प्रवृह् प्र-वृह्, cl. 6. P. A. -वृहति, -ते, -वर्हितुम्, -वर्ढुम्, Ved. to tear forth, tear away, tear off, tear out; to draw out, extract; to rescue; to tear to pieces, destroy; (Sāy.) = प्र-क्षिप्, to hurl, fling; (A.) to draw towards one's self, attract.
प्रवे: प्रवे प्र-वे, cl. 1. P. A. -वयति, -ते, -वातुम्, to sew lengthwise [cf. प्रोत]; to pierce, transfix; to infix, impale.
प्रवाणि: प्र-वाणि, इस् or ई, f. a weaver's shuttle.
प्रवेक: प्रवेक प्र-वेक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. विच् with प्र), choicest, most excellent, best, principal, chief; (at the end of a comp., cf. मणि-प्°।)
