प्रवेग: प्रवेग प्र-वेग, अस्, m. great speed, rapi-dity; [cf. शर-प्°।]
प्रवेगित: प्रवेगित, अस्, आ, अम्, moving swiftly, rapid.
प्रवेट: प्रवेट प्र-वेट, अस्, m. barley; [cf. प्र-वट, प्रावट।]
प्रवेणि: प्रवेणि प्र-वेणि, इस् or ई, f. a braid of hair, the hair twisted and unadorned (as worn by widows and by wives in the absence of their husbands); a piece of coloured woollen cloth (used instead of a saddle); the housings of an elephant; (ई), f., N. of a river.
प्रवेतृ: प्रवेतृ प्र-वेतृ, ता, m. (fr. rt. वी with प्र), a charioteer.
प्रवेय: प्र-वेय, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 83.
प्रवेप्: प्रवेप् प्र-वेप्, cl. 1. A. -वेपते, -वेपितुम्, to tremble: Caus. -वेपयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble, shake.
प्रवेपक: प्रवेपक, अस्, m. trembling, shivering, shud-dering.
प्रवेपन: प्र-वेपन, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-demon; (अम्), n. trembling, tremulous motion, shaking, agitation; (also wrongly spelt प्र-वेपण।)
प्रवेपनिन्: प्रवेपनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. ‘causing (his enemies) to tremble,’ an epithet of Indra.
प्रवेपनीय: प्र-वेपनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 34.
प्रवेपिन्: प्र-वेपिन्, ई, इनी, इ, trembling, shaking, tottering.
प्रवेरित: प्रवेरित प्रवेरित, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for प्रावेरित fr. rt. ईर् with प्र-अव, but said by some to be fr. प्र-आ-ईरित), thrown about, cast or hurled hither and thither (= इतस्ततः पातित, Mahā-bh. Svargārohaṇa-p. 47).
प्रवेल: प्रवेल प्रवेल, अस्, m. a yellow variety of kidney-bean, Phaseolus Mungo.
प्रवेष्ट्: प्रवेष्ट् प्र-वेष्ट्, cl. 1. A. -वेष्टते, -वेष्टि-तुम्, to cover over, cover, surround.
प्रवेष्ट: प्र-वेष्ट, अस्, m. an arm; the fore-arm or wrist [cf. प्र-कोष्ठ]; the fleshy part of the back of an elephant on which the rider sits; an elephant's housings; an elephant's gums.
प्रवेष्टित: प्र-वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, covered, surrounded.
प्रवेष्टक: प्रवेष्टक प्रवेष्टक, a various reading for प्रविष्टक, q. v.
प्रव्यक्त: प्रव्यक्त प्र-व्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, evident, ap-parent, manifest.
प्रव्यथ्: प्रव्यथ् प्र-व्यथ्, cl. 1. A. -व्यथते, -व्य-थितुम्, to be afflicted or distressed; to be frightened, fear, tremble at (with gen.).
प्रव्यथित: प्र-व्यथित, अस्, आ, अम्, distressed, pained; agitated, trembling.
प्रव्यध्: प्रव्यध् प्र-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्-धुम्, to throw away, cast down.
प्रव्याध: प्र-व्याध, अस्, m., Ved. a bow-shot, the dis-tance of the flight of an arrow.
प्रव्याहृ: प्रव्याहृ प्र-व्य्-आ-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्तुम्, to declare beforehand, foretell, predict; to howl, yell, roar.
प्रव्याहार: प्र-व्याहार, अस्, m. (= प्रकृष्टोक्ति), pro-longation or continuation of discourse.
प्रव्रज्: प्रव्रज् प्र-व्रज्, cl. 1. P. -व्रजति, -व्रजितुम्, to go forth, set out, travel forth, go abroad, go into exile: Caus. -व्राजयति, -यितुम्, to send into exile, banish.
प्रव्रजत्: प्र-व्रजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forth, travelling abroad.
प्रव्रजन: प्र-व्रजन, अम्, n. going abroad, migrating.
प्रव्रजिका: प्र-व्रजिका, a wrong reading for प्र-व्रजिता or प्र-व्राजिका।
प्रव्रजित: प्र-व्रजित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth, gone away, gone abroad, gone into exile; (अस्), m. a religious mendicant, a mendicant or ascetic; the pupil or attendant of a Jaina or Buddhist mendicant; (आ), f. a female ascetic or devotee; spikenard, Nardostachys Jatamansi; N. of another plant, = मुण्डीरी; (अम्), n. the life of a religious mendicant.
प्रव्रज्या: प्र-व्रज्या, f. going abroad, migration, emigra-tion; roaming, travelling, wandering about, espe-cially as a religious mendicant (in a dress not authorized by the Veda, Manu V. 89); the order of a religious mendicant; retirement into solitude. —प्रव्रज्यावसित (°या-अव्°), अस्, m. a religious mendicant who renounces his order.
प्रव्राज्: प्र-व्राज्, ट्, m. a religious mendicant; [cf. परि-व्राज्।]
प्रव्राज: प्र-व्राज, अस्, m., Ved. the bed of a river (Sāy. = अत्यन्त-निम्नो देशो नद्याः).
प्रव्राजक: प्र-व्राजक, अस्, m. a religious mendicant; (इका), f. a female ascetic.
प्रव्राजन: प्र-व्राजन, अम्, n. banishing, banishment, exile.
प्रव्राजिन्: प्र-व्राजिन्, ई, m., Ved. a religious mendicant.
प्रव्राज्य: प्र-व्राज्य, ind. having sent into exile, having banished.
प्रव्रश्च्: प्रव्रश्च् प्र-व्रश्च्, cl. 6. P. -वृश्चति, -व्रश्चि-तुम्, -व्रष्टुम्, to tear to pieces, lacerate, wound.
प्रव्रश्चन: प्र-व्रश्चन in इध्म-प्रव्रश्चन, अस्, m. an instrument for cutting fuel, a knife for cutting wood.
प्रव्रस्क: प्र-व्रस्क, अस्, m., Ved. a cut.
प्रव्लय: प्रव्लय प्र-व्लय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्ली with प्र), Ved. sinking down.
प्रशँय्युवाक: प्रशँय्युवाक प्रशंय्यु-वाक, अस्, m., see Vārttika 1. to Pāṇ. II. 4, 29.
प्रशंस्: प्रशंस् प्र-शंस्, cl. 1. P. -शंसति, -शंसि-तुम् (anomalous 3rd sing. Pot. प्र-शंसीयात्), to praise forth, praise, eulogize, laud, extol, commend, recommend; to approve; to esteem, value; to de-clare; (with न) to disapprove, blame, censure.
प्रशंसक: प्र-शंसक, अस्, इका, अम्, praising, commending, eulogizing, laudatory, flattering; a praiser.
प्रशंसन: प्र-शंसन, अम्, n. praising, eulogizing; (some-times incorrectly spelt प्र-शंशन।)
प्रशंसनीय: प्र-शंसनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-worthy, laudable, commendable.
प्रशंसा: प्र-शंसा, f. praise, commendation, panegyric, eulogy, applause, flattery; fame, reputation, glory [cf. स्त्री-प्°]; अप्रस्तुत-प्रशंसा, indirect de-scription, a description of anything implied by the description of a similar or contrary object; (some-times incorrectly spelt प्र-शंशा।) —प्रशंसा-मुखर, अस्, आ, अम्, loud with praise, praising loudly. —प्रशंसामुखरानन (°र-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘one whose mouth is loud with praise,’ speaking loudly in praise (of anything). —प्रशंसो-पमा (°सा-उप्°), f. laudatory comparison, comparing to anything superior.
प्रशंसित: प्र-शंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, commended, eulogized, extolled, applauded.
प्रशंसितव्य: प्र-शंसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or commended, praiseworthy, laudable, commendable.
प्रशंसिन्: प्र-शंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, praising, commending, eulogizing.
प्रशंस्तव्य: प्र-शंस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-worthy, laudable; [cf. प्र-शस्तव्य।]
प्रशंस्य: प्र-शंस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, com-mendable, praiseworthy, laudable; preferable, better; [cf. 1. प्र-शस्य।]
प्रशस्त: प्र-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, commended; eulogized, extolled; laudable, commendable, admir-able, excellent, good, best; happy; well; right; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a river. —प्रशस्त-कर, अस्, m., N. of an author (per-haps the writer of a work entitled Pra-śasta). —प्र-शस्त-कलश, अस्, m., N. of a man. —प्रशस्त-ता, f. or प्रशस्त-त्व, अम्, n. excellence, goodness. —प्रशस्त-पाद, अस्, m., N. of an author. —प्र-शस्ताद्रि (°त-अद्°), इस्, m., N. of a mountain to the west of Madhya-deśa.
प्रशस्तव्य: प्र-शस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, praise-worthy; [cf. प्र-शंस्तव्य।]
प्रशस्ति: प्र-शस्ति, इस्, f. praise, eulogy, fame; glorification, benediction; excellence, eminence; instruction, con-duct, guidance; an edict (?) ; प्रशस्तिं धा, to bestow praise upon, speak highly of, value highly (with loc.). —प्रशस्ति-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. bestowing praise, prais-ing. —प्रशस्ति-प्रकाशिका, f., N. of a work. —प्र-शस्ति-रत्नावली, f., N. of a poem by Viśva-nātha.
प्रशस्य: 1. प्र-शस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised or com-mended, praiseworthy, laudable, commendable; ex-cellent, eminent, distinguished; to be called happy, to be congratulated; [cf. प्र-शंस्य।] —प्रशस्य-ता, f. excellence, eminence.
2. प्र-शस्य, ind. having praised or recommended.
प्रशद्: प्रशद् प्र-शद्, Caus. P. -शातयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fall down, break off, pluck, gather.
प्रशत्त्वन्: प्र-शत्त्वन्, आ, m. the ocean; (अरी), f. a river.
प्रशम्: प्रशम् प्र-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमि-तुम्, to become calm or tranquil, to be still or unmoved; to be appeased or pacified, be soothed; to be laid or made to settle down (as dust); to be restrained; to become extinguished; to cease; to fade away: Caus. -शमयति, -यितुम्, to tranquillize, make calm or tranquil, pacify, soothe, appease; to extinguish, quench, allay; to kill, destroy; -शाम-यति, -यितुम्, to make subject, make obedient, subdue, conquer, tranquillize.
प्रशम: प्र-शम, अस्, m. becoming calm or tranquil, rest, quiet, quiescence, calmness, tranquillity, peace, composure (e. g. प्रशमम् उपैहि, go to com-posure, i. e. compose yourself); assuagement, ap-peasement, tranquillizing, removing; becoming ex-tinguished, extinction (of flames &c.), abatement; N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi and Śānti-devā; (ई), f., N. of an Apsaras. —प्रशमङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing the cessation of. —प्रशम-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a state of quiescence. —प्रशमायन (°म-अय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, walking in tranquillity.
प्रशमन: प्र-शमन, अस्, ई, अम्, tranquillizing, pacifying, calming; suppressing, curing, healing; (अम्), n. reposing, repose, quiescence; tranquillizing, pacifying, calming; mitigating, assuaging, allaying, composing; soothing (fever &c.); curing, healing; extinguish-ing, quenching, suppressing; abatement, cessation; killing, destroying, slaughter; (scil. अस्त्रम्), N. of a magic weapon; bestowing aptly or fitly (Manu VII. 56, = सत्-पात्रे प्रतिपादनम्); securing, keeping safe; लब्धस्य प्रशमनम्, the se-curing of what has been acquired or bestowing it on fit objects; [cf. लब्ध-प्°।]
प्रशमय्य: प्र-शमय्य, ind. having appeased or tranquil-lized.
प्रशमित: प्र-शमित, अस्, आ, अम्, tranquillized, appeased, relieved; quelled, quenched, allayed. —प्रशमितो-पद्रव (°त-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having all calamities or hinderances quelled (= प्रशान्त-बाध).
प्रशम्यमान: प्र-शम्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being tranquillized or pacified, being appeased; being flattered.
प्रशान्: प्र-शान्, ind., see Gaṇa Svar-ādi to Pāṇ. I. 1, 37; [cf. प्र-शाम्।]
प्रशान्त: प्र-शान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, tranquillized, composed, quieted, calmed, calm; tamed; subdued; abated, ended, ceased, discontinued (as active effort); dead, deceased; relieved; (अस्), m., N. of a divinity. —प्रशान्त-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose desires are calmed, content. —प्रशान्त-चारित्र-मति, इस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —प्रशान्त-चारिन्, इणस्, m. pl. walking tranquilly, (perhaps) an epithet of a class of deities. —प्रशान्त-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose efforts have ceased, resting. —प्रशान्त-ता, f. tranquillity (of mind). —प्रशान्त-बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, having all calamities or hinderances quelled (= प्रशमितोपद्रव). —प्रशान्तात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, ‘tranquil-souled,’ composed in mind, peace-ful, calm. —प्रशान्तोर्ज (°त-ऊर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose strength has ceased, weakened, prostrated. —प्रशान्तौजस् (°त-ओज्°), आस्, आस्, अस्, = प्रशान्-तोर्ज above.
प्रशान्तक: प्रशान्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-शान्त above.
प्रशान्ति: प्र-शान्ति, इस्, f. becoming calm or tranquil, tran-quillization, tranquillity of mind, calm, quiet, pacifi-cation, composure; ceasing, cessation, rest; allaying, quenching, extinguishing, extinction. —प्रशान्ति-दूती, f. the harbinger of rest, forerunner of repose, an epithet of old age.
प्रशाम्: प्र-शाम्, न्, न्, न्, tranquil, quiet.
प्रशाम: प्र-शाम, अस्, m. tranquillity, quiescence; paci-fying; laying, suppressing.
प्रशर्ध: प्रशर्ध प्र-शर्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शृध् with प्र), Ved. valiant (said of Indra; Sāy. = प्र-कर्षेणाभिभविता).
प्रशल: प्रशल प्रशल, a various reading for प्र-सल, q. v.
प्रशस्: प्रशस् प्र-शस्, अस्, f. (fr. rt. शस् with प्र), Ved. a hatchet, axe, knife; (according to others) = प्र-शस्त, प्रशस्त-च्छेदन।
प्रशाख: प्रशाख प्र-शाख, अस्, आ, अम्, having great branches (as a tree); an epithet of the fifth stage in the formation of an embryo (in which the hands and feet are formed, in this sense also written प्र-शक); (आ), f. a branch, small branch or twig; (probably) the extremities of the body. —प्रशाख-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having many branches.
प्रशाखिका: प्रशाखिका, f. a branch; a small branch or twig.
प्रशास्: प्रशास् प्र-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, to rule over, reign over, rule, reign, govern, com-mand, enjoin; to teach, instruct; to chastise, punish.
प्रशासन: प्र-शासन, अम्, n. governing, ruling; dominion, government; enjoining, enacting.
प्रशासित: प्र-शासित, अस्, आ, अम्, ruled over, reigned over, governed, ruled; enjoined, enacted.
प्रशासितृ: प्र-शासितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, governing, ruling, a governor, ruler.
प्रशास्तृ: प्र-शास्तृ, ता, m. ‘director,’ title of a priest also called Maitrāvaruṇa, the first assistant of the Hotṛ (Ved.); a king.
प्रशास्त्र: प्र-शास्त्र, अम्, n., Ved. the office of Praśāstṛ; the Soma vessel of the Praśāstṛ; (Sāy.) = प्रशास्तुर् यागः।
प्रशिष्ट: प्र-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ruled over, reigned, governed, commanded.
प्रशिष्टि: प्र-शिष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. injunction, command, order.
प्रशिस्: प्र-शिस्, ईस्, f., Ved. injunction, command, order; [cf. 1. आ-शिस्।]
प्रशिथिल: प्रशिथिल प्र-शिथिल, अस्, आ, अम्, very loose, relaxed, lax. —प्रशिथिली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered very loose, greatly loosened. —प्रशिथिली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become loose or lax.
प्रशिष: प्रशिष प्रशिष, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.
प्रशिष्य: प्रशिष्य प्र-शिष्य, अस्, m. the disciple of a disciple, scholar of a scholar, pupil of a pupil. —प्रशिष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being the disciple of a disciple, the condition of a pupil's pupil.
प्रशुक्रीय: प्रशुक्रीय प्रशुक्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. be-ginning with the words प्र शुक्रा (said of the hymn Ṛg-veda VII. 34, 1).
प्रशुद्धि: प्रशुद्धि प्र-शुद्धि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. शुध् with प्र), purity, clearness.
प्रशुम्भ्: प्रशुम्भ् प्र-शुम्भ्, cl. 6. A. -शुम्भते, -शुम्भितुम्, Ved. to decorate or adorn one's self highly; (Sāy.) = प्रकर्षेण स्वकीयम् अङ्गम् अलङ्-कृ।
प्रशुश्रुक: प्रशुश्रुक प्र-शुश्रुक, अस्, m., N. of a prince (a son of Maru; cf. प्र-सुश्रुत).
प्रशोचन: प्रशोचन प्र-शोचन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. शुच् with प्र), Ved. burning on, continuing to burn.
प्रशोष: प्रशोष प्र-शोष, अस्, m. (rt. शुष्), drying up, becoming dry, exsiccating, aridity.
प्रशोषण: प्र-शोषण, अस्, m. ‘drying up,’ epithet of a kind of phantom.
प्रश्रुत्: प्रश्रुत् प्र-श्चुत् or प्र-श्च्युत्, cl. 1. A. -श्चो-तति, -श्च्योतति, -श्चोतितुम्, -श्च्योतितुम्, to pour forth, shed, distil, sprinkle; to drip, fall in drops.
प्रश्चोतत्: प्र-श्चोतत् or प्र-श्च्योतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pouring forth, sprinkling; dripping, falling in drops.
प्रश्न: प्रश्न 1. प्रश्न, अस्, m. basket-work, a plaited basket.

प्रश्न 2. प्रश्न, अस्, m. (fr. rt. प्रछ्), a question, demand, inquiry, interrogation, query [cf. कुशुल-प्°]; judicial inquiry or examination [cf. साक्षि-प्°]; a controverted question, point at issue, subject of inquiry, controversy, (प्रश्नम् प्र-ब्रू, to decide a controverted point; प्रश्नम् इ, to lay a question before any one (acc.) for decision; प्रश्-नस् तव पितरि, the point at issue is before thy father, i. e. it is submitted to him to decide); a problem for calculation; inquiry into the future (in astrology; cf. दिव्य-प्°, देव-प्°, दैव-प्°); a par-ticular number of verses of the Veda repeated from memory by a pupil to his Guru, a task, lesson, repeti-tion; a term applied to short sections in various works. —प्रश्न-कोष्ठी, f., N. of a work on divination. —प्रश्न-दूती, f. a riddle, enigma, perplexing or enigmatical question. —प्रश्न-विवाक, अस्, m., Ved. one who decides controversies, an arbitrator. —प्रश्-न-विवाद, अस्, m. a controverted question, contro-versy. —प्रश्न-वैष्णव, अम्, n., N. of an astrological work. —प्रश्न-व्याकरण, अम्, n., N. of the tenth of the twelve sacred books of the Jainas. —प्रश्नार्णव (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘ocean of questions,’ N. of a work on astrology (= वैष्णव-शास्त्र). —प्रश्नोत्तर (°न-उत्°), अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a particular Śabdālaṅkāra or figure of speech. —प्रश्नोत्तर-मणि-माला or प्रश्नोत्तर-माला, f., N. of a work. —प्रश्नोत्तर-रत्न-माला, f., N. of a work. —प्रश्नोपनिषद् (°न-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad (consisting of six questions and six answers).
प्रश्नय: प्रश्नय, Nom. P. प्रश्नयति, -यितुम्, to inquire after, ask about (with two acc.).
प्रश्निन्: प्रश्निन्, ई, m., Ved. an inquirer, one who inquires into the future (Mahī-dhara = शकुनादि-प्रष्टृ).
प्रष्टव्य: प्रष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or questioned about (with acc.); deserving to be consulted; proper to be inquired into.
प्रष्टृ: प्रष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, asking, demanding, an asker, inquirer, questioner, interrogator, querist.
प्रश्नि: प्रश्नि प्रश्नि, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a race of Ṛṣis; (incorrectly for पृश्नि, q. v.)
प्रश्नी: प्रश्नी, f. incorrectly for पृश्नी, q. v.
प्रश्रथ: प्रश्रथ प्र-श्रथ, अस्, m. or प्र-श्रन्थन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. श्रन्थ् with प्र), laxity, relaxation, flaccidity.
प्रश्रब्धि: प्रश्रब्धि प्र-श्रब्धि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. श्रम्भ् with प्र), trust, confidence.
प्रश्रय: प्रश्रय प्र-श्रय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रि with प्र), respectful demeanour, affection, regard, solicit-ation, affection, respect, courtesy, civility, modesty; Modesty personified as a son of Dharma and Hrī. —प्रश्रय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, = प्रश्रयिन् below.
प्रश्रयण: प्र-श्रयण, अम्, n. respectful demeanour, civi-lity, modesty.
प्रश्रयिन्: प्रश्रयिन्, ई, इणी, इ, behaving respectfully, cour-teous, civil; modest. —प्रश्रयि-ता, f. respectful demeanour, courtesy, civility, modesty.
प्रश्रित: प्र-श्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, modest, humble, well-behaved; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Ānaka-dundubhi and Śānti-devā.
प्रश्रवण: प्रश्रवण प्र-श्रवण, an incorrect form for प्र-स्रवण, q. v.
प्रश्रवस्: प्रश्रवस् प्र-श्रवस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. ‘loud-sounding,’ an epithet of the Maruts; (Sāy.) = प्र-कृष्टान्न, having or bestowing excellent food.
प्रश्लथ: प्रश्लथ प्र-श्लथ, अस्, आ, अम्, very loose, greatly relaxed, languid, flaccid; unnerved.
प्रश्लित: प्रश्लित प्र-श्लित, अस्, m. (for प्र-श्रित), a term applied to the rule of Sandhi according to which अस् before a soft letter is changed into ओ।
प्रश्लिष्ट: प्रश्लिष्ट प्र-श्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्लिष् with प्र), twisted, entwined; (अस्), m. a term applied to the Sandhi of the vowel अ with a following vowel and of other vowels with homogeneous vowels; also to the vowel resulting from this Sandhi and of the accent with which such a vowel is pronounced; (अस्), m., N. of a man (?) .
प्रश्लेष: प्र-श्लेष, अस्, m. close contact, pressing against; euphonic coalition of vowels.
प्रश्वसितव्य: प्रश्वसितव्य प्र-श्वसितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्वस् with प्र), Ved. to be caused to recover the breath.
प्रश्वास: प्र-श्वास, अस्, m. breathing in, inhaling, breath, respiration.
प्रष्टि: प्रष्टि प्रष्टि, इस्, m. (connected with पृष्टि, q. v.), Ved. a horse harnessed at the side, a side-horse or one harnessed outside the shafts by the side of the other yoke-horses [cf. दक्षिणा-प्°]; (perhaps) a horse in front of those harnessed to the yoke or to the chariot-pole [cf. अधि-प्रष्टि-युग]; (according to Sāy.) = वाहन-त्रय-मध्य-वर्ती युग-विशेषः, a sort of yoke in the middle of three horses; a bystander, companion (Sāy. = पार्श्व-स्थ). —प्रष्टि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having side-horses (as a chariot). —प्रष्टि-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, or प्रष्टि-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. (a chariot) drawn by side-horses (and thus having at least three horses).
प्रष्ठ: प्रष्ठ प्र-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्था with प्र), standing in front, preceding, prior; chief, prin-cipal, best [cf. रथ-प्°]; a leader, conductor; (अस्), m. a species of plant; (ई), f. the wife of a leader or chief. —प्रष्ठ-वाह्, ट्, m. a young bull or steer training for the plough; प्रष्ठौही, f. a cow for the first time with calf; [cf. पष्ठ-वाह्।]
प्रष्ठिवाहिन्: प्रष्ठिवाहिन् प्रष्ठि-वाहिन्, a wrong read-ing for प्रष्टि-वाहिन्, q. v.
प्रष्णवैष्णव: प्रष्णवैष्णव प्रष्ण-वैष्णव, an incorrect form for प्रश्न-वैष्णव, q. v.
प्रस्: प्रस् प्रस्, cl. 1. A. प्रसते, प्रसितुम्, to extend, expand, spread, diffuse; to bring forth young.
प्रसक्त: प्रसक्त प्र-सक्त, प्र-सक्ति। See under प्र-सञ्ज् below.

प्र-सक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to, in contact with, united to, connected with; cleaving to, adher-ing to, fixed upon (with loc.); devoted to; accom-panying; engaged in, applied to, used, employed; attained, obtained, gained; continual, constant, eter-nal; opened, expanded; (अम्), ind. continually, in-cessantly, eternally, ever.
प्र-सक्त; add — occurred, happened, taken place.
प्रसक्षिन्: प्र-सक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. overpowering, de-feating, victorious (Sāy. = शत्रूणाम् प्रसहन-शीलः).
प्रसङ्ख्या: प्रसङ्ख्या 1. प्र-सङ्-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति, -ख्यातुम्, to count or reckon up, number, enume-rate, calculate.
2. प्र-सङ्ख्या, f. total number, sum; reflection.
प्रसङ्ख्यान: प्र-सङ्ख्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, meditating (? as an epithet of an order of ascetics); (अस्), m. payment, liquidation; a sum of money; (अम्), n. enumerat-ing, enumeration; reflection, meditation; reputation, renown. —प्रसङ्ख्यान-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, en-grossed or absorbed in meditation.
प्रसङ्ग: प्र-सङ्ग, अस्, m. adherence or attachment to, devotion to, devotedness; addiction to [cf. सुरत-प्°]; occupation [cf. विरत-प्°, विरुद्ध-प्°]; con-nection, union, association, intercourse [cf. स्त्री-प्°]; illicit intercourse; connected reasoning or argument; connected language or style; subject, topic, the case as stated; occurrence of a possibility, contingency, case, event (e. g. एचः प्लुत-प्रसङ्गे, in the event of a diphthong being prolated); conjuncture, occa-sion, circumstances, time; introduction, insertion; mention of parents; conjoint result (?); revealing a secret (?); second or subsidiary incident (?); N. of a Bud-dhist school; of a man; प्रसङ्गेन or प्रसङ्गात्, ind. through connection with or relation to; with all the heart, heartily, earnestly; on the occasion of, in consequence of, on account of, because of (lit. from its happening); when the occasion presents itself, occasionally, incidentally; in the course of (e. g. कथा-प्रसङ्गेन, in course of conversation). —प्रसङ्ग-तस्, ind. out of attachment to or respect for; = प्रसङ्गेन, प्रसङ्गात्. —प्र-सङ्ग-निवारण, अम्, n. the prevention of (similar) cases, obviation of (like future) contingencies. —प्र-सङ्ग-रत्नावली, f., N. of a work. —प्रसङ्ग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, occasional, incidental, casual. —प्र-सङ्ग-वशात्, ind. according to the time, as occasion may demand, by the force of circumstances. —प्र-सङ्ग-विनिवृत्ति, इस्, f. the non-recurrence of a case. —प्रसङ्ग-सम, अस्, m. a particular Jāti [q. v.] in logic. —प्रसङ्गाभरण (°ग-आभ्°), अम्, n., N. of a modern poetical anthology.
प्रसङ्घ: प्रसङ्घ प्र-सङ्घ, अस्, m. a great multitude.
प्रसञ्चक्ष्: प्रसञ्चक्ष् प्र-सञ्-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे, &c. (see rt. चक्ष्), to reckon up, recount, enumerate.
प्रसञ्ज्: प्रसञ्ज् प्र-सञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. -सजति, -सङ्क्तुम्, to become attached to, feel affection for: Pass. -सज्-यते, to cleave to, adhere or cling to, become fixed upon or attached to, become strongly addicted to (with loc.); to be relevant or applicable, to apply.
प्रसक्तव्य: प्र-सक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached to.
प्रसक्ति: प्र-सक्ति, इस्, f. adherence or attachment to, ad-hesion, devotion to, addiction to, engagedness, the being occupied with; bearing upon, applicability, application (especially of a rule in grammar; अति-प्रसक्ति, too wide applicability; प्रसक्तिम् प्र-या, to become attached); connection, union, association; inference, conclusion, deduction; a topic or subject of conversation; occurrence of a possibility; perse-verance, energy; acquiring, acquisition.
प्रसङ्गिन्: प्रसङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, attached to, devoted to; dependent on, contingent, additional; occasional, incidental; secondary, subordinate, non-essential. —प्रसङ्गि-ता, f. attachment, addiction to, con-nection, intercourse with.
प्रसज्य: प्र-सज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached to, to be connected with; applicable. —प्रसज्य-प्रतिषे-ध, अस्, m. a particular kind of negation, negation of a possible case (distinguished from पर्य्-उदास, q. v.), a simple prohibition of the particular matter specified without enjoining what is different.
प्रसञ्जन: प्र-सञ्जन, अम्, n. the act of attaching or con-necting, combining, uniting; applying, employing, bringing into use, bringing to bear.
प्रसद्: प्रसद् प्र-सद्, cl. 1. 6. P. -सीदति, -सत्तुम्, to settle down, become clear, become placid or tranquil, become calm, be calm, be soothed; to be content or satisfied; to be glad; to be gracious or propitious, to be favourable, favour (with gen.); to vouchsafe, be pleased to (with inf.): Caus. -सा-दयति, -यितुम्, to render calm, soothe, appease, propitiate; to beg pardon of (with acc.); (A.) to cause to be gracious, pray for grace or favour: Pass. of Caus. -साद्यते, to be rendered calm, to be soothed or appeased.
प्रसत्ति: प्र-सत्ति, इस्, f. transparency, brightness, clearness, cleanness, purity; complacency, graciousness, favour.
प्रसन्न: प्र-सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, settled down, tranquil; clear, bright, pellucid, limpid, pure, clean; soothed, propitiated, pleased, delighted; gracious, propitious, kind, kindly disposed towards, favourable, compla-cent; true; (अस्), m., N. of a prince; (आ), f. pro-pitiating, pleasing; spirituous or vinous liquor. —प्र-सन्न-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, almost quiet, tolerably calm. —प्रसन्न-ता, f. or प्रसन्न-त्व, अम्, n. brightness, pellucidness, clearness, purity; favour, kindness, propitiousness, good humour. —प्रसन्न-पाद, अस्, or अम्, m. or n. (?) , N. of a work by Dharma-kīrtti. —प्रसन्न-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘placid-countenanced,’ having a pleased or approv-ing countenance, agreeable-looking, looking pleased, smiling. —प्रसन्न-राघव, अम्, n., N. of a drama by Jaya-deva. —प्रसन्न-वेङ्कटेश्वर-माहात्म्य (°ट-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a legend in the Bhaviṣyottara-Purāṇa. —प्रसन्न-सलिल, अस्, आ, अम्, having clear or limpid water. —प्रसन्नात्मन् (°न-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, gracious-minded, propitious. —प्रसन्नेरा (°न-ईरा), f. spirituous liquor.
प्रसाद: 1. प्र-साद, अस्, m. clearness, brightness, pellucid-ness, transparentness, limpidness, purity, cleanness [cf. अम्बु-प्°]; clearness of style, perspicuity; calm-ness, tranquillity, absence of excitement, repose, composure; serenity of disposition, good humour, good temper; graciousness, propitiousness, favour, kindness, kind behaviour [cf. दुष्-प्°, दृक्-प्°]; approbation; Kindness personified as a son of Dharma and Maitrī; a propitiatory offering or gift, food offered to a god (= प्रसाद-द्रव्य, प्रसादान्न); the remnants of food presented to an idol or left by a spiritual teacher (both of which any one may freely appropriate to his own use); free gift, gratuity; well-being, welfare; N. of a commentary on the Prakriyā-kaumudī; प्रसादात्, abl. c. through the kindness of, by the favour of. —प्रसाद-दान, अम्, n. a propitiatory gift, a gift in token of favour, gift of food by a superior. —प्रसाद-पट्ट, अस्, m. a turban of honour (worn as a token of royal favour). —प्रसाद-पराङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, not caring for any one's favour; withdrawing favour from any one (with gen.). —प्रसाद-पात्र, अम्, n. an object of favour. —प्रसाद-पुरग, अस्, आ, अम्, inclined to favour, favourably inclined. —प्र-साद-प्रतिलब्ध, अस्, m., N. of a demon. —प्र-साद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pleased, delighted; gracious, favourable. —प्रसाद-वित्तक, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps an incorrect form for प्रसाद-वित्तम), best ac-quainted with the favour (of another), preferred to all others. —प्रसाद-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, abiding in serenity, kind, propitious; happy. —प्रसादान्तर (°द-अन्°), अम्, n. another (mark of) favour. —प्र-सादी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to bestow as a mark of favour, bestow graciously, present.
2. प्रसाद, Nom. P. प्रसादति, प्रसादितुम्, to be clear or bright.
प्रसादक: प्र-सादक, अस्, इका, अम्, clearing, purifying, rendering clear or pellucid; gladdening, cheering, exhilarating; propitiating, courting favour, wishing to win any one's favour.
प्रसादन: प्र-सादन, अस्, ई, अम्, rendering clear, purifying [cf. अम्बु-प्°, तोय-प्°]; calming, tranquillizing; soothing, cheering, gratifying; (अस्), m. a royal tent; (आ), f. service, worship; (अम्), n. cleaning, freeing from soil or impurities; the act of calming, tranquillizing, composing, soothing (e. g. नेत्र-प्°, administering soothing remedies to the eyes); cheer-ing, gratifying [cf. श्रुति-प्°]; rendering gracious, propitiating, pleasing, (त्वत्-प्रसादनात्, for the sake of propitiating thee); boiled rice.
प्रसादनीय: प्र-सादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious, to be propitiated.
प्रसादयत्: प्र-सादयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to be gracious, propitiating, gratifying, pleasing.
प्रसादयितव्य: प्र-सादयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious, to be propitiated.
प्रसादित: प्र-सादित, अस्, आ, अम्, purified, cleansed; pleased, conciliated, propitiated, appeased, reconciled; wor-shipped.
प्रसादिन्: प्र-सादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, calming, tranquillizing, soothing, cheering, gladdening; showing favour, treating with kindness; clear, serene, bright.
प्रसाद्य: प्र-साद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be rendered gracious, to be propitiated, to be conciliated, placable.
प्रसेदिवस्: प्र-सेदिवस्, वान्, दुषी, वत्, one who has be-come pleased or propitiated, favourable.
प्रसन्धा: प्रसन्धा प्र-सन्-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to fix or fit (an arrow) to (the bow-string).
प्रसन्धान: प्र-सन्धान, अम्, n. combination (e. g. of words in the Krama, q. v.).
प्रसन्धि: प्र-सन्धि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Manu.
प्रसभम्: प्र-सभम्, ind. (an ind. past part. of a form सभ् = सह्, cf. 2. प्र-सह्य), by force, forcibly, violently; importunately; exceedingly, much; N. of a variety of the Triṣṭubh metre. —प्रसभ-द-मन, अम्, n. forcible taming (of wild animals; according to a Scholiast = बलात्कारेण मर्दनम्). —प्रसभ-हरण, अम्, n. carrying off by force, violent seizure. —प्रसभोद्धृत (°भ-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, torn up by force, forcibly uprooted. —प्र-सभोद्धृतारि (°त-अरि), इस्, इस्, इ, one who has forcibly uprooted his enemies.
प्रसमीक्ष्: प्रसमीक्ष् प्र-सम्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to look at, look upon, observe, perceive, see; to reflect upon, consider, deliberate; to ac-knowledge, recognise as, regard as.
प्रसमीक्षण: प्र-समीक्षण, अम्, n. considering, deliberat-ing, discussing.
प्रसमीक्षित: प्र-समीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, looked upon, observed; reflected upon, considered; regarded as, declared.
प्रसमीक्ष्य: 1. प्र-समीक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be considered or weighed or discussed.
2. प्र-समीक्ष्य, ind. having looked at; having reflected upon, having considered.
प्रसमीडित: प्रसमीडित प्र-समीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, celebrated.
प्रसयन: प्रसयन प्र-सयन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सि with प्र), binding, fastening.
प्रसित: प्र-सित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound to, bound, fastened; adhering to or engaged in, diligent, attentive, zealous; attached or devoted to, engrossed by; (अम्), n. pus, matter.
प्रसिति: 1. प्र-सिति, इस्, f. (for 2. see p. 648, col. 2), a ligament, binding, tie, fetter.

प्रसिति 2. प्र-सिति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. सो with प्र; for 1. see प्र-सयन, p. 647), Ved. a track, path, course (as of fire &c.); an attack, assault; a throw, cast, shot; stretch, reach, extent, compass; duration, series, succession (e. g. दीर्घाम् अनु प्र-सितिम्, in long succession); dominion, power, autho-rity, influence; (Sāy.) = ज्वाला, a flame; = बन्धन, confinement.
प्रसर: प्र-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, moving forwards, proceeding, projecting; (अम्), n. going forwards, unimpeded motion, free course [cf. विच्छिन्न-धूम-प्°]; spreading, extending, extension, extent, dimension, diffusion, dispersion; expansion; a stream, flow, flood, torrent; (in medicine) morbid displacement of the humors of the body; multitude, assemblage; a fight, combat, battle, war; an iron arrow; speed, velocity; affectionate solicitation; (आ), f. the plant Pæderia Fœtida. —प्रसर-युत, अस्, आ, अम्, pos-sessing extension, extensive.
प्रसर्ग: प्रसर्ग प्र-सर्ग, प्र-सर्जन। See under प्र-सृज्, p. 649, col. 2.
प्र-सर्ग, अस्, m., Ved. pouring forth, flowing forth, efflux (Sāy. = वर्षण); emission, discharge.
प्रसर्प: प्र-सर्प, अस्, m. going to the part of the sacrificial enclosure called the Sadas; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
प्रसल: प्रसल प्रसल, अस्, m. the cold season, winter (= हेमन्त; also read प्रशल).
प्रसलवि: प्रसलवि प्र-सलवि, ind., Ved. towards the right side, (opposed to अप-सलवि; also incor-rectly written प्रसवि।)
प्रसव: प्रसव 1. 2. and 3. प्र-सव। See under 1. and 2. प्र-सु, col. 2, and 2. प्र-सू, p. 649.
1. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सु below), Ved. pressing out Soma juice.

2. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 3. see under 2. प्र-सू, p. 649), procreating, generating, procreation, genera-tion; the production of young, bringing forth or bearing young, childbirth, parturition, delivery, travail, labour; conception; birthplace, source, origin; offspring, young, progeny, posterity, (अन्तः-प्°, containing offspring, pregnant; किसलय-प्°, the offspring of a twig, a young shoot); a flower, blossom [cf. कनक-प्°, पीत-प्°]; fruit. —प्रसव-गृह, अम्, n. a lying-in chamber. —प्रसव-धर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, charac-terized by production, productive, prolific. —प्र-सव-बन्धन, अम्, n. the foot-stalk of a leaf or flower, the leaf-stalk or peduncle. —प्रसव-वि-कार, अस्, m., Ved. a prodigy happening at the birth of a child. —प्रसव-वेदना, f. the pangs of childbirth, throes. —प्रसव-स्थली, f. ‘birthplace,’ a mother. —प्रसव-स्थान, अम्, n. a receptacle for young, a nest. —प्रसवोत्थान (°व-उत्°), अम्, n., N. of the seventeenth Pari-śiṣṭa of the Yajur-veda. —प्रसवोन्मुख (°व-उन्°), ई, f. expecting child-birth, about to be delivered (according to Malli-nātha = आसन्न-प्रसवा).

3. प्र-सव, अस्, m. (for 1. and 2. see under 1. and 2. प्र-सु, p. 648), Ved. urging forwards, setting in motion, being set in motion; a current, course, stream; rousing up, excitement, animation; order-ing, enjoining; furtherance, assistance, help; pursuit, acquisition; one who urges on or excites.
प्रसव्य: प्रसव्य प्र-सव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards the left, (opposed to प्र-दक्षिण); contrary, reverse, reverted, inverted; favourable; (अम्), ind. towards the left, to the left side.
प्रसह्: प्रसह् 1. प्र-सह्, cl. 1. A. -सहते, -सहि-तुम्, -सोढुम्, to bear up against, be able to with-stand, sustain, endure; to overpower, conquer, de-feat; to make an effort; to be able (with inf.).
2. प्र-सह् or प्र-साह्, -साट्, m. (acc. प्र-साहम्), overpowering; an epithet of Indra, (Sāy. = शत्रूणाम् अभिभविता, the overcomer of foes); force, violence.
प्रसह: प्र-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing up against, with-standing; (अस्), m. a beast or bird of prey; endur-ance, resistance (in दुष्-प्°, q. v.); (आ), f. a kind of Solanum (= वृहतिका).
प्रसहन: प्र-सहन, अस्, m. a beast or bird of prey; (अम्), n. withstanding, resisting; overcoming, de-feating; defeat; bearing, enduring; embracing, an embrace.
प्रसह्य: 1. प्र-सह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be resisted, to be conquered or defeated; अ-प्रसह्य, not to be resisted, irresistible.

2. प्र-सह्य, ind. having withstood, having sus-tained; having overpowered or conquered; forcibly, violently, by violence, by force; exceedingly. —प्र-सह्य-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting violently, violent in action. —प्रसह्य-चौर, अस्, m. ‘a violent thief,’ a robber, plunderer. —प्रसह्य-हरण, अम्, n. taking away by force, robbing, plundering; [cf. प्र-सभ-हरण।]
प्रसह्वन्: प्र-सह्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. overpowering, defeat-ing; an epithet of Indra.
प्रसाह: प्र-साह, अस्, m. overpowering, defeating; con-trolling one's self; अ-प्रसाह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. com-pletely master of one's self, not subject to passion.
प्रसातिका: प्रसातिका प्रसातिका, f. a kind of rice with small grains (= अणु-व्रीहि; cf. प्र-साधिका).
प्रसाध्: प्रसाध् प्र-साध्, Caus. P. -साधयति, -यि-तुम्, to accomplish, effect; to promote, advance, further; to make one's own, acquire, (according to Kullūka on Manu VII. 103 = आत्मसात्-कृ); to subdue; to dress.
प्रसाधक: प्र-साधक, अस्, इका, अम्, accomplishing, per-fecting, one who accomplishes or perfects; cleansing, purifying; decorating, adorning, ornamenting; (अस्), m. an attendant who dresses his master, a valet de chambre; (इका), f. a female attendant who dresses her mistress, lady's maid; wild rice; [cf. प्रसा-तिका।]
प्रसाधन: प्र-साधन, अस्, ई, अम्, accomplishing, effecting; one who accomplishes or effects (Ved.); (अस्), m. a comb; (ई), f. a drug, commonly called सिद्धि; a comb, (केश-प्°, a comb for the hair); (अम्), n. bringing about, accomplishing, effecting; arranging; setting in order; decorating, decoration, embellish-ment, ornament, dress, toilet; a comb. —प्रसा-धन-विधि, इस्, m. a mode of decoration or em-bellishment. —प्रसाधन-विशेष, अस्, m. the highest decoration, most excellent ornament.
प्रसाधित: प्र-साधित, अस्, आ, अम्, accomplished, finished, completed, done; proved; ornamented, decorated. —प्रसाधिताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having the limbs ornamented or decorated.
प्रसाध्य: प्र-साध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accomplished or effected, practicable; to be destroyed; to be defeated.
प्रसार: प्र-सार, अस्, m. going forth, going about, spread-ing, extending, extension, expansion; stretching out [cf. बाहु-प्°]; opening (the mouth); going out to forage, spreading over the country for grass and fuel.
प्रसिच्: प्रसिच् प्र-सिच्, Pass. -सिच्यते, to be poured out or flow forth, to be scattered; to be lost.
प्रसेक: प्र-सेक, अस्, m. flowing forth, flowing, dropping, oozing; sprinkling, wetting; emission, discharge; running or watering of the mouth or nose, flow of saliva in vomiting, vomiting, sickness, nausea; the bowl of a spoon or ladle. —प्रसेक-ता, f. flow of saliva in nausea or vomiting.
प्रसेक प्र-सेक, प्रसेकिन्। See under प्र-सिच्, p. 648, col. 2.
प्रसेकिन्: प्रसेकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, discharging a fluid; suffering from morbid flow of saliva.
प्रसिध्: प्रसिध् प्र-सिध्, cl. 4. P. -सिध्यति, -सेद्-धुम्, to be accomplished or effected, to succeed; to be gained or obtained; to be established; to be made known or certified.
प्रसिद्ध: प्र-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, well known, notorious, renowned, famous, celebrated; adorned, ornamented. —प्रसिद्ध-क्षत्रिय-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, con-sisting for the most part of renowned Kṣatriyas. —प्रसिद्ध-ता, f. or प्रसिद्ध-त्व, अम्, n. celebrity, the being well known, notoriety.
प्रसिद्धक: प्रसिद्धक, अस्, m., N. of a prince descended from Janaka (a son of Maru and father of Kṛtti-ratha).
प्रसिद्धि: प्र-सिद्धि, इस्, f. accomplishment, success, attain-ment; the being generally known or admitted, celebrity, fame, notoriety; ornament, decoration. —प्रसिद्धि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, generally known, notorious, famous.
प्रसीदिका: प्रसीदिका प्रसीदिका, f. a small garden; (also read प्रसेदिका, q. v.)
प्रसु: प्रसु 1. प्र-सु, cl. 5. P. A. -सुनोति, -सुनुते, -सोतुम्, Ved. to press or squeeze out Soma juice, extract the juice of the Soma plant (Sāy. = सोमा-भिषवं कृ).

प्रसु 2. प्र-सु (sometimes written प्र-सू), cl. 1. P., 2. 4. A. -सवति, -सूते, -सूयते (properly a kind of reflexive passive form), -सोतुम्, -सवितुम्, to procreate, beget, generate, engender; to bring forth, be delivered of, bear: Pass. -सूयते (ep. also P. -ति), to be begotten by (with abl.); to be brought forth by, be born of (with loc.).
प्रसुत्: प्र-सुत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. flowing forth (as Soma from the Soma press).
प्रसुत् प्र-सुत्। See under 1. प्र-सु, col. 2.
प्रसुन्वत्: प्र-सुन्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. squeezing out or extracting Soma juice.
प्रसुव: प्र-सुव, अस्, m., Ved. pressing out Soma juice, extraction of the juice of the Soma plant.
प्रसुव प्र-सुव। See 1. प्र-सु, p. 648, col. 2.
प्रसवक: प्रसवक, अस्, m. the tree Buchanania Latifolia (= पियाल).
प्रसवत्: प्र-सवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing forth, bearing; (अन्ती), f. a woman in labour.
प्रसवन: प्र-सवन, अम्, n. bringing forth, bearing children, fecundity.
प्रसवितृ: 1. प्र-सवितृ, ता, m. (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सू, p. 649), a procreator, generator, father; (त्री), f. bringing forth, a mother.
2. प्र-सवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ (for 1. see p. 648, col. 3), Ved. urging forwards, setting in motion, ex-citing, animating; (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेणाभिज्ञातृ।)
प्रसविन्: 1. प्र-सविन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 2. see under 2. प्र-सू, p. 649), bringing forth, having or bearing young, producing.
2. प्र-सविन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 1. see under 2. प्र-सु, p. 648), urging forwards, exciting (?) .
प्रसुत: प्र-सुत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought forth, born; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?) , a particular high number; [cf. महा-प्°।]
प्रसू: 1. प्र-सू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ (for 2. see p. 649), bringing forth, bearing [cf. पितृ-प्°, पुत्रिका-प्°, स्त्री-प्°]; fruitful, productive; (ऊस्), f. a mother; a mare; a young shoot, tender grass or herbs, sacrificial grass, (Sāy. = प्रसवित्र्य् ओषधी); a spreading creeper, the plantain. —प्रसू-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, or प्रसू-वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. furnished with flowers.
प्रसू 2. प्र-सू, cl. 6. P. -सुवति, -सवितुम्, Ved. to urge forwards, incite, excite, animate.
प्रसूत: प्र-सूत, अस्, आ, अम्, procreated, begotten, en-gendered; brought forth, born, produced, grown; begetting, engendering; one who has brought forth, delivered; (अस्), m., N. of a class of deities under Manu Cākṣuṣa; (अम्), n. a flower; any productive source; (आ), f. a woman who has brought forth a child, a woman recently delivered.
प्रसूति: 1. प्र-सूति, इस्, f. procreating, procreation, beget-ting, generating; bringing forth, bearing; calving; laying eggs; birth, production, generation; coming forth, growth (of fruits, flowers, leaves; cf. फल-प्°); a production, product; a procreator, begetter; one who brings forth, a mother; offspring, children, progeny; N. of a daughter of Maru and wife of Dakṣa. —प्रसूति-ज, अम्, n. ‘birth-produced,’ pain or affliction (mental or corporeal) resulting as a ne-cessary consequence of birth. —प्रसूति-वायु, उस्, m. air generated in the womb during the pangs of travail.
2. प्र-सूति, इस्, f. (for 1. see under 2. प्र-सु), urging forwards, impelling, commanding; permission.
प्रसूतिका: प्रसूतिका, f. a woman who has had a child, a woman recently delivered; = 1. प्र-सूति (at the end of a comp., cf. नश्यत्-प्°, सकृत्-प्°).
प्रसून: प्र-सून, अस्, आ, अम्, born, produced; (अम्), n. a flower; a bud, blossom; fruit. —प्रसून-बाण or प्रसून-वाण, अस्, m. ‘having flowers for arrows,’ the god of love. —प्रसून-वर्ष, अस्, m. a shower of flowers (rained from heaven). —प्रसूनाञ्जलि (°न-अञ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, presenting a nosegay of flowers held in both hands opened and hollowed (= पुष्पाञ्जलि). —प्रसूनेषु (°न-इषु), उस्, m. ‘flower-arrowed,’ an epithet of the god of love.
प्रसूनक: प्रसूनक, अम्, n. a flower; a bud, blossom.
प्रसूयत्: प्र-सूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being born (Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 5687).
प्रसुप्: प्रसुप् प्र-सुप्, प्र-सुप्त, प्र-सुप्ति। See under प्र-स्वप्, p. 651, col. 1.
प्र-सुप्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. sleeping, asleep, slumber-ing; (Sāy. = शत्रूणां हन्तृ।)
प्रसुश्रुत: प्रसुश्रुत प्र-सुश्रुत, अस्, m., N. of a prince (a son of Maru; cf. प्र-शुश्रुक).
प्रसुह्म: प्रसुह्म प्र-सुह्म, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
प्रसृ: प्रसृ प्र-सृ, cl. 1. and Ved. cl. 3. P. -स-रति, -सिसर्ति, -सर्तुम्, to move forwards, go for-ward, proceed, advance; to pass, pass by (as time); to flow onwards, flow forth; to spring up; to break forth, break out (as fire); to spread abroad; be diffused; to be stretched forth, be extended, extend: Caus. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go forwards, move forwards, stretch forth, hold out; to spread out, spread, extend; to expand, open wide; to put forward, exhibit, expose (for sale).
प्रसरण: प्र-सरण, अम्, n. going forth, running forth, running away, escaping; going round; spreading abroad, spreading over the country to forage; sur-rounding an enemy; morbid displacement of the humors of the body; complaisance, amiability.
प्रसरणि: प्र-सरणि, इस्, or प्र-सरणी, f. surrounding an enemy.
प्रसरत्: प्र-सरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going forwards, proceed-ing, projecting; spreading out, spreading, expanding; bursting.
प्रसारण: प्र-सारण, अम्, n. causing to go forwards, stretching out, extending, spreading, spreading abroad, diffusing, diffusion, expanding, expansion, increase; displaying, unfolding; going about; surrounding an enemy; dispersion of an army by detachments for collecting forage, &c.; changing a semivowel into a vowel [cf. सम्-प्रसारण]; (ई), f. surround-ing an enemy; a species of creeper, Pæderia Fœtida.
प्रसारणिन्: प्रसारणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, containing a semivowel liable to be changed into a vowel.
प्रसारित: प्र-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved forwards, held out; stretched out, expanded, extended, spread, dif-fused; laid out, exhibited, exposed (for sale).
प्रसारिन्: प्र-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, coming forth, flowing forth, moving on; going along gently, gliding, flowing, creeping; stretching, extending; spreading forth, spreading, expanding, expanded, unfolded; spread-ing round; (इणी), f. the plant Pæderia Fœtida.
प्रसार्य: 1. प्र-सार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be changed into a vowel.
2. प्र-सार्य, ind. having stretched forth, having put forth, having held out.
प्रसृत: प्र-सृत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forwards, gone; stretched out, stretched, extended; diffused, spread abroad, dispersed; lengthened, long; swift, quick; modest, humble; attached to, engaged in, appointed; (अस्), m. the palm of the hand stretched out and hol-lowed as if to hold liquids; a handful (as a measure, = two Palas); (आ), f. the leg; (अम्), n. a measure equal to two Palas; (प्र-सृत is sometimes incor-rectly written for प्र-श्रित and even for प्र-सित, q. q. v. v.) —प्रसृत-ज, आस्, m. pl. an epithet of a particular class of sons (Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 2615).
प्रसृति: प्र-सृति, इस्, f. progress, advance; streaming, flowing; the palm of the hand hollowed, a handful; a measure equal to two Palas.
प्रसृमर: प्र-सृमर, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing forth, dropping, distilling.
प्रसृज्: प्रसृज् प्र-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to pour away; to lay aside, dismiss; to quit, leave, abandon; to hurt, injure.
प्रसर्जन: प्र-सर्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) throwing or casting forth.
प्रसृष्ट: प्र-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, poured away, laid aside, dismissed; hurt, injured; (आ), f. (probably) a par-ticular movement in fighting.
प्रसृप्: प्रसृप् प्र-सृप्, cl. 1. P. -सर्पति, -सर्प्तुम्, -स्रप्तुम्, to creep or crawl forth, creep on; to go on, proceed.
प्रसर्पक: प्र-सर्पक, अस्, m., Ved. an assistant who is under the superintendance of the Ṛtvij at a sacrifice or a mere spectator at a sacrifice (so designated from entering the part of the sacrificial enclosure called Sadas; cf. प्र-सृप्त); an uninvited guest, an intruder (?) .
प्रसर्पण: प्र-सर्पण, अम्, n. going forwards, progressing, entering (with loc.); entering the part of the sacri-ficial ground called Sadas; refuge, shelter (Ved.; Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण सर्पण-साधनम्).
प्रसर्पत्: प्र-सर्पत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, advancing, proceeding.
प्रसर्पिन्: प्र-सर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creeping or crawling forth, gliding away; coming forth, issuing; going to the part of the sacrificial enclosure called Sadas.
प्रसृप्त: प्र-सृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, crept or crawled forth, crept away, come forth; entered into the part of the sacrificial ground called Sadas; (अस्), m. = प्र-सर्-पक, q. v.
प्रसेदिका: प्रसेदिका प्रसेदिका, f. a various reading for प्रसीदिका, q. v.
प्रसेन: प्रसेन प्र-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a prince (a son of Nighna or Nimna); N. of a king of Ujjayinī succeeded by Vikramārka or Vikramāditya. —प्र-सेन-जित्, त्, m., N. of several princes, especially of a sovereign of Śrāvastī contemporary with Śākya-muni.
प्रसेव: प्रसेव प्र-सेव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सिव् with प्र), a sack, a leathern bottle; a small instrument of wood covered with leather and placed under the neck of an Indian lute to render the sound deeper.
प्रसेवक: प्रसेवक, अस्, m. a sack [cf. चर्म-प्°]; a particular part of a lute (= प्र-सेव); a crooked piece of wood at the end of a lute.
प्रस्कण्व: प्रस्कण्व प्र-स्-कण्व, अस्, m., N. of a Vedic Ṛṣi with the patronymic Kāṇva (according to the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa, a grandson of Kaṇva), author of the hymns Ṛg-veda I. 44-50, IX. 95, Vālakhilya 3, 2, and 6, 8; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the descendants of Praskaṇva.
प्रस्कन्द्: प्रस्कन्द् प्र-स्कन्द्, cl. 1. P. -स्कन्दति, -स्कन्-तुम्, to spring forward, spring forth; to spring down, leap down, alight: Caus. -स्कन्दयति, -यितुम्, to overleap, spring over, leap across, cross (a river).
प्रस्कन्दत्: प्र-स्कन्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, springing forward, springing forth.
प्रस्कन्दन: प्र-स्कन्दन, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva (‘emit-ting semen?’); (अम्), n. the act of leaping over, spring-ing across; evacuation by stool, diarrhœa, dysentery.
प्रस्कन्दिन्: प्र-स्कन्दिन्, ई, m., N. of a man possessed of extraordinary strength.
प्रस्कन्द्य: प्र-स्कन्द्य, ind. having sprung forwards, having leaped down, having quickly alighted.
प्रस्कन्न: प्र-स्कन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung forward, sprung forth; dropped, fallen; defeated in battle; (अस्), m. a transgressor, sinner; one who has violated the usages of his caste or order, an outcast.
प्रस्कुन्द: प्रस्कुन्द प्र-स्कुन्द, अस्, m. an altar or ele-vated floor of a circular shape (= चक्राकारा वेदिका).
प्रस्खल्: प्रस्खल् प्र-स्खल्, cl. 1. P. -स्खलति, -स्ख-लितुम्, to stagger forwards, stagger, reel, totter, tumble.
प्रस्खलत्: प्र-स्खलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, staggering forwards, reeling, tumbling.
प्रस्खलन: प्र-स्खलन, अम्, n. the act of staggering, stumbling, tumbling, falling.
प्रस्तर: प्रस्तर प्र-स्तर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्तृ with प्र), anything strewed about, a couch of leaves and flowers; a bed or couch in general; a flat surface, flat top, level, a plain [cf. प्रासाद-प्°]; a stone, rock; a precious stone, gem, jewel; a paragraph, section of a work; (in prosody) a tabular represen-tation of the long and short vowels of a metre (?) ; musical notation (?) . —प्रस्तर-घटनोपकरण (°न-उप्°), अम्, n. an instrument for breaking or splitting stones. —प्रस्तरे-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. स्था), Ved. being on a couch or bed.
प्रस्तरण: प्र-स्तरण, अस्, आ, m. f. a couch, bed; a seat.
प्रस्तरिणी: प्र-स्तरिणी, f. a species of small shrub (= गो-लोमिका).
प्रस्तार: प्र-स्तार, अस्, m. strewing about, spreading out, scattering, spreading, covering with; a process in pre-paring minerals; a bed made with blossoms and leaves; a bed or couch in general; a flower-bed; a jungle, a thicket or wood overgrown with grass; a flat surface, level, plain; a representation or enumeration of all the possible combinations of certain given numbers (see Colebrooke's Algebra, p. 125); N. of a prince (a son of Ud-gītha; in this sense incorrectly for प्र-स्ताव). —प्रस्तार-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. a kind of metre consisting of 12 + 12 + 8 + 8 syllables.
प्रस्तारिन्: प्र-स्तारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, extending, spreading; (scil. अर्मन्) a particular disease of the white of the eye.
प्रस्तिर: प्र-स्तिर, अस्, m. a bed or couch made of flowers and leaves (= प्र-स्तर).
प्रस्तीर्ण: प्र-स्तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, thrust forward, protruded (as the tip of the tongue in pronouncing the dentals).
प्रस्तृत: प्र-स्तृत, अस्, आ, अम्, spread out, spread, ex-tended; disappeared.
प्रस्तीत: प्रस्तीत प्र-स्तीत or प्र-स्तीम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्त्यै with प्र), crowded together, clustering, swarming; sounded, making a noise.
प्रस्तु: प्रस्तु प्र-स्तु, cl. 2. P. A. -स्तौति, -स्तवीति, -स्तुते, -स्तुवीते, -स्तोतुम्, to praise before (anything else), praise first, praise; to begin, commence; to speak, say, report, relate, propound: Caus. -स्ताव-यति, -यितुम्, to begin, commence.
प्रस्तव: प्र-स्तव, अस्, m. a hymn of praise; = प्र-स्ताव, a favourable moment, &c.
प्रस्ताव: प्र-स्ताव, अस्, m. an introductory eulogy, intro-duction; the prelude or introductory words of a Sāman (sung by the Pra-stotṛ, Ved.); the prologue of a drama (= प्र-स्तावना); beginning, commenc-ing, commencement; introducing a topic, mention-ing, mention; the occasion of a conversation, a subject, topic; occasion, opportunity, time, season; convenience, (तव प्रस्तावेन, at your conveni-ence); N. of a prince (a son of Ud-gītha); = हेला, q. v.; (ए), ind. on a suitable occasion, oppor-tunely; (एन), ind. on the occasion of, occasionally, opportunely; suitably. —प्रस्ताव-चिन्तामणि, इस्, m., N. of a work. —प्रस्ताव-तस्, ind. on the occasion of; कथा-प्°, in course of conversation. —प्रस्ताव-यज्ञ, अस्, m. ‘the sacrifice to a topic of discussion,’ a conversation to which each inter-locutor contributes his share (and therefore compared with a sacrifice at which each person present offers a contribution). —प्रस्ताव-रत्नाकर, अस्, m., N. of a work. —प्रस्ताव-सदृश, अस्, ई, अम्, suited to the occasion, appropriate, seasonable.
प्रस्तावना: प्र-स्तावना, f. causing to be praised; causing to mention or to speak of; sounding forth; introduc-tion, commencement, preface, exordium; a dramatic prologue, an introductory dialogue usually spoken by the manager and one of the actors, the scene be-tween the prayer and the beginning of the first act (of which several varieties are enumerated, viz. the Udghāṭyaka, Kathodghāṭa, Prayogātiśaya, Pra-var-taka, and Ava-lagita).
प्रस्तावयत्: प्र-स्तावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, beginning, com-mencing.
प्रस्तावित: प्र-स्तावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be told or related; mentioned.
प्रस्ताव्य: प्र-स्ताव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be preluded or introduced with a Pra-stāva (as a Sāman).
प्रस्तुत: प्र-स्तुत, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, eulogized, pane-gyrised; proposed, propounded, declared, under dis-cussion, revealed; said; expected, desired; ready, prepared; accomplished, done; happened, come to pass; made or consisting of; approached, proximate; done with effort or energy; (अम्), n. that which is propounded, any object under discussion, a proposi-tion. —प्रस्तुत-यज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared for a sacrifice. —प्रस्तुताङ्कुर (°त-अङ्°), अस्, m. a kind of metaphorical expression, allusion by the mention of any passing circumstance to something latent in the hearer's mind (as, for instance, if a girl walking in a garden with an inconstant lover were to ask a bee, Why go to the thorny plantain when you can have the jasmine flower?).
प्रस्तुति: प्र-स्तुति, इस्, f., Ved. praise, eulogium.
प्रस्तुत्य: प्र-स्तुत्य, ind. having told or related, having rehearsed.
प्रस्तोतृ: प्र-स्तोतृ, ता, m., Ved. the Ud-gātṛ's assistant who sings the Pra-stāva (q. v.).
प्रस्तोत्रीय: प्रस्तोत्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the Pra-stotṛ.
प्रस्तूत: प्रस्तूत प्र-स्तूत, अस्, m., N. of a class of deities under Manu Cākṣuṣa; (an incorrect form for प्र-भूत or प्र-सूत।)
प्रस्तोक: प्रस्तोक प्र-स्तोक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a son of Sṛñjaya; कुत्सस्य प्रस्तोकः, N. of a Sāman.
प्रस्तोभ: प्रस्तोभ प्र-स्तोभ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्तुभ् with प्र), allusion to, reference to (with gen.); रयेर् आङ्गिरसस्य प्रस्तोभः, N. of a Sāman.
प्रस्थल: प्रस्थल प्र-स्थल, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
प्रस्था: प्रस्था प्र-स्था, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) -तिष्ठते (-ति), -स्थातुम्, to set out, depart; to proceed, advance, march towards (with acc. or dat. or with प्रति); (P., Ved.) to place before, set before, deposit: Caus. -स्थापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to set forth, cause to depart, induce to retire; to send forth, send out, dispatch, send away, dismiss; to send into exile, banish; to urge forwards, push on: Desid. -तिष्ठासति, -ते, to wish to advance.
प्रस्थ: प्र-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, going on a march or journey, going to, visiting, abiding in [cf. वन-प्°]; stable, firm, solid; expanding, spread; (अस्, अम्), m. n. table-land on the top of a mountain; a level expanse, (at the end of names of towns and villages, cf. इन्द्र-प्°, ओषधि-प्°, करीर-प्°; see Pāṇ. IV. 2, 110); a particular weight and measure of capacity (= 32 Palas = (1/4) of an Āḍhaka; or = 16 Palas = 4 Kuḍavas = (1/4) of an Āḍhaka; or = 2 Śarāvas; or = 6 Palas; or = (1/16) of a Droṇa); a Prastha of anything or anything measuring a Prastha, (according to the Su-śruta a man should never lose more than a Prastha of blood in being bled); (अस्), m., N. of a man. —प्रस्थ-पुष्प, अस्, m. ‘flowering on the mountain-top,’ a species of plant, a variety of Tulasī or basil with small leaves. —प्रस्थम्-पच, अस्, आ, अम्, cooking a Prastha (said of a cooking utensil capable of containing one Prastha). —प्रस्था-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, hastening away, rapid, (according to Mahī-dhara = उत्कृष्ट-जवोपेत); (अती), f., N. of a river.
प्रस्थान: प्र-स्थान, अम्, n. going forth, setting forth, procession, proceeding, departing; marching forth, a march, the march of an army or of an assailant; sending away, dispatching; departing this life, dying [cf. महा-प्°]; a way to attain (any object), course, method, system; a sect; an inferior kind of drama the characters of which are slaves and outcasts. —प्र-स्थान-भेद, अस्, m., N. of a work by Madhu-sūdana-sarasvatī. —प्रस्थान-वत्, ind. as in setting forth, as on a departure. —प्रस्थान-विकल-गति or प्रस्थान-विक्लव-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, one whose step falters in walking. —प्रस्थान-विघ्न, अम्, n. an obstacle to proceeding or to sending (anything); non-attendance at a festival, impeding its taking place. —प्रस्थानविघ्न-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing an impe-diment to proceeding or to dispatching (anything).
प्रस्थानिक: प्रस्थानिक, belonging or relating to a de-parture, to a course, sect, &c.
प्रस्थानीय: प्रस्थानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging or re-lating to a departure.
प्रस्थापन: प्र-स्थापन, अम्, n. causing to depart, sending away, dismissing, dispatching, (दिशः प्रस्थाप-नम्, sending into all quarters of the world); using, employing, (ध्वनि-प्°, employing a metaphor); appointment to an embassy; carrying off cattle; (आ), f. sending away, dispatching.
प्रस्थापनीय: प्र-स्थापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent away, proper to be sent or dispatched; to be carried or driven off.
प्रस्थापित: प्र-स्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to depart, sent away, dismissed, sent, dispatched.
प्रस्थाप्य: 1. प्र-स्थाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent away, to be dispatched.
2. प्र-स्थाप्य, ind. having sent forth, having dispatched.
प्रस्थायिन्: प्र-स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, setting forth, starting, departing; preparing to go or depart; travelling, marching, going.
प्रस्थावन्: प्र-स्थावन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. hastening away, rapid (an epithet of the Maruts, Sāy. = गमन-शील).
प्रस्थिक: प्रस्थिक, at the end of adjectives derived from comps. ending in प्रस्थ, cf. आर्धप्रस्थिक।
प्रस्थिका: प्रस्थिका, f. a species of plant (= अम्ब-ष्ठा).
प्रस्थित: प्र-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, set forth, set out, departed, gone; an epithet of particular Soma vessels (Ved.). —प्रस्थित-याज्या, f., Ved. a particular Yājyā re-cited during the oblation offered with the Soma vessels called प्र-स्थित।
प्रस्थिति: प्र-स्थिति, इस्, f. setting forth, going forth, going away; a march, journey.
प्रस्थेय: प्र-स्थेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set forth or departed.
प्रस्न: प्रस्न प्र-स्न, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्ना with प्र), a bath, vessel for bathing.
प्रस्नातृ: प्र-स्नातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who bathes, a bather.
प्रस्नेय: प्र-स्नेय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be bathed in, suitable for bathing.
प्रस्नव: प्रस्नव प्र-स्नव, प्र-स्नाविन्। See under प्र-स्नु, col. 3.
प्र-स्नव, अस्, m. dropping, a stream; pouring forth, flowing.
प्रस्निग्ध: प्रस्निग्ध प्र-स्निग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, very fatty or greasy, very oily.
प्रस्नु: प्रस्नु प्र-स्नु, cl. 2. P. A. -स्नौति, -स्नुते, -स्नवितुम्, to pour forth, flow, distil.
प्रस्नाविन्: प्र-स्नाविन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. pouring forth, dropping.
प्रस्नुत: प्र-स्नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, poured forth; dropping. —प्रस्नुत-स्तनी, f. having breasts that distil milk (through excess of maternal love).
प्रस्नुषा: प्रस्नुषा प्र-स्नुषा, f. the wife of a grandson.
प्रस्पन्दन: प्रस्पन्दन प्र-स्पन्दन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. स्पन्द् with प्र), palpitating, quivering, trembling, vibrating.
प्रस्फुट्: प्रस्फुट् प्र-स्फुट्, Caus. or cl. 10. P. -स्फोटयति, -यितुम्, to cleave through, transfix, cleave, split, pierce; to expand.
प्रस्फुट: प्र-स्फुट, अस्, आ, अम्, cleft open, expanded, blown; manifest, clear, plain, apparent, evident; divulged, published, spread abroad.
प्रस्फोटक: प्र-स्फोटक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
प्रस्फोटन: प्र-स्फोटन, अम्, n. splitting, falling asunder; expanding, budding, opening, blooming; ripening; causing to blow or bloom; making evident or mani-fest, revealing; striking, beating; threshing or win-nowing corn; a winnowing basket; wiping away, rubbing out.
प्रस्फुर्: प्रस्फुर् प्र-स्फुर्, cl. 6. P. -स्फुरति, -स्फु-रितुम्, to become tremulous, quiver, palpitate, vibrate, throb, pulsate.
प्रस्फुरमाण: प्र-स्फुरमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, quiver-ing, palpitating.
प्रस्फुरित: प्र-स्फुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, become tremulous, quivering, vibrating. —प्रस्फुरिताधर (°त-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose lower lip quivers, with quivering nether lip.
प्रस्मृति: प्रस्मृति प्र-स्मृति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. स्मृ with प्र), forgetting, forgetfulness.
प्रस्यन्द्: प्रस्यन्द् प्र-स्यन्द्, cl. 1. A. -स्यन्दते, -स्यन्दितुम्, to flow forth, flow away; to move rapidly, dart, fly.
प्रस्यन्द: प्र-स्यन्द, अस्, m. flowing forth, trickling out.
प्रस्यन्दन: प्र-स्यन्दन, अम्, n. trickling forth, exudation.
प्रस्यन्दमान: प्र-स्यन्दमान, अस्, आ, अम्, moving rapidly, darting, flying.
प्रस्यन्दिन्: प्र-स्यन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, flowing forth, trickling down.
प्रस्रंस: प्रस्रंस प्र-स्रंस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्रंस् with प्र), Ved. falling down, falling asunder.
प्रस्रंसिन्: प्र-स्रंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, letting fall, dropping; (scil. योनि) giving birth to the fetus before the time, miscarrying.
प्रस्रु: प्रस्रु प्र-स्रु, cl. 1. P. -स्रवति, -स्रोतुम्, to flow forth; to let flow, pour out.
प्रस्रव: प्र-स्रव, अस्, m. flowing forth, gushing forth, oozing out, dropping; that which flows forth, a flow, stream; milk flowing from the breast or udder; urine; the overflowing scum of boiling rice; (आस्), m. pl. falling tears, tears gushing forth. —प्रस्रव-युक्त or प्रस्रव-संयुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, connected with a stream, flowing in a stream, falling in drops, trickling; flowing with milk.
प्रस्रवण: प्र-स्रवण, अम्, n. (often incorrectly written प्र-श्रवण), flowing forth, gushing out, oozing out, trickling, dripping, leaking; dripping or fall of water, a cascade, cataract; a fountain, spring, well; a spout, the projecting mouth of a vessel (out of which any fluid is poured); streaming forth of the milk from the breast or udder; a pool of water formed by mountain streams; washing away of rocks &c. by the dripping of water; sweat, perspi-ration; voiding urine; N. of a place where the Sarasvatī takes its rise, (also प्लाक्षम् प्रस्रव-णम्); (अस्), m., N. of a man; of a range of moun-tains on the confines of Malaya.
प्रस्रविन्: प्र-स्रविन्, ई, इणी, इ, pouring forth; yielding milk; rich in milk.
प्रस्राव: प्र-स्राव, अस्, m. flowing, dropping; urine; the overflowing scum of boiling rice.
प्रस्रुत: प्र-स्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed forth, oozed out, dropped, issued.
प्रस्रुति: प्र-स्रुति, इस्, f. flowing forth, oozing out.
प्रस्वन्: प्रस्वन् प्र-स्वन्, cl. 1. P. -स्वनति, -स्वनि-तुम्, Ved. to sound loudly, resound.
प्रस्वनित: प्र-स्वनित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. loud-sounding, resounding, resonant.
प्रस्वान: प्र-स्वान, अस्, m. a loud noise.
प्रस्वप्: प्रस्वप् प्र-स्वप्, cl. 2. P. -स्वपिति, -स्वप्-तुम्, to fall asleep, go to sleep.
प्रसुप्त: प्र-सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen into deep or sound sleep, fast asleep, asleep, sleeping, slumbering. —प्र-सुप्त-ता, f. sleepiness.
प्रसुप्ति: प्र-सुप्ति, इस्, f. sleepiness, somnolence; paralysis.
प्रस्वाप: प्र-स्वाप, अस्, m. falling asleep, sleep; a dream; (अस्, आ, अम्), causing sleep, sending to sleep.
प्रस्वापक: प्र-स्वापक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to fall asleep; causing to die, slaying.
प्रस्वापन: प्र-स्वापन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing sleep, sending to sleep; (अम्), n. the act of sending to sleep.
प्रस्वापिनी: प्र-स्वापिनी, f. ‘sending to sleep,’ N. of a daughter of Sattrājit and wife of Kṛṣṇa.
प्रस्वादस्: प्रस्वादस् प्र-स्वादस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. agree-able, pleasant.
प्रस्वार: प्रस्वार प्र-स्वार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्वृ with प्र), Ved. an epithet of the sacred syllable ॐ repeated by the religious teacher at the beginning of a lesson.
प्रस्विन्न: प्रस्विन्न प्र-स्विन्न, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्विद् with प्र), covered with perspiration, sweated, heated, perspired.
प्रस्वेद: प्र-स्वेद, अस्, m. great or excessive perspiration, sweat.
प्रस्वेदित: प्र-स्वेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, sweated, heated, perspired, perspiring, sweating; causing perspiration, hot. —प्रस्वेदित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, suffering or pro-ducing perspiration.
प्रस्वेदिन्: प्र-स्वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, covered with perspiration, sweating.
प्रहणेमि: प्रहणेमि प्रह-णेमि or प्रह-नेमि, इस्, m. the moon (incorrect forms for ग्रह-नेमि, q. v.).
प्रहन्: प्रहन् 1. प्र-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to kill, slay.
प्रहणन: प्र-हणन, अम्, n. killing, slaying (Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 22).
प्रहत: प्र-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, beaten (as a drum), smitten, wounded, killed; repelled, repulsed, over-come, defeated; spread, expanded; contiguous, bounding, limitating; conversant with the principles of science; learned, accomplished. —प्रहत-मु-रज, अस्, आ, अम्, having drums beaten, sounding with the beating of drums.
प्रहन्तव्य: प्र-हन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be killed or slain.
प्रहन्तृ: प्र-हन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, striking down, slaying, a slayer.
प्रहर: प्र-हर, अस्, m. a particular division of time (comprising about three hours, = 6 or 7 Nāḍikas; so called from its lapse being announced by beating a gong); the eighth part of a day, a watch [cf. अर्ध-प्°]; a subdivision of Śrī-vasanta-rāja's work entitled Śākuna. —प्रहर-कुटुवी, f. a species of plant (= कुटुम्बिनी). —प्रहर-विरति, इस्, f. the end of a watch; (औ), ind. at the end of the (morning) watch, at nine o'clock in the forenoon.
प्रहर्ष: प्र-हर्ष, अस्, m. extreme joy, hilarity, mirth, gladness, delight, rapture, exultation, thrill; erection of the male organ, priapism; प्रहर्षं कृ, to take pleasure or delight in (with loc.) —प्रहर्ष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, delighted, glad.
प्रहस्: प्रहस् प्र-हस्, cl. 1. P. -हसति, -हसितुम्, to break out into laughter, laugh heartily, laugh at, laugh; to mock, deride, ridicule.
प्रहस: प्र-हस, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa.
प्रहसत्: प्र-हसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, laughing heartily, laugh-ing, smiling; (अन्ती), f. Arabian jasmine (= यूथी, वासन्ती); a large chafing-dish or fire-pan.
प्रहसन: प्र-हसन, अम्, n. laughing loudly, violent or hearty laughter, laughing, mirth, merriment; laugh-ing at, mocking, deriding, ridicule, irony, mockery; sarcasm, satire (as a branch of rhetorical composi-tion); a kind of comedy, a farce.
प्रहसित: प्र-हसित, अस्, आ, अम्, laughing, cheerful; (अम्), n. laughter, mirth. —प्रहसित-नेत्र, अस्, m. ‘laughing-eyed,’ N. of a Buddha.
प्रहसित्वा: प्र-हसित्वा, ind. an anomalous form for प्र-हस्य below.
प्रहस्य: प्र-हस्य, ind. having smiled or laughed.
प्रहास: प्र-हास, अस्, m. loud laughter, violent or hearty laughter, laughing, laughter; ridicule, mocking, de-rision; satire, irony; an actor, a dancer; N. of Śiva; of an attendant of Śiva; of a son of Varuṇa; of a Nāga; of a place of pilgrimage (= सोम-तीर्थ); भरद्-वाजस्य प्रहासम्, N. of a Sāman.
प्रहासक: प्र-हासक, अस्, m. one who causes laughter or merriment, a jester.
प्रहासित: प्र-हासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to laugh.
प्रहासिन्: प्र-हासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, laughing aloud, causing laughter, diverting, joking, jesting; satirical; (ई), m. the buffoon of a drama (= वि-दूषक, q. v.).
प्रहस्त: प्रहस्त प्र-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having long hands; (अस्), m. the open hand with the fingers extended; N. of a Rākṣasa; of a companion of Sūrya-prabha (see Kathā-sarit-s. XLIV. 25).
प्रहस्तक: प्रहस्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, scil. तृच, an epithet of the verses Ṛg-veda VIII. 86, 13 — 15.
प्रहा: प्रहा 1. प्र-हा, cl. 3. P. -जहाति, -हातुम्, to forsake, desert, leave, quit, abandon; to depart from; to throw, cast, fling: Pass. -हीयते, to be for-saken or relinquished, to be neglected; to fail, be lost, perish, disappear, vanish; to cease.

2. प्र-हा, f., Ved. a good throw at dice, gain, winnings; an advantage; (Sāy. = प्र-हन्तृ, a smiter, as if fr. 1. प्र-हन्। —प्रहा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. acquiring gain, gaining; (Sāy. = प्रह-रण-वत्, dealing blows, smiting.)
प्रहाण: प्र-हाण, अम्, n. relinquishing, abandoning, omitting, avoiding.
प्रहाणि: प्र-हाणि, इस्, f. relinquishing, abandoning; want, deficiency.
प्रहापण: प्र-हापण, अम्, n. driving away, forced aban-donment or departure.
प्रहीण: प्र-हीण, अस्, आ, अम्, left, abandoned; (अस्), m. removal, loss, waste, destruction. —प्रहीण-जीवित, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has abandoned life, dead, slain.
प्रहार: प्र-हार, अस्, m. striking, hitting; a stroke, blow, slap, knock, thump [cf. तल-प्°, मुष्टि-प्°]; a kick [cf. पाद-प्°]; a cut, thrust [cf. खड्ग-प्°]; killing, wounding; pecking; shooting, hitting (with a missile), a shot, hit. —प्रहार-करण, अम्, n. dealing blows, beating. -प्रहार-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a prince of Mithilā. —प्रहार-वल्ली, f. = चर्म-कशा, मांस-रोहिणी. —प्रहारार्त (°र-आर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, bruised or wounded by a blow, hurt by a blow; (अम्), n. chronic and acute pain from a wound or hurt.
प्रहि: प्रहि 1. प्र-हि, cl. 5. P. -हिणोति, -हेतुम्, to send forth, dispatch, send to (with dat. or gen. or acc. of the person and acc. of the thing); to shoot (an arrow from a bow), send, cast, throw, discharge; (Ved.) to rouse up, urge on (?); to propitiate (?).
प्रहि 2. प्रहि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. प्र-हृ), a well.
प्रहाय्य: प्र-हाय्य, अस्, m., Ved. ‘one who is to be sent,’ a messenger; [cf. प्र-हेय।]
प्रहित: 1. प्र-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see below), sent forth, sent, dispatched; shot, discharged (as an arrow from a bow); appointed, commissioned [cf. अ-प्°]; गौरीवितेः प्रहितः, N. of a Sāman; (अम्), n. sauce, gravy, condiment. —प्रहितन्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. going on an errand or mission.
प्रहित 2. प्र-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र-धा, p. 631, col. 3; for 1. see above), put forth, placed; stretched out, extended; suitable, appropriate; learned (?).
प्रहेति: प्र-हेति, इस्, m. a missile weapon (Ved., according to Mahī-dhara = प्रकृष्टम् आयुधम्); N. of a king of the Rākṣasas; N. of an Asura.
प्रहेतृ: प्र-हेतृ, ता, m. one who sends forth; one who excites or impels.
प्रहेय: प्र-हेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent away or dis-patched, serving as a messenger.
प्रहिम: प्रहिम प्र-हिम, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 16.
प्रहुत: प्रहुत प्र-हुत, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हु with प्र), sacrificial food offered to all created beings; (अम्), n. an offering of food to all created beings (= भूत-यज्ञ, Manu III. 74).
प्रहुति: प्र-हुति, इस्, f., Ved. an oblation, sacrifice; (Sāy. = प्रकृष्टाहुतिः, an excellent oblation.)
प्रहोष: प्र-होष, अस्, m., Ved. an oblation, sacrifice (?).

प्राकर्ष: प्राकर्ष प्राकर्ष, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-कर्ष), N. of a Sāman.
