प्राछ्: प्राछ् प्राछ्, ट्, ट्, ट् (fr. rt. प्रछ्), asking, inquiring, an inquirer, questioner. —प्राड्-विवाक, अस्, m. ‘one who interrogates and discriminates,’ a judge, magistrate, the presiding officer in a court of judicature (Manu VIII. 79, 181).
प्राजक: प्राजक प्राजक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अज् with प्र), a driver, charioteer, coachman.
प्राजन: प्राजन, अस्, अम्, m. n. a whip, goad.
प्राजितृ: प्राजितृ, ता, m. a driver, charioteer, coachman.
प्राजया: प्राजया प्राजया, see Gaṇa Sākṣādādi to Pāṇ. I. 4, 74.
प्राजहित: प्राजहित प्राजहित, अस्, m., Ved. a Gārha-patya fire maintained during a longer period of time, an older Gārhapatya fire.
प्राजापत: प्राजापत प्राजापत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजा-पति), see Gaṇa Mahiṣyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 48.
प्राजापत्य: प्राजापत्य, अस्, आ (or ती), अम्, belonging to or derived from Prajā-pati, relating to Prajā-pati, sacred to Prajā-pati; (अस्), m., with or without विवाह or विधि, the third or according to Manu the fourth form of marriage (that in which the father gives his daughter to the bridegroom without receiving a present from him, but with the convic-tion that the two will live faithfully together, Manu III. 30); scil. उपवास, a kind of penance (lasting twelve days, food being eaten during the first three once in the morning, during the next three once in the evening, in the next three only if given as alms, and a plenary fast being observed during the three remaining days); scil. तिथि, the eighth day in the dark half of the month Pauṣa; a patronymic of Pataṅ-ga; of Prajā-vat; of Yakṣma-nāśana; of Yajña; of Vimada; of Viṣṇu; of Saṃvaraṇa; of Hiraṇya-garbha; (with Jainas) N. of the first black Vāsudeva; a N. of the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā, = प्र-याग; (अम्), n. a particular sacrifice performed before appointing a daughter to raise issue in default of male heirs; scil. भ or नक्षत्र, the asterism Rohiṇī; generative energy, procreative power; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), the heaven or sphere of the Manes, = पितृ-लोक; (आ), f. giving away the whole of one's property before entering upon the life of an ascetic or mendicant; a patro-nymic of Dakṣiṇā; scil. शकटी, N. of an asterism, the chariot of Rohiṇī (probably = α β γ δ ε Tauri). —प्राजापत्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of belonging or referring to Prajā-pati.
प्राजापत्यक: प्राजापत्यक, अस्, &c., belonging or referring or sacred to Prajā-pati.
प्राजावत: प्राजावत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजा-वत्), see Gaṇa Mahiṣyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 48.
प्राजेश: प्राजेश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजेश), Ved. sacred to Prajā-pati; (अम्), n. the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī.
प्राजेश्वर: प्राजेश्वर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रजेश्वर), sacred to Prajā-pati.
प्राजिधर: प्राजिधर प्राजिधर, अस्, m., N. of a man.
प्राजिमठिका: प्राजिमठिका प्राजिमठिका, f., N. of a place.
प्राज्ञ: प्राज्ञ प्राज्ञ, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. प्र-ज्ञा), intellectual, (opposed to शारीर, तैजस); intelligent, wise, clever; patient in investigation; (Ved.) having no deep insight; (अस्), m. a wise or learned man, a Paṇḍit, a skilful or clever man; a kind of parrot with red stripes on the neck and wings; (आ or ई), f. a clever or intelligent woman; (ई), f. the wife of an intellectual man, wife of a Paṇḍit; (आ), f. intelligence, understanding. —प्राज्ञ-कथा, f. a story of a wise man, tale about a wise man. —प्राज्ञ-त्व, अम्, n. or प्राज्ञ-ता, f. wisdom, learning. —प्राज्ञ-मान, अम्, n. respect for learned men. —प्राज्ञ-मानिन् or प्राज्ञम्-मानिन्, ई, इनी, इ, thinking one's self wise, fancying one's self a learned man.
प्राज्य: प्राज्य प्राज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र with rt. अज् or fr. प्र + आज्य, clarified butter used for obla-tions?), abundant, plentiful, much, many, great, im-portant; lofty. —प्राज्य-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Rājāvali-patākā. —प्राज्य-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing great power. —प्राज्य-वृष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, sending rain in abundance (said of Indra).
प्राञ्च्: प्राञ्च् प्राञ्च् (प्र-अञ्च्), प्राङ्, प्राची, प्राक्, turned towards the front, directed forwards, being before, in front, foremost; turned towards, inclined towards, disposed, ready, willing (Ved.); turning eastward, eastern, easterly; previous, prior, former; प्राञ्चं कृ, to place in front, bring, offer, provide (Ved.); to promote, further, advance (Ved., Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण गच्छन्तं कृ); to spread out, stretch out (Ved.); प्राञ्चस्, m. pl. the people of the east, eastern people; eastern grammarians; प्राचि, f. the east; प्राक्, ind. (with abl. or rarely with gen. or acc.), before (in place or time or order), in front; up to, as far as (especially in the technical language of grammatical Sūtras, e. g. प्राक् कडारात्, up to the word Kaḍāra); in the east; first, at first, formerly, previously, in the former part (of a book); at dawn, at day-break, early in the morning; प्राग् एव, recently, just; (in Buddhist writings) = किम् उत, how much more? much more, still more; प्राचा, ind., Ved. forwards, onwards; (Sāy.) = ऋजुना मार्गेण, by a straight path; प्राचस्, ind., Ved. from the front. —प्राक्-कर्मन्, अ, n. preparatory or preliminary medical treatment; an action done in a former life. —प्राक्-कल्प, अस्, m. a former age or era. —प्राक्-काल, अस्, m. a former age or time, a previous time. —प्राक्कालीन, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to former or ancient times, pertaining to a previous time, anterior, ancient, previous, former. —प्राक्-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having the points turned towards the east (said of blades of Kuśa grass; ac-cording to Kullūka on Manu II. 75 = प्राग्-अग्र); (अम्), n. the point of a blade of Kuśa grass turned towards the east; (also written प्राक्-तूल; cf. प्राचीन-कूल।) —प्राक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done be-fore; (अम्), n. an action done in a former life. —प्राक्-केवल, अस्, आ, अम्, manifested from the first in a distinct form (without preliminary symp-toms, as a disease). —प्राक्-चरणा, f. an epithet of the female organ of generation. —प्राक्-चिरम्, ind. before it is too late, in good time. —प्राक्-छाय, अम्, n. a shadow's falling eastward. —प्राक्-तनय, अस्, m. a former pupil (perhaps a wrong reading for प्राप्त-नय). —प्राक्-तूल = प्राक्-कूल, q. v. —प्राक्-पद, अम्, n. a preceding word, the first member of a compound. —प्राक्-पुण्य-प्रभव, अस्, आ, अम्, caused by merits accrued in a former existence, resulting from good works done in a former state of being. —प्राक्-पुष्पा, f., see Vārtt. 1. to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 64. —प्राक्-फल, अस्, m. the bread-fruit tree (= पनस). —प्राक्-फल्गुनी, f. the eleventh of the lunar mansions (= पूर्व-फल्गुनी, q. v.). —प्राक्फल्गुनी-भव, अस्, m. Bṛhaspati or the planet Jupiter (born when the moon was in the mansion Prākphalgunī). —प्राक्-फाल्गुन or प्राक्फाल्गुनेय, अस्, m. the planet Jupiter. —प्राक्-फाल्गुनी = पूर्व-फाल्गुनी, q. v. —प्राक्-शस्, ind. from the front, from the east. —प्राक्-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or प्राक्-शिरस or प्राक्शिरस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having the head turned forwards or to the east. —प्राक्-शृङ्ग-वत्, आन्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi. —प्राक्-श्लिष्ट, a various reading for प्राश्लिष्ट, q. v. —प्राक्-संस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or directed eastwards. —प्राक्-सन्ध्या, f. morning twilight. —प्राक्-सवन, अम्, n. a morning libation. —प्राक्-सोम, अस्, आ, अम्, or प्राक्-सौमिक, अस्, ई, अम्, preceding the Soma sacrifice. —प्राक्-स्रोतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, flowing eastward (sometimes wrongly spelt प्राक्-श्रोतस्). —प्राग्-अग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the tip or point turned forwards or towards the east (as a blade of grass). —प्राग्-अपम्, ind. (fr. प्राक् and अपम् fr. अपाक्), Ved. from the front towards the back, in a backward direction. —प्राग्-अपरायत (°र-आय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, extending eastward and westward; [cf. प्राग्-आयत।] —प्राग्-अभाव, अस्, m. previous non-existence of anything, antecedent non-existence or privation, the non-existence of any-thing which may yet be; non-existence (of an effect) previous (to production); (in law) the non-possession of property that may be possessed. —प्रा-गभाव-विचार, अस्, m., N. of a Nyāya work. —प्राग्-अभिहित, अस्, आ, अम्, before-mentioned, pre-viously mentioned. —प्राग्-अवस्था, f. a former state, previous existence. —प्राग्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, extend-ing towards the east; [cf. प्राग्-अपरायत।] —प्राग्-आह्निक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the forenoon (= पौर्वाह्णिक). —प्राग्-उक्ति, इस्, f. previous utter-ance. —प्राग्-उत्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, north-eastern; (एण), ind. to the north-east of (with abl.), north-eastwards. —प्राग्-उदक्-प्लवन, अस्, आ, अम्, in-clining towards the north-east, situated in a north-easterly direction. —प्राग्-उदङ्मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the face turned to the east or north. —प्राग्-उदञ्च्, अङ्, ईची, अक्, north-eastern; (ईची), f., scil. दिश्, the north-east quarter, the north-east; (अक्), ind. to the north-east. —प्राग्-गमन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a forward motion, going forwards. —प्राग्-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going before, preceding, intending to go before; a precursor. —प्राग्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, pos-sessing the previously mentioned quality. —प्राग्-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the neck turned towards the east. —प्राग्-जन्मन्, अ, n. a former birth, former life. —प्राग्-जाति, इस्, f. a former birth (= पूर्व-जन्-मन्). —प्राग्-ज्योतिष, अम्, n., N. of a city, the dwelling-place of the demon Naraka; (अस्), m., with or without राजा, the king of Prāg-jyotiṣa, an epithet of Bhaga-datta; N. of a country, = काम-रूप; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people living in the city of Prāg-jyotiṣa or its environs; (अम्), ind. before day-break (?), —प्राग्ज्योतिष-ज्येष्ठ, अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu. —प्राग्-दक्षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, south-eastern; (अम्), ind. to the south-east, south-eastwards. —प्राग्-दक्षिणाञ्च् (°ण-अञ्च्), आङ्, आची, आक्, turned to the south-east, south-eastward. —प्राग्-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the stem or stalk turned towards the east. —प्राग्-दिश्, क्, f. ‘the eastern quarter,’ the east. —प्राग्-देश, अस्, m. the eastern country, country of the eastern people; a former or previous place. —प्राग्-द्वार्, र्, f. a door on the east side. —प्राग्-द्वार, अस्, आ, अम्, having doors towards the east; an epithet of the seven lunar mansions beginning with Kṛttikā; (ए), ind. in front of or before the door. —प्राग्द्वारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, having the door on the eastern side. —प्राग्-बोधि, N. of a mountain. —प्राग्-भक्त, अम्, n. taking medicine before a meal. —प्राग्-भाग, अस्, m. the fore part. —प्राग्-भार, अस्, m. the top or peak of a moun-tain; a multitude, heap; bending, inclining, leaning [cf. प्राचीन-प्°]; (अस्, आ, अम्), inclined, bent. —प्राग्-भाव, अस्, m. prior or previous existence; superiority, excellence; the top of a mountain (in this sense a various reading for प्राग्-भार). —प्राग्-भाव-तस्, ind. from a prior state of existence. —प्राग्-रूप, अम्, n. symptom of disease (= पूर्व-रूप)। —प्राग्-वंश, अस्, आ, अम्, having the supporting beam turned eastwards (Ved.); (अस्), m. the space before the Vedi, (perhaps) a kind of sacrificial chamber having columns or beams towards the east and situ-ated opposite to the Vedi, (according to Malli-nātha on Raghu-v. XV. 61 = प्राचीन-स्थूणो यज्ञ-शाला-विशेषः; according to others, a room in which the family and friends of the person performing the sacrifice assemble); a former dynasty or generation; an epithet of Viṣṇu (?). —प्राग्-वचन, अम्, n. a for-mer decision; anything formerly decided or decreed. —प्राग्-वट, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a city. —प्राग्-वत्, ind. as before, as previously, as for-merly, as in former times, as in the preceding part (of a book). —प्राग्-वृत्त, अम्, n. former behaviour; (in law) = प्राङ्-न्याय, q. v. —प्राग्-वृत्तान्त, अम्, n. a former event, previous adventure, a story of the past. —प्राग्-वेष or प्राग्-वेश, अस्, m. a former dress. —प्राग्-हार, a various reading for प्राग्-भार, q. v. —प्राङ्-आयत, an incorrect form for प्राग्-आयत, q. v. —प्राङ्-नासिका or प्राङ्-नासिकी, f., see Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 1, 60. —प्राङ्-न्याय, अस्, m. (in law) a former trial of a cause, the plea of a former trial, special plea; (अस्, आ, अम्), Ved. turned forwards or eastwards according to rule. —प्राङ्न्या-योत्तर (°य-उत्°), अम्, n. the rejoinder of the defendant that the charge against him has already been tried. —प्राङ्-मुख, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having the face turned forward or towards the east, facing the east (Manu II. 51); inclined towards, desirous of, wishing. —प्राचा-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. moving the tongue forwards (said of Agni; Sāy. = प्राग्-देश-स्थित-जिह्वा-स्थानीय-ज्वाल). —प्राचा-मन्-यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. striving to move forwards (said of Indra; Sāy. = अप्रतिहत-क्रोध). —प्राची-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the east,’ an epithet of Indra. —प्राची-मूल, अम्, n. the eastern horizon.
प्राञ्च्; the meaning is ‘worshipping’ when the nasal is retained throughout (e. g. inst. sing. du. प्राञ्चा, प्राङ्भ्याम्, Gram. 176. c).
प्राक्तन: प्राक्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, former, prior, previous, anterior, antecedent, preceding; early, old, ancient, (opposed to इदानीन्तन); relating to a former state of existence, resulting from acts done in a former life. —प्राक्तन-कर्मन्, अ, n. any act formerly done or done in a former state of existence; fate, destiny. —प्राक्तन-जन्मन्, अ, n. a former birth.
प्राक्तस्: प्राक्तस् or प्राक्तात्, ind., Ved. from the front, from the east.
प्रागिवीय: प्रागिवीय (fr. प्राग् इव), see Pāṇ. V. 3, 70.
प्राग्दिशीय: प्राग्दिशीय (fr. प्राग् दिशः), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. V. 3, 2.
प्राग्दीव्यतीय: प्राग्दीव्यतीय (fr. प्राग् दीव्यतः), see Pāṇ. IV. 1, 83.
प्राग्धितीय: प्राग्धितीय, a wrong reading for प्राग्घितीय।
प्राचा: प्राचा, ind. See p. 653, col. 3, and p. 654, col. 1.
प्राचिका: प्राचिका, f. a musquito; a female falcon.
प्राचैस्: प्राचैस्, ind., Ved. forwards; [cf. उच्चैस्, नीचैस्, पराचैस्।]
प्राच्यक: प्राच्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, situated in the east, eastern, easterly.
प्राच्यायन: प्राच्यायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Prācya.
प्राञ्ज्: प्राञ्ज् प्राञ्ज् (प्र-अञ्ज्), cl. 7. P. प्राणक्ति, प्राञ्जितुम्, प्राङ्क्तुम्, Ved. (?), to adorn, deco-rate, embellish, beautify.
प्राञ्जन: प्राञ्जन, अम्, n., Ved. paint or cement (on an arrow).
प्राञ्जल: प्राञ्जल प्राञ्जल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + अञ्-जलि?), straight; honest, upright, sincere. —प्राञ्जल-ता, f. straightness; honesty.
प्राञ्जलि: प्राञ्जलि प्राञ्जलि (प्र-अञ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, hold-ing out the open hands slightly hollowed and placed side by side (as if to hold an offering; a common mark of respect and salutation, cf. अञ्जलि, कृताञ्-जलि); joining the palms of the hands in a suppli-cating manner (Manu II. 192). —प्राञ्जलि-द्वैत-भृत्, तस्, m. pl., N. of a school.
प्राडाहति: प्राडाहति प्राडाहति, इस्, m. a patronymic; see Gaṇa Taulvalyādi to Pāṇ. II. 4, 61.
प्राण्: प्राण् 1. प्राण् or प्रान् (प्र-अण् or प्र-अन्), cl. 2. P. प्राणिति (according to Vopa-deva IX. 27, also प्रानिति), &c., to breathe in; inhale, inspire; to blow (as the wind, Ved.); to live; to smell (intrans.): Caus. P. A. प्राणयति, -ते, Aor. प्राणिणत्, to cause to breathe, give life to, animate: Desid. प्राणिणिषति।
2. प्राण् (प्र-अण्), ण्, ण्, ण्, breathing (?); see Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 20.
प्राणक: प्राणक, अस्, m. a living being, an animal or sentient being; a species of plant (= जीवक); myrrh; cloth, clothes (?).
प्राणत्: प्राणत्, अन्, अती, अत्, breathing, living.
प्राणथ: प्राणथ, अस्, m. breathing; air, wind; the lord of all created beings (= प्रजा-पति); a sacred bathing-place; (अस्, आ, अम्), strong, powerful.
प्राणन: प्राणन, अस्, m. the throat; (अम्), n. the act of breathing, respiration; living, life; producing life, calling into life; (अस्, आ, अम्), giving life to, pro-ducing life. —प्राणनान्त (°न-अन्°), अस्, m. the end of life.
प्राणन्त: प्राणन्त, अस्, m. air, wind; a kind of collyrium, = रसाञ्जन; (ई), f. sneezing; sobbing.
प्राणयत्: प्राणयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, restoring to life, resusci-tating, reanimating.
प्राणायन: 2. प्राणायन, अस्, m., Ved. the offspring of the vital airs (in Vājasaneyi-Saṃhitā XIII. 54; according to Mahī-dhara प्राणायन = प्राणस्यापत्य).
प्राणिणिषु: प्राणिणिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (see Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 21), wishing to breathe or live, wishing for life.
प्राणित: प्राणित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to breathe, kept alive, animated, longing to do (anything).
प्राणिन्: प्राणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, breathing, living, alive; (ई), m. a living or sentient being, living creature, animal; a man. —प्राणि-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, killing living beings. —प्राणि-जात, अम्, n. a class or species of animals. —प्राणि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of a living being, sentient existence, life. —प्राणि-द्यूत, अम्, n. gambling with fighting animals, setting animals to fight for wagers, a fight of animals exhibited for sport, cock-fighting, ram-fighting, &c. —प्राणि-पीडा, f. giving pain to sentient beings, cruelty to animals. —प्राणि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of or peopled with living beings. —प्राणि-मातृ, ता, f. the mother of a living being; a kind of shrub (= गर्भ-दात्री)। —प्राणि-योधन, अम्, n. setting animals to fight (= प्राणि-द्यूत above). —प्राणि-हिंसा, f. doing harm to any living creature, injuring or killing an animal. —प्राणि-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, favourable or good for living beings; (आ), f. a shoe, a boot, (in this sense probably for प्राणहिता, q. v.) —प्राण्य्-अङ्ग, अम्, n. a part or limb of an animal or man, any animal product (as flesh, bone, milk, ghee, &c.).
प्राणतज: प्राणतज प्राणतज, आस्, m. pl. (with Jainas) N. of a subdivision of the Kalpa-bhavas.
प्राणहिता: प्राणहिता प्राणहिता, f. a shoe, a boot; [cf. प्राणि-हिता; both are probably corruptions.]
प्राणाय्य: प्राणाय्य प्राणाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, proper, fit, suited.
प्राणावाय: प्राणावाय प्राणावाय, अम्, n., N. of the twelfth of the fourteen Pūrvas or ancient writings of the Jainas.
प्राणाह: प्राणाह प्राणाह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. नह् with प्रा), Ved. cement (used in building).
प्राणीत्य: प्राणीत्य प्राणीत्य, अम्, n. (probably incor-rect for प्रामीत्य), debt.
प्रातर्: प्रातर् प्रातर्, ind. (fr. 1. प्र), early in the morning, at day-break, at dawn [cf. अभि-प्°]; on the next morning, to-morrow morning, early on the morrow, to-morrow; Morning personified as a son of Puṣpārṇa and Prabhā; प्रातः प्रातः, every morning; [cf. Gr. πρωΐ; Old Germ. fro, fruo; Mod. Germ. frühe.] —प्रातः-कर्मन्, अ, or प्रातः-कार्य, अम्, n. morning business, a morning ceremony; [cf. प्रातः-कृत्य below.] —प्रातः-काल, अस्, m. morning-time, the early time of day, early morning, first break of day. —प्रातः-कृत्य, अम्, n. matutinal duty, morning ceremonies, a reli-gious duty performed in the morning (as worship, ablution, purification, &c.). —प्रातः-प्रहर, अस्, m. the morning watch, the first part of the day (from six to nine o'clock); प्रातः-प्रहरे गते, the morning watch being past, at nine o'clock in the morning. —प्रातः-सन्ध्या, f. morning twi-light, dawn, the morning devotions of a Brāhman; morning sacrifice. —प्रातः-समय, अस्, m. the morning-time, early morning, day-break. —प्रातः-सव, अस्, m. or प्रातः-सवन, अम्, n. the morning libation of Soma (accompanied with ten ceremonial observances, viz. the प्रातर्-अनुवाक, अभि-षव, बहिष्-पवमान-स्तोत्र, सवनीयाः पशवः, धिष्ण्य्-उपस्थान, सवनीयाः पुरोडाशाः, द्वि-देवत्य-ग्रहाः, द्वि-देवत्य-भक्ष, ऋतु-या-जाः, आज्य or प्रüग शस्त्र). —प्रातःसवनिक or प्रातःसवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging or relating to the morning libation of Soma. —प्रा-तः-साव, अस्, m., Ved. the morning preparation of Soma, morning libation. —प्रातः-स्नान, अम्, n. bathing at sun-rise, morning ablution. —प्रातः-स्नायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bathing early in the morning. —प्रातर्-अनुवाक, अस्, m., Ved. ‘morning recita-tion,’ the hymn recited at the commencement of the Prātaḥ-savana. —प्रातर्-अभिवाद, अस्, m., Ved. morning salutation. —प्रातर्-अह्न, अस्, m. the early part of the day, forenoon; N. of a man. —प्रातर्-आश, अस्, m. the morning meal, breakfast, (अ-प्रातराश, not breakfasting.) —प्रातराशित, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has had the morning meal, one who has breakfasted. —प्रातर्-आहुति, इस्, f., Ved. the morning oblation, the second half of the daily Agni-hotra sacrifice. —प्रातर्-इत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. going out early in the morning; coming at day-break, an early guest (Sāy. = प्रातर् आगतः). —प्रातर्-गेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sung or chanted in the morning; (अस्), m. a minstrel employed to wake the king in the morning. —प्रातर्-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. victorious at day-break; conquering the morning. —प्रातर्-दिन, अम्, n. the early part of the day, forenoon. —प्रातर्-दुग्ध, अम्, n., Ved. morning milk. —प्रातर्-दोह, अस्, m. milking in the morn-ing, morning milk. —प्रातर्-भोक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who makes an early meal; (ता), m. a crow. —प्रातर्-भोजन, अम्, n. the morning meal, breakfast. —प्रातर्-यावन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. going out early in the morning, an early guest [cf. प्रातर्-इत्वन्]; (आणा), m. du. an epithet of the Aśvins (Sāy. = प्रातर् एव यज्ञ-गन्तारौ). —प्रातर्-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. yoked or harnessed early in the morning. —प्रातर्-युज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. yoking or harnessing early in the morning; yoked or harnessed early in the morning (said of a chariot, Sāy. = प्रातः-काले ऽश्वैर् युज्यमानः); (जा), m. du. an epithet of the Aśvins (Sāy. = प्रातः-सवन-ग्र-हेण संयुक्तौ). —प्रातर्-वस्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. shining in the morning; [cf. दोषा-वस्तृ।] —प्रातर्-होम, अस्, m. the morning sacrifice. —प्रातस्-तराम्, ind. very early in the morn-ing. —प्रातस्-त्रिवर्गा, f. an epithet of the river Gaṅgā (Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 1846).
प्रातस्तन: प्रातस्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the morning, matutinal; (अम्), n., Ved. early morning (the first of five parts of the day, the other four being सङ्-गव or morning, midday, afternoon, and evening).
प्रातस्त्य: प्रातस्त्य, अस्, &c., belonging or relating to the morning, matutinal.
प्रातर: प्रातर प्रातर, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga; (in Gaṇa Kṛśāsvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80, a various reading for प्रतर।)
प्रातर्दन: प्रातर्दन प्रातर्दन, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to or derived from Pra-tardana.
प्रातिकण्ठिक: प्रातिकण्ठिक प्रातिकण्ठिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-कण्ठम्), seizing by the throat (?).
प्रातिका: प्रातिका प्रातिका, f. the China rose, Hibis-cus Rosa Sinensis (= जवा).
प्रातिकामिन्: प्रातिकामिन् प्रातिकामिन्, ई, m. (fr. प्रति-कामम्), a servant, a messenger.
प्रातिकूलिक: प्रातिकूलिक प्रातिकूलिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-कूल), opposed to, opposing.
प्रातिकूल्य: प्रातिकूल्य, अम्, n. contrariety, adverseness, con-tradiction, hinderance, opposition, resistance, hostility, unfriendliness, unpleasantness.
प्रातिजनीन: प्रातिजनीन प्रातिजनीन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-जन), suitable against an adversary.
प्रातिज्ञ: प्रातिज्ञ प्रातिज्ञ, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-ज्ञा), the subject under discussion.
प्रातिथेयी: प्रातिथेयी प्रातिथेयी, f. (fr. प्र-तिथि), N. of a female sage; (also read प्रातीथेयी।)
प्रातिदैवसिक: प्रातिदैवसिक प्रातिदैवसिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-दिवसम्), happening or occurring daily.
प्रातिनिधिक: प्रातिनिधिक प्रातिनिधिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-निधि), Ved. a substitute, proxy.
प्रातिपक्ष: प्रातिपक्ष प्रातिपक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-पक्ष), belonging to an enemy, hostile; adverse, contrary.
प्रातिपक्ष्य: प्रातिपक्ष्य, अम्, n. hostility, enmity; अस्मा-कम् प्रातिपक्ष्यम्, enmity against us.
प्रातिपथिक: प्रातिपथिक प्रातिपथिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-तिपथिक), going along a road or path.
प्रातिपद: प्रातिपद प्रातिपद, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. प्रति-पद्), forming the beginning or commencement; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
प्रातिपदिक: प्रातिपदिक, अम्, n. the crude form or base of a noun, a crude word or noun as formed by either Kṛt or Taddhita affix before receiving a case-termination, a noun in its uninflected state, (when the case-termina-tion is added, the प्रातिपदिक becomes a पद or real word); (अस्), m. an epithet of fire; (अस्, ई, अम्), in express terms, express, explicit; [cf. प्रति-प-दम्।] —प्रातिपदिकानुरोध (°क-अन्°), अस्, m. conformity with the words or express terms of any statement; (आत्), ind. in conformity with express terms, expressly.
प्रातिपीय: प्रातिपीय प्रातिपीय or प्रातिपेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Balhika.
प्रातिपौरुषिक: प्रातिपौरुषिक प्रातिपौरुषिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति + पौरुष), relating or belonging to manliness or valour.
प्रातिबोध: प्रातिबोध प्रातिबोध, अस्, m. a patronymic from Prati-bodha; see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 104.
प्रातिबोधायन: प्रातिबोधायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Prati-bodha; see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 1. 100.
प्रातिभ: प्रातिभ प्रातिभ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-भा), belonging or relating to divination; (अम्), n., scil. ज्ञान, divination; quick apprehension or conception.
प्रातिभाव्य: प्रातिभाव्य प्रातिभाव्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-भू), the act of becoming bail or surety, suretiship, being answerable for the appearance of the debtor or for his being trustworthy or for the payment of his debt in case of his failing to do it.
प्रातिभासिक: प्रातिभासिक प्रातिभासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-भास), having only the appearance of, exist-ing only in appearance; bearing a resemblance, re-sembling, looking like.
प्रातिरूप्य: प्रातिरूप्य प्रातिरूप्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-रूप), similarity of form, &c.
प्रातिलोमिक: प्रातिलोमिक प्रातिलोमिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-लोम), against the hair or the grain, contrary to natural course or order, hostile, disagreeable.
प्रातिलोम्य: प्रातिलोम्य, अम्, n. contrary direction, contrariety, inverted order, inversion, the being at variance with the natural or established order of things, reverse-ness; opposition, hostility, hostile feeling; (आत्), ind. out of opposition to.
प्रातिवेशिक: प्रातिवेशिक प्रातिवेशिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-वेश), a neighbour.
प्रातिवेश्मक: प्रातिवेश्मक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-वेश्मन्), be-longing to a neighbour's house, neighbouring; (अस्), m. a neighbour.
प्रातिवेश्य: प्रातिवेश्य, अस्, m. a neighbour who lives opposite, a next-door neighbour, (according to Kullūka = नि-रन्तर-गृह-वासिन्); a neighbour in general.
प्रातिशाख्य: प्रातिशाख्य प्रातिशाख्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-शाखम्), a grammatical treatise on the rules regu-lating the euphonic combination of letters and their pronunciation peculiar to one of the different Śākhās or branches of the Vedas, i. e. to one of those versions of the Vedic texts handed down in different families in different parts of India, (the Prātiśākhyas do not undo words in the same way as the Vyākaraṇa, but take actually formed words as they occur in the hymns and teach the phonetic changes they undergo, the mode of pronouncing the accents, &c.; there exist four Prātiśākhyas, 1. a Prātiśākhya to the Śākala-śākhā of the Ṛg-veda, called Śākala-prāti-śākhya and ascribed to Śaunaka; 2. to a Śākhā of the Taittirīya or Black Yajur-veda; 3. to a Śākhā of the Mādhyandinas who belong to the family of the Vājasaneyins or authors of the White Yajur-veda, whence this is called the Vājasaneyi-prātiśākhya, it is attributed to Kātyāyana; 4. an Atharva-veda-prā-tiśākhya, called Śaunakīyā Caturādhyāyikā; but no Prātiśākhya has yet been found to the Sāma-veda.) —प्रातिशाख्य-कृत्, त्, m. the author of a Prātiśā-khya. —प्रातिशाख्य-भाष्य, अम्, n., N. of a com-mentary by Ūaṭa on the Ṛg-veda-prātiśākhya.
प्रातिश्रुत्क: प्रातिश्रुत्क प्रातिश्रुत्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-श्रुत्), Ved. existing in the echo.
प्रातिस्विक: प्रातिस्विक प्रातिस्विक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-स्व), own, peculiar, proper, not common to others; granting to every one his own due.
प्रातिहत: प्रातिहत प्रातिहत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रति-हत), epithet of a particular Svarita (= तैरोवि-राम, q. v.).
प्रातिहन्त्र: प्रातिहन्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-हन्तृ), the state or condition of a revenger; vengeance.
प्रातिहर्त्र: प्रातिहर्त्र प्रातिहर्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. प्रति-हर्तृ, rt. हृ with प्रति), the office or duty of the Prati-hartṛ, q. v.
प्रातिहार: प्रातिहार, अस्, m. (fr. प्रति-हार), a juggler.
प्रातिहारिक: प्रातिहारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, containing Prati-hāras (as a Vedic hymn); (अस्), m. a juggler, conjurer.
प्रातिहार्य: प्रातिहार्य, अम्, n. juggling, conjuring, legerde-main; working miracles; a miracle, miraculous phe-nomenon.
प्रातीतिक: प्रातीतिक प्रातीतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रतीति), existing in the mind or imagination, mental.
प्रातीथेयी: प्रातीथेयी प्रातीथेयी, a various reading for प्रातिथेयी, q. v.
प्रातीप: प्रातीप प्रातीप, अस्, m. (fr. प्रतीप), a patronymic of Śāntanu.
प्रातीपिक: प्रातीपिक, अस्, ई, अम्, contrary, reverse, retrograde.
प्रातृद: प्रातृद प्रातृद, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-tṛd.
प्रात्यक्ष: प्रात्यक्ष प्रात्यक्ष or प्रात्यक्षिक, अस्, ई, अम्, perceptible to the eyes, &c. (= प्रत्यक्ष, q. v.).
प्रात्यग्रथि: प्रात्यग्रथि प्रात्यग्रथि, इस्, m. a patro-nymic from Pratyag-ratha.
प्रात्यन्तिक: प्रात्यन्तिक प्रात्यन्तिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्रत्य्-अन्त), a prince of the Pratyantas; a lord of the marches, keeper of the borders (?).
प्रात्ययिक: प्रात्ययिक प्रात्ययिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रत्य्-अय), relating to or attended with confidence or trust, confidential, trusty, having faith in; (अस्), m., scil. प्रति-भू, a surety for the trustworthiness of a debtor.
प्रात्यवेक्षा: प्रात्यवेक्षा प्रात्यवेक्षा, wrongly for प्रत्य्-अवेक्षा, q. v.
प्रात्यहिक: प्रात्यहिक प्रात्यहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रत्य्-अहम्), occurring or happening every day, daily.

प्रादक्षिण्य: प्रादक्षिण्य प्रादक्षिण्य, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-दक्षिण), keeping the right side towards anything while moving round it, circumambulation by starting from the left and coming round to the right (by way of reverence).
प्रादा: प्रादा प्रा-दा (प्र-आ-), cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, -दातुम्, to give, bestow.
प्रादाय: प्रादाय, ind. having given or bestowed.
प्रादित्य: प्रादित्य प्रादित्य (प्र-आद्°), अस्, m., N. of two princes.
प्रादुराक्षि: प्रादुराक्षि प्रादुराक्षि, इस्, m. a patronymic; (perhaps an incorrect form for प्रादुर्-अक्षि।)
प्रादुस्: प्रादुस् प्रादुस्, ind. (perhaps fr. प्रा for 1. प्र + 1. दुर्, i. e. before or outside the door, in open daylight; said to be fr. rt. अद् with प्र; accord-ing to Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 41, the final स् is changed into ष् before क् and प्; and according to Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 87, the radical स् of rt. 1. अस्, ‘to be,’ is changed to ष् after प्रादुस् whenever in the conjugation of this rt. the initial अ is dropped, e. g. प्रादुः षन्ति, not प्रा-दुः सन्ति; प्रादुस् appears to occur only in con-nection with the rts. 1. अस्, 1. भू, and 1. कृ, except in the comp. प्रादुष्-पीतम् given as an example by the Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 41); apparently, evidently, manifestly, visibly, in sight. According to native lexicographers the senses in which प्रादुस् is used may be expressed by the following Sanskrit words, प्राकाश्य, नामन्, सम्-भाव्य, सम्-भव, प्र-वृत्ति, वृत्ति।
प्रादुरस्: प्रादुर्-अस् (see rt. 1. अस्), cl. 2. P. अस्ति, &c., to be apparent or evident, to be manifest; to appear, arise, exist.
प्रादुर्भू: प्रादुर्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become manifest, become visible; to appear, arise, come to light, exist; to become audible, be heard. —प्रादुर्-भाव, अस्, m. the becoming manifest or visible, arising, coming into existence, appearance, manifestation; the appearance of a deity on earth; the being evident; the becoming audible. —प्रादुर्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become manifest or evident, come to light, manifested, appeared, revealed.
प्रादुष्कृ: प्रादुष्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make visible or manifest, bring to light, reveal, disclose, exhibit, manifest. —प्रादुष्-करण, अम्, n. the making visible, bringing to light, manifesta-tion, production. —प्रादुष्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made visible, brought to light, manifested, displayed to view. —प्रादुष्कृत-वपुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, one whose form is manifested, appearing in a visible form (as a deity). —प्रादुष्-कृत्य, ind. having brought to light, having produced.
प्रादेश: प्रादेश प्रादेश, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-देश), the span of the thumb and forefinger, the space measured by the span of the thumb and forefinger; place, country (?). —प्रादेश-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, only a span long; प्रादेशमात्रम् भूमेः, a mere span of land.
प्रादेशन: प्रादेशन, अम्, n. = प्र-देशन, a gift, &c.
प्रादेशिक: प्रादेशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-देश), authorized by precedents or examples, precedented; significant, indicatory of the original meaning; local, limited, relating to a part; प्रादेशिको गुणः, the property of a word indicatory of its original or etymological meaning; (अस्), m. a small landed proprietor, the owner or chief of a district. —प्रादेशिकेश्वर (°क-ईश्°), अस्, m. the owner or chief of a district, a small landed proprietor, (opposed to सार्वभौम।)
प्रादेशिन्: प्रादेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. प्रादेश), a span long; (इनी), f. the forefinger, (in this sense probably an error for प्र-देशिनी।)
प्रादोष: प्रादोष प्रादोष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-दोष), belonging or relating to the evening, vespertine.
प्रादोहनि: प्रादोहनि प्रादोहनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-dohana.
प्राद्युम्नि: प्राद्युम्नि प्राद्युम्नि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-dyumna.
प्राद्योति: प्राद्योति प्राद्योति, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-dyota.
प्राद्रु: प्राद्रु प्रा-द्रु (प्र-आ-द्रु), cl. 1. P. -द्र-वति, -द्रोतुम्, to run away from, flee from; to escape to, escape.
प्राधनिक: प्राधनिक प्राधनिक, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-धन), an implement of war, a destructive weapon.
प्राधा: प्राधा प्राधा, f., N. of a daughter of Dakṣa and mother of several Apsarasas and Gan-dharvas; [cf. प्र-धा।]
प्राधेय: प्राधेय, अस्, ई, अम्, descended from Prādhā.
प्राधानिक: प्राधानिक प्राधानिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-धान), pre-eminent, most eminent or distinguished, best, most excellent, superior; predominant; derived from or relating to Pradhāna or primary matter (in the Sāṅkhya phil.).
प्राधान्य: प्राधान्य, अम्, n. predominance, preponder-ance, prevalence, ascendancy, pre-eminence, superi-ority, supremacy; the being the highest object; a principal cause; प्राधान्येन or प्राधान्यात् or प्राधान्य-तस्, ind. in regard to the highest object, with reference to the chief purpose; in the highest degree, chiefly, principally, especially. —प्राधान्य-स्तुति, इस्, इस्, इ, receiving especial praise, chiefly praised, especially celebrated.
प्राधीत: प्राधीत प्राधीत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. 5. इ with प्र-अधि), well-read, highly educated, learned (said of Brāhmans).
प्राध्ययन: प्राध्ययन, अम्, n. reciting, reading, studying.
प्राध्येषण: प्राध्येषण प्राध्य्-एषण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 3. इष् with प्र-अधि), Ved. incitement, exhortation (to study).
प्राध्व: प्राध्व प्राध्व (प्र-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, being on a road or journey, distant, remote, long, a long way off; bent, bowed, inclined; favourable, conform-able; (अस्), m. a car, carriage; (अम्), ind. favourably, conformably, agreeably; crookedly, in a contrary way (?). —प्राध्वं-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to make conformable, to bend conform-ably, to join together (as the hands) in token of good-will. —प्राध्वं-कृत्य, ind. making conformable.
प्राध्वन: प्राध्वन (प्र-अध्°), अस्, m., Ved. the bed of a river or stream.
प्राध्वंसन: प्राध्वंसन प्राध्वंसन, अस्, m. a patro-nymic from Pra-dhvaṃsana.
प्राध्वर: प्राध्वर प्राध्वर, अस्, ई, अम्, an epithet of a branch of a tree; (probably an incorrect form.)
प्रान्: प्रान् प्रान्। See 1. प्राण्, p. 654, col. 3.
प्रानाडी: प्रानाडी प्रानाडी, perhaps incorrectly for प्र-णाडी = प्र-णाली।
प्रान्त: प्रान्त प्रान्त (प्र-अन्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. edge, margin, verge, border, (ओष्ठ-प्रान्तौ, the corners of the mouth); boundary, bound, extremity, extreme verge, end [cf. यौवन-प्°]; back part; a point, tip (of a blade of grass); (अस्), m., N. of a man. —प्रान्त-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling near the boun-daries, living close by. —प्रान्त-तस्, ind. along the edge or border (of anything), marginally, along or upon the extremity. —प्रान्त-दुर्ग, अम्, n. ‘bor-der-stronghold,’ a suburb or collection of houses outside the walls of the town, a Petta or town con-tiguous to a fort and separately fortified. —प्रान्त-पुष्पा, f. a kind of plant (having flowers along the edge of the stem ?). —प्रान्त-विरस, अस्, आ, अम्, finally or ultimately insipid, tasteless in the end. —प्रान्त-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, inhabiting the borders.
प्रान्तायन: प्रान्तायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Prānta.
प्रान्तर: प्रान्तर प्रान्तर (प्र-अन्°), अम्, n. a long desolate road, a lonesome way or lane, a solitary path; an intervening long tract of country between two vil-lages; a forest; the hollow of a tree. —प्रान्तर-शून्-य, अम्, n. a long tiresome road (also प्रान्त-शून्य).
प्राप्: प्राप् 1. प्राप् (प्र-आप्), cl. 5. P. A. प्राप्-नोति, प्राप्नुते, प्राप्तुम्, to attain to, reach, arrive at; to extend, stretch; to come upon, light upon, meet with, find; to obtain, get, gain, win; to obtain as a husband or wife; to bring upon one's self, contract, incur (e. g. दण्डम् प्राप्, to incur a fine); to suffer, endure (e. g. वधम् प्राप्, to suffer capital punishment); to flee to (e. g. दिशः प्रापन्, they fled to the various quarters, i. e. they fled in all directions); to pass or be changed into (in gram.), to follow (a grammatical rule); to be present, be at hand (Ved.): Caus. प्रापयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to attain to, cause to reach or arrive at, cause to occupy; to lead to, bring to; to promote or advance to, appoint to (an office); to drive to; to cause to obtain or gain, cause to possess, give anything to any one (with two acc.); to tell, announce (Rāmāyaṇa VII. 103, 10): Desid. प्रेप्-सति, to try to attain or get at, strive to reach.
2. प्राप्, प्, प्, प्, (at the end of a comp.) obtaining.
प्राप: 1. प्राप, अस्, m. (for 2. see p. 658), arriving at, reaching, attaining, obtaining; [cf. दुष्-प्°।]
प्राप 2. प्राप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र + अप्), abounding with water, watery (?).
प्रापक: प्रापक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to arrive at, leading to (with gen.), conveying, bringing; causing to obtain, providing with, procuring; a procurer; establishing, making valid; obtaining, one who obtains.
प्रापण: प्रापण, अम्, n. attaining to, attainment, reach-ing, extending, (बाह्वोः प्रापणान्ते, as far as the arms reach); obtaining, receiving, acquisition; bring-ing to, leading to, conveying; procuring [cf. दुष्-प्रापण]; reference to.
प्रापणीय: प्रापणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attained to, to be reached, attainable; to be caused to attain, to be made to arrive at; to be provided with; to be pro-cured, procurable, obtainable.
प्रापित: प्रापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to attain to, made to arrive at; caused to occupy, placed upon; led or conducted to, brought to, conveyed; promoted or advanced to, appointed to; caused to obtain or gain, caused to possess; procured.
प्रापिन्: प्रापिन्, ई, इणी, इ, attaining to, reaching, coming to; obtaining, getting, gaining, receiving.
प्राप्त: प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attained to, reached, arrived at [cf. कर-प्°, हस्त-प्°]; come upon, lighted upon, met with, found; obtained, got, gained, acquired, procured, won; incurred, contracted; suf-fered, endured; one who has attained to or arrived at; arrived, come, present; come to a close, com-pleted, arrived at maturity; (in gram.) obtained from a rule, following from a rule, valid in conse-quence of a rule (e. g. इति प्राप्ते, because it so follows from a preceding rule); (in medicine) de-scribed (as a symptom); fixed, placed; proper, right; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people. —प्राप्त-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing what is fit or proper. —प्राप्त-काल, अस्, m. a time or moment arrived, a favourable moment, a fit time, proper season; (अस्, आ, अम्), one whose time has come (e. g. प्राप्त-कालो देही, a mortal whose time, i. e. whose last hour, is come); opportune, seasonable, suitable; arrived at maturity, marriageable; fated, destined; (अम्), ind. at the right time, opportunely. —प्राप्तकाल-त्व, अम्, n. the being a favourable moment, timeliness, season-ableness; (त्वात्), ind. because it is the proper season. —प्राप्त-जीवन, अस्, आ, अम्, restored to life. —प्राप्त-दोष, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has incurred guilt, one who has committed an offence. —प्राप्त-पञ्चत्व, अस्, आ, अम्, arrived at dissolution into the five elements, deceased, dead. —प्राप्त-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, possessed of understanding, enlightened, instructed, intelligent; regaining consciousness, be-coming conscious (after fainting), recovering. —प्राप्-त-भार, अस्, m. a draught-ox or beast of burden. —प्राप्त-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has attained to any state or condition, of a good disposition; (अस्), m. a young bullock, an ox, (? for प्राप्त-भार।) —प्राप्त-मनोरथ, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained his wish. —प्राप्त-यौवन, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has attained the age of puberty, being in the bloom of youth. —प्राप्त-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, of a proper form, fit, proper, suitable; handsome, pleas-ing, beautiful; learned, wise, educated. —प्राप्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has attained to or arrived at; one who has obtained or gained. —प्राप्त-वर, अस्, आ, अम्, fraught with blessings. —प्राप्त-व्यवहार, अस्, m. a young man come of age, an adult, one able to conduct his own affairs and respon-sible for his conduct. —प्राप्त-सूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having the sun (vertical). —प्राप्तानुज्ञ (°त-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has received permission to with-draw, allowed to depart. —प्राप्तापराध (°त-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has committed an offence, guilty of an offence. —प्राप्तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one whose object is attained, successful; (अस्), m. an object attained, an advantage gained. —प्राप्-तार्थाग्रहण (°थ-अग्°), अम्, n. the not securing of advantages gained. —प्राप्तावसर (°त-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, taking or finding occasion, opportune, seasonable; (अस्), m. a proper time, suitable occasion. —प्राप्तोदय (°त-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has attained exaltation, fortunate.
प्राप्तव्य: प्राप्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attained to, to be reached, attainable; to be met with or found; to be gained or obtained, obtainable, procurable; a fanciful name given to a man in the Pañca-tantra (who, whenever asked his name, replied प्राप्तव्यम् अर्-थं लभते मनुष्यः, a man takes anything that is to be got, see Pañca-tantra, p. 128. 17).
प्राप्ति: प्राप्ति, इस्, f. attaining to, attainment, reaching, arriving at, arrival, coming; coming or lighting upon, meeting with, finding; obtaining, getting, gaining, acquisition, profit, gain, advantage; reach, range; the power of obtaining everything, one of the eight superhuman faculties; obtaining by actions done in a former existence; discovering by percep-tion, guessing, conjecture; the being valid, holding good (of a rule); lot, share, portion, fortune, luck, good luck; (in dramatic language) happy denoue-ment, successful termination of a plot; (in astrology) N. of the eleventh lunar mansion (= आय, लाभ); Prāpti personified as wife of Śama (associated with Asti as a daughter of Jarā-sandha); a collection, assemblage, quantity. —प्राप्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has attained to or reached. —प्राप्ति-सम, अस्, m. a particular जाति (q. v.) in logic. —प्राप्त्य्-आशा, f. the hope of obtaining (an object).
प्राप्य: 1. प्राप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attained, to be arrived at, attainable, obtainable, acquirable, pro-curable [cf. सुख-प्°]; proper, fitting, suitable.
2. प्राप्य, ind. having attained to or arrived at; having come upon or met with; having obtained or gained; having incurred; having suffered or endured.
प्राप्यमाण: प्राप्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being attained to or ar-rived at; taking place (according to a rule in gram.).
प्रापणिक: प्रापणिक प्रापणिक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. पण् with प्र; according to Malli-nātha fr. प्र-पण), a trader, dealer, retail dealer; [cf. आपणिक।]
प्रापेय: प्रापेय प्रापेय for प्राधेय, q. v.
प्राबन्ध: प्राबन्ध प्राबन्ध in केसर-प्राबन्धा, q. v.
प्राबल्य: प्राबल्य प्राबल्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-बल), superiority of force, superior force, predominance, as-cendancy; powerfulness, power, vigour, might, force.
प्राबालिक: प्राबालिक प्राबालिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-बाल), a vender of coral, coral merchant.
प्राबोधक: प्राबोधक प्राबोधक, अस्, m. (= प्र-बो-धक), a minstrel employed to wake the king in the morning; (a various reading for प्राबोधिक।)
प्राबोधिक: प्राबोधिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-बोध), dawn, day-break.
प्राभञ्जन: प्राभञ्जन प्राभञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-भञ्जन), presided over by the god of wind; (अम्), n., scil. नक्षत्र or भ, the Nakṣatra Svāti.
प्राभव: प्राभव प्राभव, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भु), pre-eminence, superiority, supremacy.
प्राभवत्य: प्राभवत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भवत्), superi-ority, power, authority, ascendancy.
प्राभूतिक: प्राभूतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-भूत), see Vārttika II. to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 1.
प्राभाकर: प्राभाकर प्राभाकर, अस्, m. (fr. प्रभा-कर), a follower of Prabhā-kara, the designation of a particular philosophical sect (a branch of the Mīmāṃsā school).
प्राभातिक: प्राभातिक प्राभातिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-भात), belonging or relating to the morning, matu-tinal.
प्राभासिक: प्राभासिक प्राभासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the place Pra-bhāsa, q. v.
प्राभृत: प्राभृत प्राभृत, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-भृति), a present, gift, offering of ceremony; an offering to a deity or sovereign; a bribe; a term applied to the chapters of the Sūrya-prajñapti. —प्राभृती-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, given as a present, offered.
प्राभृतक: प्राभृतक, अम्, n. a present, an offering.
प्रामति: प्रामति प्रामति, इस्, m., N. of one of the seven sages in the tenth Manv-antara; (also read प्राप्तति; cf. प्र-मति।)
प्रामाणिक: प्रामाणिक प्रामाणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-माण), forming or being a measure; established by proof, resting or founded on an authority, pro-ceeding from evidence or authority, being of authority, authoritative; authentic, credible; true; (अस्), m. one who accepts proof or rests his arguments on authority; a president, the chief or head of a trade. —प्रामाणिक-त्व, अम्, n. = प्रामाण्य below.
प्रामाण्य: प्रामाण्य, अम्, n. the being established by proof, the resting upon authority; the being an authority; the being a rule, the being a proof; proof, evidence, authority; authenticity, credibility, genuineness (= प्रमाण-ता). —प्रामाण्य-वाद, अस्, m., N. of a Nyāya work by Raghu-nātha. —प्रामाण्य-वादिन्, ई, m. one who affirms or believes in proof.
प्रामादिक: प्रामादिक प्रामादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-माद), arising from carelessness or negligence, blundering, faulty, erroneous, incorrect, wrong; प्रा-मादिकः पाठः, a wrong reading. —प्रामादिक-त्व, अम्, n. erroneousness, incorrectness.
प्रामाद्य: प्रामाद्य, अस्, m. a species of plant, Gendarussa (= अटरूष) Adhadota or Vulgaris; (अम्), n. madness, frenzy, fury; intoxication.
प्रामोदक: प्रामोदक प्रामोदक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-मोद), charming, transporting, enchanting.
प्राय: प्राय प्राय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 5. इ with प्र), setting out or starting (for a battle, Ved.; Sāy. = प्र-वेश, entering, or = युद्ध, battle); going away, departure, departure from life, seeking death by fasting, sitting down and fasting to death (as a religious or penitentiary act, or, like the practice of sitting in Dharnā, to enforce compliance with a de-mand; often used in connection with rt. 4. आस् or with उप-विश्, e. g. प्रायम् आस्महे, we sit down seeking death by fasting; but in such examples प्रायम् may perhaps be regarded as the indeclinable participle of rt. 5. इ with प्र; cf. प्रयोपवेश); principal part, largest portion, plurality, majority, majority of cases, general rule, abundance, plenty, excess, (when used at the end of adj. comps. often translatable by ‘in most cases,’ ‘for the most part,’ ‘as a general rule,’ ‘generally,’ ‘well nigh,’ ‘almost,’ ‘nearly,’ e. g. दण्ड-प्°, one who generally inflicts punishment; जित-प्°, almost conquered; cf. आर्य-प्°, गत-प्°, दुःख-प्°, संस्तुत-प्°, सिद्ध-प्°: or translatable by ‘abounding in,’ ‘much,’ ‘exceed-ing,’ ‘abundant,’ e. g. शालि-प्°, abounding in rice; cf. हिंसा-प्°: or by ‘like,’ ‘resembling,’ e. g. अमृत-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, like nectar); a stage or condition of life (as youth, age, &c.); (अम्), n. sin (?); प्रा-येण, ind. for the most part, in most cases, mostly, commonly, as a rule; in all probability, probably, likely; much more, much rather. —प्राय-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, near departure from life, nigh unto death. —प्राय-चित्त, प्राय-चित्ति, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 1, 157, and cf. प्रायश्-चित्त, &c. —प्राय-दर्शन, अम्, n. a common or ordinary pheno-menon. —प्राय-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, being com-monly the case, usually met with. —प्राय-विधा-यिन्, ई, इनी, इ, resolved to die of starvation. —प्रा-यश्-चित्त, अम्, n. (प्राय + चित्त with श् euphonically inserted), an expiation, expiatory act, atonement, penance, satisfaction, compensation, indemnification, amends; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to or included in an expiation or atonement, expiatory. —प्रायश्चित्त-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a work by Raghu-nandana. —प्रायश्चित्त-दीपिका, f., N. of a work on ritual by Vara-da. —प्रायश्चित्त-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a work by Kāma-deva. —प्रायश्चित्त-रत्न, अम्, n., N. of a work by Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa. —प्रायश्-चित्त-विधि, इस्, m. a prescribed rule of penance or expiation. —प्रायश्चित्त-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a work by Śūla-pāṇi on expiatory ceremonies. —प्रा-यश्-चित्ति, इस्, इस्, इ (प्राय + चित्ति with श् euphoni-cally inserted), expiating, atoning; (इस्), f. expiation, atonement, penance. —प्रायश्चित्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, expiating, expiatory, performing penance (?); expi-able. —प्रायश्चित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who does penance or has to make expiation. —प्रायश्चित्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, making atonement, expiating, performing penance. —१। प्रायश्चित्तीय, Nom. A. प्रायश्चित्तीयते, -यितुम्, to have to expiate, to be obliged to perform penance. —२। प्रायश्चित्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to expiation or penance, expia-tory. —प्रायश्चित्तीय-ता, f. obligation to make an atonement. —प्रायश्चित्तेन्दु-शेखर (°त-इन्°), अस्, m., N. of a work by Kāśī-nātha on expiatory ceremonies. —प्रायोपगमन (°य-उप्°), अम्, n. going to meet death, seeking death (by abstaining from food). —प्रायोपविष्ट (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, or प्रायोपवेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who sits down in expectation of death, one who calmly awaits the approach of death (by abstaining from food), one who sits in Dharnā to compel compliance with a demand; [cf. प्रायोपवेश।] —प्रायोप-वेश (°य-उप्°), अस्, m. or प्रायोपवेशन, अम्, n. or प्रायोपवेशनिका, f. abstaining from food and awaiting in a sitting posture the approach of death, (this corresponds with the practice prevalent in some parts of India of sitting in Dharnā at the door of a house to extort a boon or gain a point which cannot be accomplished by other means; the person so sitting observes a strict fast till his object is obtained, and if he dies in the process the sin falls on the householder who refuses compliance with his de-mand.) —प्रायोपेत (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, prepared to die, resolved to die (by abstaining from food).
प्रायण: प्रायण, अस्, आ, अम्, going away, going, going well (Ved.); (अम्), n. entrance, beginning, com-mencement; the course or path of life; going for protection, taking refuge; departure from life, death, voluntary death, (प्रायणं कृ, to court death); a kind of food prepared with milk. —प्रायणान्त (°ण-अन्°), अस्, m. the end of life; (अम्), ind. till death, unto death.
प्रायणीय: प्रायणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to the entrance or commencement, introductory, ini-tiatory; (अस्), m., scil. याग or कर्म-विशेष, an introductory libation at a Soma sacrifice; scil. अति-रात्र, the first day of a Soma sacrifice lasting for several days; (अम्), n., scil. अहन्, the first day of a Soma sacrifice lasting for several days.
प्रायशस्: प्राय-शस्, ind. for the most part, mostly, almost, in all probability, always, commonly, generally, usually; (sometimes wrongly spelt प्राय-सस्।)
प्रायस्: प्रायस्, ind. for the most part, mostly; commonly, usually, frequently, oftentimes, generally, nearly; in all probability, most likely, abundantly, largely. —प्रायो-देवता, f. the most usually worshipped deity.
प्रायिक: प्रायिक, अस्, आ, अम्, common, usual, general. —प्रायिक-त्व, अम्, n. likelihood, probability; usage, custom.
प्रायत्य: प्रायत्य प्रायत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-यत), purity, cleanliness.
प्रायाणिक: प्रायाणिक प्रायाणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-याण), necessary for a march, suitable for a journey.
प्रायात्रिक: प्रायात्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-यात्रा), = प्रा-याणिक।
प्रायास: प्रायास प्रा-यास, अस्, m., Ved. another form for प्र-यास, q. v.
प्रायुद्धेषिन्: प्रायुद्धेषिन् प्रायुद्धेषिन्, ई, m. a horse, (probably an incorrect form; also spelt प्रायुधे-षिन्; cf. rt. हेष्, to neigh.)
प्रायुध्: प्रायुध् प्रा-युध् (प्र-आ-), cl. 4. A. -युध्-यते, -योद्धुम्, to fight.
प्रायेण: प्रायेण प्रायेण। See under प्राय, p. 658.
प्रायोग: प्रायोग प्रायोग, अस्, m., Ved. perhaps a wrong reading for प्र-योग, q. v.
प्रायोगिक: प्रायोगिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-योग), applied, used, applicable; a kind of sternutatory.
प्रायोज्य: प्रायोज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र-योज्य), belonging or relating to things requisite or necessary.
प्रार्: प्रार् प्रार् (प्र-ऋ), cl. 3. P. प्रेयर्ति, &c., Ved. to go forth, go, move; to set in motion, pro-duce: Caus. प्रार्पयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion, stir up, animate.
प्रार्पण: प्रार्पण, अस्, m., Ved. one who stirs up or animates.
प्रार्पण प्रार्पण। See under प्रार्, col. 1.
प्रारभ्: प्रारभ् प्रा-रभ् (प्र-आ-), cl. 1. A. -रभते, -रब्धुम्, to begin, commence, undertake.
प्रारब्ध: प्रा-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, begun, commenced, beginning; (अम्), n. an undertaking.
प्रारब्धि: प्रा-रब्धि, इस्, f. beginning, commencement; the post to which an elephant is fastened.
प्रारम्भ: प्रा-रम्भ, अस्, m. beginning, commencement; an undertaking, enterprise.
प्रारुह्: प्रारुह् प्रा-रुह् (प्र-आ-), cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्, to ascend, rise.
प्रारोह: प्रारोह, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-रोह), one who is used to rise or ascend; (अस्), m. a shoot, sprout, a new branch or leaf (= प्र-रोह).
प्रार्क्षीय: प्रार्क्षीय प्रार्क्षीय (fr. प्र + ऋक्ष), Nom. P. प्रार्क्षीयति = प्रर्क्षीयति, q. v.
प्रार्च्: प्रार्च् प्रार्च् (प्र-अर्च्), cl. 1. P. प्रार्चति, प्रार्चितुम्, to praise, celebrate in hymns (Sāy. = स्तुति-रूपाभिर् वाग्भिः पूज्); to honour, worship: Caus. प्रार्चयति, -यितुम्, to praise, honour.
प्रार्ज्: प्रार्ज् प्रार्ज् (प्र-अर्ज्), Caus. P. प्रार्जयति, यितुम्, to cause to acquire; to grant, bestow.
प्रार्जयितृ: प्रार्जयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who grants or bestows; (used to explain पर्जन्य, Nirukta X. 10.)
प्रार्जुन: प्रार्जुन प्रार्जुन (प्र-अर्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
प्रार्ण: प्रार्ण प्रार्ण (प्र-ऋण), अम्, n. a chief or principal debt.
प्रार्थ्: प्रार्थ् प्रार्थ् (प्र-अर्थ्), cl. 10. A. (rarely also P. and according to some grammarians regarded as a Nom. fr. अर्थ with प्र), प्रार्थयते (-ति), -यितुम्, to wish for, desire, require, want; to ask for, beg for, pray for, request, solicit, ask any one for anything (with two acc.); to wish or want to do anything (with inf.); to pray, prefer a suit or peti-tion, make a request.
प्रार्थ: प्रार्थ (प्र-अर्°), अस्, m., Ved. (perhaps) fur-niture, gear, harness, apparatus, equipment.
प्रार्थक: प्रार्थक, अस्, इका, अम्, wishing for, asking, desiring, soliciting, begging, an asker, solicitor; a suitor, petitioner, candidate; अ-प्रार्थक-वर, a bridegroom who has not been a suitor [cf. Kullūka on Manu III. 27].
प्रार्थन: प्रार्थन, अम्, आ, n. f. desire, wish; longing desire for; requesting, asking, begging; supplication, suit; prayer, entreaty, request, application, petition (the object may be expressed by the loc., e. g. रुक्-मिण्याम् अस्य प्रार्थना, his petition or suit for Rukmiṇī; or precedes प्रार्थन in a comp., cf. अनुज्ञा-प्°); प्रार्थनया, ind. at the request or petition of (any one). —प्रार्थना-भङ्ग, अस्, m. refusal of a request, asking in vain. —प्रार्थना-भाव (°न-अभ्°), अस्, m. absence of solicitation. —प्रार्थना-सिद्धि, इस्, f. accomplishment of a desire, fulfilment of wishes.
प्रार्थनीय: प्रार्थनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or wished for; to be asked or begged; to be prayed for; worthy of desire, desirable, proper to be solicited; (अम्), n. the third or Dvāpara age of the world.
प्रार्थयितव्य: प्रार्थयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or wished for, worthy of desire, desirable; असुलभ-प्रार्थयितव्य, one the object of whose desire is difficult of attainment.
प्रार्थयितृ: प्रार्थयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who wishes for or asks or solicits, an asker, inquirer, solicitor, impor-tuner, beggar; a lover, wooer, suitor.
प्रार्थित: प्रार्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished for, desired, wished, required, wanted; requested, solicited, asked for, prayed for; killed, hurt; obstructed or opposed by an enemy; attacked. —प्रार्थित-दुर्लभ, अस्, आ, अम्, desired but hard to obtain. —प्रार्थित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has asked or begged; asking, begging.
प्रार्थिन्: प्रार्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wishing, desiring, desirous of, ambitious for; attacking, assailing, assaulting.
प्रार्थ्य: प्रार्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or wished for by any one (inst. or gen.); desirable; to be suppli-cated, implored, petitioned, &c.
प्रार्द्: प्रार्द् प्रार्द् (प्र-अर्द्), Caus. P. प्रार्दयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to exert beyond measure, overwork; to cause to flow away.
प्रार्दक: प्रार्दक, अस्, इका, अम्, making efforts.
प्रार्ध: प्रार्ध प्रार्ध (प्र-अर्°) in परि-प्रार्ध, q. v.
प्रार्ष्: प्रार्ष् प्रार्ष् (प्र-ऋष्), cl. 1. P. प्रार्षति, प्रार्षितुम्, to flow forth.
प्रार्षभीय: प्रार्षभीय प्रार्षभीय (fr. प्र + ऋषभ), Nom. P. प्रार्षभीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रर्षभीय, q. v.
प्रार्ह्: प्रार्ह् प्रार्ह् (प्र-अर्ह्), cl. 1. A. प्रार्हते, प्रार्हितुम्, Ved. to distinguish or signalize one's self.
प्रालम्ब: प्रालम्ब प्रालम्ब, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-लम्ब), hanging down, suspended, pendent; (अस्), m. a kind of pearl ornament; the female breast; a species of gourd; (अम्), n. a garland hanging round the neck and reaching to the breast; [cf. मुक्ता-प्°।]
प्रालम्बक: प्रालम्बक, अम्, n. a garland hanging round the neck and reaching to the breast; (इका), f. a kind of golden necklace.
प्रालेपिक: प्रालेपिक प्रालेपिक, अस्, ई, अम्, an adj. de-rived from प्र-लेपिका।
प्रालेय: प्रालेय 1. प्रालेय, अस्, ई (?), अम् (anoma-lously fr. प्र-लय), produced by melting; (अम्), n. (according to some also अस्, m.), hail, snow, frost, hoar-frost (so called as being easily dissolved), dew. —प्रालेय-रश्मि, इस्, or प्रालेयांशु (°य-अं°), उस्, m. the moon (said to have cold or frosty rays). —प्रा-लेय-लेश, अस्, m. a hailstone. —प्रालेय-शैल, अस्, or प्रालेयाद्रि (°य-अद्°), इस्, m. the snowy moun-tain, Hima-vat. —प्रालेयाश्र (°य-अश्°), अम्, n. a cold or chilly tear.
2. प्रालेय, Nom. P. प्रालेयति, -यितुम्, to re-semble hail.
प्राल्कारीय: प्राल्कारीय प्राल्कारीय (fr. प्र + ऌकार), Nom. P. प्राल्कारीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रल्कारीय, q. v.
प्राव्: प्राव् प्राव् (प्र-अव्), cl. 1. P. प्रावति, प्रा-वितुम्, Ved. to attend to, observe; to take interest in, assist, encourage, animate; to protect, defend, (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण रक्ष्, to defend strenuously, to protect exceedingly); to sate, satisfy, content.
प्रावितृ: प्रावितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a protector, bene-factor, guardian, (Sāy. = रक्षक।)
प्रावितृ प्रावितृ। See under प्राव्, p. 659.
प्रावित्र: प्रावित्र, अम्, n., Ved. protection, guardianship.
प्रावी: प्रावी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. attentive, taking care of.
प्रावट: प्रावट प्रावट, अस्, m. barley; [cf. प्र-वट, प्र-वेट।]
प्रावण: प्रावण प्रावण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (according to Sāy.) a spade, shovel; (either a lengthened form for प्र-वण or a derivative from it.)
प्रावणि: प्रावणि प्रावणि, see Ujjvala-datta on Uṇādi-sūtras II. 103.
प्रावन्: प्रावन् प्रावन् (fr. rt. 1. प्रा) in क्रतु-प्°, q. v.
प्रावनिज्: प्रावनिज् प्राव-निज् (प्र-अव-), cl. 3. P. A. -नेनेक्ति, -नेनिक्ते, -नेक्तुम्, Ved. to wash away.
प्रावर: प्रावर प्रा-वर। See under प्रा-वृ, p. 660.
प्रा-वर, अस्, m. an inclosure, a fence, hedge; [cf. मही-प्°।]
प्रावरेय: प्रावरेय प्रावरेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-vara.
प्रावर्ग: प्रावर्ग प्रावर्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वर्ग), Ved. distinguished, eminent; (Sāy.) pre-eminently a scatterer of enemies (= प्रकर्षेण शत्रूणां वर्जयिता).
प्रावर्तक: प्रावर्तक प्रा-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम् (for प्र-वर्तक), bringing to light, manifesting; stirring up, inciting; founding, a founder.
प्रावर्षिन्: प्रावर्षिन् प्रा-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. वृष् with प्र), Ved. raining.
प्रावहणि: प्रावहणि प्रावहणि for प्रावाहणि, q. v.
प्रावार: प्रा-वार, अस्, m. an upper or outer garment, cloak, mantle; (अस्), m. = प्रा-वरक, N. of a district; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to, found in outer garments or cloaks. —प्रावार-कर्ण, अस्, m. ‘cloak-eared,’ N. of an owl. —प्रावार-कीट, अस्, m. ‘clothes-insect,’ a large kind of white ant.
प्रावास: प्रावास प्रावास, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वास), see Gaṇa Vyuṣṭādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 97.
प्रावासिक: प्रावासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, see Gaṇa Guḍādi to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 103, and Gaṇa Santāpādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 101.
प्रावाहणि: प्रावाहणि प्रावाहणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-vāhaṇa; (also wrongly written प्राहणि, प्रावहणि।)
प्रावाहणेय: प्रावाहणेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-vāhaṇa.
प्रावाहणेयक: प्रावाहणेयक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. प्रावाहणेय), = प्रवाहणेयक।
प्रावाहणेयि: प्रावाहणेयि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Prāvā-haṇeya.
प्रावीण्य: प्रावीण्य प्रावीण्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-वीण), cleverness, dexterity, skilfulness, proficiency, accurate knowledge, conversancy, skill.
प्रावृ: प्रावृ प्रा-वृ (प्र-आ-), cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते, -वृणाति, -वृणीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -वरीतुम्, to put on, dress one's self in (with acc.).
प्रावरक: प्रा-वरक, अस्, m., N. of a district (= प्रा-वार).
प्रावरण: प्रा-वरण, अम्, n. a covering, cover, an upper or outer garment, cloak, mantle [cf. कर्ण-प्°, कु-प्°]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; चीर-प्रावरण, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
प्रावरणीय: प्रावरणीय, अम्, n. a covering, upper garment.
प्रावारक: प्रा-वारक, अस्, m. an upper or outer garment, cloak.
प्रावारिक: प्रावारिक, अस्, m. a maker of upper garments or cloaks.
प्रावारीय: प्रावारीय, Nom. P. प्रावारीयति, -यितुम्, to use as an upper garment or cloak.
प्रावुवूर्षु: प्रा-वुवूर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to wear.
प्रावृत: प्रा-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, covered, enclosed, encom-passed, screened, sheltered; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a veil, mantle, cloak, wrapper.
प्रावृति: प्रा-वृति, इस्, f. an inclosure, fence, hedge; spiritual darkness, one of the four consequences of Māyā.
प्रावृत्य: प्रा-वृत्य, ind. having put on, having dressed one's self in.
प्रावृत्तिक: प्रावृत्तिक प्रावृत्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वृत्ति), secondary, derived, derivative, (opposed to मुख्य); informed of what is passing, well-informed.
प्रावृष्: प्रावृष् प्रा-वृष्, ट्, f. (fr. प्र-वृष्), the rainy season, wet season, rains; the months Āṣāḍha and Śrāvaṇa (comprising the first half of the rainy season which lasts in some parts from the middle of June till the middle of October). —प्रावृट्-काल, अस्, m. the period of the rains, rainy season. —प्रा-वृट्काल-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing only in the rainy season; (opposed to सदाकाल-वह।) —प्रा-वृड्-अत्यय, अस्, m. the time following the rainy season, autumn. —प्रावृषि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the rainy season, occurring during the rains.
प्रावृष: प्रा-वृष, अस्, आ, m. f. the rainy season, the rains.
प्रावृषायणी: प्रावृषायणी, f. (fr. प्रा-वृष्), a kind of weed which grows most luxuriantly during the rains, Bœrhavia Procumbens; Mucuna Pruritus.
प्रावृषिक: प्रावृषिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the rainy season, born or produced in the rainy season; (अस्), m. a peacock (as delighting in the rains).
प्रावृषीण: प्रावृषीण, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to the rainy season, rainy.
प्रावृषेण्य: प्रावृषेण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to the rainy season; coming in showers, abundant, numerous, much; (अस्), m. the Cadamba tree, Nauclea Cadamba [cf. कदम्ब]; Wrightia Anti-dysenterica; (आ), f. the plant Mucuna Pruritus; a species of Punar-navā with red flowers.
प्रावृषेय: प्रावृषेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
प्रावृष्य: प्रावृष्य, अस्, m. a species of Cadamba, Wrightia Antidysenterica; Hedysarum Alhagi; (अम्), n. lapis lazuli.
प्रावेण्य: प्रावेण्य प्रावेण्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-वेणि or प्र-वेणी), a fine woollen covering.
प्रावेप: प्रावेप प्रावेप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वेप), Ved. revolving easily, rolling easily, (Sāy. = कम्-पन-शील।)
प्रावेशन: प्रावेशन प्रावेशन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वे-शन), given on entering, to be done on entering, (see Gaṇa Vyuṣṭādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 97); (अम्), n. a manufactory, workshop.
प्रावेशिक: प्रावेशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-वेश), relating to entrance (into a house or upon the stage); connected with entry; in the habit of entering; प्रावेशिक्य् आक्षिप्तिका, a particular air or song called Ā-kṣiptikā sung by a person on entering the stage.
प्राव्रज्य: प्राव्रज्य प्राव्रज्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-व्रज्या), wandering as a religious mendicant.
प्राव्राज्य: प्राव्राज्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-व्राज्), the life of a wandering religious mendicant; vagrancy.
प्राश्: प्राश् 1. प्राश् (प्र-अश्, see rt. 1. अश्), cl. 5. P. A. प्राश्नोति, प्राश्नुते, प्राशितुम्, Ved. to arrive at, reach, (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण व्य्-आप्); to fall to the lot or share of any one (with acc.).

प्राश् 2. प्राश् (प्र-अश्, see rt. 2. अश्), cl. 9. P. A. प्राश्नाति, प्राश्नीते, प्राशितुम्, to begin to eat, begin eating; to take into the mouth; taste (Manu II. 62); to eat, consume, devour; (A.) to drink; to enjoy, sport with, dally with (with inst.): Pass. प्राश्यते, to be fed: Caus. प्राशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to eat or devour, give to eat, feed.
3. प्राश्, ट्, f., Ved. food, provisions.
प्राष्ट: प्राष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, arrived at, attained, gained. —प्राष्ट-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्रिश्नि (Nirukta X. 39).
प्राष्ट प्राष्ट। See under 1. प्राश्, col. 2.
प्राश: प्राश, अस्, m. eating, consuming, feeding upon, tasting [cf. घृत-प्°, धूम-प्°]; food, victuals [cf. चातुष्प्राश्य]; (occasionally incorrect) for प्रा-स, q. v.
प्राशक: प्राशक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who eats, an eater.
प्राशन: प्राशन, अम्, n. the act of eating, feeding upon, tasting; causing to eat or taste [cf. अन्न-प्°]; feeding (especially applied in Manu II. 29 to the cere-mony of making an infant taste, for the first time, a little honey and clarified butter); food, victuals; अमृत-प्राशन, अस्, m. having nectar for food, feeding on ambrosia, an immortal.
प्राशनीय: प्राशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, eatable, edible, esculent, serving for food; (अम्), n. food, victuals.
प्राशव्य: प्राशव्य, आस्, m. pl. (fr. 3. प्राश् or प्राश), Ved. food, provisions; (Sāy.) = साध्व्-अन्नादि, हितम् अन्नादि, good or wholesome food, &c.
प्राशित: प्राशित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken into the mouth, tasted; eaten, devoured, swallowed, well eaten; (अम्), n. an offering of rice or water to the Manes of progenitors, obsequies to deceased ancestors (Manu III. 74, = पितृ-यज्ञाख्यं नित्य-श्राद्धम्).
प्राशितव्य: प्राशितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten, eatable, edible, esculent, allowed to be eaten.
प्राशितृ: प्राशितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who eats, an eater, eating.
प्राशित्र: प्राशित्र, अम्, n., Ved. the portion of Havis eaten by the Brahman at a sacrifice; the vessel in which the Brahman's portion of Havis is placed; anything edible. —प्राशित्र-हरण, अम्, n., Ved. a vessel in which the Brahman's portion of Havis is placed.
प्राशित्रिय: प्राशित्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. in अ-प्राशित्रिय, not fit for the Prāśitra.
प्राशिन्: प्राशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) eating, feeding upon; अमृत-प्राशिन्, ई, m. eating nectar, a god.
प्राश्नत्: प्राश्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, eating, consuming, de-vouring.
प्राश्य: 1. प्राश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten, eatable, edible.
2. प्राश्य, ind. having eaten, having tasted or sipped.
प्राश्य 1. and 2. प्राश्य। See under 2. प्राश्, col. 2.
प्राशस्त्य: प्राशस्त्य प्राशस्त्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-शस्त), the being praised, praiseworthiness, celebrity, excel-lence, pre-eminence.
प्राशास्त्र: प्राशास्त्र प्राशास्त्र, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-शास्तृ), the office of the Pra-śāstṛ, q. v.; government, rule, dominion.
प्राशु: प्राशु प्राशु (प्र-आशु), उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. (accord-ing to the Nirukta = क्षिप्र), exceedingly quick or speedy, swift; (Sāy.) = सोमस्य प्राशकः, an eater or partaker of Soma; or = वृत्रस्य हिंसकः, the enemy (or injurer) of Vṛtra. —प्राशु-षह् or प्राशु-षाह्, षाट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. leading or curbing swift horses, having fleet horses; (Sāy.) = शीघ्रम् अभि-भवितृ, rapidly victorious.
प्राशृङ्ग: प्राशृङ्ग प्रा-शृङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having projecting horns, having the horns bent forward; (according to Mahī-dhara = प्रकृष्ट-श्रिङ्ग-युक्त।)
प्राश्निक: प्राश्निक प्राश्निक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रश्न), containing questions or inquiries [cf. बहु-प्°]; (अस्), m. an inquirer, asker, examiner; one who decides a dispute or quarrel, an umpire, arbiter, arbitrator; an assistant at a spectacle or assembly (?).
प्राश्नीपुत्र: प्राश्नी-पुत्र, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
प्राश्लिष्ट: प्राश्लिष्ट प्राश्लिष्ट, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-श्लिष्ट; in Ved. gram.) N. of a kind of Svarita produced by the combination of two short इस्; (also wrongly read प्राक्-श्लिष्ट।)
प्राश्वमेध: प्राश्वमेध प्राश्वमेध (प्र-अश्°), अस्, m. a preceding horse sacrifice.
प्रास्: प्रास् 1. प्रास् (प्र-अस्, see rt. 1. अस्), cl. 2. P. प्रास्ति, &c., Ved. to be in front of, be in an especial manner or extraordinary degree; to be pre-eminent, excel, preponderate, (Sāy. = प्र-भू।)
प्रास् 2. प्रास् (प्र-अस्, see rt. 2. अस्), cl. 4. P. प्रास्यति, प्रासितुम्, to throw forth, cast away, hurl forth, fling forth; to throw, cast, discharge (a missile); अंशम् प्रास्, to cast lots.
प्रास: प्रास, अस्, m. casting, throwing; interspersing, insertion; a barbed missile or dart; a particular constellation or a particular position of a planet; N. of a man.
प्रासक: प्रासक, अस्, m. a die, dice.
प्रासन: प्रासन, अम्, n. throwing forth, casting away; throwing, casting; throwing down.
प्रासिक: प्रासिक, अस्, ई, अम्, armed with a dart or javelin; (अस्), m. a spearman, lancer, javelin-man.
प्रासिक प्रासिक। See under 2. प्रास्, p. 660.
प्रास्त: प्रास्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown away, thrown off; thrown into, thrown, cast, hurled, discharged; ex-pelled, turned out, banished.
प्रासङ्ग: प्रासङ्ग प्रासङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-सङ्ग), a kind of yoke for cattle.
प्रासङ्गिक: प्रासङ्गिक, अस्, ई, अम्, resulting from attach-ment, proceeding from near relation, derived from close connection; connected with, inseparably con-nected, inherent, innate; pertaining to, belonging to any topic, relevant; opportune, seasonable; occasion-ally connected, occasional, incidental, casual, acci-dental, (opposed to आधिकारिक); episodical.
प्रासङ्ग्य: प्रासङ्ग्य, अस्, गी (?), अम्, harnessed with a yoke, yoked; (अस्), m. any animal used for draught, a draught-ox or one yoked.
प्रासच: प्रासच प्रासच, अस्, m., Ved. a sudden and violent shower of rain?; (ई), f. a flood of water produced by sudden and violent showers of rain.
प्रासह्: प्रासह् प्रा-सह्, ट्, f., Ved. power, force; प्रा-सहा, by force, violently, mightily, (Sāy. = बलेन।)
प्रासह: प्रा-सह, अस्, m., Ved. power, force, (Sāy.) = श-त्रूणाम् प्रकर्षेणाभिभविता; (आ), f., N. of the wife of Indra.
प्रासाह: प्रा-साह, अस्, आ, अम्, overpowering, subduing; ज-गत्-प्रासाह, (in which) the Jagatīmetre predominates.
प्रासाद: प्रासाद प्रासाद, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-सद्), a lofty seat or platform for spectators; a building erected on high foundations and approached by means of steps, a building consecrated to a deity or inhabited by a prince, a temple, palace; the assembly room and confessional hall of the Buddhist priest-hood. —प्रासाद-कुक्कुट, अस्, m. a domestic pigeon. —प्रासाद-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to (the roof of) a palace. —प्रासाद-तल, अम्, n. the flat roof of a house or palace. —प्रासाद-परामन्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a particular magical formula (a com-bination of the letters ह and स, = परा-प्रासाद-मन्त्र). —प्रासाद-पृष्ठ, अस्, m. a terrace or balcony on the top of a large house. —प्रासाद-प्र-तिष्ठा, f. the consecration of a temple. —प्रासाद-प्रस्तर, अस्, m. the flat roof of a house. —प्रासाद-मण्डना, f. a kind of orpiment. —प्रासाद-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling in a palace. —प्रासाद-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, accustomed to sleep in a palace. —प्रासाद-शृङ्ग, अम्, n. the spire or pinnacle of a palace or temple, a turret. —प्रासाद-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, stand-ing on (the roof of) a palace. —प्रासादाग्र्य (°द-अग्°), आणि, n. pl. the most excellent or beautiful palaces. —प्रासादाङ्गना (°द-अङ्°), f. the court-yard of a temple, precincts of a shrine. —प्रासादा-रोहण (°द-आर्°), अम्, n. the going up into a palace, entering a palace. —प्रासादारोहणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the act of going up into a palace.
प्रासादिक: प्रासादिक, अस्, आ (?), अम् (fr. प्र-साद), kind, amiable, friendly, favourable; given by way of blessing, given as a favour; beautiful.
प्रासादीय: 1. प्रासादीय, Nom. P. प्रासादीयति, &c., to imagine one's self to be in a palace.
2. प्रासादीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a palace, palatial.
प्रासूतिक: प्रासूतिक प्रासूतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. प्र-सूति), belonging or relating to childbirth.
प्रासेनजिती: प्रासेनजिती प्रासेनजिती, f. a patronymic from Prasena-jit.
प्रासेव: प्रासेव प्रा-सेव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सिव् with प्र), Ved. a rope (forming part of a horse's harness).
प्रास्कण्व: प्रास्कण्व प्रास्कण्व, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Pra-skaṇva; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
प्रास्तारिक: प्रास्तारिक प्रास्तारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्तार), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. IV. 4, 72.
प्रास्ताविक: प्रास्ताविक प्रास्ताविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्ताव), forming a commencement or introduction; having a prelude (as a hymn, Ved.); useful on occasion, suiting the subject under treatment; op-portune.
प्रास्तुत्य: प्रास्तुत्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-स्तुत), the being pro-pounded or discussed, the being under discussion.
प्रास्थानिक: प्रास्थानिक प्रास्थानिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्थान), relating to departure; favourable or auspi-cious to a departure; [cf. महा-प्°।]
प्रास्थिक: प्रास्थिक प्रास्थिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्थ), containing a Prastha, weighing a Prastha, bought for a Prastha; (अम्), n., scil. क्षेत्रम्, a field sown with a Prastha of grain.
प्रास्रवण: प्रास्रवण प्रास्रवण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-स्रवण), coming or derived from a spring or fountain (as water); (अस्), m. a patronymic from Pra-sravaṇa; प्लक्षः प्रास्रवणः, N. of a place, the source of the Sarasvatī or the spot where the Sarasvatī reappears [cf. सरस्-वती]; (also spelt प्राश्रवण।)
प्राह्: प्राह् प्राह् (प्र-अह्, see 3. अह्), only in Perf. प्राह, to utter, express; to announce, pro-claim, declare, state, tell, speak, say (with acc. of the thing and dat. or acc. of the person); to record, hand down by tradition; to call, name; to consider or regard as.
प्राह: प्राह प्राह, अस्, m. instruction in the art of acting or dancing.
प्राहणि: प्राहणि प्राहणि, इस्, m. a wrong reading for प्रावाहणि, q. v.
प्राहारिक: प्राहारिक प्राहारिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-हार), a police officer, constable (?).
प्राहृतायन: प्राहृतायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Pra-hṛta.
प्राहुण: प्राहुण प्राहुण, अस्, ई, m. f. a guest (= प्राघुण).
प्राह्ण: प्राह्ण प्राह्ण (fr. प्र + अह्न), अस्, m. the early part of the day, forenoon, morning; (अम्, ए), ind. in the forenoon, in the morning. —प्राह्णे-तमाम्, ind. very early in the forenoon. —प्राह्णे-तराम्, ind. earlier in the forenoon, very early in the morning.
प्राह्णेतन: प्राह्णेतन, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the forenoon, happening in the morning, matutinal.
प्राह्राद: प्राह्राद प्राह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-ह्राद), a patronymic of Vi-rocana.
प्राह्रादि: प्राह्रादि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Vi-rocana and of Bali.
प्रिय: प्रिय प्रिय। See under rt. 1. प्री below.

प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, beloved, dear to (with gen., loc., or dat.), dear, valued, amiable, agreeable, liked, desired, desirable, pleasing; customary, familiar, wonted, own (Ved., cf. φίλος); dear, expensive, high in price [cf. प्रिय-धान्यक, प्रियान्न-त्व]; (mostly in comps.), loving, liking, kind, favourable, affectionate, fond of (also with loc.), attached to, addicted to [cf. अक्ष-प्°, नर्तन-प्°, पुरु-प्°]; (अस्), m. a lover, husband; (according to Kullūka on Manu III. 19) a son-in-law; a kind of deer [cf. प्रियक]; a species of medicinal plant, = वृद्धि; (आ), f. a mistress, wife; a woman; news, tidings, information; small cardamoms; Arabian jasmine; vinous or spirituous liquor; N. of various metres, four times ˘˘¯˘¯; a metre of four lines of which the first, third, and fourth are ¯¯˘¯¯˘˘¯˘¯¯, and the second ˘¯ &c.; another variety of metre; (अम्), n. love; a service, kindness, favour; a pleasure; (अम्), ind. in an agreeable manner, in a pleasant way; (एण), ind. willingly, with pleasure, readily, gladly, pleasantly, agreeably (= प्रिय-प्रियेण)। —प्रियं-वद, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking kindly or pleasantly, pleasant speaking, sweet speaking, agree-able; (अस्), m. a kind of bird; (अ), n. the action of a lover. —प्रिय-क-लत्र, अस्, m. a man who is fond of his wife. —प्रिय-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of showing kindness to (with gen.), well-wishing, friendly dis-posed, benevolent. —प्रिय-काम्य, अस्, m. the plant Terminalia Tomentosa. —प्रिय-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, doing a kindness to (with gen.), doing a favour or acting kindly towards, treating kindly, pleasing, gratifying; kind, favourable, affectionate; congenial, suiting. —प्रिय-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing love, causing pleasure or gladness, agreeable. —प्रिय-कारण, अम्, n. the act of doing a favour; (आत्), ind. for the sake of doing a favour. —प्रिय-कारि-त्व, अम्, n. the act of showing kindness, kind treatment. —प्रिय-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, showing kind-ness to, acting kindly towards, doing what is pleasing, acting kindly. —प्रिय-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, doing a kind-ness; (त्), m. a friend, benefactor. —प्रियकृत्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, giving the greatest pleasure, doing that which pleases most. —प्रिय-क्षत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ruling benevolently, governing propitiously (said of the gods; Sāy. = प्रीणयितृ-बल). —प्रि-य-गुड, अस्, आ, अम्, one to whom sugar is agree-able, fond of sugar. —प्रियङ्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, acting kindly or affectionately to, showing kindness to (with gen.); agreeable; exciting or attracting regard, amiable; (अस्), m., N. of a Dānava; N. of a man; (ई), f., N. of various plants (= बृहज्-जीवन्ती, श्वेत-कण्टकारी, अश्व-गन्धा). —प्रि-यङ्-करण, अस्, ई, अम्, acting kindly or affection-ately to; the being fond of, affection, love. —प्रिय-तोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, satisfy-ing a lover; (अस्), m. a kind of coitus. —प्रिय-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving agreeable or desired objects; (आ), f. the plant Rhinacanthus Communis. —प्रिय-दत्ता, f. a mystical name of the earth; N. of a woman. —प्रिय-दर्श, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasant or agree-able to look at, (opposed to दुर्-दर्श।) —प्रिय-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasant or grateful to the sight, good looking, lovely, handsome; (अम्), n. the look of a friend; (अस्), m. a parrot; a kind of date tree; Terminalia Tomentosa; Mimusops Kauki; a plant growing in wet weather on trees and stones, (in Marāṭhī called dagaḍaphūla, in Hindūstani پتهركى پهول); N. of a prince of the Gandharvas;
