an epithet of Agni; (Sāy. = प्रिय-स्थान, fond of his station.) —प्रिय-धामन्, आ, m., Ved. = प्रिय-धाम, an epithet of Indra; (आनस्), m. pl. an epithet of the Ādityas. —प्रिय-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the beloved or desired; (Mahī-dhara) = प्रियाणाम् पा-लकः. —प्रिय-पुत्र, अस्, m. a kind of bird. —प्रिय-प्रद, अस्, m., N. of an author of a Śāktamantra. —प्रिय-प्रसादन, अम्, n. the conciliation of a husband, reconciliation with any object of affection. —प्रियप्रसादन-व्रत, अम्, n. a vow for the reconciliation of a husband. —प्रिय-प्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of life (= प्रियासु). —प्रिय-प्राय, अस्, आ, अम्, exceed-ingly kind or amiable; of pleasing speech, well-spoken, eloquent; (अम्), n. eloquence in language. —प्रिय-प्रियेण, ind. with pleasure, willingly, readily, gladly, pleasantly, agreeably. —प्रिय-प्रेप्-सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of obtaining a beloved object, lamenting the loss or absence of any beloved object, grieving for an object of affection. —प्रिय-भाषण, अम्, n. speaking kindly, kind or friendly speech. —प्रिय-भाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking kindly; (इणी), f. a kind of bird, Gracula Religiosa. —प्रिय-मण्-डन, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of trinkets or ornaments. —प्रिय-मधु, उस्, m. ‘fond of wine,’ an epithet of Bala-rāma the half-brother of Kṛṣṇa. —प्रिय-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of the lake Mānasa (the Rāja-haṃsa or Royal-goose). —प्रिय-माल्यानुले-पन (°य-अन्°), अस्, m., N. of an attendant of Skanda. —प्रिय-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a mythical Cakra-vartin. —प्रिय-मेध, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi (a descendant of Aṅgiras and author of the hymns Ṛg-veda VIII. 1-40, 57, 58, 76, IX. 28); of a descendant of Aja-mīḍha; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of the Ṛṣi Priya-medha. —प्रिय-मेध-स्तुत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praised by those who are fond of sacrifices, celebrated by pious priests; (Sāy. = प्रिय-यज्ञैर् ऋषिभिः स्तुतः।) —प्रि-यम्-भविष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, becoming dear, be-coming an object of affection. —प्रियम्भविष्णु-ता, f. or प्रियम्भविष्णु-त्व, अम्, n. the becom-ing an object of affection, amiability. —प्रियम्-भावुक, अस्, ई, अम्, one who has become dear, become an object of affection. —प्रियम्भावुक-ता, f. or प्रियम्भावुक-त्व, अम्, n. the having become dear or beloved, becoming beloved, amia-bility. —प्रिय-यज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of sacrifices, loving sacrifices. —प्रिय-रण, अस्, आ, अम्, delighting in war, warlike, martial. —प्रिय-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing a favourite chariot, (Sāy. = प्रीयमाण-रथ-युक्त); (अस्), m., N. of a man (?). —प्रिय-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, having an agreeable form. —प्रिय-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who speaks kindly or agreeably, flattering, a flatterer. —प्रिय-वचन, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose words are kind or friendly, kindly spoken; (अस्), m. = भक्तिमान् रोगी; (अम्), n. kind or flattering speech, term of endearment, endearing expression. —प्रिय-वचस्, अस्, n. a kind or friendly speech. —प्रिय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, con-taining the word प्रिय. —प्रिय-वयस्य, अस्, m. a dear friend. —प्रिय-वर्णी, f. = प्रियङ्गु, a creeping plant, Echites Frutescens. —प्रिय-वल्ली, f. a species of plant (= प्रियङ्गु, फलिनी). —प्रिय-वस्तु, n. a favourite object or topic. —प्रिय-वाक्-सहित, अस्, आ, अम्, accompanied by kind words. —प्रिय-वाच्, क्, f. kind or agreeable speech; (क्, क्, क्), one whose words are kind, kind in speech, affable in address. —प्रिय-वाद, अस्, m. kind or agreeable speech. —प्रिय-वादिका, f. a kind of musical instrument. —प्रियवादि-ता, f. speaking kindly, kindliness of speech. —प्रिय-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speaking kindly or agreeably, speaking affection-ately, flattering, a flatterer; (इनी), f. a kind of bird, Gracula Religiosa. —प्रिय-विनाकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned by a lover, deserted by a husband. —प्रि-य-विश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, see Scholiast on Pāṇ. I. 1, 29. —प्रिय-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. liking pious ob-servances, fond of obedience (said of the gods; Sāy. = प्रियाणि कर्माणि येषाम्); (अस्), m., N. of a king (a son of Manu and Śata-rūpā); N. of a priest. —प्रिय-शालक, अस्, m. the plant Terminalia To-mentosa; (also spelt प्रिय-सालक।) —प्रिय-श्र-वस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, loving glory; an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —प्रिय-स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. granting desired ob-jects; (according to Sāy. प्रियसासः = प्रियतमा धाराः।) —प्रिय-संवास, अस्, m. the society of a beloved object, the society of loved persons. —प्रि-य-सख, अस्, आ, अम्, one to whom friends are dear, loving friends; (अस्), m. a dear friend; the tree Acacia Catechu, = खदिर; (ई), f. a dear female friend, a female friend or companion, a confidante. —प्रिय-सङ्गमन, अम्, n. ‘the meeting of friends,’ N. of a place in which Indra and Viṣṇu are said to have met with their parents Aditi and Kaśyapa. —प्रिय-सत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasant and true; (अम्), n. speech at once pleasing and true, eloquent and truthful discourse. —प्रिय-सन्तति, इस्, इस्, इ, having a beloved son. —प्रिय-सन्देश, अस्, m. a tree with fragrant flowers, Michelia Champaca. —प्रिय-समागम, अस्, m. reunion with a beloved object. —प्रिय-समुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, befitting or becoming a lover. —प्रिय-सहचरी, f. a dear female companion, beloved wife. —प्रिय-सालक, अस्, m. = प्रिय-शालक, q. v. —प्रिय-सुहृद्, त्, m. a dear friend, kind or good friend. —प्रिय-स्तोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fond of praise; (Sāy. = प्रियाणि स्तोत्राणि यस्य।) —प्रिय-स्वप्न, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of sleep, sluggish. —प्रियाख्य (°य-आख्°), अस्, आ, अम्, called ‘dear,’ a lover, mistress; announcing good tidings —प्रियाख्यान (°य-आख्°), अम्, n. agreeable news, pleasant tidings. —प्रियाख्यान-पुरःसर, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by agreeable news, preceded by pleasant tidings. —प्रिया-जन, अस्, m. any dear or beloved female. —प्रियातिथि (°य-अत्°), इस्, इस्, इ, fond of guests, a lover of guests, hospitable. —प्रियात्मन् (°य-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, of a pleasant nature, agreeable, pleasant. —प्रिया-धान (°य-आध्°), अम्, n. a friendly office, good service. —प्रियान्न (°य-अन्°), अम्, n. expensive food, dear provisions. —प्रियान्न-त्व, अम्, n. dear-ness of provisions, dearth, scarcity. —प्रियापय (°य-अप्°), अस्, m. the absence of a beloved object. —प्रियाप्रिय (°य-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, agreeable and disagreeable, pleasant and unpleasant. —प्रियाम्बु (°य-अम्°), उस्, उस्, उ, fond of water; (उस्), m. the mango tree. —प्रियार्थम् (°य-अर्°), ind. for the sake of a beloved object. —प्रियार्ह (°य-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deserving love, amiable. —प्रिया-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a mistress, enamoured, being in love with. —प्रियासु (°य-असु), उस्, उस्, उ, fond of life (= प्रिय-प्राण). —प्रियासूय-मती (°य-अस्°), f., N. of a woman. —प्रियैषिन् (°य-एष्°), ई, इणी, इ, wishing to please, friendly, affectionate. —प्रियोक्ति (°य-उक्°), इस्, f. friendly speech. —प्रियोदित (°य-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, well or kindly spoken, pleasingly uttered; (अम्), n. kind or gentle speech. —प्रियोपपत्ति (°य-उप्°), इस्, f. a happy event or circumstance, pleasant occurrence. —प्रियो-पभोग (°य-उप्°), अस्, m. the enjoyment of a lover or of a mistress. —प्रियोपभोग-बन्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, barren or destitute of the enjoyment of a lover. —प्रियोस्रिय (°य-उस्°), अस्, m., Ved. loving cows, amorous (said of a bull).
प्रियाल: प्रियाल, अस्, m. the tree Buchanania Latifolia (com-monly called Piyāl, = पियाल, तापस-प्रिय); (आ), f. a vine, a bunch of grapes (= द्राक्षा). —प्रियाल-ताल-खर्जूर-हरीतकी-विभीतक, आस्, m. pl. piyāl, palm, date and yellow and beleric myrobalan trees.
प्री: प्री 1. प्री, cl. 9. (and 1 ?). P. A. प्रीणाति, प्रीणीते, प्रयति (?), -ते (?), पिप्राय, पि-प्रिये, प्रेष्यति, -ते, अप्रैषीत्, अप्रेष्ट, प्रेतुम् (Vedic forms are प्रीणाहि = प्रीणीहि, पिप्रीहि, अपि-प्रेस्, अपिप्रयत्, पिप्रयस्व), (P.) to please, de-light, gladden, cheer, regale; to act kindly to, show kindness to, show grace or favour to any one (with acc.); to take pleasure in, delight in (with gen. or loc.); to love; (A.) to be pleased or gratified, be glad or cheerful: Pass. प्रीयते (by some regarded as cl. 4. A.; ep. also P. प्रीयति), to be pleased or gratified, be glad or cheerful; to feel affection for, regard with affection, love; to be satisfied, assent: Caus. प्रीणयति (according to Siddhānta-kaum. p. 150 also प्रापयति, and according to Vopa-deva XVIII. 12 also प्राययति), -यितुम्, Aor. अपि-प्रीणत्, to give pleasure to, please, delight, gratify; to act kindly or graciously to, treat kindly: Desid. पिप्रीषति, -ते, Ved. to wish to please or propitiate: Intens. पेप्रीयते, पेप्रयीति, पेप्रेति; [cf. Zend frī, ‘to love, praise;’ fry-a, ‘beloved, a friend:’ Gr. φίλο-ς, φιλέω fr. a rt. φιλ for φλι, πρᾷο-ς, πραΰ-ς (Ion. πρη-ΰ-ς), πρᾳ-ό-τη(τ)-ς, πραΰ-ν-ω: perhaps Lat. pla-ceo, pla-co, pius for prius (?), lœ-tus for plœ-tus (?), filius = प्रिय (?): Goth. fri-j-on, ‘to love;’ frijond-s, ‘a friend;’ fria-thva, ‘love,’ = प्रिय-त्व; faihu-freiks, ‘money-lov-ing, avaricious:’ Old Germ. fra-o, frô, ‘joyful;’ friunt, ‘a friend;’ fri-du, fri-da, ‘peace;’ friu-dil, fri-del, fre-del, ‘a minion, favourite:’ Old Slav. pri-ja-ti, ‘to provide;’ pri-ja-telu = Russ. prijāteli = Lith. prëteliu-s, ‘a friend:’ Cambro-Brit. prïawd.]
2. प्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, in अध-प्री, कध-प्री, घृत-प्री, &c., q. q. v. v.
प्रियक: प्रियक, अस्, m. a kind of variegated or spotted deer; a kind of bird; a bee; N. of several plants, Nauclea Cadamba; Terminalia Tomentosa; saffron; = प्रियङ्गु, a kind of tree; N. of an attendant on Skanda; N. of a man.
प्रियङ्गु: प्रियङ्गु, उस्, उस्, m. f. panic seed, Panicum Italicum; a medicinal plant and perfume, commonly called Priyaṅgu and described in some places as a fra-grant seed (= फलिनी); Italian millet; long pepper; Sinapis Ramosa, = कटुकी; (अम्), n. saffron. —प्रि-यङ्गु-द्वीप, अस्, m., N. of a country. —प्रियङ्गु-श्यामा, f., N. of the wife of Naravāhana-datta.
प्रियाकृ: प्रिया-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to act kindly towards, treat kindly (with acc.).
प्रीण: 1. प्रीण, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see s. v.), pleased, satisfied.
प्रीण 2. प्रीण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. प्र), old, ancient, former (= प्रण, पुराण).
प्रीणन: प्रीणन, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasing, gratifying, appeas-ing, allaying, soothing; (अम्), n. the act of pleasing or delighting, gladdening, satisfying, satisfaction, satiety; a means of gladdening or satisfying.
प्रीणयित्वा: प्रीणयित्वा, ind. having pleased or propitiated.
प्रीणित: प्रीणित, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, gratified, delighted.
प्रीत: प्रीत, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, delighted, gladdened, satisfied; joyful, content; happy, glad; dear, be-loved, loved; gracious, kind, affectionate; (अम्), n. pleasure, delight; jest, mirth. —प्रित-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more highly pleased, much gratified. —प्रीत-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, pleased in mind, gratified in mind. —प्रीतात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, pleased in mind, rejoiced in spirit, pleased, satisfied, content.
प्रीति: प्रीति, इस्, f. any pleasurable sensation, pleasure, joy, gladness, happiness; enjoyment, gratification, sa-tisfaction [cf. आत्म-प्°]; graciousness, grace, favour, favourableness, kindness, propitiousness; friendly disposition, liking, fondness for, delighting in, friend-liness, amity, regard, harmony, affection, love; con-ciliation; Joy or Gratification personified as a daughter of Dakṣa; Love personified as wife of Kāma-deva; the second of the twenty-seven astro-nomical Yogas; N. of the thirteenth Kalā of the moon; a symbolical expression for the letter ध्; प्रीत्या, ind. in a friendly way, amicably, peaceably. —प्रीति-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing pleasure; inspiring love or affection; pleasing, agreeable. —प्रीति-क-रण, अम्, n. the act of causing pleasure, gratifying. —प्रीति-कर्मन्, अ, n. an act of friendship or love; kind action. —प्रीति-कूट, N. of a village. —प्रीति-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —प्रीति-जुषा, f., N. of the wife of A-niruddha. —प्रीति-तृष्, ट्, m. a N. of the god of love. —प्रीति-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving pleasure; inspiring love or regard, affectionate; (अस्), m. a jester or buffoon in a play, the Vidūṣaka. —प्रीति-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, given through love or affection; (अम्), n. (?), property or valuables presented to a female by her relations and friends at the time of her marriage, and constituting part of her peculiar property. —प्रीति-दान, अम्, n. or प्रीति-दाय, अस्, m. ‘gift of love,’ a present made from love or affection, a kind or friendly present, token of affection. —प्रीति-धन, अम्, n. money given from love or friendship. —प्रीति-पात्र, अम्, n. an object of affection, a beloved person or thing. —प्रीति-पुरोग, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by affection, affectionate, loving. —प्रीति-पूर्वम् or प्रीति-पूर्वकम्, ind. with the accompaniment of kindness, kindly, graciously, affectionately, in an af-fectionate manner. —प्रीति-प्रमुख, अस्, आ, अम्, preceded by kindness (= प्रीति-पूर्वक), kind, friendly. —प्रीतिप्रमुख-वचन, अम्, n. a speech preceded by affection, affectionate words, kind speech (= प्रीति-पूर्वकाणि वचनानि or according to others = स्नेह-प्रधान-वचनम्, speech principally characterized by affection). —प्रीति-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, enjoying friendship, receiving friendly offices. —प्री-ति-भोज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eaten joyfully or cheer-fully. —प्रीति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having pleasurable sensations, pleased, gratified; having love or affection for (with loc. or gen.), full of affection, loving, fond, affectionate, kind; favourable; (अती), f. a kind of metre consisting of four lines, alternately ˘¯˘¯¯ ˘˘¯˘¯¯ and ¯¯˘¯¯˘˘¯˘¯¯. —प्रीति-म-नस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, joyous-minded, joyful-hearted, pleased in mind, content, happy; प्रीयमाण: प्रीयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being pleased or pro-pitiated; being glad or joyful; being dear or beloved; kind, affectionate.
प्रेणा: प्रेणा, a shortened form for प्रेम्णा, inst. of प्रेमन्, q. v.
प्रेणि: प्रेणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. gladdening, delighting, one who delights (by praises); (Sāy.) = प्रेरयितृ, in-citing, instigating.
प्रेतृ: प्रेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who loves or cherishes, a benefactor; (Sāy.) = तर्पयितृ।
प्रेम: प्रेम, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्रेमन्, love, affection, (at the end of adj. comps.; cf. स-प्°); (आ), f. = प्रेमन् (in प्रेमा-बन्ध); a kind of metre consisting of four lines (the first, second, and fourth being ¯¯˘¯¯˘˘¯˘¯¯ and the third ˘¯˘¯¯ &c.). —प्रेमा-बन्ध = प्रेम-बन्ध, q. v.
प्रेमन्: प्रेमन्, आ, अ, m. n. love, affection, kindness, tender regard, favour; sport, pastime; joy, glad-ness, pleasure; (आ), m. a jest, joke; wind, air; an epithet of Indra; N. of various men; प्रेम्णा (Ved. also प्रेणा), ind. through love or affection. —प्रेम-तत्त्व-निरूपण, अम्, n., N. of a Bengālī poem by Kṛṣṇa-dāsa. —प्रेम-नारायण, अस्, m., N. of a king (= प्रेम-साहि). —प्रेम-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, intent on love, filled with affection, affec-tionate, loving, constant. —प्रेम-पातन, अम्, n. defluxion of rheum or of tears. —प्रेम-पात्र, अम्, n. an object of affection, a beloved person or thing. —प्रेम-बन्ध, अस्, m. or प्रेम-बन्धन, अम्, n. ‘love-bond,’ the ties of love, love. —प्रेम-भाव, अस्, m. state of affection, love. —प्रेम-राशी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become (as it were) one mass of affection. —प्रेमर्द्धि (°म-ऋ°), इस्, f. increase of affection, ardent love. —प्रेम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, full of love, affectionate; (अती), f. a mistress. —प्रेम-विश्वास-भूमि, इस्, f. an object of love and confidence. —प्रेम-सागर, अस्, m. an ocean of love. —प्रेम-साहि, इस्, m. (fr. प्रेमन् + साहि = شاه) = प्रेम-नारायण. —प्रेमामृत (°म-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘love-ambrosia,’ N. of a metrical list of 112 names of Kṛṣṇa. —प्रेमाश्रु (°म-अश्°), उ, n. a tear of affection.
प्रेमिन्: प्रेमिन्, ई, इणी, इ, loving, affectionate, friendly.
प्रेयस्: प्रेयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. प्रिय), dearer, very dear, more agreeable, more desired; dearest, most beloved; kinder, more affectionate; (आन्), m. a lover, husband; (असी), f. a mistress, wife; (आन्, अस्), m. n. (in rhetoric) flattery. —प्रेयस्-कर, अस्, m. the hand of a lover. —प्रेयस्-ता, f. or प्रेयस्-त्व, अम्, n. the being dearer, being very dear. —प्रेयो-ऽपत्य, अस्, m. ‘very fond of offspring,’ a heron.
प्रेष्ठ: प्रेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. प्रिय), dearest, very dear, most beloved, greatly beloved, most agreeable, most desired; (अस्), m. a lover, husband; (आ), f. a mistress, wife; a leg. —प्रेष्ठ-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, dearest, most beloved.
प्रीतु: प्रीतु प्रीतु, उस्, m. a bird (?).
प्रु: प्रु प्रु [cf. rt. प्लु], cl. 1. A. प्रवते, पुप्रुवे, &c., to spring up, jump up; to go, move: Caus. प्रावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अपुप्रवत्, अपिप्रवत्, to reach to, extend as far as (with acc.): Desid. of Caus. पुप्रावयिषति, पिप्रावयिषति।
प्रुत्: प्रुत्, त्, त्, त्, moving, going, (at the end of comps.; cf. अन्तरिक्ष-प्°, उद-प्°, उपरि-प्°, कृष्ण-प्°।)
प्रुथ्: प्रुथ् प्रुथ्, by some regarded as the proper form of rt. प्रोथ्, q. v.
प्रुष्: प्रुष् 1. प्रुष् [cf. rt. प्लुष्], cl. 5. 9. 10. P. A. प्रुष्णोति, प्रुष्णुते, प्रुष्णाति, प्रुष्णीते, प्रुषायति, -ते, प्रोषितुम्, Ved. to scatter or sprinkle down in drops, rain, shower, wet, moisten (in these senses probably fr. प्र + उक्ष्; Sāy. = सिच्); cl. 9. P. प्रुष्णाति, to become moist or wet, become unctuous; to pour out, sprinkle, shed, discharge; to fill; cl. 1. P. प्रोषति, to burn (in this sense probably fr. प्र + 1. उष्); [cf. प्रुषित: प्रुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled, wetted, moist-ened; burning, consuming; (Sāy.) = दग्धुम् प्र-वृत्तः. —प्रुषित-प्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. of a speckled or dappled aspect, piebald, of a varied hue (said of the horses of the Aśvins and of Indra; Sāy. = विचित्र-रूप).
प्रुष्ट: प्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, consumed.

प्रुष्व: प्रुष्व, अस्, m. the rainy season, the rains; the sun; (आ), f., Ved. a drop of water, a frozen drop of water, hoar-frost.
प्रुष्वाय: प्रुष्वाय, Nom. A. प्रुष्वायते, -यितुम्, to fall in drops, trickle.
प्रोष: प्रोष, अस्, m. burning, combustion; [cf. प्लोष।]

प्रोषक: प्रोषक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
प्रोषक प्रोषक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people (Mahā-bh. Bhīṣma-p. 376).
प्रू: प्रू प्रू in कट-प्रू, q. v.

P. प्रैति, प्रैतुम् (Ved. प्रेषे), to go forth, come forth, appear (Ved.); to go on, proceed (especially as a sacrifice, Ved.); to go forwards, go farther; to go to, come to, arrive at, attain, reach; to go out; to depart (this life), die: Intens. प्रेयते, Ved. to drive or go forth (in a chariot, said of Uṣas).
प्रेत: प्रेत, अस्, आ, अम्, departed, deceased, dead, de-funct, a dead person; (अस्), m. the spirit of a de-parted person, departed spirit, spirit abiding in the lower world, the spirit before obsequial rites are performed; a ghost, an evil being (especially one ani-mating the carcases of the dead). —प्रेत-कर्मन्, अ, n. an obsequial act or rite, funeral rites. —प्रेत-कल्प, अस्, m. ‘obsequial ordinance,’ N. of the second part of the Garuḍa-Purāṇa. —प्रेत-कार्य, अम्, n. or प्रेत-कृत्य, अम्, आ, n. f. an obsequial or funeral rite, obsequial ceremonies in honour of the dead or of deceased ancestors. —प्रेत-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to the departed, dead. —प्रेत-गृह, अम्, n. ‘house of the dead,’ a burying ground. —प्रे-त-गोप, अस्, m. the Keeper of the dead. —प्रेत-चारिन्, ई, m. ‘roaming among the dead,’ Śiva. —प्रे-त-त्व, अम्, n. the state of a departed spirit, the being dead. —प्रेत-दाह, अस्, m. the burning of the dead. —प्रेत-धूम, अस्, m. ‘smoke of the dead,’ the smoke of a funeral pile; (according to Kullūka = दह्यमान-शव-धूम।) —प्रेत-नदी, f. the river of the dead (= वैतरणी, q. v.). —प्रेत-नर, अस्, m. a dead man, a corpse, a ghost. —प्रेत-निर्यातक or प्रेत-निर्हारक, अस्, m. a man employed to carry forth dead bodies; प्रेति: प्रेति, इस्, f., Ved. departure, flight. —प्रेति-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the word प्रेति or a form of प्रे. —प्रेतीषणि (°ति-इष्°), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. striving to move forwards (an epithet of Agni; Sāy. = प्राप्त-गमन).
प्रेतिक: प्रेतिक, अस्, m. the soul of a deceased person, a spirit, ghost.
प्रेत्य: प्रेत्य, ind. having departed, having died, after death, in the next world, in the life to come. —प्रेत्य-जाति, इस्, f. rank or position in the world to come. —प्रेत्य-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, obtaining after death, enjoying the fruits of anything in the next world. —प्रेत्य-भाव, अस्, m. the state after death, condition of the soul after death, future state. —प्रे-त्यभाविक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the state after death, (opposed to ऐहलौकिक; probably an incor-rect form for प्रैत्यभाविक।)

प्रेहिकर्दमा: प्रेहि-कर्दमा, f. a rite in which no impurity of any kind is allowed.
प्रेहिद्वितीया: प्रेहि-द्वितीया, f. a rite at which no second person is allowed to be present.
प्रेहिवाणिजा: प्रेहि-वाणिजा, f. a rite at which no merchants are allowed to be present.
प्रेकीय: प्रेकीय प्रेकीय (fr. प्र + एक), Nom. P. प्रे-कीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रैकीय; see Vopa-deva II. 4.

प्रेक्षणक: प्रेक्षणक, अस्, इका, अम्, looking at, viewing, a spectator; (अम्), n. a spectacle, show, a play.
प्रेक्षणिक: प्रेक्षणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, looking at, one who looks at or views; (आ), f. a woman fond of seeing shows.
प्रेक्षणीय: प्रेक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen or viewed, to be beheld or gazed at, visible, apparent, conspi-cuous [cf. दुष्-प्°]; worth seeing, worthy of being looked at, beautiful to the view, sightly; to be re-garded as, resembling, looking or appearing like. —प्रेक्षणीय-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most worthy of being seen, most sightly. —प्रेक्षणीय-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more worthy of being seen, more sightly, more conspicuous. —प्रेक्षणीय-ता, f. sightliness, conspicuousness, beautifulness.
प्रेक्षणीयक: प्रेक्षणीयक, अस्, इका, अम्, visible, apparent, conspicuous; (अम्), n. a play, spectacle.
प्रेक्षत्: प्रेक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking at, beholding, regarding, observing.
प्रेक्षमाण: प्रेक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, looking on, viewing, beholding, regarding.
प्रेक्षा: प्रेक्षा, f. looking at, viewing, beholding, ob-serving, seeing, regarding, (sometimes at the end of a comp., e. g. धर्म-प्रेक्ष, regarding or con-sidering the law; cf. मुख-प्°); sight, view, look, aspect, appearance; being a spectator, seeing a play or dance; any public show or spectacle, a sight; a play, dancing; conceiving, conception, understand-ing, intellect; circumspection, consideration; reflec-tion, deliberation; the branch of a tree. —प्रेक्षा-गार (°षा-अग्° or °षा-आग्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. or प्रेक्षा-गृह, अम्, n. ‘spectacle-house,’ any build-ing erected for a show, temporary structure consisting of stalls for spectators, a play-house. —प्रेक्षा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of circumspection, considerate, wise, prudent. —प्रेक्षा-समाज, अस्, m. an assembly at a spectacle, crowd at a theatre; (according to Kullūka = नृत्यादि-स्थान-जन-समृद्धि।)
प्रेक्षित: प्रेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, looked at, viewed, beheld, seen; (अम्), n. a look, glance.
प्रेक्षितृ: प्रेक्षितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who looks on, a spectator.
प्रेक्षिन्: प्रेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, looking at, viewing, regarding; watching narrowly, scrutinizing [cf. मुख-प्°]; having the eyes or glance of [cf. मृग-प्°, वृक-प्°]; जिह्म-प्रेक्षिन्, looking aside, looking askance. —प्रेक्षि-त्व, अम्, n. the act of watching nar-rowly, scrutinizing.
प्रेक्ष्य: 1. प्रेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at, to be regarded or observed [cf. दुष्-प्°]; to be seen, visible, apparent, brilliantly conspicuous; to be looked at patiently, to be suffered or endured; worthy of being seen, sightly, conspicuous; N. of a Śabdālaṅkāra.
2. प्रेक्ष्य, ind. having looked at, having beheld or observed.
प्रेक्ष्यमाण: प्रेक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being looked at or beheld, being seen.
प्रेङ्ख्: प्रेङ्ख् प्रेङ्ख् (प्र-ईङ्ख्), cl. 1. P. प्रेङ्खति, प्रेङ्खितुम्, to tremble, shake, quiver, oscillate, vibrate: Caus. प्रेङ्खयति, -यितुम्, to cause to oscillate or vibrate, swing (trans.), shake.
प्रेङ्ख: प्रेङ्ख, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, shaking, vibrating, oscillating, swinging (Ved.); (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a swing, a sort of hammock or swinging cot (either for travelling or diversion); नकुलस्य वामदे-वस्य प्रेङ्खः and मरुताम् प्रेङ्खः, N. of two Sāmans; (आ), f. dancing; wandering, travelling about, roaming (?); a particular pace of a horse. —प्रेङ्खेङ्खन (°ख-ईङ्°), अम्, n. swinging.
प्रेङ्खण: प्रेङ्खण, अस्, आ, अम्, wandering, moving or going towards, entering; (अम्), n. swinging; a swing; a minor drama in one act; going, wandering (?). —प्रेङ्खण-कारिका, f. a female swinger or dancer.
प्रेङ्खणीय: प्रेङ्खणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be swung or made to oscillate.
प्रेङ्खत्: प्रेङ्खत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shaking, moving, oscil-lating, vibrating; wandering (?); diffusing (?); touching (?).
प्रेङ्खित: प्रेङ्खित, अस्, आ, अम्, swung, shaken, set in motion, made to oscillate; being in contact with (?).
प्रेङ्खोलन: प्रेङ्खोलन, अम्, n. swinging, shaking, oscil-lating; a swing, swing-cot or hammock.
प्रेङ्खोलय: प्रेङ्खोलय, Nom. P. प्रेङ्खोलयति, -यितुम्, to swing, shake; [cf. अन्दोलय, आन्दोलय, हिन्दो-लय।]
प्रेङ्गण: प्रेङ्गण प्रेङ्गण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. इङ्ग् with प्र), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 32.
प्रेड्: प्रेड् प्रेड् (प्र-ईड्), cl. 2. A. प्रेट्टे, प्रेडितुम्, Ved. to implore, supplicate; praise, celebrate; (Sāy. = प्रकर्षेण स्तु, to praise greatly, celebrate ex-ceedingly.)
प्रेडक: प्रेडक प्रेडक, an incorrect form for प्रे-रक, q. v.
प्रेद्ध: प्रेद्ध प्रेद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. इन्ध् with प्र), Ved. kindled, lighted.
प्रेन्: प्रेन् प्रेन् (प्र-इन्), cl. 8. P. प्रेनोति, &c., Ved. to send forth, impel forwards or upwards.
प्रेन्वन: प्रेन्वन प्रेन्वन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. इन्व् with प्र), see Vārttika II. to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 2.
प्रेन्वनीय: प्रेन्वनीय, see Vārttika II. to Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 2.
प्रेप्सा: प्रेप्सा प्रेप्सा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. आप् with प्र), the wish to attain, desire of obtaining, desire, longing for; supposition, assumption.
प्रेप्सु: प्रेप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to attain, desirous of obtaining, wishing, seeking, longing for (with acc.); aiming at, having in view; supposing, assuming; anxious to rescue or save; तत्-प्रेप्सु, उस्, m. (in Ved. gram.) epithet of a particular form of the Desiderative.
प्रेर्: प्रेर् प्रेर् (प्र-ईर्), cl. 2. A. प्रेर्ते, प्रेरि-तुम्, to move, come forward, come forth, go forth, rise, appear (Ved.): Caus. P. प्रेरयति, -यितुम्, to set in motion, cause to move forwards, move; to drive forwards, push on, drive onwards, urge or press forwards; to urge on, force on, hasten, stimu-late, incite, excite; to send forth, dismiss, dispatch; to send; to direct towards; to utter; to ask.
प्रेरक: प्रेरक, अस्, इका, अम्, setting in motion, urging on, impelling, inciting, stimulating, exciting; sending. —प्रेरक-त्व, अम्, n. the act of setting in motion, urging on.
प्रेरण: प्रेरण, अम्, n. driving on [cf. पशु-प्°]; (अम्, आ), n. f. the act of urging on, inciting, driving, instigating; impulse, passion; sending, dispatching, directing, ordering, order, direction, commanding; activity, action; the sense of the causal verb, [cf. Vopa-deva XVIII. 1.] —प्रेरणार्थ (°ण-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the sense of inciting or of the causal verb.
प्रेरणीय: प्रेरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be urged on or incited.
प्रेरयत्: प्रेरयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, setting in motion, mov-ing, directing (the eyes).
प्रेरयितृ: प्रेरयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who urges, an insti-gator, inciting, instigating; one who sends.
प्रेरित: प्रेरित, अस्, आ, अम्, driven forwards, impelled, influenced, instigated; excited, urged, stimulated; incited to speak; sent, directed, dispatched; ordered; touched; (अस्), m. an envoy, a messenger.
प्रेरितृ: प्रेरितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who urges on or incites, an inciter; one who sends.
प्रेर्त्वन्: प्रेर्त्वन्, आ, m., Ved. the ocean, the sea; (अरी), f. a river.
प्रेर्यमाण: प्रेर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being urged on, being incited.
प्रेष्: प्रेष् 1. प्रेष्, cl. 1. A. प्रेषते, &c., to go, move; (also read ह्रेष्।)

प्रेष् 2. प्रेष् (प्र-इष्, see rt. 1. इष्), cl. 4. P. A. प्रेष्यति, -ते, प्रेषितुम्, to drive forth, drive away, drive forwards, drive on; to send forth, send out, utter; to hurl, fling, cast; (P.) to call upon, invite, summon (in Vedic ritual said technically of the presiding priest at a sacrifice calling upon the assistant priests to commence a recitation or a ceremony; with acc. of the object, e. g. साम प्रेष्यति गाय ब्रूहीति वा, he calls upon an assistant priest with the words ‘Sing’ or ‘Say’ to commence the recitation of a Sāman; also with gen. of the object; also with dat. of the deity to whom the recitation is addressed or the sacrifice offered, e. g. अग्नये प्रेष्य, call upon an assistant priest to commence the offering or to commence the hymn to Agni); Caus. प्रेषयति, -यितुम्, to send forth, send away, dismiss; to send into exile, banish; to send, dispatch; to send word to, send a message to; to hurl, fling, cast, throw; to turn or direct (the eyes).
3. प्रेष्, ट्, f., Ved. pressing, pressure; (ट्, ट्, ट्), pressing, urging on, (Sāy. = प्रेरक।)
प्रेष: प्रेष, अस्, m. urging on, impelling (Ved. = प्रैष); pain, affliction.
प्रेषक: प्रेषक, अस्, इका, अम्, sending, dispatching; one who orders or commands, ordering, directing.
प्रेषण: प्रेषण, अम्, n. the act of sending, dispatching (a messenger); sending on a mission, commissioning, charging, ordering, directing, commanding; execut-ing a commission. —प्रेषण-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, executing a commission. —प्रेषणाध्यक्ष (°ण-अध्°), अस्, m. a superintendent of the commands (of a king), chief of the administration.
प्रेषणीय: प्रेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent or dispatched.
प्रेषयत्: प्रेषयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sending forth, sending away; turning, directing (the eyes).
प्रेषयितृ: प्रेषयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, sending on a commis-sion, giving orders.
प्रेषित: प्रेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, sent forth, sent away; sent into exile, banished; sent, dispatched (on an errand); ordered, directed; turned, directed (as the eyes).
प्रेषितवत्: प्रेषितवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has sent or dispatched.
प्रेषितव्य: प्रेषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be called upon or invited (to commence a ceremony).
प्रेष्य: प्रेष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sent or dispatched, proper to be sent [cf. कार्य-प्°]; (अस्), m. a mes-senger, servant, menial, slave [cf. ग्राम-प्°]; (आ), f. a female messenger, female servant; (अम्), n. the being a servant, servitude; [cf. शूद्र-प्°।] —प्रेष्य-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, executing orders. —प्रेष्य-जन, अस्, m. servants collectively, domestics, an establishment of servants. —प्रेष्य-ता, f. or प्रेष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being a servant, servitude. —प्रेष्य-भाव, अस्, m. the state or condition of a servant, servitude. —प्रेष्य-वधू, ऊस्, f. a female servant, hand-maid; the wife of a slave. —प्रेष्य-वर्ग, अस्, m. a train of servants. —प्रेष्या-त्व, अम्, n. the state of a female servant, being a handmaid.
प्रेष्यमाण: प्रेष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being sent forth, being sent or dispatched (on an errand).
प्रैष: प्रैष, अस्, m. an invitation, order, command (especially in liturgical language, = प्रेष); sending, directing; sorrow, distress, affliction; phrenzy, in-toxication, insanity (?). —प्रैष-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. executing orders or commands, a servant.
प्रैषणिक: प्रैषणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रेषण), executing orders or commissions (as a means of livelihood), fitted for the execution of commands.
प्रैषम्: प्रैषम्, ind., Ved. in the formula प्रैषैः or इष्टिभिः प्रैषम् इच्छति, he strives to start (the sacrifice compared to an animal in the chase) with invocations or exclamations.
प्रैषिक: प्रैषिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रैष), belonging to or connected with the invitatory formulas (in liturgical language).
प्रैष्य: प्रैष्य, अस्, m. a servant, slave; (आ), f. a female servant; (अम्), n. the being a servant, servitude. —प्रैष्य-भाव, अस्, m. the state or condition of a servant, servitude.
प्रेहण: प्रेहण प्रेहण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ईह् with प्र), see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 4, 31.
प्रैकीय: प्रैकीय प्रैकीय (fr. प्र + एक), Nom. P. प्रैकीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रेकीय, see Vopa-deva II. 4.
प्रैय: प्रैय प्रैय, अम्, n. an abstract noun from प्रिय, see Gaṇa Pṛthv-ādi to Pāṇ. V. 1, 122.
प्रैयक: प्रैयक, अस्, m. a patronymic from Priyaka.
प्रैयङ्गव: प्रैयङ्गव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रियङ्गु), Ved. relating to panic-grass.
प्रैयमेध: प्रैयमेध, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. an adj. from प्रिय-मेध; (अस्), m., N. of a Sāman; a patro-nymic of Sindhu-kṣit.
प्रैयरूपक: प्रैयरूपक, अम्, n. an abstract noun from प्रिय-रूप।
प्रैयव्रत: प्रैयव्रत, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to Priya-vrata; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Priya-vrata.
प्रैय्यङ्गव: प्रैय्यङ्गव, a wrong form for प्रैयङ्गव, q. v.
प्रैय्यमेध: प्रैय्यमेध, अस्, m. a patronymic; (अस्, ई, अम्), a wrong form for प्रैयमेध, q. v.
प्रोक्त: प्रोक्त प्रोक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्र-वच्), spoken to, addressed; announced, declared, laid down as a rule or axiom, said, told, uttered. —प्रोक्त-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing what one has been told.
प्रोक्तवत्: प्रोक्तवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has said or declared.
प्रोच्यमान: प्रोच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being declared or an-nounced, being uttered or said.
प्रोक्ष्: प्रोक्ष् प्रोक्ष् (प्र-उक्ष्), cl. 6. P. A. प्रोक्-षति, -ते, प्रोक्षितुम्, to sprinkle upon, besprinkle, sprinkle; to consecrate (by sprinkling), consecrate as a sacrificial victim; to sacrifice, kill, slay, slaughter (a sacrificial victim): Caus. प्रोक्षयति, -यितुम्, to sprinkle, sprinkle with.
प्रोक्षण: प्रोक्षण, अम्, n. the act of sprinkling with water (for purification), sprinkling, consecration by sprinkling (of a sacrifical animal or of a dead body before burial); immolation of victims, killing animals in sacrifice; a text to be repeated at an animal sacri-fice; (ई), f. (generally used in pl.) water for sprinkling, holy water, water for consecrating (mixed with rice and barley grains). —प्रोक्षणी-पात्र, अम्, n. a vessel for sprinkling water, &c.
प्रोक्षणीय: प्रोक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sprinkled, fit to be sprinkled; (अम्), n. water used for consecrating.
प्रोक्षत्: प्रोक्षत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. sprinkling, consecrating.
प्रोक्षित: प्रोक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled, purified by sprinkling; offered in sacrifice; immolated, killed, slaughtered.
प्रोक्षितव्य: प्रोक्षितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sprinkled, to be consecrated.
प्रोघीय: प्रोघीय प्रोघीय (प्र-ओघ), Nom. P. प्रो-घीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रौघीय, see Vopa-deva II. 4.
प्रोच्चण्ड: प्रोच्चण्ड प्रोच्चण्ड (प्र-उच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly terrible or horrible, very violent.
प्रोच्चर्: प्रोच्चर् प्रोच्-चर् (प्र-उद्-चर्), cl. 1. P. -च-रति, -चरितुम्, to utter a sound, utter, pronounce: Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sound, utter a sound.
प्रोच्चरत्: प्रोच्-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, uttering a sound, uttering.
प्रोच्चारित: प्रोच्-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to sound, sounding.
प्रोच्चैस्: प्रोच्चैस् प्रोच्चैस् (प्र-उच्°), ind. exceedingly high, in a very high degree; very loudly.
प्रोच्छल्: प्रोच्छल् प्रोच्-छल् (प्र-उद्-शल्), cl. 1. A. -छलते, -छलितुम्, to spirt out, gush forth, flow forth.
प्रोच्छलत्: प्रोच्-छलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, spirting out, gushing forth, flowing or issuing forth, flowing out or up.
प्रोच्छून: प्रोच्छून प्रोच्-छून, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्वि with प्र-उद्), swelled, swollen.
प्रोच्छ्रि: प्रोच्छ्रि प्रोच्-छ्रि (प्र-उद्-श्रि), cl. 1. P. प्रोच्छ्रयति, -यितुम्, to set up, erect.
प्रोच्छ्रित: प्रोच्-छ्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, high, lofty.
प्रोज्जासन: प्रोज्जासन प्रोज्-जासन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जस् with प्र-उद्), killing, slaughter.
प्रोज्ज्वल्: प्रोज्ज्वल् प्रोज्-ज्वल् (प्र-उद्-ज्वल्), cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति, -ज्वलितुम्, to shine brightly, flash, glitter.
प्रोज्झ्: प्रोज्झ् प्रोज्झ् (प्र-उज्झ्), cl. 6. P. प्रोज्झति, प्रोज्झितुम्, to abandon, forsake, avoid, shun, leave, quit, escape.
प्रोज्झन: प्रोज्झन, अम्, n. abandoning, forsaking, leaving, quitting, letting go.
प्रोज्झित: प्रोज्झित, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, forsaken, quitted, shunned, avoided.
प्रोञ्छ्: प्रोञ्छ् प्रोञ्छ् (प्र-उञ्छ्), cl. 1. 6. P. प्रोञ्-छति, प्रोञ्छितुम्, to wipe out, efface.
प्रोञ्छन: प्रोञ्छन, अम्, n. wiping out, wiping away, effacing; picking up the remnants; [cf. उञ्छन, and cf. also Kullūka on Manu II. 241.]
प्रोड्डी: प्रोड्डी प्रोड्-डी (प्र-उद्-डी), cl. 1. 4. A. -ड-यते, -डीयते, -डयितुम्, to fly up, fly away, fly off.
प्रोड्डीन: प्रोड्-डीन, अस्, आ, अम्, flown up, flown away.
प्रोड्डीय: प्रोड्-डीय, ind. having flown up, having flown away.
प्राढम्: प्राढम् प्रोढम्, ind., see Gaṇa Tish-ṭhadgv-ādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 17.
प्रोण्ठ: प्रोण्ठ प्रोण्ठ, अस्, m. a spitting-pot, spit-toon.
प्रोत: प्रोत प्रोत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वे with प्र), sewed, stitched; extended lengthwise or perpendicu-larly, sewed with the threads lengthwise (as the warp of ‘a piece of cloth, opposed to ओत, q. v., which means extended horizontally or sewn with the threads crosswise as the woof of cloth;’ ओत-प्रोत in Mahā-bh. Udyoga-p. 1789 probably means ‘who is the woof and warp of the universe,’ i. e. extended every-where; according to the Scholiast ओतः प्रोतश्च = तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वं च पटे तन्तव इवानुस्यूतः); tied, strung; joined, connected; set, inlaid; trans-fixed, pierced, impaled, put on (a spit); (अम्), n. cloth, clothes. —प्रोतोत्सादन (°त-उत्°), अम्, n. a parasol, umbrella.
प्रोतय: प्रोतय, Nom. P. प्रोतयति, -यितुम्, to infix, insert.
प्रोतयित्वा: प्रोतयित्वा, ind. having infixed or inserted.
प्रोति: प्रोति, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
प्रोत्कट: प्रोत्कट प्रोत्कट (प्र-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, scil. भृत्य, a head servant, favourite servant.
प्रोत्कण्ठ: प्रोत्कण्ठ 1. प्रोत्कण्ठ (प्र-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, stretching out or lifting up the neck.
2. प्रोत्कण्ठ, Nom. Caus. P. -कण्ठयति, -यि-तुम्, to awaken longings, excite desires in (with acc.).
प्रोत्क्रुष्ट: प्रोत्क्रुष्ट प्रोत्क्रुष्ट (प्र-उत्°), अम्, n. a loud cry or uproar, loud sound (Hari-vaṃśa 13816).
प्रोत्खन्: प्रोत्खन् प्रोत्-खन् (प्र-उद्-खन्), cl. 1. P. A. -खनति, -ते, -खनितुम्, to dig up, dig through, dig out, dig open.
प्रोत्खात: प्रोत्-खात, अस्, आ, अम्, dug up, dug out.
प्रोत्खै: प्रोत्खै प्रोत्-खै (प्र-उद्-खै), cl. 1. P. -खायति, -खातुम्, to dig up, dig out.
प्रोत्तान: प्रोत्तान प्रोत्तान (प्र-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. stretched out widely.
प्रोत्तुङ्ग: प्रोत्तुङ्ग प्रोत्तुङ्ग (प्र-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, very high or lofty, elevated, prominent.
प्रोत्तॄ: प्रोत्तॄ प्रोत्-तॄ (प्र-उद्-तॄ), cl. 1. P. -तरति, -तरितुम्, -तरीतुम्, to cross over, pass over; to rise or come out from, emerge.
प्रोत्पत्: प्रोत्पत् प्रोत्-पत् (प्र-उद्-पत्), cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to fly up, soar aloft.
प्रोत्पन्न: प्रोत्पन्न प्रोत्-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. पद् with प्र-उद्), produced, originated, developed.
प्रोत्फुल्ल: प्रोत्फुल्ल प्रोत्फुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. फल् with प्र-उद्), widely expanded, full-blown. —प्रोत्-फुल्ल-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, having the eyes wide open.
प्रोत्फल: प्रोत्फल (प्र-उत्°), अस्, m. a species of tree resembling the fan-palm.
प्रोत्सद्: प्रोत्सद् प्रोत्-सद् (प्र-उद्-सद्), Caus. P. -सादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to perish, destroy, re-move; to pacify, appease (anger); to draw forth.
प्रोत्सादन: प्रोत्-सादन, अम्, n. causing to perish, destroying; contriving, device (?).
प्रोत्साद्य: प्रोत्-साद्य, ind. having destroyed; having drawn forth.
प्रोत्सह्: प्रोत्सह् प्रोत्-सह् (प्र-उद्-सह्), cl. 1. P. A. -सहति, -ते, -सहितुम्, -सोढुम्, to make effort, exert one's self; to take courage, take heart: Caus. -साहयति, -यितुम्, to incite, instigate, inspirit; to exhort.
प्रोत्साह: प्रोत्-साह, अस्, m. any great exertion or effort, great zeal, ardour; stimulus, incitement.
प्रोत्साहक: प्रोत्-साहक, अस्, m. an instigator, inciter, ex-horter; (in law) the instigator of any crime.
प्रोत्साहन: प्रोत्-साहन, अम्, n. the act of inspiriting or inciting, instigation, stimulating to bold and vigorous effort.
प्रोत्साहित: प्रोत्-साहित, अस्, आ, अम्, incited, instigated, stimu-lated, encouraged.
प्रोत्सृ: प्रोत्सृ प्रोत्-सृ (प्र-उद्-सृ), Caus. P. -सा-रयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go forwards, urge on, incite; to exhort; to offer, grant, give.
प्रोत्सारण: प्रोत्-सारण, अम्, n. sending away, removing, getting rid of, clearing away, expelling.
प्रोत्सारित: प्रोत्-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, urged forwards, incited; removed, got rid of, ejected, expelled; offered, granted, given; relinquished.
प्रोत्सार्यमाण: प्रोत्-सार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being urged on or incited.
प्रोथ्: प्रोथ् प्रोथ्, cl. 1. P. A. प्रोथति, -ते, प्रोथितुम्, to pant, neigh, whinny, snort (as a horse, Ved.); to be equal to, be a match for, be able to withstand (with dat. or gen.); to be able, to be adequate or competent; to be full, be complete or ample; to subdue, overpower; to destroy: Intens. (in pres. part. पोप्रुथत्), Ved. to neigh, snort; to champ; (Sāy. = घास-भक्षणानन्तर-भावि-नम् ओष्ठ-शब्दं कृ।)
प्रोथ: प्रोथ, अस्, अम्, m. n. (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 12, fr. rt. प्रु), the nostrils of a horse, the nose of a horse or the tip of it; the snout of a hog; (अस्), m. the loins or hip; the womb (?); an embryo; an excavation or cave; a petticoat, old clothes; terror, fright; (अस्, आ, अम्), travelling, wayfaring, a traveller; notorious, famous; placed, fixed.
प्रोथथ: प्रोथथ, अस्, m., Ved. panting, snorting.
प्रोदि: प्रोदि प्रोद्-इ (प्र-उद्-इ), cl. 2. P. -एति, -एतुम्, to go up, rise.
प्रोद्गम्: प्रोद्गम् प्रोद्-गम् (प्र-उद्-गम्), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to extend forward, jut out, project, overhang.
प्रोद्गत: प्रोद्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, projecting, prominent.
प्रोद्गै: प्रोद्गै प्रोद्-गै (प्र-उद्-गै), cl. 1. P. -गा-यति, -गातुम्, to begin to sing.
प्रोद्गीत: प्रोद्-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, begun to be sung.
प्रोद्घुष्: प्रोद्घुष् प्रोद्-घुष् (प्र-उद्-घुष्), cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -घोषितुम्, to sound forth, resound; to fill with cries: Caus. -घोषयति, -यितुम्, to cause to resound, cause to sound forth; to proclaim loudly, proclaim.
प्रोद्घुष्ट: प्रोद्-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, resounding, resonant, sounding forth; making a loud noise.
प्रोद्घोषण: प्रोद्-घोषण, अम्, आ, n. f. sounding or crying aloud; causing to sound forth, proclaiming, procla-mation.
प्रोद्घोषयत्: प्रोद्-घोषयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to sound forth, proclaiming loudly, proclaiming.
प्रोद्दाम: प्रोद्दाम प्रोद्दाम (प्र-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, unbounded, immense, vast, huge.
प्रोद्धृ: प्रोद्धृ प्रोद्-धृ (प्र-उद्-हृ), cl. 1. P. A. -धरति, -ते, -धर्तुम्, to lift up, draw up (water from a well); to save, extricate.
प्रोद्बुद्ध: प्रोद्बुद्ध प्रोद्-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. बुध् with प्र-उद्), awakened (in a metaphorical sense).
प्रोद्बोध: प्रोद्-बोध, अस्, m. awaking, appearing, appear-ance.
प्रोद्भिद्: प्रोद्भिद् प्रोद्-भिद् (प्र-उद्°), cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति, -भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to break forth, burst forth.
प्रोद्भिन्न: प्रोद्-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken forth, burst forth; germinated, standing erect.
प्रोद्भूत: प्रोद्भूत प्रोद्-भूत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. भू with प्र-उद्), sprung up, arisen.
प्रोद्यम्: प्रोद्यम् प्रोद्-यम् (प्र-उद्-यम्), cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्, to lift up, raise; to throw for-wards, throw, cast.
प्रोद्यत: प्रोद्-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, lifted up, raised.
प्रोद्वाह: प्रोद्वाह प्रोद्-वाह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वह् with प्र-उद्), marriage.
प्रोन्नद्: प्रोन्नद् प्रोन्-नद् (प्र-उद्-नद्), cl. 1. P. -नदति, -नदितुम्, to roar out, roar.
प्रोन्नम्: प्रोन्नम् प्रोन्-नम् (प्र-उद्-नम्), Caus. P. -नमयति, -यितुम्, to raise up, erect.
प्रोन्नत: प्रोन्-नत, अस्, आ, अम्, raised up, elevated, very high, towering, very lofty; projecting; superior to.
प्रोन्नमित: प्रोन्-नमित, अस्, आ, अम्, raised up, erected.
प्रोन्नम्य: प्रोन्-नम्य, ind. having raised up or erected.
प्रोन्नी: प्रोन्नी प्रोन्-नी (प्र-उद्-नी), cl. 1. P. A. -न-यति, -ते, -नेतुम्, to bring up, lead up, raise, elevate.
प्रोन्मद्: प्रोन्मद् प्रोन्-मद् (प्र-उद्-मद्), cl. 4. P. -माद्यति, -मदितुम्, to begin to grow furious, begin to rut (as an elephant).
प्रोन्माथिन्: प्रोन्माथिन् प्रोन्-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. मथ् with प्र-उद्), destroying, annihilating.
प्रोन्मील्: प्रोन्मील् प्रोन्-मील् (प्र-उद्-मील्), cl. 1. P. -मीलति, -मीलितुम्, Ved. to open the eyes, open (as a flower), blossom; come to light, appear: Caus. -मीलयति, -यितुम्, to open the eyes; to unfold, reveal, bring to light, discover.
प्रोभ्: प्रोभ् प्रोभ् or प्रोम्भ् (प्र-उभ् or प्र-उम्भ्), cl. 6. P. प्रोभति, प्रोम्भति, प्रोभितुम्, प्रोम्भितुम्, Ved. to bind.
प्रोम्भित: प्रोम्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound; filled (?).
प्रोर्णु: प्रोर्णु प्रोर्णु (प्र-ऊर्णु), cl. 2. P. A. प्रोर्-णोति, प्रोर्णौति, प्रोर्णुते, प्रोर्णवितुम्, प्रोर्णु-वितुम्, (P.) to cover over, cover up, cover, envelop; (A.) to be covered: Intens. प्रोर्णोनूयते, to cover or envelop completely.
प्रोर्णुनविषु: प्रोर्णुनविषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to cover or conceal.
प्रोर्णुनूषु: प्रोर्णुनूषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to cover.
प्रोर्णुवत्: प्रोर्णुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, covering over, covering, enveloping.
प्रोर्णुवितृ: प्रोर्णुवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who covers or envelops.
प्रोल्लस्: प्रोल्लस् प्रोल्-लस् (प्र-उद्-लस्), cl. 1. P. -ल-सति, -लसितुम्, to shine brightly, glitter.
प्रोल्लसत्: प्रोल्-लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining brightly, glit-tering.
प्रोल्लाघित: प्रोल्लाघित प्रोल्-लाघित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. लाघ् with प्र-उद्), recovered from sickness, con-valescent, strong, robust.
प्रोल्लिखत्: प्रोल्लिखत् प्रोल्-लिखत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत् (fr. rt. लिख् with प्र-उद्), making lines or scratches, marking.
प्रोल्लेखन: प्रोल्-लेखन, अम्, n. drawing marks or lines, scratching, marking.
प्रोषित: प्रोषित प्रोषित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 6. वस् with प्र), sojourning abroad or in a foreign country, away from home, absent, abroad. —प्रोषित-त्रास, अस्, m. fear of one who is absent. —प्रोषित-भर्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, whose husband is abroad. —प्रोषित-मरण, अम्, n. dying abroad or in a foreign country. —प्रोषित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, sojourn-ing away from home, strange, a stranger.
प्रोष्य: प्रोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. moving to distant places, flowing onwards (as water; perhaps connected with rt. 1. प्रुष्). —प्रोष्य-पापीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, become worse by sojourning in a foreign country, deteriorated by living abroad.
प्रोष्य प्रोष्य। See under प्रोषित above.
प्रोष्ठ: प्रोष्ठ प्रोष्ठ, अस्, m. (perhaps a contrac-tion for a form प्राव-स्थ fr. rt. स्था with प्र-अव), a bench, stool; a bull, an ox; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (अस्, ई), m. f. a sort of carp, Cyprinus Pausius (= शफरी). —प्रोष्ठ-पद, अस्, आ, m. f. (also ए, f. du., आस्, pl.), ‘the foot of a stool,’ N. of a double Nakṣatra or of the third and fourth lunar mansions, the month Bhādra or August-September; (also called पूर्व-भाद्रपदा and उत्तर-भाद्रपदा; cf. नक्षत्र, भाद्र-पदा।) —प्रोष्ठ-पाद, अस्, ई, अम्, one whose feet rest on a bench; born under the Nakṣatra Proṣṭha-padā. —प्रोष्ठे-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sleeping on a couch; (Sāy.) = प्राङ्गणे शयानः, sleeping or lying in a court-yard.
प्रोष्ठिक: प्रोष्ठिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
प्रोष्ण: प्रोष्ण प्रोष्ण (प्र-उष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ex-ceedingly hot, burning hot, scorching.
प्रोह्: प्रोह् प्रोह् (प्र-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्), cl. 1. P. प्रोहति, प्रोहितुम्, Ved. to push forward, push away, (according to Mahī-dhara = निर्-आकृ); to throw down; (प्रोहति = पातयति।)
प्रोह: 1. प्रोह in प्रोह-करटा, f. (प्रोह, 2nd sing. Impv. of प्रोह्), a various reading for प्रेहि-कटा, q. v. —प्रोह-कर्दमा, f. a ceremony at which impurity is cleared away (see Gaṇa Mayūra-vyaṃsa-kādi to Pāṇ. II. 1, 72).

प्रोह 2. प्रोह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with प्र), logical reasoning; an elephant's foot; the ankle of an elephant; a joint, a knot; (अस्, आ, अम्), skilful, clever; reasoning logically, a reasoner, disputant.
प्रोहण: प्रोहण, अम्, n. the act of pushing away (?).
प्रोह्यपदि: प्रोह्य-पदि, ind. (perhaps) by or in pushing away the foot (Gaṇa Dvidaṇḍy-ādi to Pāṇ. V. 4, 128).
प्रोहणीय: प्रोहणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reasoned or argued.
प्रौह: प्रौह, अस्, ई, अम्, clever, skilful; (अस्), m. con-sideration, reflection; a good argument; the foot of an elephant; a joint.
प्रौह प्रौह। See under 2. प्रोह, col. 2.
प्रौक्त: प्रौक्त प्रौक्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रोक्त), having the sense of ‘proclaimed by’ (said of a suffix).
प्रौघीय: प्रौघीय प्रौघीय (fr. प्र + ओघ), Nom. P. प्रौघीयति, -यितुम्, = प्रोघीय, see Vopa-deva II. 4.
प्रौढ: प्रौढ प्रौढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वह् with प्र), grown up, full-grown, fully developed, matured, perfected; mature, adult, old; married; luxuriant (as a plant); great, grand, mighty, strong; impulsive, impetuous, violent; thick, dense (as darkness); full (as the moon); filled with, full of, (at the end of comps.; cf. मृदु-प्°); confident, bold, arrogant, audacious, impudent; forward; raised up, lifted up; controverted; an epithet of one of the seven Ullāsas in the Kulārṇava-tantra; (in music) an epithet of one of the seven Rūpakas; प्रौढम् ब्राह्म-णम्, the great Brāhmaṇa; (आ), f. a married woman from thirty to fifty-five years of age; a violent or impetuous woman (described as a Nāyikā who stands in no awe of her lover or husband). —प्रौ-ढ-चरित-नामन्, आनि, n. pl., N. of a work by Vallabha Ācārya on the titles of Kṛṣṇa derived from one hundred and twenty-eight of his exploits during adolescence. —प्रौढ-त्व, अम्, n. confi-dence, arrogance. —प्रौढ-पाद, अस्, ई, अम्, one whose feet are raised on a bench; [cf. प्रोष्ठ-पाद।] —प्रौढ-पुष्प, अस्, आ, अम्, having blossoms full-grown (as a tree). —प्रौढ-प्रताप, अस्, आ, अम्, of mighty prowess, renowned in arms. —प्रौ-ढप्रताप-मार्तण्ड, N. of a work attributed to Pratāpa-rudra Gaja-pati on the appropriate seasons for the worship of Viṣṇu. —प्रौढ-प्रिया, f. a bold or confident mistress; (according to Malli-nātha = प्रगल्भ-कान्ता।) —प्रौढ-मनोरमा, f., N. of a commentary by Bhaṭṭoji-dīkṣita on his own work the Siddhānta-Kaumudī. —प्रौढ-यौवन, अस्, आ, अम्, in the prime or bloom of youth. —प्रौ-ढ-वाद, अस्, m. an arrogant expression. —प्रौ-ढाङ्गना (°ढ-अङ्°), f. a bold or impulsive woman. —प्रौढान्त (°ढ-अन्°), N. of one of the seven Ullāsas in the Kulārṇava-tantra. —प्रौ-ढोक्ति (°ढ-उक्°), इस्, f. a bold expression or speech.
प्रौढि: प्रौढि, इस्, f. growth, increase; maturity, per-fect state (of body or mind); full development, elevation, greatness, grandeur; sense of power, self-confidence, feeling of security, arrogance; audacity, boldness; zeal, enterprise, exertion; investigation, controversy, discussion. —प्रौढि-वाद, अस्, m. a bold assertion, confident affirmation; a pompous speech.
प्रौढीभू: प्रौढी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to grow up, increase, come to maturity. —प्रौढी-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, growing up, coming to matu-rity. —प्रौढी-भविष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to arrive at maturity.
प्रौण: प्रौण प्रौण, अस्, आ, अम्, clever, learned, skilful; [cf. प्रौह, प्रोह।]
प्रौष्ठ: प्रौष्ठ प्रौष्ठ, अस्, m. a patronymic from Proṣṭha.
प्रौष्ठपद: प्रौष्ठपद, अस्, m. (fr. प्रोष्ठ-पद), scil. मास, the month Bhādra (August-September); N. of one of Kuvera's treasure-keepers; N. of a Pari-śiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda; (ई), f., scil. पौर्ण-मासी, full moon in the month Bhādra.
प्रौष्ठपदिक: प्रौष्ठपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्रोष्ठ-पदा), see Pāṇ. IV. 2, 35.
प्रौष्ठिक: प्रौष्ठिक, अस्, m. a patronymic from Prosh-ṭhika.
प्लक: प्लक प्लक, अस्, m., Ved. in कश-प्लकौ, pudenda muliebria.
प्लक्ष्: प्लक्ष् प्लक्ष्, cl. 1. P. A. प्लक्षति, -ते, &c., to eat, consume; (a various reading for भक्ष्।)
प्लक्ष: प्लक्ष प्लक्ष, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. प्लुष्, to burn), the waved-leaf fig-tree or Ficus Infec-toria (a large and beautiful tree with small white fruit); the holy fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa; the tree Hibiscus Populneoides, Thespesia Populneoides; a side door, private or back door; the space at the side of a door; one of the seven Dvīpas or continents into which the world is divided; N. of a man; (आ), f. a N. of the river Sarasvatī. —प्लक्ष-जाता, f. ‘rising near the fig-tree,’ an epithet of the Sarasvatī. —प्लक्ष-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of pil-grimage. —प्लक्ष-प्रस्रवण, अम्, n. ‘the fig-tree source,’ N. of the place where the Sarasvatī takes its rise. —प्लक्ष-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the fig-trees,’ N. of the place where the Sarasvatī becomes visible. —प्लक्ष-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, surrounded by fig-trees (Ficus Infectoria); (अती), f., N. of a river (perhaps the Sarasvatī). —प्लक्ष-समुद्र-वा-चका, f. an epithet of the river Sarasvatī. —प्लक्ष-स्रवण, अम्, n., N. of the place where the Saras-vatī becomes visible; [cf. प्लक्ष-प्रस्रवण।] —प्लक्षावतरण (°ष-अव्°), अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
प्लक्षकीय: प्लक्षकीय, see Gaṇa Naḍādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 91.
प्लाक्ष: प्लाक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to the waved-leaf fig-tree (Ficus Infectoria); (अम्), n. the fruit of the waved-leaf fig-tree and of the various trees called Plaksha; (अस्), m. a patronymic from Plākṣi.
प्लाक्षकि: प्लाक्षकि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Plaksha.
प्लाक्षायण: प्लाक्षायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Plākṣi.
प्लाक्षि: प्लाक्षि, इस्, ई, m. f. a patronymic from Plaksha.
प्लति: प्लति प्लति, इस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.
प्लात: प्लात, अस्, m. a patronymic from Plati.
प्लब्: प्लब् प्लब् or प्लव्, cl. 1. A. प्लबते, प्ल-वते, &c., to float, = rt. प्लु, q. v.
प्लयोग: प्लयोग प्लयोग (= प्र-योग?), अस्, m., N. of a man.
प्लायोगि: प्लायोगि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Āsaṅga.
प्लव: प्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, swimming, floating; leaping, jumping, one who goes by leaps or jumps, a tumbler; superior, excellent (Ved.); (अस्), m. the act of swimming, floating, diving, bathing [cf. जल-प्°, धरणी-प्°]; flooding, a flood, the swelling of a river; suffusion, (नयन-प्°, suffusion or swimming of the eyes); jumping, leaping, plunging, going by leaps or plunges; a float, raft, boat, canoe, small ship; a snare or basket of wicker-work for catching fish (= पलव); a kind of aquatic bird, Pelicanus Fusicollis (= गात्र-सम्प्लव); a kind of duck (= कारण्डव); = जल-वायस; = जल-काक; = जल-कुक्कुट; a frog; a monkey; a sheep; a man of low or degraded tribe, a Cāṇḍāla; an enemy; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria (= प्लक्ष); a kind of weapon; the thirty-fifth (or ninth) year in a cycle of Jupiter; N. of various Sāmans; the prolated utterance of a vowel; protracting a sentence through three or more Ślokas (= कुलक); a kind of metre; a declivity, slope, shelving ground; proclivity, incli-nation; returning, return; urging on, inciting; (अम्), n. a species of grass, Cyperus Rotundus; a kind of fragrant grass (= गन्ध-तृण); [cf. Gr. πλόος, πλοῖον; Hib. falc, ‘a flood.’] —प्लव-ग, अस्, m. ‘going by leaps,’ a frog; an ape, monkey; a sort of aquatic bird, the diver; the plant Acacia Sirissa (= शिरीष); N. of the charioteer of the Sun; of a son of the Sun; (आ), f. the sign of the zodiac Virgo. —प्लव-गति, इस्, f. going by leaps and jumps; (इस्), m. a frog. —प्लवङ्-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘going by leaps,’ an epithet of fire as flickering; (अस्), m. an ape, baboon, monkey; a deer; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria; N. of the forty-first (or fifteenth) year in a sixty years' cycle of Jupiter. —प्लवङ्-गम, अस्, m. ‘going by leaps,’ a frog; an ape, monkey; (आ), f. a kind of metre. —प्लवङ्-गमेन्दु (°म-इन्°), उस्, m. ‘moon among the apes,’ an epithet of Hanumat. —प्लव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing a ship, owner of a boat.
प्लाय: प्लाय प्लाय। See under प्ले, col. 3.
प्लाय, अस्, m., Ved. = प्राय, abundance, q. v.
प्लाव: प्लाव, अस्, m. flowing over; filling a vessel till it overflows; submersion; jumping.
प्लाशि: प्लाशि प्लाशि, इस्, m., Ved. a particular part of the intestines; (according to Mahī-dhara = शिश्न or शिश्न-मूल-नाड्यः।)
प्लाशुक: प्लाशुक प्लाशुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. प्लाशु = प्राशु), Ved. growing rapidly; (according to the Scholiasts) growing again, springing up again.
प्लाशुचित्: प्लाशुचित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. quick, speedy; [cf. प्राशु।]
प्लिह्: प्लिह् प्लिह्, cl. 1. A. प्लेहते, पिप्लिहे, प्ले-हितुम्, to go, move.
प्लीहन्: प्लीहन्, आ, m. the spleen (which with the liver is regarded by the Hindūs as the part of the body from which the blood flows); disease of the spleen (said to be equally applied to enlargement of the mesenteric glands, &c.); [cf. Gr. σπλήν, σπλάγχ-νο-ν; Lat. lien; Bohem. slez-ina; Lith. bluz-ni-s; Eng. spleen.] —प्लीह-घ्न, अस्, or प्लीह-शत्रु, उस्, m. ‘destroying spleen’ or ‘enemy to spleen,’ N. of a medicinal plant, Amoora Rohitaka (commonly Rohera or Rohinī). —प्लीहा-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) suffering from a particular disease of the ear called प्लीहन्. —प्लीहारि (°ह-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy to spleen,’ the holy fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa. —प्लीहोदर (°ह-उद्°), अम्, n. enlargement of the spleen, disease of the spleen. —प्लीहोदरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, affected with enlargement or disease of the spleen, splenetic.
प्ली: प्ली प्ली, cl. 9. P. प्लिनाति, &c., to go, move.
प्लु: प्लु प्लु, cl. 1. A. (in poetry sometimes also P.) प्लवते (-ति), पुप्लुवे, प्लोष्यते, अप्लोष्ट (2nd pl. अप्लोढ्वम्), प्लोषीष्ट, प्लो-तुम्, to float, swim; to go in a boat, cross in a boat, navigate; to bathe; to sway to and fro, vibrate, hover, soar, fly; to fly away, haste away; to blow (as the wind); to fade away, disappear; to leap, jump, spring, (in these senses originally प्रु); to hop, skip, dance; to spring over, jump over, leap across, spring upon, spring down; to be length-ened or prolated (as a vowel): Caus. P. प्लावयति, यितुम्, Aor. अपुप्लवत्, अपिप्लवत्, to cause to float or swim, flood, deluge, inundate, submerge; to pour water upon, sprinkle, bathe, wash; to wash away, remove; to cause to leap; to cause to stagger; to lengthen, prolate (a vowel): Pass. of Caus. प्लाव्-यते, to be deluged, to be overflowed, to be inun-dated: Desid. of Caus. पिप्लावयिषति, पुप्लावयि-षति: Desid. पुप्लूषते: Intens. पोप्लूयते, पोप्लोति, to float about, swim about; to swim rapidly; [cf. Gr. πλέ-ω, πλεύ-σομαι, πλό-ο-ς, πλω-τό-ς, πλώ-τη-ς, πλύν-ω, πλῦ-μα, πλυ-τό-ς, πλυν-τήρ, πύελος; perhaps λού-ω for πλού-ω: Lat. plu-i-t, pluv-ia, flu-o, fle-o, plôra-re, linter; perhaps fund-o for plund-o; perhaps pluma; probably lav-o for plav-o: Old Lat. per-plov-ere: Umbr. pre-plo-tutu, ‘overflowed:’ Goth. flô-du-s, ‘a river:’ Old Germ. flew-iu, ‘float;’ fliu-z-u, ‘flow;’ fluz, perhaps flug: Angl. Sax. fleot, fleowan, flod, fleogan, fliogan, fleón, flión, aet-flowan, fleotan; Iceland. flut: Old Slav. plov-a, plou-ti, ‘to sail;’ plu-ti, ‘to swim:’ Russ. plavaju, ‘I swim:’ Lith. pláu-j-u, plau-ti, ‘to wash off;’ plaú-t-is; plú-sti, ‘to swim:’ Hib. plod, ‘a fleet;’ plodaim, ‘I float;’ perhaps lua = Gaelic lu, ‘water;’ luathaim, ‘I hasten, I move;’ falcaim, ‘I bathe;’ luan, ‘a woman's breast:’ Gaelic plucas, ‘a flux, ventris fluxio.’]
प्लवक: प्लवक, अस्, m. a frog; a tumbler, a dancer, a man who walks on the edge of a sword, a rope-dancer, &c.; an outcast, a Cāṇḍāla; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria.
प्लवन: प्लवन, अम्, n. swimming, plunging into, bathing; a deluge, inundation; jumping, leaping, plunging; capering, one of a horse's paces; flying; declivity, inclination; (अस्, आ, अम्), inclined, stooping down, (at the end of comps.; cf. प्राग्-उदक्-प्°।)
प्लवमान: प्लवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, floating, swimming; going in a boat, crossing in a boat; bathing; hover-ing, soaring; blowing (as the wind); fading away, disappearing; leaping, springing, bounding.
प्लवाका: प्लवाका, f. a boat, a raft.
प्लविक: प्लविक, अस्, आ, अम्, ferrying over in a boat, a ferryman.
प्लवितृ: प्लवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, leaping, springing, a leaper.
प्लावन: प्लावन, अम्, n. bathing, immersion, ablution; filling a vessel till it overflows, flooding, deluging; inundation, flood, deluge; [cf. जल-प्°।]
प्लावयत्: प्लावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to float, flooding, inundating.
प्लावयितृ: प्लावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes to swim, causing to cross or go in a boat.
प्लावित: प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to float, made to swim; made to overflow; overflowed, deluged, inundated, flooded; moistened, soaked; covered with; [cf. रुधिर-प्°।]
प्लाविन्: प्लाविन्, ई, m. spreading, promulgating; (ई), m. a bird.
प्लाव्य: 1. प्लाव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be submerged or inun-dated; to be steeped or soaked in anything (with inst.); to be jumped or leaped.
2. प्लाव्य, ind. having caused to float or swim; having immersed or flooded; having washed away.
प्लुत: प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, floated, floating or swimming in [cf. उद-प्°]; bathed in; inundated, submerged, overflowed, wet; covered with, filled with [cf. म-धु-प्°, रजः-प्°]; flown; jumped, leaped, one who has leaped, gone by leaps or jumps; protracted, prolated, continuous or lengthened to three Mātrās or prosodial instants (as a vowel in pronunciation, cf. मात्रा); (अम्), n. leaping, jumping, tumbling; bounding, vaulting; capering, one of a horse's paces. —प्लुत-गति, इस्, f. going by jumps or leaps; a bounding motion, galloping, a gallop; (इस्), m. a hare.
प्लुतवत्: प्लुतवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has leaped or jumped.
प्लुति: प्लुति, इस्, f. overflowing, a flood; a leap, jump, skip, hop; bounding, capering, curvet, one of a horse's paces; prolation (of a vowel).
प्लुष्: प्लुष् प्लुष् [cf. rt. 1. प्रुष्], cl. 1. 4. 9. P. प्लोषति, प्लुष्यति, प्लुष्णाति, पुप्लो-ष, प्लोषितुम्, to burn, scorch, singe; cl. 9. P. to sprinkle; to anoint, embrocate; to fill.
प्लुक्षि: प्लुक्षि, इस्, m. fire; the god of fire (?); the burning of a house; oil.
प्लुषि: प्लुषि, इस्, m., Ved. a species of noxious insect; (according to Mahī-dhara = पुत्तिका; according to another Scholiast = वक्र-तुण्ड।)
प्लुष्ट: प्लुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, burned, scorched, singed.
प्लुष्टाय: प्लुष्टाय, Nom. A. प्लुष्टायते, -यितुम्, = प्लुष्टां कृ; (perhaps an incorrect form for प्लुष्वाय = प्रुष्वाय।)
प्लोष: प्लोष प्लोष। See under rt. प्लुष् above.
प्लोषण: प्लोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, burning, scorching, singeing.
प्लुस्: प्लुस् प्लुस्, cl. 4. P. प्लुस्यति, &c., to burn, (a various reading for प्लुष्); to share.
प्ले: प्ले प्ले (rt. 5. इ with प्ल for प्र) = प्रे, q. v.
प्लेङ्ख: प्लेङ्ख प्लेङ्ख, Ved. = प्रेङ्ख, a swing.
प्लेव्: प्लेव् प्लेव् [cf. rts. पेब्, पेव्, सेव्], cl. 1. A. प्लेवते, &c., to serve, wait upon.
प्लोत: प्लोत प्लोत, अम्, n. (probably = प्रोत), cloth, stuff; a bandage.
प्सरस्: प्सरस् प्सरस्। See under rt. 1. प्सा below.

प्सरस्, अस्, n., Ved. a favourite dish or kind of food, feast, enjoyment, (occurring in connection with महि; cf. मधु-प्°); food, sacrificial food; देव-प्सरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. being a pleasure for the gods, delightful to the gods.
प्सा: प्सा 1. प्सा, cl. 2. P. प्साति (3rd pl. Impf. अप्सुस् or अप्सान्), पप्सौ, प्सास्यति, अप्-सासीत्, प्सायात् or प्सेयात्, प्सातुम्, Ved. to chew, masticate, eat, consume; to go; [cf. Old Germ. spīsa, ‘food;’ Mod. Germ. speise.]
प्सात: प्सात, अस्, आ, अम्, chewed, eaten; hungry.
प्सुर्: प्सुर्, र्, f. or प्सुरस्, अस्, n., Ved. (perhaps) fruit, (according to Sāy. an epithet of Indra, = रूप-वत् which would come under प्सु below); [cf. Zend fshu.]
प्सु: प्सु प्सु, Ved. form, aspect, (at the end of comps.; cf. अरुण-प्सु, ऋत-प्सु।)
पस्पृधान: पस्पृधान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. contending with, rivaling, a rival, opponent, enemy (Ved.).
पङ्कय: पङ्कय, Nom. P. पङ्कयति, -यितुम्, to make muddy, bemire.
पणयितृ: पणयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who buys, a purchaser.
पराङ्गना: पराङ्गना (°र-अङ्°), f. the wife of another, a wife.
परासेध: परा-सेध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. सिध् with पर; cf. 2. सेध), restraint, confinement, imprisonment.
परिज्वल्: परि-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति, &c., to shine very brightly, glow.
परिलोलित: परिलोलित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about, tossed about.
परिशान्त्व्: परि-शान्त्व्, cl. 10. P. A. -शान्त्वयति, -ते, &c., to console, comfort, soothe, conciliate.
परिषिक्त: परि-षिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled about, diffused.
पारमार्थ्य: पारमार्थ्य, अम्, n. (fr. परमार्थ), the complete truth.
पितृमात्रर्थ: पितृ-मात्रर्थ (°तृ-अर्°), अस्, m. one who seeks to provide a maintenance for his father and mother.
पितृसद्मन्: पितृ-सद्मन्, अ, n. the abode of the Pitṛs, a cemetery.
पिशङ्गित: पिशङ्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, made brown or red, em-browned, reddened.
पीडाभाज्: पीडा-भाज्; possessing marks of pressure or wavy indentations.
पूतन: पूतन, अस्, m. a kind of evil spirit; [cf. पूतना।]
पूर्णमुख: पूर्ण-मुख; add — a kind of bird.
पृथूकृ: पृथू-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to expand, ex-tend, enlarge, spread out.
प्रग्रहिन्: प्र-ग्रहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, taking the reins.
प्रघोष: प्र-घोष, अस्, m. noise, din, clamour; N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa.
प्रज्वाला: प्र-ज्वाला, f. a flame, blazing up.
प्रतप: प्र-तप, अस्, m. heat, the heat of the sun.
प्रतपत्र: प्रतप-त्र, अम्, n. ‘protecting from heat,’ a parasol, umbrella.
प्रतरण: प्र-तरण, अस्, ई, अम्, crossing over; bringing forward, carrying on, furthering, promoting, increas-ing; (अम्), n. the act of crossing over, passing over by boat.
प्रतरीतृ: प्र-तरीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who causes progress, bringing on, advancing, lengthening, a promoter, furtherer.
प्रतितर्ज्: प्रति-तर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -तर्जति, &c., to menace, threaten, scold at; to challenge.
प्रतिश्रित: प्रति-श्रित, अम्, n. a protected place, shelter.
प्रत्ययलोप: प्रत्यय-लोप, अस्, m. elision of a grammatical affix or suffix.
प्रत्ययस्वर: प्रत्यय-स्वर, अस्, m. ‘suffix accent,’ an accent on a suffix or affix.
प्रत्यावृत्ति: प्रत्य्-आवृत्ति, इस्, f. turning back, return.
प्रत्याह्वय: प्रत्य्-आह्वय, अस्, m. ‘calling in reply,’ an echo.
प्रमाणकोटि: प्रमाण-कोटि, इस्, f. the point in an argument which is regarded as actual proof.
प्रमृड: प्र-मृड, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. मृड् with प्र), favourable, gracious.
प्रमोष: प्र-मोष, अस्, m. carrying off, plundering, robbery.
प्रवीविविक्षु: प्र-वीविविक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, intending to pervade or embrace.
